### [1] [Relativistic Effects of PSR J1856-0039 Double Neutron Star System in a 2.36-Hour Compact Orbit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27333)
*Yang, Z. L.,Han, J. L.,Su, W. Q.,Wang, P. F.,Wang, C.,Wang, T.,Zhou, D. J.,Yan, Yi,Xu, J.,Jing, W. C.,Cai, N. N.,Xu, R. X.,Wang, H. G.,You, X. P.*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: FAST 发现了一个新的双中子星系统 PSR J1856-0039，其轨道周期仅 2.36 小时、轨道偏心率为 0.106，测量到的相对论效应给出已知双中子星系统中最低的总质量 2.48841±0.00015 \(M_{\odot}\)，且观测到的引力波轨道衰减与广义相对论预言在 68% 置信度上一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 致密双中子星系统可作为检验引力理论和研究中子星并合的实验室；本文报告由 FAST 新发现的双中子星系统 PSR J1856--0039 的性质，以测量其相对论效应并检验引力理论预言。

Method: 摘要指出该脉冲星由五百米口径球面射电望远镜（FAST）发现，并通过后续 FAST 观测开展研究。摘要报告了对相对论效应的测量，包括轨道周期导数、近星点进动和爱因斯坦延迟，并给出了轨道参数、倾角和质量结果；摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度、计时分析流程或数据量。

Result: 该脉冲星为轻度再循环，周期 23.4 ms，处于偏心轨道（\(e=0.106\)）上，轨道周期为 2.36 小时。测得的相对论效应为 \(\dot{P}_{\mathrm{orb}}=-1.284\pm0.019\times10^{-12}\ \mathrm{s}\ \mathrm{s}^{-1}\)、\(\dot{\omega}=17.5859\pm0.0007\ \mathrm{deg}\ \mathrm{yr}^{-1}\)、\(\gamma=0.445\pm0.011\ \mathrm{ms}\)。系统轨道倾角 \(i=133.\!^{\circ}2\pm1.\!^{\circ}1\)，总质量 \(M_{\mathrm{tot}}=2.48841\pm0.00015\,M_{\odot}\)，为已知双中子星系统中最低；脉冲星质量 \(1.304\pm0.022\,M_{\odot}\)，伴星质量 \(1.185\pm0.022\,M_{\odot}\)。观测的引力波轨道衰减与广义相对论预言一致，比值 \(\dot{P}_{\mathrm{orb,obs}}^{\mathrm{GW}}/\dot{P}_{\mathrm{orb,pred}}^{\mathrm{GW}}=1.009(14)\)（68% 置信度）。

Conclusion: 作者认为，该双中子星系统的观测引力波轨道衰减与广义相对论预言在 68% 置信度上一致；该系统将在 82 Myr 后并合，并可能在自转减慢后形成稳定中子星或坍缩为黑洞，长期监测有可能探测 Lense-Thirring 进动。

Abstract: Compact double neutron star (DNS) systems are unique laboratories for testing gravitational theories and studying DNS mergers. Here we report the properties of a new DNS system, PSR J1856--0039, discovered in the Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical radio Telescope (FAST). The pulsar is mildly recycled with a period of 23.4 ms in a compact eccentric orbit (<inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>e</mml:mi><mml:mo>=</mml:mo><mml:mn>0.106</mml:mn></mml:math></inline-formula>) with an orbital period of 2.36 hours. By following up FAST observations, we measured the relativistic effects, including the orbital period derivative <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:msub><mml:mrow><mml:mover><mml:mrow><mml:mi>P</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>˙</mml:mo></mml:mrow></mml:mover></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mi>orb</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub><mml:mo>=</mml:mo><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:mn>1.284</mml:mn><mml:mo>±</mml:mo><mml:mn>0.019</mml:mn><mml:mo>×</mml:mo><mml:msup><mml:mrow><mml:mn>10</mml:mn></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:mn>12</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msup><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>s</mml:mi><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:msup><mml:mrow><mml:mi>s</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:mn>1</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msup></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula>, periastron advance <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mover><mml:mrow><mml:mi>ω</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>˙</mml:mo></mml:mrow></mml:mover><mml:mo>=</mml:mo><mml:mn>17.5859</mml:mn><mml:mo>±</mml:mo><mml:mn>0.0007</mml:mn><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>deg</mml:mi><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mrow><mml:msup><mml:mrow><mml:mi>yr</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:mn>1</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msup></mml:mrow></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula>, and Einstein delay <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>γ</mml:mi><mml:mo>=</mml:mo><mml:mn>0.445</mml:mn><mml:mo>±</mml:mo><mml:mn>0.011</mml:mn><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>ms</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula>. This DNS system has a low orbital inclination of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>i</mml:mi><mml:mo>=</mml:mo><mml:mn>133</mml:mn><mml:mover><mml:mrow><mml:mo>.</mml:mo></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>∘</mml:mo></mml:mrow></mml:mover><mml:mn>2</mml:mn><mml:mo>±</mml:mo><mml:mn>1</mml:mn><mml:mover><mml:mrow><mml:mo>.</mml:mo></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>∘</mml:mo></mml:mrow></mml:mover><mml:mn>1</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> and the lowest total mass of any known DNS, <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:msub><mml:mrow><mml:mi>M</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mi>tot</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub><mml:mo>=</mml:mo><mml:mn>2.48841</mml:mn><mml:mo>±</mml:mo><mml:mn>0.00015</mml:mn><mml:msub><mml:mrow><mml:mi>M</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>⊙</mml:mo></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula>, with a determined pulsar mass of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mn>1.304</mml:mn><mml:mo>±</mml:mo><mml:mn>0.022</mml:mn><mml:msub><mml:mrow><mml:mi>M</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>⊙</mml:mo></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> and a companion mass of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mn>1.185</mml:mn><mml:mo>±</mml:mo><mml:mn>0.022</mml:mn><mml:msub><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mo>⊙</mml:mo></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula>, one of the lowest neutron-star masses. The observed orbital decay due to gravitational-wave emission <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:msubsup><mml:mrow><mml:mover><mml:mrow><mml:mi>P</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>˙</mml:mo></mml:mrow></mml:mover></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mi>orb</mml:mi><mml:mo>,</mml:mo><mml:mi>obs</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mi>GW</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msubsup></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> and the orbital decay predicted by general relativity <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msubsup><mml:mover><mml:mi>P</mml:mi><mml:mo>˙</mml:mo></mml:mover><mml:mrow><mml:mi>orb</mml:mi><mml:mo>,</mml:mo><mml:mrow><mml:mi>pred</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:mrow><mml:mi>GW</mml:mi></mml:msubsup></mml:math></inline-formula> are consistent at a level of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:msubsup><mml:mrow><mml:mover><mml:mrow><mml:mi>P</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>˙</mml:mo></mml:mrow></mml:mover></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mi>orb</mml:mi><mml:mo>,</mml:mo><mml:mi>obs</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mi>GW</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msubsup><mml:mo>/</mml:mo><mml:msubsup><mml:mrow><mml:mover><mml:mrow><mml:mi>P</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>˙</mml:mo></mml:mrow></mml:mover></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mi>orb</mml:mi><mml:mo>,</mml:mo><mml:mrow><mml:mi>pred</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mi>GW</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msubsup><mml:mo>=</mml:mo><mml:mn>1.009</mml:mn><mml:mo>(</mml:mo><mml:mn>14</mml:mn><mml:mo>)</mml:mo></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> (68% confidence). This DNS will merge after 82 Myr and may form a stable neutron star or collapse into a black hole after spin-down. Long-term monitoring could potentially probe the Lense-Thirring precession.

### [2] [Cavendish experiment with fast radio bursts on cosmological scales](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.11022)
*Zhou, Shuren,Zhang, Pengjie*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 在遵循弱等效原理的理论框架下，局域FRB的DM可作为物质超密度 $\delta_m$ 的良好示踪量，从而提出基于FRB的估计量 $F_G$ 直接测量有效引力常数 $G_{\rm light}$；在 $k \leq 0.1\,h/{\rm Mpc}$ 截断下，于 $z \lesssim 1$ 的十个等宽红移 bins 上可达 $\lesssim 10\%\sqrt{10^5/N_{\rm FRB}}$ 的精度，FRB由此可为跨越20个数量级的空间和时间尺度上的引力物理提供启示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 外尔势 $\Psi+\Phi$ 与物质超密度 $\delta_m$ 之间的关系体现为光运动对应的有效引力常数 $G_{\rm light}$，其数值及可能的空间和时间变化对探测爱因斯坦引力之外的物理至关重要。但目前缺乏 $\delta_m$ 的无偏示踪量，阻碍了对 $G_{\rm light}$ 的直接测量，这是本工作所要解决的问题。

Method: 摘要提出在遵循弱等效原理的理论框架内，利用局域快速射电暴（FRB）的色散量（DM）作为物质超密度 $\delta_m$ 的示踪量；并提出基于FRB的估计量 $F_G$，结合局域FRB的星系DM与星系弱透镜交叉相关来直接测量 $G_{\rm light}$。分析中采用保守截断 $k \leq 0.1\,h/{\rm Mpc}$，并在 $z \lesssim 1$ 的十个等宽红移 bins 上评估测量精度。具体观测样本、望远镜、频段、时间跨度及统计方法摘要未说明。

Result: 在保守截断 $k \leq 0.1\,h/{\rm Mpc}$ 下，该测量在 $z \lesssim 1$ 的十个等宽红移 bins 上可达到 $\lesssim 10\%\sqrt{10^5/N_{\rm FRB}}$ 的精度。主要系统误差来自由FRB DM所示踪的电子的成团偏置，其在5%水平上仍为次主导；基于总重子（电离弥散气体、恒星、中性氢等）的成团偏置在足够大尺度上趋近于1这一不依赖天体物理细节的行为，该误差可进一步降低至 $\lesssim 1\%$ 的水平。

Conclusion: 在遵循弱等效原理的理论框架内，局域FRB的DM可作为 $\delta_m$ 的良好示踪量，据此提出的 $F_G$ 估计量可结合局域FRB的星系DM与星系弱透镜交叉相关直接测量 $G_{\rm light}$；主要系统误差在5%水平上仍为次主导，并可进一步降低至 $\lesssim 1\%$ 水平，因此FRB为跨越20个数量级的空间和时间尺度上的引力物理提供了启示。该工作与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱、瞬变射电发射或磁星与FRB联系的具体关系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: A key measure of gravity is the relation between the Weyl potential <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>Ψ</mml:mi><mml:mo>+</mml:mo><mml:mi>Φ</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> and the matter overdensity <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>δ</mml:mi><mml:mi>m</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula>, encapsulated as an effective gravitational constant <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>G</mml:mi><mml:mi>light</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> for light motion. Its value, along with possible spatial and temporal variations, is essential for probing physics beyond Einstein gravity. However, the absence of an unbiased proxy for <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>δ</mml:mi><mml:mi>m</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> prevents the direct measurement of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>G</mml:mi><mml:mi>light</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula>. In this work, we show that, within a theoretical framework respecting the weak equivalence principle, the dispersion measure (DM) of localized fast radio bursts (FRBs) serve as a good proxy for <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>δ</mml:mi><mml:mi>m</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula>. We further propose an FRB-based estimator <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>F</mml:mi><mml:mi>G</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> to directly measure <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>G</mml:mi><mml:mi>light</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula>, combining galaxy-DM of localized FRBs and galaxy-weak lensing cross-correlations. With a conservative cut <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>k</mml:mi><mml:mo>&lt;=</mml:mo><mml:mn>0.1</mml:mn><mml:mi>h</mml:mi><mml:mo>/</mml:mo><mml:mi>Mpc</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula>, the measurement can achieve a precision of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mo>≲</mml:mo><mml:mn>10</mml:mn><mml:mo>%</mml:mo><mml:msqrt><mml:mrow><mml:msup><mml:mn>10</mml:mn><mml:mn>5</mml:mn></mml:msup><mml:mo>/</mml:mo><mml:msub><mml:mi>N</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mi>FRB</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:mrow></mml:msqrt></mml:math></inline-formula> over ten equal-width redshift bins at <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>z</mml:mi><mml:mo>≲</mml:mo><mml:mn>1</mml:mn></mml:math></inline-formula>. The major systematic error, arising from the clustering bias of electrons traced by the FRB DM, remains subdominant at the 5% level. It can be further mitigated to the <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mo>≲</mml:mo><mml:mn>1</mml:mn><mml:mo>%</mml:mo></mml:math></inline-formula> level, based on the gastrophysics-agnostic behavior that the clustering bias of total baryons (ionized diffuse gas, stars, neutral hydrogen, etc.) approaches unity at sufficiently large scales. Therefore, FRBs shed light on gravitational physics across spatial and temporal scales spanning 20 orders of magnitude.

</details>


### [3] [Probing cosmic curvature with fast radio bursts and DESI DR2 data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.01504)
*Fortunato, Jéferson A. S.,Hipólito-Ricaldi, Wiliam S.,Romero, Gustavo E.*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该工作利用 120 个具有已知红移和 DM 的已定位 FRB，结合人工神经网络重建的 $H(z)$ 与 DESI DR2 的 BAO 测量，以不依赖宇宙学模型的方式约束空间曲率，得到 $\Omega_k = -0.31 \pm 0.57$（基于协方差）和 $\Omega_k = -0.13 \pm 0.46$（对角处理），两者在 $1\sigma$ 水平上与空间平坦性一致，但对负曲率有轻微偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 宇宙空间曲率仍是现代宇宙学的核心问题。摘要指出，本工作旨在探索已定位 FRB 作为一种新工具，以不依赖宇宙学模型的方式约束宇宙曲率参数 $\Omega_k$ 的潜力，并评估 FRB 与 BAO 结合用于探测宇宙大尺度几何的价值。

Method: 使用包含 120 个具有已知红移和色散量（DM）的 FRB 样本；通过人工神经网络重建哈勃参数 $H(z)$，并据此以两种互补方法获得角直径距离 $D_A(z)$：一是直接从 FRB 导出共动距离 $D_C(z)$ 和 $D_A(z)$，不假设基准宇宙学；二是将基于 FRB 的 $H(z)$ 与重子声学振荡（BAO）DESI DR2 测量结合以推断 $D_A(z)$。通过比较 FRB 导出与 $\mathrm{BAO}+\mathrm{FRB}$ 导出的 $D_A(z)$ 约束空间曲率，并采用基于协方差的似然（考虑相关不确定性）以及对角（高斯）处理。

Result: 基于协方差的似然（考虑相关不确定性）给出 $\Omega_k = -0.31 \pm 0.57$，而对角（高斯）处理给出 $\Omega_k = -0.13 \pm 0.46$。两种估计在 $1\sigma$ 水平上与空间平坦性一致，尽管对负曲率有轻微的偏好。摘要明确指出，明确考虑完整协方差会加宽区间，并避免低估不确定性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，这些结果凸显了 FRB 在精确宇宙学中日益增长的重要性，以及 FRB 与 BAO 的协同作用，即作为一种强有力的、不依赖宇宙学模型的大尺度宇宙几何探针。对负曲率的轻微偏好并不改变两种估计在 $1\sigma$ 水平上与空间平坦性一致这一结论。根据摘要无法判断该曲率约束对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲辐射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、脉冲星计时、自转减速力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱或 FRB 与磁星之间联系的具体物理含义。

Abstract: The spatial curvature of the Universe remains a central question in modern cosmology. In this work, we explore the potential of localized fast radio bursts (FRBs) as a novel tool to constrain the cosmic curvature parameter <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>Ω</mml:mi><mml:mi>k</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> in a cosmological model-independent way. Using a sample of 120 FRBs with known redshifts and dispersion measures, we reconstruct the Hubble parameter <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>H</mml:mi><mml:mo>(</mml:mo><mml:mi>z</mml:mi><mml:mo>)</mml:mo></mml:math></inline-formula> via artificial neural networks, and use it to obtain angular-diameter distances <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>D</mml:mi><mml:mi>A</mml:mi></mml:msub><mml:mo>(</mml:mo><mml:mi>z</mml:mi><mml:mo>)</mml:mo></mml:math></inline-formula> through two complementary approaches. First, we derive the comoving distance <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>D</mml:mi><mml:mi>C</mml:mi></mml:msub><mml:mo>(</mml:mo><mml:mi>z</mml:mi><mml:mo>)</mml:mo></mml:math></inline-formula> and <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>D</mml:mi><mml:mi>A</mml:mi></mml:msub><mml:mo>(</mml:mo><mml:mi>z</mml:mi><mml:mo>)</mml:mo></mml:math></inline-formula> directly from FRBs without assuming a fiducial cosmology. Conclusion: 作者认为，对已知PULX的定向FRB搜索将在研究FRB progenitor方面发挥重要作用；若探测到FRB，可直接解决FRB起源之谜，若未探测到，则可统计约束ULX相关模型（如爆发率上限、占空比周期），并可用于搜寻PULX中的射电脉冲星。上述推断均以拟议观测为前提，摘要未报告实际探测或约束结果；其对具体FRB—ULX物理机制的适用性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) are extragalactic radio transients with the duration time in the range of several microseconds to tens of milliseconds. The origin of them is still unclear. Ultraluminous X-ray Sources (ULXs) are objects that mostly discovered in external galaxies which host black holes or neutron stars, with isotropic luminosities exceeding the usual Eddington value for stellar-mass black holes. The host galaxies of ULXs, and their spatial offsets within their hosts, show broad similarities to those of FRB. Periodicity of days to years of some repeated FRBs could be attributed to the companion effect of ULXs. Moreover, pulsing ULXs (PULXs) which hots neutron stars may be the manifestation of accreting magnetars. Therefore, we propose targeted FRB searches of known PULXs, which have not yet been carried out by other telescopes according to published literature to date. Our observations will play an important role in investigating the FRB progenitors. If FRBs were detected in our selected ULXs, then puzzle of FRBs' origin would be directly resolved. If no FRB is detected, we can still constrain some ULX-related models statistically, e.g. the upper limit of the burst rate, the period of duty cycle, etc. Our observations can also be used to hunt for radio pulsars in PULXs.

</details>

*Yang, Z. L.,Han, J. L.,Yan, Yi,Liu, Bin,Guo, Y. L.,Yang, M. K.,Wang, Bo,Gu, Wei-Min,Li, J.,Li, L. H.,Xu, J.,Fu, Jian-Ning*

Abstract: Background: Constraining the nuclear matter equation of state (EoS) from neutron star observations is one of the main subjects in nuclear physics today. Most studies are based on the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equation, which describes a star in spherical hydrostatic equilibrium in general relativity. In general, however, neutron stars rotate rapidly and the structure of neutron stars can be affected by rotation, especially in millisecond pulsars. To better constrain the nuclear EoS, it is important to describe neutron star structure taking into account the effects of rotation in a fully relativistic manner. We explore correlations between rotational effects and EoS parameters, based on fully general relativistic calculations of rapidly rotating neutron stars. Methods: We consider the standard class of neutron stars with cores composed of neutrons, protons, electrons, and muons (<inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>n</mml:mi><mml:mi>p</mml:mi><mml:mi>e</mml:mi><mml:mi>μ</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> matter), surrounded by the crust. For the EoS, we employ Skyrme-type energy density functionals for <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>n</mml:mi><mml:mi>p</mml:mi><mml:mi>e</mml:mi><mml:mi>μ</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> matter and the conventional Baym-Pethick-Sutherland (BPS) EoS for the inner and outer crusts. To account for the rotational effects, we employ a method proposed by Komatsu, Eriguchi, and Hachisu (the KEH method), which provides stable solutions for axially symmetric rotating equilibrium configurations. Results: Using five different Skyrme-type EoS parameter sets, we find that the maximum angular frequency achievable by rotating neutron stars, as calculated via the KEH method, varies depending on the stiffness of the equation of state. We confirm that an increase in the rotating frequency leads to an overall increase in both the mass and radius along the <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mtext>-</mml:mtext><mml:mi>R</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> curve, consistent with earlier studies. By performing calculations for three frequently referenced neutron stars, we further examine how the changes in mass and radius correlate with the nuclear matter properties at saturation density. Our results suggest that the often-quoted 716 Hz rotational constraint may require a more conservative interpretation when accounting for realistic stellar deformation effects. Conclusions: To place stringent constraints on the nuclear EoS based on observational data, it is sometimes essential to account for the effects of rotation in neutron star models. In particular, the influence of rotation becomes increasingly significant at higher spin frequencies and cannot be neglected in rapidly rotating systems with <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>ν</mml:mi><mml:mo>≳</mml:mo><mml:mn>400</mml:mn><mml:mspace></mml:mspace><mml:mi>Hz</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula>.

Abstract: Relativistic magnetized shocks are natural sources of coherent radiation, representing a promising framework for fast radio bursts (FRBs). Abstract: Ultra-long period neutron stars (ULPNSs) are an emerging class of objects that have sparked interest and curiosity in the fast transient community. Along with standard magnetars, they have been theorised to be potential progenitors of the enigmatic fast radio bursts (FRBs). The MeerTRAP project at the MeerKAT radio telescope is uncovering several magnetar and ultra-long period neutron star candidates, an example of which is PSR J0901-4046 with a period of 76s. Continued long-term monitoring of PSR J0901-4046 has shown it to be potentially transitioning into radio quiescence. The proposed observations will enable us to continue to monitor and characterise the decline in flux density. We have also discovered two new candidates MTP0027 and MTP0068 with periods of ~10 seconds and ~5 seconds respectively. Both sources exhibit magnetar-like pulse morphology and have only been detected in one epoch with MeerKAT. We propose to continue monitoring these sources to re-detect pulses and study their spectro-temporal-polarimetric properties.

Abstract: Ultra-long period neutron stars (ULPNSs) are an emerging class of objects that have sparked interest and curiosity in the fast transient community. Along with standard magnetars, they have been theorised to be potential progenitors of the enigmatic fast radio bursts (FRBs). The MeerTRAP project at the MeerKAT radio telescope is uncovering several magnetar and ultra-long period neutron star candidates, an example of which is PSR J0901-4046 with a period of 76s. Continued long-term monitoring of PSR J0901-4046 has shown it to be potentially transitioning into radio quiescence. The proposed observations will enable us to continue to monitor and characterise the decline in flux density. We have also discovered two new candidates MTP0027 and MTP0068 with periods of ~10 seconds and ~5 seconds respectively. Both sources exhibit magnetar-like pulse morphology and have only been detected in one epoch with MeerKAT. We propose to continue monitoring these sources to re-detect pulses and study their spectro-temporal-polarimetric properties.

Abstract: Ultra-long period neutron stars (ULPNSs) are an emerging class of objects that have sparked interest and curiosity in the fast transient community. Along with standard magnetars, they have been theorised to be potential progenitors of the enigmatic fast radio bursts (FRBs). Abstract: Ultra-long period neutron stars (ULPNSs) are an emerging class of objects that have sparked interest and curiosity in the fast transient community. Along with standard magnetars, they have been theorised to be potential progenitors of the enigmatic fast radio bursts (FRBs). The MeerTRAP project at the MeerKAT radio telescope is uncovering several magnetar and ultra-long period neutron star candidates, an example of which is PSR J0901-4046 with a period of 76s. Continued long-term monitoring of PSR J0901-4046 has shown it to be potentially transitioning into radio quiescence. The proposed observations will enable us to continue to monitor and characterise the decline in flux density. We have also discovered two new candidates MTP0027 and MTP0068 with periods of ~10 seconds and ~5 seconds respectively. Both sources exhibit magnetar-like pulse morphology and have only been detected in one epoch with MeerKAT. We propose to continue monitoring these sources to re-detect pulses and study their spectro-temporal-polarimetric properties.

Conclusion: 超长周期中子星与标准磁星被理论化为快速射电暴（FRBs）的潜在前身天体，此为该提案所引用的理论背景；PSR J0901-4046 可能正在向射电宁静态转变，拟议观测旨在继续监测并刻画其通量密度下降，并重新探测 MTP0027 和 MTP0068 的脉冲以研究其谱-时-偏振性质。作者并未在摘要中给出这些源与 FRBs 之间观测联系的结论；根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Ultra-long period neutron stars (ULPNSs) are an emerging class of objects that have sparked interest and curiosity in the fast transient community. Along with standard magnetars, they have been theorised to be potential progenitors of the enigmatic fast radio bursts (FRBs). The MeerTRAP project at the MeerKAT radio telescope is uncovering several magnetar and ultra-long period neutron star candidates, an example of which is PSR J0901-4046 with a period of 76s. Continued long-term monitoring of PSR J0901-4046 has shown it to be potentially transitioning into radio quiescence. The proposed observations will enable us to continue to monitor and characterise the decline in flux density. We have also discovered two new candidates MTP0027 and MTP0068 with periods of ~10 seconds and ~5 seconds respectively. Both sources exhibit magnetar-like pulse morphology and have only been detected in one epoch with MeerKAT. We propose to continue monitoring these sources to re-detect pulses and study their spectro-temporal-polarimetric properties.

### [114] [Magnetars: Properties, Origin and Evolution]()
*Mereghetti, Sandro,Pons, José A.,Melatos, Andrew*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该综述总结磁星的观测性质：强磁场是其主导能源，已知约二十多颗磁星及若干候选体表现为高度变化的X射线源，部分同时是射电和/或光学脉冲星，其2-12 s周期与自转减慢率指示外部偶极磁场 $\sim10^{13-15}$ G，内部和非偶极磁层可能有更强磁场；文章还讨论磁场起源模型、演化及其与其它类中子星的联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 磁星以强磁场为主要能量来源，已知数量约二十多颗并有若干候选体，且表现为高度变化的X射线源，部分还表现为射电和/或光学脉冲星；因此需要在统一框架下理解其持续辐射性质、强磁场的起源以及演化路径和与其他类中子星的关系。

Method: 本文是一篇综述：总结磁星持续辐射的观测性质，讨论为解释其磁场起源而提出的主要模型，并介绍其演化及与其它类中子星联系研究的最新进展。摘要未说明具体观测仪器、频段、时间跨度、样本筛选或统计分析方法。

Result: 摘要指出，银河系和麦哲伦云中目前已知约二十多颗磁星，另有若干候选体；它们表现为高度变化的X射线源，在某些情况下也表现为射电和/或光学脉冲星。其自转周期为2-12 s，自转减慢率为 $\sim10^{-13}\mbox{--}10^{-10}~\mbox{s}\,\mbox{s}^{-1}$，表明外部偶极磁场为 $\sim10^{13-15}$ G；并有证据表明恒星内部及非偶极磁层成分中存在更强的磁场。

Conclusion: 作者将磁星刻画为以强磁场为主要能源的中子星，并据此综述持续辐射的观测性质、磁场起源的主要模型以及演化与和其它类中子星的联系；摘要所支持的结论是这些观测特征指向外部偶极磁场及内部/非偶极成分中的更强磁场。关于磁星与脉冲星单脉冲、模式转换、计时噪声、偏振、射电频谱或FRB的具体联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Magnetars are neutron stars in which a strong magnetic field is the main energy source. About two dozens of magnetars, plus several candidates, are currently known in our Galaxy and in the Magellanic Clouds. They appear as highly variable X-ray sources and, in some cases, also as radio and/or optical pulsars. Their spin periods (2-12 s) and spin-down rates (∼10-13-10-10ss-1$\sim10^{-13}\mbox{--}10^{-10}~\mbox{s}\,\mbox{s}^{-1}$) indicate external dipole fields of ∼1013-15$\sim10^{13-15}$ G, and there is evidence that even stronger magnetic fields are present inside the star and in non-dipolar magnetospheric components. Here we review the observed properties of the persistent emission from magnetars, discuss the main models proposed to explain the origin of their magnetic field and present recent developments in the study of their evolution and connection with other classes of neutron stars.

</details>


### [115] [Mean mass density near the Sun from the divergence theorem and pulsar accelerations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.15865)
*Donlon, Thomas, II,Widrow, Lawrence M.,Chakrabarti, Sukanya*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该文提出一种基于散度定理、利用毫秒脉冲星视向加速度的非参数方法，用以估计以太阳为中心的球体内平均质量密度，结果与先前分析一致；当前数据尚无法明确测量局部暗物质信号，但未来数据量和精度提升后有望实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需要一种非参数方法来估计以太阳为中心任意半径球体内的质量，并给出暗物质平均质量密度随距太阳距离变化的函数，而非运动学研究中通常报告的单一数值；同时关注利用脉冲星加速度数据估计密度不对称性。

Method: 基于散度定理，将其应用于毫秒脉冲星视向加速度的测量；描述推断以太阳为中心、给定半径球体内平均质量密度的流程；结合重子分布模型；并将球壳定理推广到密度和势的球谐展开，用于从观测加速度数据获得相对于银河系中面的密度不对称性。具体观测频段、时间跨度、样本量等摘要未说明。

Result: 所得结果与先前分析一致；与重子分布模型结合后，给出暗物质平均质量密度随距太阳距离变化的函数。但利用当前脉冲星数据，该方法此时无法明确测量来自局部暗物质分布的信号。由观测加速度数据得到的相对于银河系中面的密度不对称性预测，与观测到的银河系盘恒星或气体的分布不一致。

Conclusion: 作者认为，随着脉冲星加速度数据量增长和精度提高，测量局部暗物质分布信号预计很快将变得可行；预测的密度不对称性与银河系盘恒星或气体分布不一致，有可能由太阳邻域内暗物质的非均匀分布来解释。根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星单脉冲、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）的具体物理联系。

Abstract: We introduce a new, nonparametric method for estimating the mass enclosed within a sphere of arbitrary radius centered on the Sun. The method is based on the divergence theorem as applied to measurements of the line-of-sight accelerations of millisecond pulsars. We describe a procedure for inferring the mean mass density within a sphere of a given radius centered on the Sun and find results that are consistent with previous analyses. When combined with a model for the distribution of baryons, this provides the mean mass density of dark matter as a function of distance from the Sun, rather than a single value as is typically reported by kinematic studies. However, with the present pulsar data, the method cannot unambiguously measure a signal from the local distribution of dark matter at this time; such a measurement is expected to soon become possible as the amount of pulsar acceleration data grows and its precision improves. We derive an extension of the well-known shell theorem to a spherical-harmonics expansion of the density and potential and use the result to obtain estimates for density asymmetries with respect to the Galactic midplane from the observed acceleration data. The predicted asymmetries do not follow the observed distribution of Milky Way disk stars or gas; this can potentially be explained by a nonuniform distribution of dark matter in the solar neighborhood.

</details>

### [117] [Parkes observations for project P1327 semester 2024APRS_11]()
*Zhao, Shiqian,Hobbs, George,Caleb, Manisha,Dai, Shi,Wang, Shuangqiang,Luo, Rui*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟用 Parkes/Murriyang 64 米望远镜 UWL 接收机对 PSR J0901-4046 开展总计 24 小时的单脉冲搜寻观测，研究其单脉冲结构与偏振轮廓，并考察其谱偏振特征与 FRBs 的相似性，以期理解磁星射电辐射起源并探讨银河系中子星与 FRBs 的潜在关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 射电辐射中子星涵盖自转周期从几毫秒到几十秒的天体，但近年来超长周期射电暂现源的发现对中子星磁层偶极模型的经典理论框架提出了新挑战。该提案因此关注 PSR J0901-4046 的独特性质及其与 FRBs 的相似性。

Method: 使用配备超宽带低频接收机（UWL）的 Parkes/Murriyang 64 米射电望远镜，拟对 PSR J0901-4046 开展总计 24 小时的观测，用于搜寻单脉冲，并观测其单脉冲结构和偏振轮廓。具体观测频段、时间跨度与数据分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要所述为提案计划：拟开展总计 24 小时观测以搜寻单脉冲；预期成果包括探测到具有独特特征的丰富单脉冲，并为中子星种群及其与 FRBs 的联系提供见解。尚未报告实际观测结果或具体测量数值。

Conclusion: 作者希望通过对 PSR J0901-4046 单脉冲结构和偏振轮廓的观测，理解磁星射电辐射的起源，并建立银河系中子星与 FRBs 之间的潜在关联。这些属于提案所表述的目标与预期，而非已由观测确立的结论；具体物理机制与关联是否成立，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The radio radiation neutron star include objects with spin periods ranging from a few milliseconds to tens of seconds. In the past years, however, the discovery of ultra-long period radio transient sources has posed a new challenge to the classical theoretical framework of the neutron star magnetospheric dipole model. This proposal aims to study the unique characteristics of the radio emitting neutron star, PSR J0901-4046, and the similarity of its spectro-polarimetric features with fast radio bursts (FRBs). By observing its single-pulse structures and polarization profiles, we hope to understand the origin of radio emission from magnetars and establish the potential association between Galactic neutron stars and FRBs. Using the Parkes/Murriyang 64-m radio telescope equipped with the Ultra-Wideband Low-Frequency receiver (UWL), we propose to conduct a total of 24-hour observations to search for single pulses. The expected outcomes include detecting rich single pulses with unique characteristics and providing insights into neutron star populations and their connection to FRBs.

</details>

Method: 使用配备超宽带低频接收机（UWL）的 Parkes/Murriyang 64-m 射电望远镜，对 PSR J0901-4046 开展总计 24 小时的观测，以搜寻单脉冲，并观测其单脉冲结构与偏振轮廓；摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、观测时间跨度及数据分析方法。

Conclusion: 作者希望通过观测 PSR J0901-4046 的单脉冲结构和偏振轮廓，理解磁星射电发射的起源，并建立银河系中子星与快速射电暴（FRB）之间的潜在联系。根据摘要无法判断该物理诠释及其向脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、偏振、射电频谱或 FRB 相关研究的可迁移性；摘要所述结果为预期性质，尚待观测检验。

Abstract: The radio radiation neutron star include objects with spin periods ranging from a few milliseconds to tens of seconds. In the past years, however, the discovery of ultra-long period radio transient sources has posed a new challenge to the classical theoretical framework of the neutron star magnetospheric dipole model. This proposal aims to study the unique characteristics of the radio emitting neutron star, PSR J0901-4046, and the similarity of its spectro-polarimetric features with fast radio bursts (FRBs). By observing its single-pulse structures and polarization profiles, we hope to understand the origin of radio emission from magnetars and establish the potential association between Galactic neutron stars and FRBs. Using the Parkes/Murriyang 64-m radio telescope equipped with the Ultra-Wideband Low-Frequency receiver (UWL), we propose to conduct a total of 24-hour observations to search for single pulses. ### [138] [Parkes observations for project P1327 semester 2024APRS_22]()
*Zhao, Shiqian,Hobbs, George,Caleb, Manisha,Dai, Shi,Wang, Shuangqiang,Luo, Rui*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划用 Parkes/Murriyang 64 米望远镜的 UWL 接收机对 PSR J0901-4046 进行总计 24 小时的单脉冲搜寻，通过单脉冲结构和偏振轮廓研究其与 FRB 的谱偏振相似性，以期理解磁星射电辐射起源并探讨银河系中子星与 FRB 的潜在关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 射电辐射中子星涵盖自转周期从几毫秒到数十秒的天体；近年超长周期射电暂现源的发现对中子星磁层偶极模型的经典理论框架提出了新挑战。该提案由此提出研究 PSR J0901-4046 的独特特征及其谱偏振特征与 FRB 的相似性，以理解磁星射电辐射起源并探讨银河系中子星与 FRB 的潜在关联。

Method: 使用配备超宽带低频接收机（UWL）的 Parkes/Murriyang 64 米射电望远镜，拟对 PSR J0901-4046 开展总计 24 小时观测，搜寻单脉冲，并观测其单脉冲结构与偏振轮廓。摘要未说明具体观测频段、观测时间跨度、数据采样与偏振分析流程等细节。

Result: 这是观测提案，摘要未给出已获得的观测结果。摘要仅说明预期结果：探测到具有独特特征的丰富单脉冲，并就中子星族群及其与 FRB 的联系提供见解。摘要未说明脉冲数、信噪比、偏振度或其他定量结果。

Conclusion: 作者希望通过对 PSR J0901-4046 单脉冲结构与偏振轮廓的观测，理解磁星射电辐射的起源，并建立银河系中子星与 FRB 之间的潜在关联，为超长周期射电暂现源挑战经典磁层偶极模型这一问题提供线索。上述结论为提案的预期目标而非已证实的物理结论；该源与 FRB 的物理联系及对磁星辐射机制的具体推论，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The radio radiation neutron star include objects with spin periods ranging from a few milliseconds to tens of seconds. In the past years, however, the discovery of ultra-long period radio transient sources has posed a new challenge to the classical theoretical framework of the neutron star magnetospheric dipole model. This proposal aims to study the unique characteristics of the radio emitting neutron star, PSR J0901-4046, and the similarity of its spectro-polarimetric features with fast radio bursts (FRBs). By observing its single-pulse structures and polarization profiles, we hope to understand the origin of radio emission from magnetars and establish the potential association between Galactic neutron stars and FRBs. Using the Parkes/Murriyang 64-m radio telescope equipped with the Ultra-Wideband Low-Frequency receiver (UWL), we propose to conduct a total of 24-hour observations to search for single pulses. The expected outcomes include detecting rich single pulses with unique characteristics and providing insights into neutron star populations and their connection to FRBs.

</details>


### [139] [Realistic assessment of a single gravitational wave source localization taking into account precise pulsar distances with pulsar timing arrays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.02819)
*Kato, Ryo,Takahashi, Keitaro*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 通过模拟87颗脉冲星并纳入J0437-4715和J0030+0451在SKA时代预期的精确距离，研究表明在10 ns噪声下可将单个连续引力波源的定位不确定度降至约10^{-3} deg^{2}，而仅用当前距离信息则不足以识别宿主星系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PTAs预计不久将探测到单个SMBHB的连续GWs，但要识别GW源的宿主星系，需将角分辨率显著提升到优于近期连续GW搜索典型的100--1000平方度；因此作者研究精确脉冲星距离测量能否增强单个GW源定位。

Method: 摘要提及聚焦J0437-4715（156 pc）与J0030+0451（331 pc），采用基于当前VLBI测量及SKA时代预期的实际距离不确定度；模拟87颗含GW信号与计时残差高斯白噪声的脉冲星，评估距离信息对GW源定位的影响。其余观测细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：若缺乏精确距离信息，在10 ns噪声下定位仍不足以识别宿主星系；纳入J0437-4715和J0030+0451的SKA时代距离精度后，10 ns噪声下定位不确定度可降至所需的10^{-3} deg^{2}水平。定位精度强烈依赖距离测量良好脉冲星的几何构型，并在这些脉冲星附近及其之间显著改善。

Conclusion: 作者认为，距离测量良好脉冲星带来的定位改善将极大有助于识别GW源的宿主星系、构建SMBHB星表，并进一步促成后续电磁观测以更详细地研究SMBHB。根据摘要无法判断该方法是否可迁移至脉冲星、磁星或FRB相关研究。

Abstract: Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) are anticipated to detect continuous gravitational waves (GWs) from individual supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs) in the near future. To identify the host galaxy of a GW source, PTAs require significantly improved angular resolution beyond the typical range of 100--1000 square degrees achieved by recent continuous GW searches. In this study, we investigate how precise pulsar distance measurements can enhance the localization of a single GW source. Accurate distance information, comparable to or better than the GW wavelength (typically 1 pc) can refine GW source localization. In the near future, with the advent of Square Kilometre Array (SKA), such high-precision distance measurements will be feasible for a few nearby pulsars. We focus on the relatively nearby pulsars J0437-4715 (156 pc) and <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>J</mml:mi><mml:mn>0030</mml:mn><mml:mo>+</mml:mo><mml:mn>0451</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> (331 pc), incorporating their actual distance uncertainties based on current very long baseline interferometry measurements and the anticipated precision of the SKA-era. By simulating 87 pulsars with the GW signal and Gaussian white noise in the timing residuals, we assess the impact of the pulsar distance information on GW source localization. Our results show that without precise distance information, localization remains insufficient to identify host galaxies under 10 ns noise. However, incorporating SKA-era distance precision for nearby pulsars J0437-4715 and <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>J</mml:mi><mml:mn>0030</mml:mn><mml:mo>+</mml:mo><mml:mn>0451</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> can reduce localization uncertainties to the required level of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msup><mml:mn>10</mml:mn><mml:mrow><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:mn>3</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msup><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:msup><mml:mi>deg</mml:mi><mml:mn>2</mml:mn></mml:msup></mml:math></inline-formula> under 10 ns noise. Localization accuracy strongly depends on the geometric configuration of pulsars with well-measured distances and improves notably near and between such pulsars. The improvement of the localization will greatly aid in identifying the host galaxy of a GW source and constructing an SMBHB catalog. It will further enable follow-up electromagnetic observations to investigate the SMBHB in greater detail.

</details>


### [140] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2018OCTS_10]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用 Parkes 对 ASKAP 探测到并定位良好的 FRB 样本进行重复暴搜寻，以注量极限比原探测低 60 倍以上的密集监测，判定是否存在更多重复 FRB 或 FRB 121102 是否在群体中独一无二。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 121102 已被亚角秒精度定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云，并有人提出其源可能是一颗年轻的高度磁化中子星；但重复暴与该群体其余部分的关系仍不清楚。

Method: 摘要说明将利用 Parkes 对 ASKAP 在过去一年探测到的 26 个爆发以及未来六个月可能再探测到的 12 个 FRB 组成的大样本开展重复暴搜寻，并对定位良好的爆发进行密集监测，监测的注量极限比其探测时低 60 倍以上；更具体的观测频段、时间跨度与分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者提出：对综合样本的搜寻和对定位良好爆发的密集监测，将要么确认存在额外的重复 FRB，要么确认 FRB 121102 在该群体中的独特性。根据摘要无法判断该结果与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振或射电频谱等具体物理过程的联系。

Abstract: A major breakthrough in fast radio burst (FRB) astronomy was recently made when the repeating FRB 121102 was localized to sub-arcsecond precision. The bursts were found to originate in a bright radio nebula (hypothesized to be a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. These dwarf galaxies are also preferential hosts to superluminous supernova and long gamma-ray bursts, and it has been therefore suggested that the source of the repeating FRB could be a young highly magnetised neutron star. While an understanding of the repeating FRB is emerging, it is still unclear what relationship it has to the rest of the population. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 26 bursts, and over the next six month will likely detect another 12 FRBs, which will be localized to a few arcseconds. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

### [144] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2018OCTS_26]()

Conclusion: 作者提出，对定位良好的快速射电暴样本进行密集监测的重复搜寻，将要么确认存在更多重复快速射电暴，要么确认 FRB 121102 在该种群中的独特性。至于重复暴与其余种群关系的具体物理图像，以及年轻高度磁化中子星这一解释是否成立，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: A major breakthrough in fast radio burst (FRB) astronomy was recently made when the repeating FRB 121102 was localized to sub-arcsecond precision. The bursts were found to originate in a bright radio nebula (hypothesized to be a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. These dwarf galaxies are also preferential hosts to superluminous supernova and long gamma-ray bursts, and it has been therefore suggested that the source of the repeating FRB could be a young highly magnetised neutron star. While an understanding of the repeating FRB is emerging, it is still unclear what relationship it has to the rest of the population. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 26 bursts, and over the next six month will likely detect another 12 FRBs, which will be localized to a few arcseconds. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>


### [145] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2018OCTS_01]()

Conclusion: 作者提出，以比原探测注量极限低 60 倍以上的注量极限，对综合样本和定位良好的暴进行密集监测，将要么确认存在额外的重复 FRB，要么确认 FRB 121102 在该群体中的唯一性；该监测结果有望厘清重复暴与其余 FRB 群体之间的关系。摘要所提的年轻高度磁化中子星来源属于已提出的推测，其与 FRB 群体的物理联系根据摘要无法判断。

The bursts were found to originate in a bright radio nebula (hypothesized to be a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. These dwarf galaxies are also preferential hosts to superluminous supernova and long gamma-ray bursts, and it has been therefore suggested that the source of the repeating FRB could be a young highly magnetised neutron star. While an understanding of the repeating FRB is emerging, it is still unclear what relationship it has to the rest of the population. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 26 bursts, and over the next six month will likely detect another 12 FRBs, which will be localized to a few arcseconds. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

### [151] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2018OCTS_42]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用对ASKAP已探测并定位的FRB样本的密集监测，在比原探测注量极限低60倍以上的水平上搜寻重复爆发，以判定是否存在更多重复FRB，或FRB 121102是否为该群体中独一无二的存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 121102已被精确定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云，并被推测源于一颗年轻的高度磁化中子星；但重复FRB与FRB总体群体之间的关系仍不清楚，因此需要检验是否还存在其他重复FRB。

Method: 摘要说明：以ASKAP搜寻所探测的FRB为综合样本，对定位良好的爆发开展密集监测，监测的注量极限比其被探测时低60倍以上；过去一年已探测26个爆发，未来六个月可能再探测12个并将定位到几角秒。具体观测频段、时间跨度与分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：重复FRB 121102被定位到亚角秒精度，其爆发起源于一个明亮射电星云，该星云被假设为年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云，并位于一个遥远矮星系中；这类矮星系也是超亮超新星和长伽马射线暴的偏好宿主。过去一年ASKAP搜寻探测到26个爆发，未来六个月可能再探测12个FRB并定位到几角秒。上述监测的最终搜寻结果尚未给出。

Conclusion: 作者认为，这一综合样本与低注量极限的密集监测将要么确认存在更多重复FRB，要么确认FRB 121102在群体中的独特性。摘要提出重复FRB的源可能是一颗年轻的高度磁化中子星，但根据摘要无法判断该解释在其他FRB中是否成立，也无法判断本提案与其他脉冲星、磁星或FRB群体研究的具体联系。

Abstract: A major breakthrough in fast radio burst (FRB) astronomy was recently made when the repeating FRB 121102 was localized to sub-arcsecond precision. The bursts were found to originate in a bright radio nebula (hypothesized to be a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. These dwarf galaxies are also preferential hosts to superluminous supernova and long gamma-ray bursts, and it has been therefore suggested that the source of the repeating FRB could be a young highly magnetised neutron star. While an understanding of the repeating FRB is emerging, it is still unclear what relationship it has to the rest of the population. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 26 bursts, and over the next six month will likely detect another 12 FRBs, which will be localized to a few arcseconds. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者提出，涵盖全面样本并对定位良好的暴进行密集监测（注量极限比其被探测时低 60 倍以上）的搜索，将要么确认存在额外的重复 FRB，要么确认 FRB 121102 在该群体中的独特性。根据摘要无法判断重复 FRB 与其余 FRB 群体之间具体关系的物理性质；摘要所述重复暴源可能为年轻高度磁化中子星仅是对 FRB 121102 的推测，并非该提案所确立的结论。

Abstract: A major breakthrough in fast radio burst (FRB) astronomy was recently made when the repeating FRB 121102 was localized to sub-arcsecond precision. The bursts were found to originate in a bright radio nebula (hypothesized to be a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. These dwarf galaxies are also preferential hosts to superluminous supernova and long gamma-ray bursts, and it has been therefore suggested that the source of the repeating FRB could be a young highly magnetised neutron star. While an understanding of the repeating FRB is emerging, it is still unclear what relationship it has to the rest of the population. Over the next six months, searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) are poised to detect at least 20 additional FRBs, some that will be localized to a few arcseconds. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者提出，利用该综合样本及对定位良好爆发的密集监测，将要么确认存在更多重复 FRB，要么确认 FRB 121102 在该群体中的独特性。摘要还提到，重复 FRB 的源被推测可能是一颗年轻的高度磁化中子星。根据摘要无法判断 FRB 121102 与被推测为年轻高度磁化中子星的源之间关系的具体物理解释。

Abstract: A major breakthrough in fast radio burst (FRB) astronomy was recently made when the repeating FRB 121102 was localized to sub-arcsecond precision. The bursts were found to originate in a bright radio nebula (hypothesized to be a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. These dwarf galaxies are also preferential hosts to superluminous supernova and long gamma-ray bursts, and it has been therefore suggested that the source of the repeating FRB could be a young highly magnetised neutron star. While an understanding of the repeating FRB is emerging, it is still unclear what relationship it has to the rest of the population. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 26 bursts, and over the next six month will likely detect another 12 FRBs, which will be localized to a few arcseconds. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

### [166] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2018APRS_BPSR_13]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 摘要描述了利用ASKAP在接下来六个月内开展搜寻，预期探测至少20个额外FRB，其中部分可定位到几角秒；随后对该群体进行重复搜寻，并对定位良好的爆发实施密集监测，监测流量限比其探测流量限低60倍以上。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度细节、样本量、统计方法或数据处理流程。

Conclusion: 作者提出，对ASKAP新探测FRB群体的重复搜寻，结合对定位良好爆发的密集监测和更低的流量限，将能够判定重复FRB是否为普遍现象，或FRB 121102是否在群体中独一无二。摘要中关于重复FRB源可能是年轻高磁化中子星的说法以“提出”形式表述，属于基于定位与宿主星系性质的推测；其与FRB其余群体的关系仍不明确。根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星、磁星或单脉冲发射细节的具体物理联系。

Abstract: A major breakthrough in fast radio burst (FRB) astronomy was recently made when the repeating FRB 121102 was localized to sub-arcsecond precision. The bursts were found to originate in a bright radio nebula (hypothesized to be a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. These dwarf galaxies are also preferential hosts to superluminous supernova and long gamma-ray bursts, and it has been therefore suggested that the source of the repeating FRB could be a young highly magnetised neutron star. </details>

*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用 Parkes 对 ASKAP 探测并定位的 FRB 样本开展重复暴搜寻与密集监测，以注量极限比探测时低 60 倍以上的深度，判定是否存在更多重复 FRB，还是 FRB 121102 在该种群中独一无二。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 121102 已被精确定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云，其源被推测为年轻的高度磁化中子星，但重复暴与其余 FRB 种群之间的关系仍不清楚。ASKAP 过去一年探测到 26 个爆发，未来六个月预计再探测约 12 个并可定位到几角秒，因此需要对该种群搜寻重复暴。

Method: 摘要说明了这是针对 Parkes 项目 P958 的提案，计划对 ASKAP 探测的 FRB 种群搜寻重复暴，并对定位良好的爆发开展密集监测活动，注量极限比其被探测时低 60 倍以上。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本量细节以及所采用的分析方法。

Result: 过去一年 ASKAP 的搜寻已探测到 26 个爆发，未来六个月很可能再探测到另外 12 个 FRB，这些爆发将被定位到几角秒精度。FRB 121102 已被定位到亚角秒精度，其爆发被发现起源于遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云。摘要未给出该提案监测活动本身的观测结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出的这一全面样本与密集监测将要么确认存在更多重复 FRB，要么确认 FRB 121102 在该种群中的独特性。摘要还提到矮星系也偏好作为超亮超新星和长伽马射线暴的宿主，并据此提出重复 FRB 的源可能是一颗年轻的高度磁化中子星；该物理图像与读者关注的磁星、FRB 联系存在表述上的相关性，但根据摘要无法判断其对单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、偏振或射电频谱的具体适用性。

Abstract: A major breakthrough in fast radio burst (FRB) astronomy was recently made when the repeating FRB 121102 was localized to sub-arcsecond precision. The bursts were found to originate in a bright radio nebula (hypothesized to be a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. These dwarf galaxies are also preferential hosts to superluminous supernova and long gamma-ray bursts, and it has been therefore suggested that the source of the repeating FRB could be a young highly magnetised neutron star. While an understanding of the repeating FRB is emerging, it is still unclear what relationship it has to the rest of the population. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 26 bursts, and over the next six month will likely detect another 12 FRBs, which will be localized to a few arcseconds. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>


### [172] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2018OCTS_43]()

Here we propose to search this population for repeats. ### [178] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2018APRS_BPSR_09]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao*

Main category: scix

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 摘要提及利用澳大利亚平方公里阵列探路者（ASKAP）在未来六个月内开展搜寻，预计探测到至少20个额外的FRB，其中一些将被定位到几角秒精度；提议对这一群体搜寻重复暴，并对定位良好的爆发进行密集监测，监测的注量限比其探测注量限低60倍以上。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、时间跨度、样本量细节及分析统计方法。

Conclusion: 作者提出的结论是，通过对全面样本和定位良好的爆发开展密集监测，将要么确认存在更多重复FRB，要么确认FRB 121102在FRB群体中的独特性。关于重复FRB源为年轻高磁化中子星的假设、明亮射电星云为年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云的推测，以及矮星系与超亮超新星、长伽马射线暴的关联，均以摘要所述方式表述；根据摘要无法判断其进一步物理含义及对脉冲星、磁星等具体联系的可迁移性。

Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>


### [179] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2018OCTS_29]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry*

Main category: scix

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重复FRB 121102已被定位到亚角秒精度，其暴起源于遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云，这类矮星系也偏好作为超亮超新星和长伽马射线暴的宿主，因此有人提出其源可能是一颗年轻的高度磁化中子星。摘要指出，尽管对重复FRB的认识正在形成，但它与其余FRB族群具有何种关系仍不清楚，这正是本提案要解决的问题。

Method: 摘要说明，过去一年使用ASKAP的搜寻已探测到26个暴，未来六个月可能再探测到12个FRB，并将被定位到几角秒。提案据此提出在这一族群中搜寻重复，方式为对定位良好的暴开展密集监测活动，观测注量极限比这些暴被探测到时低60倍以上。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、监测时间跨度、样本筛选细节及统计分析方法。标题显示这是Parkes项目P958在2018OCTS学期的观测提案，摘要未说明Parkes观测的具体参数。

Result: 摘要报告：重复FRB 121102已被定位到亚角秒精度，其暴起源于明亮射电星云，该星云被推测为年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风星云，位于遥远矮星系中。过去一年ASKAP搜寻已探测到26个暴，未来六个月可能再探测到12个FRB，这些FRB将被定位到几角秒。拟议监测的注量极限比这些暴被探测到时低60倍以上。摘要未说明拟议搜寻是否已获得重复探测结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出的预期结论是：这一综合样本和密集监测活动将要么确认存在更多重复FRB，要么确认FRB 121102在该族群中的独特性。摘要还提出，重复FRB的源可能是一颗年轻的高度磁化中子星，但这是以推测形式表述的。至于重复FRB与非重复族群之间关系最终如何，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: A major breakthrough in fast radio burst (FRB) astronomy was recently made when the repeating FRB 121102 was localized to sub-arcsecond precision. The bursts were found to originate in a bright radio nebula (hypothesized to be a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. These dwarf galaxies are also preferential hosts to superluminous supernova and long gamma-ray bursts, and it has been therefore suggested that the source of the repeating FRB could be a young highly magnetised neutron star. While an understanding of the repeating FRB is emerging, it is still unclear what relationship it has to the rest of the population. Conclusion: 作者提出，对完备样本的搜寻以及对定位良好的暴进行的密集监测（注量极限比其探测时低 60 倍以上），将要么确认存在更多重复 FRB，要么确认 FRB 121102 在该群体中的独特性。根据摘要无法判断重复 FRB 与其余 FRB 群体之间关系的具体物理性质。

Abstract: A major breakthrough in fast radio burst (FRB) astronomy was recently made when the repeating FRB 121102 was localized to sub-arcsecond precision. The bursts were found to originate in a bright radio nebula (hypothesized to be a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. These dwarf galaxies are also preferential hosts to superluminous supernova and long gamma-ray bursts, and it has been therefore suggested that the source of the repeating FRB could be a young highly magnetised neutron star. While an understanding of the repeating FRB is emerging, it is still unclear what relationship it has to the rest of the population. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 26 bursts, and over the next six month will likely detect another 12 FRBs, which will be localized to a few arcseconds. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

### [191] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2018APRS_BPSR_12]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用ASKAP在接下来六个月新探测并定位的FRB样本中搜寻重复暴，以比原探测流量限低60倍以上的灵敏度对定位良好的爆发进行密集监测，从而确认是否存在更多重复FRB，或确认FRB 121102在群体中的独特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重复FRB 121102已被亚角秒精度定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云，且该宿主类型也偏好超亮超新星和长伽马射线暴，因此有人提出其源可能是年轻高磁化中子星。尽管对重复FRB的认识正在形成，但它与其余FRB群体之间的关系仍不清楚。

Method: 摘要提到，未来六个月内将利用澳大利亚平方公里阵列探路者（ASKAP）开展搜寻，有望探测到至少20个额外FRB，其中一些将被定位到几角秒。作者提议在这一新探测并定位的群体中搜寻重复暴，并对定位良好的爆发开展密集监测，其流量限比这些爆发被探测到时低60倍以上。摘要未说明具体观测频段、时间跨度细节、样本筛选标准或统计分析方法。

Result: 摘要中报告的主要进展是：重复FRB 121102被定位到亚角秒精度，其爆发起源于一个遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云，该星云被推测为年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云。摘要预计，未来六个月ASKAP搜寻将探测到至少20个额外FRB，其中一些将被定位到几角秒。所提议搜寻的流量限比这些爆发被探测到时低60倍以上，其预期结果是确认存在额外重复FRB，或确认FRB 121102在群体中的独特性。摘要未给出已完成的重复搜寻结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出，对定位良好的新FRB群体进行重复搜寻，采用比原探测低60倍以上的流量限，将能够判定是否存在更多重复FRB，或判定FRB 121102在其他FRB群体中是否独特。关于重复FRB源可能为年轻高磁化中子星，摘要仅表述为一种已提出的推测；其与FRB群体的关系仍不清楚。根据摘要无法判断该方案对脉冲星、磁星或单脉冲相关物理的进一步解释。

Abstract: A major breakthrough in fast radio burst (FRB) astronomy was recently made when the repeating FRB 121102 was localized to sub-arcsecond precision. The bursts were found to originate in a bright radio nebula (hypothesized to be a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. These dwarf galaxies are also preferential hosts to superluminous supernova and long gamma-ray bursts, and it has been therefore suggested that the source of the repeating FRB could be a young highly magnetised neutron star. While an understanding of the repeating FRB is emerging, it is still unclear what relationship it has to the rest of the population. Over the next six months, searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) are poised to detect at least 20 additional FRBs, some that will be localized to a few arcseconds. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 121102 已被亚角秒精度定位到一个遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云，并被推测其源可能是年轻的高度磁化中子星；矮星系也是超亮超新星和长伽马射线暴的偏好宿主。然而，重复暴与其余 FRB 群体之间的关系仍不清楚，需要系统搜寻更多重复暴。

Result: 摘要未说明该研究已获得的结果；其中描述的 ASKAP 探测数量、定位精度与注量极限均为对今后六个月搜寻的预期或拟议观测条件，而非已实现的探测或发现。

Conclusion: 作者明确表示，拟议的全面样本与密集监测将要么确认存在额外的重复 FRB，要么确认 FRB 121102 在群体中的独特性。该结论关于重复暴种群是否普遍存在，摘要未给出已完成的判定；至于这些结果能否推广到磁星—FRB 联系等物理图像，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: A major breakthrough in fast radio burst (FRB) astronomy was recently made when the repeating FRB 121102 was localized to sub-arcsecond precision. The bursts were found to originate in a bright radio nebula (hypothesized to be a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. These dwarf galaxies are also preferential hosts to superluminous supernova and long gamma-ray bursts, and it has been therefore suggested that the source of the repeating FRB could be a young highly magnetised neutron star. While an understanding of the repeating FRB is emerging, it is still unclear what relationship it has to the rest of the population. Over the next six months, searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) are poised to detect at least 20 additional FRBs, some that will be localized to a few arcseconds. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry*

Conclusion: 作者明确提出，对全面样本及定位良好的爆发进行密集监测，将在低于其探测注量极限60倍以上的注量极限下，要么确认存在更多重复FRB，要么确认FRB 121102在该群体中的独特性。至于重复FRB与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、模式转换或计时等具体课题的关系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: A major breakthrough in fast radio burst (FRB) astronomy was recently made when the repeating FRB 121102 was localized to sub-arcsecond precision. The bursts were found to originate in a bright radio nebula (hypothesized to be a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. These dwarf galaxies are also preferential hosts to superluminous supernova and long gamma-ray bursts, and it has been therefore suggested that the source of the repeating FRB could be a young highly magnetised neutron star. While an understanding of the repeating FRB is emerging, it is still unclear what relationship it has to the rest of the population. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 26 bursts, and over the next six month will likely detect another 12 FRBs, which will be localized to a few arcseconds. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>


### [198] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2018OCTS_73]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry*

Conclusion: 作者提出，由于这些矮星系也是超亮超新星和长伽马射线暴的偏好宿主星系，重复 FRB 的源可能是一颗年轻的高磁化中子星；但重复 FRB 与其余群体之间的关系仍不清楚。作者计划通过综合样本和密集监测，以比探测注量极限低 60 倍以上的注量极限搜寻重复暴，从而要么确认存在更多重复 FRB，要么确认 FRB 121102 在该群体中的独特性。

These dwarf galaxies are also preferential hosts to superluminous supernova and long gamma-ray bursts, and it has been therefore suggested that the source of the repeating FRB could be a young highly magnetised neutron star. While an understanding of the repeating FRB is emerging, it is still unclear what relationship it has to the rest of the population. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 26 bursts, and over the next six month will likely detect another 12 FRBs, which will be localized to a few arcseconds. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者认为，对定位良好的 FRB 所作全面样本的重复搜寻与密集监测，其注量极限比探测时低 60 倍以上，将要么确认存在更多重复 FRB，要么确认 FRB 121102 在该群体中的独特性。摘要还指出，有人提出重复 FRB 的源可能是年轻的高度磁化中子星，但重复 FRB 与其余群体之间的关系仍不清楚；根据摘要无法判断该提议搜寻对磁星—FRB 联系或脉冲星单脉冲、偏振等具体物理问题的可推广性。

Abstract: A major breakthrough in fast radio burst (FRB) astronomy was recently made when the repeating FRB 121102 was localized to sub-arcsecond precision. The bursts were found to originate in a bright radio nebula (hypothesized to be a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. These dwarf galaxies are also preferential hosts to superluminous supernova and long gamma-ray bursts, and it has been therefore suggested that the source of the repeating FRB could be a young highly magnetised neutron star. While an understanding of the repeating FRB is emerging, it is still unclear what relationship it has to the rest of the population. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 26 bursts, and over the next six month will likely detect another 12 FRBs, which will be localized to a few arcseconds. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 26 bursts, and over the next six month will likely detect another 12 FRBs, which will be localized to a few arcseconds. <details>

Conclusion: 作者提出通过对ASKAP新探测FRB族群进行重复暴搜寻，并以比探测注量限低60倍以上的注量限密集监测定位良好的暴，可检验两种可能结局：要么证实存在额外的重复FRB，要么确认FRB 121102在该族群中的独特性。摘要还提到此前已有观点认为重复FRB的源可能是年轻高磁化中子星，但这属于既有推测而非本摘要所确立的结论。关于该方案与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振或射电频谱研究的具体联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Method: 摘要未说明。文中提及在此提议对ASKAP已探测的FRB群体搜寻重复爆发，并开展密集监测活动，所用注量限比这些探测的注量限低60倍以上；观测频段、时间跨度、样本量与具体分析流程摘要未说明。标题提及Parkes观测，但摘要未说明具体望远镜。

Result: 摘要未说明。过去一年中ASKAP搜寻已探测到26个爆发，未来六个月可能再探测到12个FRB，并将定位到几角秒精度；这些爆发被提议用于重复爆发搜寻，其注量限比原探测低60倍以上，但摘要未给出搜寻结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出，对综合样本和定位良好爆发的密集监测，将要么确认存在更多重复FRB，要么确认FRB 121102在该群体中的唯一性。摘要并据此推测重复FRB源可能是年轻高度磁化中子星；该源与其余FRB群体的物理关系根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: A major breakthrough in fast radio burst (FRB) astronomy was recently made when the repeating FRB 121102 was localized to sub-arcsecond precision. The bursts were found to originate in a bright radio nebula (hypothesized to be a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. These dwarf galaxies are also preferential hosts to superluminous supernova and long gamma-ray bursts, and it has been therefore suggested that the source of the repeating FRB could be a young highly magnetised neutron star. While an understanding of the repeating FRB is emerging, it is still unclear what relationship it has to the rest of the population. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 26 bursts, and over the next six month will likely detect another 12 FRBs, which will be localized to a few arcseconds. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用 ASKAP 预期新探测的 FRB 样本，并以比探测时低 60 倍以上的注量下限对这些定位良好的暴进行密集监测，以搜寻重复暴，从而确认是否存在更多重复 FRB，或确认 FRB 121102 在族群中的独特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重复暴 FRB 121102 已被定位到亚角秒精度，并被认为起源于遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云，其来源被推测为年轻的高度磁化中子星；但重复 FRB 与其余 FRB 族群之间关系仍不清楚，且尚不确定是否存在其他重复暴。

Method: 摘要未说明具体使用的望远镜接收系统、观测频段或数据处理方法；仅说明拟在接下来的六个月内借助 ASKAP 搜寻预计探测到的至少 20 个额外 FRB（部分可定位到几角秒），对该样本中定位良好的暴开展密集监测，并采用比其探测时低 60 倍以上的注量下限搜寻重复暴。

Result: 摘要未说明已获得的探测或监测结果。摘要仅报告：重复暴 FRB 121102 已被定位到亚角秒精度，其暴起源于遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云，据推测该星云为年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云；并预期 ASKAP 在接下来六个月内至少探测 20 个额外 FRB，其中一些可定位到几角秒。摘要未给出具体数值、显著性或其他结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出，对预期新增的、定位良好的 FRB 样本进行低于其探测注量 60 倍以上的密集监测，将要么确认存在额外的重复 FRB，要么确认 FRB 121102 在该族群中的独特性。摘要指出重复 FRB 的来源可能是年轻的高度磁化中子星，但根据摘要无法判断该解释对其他 FRB 的适用性。

Abstract: A major breakthrough in fast radio burst (FRB) astronomy was recently made when the repeating FRB 121102 was localized to sub-arcsecond precision. The bursts were found to originate in a bright radio nebula (hypothesized to be a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. These dwarf galaxies are also preferential hosts to superluminous supernova and long gamma-ray bursts, and it has been therefore suggested that the source of the repeating FRB could be a young highly magnetised neutron star. While an understanding of the repeating FRB is emerging, it is still unclear what relationship it has to the rest of the population. Over the next six months, searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) are poised to detect at least 20 additional FRBs, some that will be localized to a few arcseconds. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

### [226] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2018APRS_09]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao*

Abstract: A major breakthrough in fast radio burst (FRB) astronomy was recently made when the repeating FRB 121102 was localized to sub-arcsecond precision. These dwarf galaxies are also preferential hosts to superluminous supernova and long gamma-ray bursts, and it has been therefore suggested that the source of the repeating FRB could be a young highly magnetised neutron star. Over the next six months, searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) are poised to detect at least 20 additional FRBs, some that will be localized to a few arcseconds. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>


### [227] [Self-Confinement of Relativistic Pair Beams in Magnetized Interstellar Plasmas: The Case of Pulsar X-Ray Filaments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.15847)
*Orusa, Luca,Sironi, Lorenzo*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 利用完全动理学二维和三维粒子模拟，作者表明电荷中性的电子-正电子对束在电子-质子等离子体中可自发产生净电流，其中束电子被Weibel不稳定性产生的自生磁丝聚焦而束正电子不受约束，三维下净正电子电流进一步驱动非共振流不稳定性并放大磁场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 弓形激波脉冲星风云附近的丝状X射线结构以及Geminga、Monogem、PSR J0622+3749等脉冲星周围的慢扩散区域，暗示扩散系数比银河系平均值小2个数量级，挑战了星际介质中宇宙线输运的标准图像。抑制扩散可归因于逃逸电子-正电子对通过非共振流不稳定性驱动的自生磁湍流，但该不稳定性需要净电流，而逃逸对束预期是电荷中性的。

Method: 采用具有真实质量比的完全动理学二维粒子模拟（particle-in-cell simulations），并进一步开展三维模拟。摘要未说明具体的模拟参数、网格尺度、时间跨度、束流能量或等离子体参数。

Result: 二维模拟显示，束电子被聚焦到由Weibel不稳定性非线性演化产生的自生磁丝中，而束正电子保持不受约束。三维模拟表明，由此产生的净（正电子）电流驱动非共振流不稳定性，进一步放大磁场。摘要未给出量化数值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为该机制为最初电荷中性的对束中出现电荷不对称性、以及能有效散射束粒子的磁涨落增长提供了一条途径，对X射线丝的形成具有意义，并可能对PWNe周围TeV晕中的粒子自约束具有意义。根据摘要无法判断该机制与脉冲星单脉冲、模式转换、计时或FRB之间的具体联系。

Abstract: The observation of filamentary x-ray structures near bow-shock pulsar wind nebulae (PWNe)---such as the Guitar, Lighthouse, and PSR <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>J</mml:mi><mml:mn>2030</mml:mn><mml:mo>+</mml:mo><mml:mn>4415</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> nebulae---and of slow-diffusion regions around pulsars like Geminga, Monogem, and PSR <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>J</mml:mi><mml:mn>0622</mml:mn><mml:mo>+</mml:mo><mml:mn>3749</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula>, challenges the standard picture of cosmic-ray transport in the interstellar medium, implying a diffusion coefficient 2 orders of magnitude smaller than the Galactic average. The suppressed diffusion can be attributed to self-generated magnetic turbulence driven, via the nonresonant streaming instability, by electron-positron pairs escaping the PWNe. This instability requires a net current, yet the beam of escaping pairs is expected to be charge neutral. We show that a charge-neutral pair beam propagating through an electron-proton plasma can spontaneously generate a net current. Using fully kinetic two-dimensional particle-in-cell simulations with realistic mass ratios, we find that beam electrons get focused into self-generated magnetic filaments produced by the nonlinear evolution of the Weibel instability, while beam positrons remain unconfined. We show that in three-dimensional simulations, the resulting net (positron) current drives the nonresonant streaming instability, further amplifying the magnetic field. This mechanism provides a pathway for the onset of charge asymmetries in initially charge-neutral pair beams and for the growth of magnetic fluctuations that efficiently scatter the beam particles, with implications for the formation of x-ray filaments and, potentially, for particle self-confinement in TeV halos around PWNe.

</details>


### [228] [Parkes observations for project P1083 semester 2021APRS_02]()
*Possenti, Andrea,Burgay, Marta,Israel, Gianluca,Keane, Evan,Rea, Nanda,Esposito, Paolo,Pilia, Maura*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该项目提出通过射电与X射线“同时”观测磁星及表现出类磁星行为的普通脉冲星，以检验磁星与FRB的联系、磁星亚群的射电辐射机制以及磁星与普通射电脉冲星族群之间可能的演化路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 磁星 SGR 1935+2154 的两个极强毫秒射电脉冲与一个双峰硬X射线暴时间重合的突破性观测，为长期提出的磁星与快速射电暴（FRBs）存在联系的模型提供了有力支持；同时，磁星的射电辐射机制以及磁星与普通射电脉冲星族群之间是否存在演化路径仍有待探讨。

Method: 开展 NAPA 计划，对磁星以及表现出类磁星行为的普通脉冲星进行一系列射电波段与 X 射线波段的“同时”观测；触发条件是目标所对应的中子星在高能波段发生激活（或再激活）后所分配的合适 X 射线观测。摘要未说明所用望远镜、观测频段、时间跨度与样本量。

Result: 摘要未说明具体观测结果。摘要仅报告称，对磁星 SGR 1935+2154 的两个极强毫秒持续时间射电脉冲与一个双峰硬 X 射线暴时间重合的突破性观测，最近为磁星与快速射电暴（FRBs）之间存在联系的模型提供了有力支持。

Conclusion: 作者称该突破性观测为磁星与 FRBs 联系的模型提供了有力支持，并期望该项目探讨磁星与 FRBs 之间的联系、至少在磁星族群一个子集中起作用的射电辐射机制，以及是否存在连接磁星与普通射电脉冲星族群的演化路径。上述联系与演化路径属于该项目拟探讨的问题，根据摘要无法判断其是否已得到证实。

Abstract: The breakthrough observation of two ultra strong millisecond duration radio pulses temporally coincident with a double-peaked hard X-ray burst from the magnetar SGR 1935+2154 has recently lent strong support to the since long proposed model of a connection among the magnetars and the Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs). We are mounting a NAPA program aimed to run a series of "simultaneous" observations in the radio and X-ray bands of both magnetars and ordinary pulsars showing a magnetar-like behavior. The trigger will be suitable X-ray observations allocated after the occurrence of an activation (or reactivation) in the high energy bands of the neutron star underlying the targets. The project will address a range of astrophysical questions, among which: (i) the occurrence of a the link among magnetars and FRBs, (ii) the radio emission mechanisms operating in at least a subset of the magnetar population; (iii) the occurrence (if any) of an evolutionary path connecting the magnetars to the ordinary radio pulsar population

</details>


### [229] [Parkes observations for project P1083 semester 2020OCTS_01]()
*Possenti, Andrea,Burgay, Marta,Israel, Gianluca,Keane, Evan,Rea, Nanda,Esposito, Paolo,Pilia, Maura*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该 NAPA 计划拟对磁星及具有类磁星行为的普通脉冲星开展射电与 X 射线的“同时”观测，以检验磁星与 FRB 的联系、磁星族群中的射电辐射机制，以及磁星与普通射电脉冲星之间可能的演化联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SGR 1935+2154 同时出现的双峰硬 X 射线暴与两个超强毫秒持续时间射电脉冲的突破性观测，近来为长期提出的磁星与 FRB 相联系模型提供了有力支持。该计划由此出发，提出通过射电与 X 射线“同时”观测，检验磁星与 FRB 的联系、磁星族群中至少一部分的射电辐射机制，以及磁星与普通射电脉冲星族群之间是否存在演化路径。

Method: 摘要说明将开展一项 NAPA 计划，对磁星以及表现出类磁星行为的普通脉冲星进行一系列射电波段与 X 射线波段的“同时”观测；触发条件为在目标天体的中子星高能波段发生激活（或再激活）之后，安排合适的 X 射线观测。望远镜、具体频率或波段、时间跨度、样本大小以及数据分析方法：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要中明确报告的结果是：此前对磁星 SGR 1935+2154 同时出现的双峰硬 X 射线暴所伴随的两个超强毫秒持续时间射电脉冲的突破性观测，近来为磁星与 FRB 相联系的长期模型提供了有力支持。该 NAPA 计划本身尚处于筹划阶段，摘要未报告其观测结果、数值、统计显著性或其他发现。

Conclusion: 作者明确支持的解释是：SGR 1935+2154 的同时观测为磁星与 FRB 之间的联系模型提供了有力支持，并据此提出该计划将探讨磁星与 FRB 的联系、磁星族群中至少一部分的射电辐射机制，以及磁星与普通射电脉冲星族群之间是否存在演化路径。这些均为该计划拟研究的问题，而非该计划已得到的结论；根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The breakthrough observation of two ultra strong millisecond duration radio pulses temporally coincident with a double-peaked hard X-ray burst from the magnetar SGR 1935+2154 has recently lent strong support to the since long proposed model of a connection among the magnetars and the Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs). We are mounting a NAPA program aimed to run a series of "simultaneous" observations in the radio and X-ray bands of both magnetars and ordinary pulsars showing a magnetar-like behavior. The trigger will be suitable X-ray observations allocated after the occurrence of an activation (or reactivation) in the high energy bands of the neutron star underlying the targets. The project will address a range of astrophysical questions, among which: (i) the occurrence of a the link among magnetars and FRBs, (ii) the radio emission mechanisms operating in at least a subset of the magnetar population; (iii) the occurrence (if any) of an evolutionary path connecting the magnetars to the ordinary radio pulsar population

</details>

### [231] [Parkes observations for project P1327 semester 2025APRS_15]()
*Zhao, Shiqian,Hobbs, George,Caleb, Manisha,Dai, Shi,Wang, Shuangqiang,Luo, Rui*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 在Parkes观测中，研究人员从PSR J0901-4046探测到与FRB持续时间相似的单脉冲，其中包含与某些FRB相似的准周期子结构，并请求继续监测该源以探测更多脉冲。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超长周期射电暂现源的发现对中子星磁层偶极子模型的经典理论框架提出了新挑战。作者希望理解磁星射电辐射的起源，并建立银河系中子星与FRB之间的潜在关联。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测频率、观测频段、时间跨度、样本量或统计分析方法。摘要提到在Parkes的观测中探测单脉冲，并计划继续监测PSR J0901-4046，通过观测其单脉冲结构和偏振轮廓开展研究。

Result: 在Parkes观测中探测到与FRB持续时间相似的单脉冲，并显著包含与某些FRB相似的准周期子结构。摘要未说明具体脉冲数量、数值、持续时间、显著性水平或子结构参数。

Conclusion: 作者认为相似的现象可能具有相似的物理机制，并希望通过观测单脉冲结构和偏振轮廓理解磁星射电辐射的起源，建立银河系中子星与FRB之间的潜在关联；继续监测PSR J0901-4046旨在探测更多信号脉冲和多结构脉冲，为磁星作为FRB可能的前身起源提供见解，加强磁星与FRB之间的联系。根据摘要无法判断具体的物理机制或该关联的普适性。

Abstract: The radio radiation neutron star includes objects with spin periods ranging from milliseconds to tens of seconds. In the past years, however, the discovery of ultra-long period radio transient sources has posed a new challenge to the classical theoretical framework of the neutron star magnetospheric dipole model. In Parkes' observations, we detected single pulses with similar durations to fast radio bursts (FRBs), notably containing quasi-periodic substructures similar to some FRBs, and similar phenomena may have similar physical mechanisms. By observing its single-pulse structures and polarization profiles, we hope to understand the origin of radio emission from magnetars and establish the potential association between Galactic neutron stars and FRBs. Hence, we strongly request to keep monitoring this source, aiming to detect more signal pulses and interesting multi-structure pulses from PSR J0901-4046 to provide insights into magnetars as possible progenitor origins of FRBs, strengthening the link between magnetars and FRBs.

</details>

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案请求继续监测PSR J0901-4046，以便探测更多单脉冲和多结构脉冲；此前Parkes观测已探测到与FRB持续时间相似、并含类似某些FRB的准周期子结构的单脉冲，作者据此希望理解磁星射电辐射起源并加强磁星与FRB的关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超长周期射电暂现源的发现对中子星磁层偶极模型的经典理论框架构成新挑战；Parkes观测探测到与FRB持续时间相似的单脉冲并含有与某些FRB相似的准周期子结构，提示相似现象可能具有相似物理机制，因此需要理解磁星射电辐射起源并探讨银河系中子星与FRB的潜在关联。

Method: 通过Parkes观测PSR J0901-4046的单脉冲结构和偏振轮廓，并请求继续监测该源以探测更多信号脉冲和有趣的多结构脉冲；摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本量及统计分析方法。

Result: 在Parkes观测中探测到与FRB持续时间相似的单脉冲，其中显著包含与某些FRB相似的准周期子结构；摘要未给出具体脉冲数量、周期或子结构参数、频率、显著性等定量结果。作者表示需要继续监测以探测更多信号脉冲和有趣的多结构脉冲。

Conclusion: 作者认为相似现象可能具有相似物理机制，希望通过单脉冲结构和偏振轮廓观测理解磁星射电辐射起源，建立银河系中子星与FRB的潜在关联，并加强磁星与FRB之间的联系，为磁星作为FRB可能前身起源提供见解；该物理关联的具体机制根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The radio radiation neutron star includes objects with spin periods ranging from milliseconds to tens of seconds. In the past years, however, the discovery of ultra-long period radio transient sources has posed a new challenge to the classical theoretical framework of the neutron star magnetospheric dipole model. In Parkes' observations, we detected single pulses with similar durations to fast radio bursts (FRBs), notably containing quasi-periodic substructures similar to some FRBs, and similar phenomena may have similar physical mechanisms. By observing its single-pulse structures and polarization profiles, we hope to understand the origin of radio emission from magnetars and establish the potential association between Galactic neutron stars and FRBs. Hence, we strongly request to keep monitoring this source, aiming to detect more signal pulses and interesting multi-structure pulses from PSR J0901-4046 to provide insights into magnetars as possible progenitor origins of FRBs, strengthening the link between magnetars and FRBs.

</details>

In Parkes' observations, we detected single pulses with similar durations to fast radio bursts (FRBs), notably containing quasi-periodic substructures similar to some FRBs, and similar phenomena may have similar physical mechanisms. By observing its single-pulse structures and polarization profiles, we hope to understand the origin of radio emission from magnetars and establish the potential association between Galactic neutron stars and FRBs. Hence, we strongly request to keep monitoring this source, aiming to detect more signal pulses and interesting multi-structure pulses from PSR J0901-4046 to provide insights into magnetars as possible progenitor origins of FRBs, strengthening the link between magnetars and FRBs.

</details>
