Result: 摘要未说明观测结果；本文为观测提案，仅陈述此前的 FAST 观测已揭示与零脉冲脉冲星、巨脉冲和 FRB 群体在多个方面相符的特征，并指出跟踪时长、有效时间分辨率和窄带能力方面的局限导致许多谜团未解。

Conclusion: 作者预期 UWL 数据将提供有价值的见解，用以确定该源的性质更接近脉冲星还是 FRB；这一判断有待拟议观测完成。根据摘要无法判断具体的物理机制或该源与磁星的联系。

Abstract: Rotating Radio Transients (RRATs) are neutron stars that emit sporadic radio bursts. Our observations of RRAT~J1913+1330 using the FAST telescope have revealed intriguing characteristics that align with populations of nulling pulsars, giant pulses, and Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) from various perspectives. However, the limitations in tracking length, effective time resolution, and narrowband capabilities of the FAST observation have left many mysteries surrounding this source unanswered. In this proposal, we aim to conduct observations of J1913+1330 using the Parkes Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver. Our objective is to perform a single tracking session lasting up to 5 hours, employing high-time resolution, in order to search for a long-term period and sub-millisecond quasi-periodic oscillation. Through an analysis of the spectrum and potential scattering effects using wideband observation, the UWL data will provide valuable insights to determine whether this source exhibits properties more akin to pulsars or FRBs.

</details>


### [305] [Optimal strategies for gravitational wave memory detection in pulsar timing arrays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.19977)
*Sun, Jerry P.,Siemens, Xavier,Madison, Dustin R.*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该工作针对脉冲星计时数据中带记忆的引力波暴，推导了相干与非相干两个频率学派检测统计量，二者服从 χ² 分布且非中心参数由 SNR 给出，并可作为振幅参数的最大似然估计量；在 SNR ≲ 5 的低信号区估计量不准确，而在中到高信号区可准确确定信号参数，且纳入红噪声会降低注入记忆信号的 SNR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文关注的是在脉冲星计时数据中搜寻带记忆的引力波暴这一探测问题，并指出所需检测统计量可与连续波搜寻中常用的 F_e 与 F_p 统计量相类比；摘要未明确说明该领域此前存在的具体知识空白或未解决问题。

Method: 摘要说明：通过以两种不同方式最大化似然比，分别构造一个相干统计量和一个非相干统计量；论证这两个统计量服从 χ² 分布，其自由度可变，非中心参数由数据中信号的信噪比（SNR）给出；并将二者用于计算引力波记忆信号振幅参数的最大似然估计量；还研究了红噪声对这些统计量的影响。具体的观测数据、仪器、频段、时间跨度与样本量，摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：所构造的相干统计量和非相干统计量均服从 χ² 分布，自由度可变，非中心参数由数据中信号的信噪比给出；这些统计量可用于计算脉冲星计时数据中可能引力波记忆信号振幅参数的最大似然估计量；在低信号区（SNR ≲ 5），估计量不准确，而在中到高信号区，这些估计量能够准确确定正确的信号参数；纳入红噪声会降低所注入记忆信号的信噪比。

Conclusion: 作者得出结论：所推导的两个计算高效的频率学派统计量可用于脉冲星计时数据中带记忆引力波暴的搜寻，并可用于振幅参数的最大似然估计；在低信号区（SNR ≲ 5）估计量不准确，而在中到高信号区可准确确定信号参数；红噪声会降低注入记忆信号的信噪比。至于该统计量是否可用于磁星、单脉冲、模式转换或快速射电暴等其他研究方向，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: In this work we derive two computationally efficient frequentist detection statistics that can be used in searches for gravitational-wave bursts with memory in pulsar timing data. By maximizing the likelihood ratio in two different ways we construct a coherent statistic and an incoherent statistic, which are analogs of the <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>F</mml:mi><mml:mi>e</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> and <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>F</mml:mi><mml:mi>p</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> statistics commonly used for continuous-wave searches in pulsar timing data. We show that both statistics are <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msup><mml:mi>χ</mml:mi><mml:mn>2</mml:mn></mml:msup></mml:math></inline-formula>-distributed with varying degrees of freedom and noncentrality parameters given by the signal-to-noise (SNR) ratio of the signal present in our data. The statistics can also be used to compute the maximum likelihood estimators of amplitude parameters of a possible gravitational-wave memory signal in pulsar timing data. We find that in the low-signal regime (<inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>SNR</mml:mi><mml:mo>≲</mml:mo><mml:mn>5</mml:mn></mml:math></inline-formula>), the estimators are inaccurate. However, in intermediate- to high-signal regimes, we show that these estimators can accurately determine the correct signal parameters. We also study the effects of red noise on these statistics, and find that the inclusion of red noise reduces the signal-to-noise ratio for injected memory signals.

</details>


### [306] [Probing quadratically coupled ultralight dark matter with pulsar timing arrays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.13945)
*Gan, Xucheng,Kim, Hyungjin,Mitridate, Andrea*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该工作刻画了二次耦合超轻暗物质在脉冲星计时阵列中产生的相干与随机信号，并评估当前及未来PTA的探测灵敏度；结果显示，对相干信号，当前PTA灵敏度可与等效原理检验和原子钟竞争甚至超越，而对随机信号，PTA灵敏度在现有和未来数据集下均不及等效原理约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超轻暗物质可能二次耦合到标准模型粒子，从而在脉冲星计时阵列观测中留下信号；需要刻画这些信号并评估当前与未来PTA观测对其的探测能力，以判断PTA在这一探测方向上相对于其他探针的竞争力。

Method: 摘要未说明。摘要仅说明本研究刻画二次耦合超轻暗物质在PTA观测中产生的相干与随机信号，并纳入暗物质在有限密度介质中传播的效应，据此评估当前和未来PTA观测的灵敏度。

Result: 对于相干信号，当前PTA观测的灵敏度可与等效原理检验和原子钟等其他探针竞争，有时甚至超过它们。对于随机信号，无论现有还是未来的PTA数据集，PTA灵敏度均不及等效原理约束。

Conclusion: 作者认为，二次耦合超轻暗物质产生的相干信号是PTA可与其他探针竞争甚至更具优势的探测目标，而随机信号方面PTA灵敏度尚不及等效原理约束。根据摘要无法判断该研究对脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）具体观测研究的可迁移性。

Abstract: Ultralight dark matter may couple quadratically to Standard Model particles. Such quadratic interactions give rise to both coherent and stochastic signals in pulsar timing array (PTA) observations. In this work, we characterize these signals, including the effects of dark matter propagation in a finite-density medium, and assess the sensitivity of current and upcoming PTA observations to their detection. For coherent signals, we find that the sensitivity of current PTA observations competes with and sometimes exceeds that of other probes, such as equivalence principle tests and atomic clocks. For stochastic signals, we find that PTA sensitivities underperform equivalence principle constraints for both existing and upcoming PTA datasets.

</details>


### [307] [VizieR Online Data Catalog: NS in binary systems kick velocities study (O'Doherty+, 2023)]()
*O'Doherty, T. N.,Bahramian, A.,Miller-Jones, J. C. A.,Goodwin, A. J.,Mandel, I.,Willcox, R.,Atri, P.,Strader, J.*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该数据目录基于145个年老中子星双星系统样本，估计其出生时可能经受的双星kick分布，样本包括14颗红背脉冲星、19个NS LMXB、17个黑寡妇系统和95颗MSP，并与其他中子星和黑洞比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 年老中子星双星（如MSP和NS LMXB）出生时经历的双星kick尚缺乏系统估计。以往双星kick估计方法主要聚焦于黑洞LMXB，而适用于年老中子星双星的技术尚未被用于汇编大样本，因此需要估计这些系统的潜在双星kick分布并进行类别间比较。

Method: 摘要未说明具体的观测仪器、频段与时间跨度。文中汇编了145个年老中子星双星系统样本，包括通过搜寻Gaia EDR3/DR3对应体得到的14颗红背脉冲星、来自Arnason et al. (2021MNRAS.502.5455A) 的19个场中NS LMXB、从Hui &amp; Li (2019Galax...7...93H) 提取的17个黑寡妇系统，以及使用ATNF星表（Manchester et al. 2005）的95颗MSP。方法利用系统的距离、自行和系统视向速度估计双星kick分布，并采用PKVs概率分布分析及拟合模型，结果与距离列于msps.dat、blwidows.dat、nslmxbs.dat、redbacks.dat。

Result: 共汇编145个年老中子星双星系统，包括14颗已证认的红背脉冲星、19个场中NS LMXB系统、17个黑寡妇系统和95颗MSP，分别对应数据表redbacks.dat、nslmxbs.dat、blwidows.dat和msps.dat。摘要给出了各样本的来源与数量，以及PKVs概率分布分析结果连同所用天体测量和距离已列于相应表格；摘要未给出具体数值、分布参数或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者利用距离、自行和系统视向速度估计年老中子星双星出生时的潜在双星kick分布，并将其先与不同类别的年老中子星比较，再与其他中子星和黑洞比较。摘要未给出具体的物理推断结果。与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、模式转换、计时、偏振、射电频谱、快速射电暴（FRB）等主题的直接联系：摘要未说明；根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Neutron stars (NSs) are ultra-dense remnants left behind after massive stars end their lives in a supernova explosion, and are most often observed as pulsars and in X-ray binaries (XRBs). Pulsars are highly magnetic, rapidly rotating NSs that produce beamed radio emission. Typical pulsars are young (&lt;10<SUP>8</SUP> yr) and have spin periods ~1 s. However, millisecond pulsars (MSPs) are much older (&gt;10<SUP>9</SUP> yr) with spin periods &lt; 30 ms and weaker magnetic fields. The NS XRBs are binary systems with an NS accreting material from a stellar companion. Systems with low-mass companions (M<SUB>c</SUB> &lt;= 1 M<SUB>ȯ</SUB>) are called low-mass XRBs (LMXBs) and are long lived (&gt;10<SUP>9</SUP> yr) with stable mass transfer occurring during the long lifetime of the companion. <P />Recently, Atri et al. (2019MNRAS.489.3116A) developed a novel method for estimating the binary kicks of old binary systems. The technique uses the system's distance, proper motion, and systemic radial velocity to robustly estimate the potential binary kick distribution for each system. While Atri et al. (2019MNRAS.489.3116A) focused on black hole LMXBs, this technique is equally applicable to estimating the binary kicks of old NSs like MSPs and NS LMXBs. In this paper, we compile a sample of 145 old NSs and estimate the potential binary kick distribution they could have received at birth, comparing them first to different classes of old NSs, and then to other NSs and black holes. <P />Estimates distance methods, kick distribution and fits models are fully discussed in section 2. As presented in section 3, with searching for Gaia EDR3/DR3 counterparts, we firstly compiled 14 confirmed redback pulsars mostly originated from Strader et al. (2019ApJ...872...42S; Cat. J/ApJ/872/42). Secondly in a way, we compiled 19 NS LMXB systems in the field from Arnason et al. (2021MNRAS.502.5455A), 17 black widow systems extracted from Hui &amp; Li (2019Galax...7...93H) using their table of Galactic field black widows. Finally, we focus on 95 MSPs using ATNF catalog from Manchester et al. (2005AJ....129.1993M, Cat. B/psr). Results from PKVs probability distributions analysis as well as astrometrics and distances used are provided in tables msps.dat, blwidows.dat, nslmxbs.dat, redbacks.dat respectively for samples of 145 NS binary systems. <P />(4 data files).

</details>


### [308] [Parkes observations for project P1421 semester 2026APRS_02]()
*Balzan, Joel,James, Clancy,Meyers, Bradley,Bera, Apurba*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该研究计划系统识别并表征一类在纳秒-微秒尺度上表现出相干或部分有序偏振角演化的蟹状星云脉冲星单脉冲，并使用FIRES模拟器在偏振尖峰噪声框架内建模，将其推断的尖峰性质与高时间分辨率CRAFT FRB样本比较，以评估其作为FRB类似物的相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 快速射电暴（FRB）因其河外距离与偶发出现而难以直接研究其辐射物理，蟹状星云脉冲星的巨脉冲曾被当作潜在银河系类似物；但纳秒分辨率下巨脉冲的随机偏振角与多数FRB在微秒-毫秒尺度上的相干偏振角演化相矛盾，使其一般被视为不佳的FRB类似物。近期CRAFT巡天的高时间分辨率观测与稀有蟹状星云脉冲星单脉冲亚类的发现，促使重新评估这一问题。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测设备、频段、时间跨度或样本量。作者计划系统性识别和表征一类在纳秒-微秒尺度上表现出相干或部分有序偏振角演化的罕见蟹状星云脉冲星单脉冲，并使用快速、强射电辐射模拟器（FIRES）在偏振尖峰噪声框架内对这些事件建模，再将推断出的尖峰性质与高时间分辨率CRAFT FRB样本直接比较。

Result: 摘要未说明本研究已获得的观测或建模结果。摘要提及的既有背景包括：在纳秒分辨率下，蟹状星云脉冲星的巨脉冲分解为窄带、接近100%偏振的纳秒尖峰，其偏振角随机分布；大多数FRB经常在微秒-毫秒时间尺度上表现出相干的偏振角演化；近期CRAFT巡天的高时间分辨率观测揭示了具有快速、高度结构化偏振角变化的FRB，被自然解释为部分相关偏振尖峰的叠加，而非平滑偏振角摆动；并已识别出一类罕见且在很大程度上未被探索的蟹状星云脉冲星单脉冲亚类，在纳秒-微秒尺度上表现出相干或部分有序的偏振角演化。

Conclusion: 作者拟通过对比这些蟹状星云脉冲星脉冲与高时间分辨率CRAFT FRB样本的推断尖峰性质，评估其作为FRB类似物的相关性。摘要指出，此类脉冲的相干或部分有序偏振角演化意味着相关尖峰性质或辐射区内有序的等离子体和磁场结构。关于本研究最终能达到何种物理结论，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are brief, ultra-bright transients, most likely associated with neutron stars. Although their luminosity makes them powerful probes of cosmological environments, their extragalactic distances and sporadic occurrence hinder direct investigation of their emission physics. The Crab pulsar has been considered a potential Galactic analogue to FRBs through its giant pulses (GPs). At nanosecond resolution, Crab GPs resolve into narrowband, nearly 100% polarised nanoshots with randomly distributed polarisation angles (PAs), motivating models in which burst envelopes arise from the superposition of many independently polarised shots. However, this behaviour contrasts with most FRBs, which frequently exhibit coherent PA evolution across microsecond-millisecond timescales. Consequently, Crab GPs have generally been regarded as poor FRB analogues. Recent high-time-resolution observations from the CRAFT survey revealed FRBs with rapid, highly structured PA variability that is naturally interpreted as the superposition of partially correlated polarised shots rather than smooth PA swings. Also, a rare and largely unexplored sub-class of Crab single pulses has been identified that exhibits coherent or partially ordered PA evolution on nanosecond-microsecond timescales, implying correlated shot properties or organised plasma and magnetic-field structure within the emission region. We aim to systematically identify and characterise these Crab pulses and assess their relevance as FRB analogues. Using the Fast, Intense Radio Emission Simulator (FIRES), we model these events within a polarised shot noise framework and directly compare their inferred shot properties to the high-time-resolution CRAFT FRB sample.

</details>

### [310] [Parkes observations for project P1421 semester 2026APRS_03]()
*Balzan, Joel,James, Clancy,Meyers, Bradley,Bera, Apurba*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该研究拟系统识别并表征蟹状星云脉冲星中表现出纳秒-微秒尺度相干或部分有序偏振角演化的单脉冲子类，并用FIRES在偏振尖峰噪声框架下建模，将其推断的尖峰性质与高时间分辨率CRAFT FRB样本直接比较，以评估其作为FRB类似物的相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB最可能与中子星有关，但其河外距离和偶发出现阻碍了对辐射物理的直接研究；蟹状星云脉冲星巨脉冲曾被视作银河系FRB类似物，但其纳秒尖峰的随机偏振角与大多数FRB在微秒-毫秒尺度上的相干偏振角演化相矛盾，因而通常被认为是不佳类似物。CRAFT巡天发现具有快速、高度结构化偏振角变化的FRB，同时一类罕见且未被充分探索的蟹状星云脉冲星单脉冲子类表现出相干或部分有序的偏振角演化，需要系统性识别与评估。

Method: 摘要未说明观测时间、望远镜或频段等具体观测细节；方法上使用Fast, Intense Radio Emission Simulator（FIRES），在偏振尖峰噪声框架内对相关事件建模，并将推断出的尖峰性质与高时间分辨率CRAFT FRB样本直接比较。目标是对表现出相干或部分有序偏振角演化的蟹状星云脉冲星单脉冲进行系统性识别与表征。

Result: 摘要未说明本研究的具体结果或数值。背景性陈述包括：在纳秒分辨率下，蟹状星云脉冲星巨脉冲分解为窄带、接近100%偏振的纳秒尖峰，其偏振角随机分布；大多数FRB常在微秒-毫秒时间尺度上表现出相干偏振角演化；CRAFT巡天的高时间分辨率观测揭示了具有快速、高度结构化偏振角变化的FRB；并识别出一类罕见且在很大程度上未被探索的蟹状星云脉冲星单脉冲子类，其在纳秒-微秒时间尺度上表现出相干或部分有序的偏振角演化。

Conclusion: 摘要未给出本研究的明确结论；其提出的工作目标是系统识别并表征这些蟹状星云脉冲星脉冲，并评估它们作为FRB类似物的相关性。摘要指出，随机偏振角的蟹状星云脉冲星巨脉冲与大多数FRB的相干偏振角演化相矛盾，因此通常被视为不佳FRB类似物；而快速、高度结构化偏振角变化的FRB被解释为部分相关偏振尖峰的叠加，稀有蟹状星云脉冲星单脉冲子类的相干或部分有序偏振角演化则暗示相关尖峰性质或辐射区内有组织的等离子体和磁场结构。根据摘要无法判断本研究最终能否支持蟹状星云脉冲星脉冲作为FRB类似物。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are brief, ultra-bright transients, most likely associated with neutron stars. Although their luminosity makes them powerful probes of cosmological environments, their extragalactic distances and sporadic occurrence hinder direct investigation of their emission physics. The Crab pulsar has been considered a potential Galactic analogue to FRBs through its giant pulses (GPs). At nanosecond resolution, Crab GPs resolve into narrowband, nearly 100% polarised nanoshots with randomly distributed polarisation angles (PAs), motivating models in which burst envelopes arise from the superposition of many independently polarised shots. However, this behaviour contrasts with most FRBs, which frequently exhibit coherent PA evolution across microsecond-millisecond timescales. Consequently, Crab GPs have generally been regarded as poor FRB analogues. Recent high-time-resolution observations from the CRAFT survey revealed FRBs with rapid, highly structured PA variability that is naturally interpreted as the superposition of partially correlated polarised shots rather than smooth PA swings. Also, a rare and largely unexplored sub-class of Crab single pulses has been identified that exhibits coherent or partially ordered PA evolution on nanosecond-microsecond timescales, implying correlated shot properties or organised plasma and magnetic-field structure within the emission region. We aim to systematically identify and characterise these Crab pulses and assess their relevance as FRB analogues. Using the Fast, Intense Radio Emission Simulator (FIRES), we model these events within a polarised shot noise framework and directly compare their inferred shot properties to the high-time-resolution CRAFT FRB sample.

</details>


### [311] [Parkes observations for project P1281 semester 2024OCTS_09]()
*Zhao, Shiqian,Hobbs, George,Toomey, Lawrence,Dai, Shi,Wang, Shuangqiang,Jiang, Jinchen,Luo, Rui,Wang, Weiyang*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 对射电源VT 1137-0337的FAST和Parkes观测发现了若干色散量非常接近的可疑短时标单脉冲候选体，其中Parkes UWL数据中的信号脉宽约1 ms并呈现明显宽带特征；作者据此请求继续用Parkes UWL监测该源以探测显著FRB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB物理起源长期存在争论；2020年银河系磁星的明亮射电暴表明至少部分暗弱FRB可来自正常磁星。目前仅有两个活跃FRB重复暴被确认与持续射电源相关，后者常被解释为磁星风星云。摘要关注的空白是：活跃FRB重复暴的本质尚未直接揭示，因此需要对一个特定射电源持续监测。

Method: 摘要说明使用FAST和Parkes望远镜对特定射电源VT 1137-0337进行了最近观测，并在Parkes UWL数据中搜索短时标单脉冲候选体，比较其色散量；摘要请求继续使用Parkes UWL接收机监测该源。观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本大小及具体分析流程摘要未说明。

Result: 在FAST和Parkes的最近观测中，对射电源VT 1137-0337发现了若干可疑的短时标单脉冲候选体，其色散量非常接近。值得注意的是，Parkes UWL数据中发现的信号具有约1 ms的典型脉冲宽度，并呈现出明显的宽带特征。摘要未说明这些候选体的统计显著性、数量、具体色散量数值或确认状态。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些可疑信号支持继续使用Parkes UWL接收机监测VT 1137-0337，目标是探测到一个显著的FRB并直接揭示活跃FRB重复暴的本质。至于该源是否确为活跃FRB重复暴、其持续射电源是否确为磁星风星云，以及疑似信号是否确为FRB，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The physical origin of fast radio bursts (FRBs) has been hotly debated over the past decade until the discovery of bright radio bursts from the Galactic magnetar in 2020. The discovery of galactic FRBs has demonstrated that at least some faint FRBs can originate from normal magnetars. So far, only two active FRB repeaters are confirmed to be associated with persistent radio sources, which are normally interpreted as magnetar wind nebulae by theorists. From the most recent observations with the FAST and Parkes telescopes, we observed a particular radio source, VT 1137-0337, and we found several suspicious short-duration single pulse candidates whose dispersion measurements were very close. Notably, the signal found in the Parkes UWL data has a typical pulse width of 1 ms and exhibits an apparent broadband feature. We strongly request continuing to monitor this source with the Parkes UWL receiver, aiming to detect a significant FRB and directly reveal the nature of the active FRB repeaters.

</details>

The discovery of galactic FRBs has demonstrated that at least some faint FRBs can originate from normal magnetars. So far, only two active FRB repeaters are confirmed to be associated with persistent radio sources, which are normally interpreted as magnetar wind nebulae by theorists. From the most recent observations with the FAST and Parkes telescopes, we observed a particular radio source, VT 1137-0337, and we found several suspicious short-duration single pulse candidates whose dispersion measurements were very close. Notably, the signal found in the Parkes UWL data has a typical pulse width of 1 ms and exhibits an apparent broadband feature. Method: 摘要未说明观测时间跨度、样本规模与具体分析方法。摘要说明：使用FAST和Parkes望远镜进行最近观测，并分析Parkes UWL数据，识别短时标单脉冲候选体并比较其色散量，其中Parkes UWL信号的脉冲宽度为1 ms并表现出宽带特征；作者请求继续用Parkes UWL接收机监测该源。

Result: 在最近使用FAST和Parkes望远镜的观测中，观测了特定射电源VT 1137-0337，发现了若干个可疑的短时标单脉冲候选体，其色散量（DM）非常接近。值得注意的是，Parkes UWL数据中发现的信号具有典型的1 ms脉冲宽度，并表现出明显的宽带特征。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些候选体值得进一步监测，并强烈请求继续用Parkes UWL接收机监测VT 1137-0337，目标是探测到一个显著的FRB，从而直接揭示活跃FRB重复暴的本质。摘要未说明这些候选体是否确为FRB，也未给出其与磁星或磁星风星云物理联系的判断；根据摘要无法判断该源性质是否已被确认。

Abstract: The physical origin of fast radio bursts (FRBs) has been hotly debated over the past decade until the discovery of bright radio bursts from the Galactic magnetar in 2020. The discovery of galactic FRBs has demonstrated that at least some faint FRBs can originate from normal magnetars. So far, only two active FRB repeaters are confirmed to be associated with persistent radio sources, which are normally interpreted as magnetar wind nebulae by theorists. From the most recent observations with the FAST and Parkes telescopes, we observed a particular radio source, VT 1137-0337, and we found several suspicious short-duration single pulse candidates whose dispersion measurements were very close. Notably, the signal found in the Parkes UWL data has a typical pulse width of 1 ms and exhibits an apparent broadband feature. We strongly request continuing to monitor this source with the Parkes UWL receiver, aiming to detect a significant FRB and directly reveal the nature of the active FRB repeaters.

</details>

TL;DR: 该提案请求用 32 小时观测两个可能具有磁星前身天体的源，以期从疑似磁星驱动的短伽马射线暴方向探测快速射电暂现源；若探测成功，将确认 FRB 与 SGRB 前身天体的关联，并直接揭示至少一个族群河外 FRB 的起源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 的前身天体长期存在争议。来自银河系磁星 SGR 1935+2154 的明亮射电暴表明部分暗弱 FRB 可能源自普通磁星，而邻近星系的短伽马射线暴 GRB 200415A 被证明由磁星巨耀发引起。若部分 SGRB 与重复 FRB 共享相似的磁星前身天体，则应能从疑似磁星驱动的 SGRB 中探测到快速射电暂现源。

Method: 摘要说明这是一项观测提案：提议观测两个可能具有磁星前身天体的源，并请求总共 32 小时的观测时间。摘要未说明所使用的望远镜或仪器、观测频率或波段、观测时间跨度、数据形式以及具体分析流程。

Result: 摘要未报告任何观测结果或探测。摘要仅说明提出了一项针对两个可能具有磁星前身天体的源的观测提案，请求总观测时间为 32 小时，并预期若实现探测，可确认 FRB 与 SGRB 前身天体的关联并直接揭示至少一个族群河外 FRB 的起源。摘要未说明探测数量、显著性、辐射特征、计时或偏振结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出，若由磁星巨耀发驱动的 SGRB 与重复 FRB 共享相似的磁星前身天体，则对疑似磁星驱动的 SGRB 方向进行射电观测有可能探测到快速射电暂现源；一旦探测成功，将确认 FRB 和 SGRB 两者前身天体的关联，并直接揭示至少一个族群河外 FRB 的起源。该结论是基于假定的预期，摘要中并未给出实际探测证据。根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时或偏振等具体观测议题的关联。

Abstract: The progenitors of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) have been highly debated in past decade. The discovery of a bright radio burst from a Galactic magnetar, SGR 1935+2154, implies that some of faint FRBs can originate from normal magnetars. A recent short gamma-ray bursts (GRB 200415A) from a nearby galaxy turned out to be caused by magnetar giant flare. If a fraction of SGRBs and repeating FRBs share similar magnetars as progenitors, we could expect to detect fast radio transients from some suspicious magnetar-driven SGRBs. Here we propose to observe two sources with possible magnetar progenitors, in particular, a total observing time of 32 hours is requested. If detections made, we would confirm the association of progenitors of both FRBs and SGRBs and directly uncover the origin of extragalactic FRBs for at least one population.

</details>

Motivation: FRB 的 progenitor 在过去十年中备受争议。从银河系磁星 SGR 1935+2154 探测到的明亮射电爆发表明部分微弱 FRB 可能来自普通磁星，而邻近星系的短伽马射线暴 GRB 200415A 被证明由磁星巨耀发引起；若部分 SGRB 与重复 FRB 共享相似的磁星 progenitor，则可预期从可疑的磁星驱动 SGRB 中探测到快速射电暂现源。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测仪器、接收机、观测频段、数据处理流程或分析手段；仅提出观测两个可能具有磁星 progenitor 的源，并请求总计 32 小时的观测时间。

Result: 摘要未报告实际探测结果，也未给出观测数据、显著性、偏振、频谱、计时或脉冲轮廓等结果；其陈述结果为：从银河系磁星 SGR 1935+2154 探测到一次明亮射电爆发，以及邻近星系的短伽马射线暴 GRB 200415A 被证明由磁星巨耀发引起。

Conclusion: 作者提出若实现探测，将确认 FRB 与 SGRB 两者的 progenitor 关联，并直接揭示至少一个族群的外星系 FRB 起源。这些推断取决于未来观测是否探测到快速射电暂现源；根据摘要无法判断对脉冲星单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、偏振或射电频谱研究的可迁移性。关于磁星与 FRB 观测之间的具体物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The progenitors of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) have been highly debated in past decade. The discovery of a bright radio burst from a Galactic magnetar, SGR 1935+2154, implies that some of faint FRBs can originate from normal magnetars. A recent short gamma-ray bursts (GRB 200415A) from a nearby galaxy turned out to be caused by magnetar giant flare. If a fraction of SGRBs and repeating FRBs share similar magnetars as progenitors, we could expect to detect fast radio transients from some suspicious magnetar-driven SGRBs. Here we propose to observe two sources with possible magnetar progenitors, in particular, a total observing time of 32 hours is requested. If detections made, we would confirm the association of progenitors of both FRBs and SGRBs and directly uncover the origin of extragalactic FRBs for at least one population.

</details>

### [340] [From new physics to a running power law and back again: Minimal refitting techniques for the reconstruction of the gravitational-wave background signal in pulsar timing array data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.23574)
*Esmyol, David,Iovino, Antonio J.,Schmitz, Kai*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该文提出将引力波背景谱模型重拟合到游走幂律（RPL）后验密度的新方法，通过构造映射 $\Phi$ 并由 $\chi^{2}$ 最小化构造该映射，从而在 GWB 模型参数空间上诱导似然，并以稳定宇宙弦、亚稳宇宙弦和标量诱导引力波三个例子进行验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PTA 合作组最近报告了纳赫兹频率上 GWB 信号的证据；本文旨在引入新的重拟合技术，将文献中的相关技术提升到更严格的水平，为快速而准确的贝叶斯推断和物理上直观的模型比较提供基础。摘要未说明所针对的具体知识空白。

Method: 摘要描述的方法为：构造从 GWB 谱模型到游走幂律（RPL）参考模型的映射 $\Phi$，使 RPL 后验密度 $P_{\mathrm{RPL}}$ 的拉回 $\Phi^{*}P_{\mathrm{RPL}}$ 在 GWB 模型参数空间上诱导似然，即将谱模型重新拟合到 RPL 后验密度；为构造 $\Phi$，引入匹配滤波方法，$\Phi$ 来自考虑了 PTA 灵敏度曲线频率依赖性的 $\chi^{2}$ 最小化。摘要未说明具体观测、数据、仪器、频段、时间跨度或样本。

Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果或显著性，仅说明所提出的重拟合技术通过三个具体例子得到验证和展示：来自稳定宇宙弦的 GW、来自亚稳宇宙弦的 GW，以及标量诱导的 GW。

Conclusion: 作者提出该重拟合技术为快速而准确的贝叶斯推断和物理上直观的模型比较提供了基础，并通过稳定宇宙弦、亚稳宇宙弦和标量诱导引力波三个例子加以验证和展示。摘要未给出上述引力波源的具体物理结论。该文方法可能对 GWB 谱模型推断具有方法学参考意义，但其与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、FRB 等具体主题的联系根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Pulsar timing array (PTA) collaborations recently presented evidence for a gravitational-wave background (GWB) signal at nanohertz frequencies. In this paper, we introduce new refitting techniques for PTA data analysis that elevate related techniques in the literature to a more rigorous level, and thus provide the basis for fast and accurate Bayesian inference and physically intuitive model comparisons. The key idea behind our approach is to construct maps <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>Φ</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> from GWB spectral models to a running-power-law (RPL) reference model, such that the pullback <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msup><mml:mi>Φ</mml:mi><mml:mo>*</mml:mo></mml:msup><mml:msub><mml:mi>P</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mi>RPL</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> of the RPL posterior density <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>P</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mi>RPL</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> induces a likelihood on the GWB model parameter space; in other words, we refit spectral models to the RPL posterior density. In order to construct <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>Φ</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula>, we introduce a matched-filtering approach in which <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>Φ</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> follows from a <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msup><mml:mi>χ</mml:mi><mml:mn>2</mml:mn></mml:msup></mml:math></inline-formula> minimization that accounts for the frequency dependence of PTA sensitivity curves. We validate and illustrate our techniques by three concrete examples: GWs from stable cosmic strings, GWs from metastable strings, and scalar-induced GWs.

</details>


### [341] [Parkes observations for project P871 semester 2017APRS_BPSR_02]()
*Petroff, Emily,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Bailes, Matthew,Burke-Spolaor, Sarah,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Keane, Evan,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Caleb, Manisha*

TL;DR: 该提案提出通过监测两个已知FRB的视场来搜寻重复脉冲，以直接检验FRB起源于类Crab脉冲星巨脉冲或遥远磁星活跃期的假设；这两个目标源具有已有的多波段存档图像和由DM推得的小距离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB是明亮的毫秒时标射电脉冲，被推测起源于宇宙学距离；迄今只观测到一个FRB重复，其起源仍是谜团。有人提出FRB来自类Crab脉冲星巨脉冲或遥远磁星的活跃期，这两种机制都会产生可观测的后续类FRB事件，因此需要直接检验这一假设。

Method: 摘要说明这是一份观测提案：监测两个已知FRB的视场，搜寻可能解释其前身星的重复脉冲；目标选择基于该视场已有的多波段存档图像以及由DM推得的小距离。观测所用望远镜、频段、时间跨度、样本量及具体分析手段摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未说明观测结果。摘要仅报告：迄今已观测到一个FRB重复出现；提案拟监测两个已知FRB的视场以搜寻重复脉冲；所选两个目标具有已有的多波段存档图像和由DM推得的小距离。

Conclusion: 作者拟通过监测两个已知FRB的视场并搜寻重复脉冲，直接检验FRB起源于类Crab脉冲星巨脉冲或遥远磁星活跃期的假设。摘要未给出该检验的结论；关于FRB前身星的具体物理图像，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) are bright, millisecond-duration radio pulses hypothesized to originate at cosmological distances. To date, one FRB has been seen to repeat but their origins remain a puzzling mystery. Some have proposed FRBs come from Crab-like pulsar giant pulses or periods of high activity of distant magnetars. Both mechanisms would generate observable subsequent FRB-like events. In this proposal we directly test this hypothesis by monitoring the fields of two known FRBs to search for repeating pulses that may explain their progenitors. We target two sources with existing multi-wavelength archival images of the field and small DM-derived distances.

</details>

Abstract: Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) are bright, millisecond-duration radio pulses hypothesized to originate at cosmological distances. To date, one FRB has been seen to repeat but their origins remain a puzzling mystery. Some have proposed FRBs come from Crab-like pulsar giant pulses or periods of high activity of distant magnetars. We target two sources with existing multi-wavelength archival images of the field and small DM-derived distances.

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB是明亮的毫秒量级射电脉冲，被推测起源于宇宙学距离；迄今仅观测到一个FRB重复出现，其起源仍是未解之谜。已有观点提出FRB可能来自类蟹状脉冲星巨脉冲或遥远磁星的高活动期，而这两种机制都应产生可观测的后续类FRB事件，因此需要通过对已知FRB视场进行监测来检验该假设。

Method: 摘要说明该工作为观测提案：监测两个已知FRB的视场以搜寻重复脉冲。所针对的两个源具有现有多波段存档视场图像，并具有由DM导出的小距离。标题提及Parkes与项目P871、学期2016OCTS。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、观测时间跨度、样本大小以及具体分析或统计方法。

Result: 摘要未说明。摘要仅指出迄今已观测到一个FRB重复出现，并提出两种可能机制；未报告本提案的观测结果、重复脉冲探测、脉冲轮廓、偏振、频谱、计时或自转减慢行为等具体发现或数值。

Conclusion: 作者提出通过监测两个已知FRB的视场来直接检验FRB来自类蟹状脉冲星巨脉冲或遥远磁星高活动期这一假设。摘要仅给出拟检验的假设和观测计划，未给出检验结果或由此得出的物理结论；因此关于FRB前身星性质、重复行为以及磁星与FRB联系的具体解释，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) are bright, millisecond-duration radio pulses hypothesized to originate at cosmological distances. To date, one FRB has been seen to repeat but their origins remain a puzzling mystery. Some have proposed FRBs come from Crab-like pulsar giant pulses or periods of high activity of distant magnetars. Both mechanisms would generate observable subsequent FRB-like events. In this proposal we directly test this hypothesis by monitoring the fields of two known FRBs to search for repeating pulses that may explain their progenitors. We target two sources with existing multi-wavelength archival images of the field and small DM-derived distances.

</details>


### [345] [Parkes observations for project P1039 semester 2020APRS_01]()
*Jankowski, Fabian,Stappers, Benjamin,Keane, Evan,Caleb, Manisha*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用Parkes UWL接收机对29个南半球已知旋转射电暂现源（RRATs）进行系统性观测，测量其绝对定标流量密度、偏振轮廓、频谱行为、探测率、脉冲间等待时间和自转参数，以判断RRAT是否构成区别于普通射电脉冲星的独立类别，并探讨其与重复快速射电暴脉冲的潜在关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RRATs是一类零星发射的中子星，其不规则的单脉冲发射使其难以探测，导致即使对群体基本参数的了解也仍然匮乏。该提案希望通过系统性地测量大量已知RRAT的光谱和自转参数，回答RRAT是否构成一个区别于普通射电脉冲星的独立类别这一问题，并为未来设施的巡天观测和RRAT产额提供依据。

Method: 摘要说明这是一个观测提案，拟对南半球已知RRAT群体中很大一部分（29个）进行系统性复核，约为定位良好的RRAT的90%。观测使用新近投入使用的Parkes UWL接收机和后端系统，其瞬时频率覆盖为3.3-GHz，具备优异灵敏度并可相干去除星际介质色散效应。将测量绝对定标流量密度、偏振轮廓、频谱行为、探测率、脉冲间等待时间和自转参数。具体观测时间跨度、数据样本细节和统计分析方法：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未报告已完成的结果或测量数值；其表述为拟议项目的预期产出。计划中的测量包括29个南半球RRAT的绝对定标流量密度、偏振轮廓、频谱行为、探测率、脉冲间等待时间和自转参数。摘要未给出任何具体测量值、显著性、相关性或趋势。根据摘要无法判断。

Conclusion: 作者指出，这些测量对于理解RRAT是否构成一个区别于普通射电脉冲星的独立类别至关重要，并将为未来设施的巡天观测和RRAT产额提供参考；此外，这些测量将阐明RRAT与重复快速射电暴脉冲之间是否存在任何潜在关系。上述结论为提案所陈述的目标和预期意义，摘要未报告已完成观测所支持的物理结论。根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Rotating Radio Transients (RRATs) are a group of sporadically emitting neutron stars. Their erratic single-pulse emission makes them hard to detect and consequently, our knowledge of even the basic parameters of the population is lacking. Here we propose an ambitious project to systematically review the spectral and rotational parameters of a large fraction (29) of the known RRAT population in the southern hemisphere, roughly 90 per cent of those that are well localised. Our project plays to the strengths of the newly commissioned Parkes UWL receiver and backend system, its wide 3.3-GHz instantaneous frequency coverage, excellent sensitivity and ability to coherently remove the effects of dispersion in the interstellar medium. The data will enable us to measure their absolute calibrated flux densities, polarimetric profiles, spectral behaviour, detection rates, inter-pulse waiting times and rotational parameters. Our measurements are crucial to understanding whether the RRATs form a distinct class from the ordinary radio pulsars and will inform observations and RRAT yields of surveys at upcoming facilities. Additionally, they will elucidate any potential relationship with pulses from repeating Fast Radio Bursts.

</details>

Motivation: RRATs是偶发发射的中子星，其不规则的单脉冲发射使其难以探测，导致对该群体甚至基本参数的了解仍然匮乏。研究需要系统性地审视南半球已知RRAT群体中很大一部分的频谱与自转参数，以判断RRAT是否构成区别于普通射电脉冲星的独立类别。

Method: 拟利用新投入使用的Parkes UWL接收机与后端系统，对南半球已知RRAT群体中29颗（约占定位良好者的90%）进行观测。该系统具有3.3-GHz瞬时频率覆盖、优异灵敏度以及相干消除星际介质色散效应的能力。数据将用于测量绝对定标流量密度、偏振轮廓、频谱行为、探测率、脉冲间等待时间和自转参数。摘要未说明观测时间跨度与具体分析算法。

Result: 摘要为项目提案，未报告已完成的观测结果或具体测量数值。摘要未说明所测流量密度、偏振轮廓、频谱行为、探测率、脉冲间等待时间或自转参数的具体结果，也未给出任何统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者提出，这些测量对于理解RRAT是否构成一个区别于普通射电脉冲星的独立类别至关重要，并将为未来设施的巡天观测及RRAT产额提供参考；此外，测量将阐明RRAT与重复快速射电暴脉冲之间任何潜在的关系。这些均系该项目预期可回答的问题，而非已由结果确立的结论。根据摘要无法判断该方法对脉冲星计时、自旋下降力矩变化或磁星—FRB关联等其他方向的具体可迁移性。

Abstract: Rotating Radio Transients (RRATs) are a group of sporadically emitting neutron stars. Their erratic single-pulse emission makes them hard to detect and consequently, our knowledge of even the basic parameters of the population is lacking. Here we propose an ambitious project to systematically review the spectral and rotational parameters of a large fraction (29) of the known RRAT population in the southern hemisphere, roughly 90 per cent of those that are well localised. Our project plays to the strengths of the newly commissioned Parkes UWL receiver and backend system, its wide 3.3-GHz instantaneous frequency coverage, excellent sensitivity and ability to coherently remove the effects of dispersion in the interstellar medium. The data will enable us to measure their absolute calibrated flux densities, polarimetric profiles, spectral behaviour, detection rates, inter-pulse waiting times and rotational parameters. Our measurements are crucial to understanding whether the RRATs form a distinct class from the ordinary radio pulsars and will inform observations and RRAT yields of surveys at upcoming facilities. Additionally, they will elucidate any potential relationship with pulses from repeating Fast Radio Bursts.

</details>

<details>

Conclusion: 作者明确提出，对RRATs频谱与自转参数的系统测量将有助于理解RRATs是否构成一个区别于普通射电脉冲星的独立类别，并将为即将建成的设施所开展的巡天观测及RRAT产额提供参考。作者还提出，这些测量将阐明RRATs与重复快速射电暴脉冲之间可能存在的任何关系。上述均为拟开展项目的目标与预期意义，摘要未给出任何已完成观测所支持的物理结论。关于该种群具体物理性质、与脉冲星或快速射电暴的因果关系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Rotating Radio Transients (RRATs) are a group of sporadically emitting neutron stars. Their erratic single-pulse emission makes them hard to detect and consequently, our knowledge of even the basic parameters of the population is lacking. Here we propose an ambitious project to systematically review the spectral and rotational parameters of a large fraction (29) of the known RRAT population in the southern hemisphere, roughly 90 per cent of those that are well localised. Our project plays to the strengths of the newly commissioned Parkes UWL receiver and backend system, its wide 3.3-GHz instantaneous frequency coverage, excellent sensitivity and ability to coherently remove the effects of dispersion in the interstellar medium. The data will enable us to measure their absolute calibrated flux densities, polarimetric profiles, spectral behaviour, detection rates, inter-pulse waiting times and rotational parameters. Our measurements are crucial to understanding whether the RRATs form a distinct class from the ordinary radio pulsars and will inform observations and RRAT yields of surveys at upcoming facilities. Additionally, they will elucidate any potential relationship with pulses from repeating Fast Radio Bursts.

### [353] [Cross-correlating galaxies and cosmic dispersion measures: Constraints on the gas-to-halo mass relation from 2MASS galaxies and 133 localized fast radio bursts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21336)
*Shirasaki, Masato,Takahashi, Ryuichi,Osato, Ken,Ioka, Kunihito*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 利用 2MASS 星系与 133 个已定位 FRB 的宇宙色散量做互相关，在 $0.01 \lt R\,[h^{-1}\,\mathrm{Mpc}] \lt 1$ 范围内与零探测一致；该零信号在 $R \sim 0.01\,h^{-1}\,\mathrm{Mpc}$ 处与 TNG300 预测不符，暗示 $10^{12-13}\,M_\odot$ 晕中的热气体质量分数低于全球重子分数的 ${\sim}10\%$。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文关注星系形成中反馈过程如何影响晕内热气体含量这一问题。摘要指出，现有从 X 射线发射和 Sunyaev--Zel'dovich 测量推断的约束依赖电子温度测量，而星系--FRB 互相关可提供不依赖电子温度的直接估计，因此作者希望用 2MASS 星系与已定位 FRB 的宇宙色散量互相关来检验晕内热气体质量分数。

Method: 摘要说明：对 2MASS 星系 catalog 所描绘的大尺度结构与 133 个已定位 FRB 的宇宙色散量开展互相关分析；互相关信号作为 2MASS 星系与背景 FRB 视线之间共动间距 R 的函数测量，并利用两个数据集的红移信息。分析采用基于晕的模型，自由电子密度剖面取自流体动力学模拟 IllustrisTNG-300（TNG300），并在此基础上做了简单的唯象修改。摘要未说明观测频段、时间跨度、具体统计量与显著性检验方法。

Result: 测量结果在 $0.01 \lt R\,[h^{-1}\,\mathrm{Mpc}] \lt 1$ 范围内与零探测一致。在 $R \sim 0.01\,h^{-1}\,\mathrm{Mpc}$ 处，零信号与 TNG300 的预测不一致。作者据此指出，在承载 2MASS 星系、质量为 $10^{12-13}\,M_\odot$ 的晕中，热气体质量分数必须低于 TNG300 预测值；对 TNG300 模型的简单唯象修改表明该质量范围内热气体质量分数应低于近邻宇宙全球重子分数的 ${\sim}10\%$。摘要称该约束与星系中 X 射线发射和 Sunyaev--Zel'dovich 测量推断的结果一致。

Conclusion: 作者认为，$10^{12-13}\,M_\odot$ 晕中热气体质量分数偏低意味着该质量范围内需要更强的反馈；星系--FRB 互相关可提供不依赖电子温度测量的热气体质量分数直接估计，并与 X 射线发射和 Sunyaev--Zel'dovich 测量的推断一致。作者据此总结，星系--FRB 互相关是探测星系形成中反馈过程的强有力手段。是否可推广至脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲发射或 FRB 与磁星的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We conduct a cross-correlation analysis between large-scale structures traced by the Two Micron All Sky Survey (2MASS) galaxy catalog and the cosmic dispersion measures of 133 localized fast radio bursts (FRBs). The cross-correlation signal is measured as a function of the comoving separation R between 2MASS galaxies and background FRB sightlines, making full use of the available redshift information for both datasets. Our measurements are consistent with a null detection over the range <inline-formula><tex-math>$0.01 \lt R\, [h^{-1}\, \mathrm{Mpc}] \lt 1$</tex-math></inline-formula>. Using a halo-based model in which free-electron density profiles are drawn from the hydrodynamical simulation IllustrisTNG-300 (TNG300), we show that the null signal at <inline-formula><tex-math>$R \sim 0.01\, h^{-1}\, \mathrm{Mpc}$</tex-math></inline-formula> is inconsistent with the TNG300 prediction. This discrepancy indicates that the hot-gas mass fraction in halos with masses of <inline-formula><tex-math>$10^{12-13}\, M_\odot$</tex-math></inline-formula> hosting 2MASS galaxies must be lower than that predicted by TNG300. A simple phenomenological modification of the TNG300 model suggests that the hot-gas mass fraction in halos of <inline-formula><tex-math>$10^{12-13}\, M_\odot$</tex-math></inline-formula> should be below <inline-formula><tex-math>${\sim }10\%$</tex-math></inline-formula> of the global baryon fraction in the nearby universe, implying the need for stronger feedback in this mass range. Our constraints are consistent with those inferred from X-ray emission and Sunyaev--Zel'dovich measurements in galaxies, while providing a direct estimate of the hot-gas mass fraction that does not rely on electron-temperature measurements. These results demonstrate that galaxy--FRB cross correlations offer a powerful probe of feedback processes in galaxy formation.

</details>


### [354] [Parkes observations for project P1156 semester 2022APRS_04]()
*Dai, Shi,Filipovic, Miroslav,Keane, Evan,Bhandari, Shivani,Qiu, Hao,Balzan, Joel*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案受球状星团中重复快速射电暴 FRB 20200120E 的发现启发，提出以邻近椭圆星系 Centaurus A 为目标搜寻 FRB，以限制球状星团中 FRB 的事件率和光度，并理解其对宇宙学 FRB 率的贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重复 FRB 20200120E 被定位于邻近 M81 星系的一个球状星团，其处于老年恒星系统且距离地球很近，这挑战了对 FRB 的当前理解，并对 FRB 的起源及这类源的数量密度和光度具有深刻意义。因此需要针对其他邻近球状星团富集星系搜寻 FRB。

Method: 摘要未说明。摘要仅提出以邻近椭圆星系 Centaurus A 为目标开展定向巡天搜寻 FRB，未说明所用望远镜、观测频段、时间跨度、样本或具体分析方法。

Result: 摘要未说明。摘要未报告任何新观测结果或探测事件，仅指出重复 FRB 20200120E 定位于邻近（约 3.6 Mpc）M81 星系的球状星团中，其距离比任何其他已探测到的河外 FRB 近 40 倍，并指出 Centaurus A 相对邻近（约 3.5 Mpc）且富含球状星团（&gt;1200）。

Conclusion: 作者提出，针对 Centaurus A 的定向巡天将能够限制来自球状星团的 FRB 的事件率和光度，从而理解其对宇宙学 FRB 率的贡献，并为球状星团中中子星的形成提供新启示。根据摘要无法判断该方法对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、偏振或射电频谱等其他具体主题的可迁移性。

Abstract: The discovery of a repeating fast radio burst (FRB) 20200120E localized to a globular cluster (GC) of the nearby (~3.6 Mpc) M81 galaxy challenged our current understanding of FRBs. Its location in an old stellar system and proximity to the Earth (40 times closer than any other extragalactic FRB detected) have profound implications on the origin of FRBs and the number density and luminosity of this type of source. Motivated by this discovery, we propose to search for FRBs targeting at another nearby elliptical galaxy, Centaurus A. Its relative proximity (~3.5 Mpc), combined with its richness in GCs (&gt;1200), makes Centaurus A the best target in the sky for detecting new FRB sources in GCs. Such a targeted survey will allow us to constrain the event rate and luminosity of FRBs from GCs and hence understand their contribution to the cosmological FRB rate and shed new light on the formation of neutron stars in GCs.

</details>

Method: 提出一项定向搜索 FRB 的巡天，目标为另一个邻近椭圆星系 Centaurus A；摘要强调其相对距离约 3.5 Mpc 且富含球状星团（&gt;1200），称其为天空中探测球状星团中新 FRB 源的最佳目标。摘要未说明所用的望远镜或仪器、观测频段、时间跨度、样本量或具体数据分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告了重复 FRB 20200120E 被定位到邻近（约 3.6 Mpc）M81 星系的一个球状星团，并指出它比其他任何已探测到的河外 FRB 近 40 倍。摘要未说明该源的事件率、光度、偏振、谱、单脉冲或计时测量等具体结果。所提出的 Centaurus A 搜索尚属提议，未报告任何探测或观测结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，针对 Centaurus A 的定向巡天将能限制来自球状星团的 FRB 的事件率和光度，从而理解它们对宇宙学 FRB 率的贡献，并为球状星团中中子星的形成提供新的启示。这些解释由摘要表述为预期成果；根据摘要无法判断该巡天是否可以实际实现这些限制。

Abstract: The discovery of a repeating fast radio burst (FRB) 20200120E localized to a globular cluster (GC) of the nearby (~3.6 Mpc) M81 galaxy challenged our current understanding of FRBs. Its location in an old stellar system and proximity to the Earth (40 times closer than any other extragalactic FRB detected) have profound implications on the origin of FRBs and the number density and luminosity of this type of source. Motivated by this discovery, we propose to search for FRBs targeting at another nearby elliptical galaxy, Centaurus A. Its relative proximity (~3.5 Mpc), combined with its richness in GCs (&gt;1200), makes Centaurus A the best target in the sky for detecting new FRB sources in GCs. Such a targeted survey will allow us to constrain the event rate and luminosity of FRBs from GCs and hence understand their contribution to the cosmological FRB rate and shed new light on the formation of neutron stars in GCs.

</details>

### [358] [Parkes observations for project P1156 semester 2022APRS_09]()
*Dai, Shi,Filipovic, Miroslav,Keane, Evan,Bhandari, Shivani,Qiu, Hao,Balzan, Joel*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 受球状星团中重复快速射电暴 20200120E 的发现启发，作者提出对邻近椭圆星系 Centaurus A（约 3.5 Mpc，>1200 个球状星团）开展定向 FRB 搜寻，以限制球状星团中 FRB 的事件率与光度及其对宇宙学 FRB 率的贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重复 FRB 20200120E 被发现定位于邻近（约 3.6 Mpc）M81 星系的一个球状星团中，其位于年老恒星系统且比任何其他已探测河外 FRB 近 40 倍，这一发现挑战了当前对 FRB 的理解，并对 FRB 的起源及该类源的数密度和光度具有深远意义。摘要由此提出在另一个邻近椭圆星系中搜寻 FRB，以限制球状星团 FRB 的事件率和光度。

Method: 摘要说明这是一项提出中的定向 FRB 搜寻，目标为邻近椭圆星系 Centaurus A，理由是其相对较近（约 3.5 Mpc）且富含球状星团（>1200 个）。标题提及 Parkes 观测与项目 P1156 semester 2022APRS_09。摘要未说明具体望远镜、接收机、观测频段或频率、观测时间跨度、样本、搜寻算法或统计分析方法。

Conclusion: 作者认为，对 Centaurus A 的定向巡天将可限制球状星团中 FRB 的事件率和光度，从而理解其对宇宙学 FRB 率的贡献，并为球状星团中中子星的形成提供新线索。摘要未报告任何观测结果，因此关于该巡天实际能否实现这些约束，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The discovery of a repeating fast radio burst (FRB) 20200120E localized to a globular cluster (GC) of the nearby (~3.6 Mpc) M81 galaxy challenged our current understanding of FRBs. Its location in an old stellar system and proximity to the Earth (40 times closer than any other extragalactic FRB detected) have profound implications on the origin of FRBs and the number density and luminosity of this type of source. </details>

TL;DR: 受球状星团中重复FRB 20200120E发现的启发，本文提出对邻近椭圆星系半人马座A开展定向FRB搜索；该星系距离约3.5 Mpc且拥有超过1200个球状星团，被认为是在球状星团中探测新FRB源的最佳天空目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重复FRB 20200120E被定位到邻近M81星系（约3.6 Mpc）的球状星团中，其位于老年恒星系统且距离地球比任何其他已探测河外FRB近40倍，挑战了当前对FRB的理解，并对FRB起源及源数密度和光度有深刻意义。

Method: 提出搜索FRB，并将目标定位于另一个邻近椭圆星系半人马座A；摘要仅说明其相对距离约3.5 Mpc且拥有超过1200个球状星团，认为其是探测球状星团中新FRB源的最佳天空目标。具体望远镜、频段、时间跨度、样本和数据分析方法摘要未说明；标题提到Parkes观测，但摘要正文未描述该观测。

Result: 摘要未报告任何观测结果或数据分析结果；其陈述的是拟议的定向巡天，目标为半人马座A，并期望该巡天能够限制来自球状星团的FRB事件率和光度，进而理解其对宇宙学FRB率的贡献，并为球状星团中中子星的形成提供新启示。摘要未给出探测、事件率、光度或统计显著性的具体数值。

Conclusion: 作者提出，针对半人马座A的定向巡天可限制来自球状星团的FRB事件率和光度，从而理解其对宇宙学FRB率的贡献，并为球状星团中中子星的形成提供新的启示；该结论是基于其邻近距离和丰富球状星团的拟议目标选择。根据摘要无法判断实际探测能力、可达到的约束强度或对中子星形成机制的具体物理结论。

Abstract: The discovery of a repeating fast radio burst (FRB) 20200120E localized to a globular cluster (GC) of the nearby (~3.6 Mpc) M81 galaxy challenged our current understanding of FRBs. Its location in an old stellar system and proximity to the Earth (40 times closer than any other extragalactic FRB detected) have profound implications on the origin of FRBs and the number density and luminosity of this type of source. Motivated by this discovery, we propose to search for FRBs targeting at another nearby elliptical galaxy, Centaurus A. Its relative proximity (~3.5 Mpc), combined with its richness in GCs (&gt;1200), makes Centaurus A the best target in the sky for detecting new FRB sources in GCs. Such a targeted survey will allow us to constrain the event rate and luminosity of FRBs from GCs and hence understand their contribution to the cosmological FRB rate and shed new light on the formation of neutron stars in GCs.

</details>


### [366] [Parkes observations for project P1105 semester 2021APRS_20]()
*Zhang, Songbo,Manchester, Dick,Staveley-Smith, Lister,Hobbs, George,Dai, Shi,Russell, Christopher,Wu, Xuefeng,Luo, Rui,Li, Ye,Wei, Junjie,Yang, Xuan,Tang, Zhenfan,Chang, Chenming,Geng, Jinjun*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 通过重新处理 Parkes 多波束接收机最初四年的档案观测数据并采用新的人工智能算法，作者报告了 87 个新的 S/N 高于 7 的 FRB 候选体，其仅在单个波束中被探测到，且 DM 超出估计的银河系 DM，暗示其位于河外距离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面对 Parkes 脉冲星数据档案中最初四年多波束接收机观测形成的大量候选体，需要有效的筛选与分析方法；此前已有探测，但仍需进一步挖掘档案数据中的 FRB 候选体，并检验其是否为地球干扰，同时利用 UWL 接收机寻找其中部分候选体的重复信号。

Method: 摘要说明：重新处理 Parkes 脉冲星数据档案中 Parkes 多波束接收机最初四年的全部观测数据；开发了一种新的人工智能（AI）算法用于研究海量候选体；所有信号均在 20 cm 波段探测到；并提及使用 Ultra Wideband Low（UWL）接收机以探测部分 FRB 候选体的重复信号。摘要未说明具体观测频率范围、时间跨度细节、样本量、AI 算法类型及统计分析方法。

Result: 除此前探测外，最新结果包括 87 个新的 FRB 候选体，S/N 高于 7；这些信号仅在接收机的单个波束中被探测到，表明它们不太可能来自地球上的干扰；其 DM 超出估计的银河系 DM，从而将其置于河外距离。摘要未说明这些候选体的重复探测结果、其他波段观测结果、具体 DM 数值或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者根据单波束探测与 DM 超出银河系估计值，判断这些新候选体不太可能为地球干扰，并可能位于河外距离；同时指出 UWL 接收机提供了从部分候选体探测重复信号以及在其他观测波段观测更强辐射的机会。根据摘要无法判断这些候选体与脉冲星、磁星或 FRB 物理起源之间的具体联系。

Abstract: We have re-processed all the observations in the Parkes pulsar data archive obtained during the first four years of the Parkes multibeam receiver and have developed a new artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm to investigate huge volume of candidates. Except for our previous detections, the latest results include 87 new fast radio burst (FRB) candidates with S/N above 7. These signals were only detected in a single beam of the receiver suggesting that they are unlikely to be terrestrial. Their dispersion measure (DM) excesses over the estimated Galactic DM place them at extragalactic distances. Using the Ultra Wideband Low (UWL) receiver we have opportunity to detect repeating signals from some of these FRB candidates. As all these signals were detected in the 20 cm band, the UWL provides the opportunity to observe stronger emission in other observing bands.

</details>

*Zhang, Songbo,Manchester, Dick,Staveley-Smith, Lister,Hobbs, George,Dai, Shi,Russell, Christopher,Wu, Xuefeng,Luo, Rui,Li, Ye,Wei, Junjie,Yang, Xuan,Tang, Zhenfan,Chang, Chenming,Geng, Jinjun*

Main category: scix

Method: 重新处理 Parkes 脉冲星数据档案中在 Parkes 多波束接收机最初四年期间获得的所有观测；开发一种新的人工智能（AI）算法以研究数量巨大的候选信号；候选信号选择标准为 S/N 高于 7；利用 Ultra Wideband Low（UWL）接收机探测其中一些 FRB 候选信号的重复信号。所用观测频率或波段：所有信号均在 20 cm 波段探测到，UWL 提供了在其他观测波段观测的机会。时间跨度、样本大小（除 87 个新候选信号外）等细节摘要未说明。

Result: 除此前的探测之外，最新结果包括 87 个 S/N 高于 7 的新 FRB 候选信号。这些信号仅在该接收机的单个波束中被探测到，表明它们不太可能来自地面。它们相对于估计的银河系 DM 的 DM 超出部分将它们置于河外距离。所有这些信号都是在 20 cm 波段探测到的。

Conclusion: 作者认为，单波束探测这一特征表明这些信号不太可能来自地面；其 DM 相对于估计的银河系 DM 的超出部分将它们置于河外距离。作者还指出，由于所有信号均在 20 cm 波段探测到，UWL 接收机提供了在其他观测波段观测到更强辐射的机会，并有机会从其中一些 FRB 候选信号中探测到重复信号。关于这些 FRB 候选信号与脉冲星、磁星或 FRB 起源物理的具体联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We have re-processed all the observations in the Parkes pulsar data archive obtained during the first four years of the Parkes multibeam receiver and have developed a new artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm to investigate huge volume of candidates. Except for our previous detections, the latest results include 87 new fast radio burst (FRB) candidates with S/N above 7. These signals were only detected in a single beam of the receiver suggesting that they are unlikely to be terrestrial. Their dispersion measure (DM) excesses over the estimated Galactic DM place them at extragalactic distances. Using the Ultra Wideband Low (UWL) receiver we have opportunity to detect repeating signals from some of these FRB candidates. As all these signals were detected in the 20 cm band, the UWL provides the opportunity to observe stronger emission in other observing bands.

</details>

### [379] [Parkes observations for project P1105 semester 2021APRS_23]()
*Zhang, Songbo,Manchester, Dick,Staveley-Smith, Lister,Hobbs, George,Dai, Shi,Russell, Christopher,Wu, Xuefeng,Luo, Rui,Li, Ye,Wei, Junjie,Yang, Xuan,Tang, Zhenfan,Chang, Chenming,Geng, Jinjun*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 重新处理 Parkes 脉冲星数据档案中 Parkes 多波束接收机最初四年的全部观测，并开发了一种新的人工智能（AI）算法来研究数量巨大的候选体；信号在 20 cm 波段被探测，并计划利用 Ultra Wideband Low（UWL）接收机对其他观测波段进行观测。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度以外的细节、样本筛选流程及统计分析方法。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些单波束探测且 DM 超出银河系估计的信号不太可能来自地球干扰，并可依据 DM 超出量置于河外距离；借助 UWL 接收机，有望从部分候选体中探测到重复信号，并因现有探测集中在 20 cm 波段而有机会在其他观测波段观测到更强辐射。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、脉冲星单脉冲或脉冲轮廓演化的具体物理联系。

These signals were only detected in a single beam of the receiver suggesting that they are unlikely to be terrestrial. Their dispersion measure (DM) excesses over the estimated Galactic DM place them at extragalactic distances. Using the Ultra Wideband Low (UWL) receiver we have opportunity to detect repeating signals from some of these FRB candidates. Main category: scix

TL;DR: SUPERBx 在高银纬区域利用优化的 GPU 代码和超级计算实时搜寻脉冲星与 FRB，所发现的脉冲星通常为近邻闪烁源、间歇源或有趣双星系统源，FRB 发现延迟约 1 秒并触发快速警报以支持定位、宿主星系识别及宇宙学应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要指出 SUPERBx 旨在搜寻最高银纬区域的脉冲星和快速射电暴（FRB），并强调随着数据不断到来而对其进行处理对 SKA Phase I 时代以及下一代望远镜的高数据率具有重要性；同时，FRB 定位与宿主星系识别被表述为解开其前身星之谜并利用其开展精密宇宙学测量的关键。

Method: 摘要说明使用优化的 GPU 代码和超级计算，对最高银纬区域的数据进行脉冲星和 FRB 搜寻，并在数据到来时实时处理；对 FRB 的发现通过专门的 VOEvent 格式和 Astronomer's Telegrams 向全球后续观测群体发送快速警报。其它观测、数据、仪器、频率或能段、时间跨度、样本以及分析方法的细节，摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告，所发现的脉冲星通常是近邻的闪烁源、间歇源以及处于有趣双星系统中的源；所发现的 FRB 的发现延迟约为 1 秒，而非数月/数年，并会通过专门的 VOEvent 格式和 Astronomer's Telegrams 向全球后续观测群体发送快速警报。摘要未说明具体源名、数量、显著性、观测频率、时间跨度或统计分析结果。

Conclusion: 作者表示，实时处理不断到来的数据对 SKA Phase I 时代至关重要，因此这项工作直接适用于下一代望远镜的高数据率；快速警报的目的是使所发现的 FRB 能够被定位，而定位是识别 FRB 宿主星系的关键，从而解开其前身星之谜，并利用它们作为精密宇宙学测量工具的诸多用途。就观测射电天文中脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱或暂现射电与 FRB 之间联系等具体解释或可迁移性而言，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: SUPERBx looks at the highest Galactic latitudes in a search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs). We use optimised GPU codes and supercomputing to search for these, making discoveries in real time. Handling our data as it comes in is essential for the SKA Phase I era so this work applies directly to the high-data rates of next generation telescopes. Our pulsar discoveries are typically nearby scintillating sources, intermittent sources and those in interesting binary systems. Our FRB discoveries have discovery lags of ~1 second, rather than months/years and these feed rapid alerts to the world-wide follow-up community via a dedicated VOEvent format an Astronomer's Telegrams. The goal of this is to allow localisation of the discovered FRBs. This is key for identifying FRB host galaxies, so as to solve the mystery of their progenitors and to exploit their many uses as tools for precision cosmology measurements.

</details>

Our pulsar discoveries are typically nearby scintillating sources, intermittent sources and those in interesting binary systems. *Keane, Evan,Possenti, Andrea,Green, James,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,Eatough, Ralph,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Jameson, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Tiburzi, Caterina,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Jankowski, Fabian,Caleb, Manisha,Morello, Vincent,Bhandari, Shivani,Venkatraman Krishnan, Vivek,Primak, Natalia,Spiewak, Renee,Farah, Wael*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: SUPERBx 在高银纬区域搜寻脉冲星和 FRB，利用优化的 GPU 代码在超级计算机上实时搜寻；其脉冲星发现多为邻近闪烁源、间歇源及有趣双星系统源，FRB 发现延迟约 1 秒，并通过 VOEvent 和 Astronomer's Telegrams 发出快速警报以促成定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该工作针对最高银纬区域开展脉冲星和 FRB 搜寻，并强调在数据到达时即进行处理对 SKA Phase I 时代和下一代望远镜的高数据率具有直接适用性。识别 FRB 宿主星系被视为解决其 progenitors 之谜并利用 FRB 进行精密宇宙学测量的关键，因此需要使所发现的 FRB 能够被定位。

Method: 使用优化的 GPU 代码和超级计算搜寻脉冲星和 FRB，并在数据到达时实时处理数据。发现 FRB 后，通过专用 VOEvent 格式和 Astronomer's Telegrams 向全球后续观测群体发送快速警报，以促成所发现 FRB 的定位。摘要未说明具体望远镜、观测频率或频段、时间跨度、样本量及统计分析细节。

Result: 我们发现的脉冲星通常是邻近的闪烁源、间歇源以及处于有趣双星系统中的源。我们发现的 FRB 的发现延迟约为 1 秒，而不是数月/数年；这些发现通过专用 VOEvent 格式和 Astronomer's Telegrams 向全球后续观测群体发送快速警报。

Conclusion: 作者指出，在数据到达时即进行处理对 SKA Phase I 时代至关重要，因此这项工作直接适用于下一代望远镜的高数据率；快速警报旨在使所发现的 FRB 能够被定位，而定位对于识别 FRB 宿主星系、解开其 progenitors 之谜并利用其作为精密宇宙学测量工具至关重要。根据摘要无法判断本工作所报告的实时搜寻流程与脉冲星、磁星或 FRB 的物理机制之间有何进一步联系。

Abstract: SUPERBx looks at the highest Galactic latitudes in a search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs). We use optimised GPU codes and supercomputing to search for these, making discoveries in real time. Handling our data as it comes in is essential for the SKA Phase I era so this work applies directly to the high-data rates of next generation telescopes. Our pulsar discoveries are typically nearby scintillating sources, intermittent sources and those in interesting binary systems. Our FRB discoveries have discovery lags of ~1 second, rather than months/years and these feed rapid alerts to the world-wide follow-up community via a dedicated VOEvent format an Astronomer's Telegrams. The goal of this is to allow localisation of the discovered FRBs. This is key for identifying FRB host galaxies, so as to solve the mystery of their progenitors and to exploit their many uses as tools for precision cosmology measurements.

</details>

Method: 摘要仅说明 SUPERBx 在最高银纬区域搜寻脉冲星和 FRB，使用优化的 GPU 代码和超级计算进行搜寻，并实时作出发现；数据在到达时被处理；FRB 发现后通过专门的 VOEvent 格式和 Astronomer's Telegrams 向全球后续观测群体发送快速警报。具体望远镜、观测频段、时间跨度、样本量及统计分析细节摘要未说明。

Abstract: SUPERBx looks at the highest Galactic latitudes in a search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs). We use optimised GPU codes and supercomputing to search for these, making discoveries in real time. Handling our data as it comes in is essential for the SKA Phase I era so this work applies directly to the high-data rates of next generation telescopes. Our pulsar discoveries are typically nearby scintillating sources, intermittent sources and those in interesting binary systems. Our FRB discoveries have discovery lags of ~1 second, rather than months/years and these feed rapid alerts to the world-wide follow-up community via a dedicated VOEvent format an Astronomer's Telegrams. The goal of this is to allow localisation of the discovered FRBs. This is key for identifying FRB host galaxies, so as to solve the mystery of their progenitors and to exploit their many uses as tools for precision cosmology measurements.

Result: 发现的脉冲星通常是邻近的闪烁源、间歇源以及处于有趣双星系统中的脉冲星。发现的 FRB 的发现延迟约为 ~1 秒，而非数月/数年；这些发现通过专门的 VOEvent 格式和 Astronomer's Telegrams 向全球后续观测群体发送快速警报。摘要未给出具体源名、数目或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者提出的目标是通过快速警报使所发现的 FRB 能够被定位；这对于识别 FRB 宿主星系至关重要，从而解开其 progenitor 之谜，并利用其作为精密宇宙学测量工具。摘要未给出具体定位结果或宿主星系识别结果。

Abstract: SUPERBx looks at the highest Galactic latitudes in a search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs). We use optimised GPU codes and supercomputing to search for these, making discoveries in real time. Handling our data as it comes in is essential for the SKA Phase I era so this work applies directly to the high-data rates of next generation telescopes. Our pulsar discoveries are typically nearby scintillating sources, intermittent sources and those in interesting binary systems. Our FRB discoveries have discovery lags of ~1 second, rather than months/years and these feed rapid alerts to the world-wide follow-up community via a dedicated VOEvent format an Astronomer's Telegrams. The goal of this is to allow localisation of the discovered FRBs. This is key for identifying FRB host galaxies, so as to solve the mystery of their progenitors and to exploit their many uses as tools for precision cosmology measurements.

</details>

Abstract: SUPERBx looks at the highest Galactic latitudes in a search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs). We use optimised GPU codes and supercomputing to search for these, making discoveries in real time. Handling our data as it comes in is essential for the SKA Phase I era so this work applies directly to the high-data rates of next generation telescopes. Our pulsar discoveries are typically nearby scintillating sources, intermittent sources and those in interesting binary systems. Our FRB discoveries have discovery lags of ~1 second, rather than months/years and these feed rapid alerts to the world-wide follow-up community via a dedicated VOEvent format an Astronomer's Telegrams. Result: 摘要报告，所发现的脉冲星通常是邻近的闪烁源、间歇源以及处于有趣双星系统中的源。所发现的 FRB 的发现延迟约为 1 秒，而非数月/数年，并向全球范围的后续观测群体提供快速警报。摘要未给出脉冲星或 FRB 的具体数量、源标识、显著性数值、频率、DM、RM 或定位结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出，即时处理数据的工作直接适用于下一代望远镜的高数据率；快速警报旨在使所发现的 FRB 能够被定位。定位被描述为识别 FRB 宿主星系的关键，以解开其 progenitor 之谜，并利用其作为精密宇宙学测量的工具。根据摘要无法判断与脉冲星单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、极化、射电频谱或磁星—FRB 联系的更具体物理联系。

Abstract: SUPERBx looks at the highest Galactic latitudes in a search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs). We use optimised GPU codes and supercomputing to search for these, making discoveries in real time. Handling our data as it comes in is essential for the SKA Phase I era so this work applies directly to the high-data rates of next generation telescopes. Our pulsar discoveries are typically nearby scintillating sources, intermittent sources and those in interesting binary systems. Our FRB discoveries have discovery lags of ~1 second, rather than months/years and these feed rapid alerts to the world-wide follow-up community via a dedicated VOEvent format an Astronomer's Telegrams. The goal of this is to allow localisation of the discovered FRBs. This is key for identifying FRB host galaxies, so as to solve the mystery of their progenitors and to exploit their many uses as tools for precision cosmology measurements.

</details>

Method: SUPERBx 在最高银纬区域搜寻脉冲星和 FRB；使用优化的 GPU 代码和超级计算进行搜寻，并实时作出发现，对到来的数据即时处理。摘要未说明具体望远镜、观测频段、时间跨度、样本量或统计分析方法。

Result: 所发现的脉冲星通常是邻近的闪烁源、间歇源以及处于有趣双星系统中的源。所发现的 FRB 的发现延迟约为 1 秒，而非数月/数年；这些发现通过专门的 VOEvent 格式和 Astronomer's Telegrams 向全球后续观测群体发出快速警报。摘要未说明具体的源名、数量或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者指出，实时发出 FRB 警报的目的是使所发现的 FRB 能够被定位；定位对于识别 FRB 宿主星系至关重要，从而解开其 progenitor 之谜，并利用它们作为精密宇宙学测量工具的诸多用途。根据摘要无法判断其对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振或射电频谱的具体物理含义。

Abstract: SUPERBx looks at the highest Galactic latitudes in a search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs). We use optimised GPU codes and supercomputing to search for these, making discoveries in real time. Handling our data as it comes in is essential for the SKA Phase I era so this work applies directly to the high-data rates of next generation telescopes. Our pulsar discoveries are typically nearby scintillating sources, intermittent sources and those in interesting binary systems. Our FRB discoveries have discovery lags of ~1 second, rather than months/years and these feed rapid alerts to the world-wide follow-up community via a dedicated VOEvent format an Astronomer's Telegrams. The goal of this is to allow localisation of the discovered FRBs. This is key for identifying FRB host galaxies, so as to solve the mystery of their progenitors and to exploit their many uses as tools for precision cosmology measurements.

### [462] [Method for testing diffusive shock acceleration and diffusion propagation of 1-100 TeV cosmic electrons with multiwavelength observations of the Geminga halo and pulsar wind nebula](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.10276)
*Gao, Weikang,Bao, Li-Zhuo,Fang, Kun,Chen, En-sheng,Liu, Siming,Hu, HongBo*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该工作发展了一种利用HAWC和Fermi-LAT对Geminga区域的能谱与形态数据在1至数百TeV检验扩散激波加速与扩散传播模型的方法；结果表明这些理论与观测一致，但已发表的形态数据因能量分箱较宽而尚无法高精度检验推断出的能量相关扩散系数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散激波加速（DSA）和扩散传播是标准宇宙线模型的重要组成部分，其直接证据主要来自MeV能区的高能太阳过程观测；尽管该模型被广泛用于解释高能宇宙现象，但直接验证一直难以实现。Geminga脉冲星风云及其脉冲星晕的多波段能谱与角剖面测量，特别是HAWC和LHAASO-KM2A的精确能谱观测，为在1 TeV至数百TeV检验这些理论提供了机会。

Method: 摘要说明，本工作发展了一种在1至数百TeV能量范围内检验扩散激波加速和扩散传播模型的方法，使用HAWC和Fermi-LAT对Geminga区域的最新能谱和形态数据。摘要未说明具体的观测时间跨度、样本规模、数据处理流程或统计分析方法。

Result: 结果表明，扩散激波加速和扩散传播理论与实验观测一致。然而，已发表的形态数据采用了相当宽的能量分箱，目前无法通过观测能谱与DSA理论对推断出的能量相关扩散系数进行高精度检验。摘要预期未来HAWC和LHAASO-KM2A观测将给出更高精度结果，并指出确认100 TeV以上快速增加的扩散系数将成为支持该理论的重要证据。

Conclusion: 作者认为，扩散激波加速和扩散传播理论与当前Geminga区域的观测一致；确认100 TeV以上快速增加的扩散系数将支持这一加速和传播理论。作者强调，这种确认专门检验该加速和传播理论，而不确认或排除其他模型，并认为对其他模型开展类似检验也既重要又有价值。根据摘要无法判断本文方法与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、快速射电暴（FRB）或磁星—FRB联系之间的直接物理关联。

Abstract: Diffusive shock acceleration (DSA) and diffusion propagation are essential components of the standard cosmic ray model. These theories are based on extensive observations of high-energy solar processes, providing substantial direct evidence in the MeV energy range. Although the model is widely and successfully used to explain high-energy cosmic phenomena, direct validation has been elusive. The multiwavelength spectra and angular profile measurements of the Geminga pulsar wind nebula and its pulsar halo, particularly the precise spectral observations by HAWC and LHAASO-KM2A in recent years, offer a rare opportunity to test these theories with cosmic rays energies between 1 TeV and several hundred TeV. These observations are expected to elevate the direct testing of theoretical models from multi-MeV to sub-PeV energies. In this work, a method is developed to test the diffusive shock acceleration and diffusion propagation model between one and several hundred TeV energies through the latest spectral and morphological data of the Geminga region from HAWC and Fermi-LAT. Our results show that the theories of diffusive shock acceleration and diffusion propagation are consistent with experimental observations. However, the published morphological data adopted rather wide energy bins and currently do not allow a high precision test of the inferred energy dependent diffusion coefficient by observed energy spectra with DSA theory. It is anticipated that future HAWC and LHAASO-KM2A observations will yield higher-precision results, and the confirmation of a rapidly increasing diffusion coefficient above 100 TeV would serve as important evidence supporting the diffusive shock acceleration and diffusion propagation theory. We emphasize that such a confirmation specifically tests this acceleration and propagation theory, without confirming or excluding other models. Similar tests would be both important and valuable for other models.

</details>


### [463] [Searching for axion dark matter near relaxing magnetars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.20450)
*Roy, Sandip,Prabhu, Anirudh,Thompson, Christopher,Witte, Samuel J.,Blanco, Carlos,Zhang, Jonathan*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该工作构建与磁星观测一致的磁层电荷和电流分布，重新计算射电与亚毫米波望远镜对轴子暗物质的灵敏度，并表明两个主流模型对轴子诱导谱线的频率和幅度给出截然不同的预言。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 磁星磁层中的轴子暗物质可与低能光子共振混合并产生可探测的窄谱线，但以往研究多假设完美偶极磁场和最小电荷分离无力构型；磁星强磁场被认为会显著偏离该最小构型，因此需要评估真实磁星磁层对轴子暗物质电磁辐射预言的影响。

Method: 构建与磁星观测相一致的电荷分布和电流分布，并据此重新计算射电和亚毫米波望远镜对轴子暗物质的预期灵敏度；比较两个主流模型对谱线频率和幅度的预言。具体望远镜、频段、观测时间跨度和样本量：摘要未说明。

Result: 两个主流模型对轴子暗物质诱导谱线的频率和幅度给出截然不同的预言，表明等离子体结构中的系统不确定性是显著的。摘要未给出具体数值、频段或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者指出，磁星磁层的真实电荷与电流分布会显著影响轴子暗物质电磁辐射的预言，等离子体结构的系统不确定性不可忽略；他们还讨论了可用于区分单个磁星局部等离子体加载机制的观测特征，认为这是利用此类天体搜寻轴子的必要前提。根据摘要无法判断该研究对脉冲星、快速射电暴（FRB）等具体领域的可迁移性。

Abstract: Axion dark matter passing through the magnetospheres of magnetars can undergo hyperefficient resonant mixing with low-energy photons, leading to the production of narrow spectral lines that could be detectable on Earth. Since this is a resonant process triggered by the spatial variation in the photon dispersion relation, the luminosity and spectral properties of the emission are highly sensitive to the charge and current densities permeating the magnetosphere. To date, a majority of the studies investigating this phenomenon have assumed a perfectly dipolar magnetic field structure with a near-field plasma distribution fixed to the minimal charge-separated force-free configuration. While this may be a reasonable treatment for the closed field lines of conventional radio pulsars, the strong magnetic fields around magnetars are believed to host processes that drive strong deviations from this minimal configuration. In this work, we study how realistic magnetar magnetospheres impact the electromagnetic emission produced from axion dark matter. Specifically, we construct charge and current distributions that are consistent with magnetar observations and use these to recompute the prospective sensitivity of radio and submillimeter telescopes to axion dark matter. We demonstrate that the two leading models yield vastly different predictions for the frequency and amplitude of the spectral line, indicating systematic uncertainties in the plasma structure are significant. Finally, we discuss various observational signatures that can be used to differentiate the local plasma loading mechanism of an individual magnetar, which will be necessary if there is hope of using such objects to search for axions.

</details>


### [464] [Scalable continuous gravitational wave detection in PTA data with nonparametric red noise suppression and optimal pulsar selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07942)
*Qian, Yi-Qian,Wang, Yan,Mohanty, Soumya D.,Chen, Siyuan*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该工作提出一种计算高效的频率派方法，将自适应样条非参数红噪声抑制与最优脉冲星子集选择相结合，用于在PTA数据中搜索连续引力波；在基于NANOGrav 15-yr数据释放的模拟数据集上，其参数估计精度与贝叶斯分析相当，而计算耗时不到5 h（贝叶斯方法为1--2天）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大规模脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）中，贝叶斯CGW探测方法的计算成本因模型噪声与信号参数数目随PTA规模成正比而迅速增长，这限制了其对下一代射电天文设施预期提供的数百颗脉冲星规模PTA的可扩展性。因此需要一种计算高效、可扩展的CGW搜索方法。

Method: 摘要未说明实际观测数据、望远镜、频段或时间跨度。方法为频率派框架，结合自适应样条拟合算法以非参数方式抑制红噪声，从而无需贝叶斯方法中固有的复杂噪声建模，并采用一种用于优化纳入搜索的脉冲星子集的新方案。性能在一个基于NANOGrav 15-yr数据释放的模拟数据集上量化，并使用多个数据实现和信号参数进行严格研究。

Result: 在基于NANOGrav 15-yr数据释放的模拟数据集上，该方法性能与贝叶斯分析相当：对于信噪比≈10的CGW信号，使用最优脉冲星选择时，相对特征应变误差为1.0%、频率误差为0.072%（相对于注入值）；标准贝叶斯分析的相同误差分别为1.7%和0.16%。该分析在不到5 h内完成，而贝叶斯方法需要1--2天。

Conclusion: 作者认为，该方法在精度上与贝叶斯分析相当，同时显著缩短计算时间，并支持使用多个数据实现和信号参数进行严格研究，因而可被确立为一种用于大规模PTA连续引力波搜索的高效且可扩展的工具。根据摘要无法判断其对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱、瞬变射电发射或磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）联系的具体物理意义。

Abstract: Bayesian methods for the detection of continuous gravitational waves (CGWs) in pulsar timing array (PTA) data incur substantial computational costs that grow rapidly due to the number of noise and signal parameters characterizing the fitted model being proportional to the size of the PTA. This computational burden limits the scalability of these methods for large-scale PTAs comprising hundreds of pulsars anticipated from next-generation radio astronomy facilities. In this work, we introduce a computationally efficient frequentist method designed to circumvent this challenge. This is achieved by combining an adaptive spline fitting algorithm that nonparametrically suppresses red noise, thereby eliminating the need for complex noise modeling inherent to Bayesian methods, with a novel scheme for optimizing the subsets of pulsars included in the search. We quantify the performance of our method on a simulated dataset based on the NANOGrav 15-yr data release and find that it achieves a performance comparable to that of Bayesian analysis: for a CGW signal with a signal-to-noise ratio of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mo>≈</mml:mo><mml:mn>10</mml:mn></mml:math></inline-formula>, our method yields a relative characteristic strain error of 1.0% and a frequency error of 0.072% from the injected values by using the optimal pulsar selections, while the same errors are 1.7% and 0.16%, respectively, for the standard Bayesian analysis. At the same time, our analysis completes in less than 5 h, in contrast to the 1--2 days required by Bayesian methods. This allows us to perform a rigorous study of our method using multiple data realizations and signal parameters, establishing it as an efficient and scalable tool for CGW searches with large-scale PTAs.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者提出，实时处理与多望远镜协同定位对识别FRB宿主星系至关重要，从而有助于解开FRB progenitor 之谜；该方法也直接适用于下一代望远镜的高数据率。至于FRB与脉冲星、磁星之间是否存在物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: SUPERBx is an extension to the SUPERB survey which looks at the highest Galactic latitudes in a search for fast radio bursts (FRBs). Recent results show that there is a strong latitude dependence to FRB detectability so SUPERBx will search above 25 degrees in Galactic latitude. It will use optimised GPU codes to search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs), making discoveries in real time. Handling our data as it comes in is essential for the SKA Phase I era so this work applies directly to the high-data rates of next generation telescopes. The FRBs discovered will have much more associated information than all previous detections. Firstly the discovery lag will be ~1 second, rather than months/years. The Parkes observations will be shadowed by other radio telescopes (Molonglo, GMRT, MWA) to allow, for the first time, localisation of FRBs, and a host of optical and high-energy telescopes will then be triggered as appropriate. This is key for identifying FRB host galaxies, so as to solve the mystery of their progenitors.

</details>

TL;DR: 该提案计划用 Parkes 超宽带接收机对四个表面上看仅出现一次观测的 RRAT 进行深度后随监测，以限制其脉冲重复率和能量分布，并检验隐藏的重复发射能否解释其表面上的单次观测性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表面上看仅出现一次观测的 RRAT 是否真正重复仍未解决；FAST 高灵敏度后随观测已揭示多个原由 Parkes 探测的表面单次 RRAT 实为重复源，其脉冲弱数百倍，因此需判断这类源是观测灵敏度不足所致，还是本质上灾难性的暂现事件。

Method: 摘要说明拟用 Parkes 超宽带接收机系统对四个表面上看仅出现一次观测的 RRAT 进行深度后随监测，该系统灵敏度比 Multibeam 发现数据高 1.7-3.4 倍；用于限制脉冲重复率与能量分布。具体观测频率范围、时间跨度、样本筛选与统计分析方法摘要未说明；提及近期使用 FAST 的高灵敏度后随观测，但未给出其细节。

Conclusion: 作者提出用更高灵敏度的 Parkes 超宽带观测检验隐藏的重复发射能否解释这些源表面上的单次观测性质，从而区分观测灵敏度不足与本质灾难性暂现事件；对哪些源会呈现重复、以及其物理机制，根据摘要无法判断。该工作对 RRAT 单脉冲与重复率研究有方法学上的潜在相关性，但摘要未给出结论性结果。

Abstract: Rotating radio transients (RRATs) are Galactic neutron stars that emit sporadic radio pulses, and the question of whether apparently one-off sources truly repeat remains unresolved. With the discovery of numerous fast radio bursts (FRBs), the paradigm of 'one detection defines an astrophysical source' has shifted. However, the distinction between truly non-repeating Galactic transients and insufficiently observed repeating sources remains critical. Recent high-sensitivity follow-up observations with FAST have revealed that multiple apparent one-off RRATs originally detected by Parkes are in fact repeating sources, with fainter pulses hundreds of times weaker than their initial bright detections. This discovery raises a fundamental question: are many one-off RRATs simply the result of insufficient observational sensitivity, or do they represent intrinsically catastrophic transient events. We propose deep follow-up monitoring of four apparent one-off RRATs using the Parkes Ultra-Wideband receiver system, which offers 1.7-3.4 times higher sensitivity than the Multibeam discovery data. These observations will constrain the pulse repetition rates and energy distributions of these sources, examine the extreme variability seen in some RRATs and pulsars that exhibit pulses differing by &gt;500 times in brightness, and test whether hidden repeating emission explains the apparent one-off nature of these sources.

Method: 提案使用 Parkes 超宽带接收机系统对四个看似只出现一次的 RRAT 进行深度后续监测；摘要指出该系统比 Multibeam 发现数据灵敏度高 1.7-3.4 倍。观测将用于限制脉冲重复率和能量分布，并检验极端变化性与隐藏重复辐射。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度、总观测时长或其他分析细节。

Result: 摘要未报告本提案的实际观测结果。已引用的既有结果是：近期使用 FAST 的高灵敏度后续观测表明，多个最初由 Parkes 探测到的、看似只出现一次的 RRAT 实际上是重复源，其较暗脉冲比最初探测到的亮脉冲弱数百倍；此外，一些 RRAT 和脉冲星表现出脉冲亮度相差 &gt;500 倍的极端变化性。

Conclusion: 作者提出，许多看似只出现一次的 RRAT 可能源于观测灵敏度不足，而非本质上的灾难性暂现事件，但该问题仍未解决，需通过更高灵敏度的深度监测加以检验。根据摘要无法判断这些源最终的物理归属，也无法判断其与磁星或 FRB 的具体联系；摘要仅提及 FRB 发现改变了“一次探测即定义一个源”的范式。

Abstract: Rotating radio transients (RRATs) are Galactic neutron stars that emit sporadic radio pulses, and the question of whether apparently one-off sources truly repeat remains unresolved. With the discovery of numerous fast radio bursts (FRBs), the paradigm of 'one detection defines an astrophysical source' has shifted. However, the distinction between truly non-repeating Galactic transients and insufficiently observed repeating sources remains critical. Recent high-sensitivity follow-up observations with FAST have revealed that multiple apparent one-off RRATs originally detected by Parkes are in fact repeating sources, with fainter pulses hundreds of times weaker than their initial bright detections. This discovery raises a fundamental question: are many one-off RRATs simply the result of insufficient observational sensitivity, or do they represent intrinsically catastrophic transient events. We propose deep follow-up monitoring of four apparent one-off RRATs using the Parkes Ultra-Wideband receiver system, which offers 1.7-3.4 times higher sensitivity than the Multibeam discovery data. These observations will constrain the pulse repetition rates and energy distributions of these sources, examine the extreme variability seen in some RRATs and pulsars that exhibit pulses differing by &gt;500 times in brightness, and test whether hidden repeating emission explains the apparent one-off nature of these sources.

</details>

Method: 拟利用 Parkes 超宽带接收机系统对四个看似只出现一次的 RRATs 进行深度后续监测；该系统的灵敏度比 Multibeam 发现数据高 1.7-3.4 倍。观测将用于限制脉冲重复率与能量分布、考察极端变化性并检验隐藏重复辐射。观测时长、频率覆盖范围及其他分析细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未说明本研究已获得的观测结果。摘要报告的背景结果为：近期 FAST 高灵敏度后续观测揭示，多个最初由 Parkes 探测到的、看似只出现一次的 RRATs 实际上是重复源，具有比最初明亮探测弱数百倍的较暗脉冲；某些 RRATs 和脉冲星表现出脉冲亮度相差超过 500 倍的极端变化性。

Conclusion: 作者拟通过深度后续监测，限制这些源的脉冲重复率和能量分布，并检验隐藏的重复辐射能否解释其看似只出现一次的性质。FAST 的发现表明，“一次探测定义一个源”的范式已发生转变，而区分真正不重复的银河系暂现源与观测不足的重复源仍然关键；该工作能否判定这些源是否为本质上的灾难性暂现事件，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Rotating radio transients (RRATs) are Galactic neutron stars that emit sporadic radio pulses, and the question of whether apparently one-off sources truly repeat remains unresolved. With the discovery of numerous fast radio bursts (FRBs), the paradigm of 'one detection defines an astrophysical source' has shifted. However, the distinction between truly non-repeating Galactic transients and insufficiently observed repeating sources remains critical. Recent high-sensitivity follow-up observations with FAST have revealed that multiple apparent one-off RRATs originally detected by Parkes are in fact repeating sources, with fainter pulses hundreds of times weaker than their initial bright detections. This discovery raises a fundamental question: are many one-off RRATs simply the result of insufficient observational sensitivity, or do they represent intrinsically catastrophic transient events. We propose deep follow-up monitoring of four apparent one-off RRATs using the Parkes Ultra-Wideband receiver system, which offers 1.7-3.4 times higher sensitivity than the Multibeam discovery data. These observations will constrain the pulse repetition rates and energy distributions of these sources, examine the extreme variability seen in some RRATs and pulsars that exhibit pulses differing by &gt;500 times in brightness, and test whether hidden repeating emission explains the apparent one-off nature of these sources.

</details>

### [482] [Full analytic expressions of overlap reduction functions for anisotropies of the stochastic gravitational-wave background with pulsar timing arrays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07095)
*Zhou, Kun,Li, Jin*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该工作在一个解析互相关框架内严格推导了脉冲星计时阵列随机引力波背景各向异性的完整重叠缩减函数（ORFs），建立了可为全部六种极化模式推导任意阶各向异性ORF解析表达式的通用框架，并给出了直至 \(\ell \le 5\) 阶的完整解析表达式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PTA已被认为在纳赫兹频段探测到随机引力波背景，其数据分析依赖脉冲星对计时残差的互相关，而ORF决定分析灵敏度。然而，基于“短波近似”的传统ORF计算在处理标量纵极化模式时失效，且无法准确描述频率依赖效应与各向异性，因此需要更严格的响应函数推导。

Method: 摘要所述的观测、数据、仪器、频段、时间跨度和样本：摘要未说明。分析层面，作者在解析互相关框架内严格推导完整响应函数，通过变量替换和坐标旋转将复杂积分化为解析可处理形式，并建立通用框架以推导全部六种极化模式任意阶各向异性ORF的完全解析表达式；其(0,0)分量对应各向同性情形。

Result: 作者首次系统揭示了不同极化模式下各向异性ORF积分之间的内在对称性与数学关系，解决了矢量和标量纵模式中的发散困难，并给出直到 \(\ell \le 5\) 阶的各向异性ORF完整解析表达式。该框架不含近似，其 \((0,0)\) 分量自然对应各向同性情形并再现著名的Hellings-Downs曲线；与数值积分相比，结果适用性更广、计算显著更快、精度更高。

Conclusion: 作者认为，该无近似的通用解析框架及其在 \(\ell \le 5\) 阶给出的完整解析表达式，为利用PTA数据进行高精度各向异性天图绘制、极化模式分离以及新物理搜寻提供了有价值的理论和计算基础。关于该框架与脉冲星单脉冲、模式转换、计时或磁星-FRB联系的具体物理推论，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Recent findings collectively suggest that pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) have detected the stochastic gravitational-wave background in the nanohertz frequency band, opening new avenues for testing theories of gravity and cosmology. PTAs serve as a unique tool for probing the nanohertz stochastic gravitational-wave background, enabling studies of supermassive black hole evolution and early-Universe physics. PTA data analysis fundamentally relies on cross-correlating timing residuals from pulsar pairs, for which the overlap reduction functions (ORFs) are critical in determining the sensitivity of such analyses. Conventional ORF calculations based on the ``short-wavelength approximation'' break down when handling the scalar longitudinal polarization mode and fail to accurately describe frequency-dependent effects and anisotropies. This work presents a significant advance by rigorously deriving the full response functions within an analytical cross-correlation framework. We systematically reveal, for the first time, the intrinsic symmetries and mathematical relationships among the anisotropic ORF integrals for different polarization modes. Through variable substitutions and coordinate rotations, we transform the complex integrals into analytically tractable forms, resolving the divergence difficulties encountered in the vector and scalar longitudinal modes. Building on these theoretical advances, we establish a universal framework capable of deriving fully analytical expressions for anisotropic ORFs to arbitrary order for all six polarization modes. As a direct application of this framework, we provide complete analytical expressions for anisotropic ORFs up to the order of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mo>ℓ</mml:mo><mml:mo>&lt;=</mml:mo><mml:mn>5</mml:mn></mml:math></inline-formula>. This universal framework is free from approximations; its (0,0) component naturally corresponds to the isotropic case and recovers the well-known Hellings-Downs curve. Compared to numerical integration, our results offer broader applicability, significantly faster computation, and higher precision. They provide a valuable theoretical and computational foundation for conducting high-precision anisotropic sky mapping, polarization-mode separation, and searches for new physics using PTA data.

</details>


### [483] [Parkes observations for project P1356 semester 2025APRS_11]()
*Bause, Marlon,Kramer, Michael,Spitler, Laura,Desvignes, Gregory,Lower, Marcus,Sherman, Myles,bethapudi, suryarao,Younes, George,Nicotera, Lorena,Manaswini, Ninisha*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟用 Parkes UWL 接收机对 4 颗射电宁静磁星开展每两周一次的定期监测，其中 3 个源有配套 X 射线观测，以探究独立于爆发事件的射电–X 射线关系；任何射电探测（单脉冲或折叠轮廓）都将是重大发现，而非探测也能给出上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已知 30 颗磁星中仅 6 颗探测到射电辐射，其余 24 颗通常只在 X 射线爆发后才被搜寻射电，这引入了强选择偏差；已知射电明亮磁星射电辐射随时间快速变化，且 XTE J1810-197 出现射电通量强烈增加而无 X 射线通量增强，因此射电宁静磁星是否真正射电宁静仍不清楚，射电–X 射线关系似乎相当复杂。

Method: 摘要未说明观测是否已在执行或获得时间分配；提案为对 4 颗射电宁静磁星开展定期监测，使用 Parkes UWL 接收机进行每两周一次的观测，其中 3 个源有配套 X 射线观测。摘要未说明具体源名、频段、时间跨度、数据量与分析方法（如计时、单脉冲、折叠轮廓或偏振分析）。

Result: 摘要未说明实际观测结果。摘要仅报告：已知 30 颗磁星中只有六颗曾被探测到射电辐射；射电明亮磁星的射电辐射随时间快速变化；对 XTE J1810-197 已观测到射电通量强烈增加而无 X 射线通量增强。摘要未给出数值、不确定度或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者提出，对 4 颗射电宁静磁星的定期监测（3 个源有配套 X 射线观测）可提供独特数据集以探究独立于爆发事件的射电–X 射线关系；任何射电探测（单脉冲或折叠轮廓）都将是重大发现并有助于约束磁星辐射机制，也有助于增进对快速射电暴辐射机制的理解；而非探测给出的上限可作为未来爆发前的基线，并有助于约束磁星相对于脉冲星的形成过程。

Abstract: Magnetars are neutron stars with exceptionally high magnetic fields. From the 30 known magnetars, only six have had radio emission detected so far. The remaining 24 magnetars are generally only searched for radio emission after an X-ray outburst. This added a strong selection bias to whether magnetars are radio loud or not. From the known six radio loud magnetars, we know that the radio emission changes quickly with time and for the magnetar XTE J1810-197, it has been observed that the radio flux increases strongly without an enhancement in X-ray flux. Thus, it remains unclear whether the radio quiet magnetars are in fact radio quiet and the radio X-ray relation appears to be rather complex. In this proposal, we propose a regular monitoring campaign of 4 radio quiet magnetars with bi-weekly observations using the Parkes UWL receiver. For 3 of the sources, we will have accompanying X-ray observations and thus, this will give an unique data set to probe the relation between radio and X-ray independent outbursts. Any detection of radio emission, i.e. single pulses or folded profiles, would be a major discovery and help to constrain the emission mechanisms of magnetars. This will also help to improve the understanding of the emission mechanism of fast radio bursts. However, also a non-detection of radio emission will provide upper limits that serve as a baseline before any future outburst of the observed magnetars as well as allow to constrain the formation process of magnetars in contrast to pulsars.

</details>
