Abstract: Magnetars are neutron stars with exceptionally high magnetic fields. From the 30 known magnetars, only six have had radio emission detected so far. The remaining 24 magnetars are generally only searched for radio emission after an X-ray outburst. This added a strong selection bias to whether magnetars are radio loud or not. From the known six radio loud magnetars, we know that the radio emission changes quickly with time and for the magnetar XTE J1810-197, it has been observed that the radio flux increases strongly without an enhancement in X-ray flux. Thus, it remains unclear whether the radio quiet magnetars are in fact radio quiet and the radio X-ray relation appears to be rather complex. In this proposal, we propose a regular monitoring campaign of 4 radio quiet magnetars with bi-weekly observations using the Parkes UWL receiver. For 3 of the sources, we will have accompanying X-ray observations and thus, this will give an unique data set to probe the relation between radio and X-ray independent outbursts. Any detection of radio emission, i.e. single pulses or folded profiles, would be a major discovery and help to constrain the emission mechanisms of magnetars. This will also help to improve the understanding of the emission mechanism of fast radio bursts. However, also a non-detection of radio emission will provide upper limits that serve as a baseline before any future outburst of the observed magnetars as well as allow to constrain the formation process of magnetars in contrast to pulsars.

Method: 提出对 4 颗射电安静磁星开展定期监测活动，使用 Parkes UWL 接收机进行双周观测；其中 3 颗源有伴随的 X 射线观测，从而提供探究射电与 X 射线在爆发无关情形下关系的独特数据集。具体观测时长、时间跨度、频率设置和数据分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未报告实际观测结果，仅说明：已知 30 颗磁星中 6 颗探测到射电辐射；XTE J1810-197 已观测到射电流量强烈增加而 X 射线流量未增强。提出的监测若探测到射电辐射（单脉冲或折叠轮廓）将是重大发现；即使未探测到射电辐射，也将给出上限，作为未来爆发的基线。

Conclusion: 作者认为，该监测可约束磁星辐射机制，并有助于增进对快速射电暴辐射机制的理解；非探测上限可用作未来爆发的基线，并有助于约束磁星相对于脉冲星的形成过程。探测结果尚未获得，具体物理机制根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Magnetars are neutron stars with exceptionally high magnetic fields. From the 30 known magnetars, only six have had radio emission detected so far. The remaining 24 magnetars are generally only searched for radio emission after an X-ray outburst. This added a strong selection bias to whether magnetars are radio loud or not. From the known six radio loud magnetars, we know that the radio emission changes quickly with time and for the magnetar XTE J1810-197, it has been observed that the radio flux increases strongly without an enhancement in X-ray flux. Thus, it remains unclear whether the radio quiet magnetars are in fact radio quiet and the radio X-ray relation appears to be rather complex. In this proposal, we propose a regular monitoring campaign of 4 radio quiet magnetars with bi-weekly observations using the Parkes UWL receiver. For 3 of the sources, we will have accompanying X-ray observations and thus, this will give an unique data set to probe the relation between radio and X-ray independent outbursts. Any detection of radio emission, i.e. single pulses or folded profiles, would be a major discovery and help to constrain the emission mechanisms of magnetars. This will also help to improve the understanding of the emission mechanism of fast radio bursts. However, also a non-detection of radio emission will provide upper limits that serve as a baseline before any future outburst of the observed magnetars as well as allow to constrain the formation process of magnetars in contrast to pulsars.

</details>

Abstract: Magnetars are neutron stars with exceptionally high magnetic fields. From the 30 known magnetars, only six have had radio emission detected so far. The remaining 24 magnetars are generally only searched for radio emission after an X-ray outburst. This added a strong selection bias to whether magnetars are radio loud or not. From the known six radio loud magnetars, we know that the radio emission changes quickly with time and for the magnetar XTE J1810-197, it has been observed that the radio flux increases strongly without an enhancement in X-ray flux. Thus, it remains unclear whether the radio quiet magnetars are in fact radio quiet and the radio X-ray relation appears to be rather complex. In this proposal, we propose a regular monitoring campaign of 4 radio quiet magnetars with bi-weekly observations using the Parkes UWL receiver. For 3 of the sources, we will have accompanying X-ray observations and thus, this will give an unique data set to probe the relation between radio and X-ray independent outbursts. Any detection of radio emission, i.e. single pulses or folded profiles, would be a major discovery and help to constrain the emission mechanisms of magnetars. This will also help to improve the understanding of the emission mechanism of fast radio bursts. However, also a non-detection of radio emission will provide upper limits that serve as a baseline before any future outburst of the observed magnetars as well as allow to constrain the formation process of magnetars in contrast to pulsars.

</details>

### [500] [Hybrid quark stars with quark-quark phase transitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.00776)
*Yang, Zongcan,Zeng, Tianxiong,Yan, Yan,Yuan, Wen-Li,Zhang, Chen,Zhou, Enping*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该工作提出杂化夸克星（HybQSs）中可发生尖锐的一阶夸克-夸克相变，并用脉冲星质量测量 $M_{\mathrm{TOV}}\gtrsim2M_{\odot}$ 与 GW170817 的潮汐形变上限 $\Lambda_{1.4M_{\odot}}<800$ 约束其参数空间，发现部分参数空间存在双星，且此类相变也可能导致 $f_{\mathrm{peak}}$ 与 $\Lambda_{1.35M_{\odot}}$ 近似普适关系的偏离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统杂化星中的相变是强子-夸克相变；本文关注夸克星内部不同夸克物质相之间的相变，即夸克-夸克相变，从而产生杂化夸克星（HybQSs）。摘要指出需要给出这类星体质量-半径关系形式的通用相图，并考察近期观测对相变参数空间的约束，以及这类相变是否会影响此前归因于杂化中子星强子-夸克相变的并合后关系。

Method: 摘要未说明实际观测数据、望远镜或仪器名称、观测频段与时间跨度，也未说明样本数量。所述方法为：先获得杂化夸克星质量-半径关系形式的通用相图；再采用成熟的相互作用夸克物质通用参数化方案，构建含各类尖锐一阶夸克-夸克相变的夸克星模型；随后用脉冲星质量测量 $M_{\mathrm{TOV}}\gtrsim2M_{\odot}$ 和 GW170817 的潮汐形变上限 $\Lambda_{1.4M_{\odot}}<800$ 对可行参数空间进行约束，并考察双星与并合后频率-潮汐形变关系。

Result: 摘要报告：(1) 获得了杂化夸克星可能的质量-半径关系形式的通用相图；(2) 用相互作用夸克物质通用参数化构建了具有各类尖锐一阶夸克-夸克相变的夸克星模型，区别于传统杂化星中的强子-夸克相变；(3) 脉冲星质量测量 $M_{\mathrm{TOV}}\gtrsim2M_{\odot}$ 与 GW170817 的潮汐形变上限 $\Lambda_{1.4M_{\odot}}<800$ 对可行参数空间施加了约束；(4) 在部分 HybQS 参数空间中识别出双星；(5) 杂化夸克星中的夸克-夸克相变可能导致主导并合后频率 $f_{\mathrm{peak}}$ 与潮汐形变 $\Lambda_{1.35M_{\odot}}$ 之间近似普适关系的偏离，而该偏离此前被认为仅由杂化中子星中的强子-夸克相变引起。摘要未给出具体数值拟合结果、统计显著性或参数空间的具体范围。

Conclusion: 作者认为，杂化夸克星内部的夸克-夸克相变可产生新的致密星类型，并且这类相变也能导致 $f_{\mathrm{peak}}$ 与 $\Lambda_{1.35M_{\odot}}$ 近似普适关系的偏离，从而扩展了此前仅由强子-夸克相变解释的图景。作者总结称，这项工作揭示了相变的新可能性以及由此在现实天体物理场景中产生的新型致密星。就脉冲星计时、单脉冲、偏振、射电频谱、模式转换或磁星-快速射电暴联系而言，摘要未说明；根据摘要无法判断其可直接迁移性。

Abstract: We explore the possibility of phase transitions between different quark matter phases occurring within quark stars, giving rise to the hybrid quark stars (HybQSs). First, we obtain the generic phase diagram of possible mass-radius relation forms for the HybQSs. Then, utilizing a well-established general parametrization of interacting quark matter, we construct quark star models featuring sharp first-order quark-quark phase transitions of various types, in contrast to the hadron-quark transition in conventional hybrid stars. We systematically investigate how recent observations, such as the pulsar mass measurement <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mi>TOV</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub><mml:mo>≳</mml:mo><mml:mn>2</mml:mn><mml:msub><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mo>⊙</mml:mo></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> and the GW170817's tidal deformability bound <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>Λ</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mn>1.4</mml:mn><mml:msub><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mo>⊙</mml:mo></mml:msub></mml:mrow></mml:msub><mml:mo>&lt;</mml:mo><mml:mn>800</mml:mn></mml:math></inline-formula>, constrain the viable parameter space. We also identified twin stars in some of the HybQS parameter space. Furthermore, we found that the quark-quark phase transitions in hybrid quark stars may also cause the deviation from the approximate universal relation between the dominant postmerger frequency <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>f</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mi>peak</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> and tidal deformability <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>Λ</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mn>1.35</mml:mn><mml:msub><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mo>⊙</mml:mo></mml:msub></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula>, which was previously believed to only be caused by the hadron-quark phase transitions in hybrid neutron stars. This work unveils new possibilities of phase transitions and the resulting new types of compact stars in realistic astrophysical scenarios.

</details>


### [501] [Parkes observations for project P1171 semester 2022OCTS_06]()
*Eppel, Florian,James, Clancy,Kadler, Matthias,Wilms, Joern,Shannon, Ryan,Spitler, Laura,Rau, Arne,Niu, Chenhui,Krumpe, Mirko,Bahic, Sabina,Cruces, Marylin*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟用Parkes/Murriyang望远镜开展“shadowing”射电观测，在同时被XMM-Newton覆盖的视场内搜寻新的FRB，并以邻近低红移星系（此前被认定为FRB宿主）作为观测目标；若探测到FRB，将有保证地获得同时的X射线覆盖，从而获得相关X射线能谱与光变曲线信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB起源仍不清楚且理论模型众多。若干模型预测伴随多波段辐射，但此前对FRB的光学、X射线或伽马射线对应体的搜寻均未导致任何探测。银河系磁星 SGR 1935+2154A 已被观测到同时发射类FRB暴与X射线耀发，这暗示河外FRB源也可能呈现X射线对应体。然而X射线卫星成本高、视场小、FRB探测概率相对低，使协调的射电与X射线观测在后勤上极难安排，因此需要新的观测途径来对理论模型施加约束。

Method: 提出使用X射线卫星XMM-Newton与Parkes/Murriyang射电望远镜配合的新方法：用Parkes望远镜开展shadowing观测，在同时被XMM-Newton覆盖的视场内搜寻新的FRB；并针对邻近（低z）星系开展常规XMM观测，因为此类天体此前已被认定为FRB宿主。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本量、灵敏度或分析流程。

Result: 摘要未说明任何新取得的观测结果。摘要仅报告既往情况：此前对FRB的光学、X射线或伽马射线对应体的搜寻均未导致任何探测；银河系磁星 SGR 1935+2154A 已被观测到同时发射类FRB暴和X射线耀发。所提出的观测若探测到FRB，将获得有保证的同时X射线覆盖，并得到相关X射线能谱和光变曲线的详细信息。

Conclusion: 作者提出通过Parkes/Murriyang与XMM-Newton的协调（shadowing）观测，在同时被XMM-Newton覆盖的视场内搜寻FRB，以对FRB起源的理论模型施加约束；选择邻近（低z）星系作为目标，是因为此类天体此前已被认定为FRB宿主。若探测到FRB，则可获得同时的X射线覆盖以及相关X射线能谱与光变曲线信息。摘要未给出该方案的实施结果或已取得的物理结论；根据摘要无法判断其能否真正约束FRB起源模型或验证上述预言。

Abstract: The origin of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) is still unclear with a plethora of theoretical models for their origin. Several models predict associated multi-wavelength emission, but previous searches for optical, X-ray or gamma-ray counterparts of FRBs have not led to any detection. The Galactic magnetar SGR 1935+2154A has been observed to simultaneously emit FRB-like bursts and X-ray flares, which suggests that also extragalactic FRB sources may exhibit X-ray counterparts. Because of the high cost of X-ray satellites and in face of the relatively low FRB detection probability in their small field of view, coordinated radio and X-ray observations are logistically very difficult to set up. We propose a new approach using the X-ray satellite XMM-Newton and the Parkes/Murriyang radio telescope to put constraints on the theoretical models: We aim to conduct shadowing observations with the Parkes telescope to search for new FRBs in fields that are simultaneously covered by XMM-Newton. We hereby target regular XMM observations of nearby (low-z) galaxies, since objects of this type have been previously identified as FRB hosts. In case of an FRB detection in the radio band, we will have guaranteed simultaneous X-ray coverage and will get detailed information about the associated X-ray spectrum and light curve.

</details>

### [507] [Parkes observations for project P1171 semester 2022OCTS_10]()
*Eppel, Florian,James, Clancy,Kadler, Matthias,Wilms, Joern,Shannon, Ryan,Spitler, Laura,Rau, Arne,Niu, Chenhui,Krumpe, Mirko,Bahic, Sabina,Cruces, Marylin*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 起源仍不清楚，理论模型众多；若干模型预言伴随多波段辐射，但此前对光学、X 射线或伽马射线对应体的搜寻均未探测到。银河系磁星 SGR 1935+2154A 同时发出类 FRB 爆发与 X 射线耀发，提示河外 FRB 源也可能有 X 射线对应体。但 X 射线卫星成本高、视场小且 FRB 探测概率低，协调射电与 X 射线观测在后勤上极难安排，这一困难构成待解决的知识与技术缺口。

Result: 摘要报告：此前对 FRB 的光学、X 射线或伽马射线对应体搜寻均未导致任何探测；银河系磁星 SGR 1935+2154A 已被观测到同时发出类 FRB 爆发和 X 射线耀发；邻近（低 z）星系此前已被识别为 FRB 宿主。该文为观测提案，所提出的掩星联合观测尚未给出探测结果，摘要未说明任何新探测、数目、显著性、谱或光变曲线测量值。

In case of an FRB detection in the radio band, we will have guaranteed simultaneous X-ray coverage and will get detailed information about the associated X-ray spectrum and light curve.

<details>

Motivation: 此前工作表明，高银纬区域的 FRB 可探测性可比银道面内高出多达 4 倍，因此 SUPERBx 将搜寻重点放在最高银纬区域。同时，在数据到达时实时处理数据对于 SKA 第一阶段时代十分必要，并可推广到下一代望远镜的高数据率情形；而定位 FRB 并证认其宿主星系，是解决其前身星之谜并用于精密宇宙学测量的关键。

Method: SUPERBx 是 SUPERB 巡天在高银纬区域搜寻 FRB 的扩展，使用优化的 GPU 代码搜寻脉冲星和 FRB，并实时做出发现，即在数据到达时进行处理。摘要提到 Parkes 的观测，并称将获得其他射电望远镜的同步观测（尤其是翻新后的 Molonglo），随后视情况触发光学和高能望远镜。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本量及统计分析方法。

Result: 摘要称此前工作显示高银纬区域的 FRB 可探测性可比银道面内高出多达 4 倍；SUPERBx 使用优化的 GPU 代码实时搜寻脉冲星和 FRB；该项目已发现四个 FRB。所发现的 FRB 将拥有远多于此前所有探测的关联信息，发现延迟约为 1 秒，而非数月/数年。翻新后的 Molonglo 性能已达到在 2016 年独立发现 3 个 FRB 的水平。摘要未说明这些 FRB 的具体性质、显著性或其他数值结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，实时处理数据对 SKA 第一阶段时代至关重要，因此这项工作直接适用于下一代望远镜的高数据率。他们认为，Parkes 观测与其他射电望远镜的同步观测以及对光学和高能望远镜的触发，对于定位所发现的 FRB 和证认其宿主星系至关重要，从而可解开 FRB 前身星之谜，并利用其作为精密宇宙学测量工具的诸多用途。根据摘要无法判断所发现的 FRB 与脉冲星、磁星或单脉冲发射的具体物理联系。

Abstract: SUPERBx is an extension to the SUPERB survey which looks at the highest Galactic latitudes in a search for fast radio bursts (FRBs). We will focus our efforts at high Galactic latitudes where our previous work has shown FRB detectability to be as much as 4 times higher than in the plane. SUPERBx uses optimised GPU codes to search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs), making discoveries in real time. Handling our data as it comes in is essential for the SKA Phase I era so this work applies directly to the high-data rates of next generation telescopes. The FRBs discovered (we have already discovered four FRBs in this project) will have much more associated information than all previous detections. Firstly our discovery lag is ~1 second, rather than months/years. The Parkes observations will be shadowed by other radio telescopes (in particular the refurbished Molonglo which has now reached a level of performance where it has independently discovered 3 FRBs in 2016) to allow localisation of the discovered FRBs, and a host of optical and high-energy telescopes will then be triggered as appropriate. This is key for identifying FRB host galaxies, so as to solve the mystery of their progenitors and to exploit their many uses as tools for precision cosmology measurements.

</details>

### [516] [Magnetic Fields at Largest Universal Strengths: Overview]()
*Beskin, V. S.,Balogh, A.,Falanga, M.,Treumann, R. A.*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于宇宙中最强磁场的综述，指出极强磁场主要被视为化石场，由引力坍缩和磁通量守恒将前身星磁场放大而来，其多样性反映了坍缩停止时不同的质量与阶段，最轻见于白矮星，最强见于磁星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要指出需要综述强磁场在宇宙中的作用，并系统列出后续各章涵盖的主要观测与理论成果及若干开放问题。其背景是宇宙中的强磁场比任何大尺度磁场高出若干个数量级，乍看之下提示其产生机制可能不同，因此需要梳理相关认识。

Method: 摘要未说明。本文为简要综述，摘要仅说明其列出后续各章的主要观测与理论成果及开放问题，未给出具体的观测、数据、仪器、频段、时间跨度、样本或分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告称，宇宙中的强磁场比任何大尺度磁场高出若干个数量级；人们相信引力坍缩和磁通量守恒将前身星中产生的磁场放大到观测到的强度。极强磁场因此主要是化石场，其多样性印证了坍缩停止时不同的质量和阶段：最轻的在白矮星中，最强的在磁星中。摘要还指出磁星是一类特殊的中子星，具有强不均匀、尤其结构化的壳层，并提及与这类磁场探测、辐射产生及环境影响有关的各种效应。

Conclusion: 作者明确提出，极强磁场主要是化石场，由引力坍缩和磁通量守恒把前身星中产生的磁场放大至观测强度，其多样性反映了坍缩停止时不同的质量与阶段，从白矮星到磁星。摘要将磁星描述为一类具有强不均匀、尤其结构化壳层的中子星，并指出与探测、辐射产生和环境效应相关的内容指向本卷相关章节。至于这些结果对脉冲星、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自旋下降力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱、瞬变射电发射或磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）联系的直接意义，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: A brief review is given about the role strong magnetic fields play in the universe. We list the main observational and theoretical achievements treated in the following chapters including a number of open questions which future research is going to attack. Strong fields in the universe exceed any large scale fields by several orders of magnitude, at first glance suggesting that their generation mechanisms would be different. However, it is believed that gravitational collapse and magnetic flux conservation is responsible for the amplification of fields generated in the progenitors to the observed strengths. In this sense the extremely strong fields are mainly fossil, and their variety confirms the different masses and stages where the collapse comes to rest, at the lightest in white dwarfs and at the strongest in magnetars, which are a particular class of neutron stars with strongly inhomogeneous particularly structured crust. Various effects related to the detection of such fields, radiation generation and consequences for the environment are pointed out and referred to the relevant chapters in this volume.

</details>


### [517] [Revisiting QCD-induced little inflation with chiral density wave state and its implications on pulsar timing array gravitational-wave signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.29772)
*Jung, Tae Hyun,Kim, Seyong,Lee, Jong-Wan,Shin, Chang Sub,Yang, Hee Beom*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 本文重新审视QCD诱导的小暴胀情景，考虑手征密度波（CDW）相；作者发现，即便CDW相可在低重子密度下保持亚稳，包含液-气相变与相分离后释放的潜热仍过小，无法实现可行的QCD诱导小暴胀及其PTA尺度引力波信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规的夸克-胶子等离子体到强子气体的均匀相变难以达到观测重子密度所需的过冷强度，这一困难促使作者探究大重子化学势下性质不同的相结构是否能改变重子密度与化学势的关系，进而改变相变的过冷历史，并影响纳赫兹随机引力波背景的产生。

Method: 采用包含同位旋标量矢量介子的核子-介子模型，确定手征密度波（CDW）相在(μ_B, T)平面上的临界结构与旋节结构；并进一步计入随后的液-气相变与相分离。摘要未说明数值求解方法、参数取值或统计分析方法的具体细节。

Result: 作者发现，CDW相表现出非平凡的结构，并可在参数空间的某一区域保持亚稳直至低重子密度；但在计入随后的液-气相变和相分离后，释放的潜热太小，无法实现可行的QCD诱导小暴胀情景及其相关的PTA尺度引力波信号。摘要未给出具体数值、误差或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者据此认为，所考虑的CDW相与后续液-气相变、相分离不足以产生可行的QCD诱导小暴胀及PTA尺度引力波信号；该分析明确了QCD相变可作为纳赫兹引力波宇宙学来源的条件，并澄清了非均匀QCD相可能的宇宙学相关性。对脉冲星计时阵列研究而言，本文是在宇宙学引力波源层面讨论PTA频段的可能来源，并非对脉冲星计时观测数据的分析；根据摘要无法判断其结论对其他PTA相关物理情形的可迁移性。

Abstract: We revisit QCD-induced little inflation in which the Universe starts with a large baryon chemical potential and undergoes a strong first-order QCD phase transition, generating an observable stochastic gravitational-wave background in the nano-Hz range relevant for pulsar timing array (PTA) observations. We point out that the conventional homogeneous transition from the quark-gluon plasma phase to the hadronic gas phase faces an unavoidable difficulty in achieving the required strength of supercooling for the observed baryon density. This motivates us to explore whether a qualitatively different phase structure at a large baryon chemical potential can alter the relation between the baryon density and the chemical potential, and thereby modify the supercooling history of the transition. Using the nucleon-meson model with isoscalar vector mesons, we determine the critical and spinodal structure of the chiral density wave (CDW) phase in the <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mo>(</mml:mo><mml:msub><mml:mrow><mml:mi>μ</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mi>B</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub><mml:mo>,</mml:mo><mml:mi>T</mml:mi><mml:mo>)</mml:mo></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> plane. We find that the CDW phase exhibits a nontrivial structure and can remain metastable down to a low baryon density in a certain region of the parameter space. Taking into account the subsequent liquid-gas transition and phase separation, however, the released latent heat is too small to realize a viable QCD-induced little inflation scenario and its associated PTA-scale gravitational-wave signal. Our analysis sharpens the conditions under which QCD phase transitions may act as cosmological sources of nano-Hz gravitational waves, while clarifying the possible cosmological relevance of inhomogeneous QCD phases.

</details>


### [518] [Parkes observations for project P892 semester 2016OCTS_BPSR_52]()
*Keane, Evan,Possenti, Andrea,Green, James,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,Burke-Spolaor, Sarah,Eatough, Ralph,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Jameson, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Tiburzi, Caterina,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Jankowski, Fabian,Caleb, Manisha,Morello, Vincent,Bhandari, Shivani*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: SUPERBx 扩展巡天针对高银纬区域搜索 FRB，最新结果显示银纬约 45 度及以上处 FRB 探测率高出 4 倍，并已在该项目中实时发现四个 FRB，同时计划由其他射电望远镜协同跟踪以定位 FRB，并触发光学与高能观测以证认宿主星系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SUPERBx 是 SUPERB 巡天的扩展，旨在观测最高银河系纬度以搜寻 FRB。近期结果显示 FRB 可探测性强烈依赖银纬，银道面以上约 45 度及更高处探测率高出 4 倍，因此 SUPERBx 将重点转向该区域。此外，实时处理数据对 SKA 第一阶段时代的高数据率具有重要意义。

Method: SUPERBx 使用优化的 GPU 代码搜寻脉冲星和 FRB，并实时做出发现。Parkes 的观测将由其他射电望远镜协同跟踪，特别是经翻新的 Molonglo（其已在 2016 年独立发现 3 个 FRB），以对发现的 FRB 进行定位，并酌情触发光学和高能望远镜。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度与样本量。

Result: 最新结果显示 FRB 可探测性存在强烈的银纬依赖：在银道面以上约 45 度及更高处的探测率高出 4 倍。该项目已发现四个 FRB，且发现延迟约为 1 秒，而非数月/数年；所发现的 FRB 将拥有比以往所有探测多得多的关联信息。经翻新的 Molonglo 已独立发现 3 个 FRB。摘要未说明这些结果的统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，将 Parkes 观测与其他射电望远镜协同跟踪，并触发光学与高能望远镜，对于定位 FRB、证认其宿主星系至关重要，从而有助于解开 FRB 起源之谜，并利用其作为精密宇宙学测量工具的诸多用途。实时处理数据直接适用于下一代望远镜的高数据率。根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星、磁星单脉冲发射或自转能损变化的直接物理联系。

Abstract: SUPERBx is an extension to the SUPERB survey which looks at the highest Galactic latitudes in a search for fast radio bursts (FRBs). Our most recent results show that there is a strong Galactic latitude dependence to FRB detectability with the detection rate being 4 times higher ~45 degrees and higher above the plane; this is where SUPERBx will focus its efforts from now on. SUPERBx uses optimised GPU codes to search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs), making discoveries in real time. Handling our data as it comes in is essential for the SKA Phase I era so this work applies directly to the high-data rates of next generation telescopes. The FRBs discovered (we have already discovered four FRBs in this project) will have much more associated information than all previous detections. Firstly our discovery lag is ~1 second, rather than months/years. The Parkes observations will be shadowed by other radio telescopes (in particular the refurbished Molonglo which has now reached a level of performance where it has independently discovered 3 FRBs in 2016) to allow localisation of the discovered FRBs, and a host of optical and high-energy telescopes will then be triggered as appropriate. This is key for identifying FRB host galaxies, so as to solve the mystery of their progenitors and to exploit their many uses as tools for precision cosmology measurements.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者指出，在数据到达时即进行处理对 SKA 第一阶段时代的高数据率至关重要，因此该工作直接适用于下一代望远镜。所发现 FRB 具备更多关联信息，Parkes 与其他射电望远镜的同步观测有助于定位 FRB，并触发光学和高能望远镜，这对证认 FRB 宿主星系、解开其前身天体之谜以及将其用作精密宇宙学测量工具十分关键。关于脉冲星单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、偏振、射电频谱或磁星与 FRB 的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: SUPERBx is an extension to the SUPERB survey which looks at the highest Galactic latitudes in a search for fast radio bursts (FRBs). Our most recent results show that there is a strong Galactic latitude dependence to FRB detectability with the detection rate being 4 times higher ~45 degrees and higher above the plane; this is where SUPERBx will focus its efforts from now on. SUPERBx uses optimised GPU codes to search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs), making discoveries in real time. Handling our data as it comes in is essential for the SKA Phase I era so this work applies directly to the high-data rates of next generation telescopes. The FRBs discovered (we have already discovered four FRBs in this project) will have much more associated information than all previous detections. Firstly our discovery lag is ~1 second, rather than months/years. The Parkes observations will be shadowed by other radio telescopes (in particular the refurbished Molonglo which has now reached a level of performance where it has independently discovered 3 FRBs in 2016) to allow localisation of the discovered FRBs, and a host of optical and high-energy telescopes will then be triggered as appropriate. This is key for identifying FRB host galaxies, so as to solve the mystery of their progenitors and to exploit their many uses as tools for precision cosmology measurements.

</details>

*Keane, Evan,Possenti, Andrea,Green, James,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,Burke-Spolaor, Sarah,Eatough, Ralph,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Jameson, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Tiburzi, Caterina,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Jankowski, Fabian,Caleb, Manisha,Morello, Vincent,Bhandari, Shivani*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: SUPERBx 在最高银纬区域搜寻 FRB，最新结果显示 FRB 探测率在银盘面以上约 45 度及更高处高 4 倍；该项目使用优化的 GPU 代码实时搜寻脉冲星和 FRB，并将由其他射电望远镜 shadow 观测以定位 FRB，进而触发光学和高能望远镜证认宿主星系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SUPERBx 是 SUPERB 巡天的扩展，目标是在最高银纬区域搜寻 FRB。摘要指出最新结果显示 FRB 可探测性存在很强的银纬依赖，因此需要将搜寻集中于银盘面以上约 45 度及更高处；同时，实时处理数据对于 SKA Phase I 时代的高数据率具有重要意义，而证认 FRB 宿主星系有助于解开其 progenitor 之谜并用于精密宇宙学测量。

Method: 摘要说明 SUPERBx 使用优化的 GPU 代码搜寻脉冲星和 FRB，并实时做出发现；该项目在最高银纬区域、特别是银盘面以上约 45 度及更高处开展搜寻。摘要提到 Parkes 的观测将被其他射电望远镜 shadow，特别是经 refurbished 的 Molonglo，并会酌情触发光学和高能望远镜。摘要未说明观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本大小或统计分析细节。

Result: 摘要报告，最新结果表明 FRB 可探测性存在很强的银纬依赖，在银盘面以上约 45 度及更高处探测率高出 4 倍。该项目已发现四个 FRB，且发现延迟约为 1 秒，而不是数月/数年；这些 FRB 将拥有远比以往所有探测更多的相关信息。Molonglo 在 2016 年独立发现了 3 个 FRB。摘要未给出探测率或延迟的统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者明确支持的解释或含义是：SUPERBx 从现在起将把工作重点放在银盘面以上约 45 度及更高处；在数据到达时即进行处理，直接适用于下一代望远镜的高数据率，对 SKA Phase I 时代至关重要。作者还表示，对其他射电望远镜的 shadow 观测以及酌情触发光学和高能望远镜，对于证认 FRB 宿主星系十分关键，从而解开其 progenitor 之谜，并利用它们作为精密宇宙学测量工具的诸多用途。根据摘要无法判断本工作与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱或暂现射电发射的具体联系。

Abstract: SUPERBx is an extension to the SUPERB survey which looks at the highest Galactic latitudes in a search for fast radio bursts (FRBs). Our most recent results show that there is a strong Galactic latitude dependence to FRB detectability with the detection rate being 4 times higher ~45 degrees and higher above the plane; this is where SUPERBx will focus its efforts from now on. SUPERBx uses optimised GPU codes to search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs), making discoveries in real time. Handling our data as it comes in is essential for the SKA Phase I era so this work applies directly to the high-data rates of next generation telescopes. The FRBs discovered (we have already discovered four FRBs in this project) will have much more associated information than all previous detections. Firstly our discovery lag is ~1 second, rather than months/years. The Parkes observations will be shadowed by other radio telescopes (in particular the refurbished Molonglo which has now reached a level of performance where it has independently discovered 3 FRBs in 2016) to allow localisation of the discovered FRBs, and a host of optical and high-energy telescopes will then be triggered as appropriate. This is key for identifying FRB host galaxies, so as to solve the mystery of their progenitors and to exploit their many uses as tools for precision cosmology measurements.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要指出 SUPERBx 是 SUPERB 巡天的扩展，用于在最高银纬区域搜寻 FRB，并说明最新结果给出了 FRB 可探测性对银纬的强依赖；同时摘要强调，在数据到达时即处理数据对 SKA 第一阶段时代以及下一代望远镜的高数据率十分重要，而证认 FRB 宿主星系有助于解决其前身天体之谜并利用其进行精密宇宙学测量。

Conclusion: 摘要给出的结论是，SUPERBx 今后将聚焦于银道面以上约 45 度及更高区域，以利用那里更高的 FRB 探测率；实时处理数据直接适用于下一代望远镜的高数据率。摘要指出，与其他射电望远镜协同观测以定位 FRB，并视情况触发光学和高能望远镜，对于证认 FRB 宿主星系、解开其前身天体之谜以及将其用作精密宇宙学测量工具十分关键。摘要未说明与脉冲星、磁星、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、自转减慢力矩变化或磁星—FRB 联系有关的具体结论；根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: SUPERBx is an extension to the SUPERB survey which looks at the highest Galactic latitudes in a search for fast radio bursts (FRBs). Our most recent results show that there is a strong Galactic latitude dependence to FRB detectability with the detection rate being 4 times higher ~45 degrees and higher above the plane; this is where SUPERBx will focus its efforts from now on. SUPERBx uses optimised GPU codes to search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs), making discoveries in real time. Handling our data as it comes in is essential for the SKA Phase I era so this work applies directly to the high-data rates of next generation telescopes. The FRBs discovered (we have already discovered four FRBs in this project) will have much more associated information than all previous detections. Firstly our discovery lag is ~1 second, rather than months/years. The Parkes observations will be shadowed by other radio telescopes (in particular the refurbished Molonglo which has now reached a level of performance where it has independently discovered 3 FRBs in 2016) to allow localisation of the discovered FRBs, and a host of optical and high-energy telescopes will then be triggered as appropriate. This is key for identifying FRB host galaxies, so as to solve the mystery of their progenitors and to exploit their many uses as tools for precision cosmology measurements.

Result: 摘要报告，FRB 可探测性存在强烈的银纬依赖性，在银道面以上约 45 度及更高处探测率高出 4 倍。该项目已发现四个 FRB，其发现延迟约为 1 秒，而非数月/数年，因此将拥有比此前所有探测多得多的关联信息。Molonglo 在 2016 年已独立发现 3 个 FRB。摘要未说明这些结果的显著性、误差或具体数值范围。

Conclusion: 作者认为，将 SUPERBx 的搜寻集中于银道面以上约 45 度及更高处，并配合其他射电望远镜对 Parkes 观测的跟踪定位以及光学和高能望远镜的触发，对于识别 FRB 宿主星系至关重要，从而可解开其前身天体之谜，并利用它们作为精密宇宙学测量工具。根据摘要无法判断该方法对其他脉冲星、磁星或单脉冲研究的具体可迁移性。

Abstract: SUPERBx is an extension to the SUPERB survey which looks at the highest Galactic latitudes in a search for fast radio bursts (FRBs). Our most recent results show that there is a strong Galactic latitude dependence to FRB detectability with the detection rate being 4 times higher ~45 degrees and higher above the plane; this is where SUPERBx will focus its efforts from now on. SUPERBx uses optimised GPU codes to search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs), making discoveries in real time. Handling our data as it comes in is essential for the SKA Phase I era so this work applies directly to the high-data rates of next generation telescopes. The FRBs discovered (we have already discovered four FRBs in this project) will have much more associated information than all previous detections. Firstly our discovery lag is ~1 second, rather than months/years. The Parkes observations will be shadowed by other radio telescopes (in particular the refurbished Molonglo which has now reached a level of performance where it has independently discovered 3 FRBs in 2016) to allow localisation of the discovered FRBs, and a host of optical and high-energy telescopes will then be triggered as appropriate. This is key for identifying FRB host galaxies, so as to solve the mystery of their progenitors and to exploit their many uses as tools for precision cosmology measurements.

</details>


### [535] [Parkes observations for project P892 semester 2016OCTS_BPSR_05]()

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: SUPERBx 是 SUPERB 巡天的扩展，观测最高的银河系纬度以搜寻 FRB；使用优化的 GPU 代码搜寻脉冲星和 FRB，并实时作出发现。观测由 Parkes 进行，并将被其他射电望远镜遮蔽（特别是翻新后的 Molonglo），以便对发现的 FRB 进行定位；随后视情况触发大量光学和高能望远镜。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、观测时间跨度、样本量以及统计分析细节。

### [540] [Parkes observations for project P892 semester 2016OCTS_BPSR_50]()
*Keane, Evan,Possenti, Andrea,Green, James,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,Burke-Spolaor, Sarah,Eatough, Ralph,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Jameson, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Tiburzi, Caterina,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Jankowski, Fabian,Caleb, Manisha,Morello, Vincent,Bhandari, Shivani*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: SUPERBx 是 SUPERB 巡天向最高银纬区域的扩展，用于搜寻 FRB；最新结果显示 FRB 探测率在银道面以上约 45 度及更高处高出 4 倍，该项目已发现四个 FRB，并依托实时 GPU 搜寻与多望远镜协同来实现 FRB 定位和宿主星系证认。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要指出，SUPERBx 旨在观测最高银纬区域以搜寻 FRB；其最新结果显示 FRB 可探测性对银纬有强依赖，在银道面以上约 45 度及更高处探测率高 4 倍。为解决 FRB 前身星之谜并把 FRB 用作精密宇宙学测量工具，需要确认其宿主星系，因此需要定位所发现的 FRB。

Method: 摘要说明 SUPERBx 是 SUPERB 巡天的扩展，在最高银纬区域搜寻 FRB，并使用经过优化的 GPU 代码实时搜寻脉冲星和 FRB；项目利用 Parkes 的观测，并计划由其他射电望远镜（特别是经翻新后的 Molonglo）对所发现的 FRB 进行协同定位，随后视情况触发光学和高能望远镜。观测频率、频段、时间跨度、样本量与统计分析方法：摘要未说明。

Result: 最新结果显示 FRB 可探测性对银纬有很强的依赖，在银道面以上约 45 度及更高处探测率高出 4 倍。该项目已发现四个 FRB，摘要称它们将比以往所有探测拥有多得多的关联信息；发现延迟约为 1 秒，而不是数月/数年。经翻新后的 Molonglo 性能已达在 2016 年独立发现 3 个 FRB 的水平。摘要未给出这些 FRB 的偏振、频谱、脉冲轮廓、DM、RM 等具体测量结果，也未给出统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者据此认为 SUPERBx 将把工作重点放在银道面以上约 45 度及更高区域；在数据到达时即处理对 SKA Phase I 时代以及下一代望远镜的高数据率具有直接适用性。作者期望通过其他射电望远镜协同定位并触发光学和高能望远镜，来确认 FRB 宿主星系，从而解开其前身星之谜，并利用 FRB 作为精密宇宙学测量工具。对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化及磁星—FRB 联系的具体推断，根据摘要无法判断。

SUPERBx uses optimised GPU codes to search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs), making discoveries in real time. Result: 摘要报告，最新结果显示 FRB 可探测性存在强烈的银河系纬度依赖：在银盘面以上约 45 度及更高处，探测率高 4 倍。该项目已发现四个 FRB。发现延迟约为 1 秒，而非数月/数年；所发现的 FRB 将比以往所有探测拥有更多相关信息。摘要还说明 Molonglo 在 2016 年独立发现 3 个 FRB，其性能达到相应水平。摘要未给出这些结果的统计显著性或其他数值。

Conclusion: 摘要陈述的结论是：在最高银河系纬度实时搜寻 FRB 直接适用于 SKA 第一阶段时代及下一代望远镜的高数据率；Parkes 观测与其他射电望远镜跟踪以及光学、高能望远镜触发的结合，对于识别 FRB 宿主星系至关重要，从而解开其 progenitors 之谜，并利用它们作为精密宇宙学测量工具。关于这些结果的物理解释或其对脉冲星、磁星等具体领域的可迁移性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: SUPERBx is an extension to the SUPERB survey which looks at the highest Galactic latitudes in a search for fast radio bursts (FRBs). Our most recent results show that there is a strong Galactic latitude dependence to FRB detectability with the detection rate being 4 times higher ~45 degrees and higher above the plane; this is where SUPERBx will focus its efforts from now on. SUPERBx uses optimised GPU codes to search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs), making discoveries in real time. Handling our data as it comes in is essential for the SKA Phase I era so this work applies directly to the high-data rates of next generation telescopes. The FRBs discovered (we have already discovered four FRBs in this project) will have much more associated information than all previous detections. Firstly our discovery lag is ~1 second, rather than months/years. The Parkes observations will be shadowed by other radio telescopes (in particular the refurbished Molonglo which has now reached a level of performance where it has independently discovered 3 FRBs in 2016) to allow localisation of the discovered FRBs, and a host of optical and high-energy telescopes will then be triggered as appropriate. This is key for identifying FRB host galaxies, so as to solve the mystery of their progenitors and to exploit their many uses as tools for precision cosmology measurements.

</details>

Abstract: SUPERBx is an extension to the SUPERB survey which looks at the highest Galactic latitudes in a search for fast radio bursts (FRBs). Our most recent results show that there is a strong Galactic latitude dependence to FRB detectability with the detection rate being 4 times higher ~45 degrees and higher above the plane; this is where SUPERBx will focus its efforts from now on. SUPERBx uses optimised GPU codes to search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs), making discoveries in real time. Handling our data as it comes in is essential for the SKA Phase I era so this work applies directly to the high-data rates of next generation telescopes. The FRBs discovered (we have already discovered four FRBs in this project) will have much more associated information than all previous detections. Firstly our discovery lag is ~1 second, rather than months/years. The Parkes observations will be shadowed by other radio telescopes (in particular the refurbished Molonglo which has now reached a level of performance where it has independently discovered 3 FRBs in 2016) to allow localisation of the discovered FRBs, and a host of optical and high-energy telescopes will then be triggered as appropriate. This is key for identifying FRB host galaxies, so as to solve the mystery of their progenitors and to exploit their many uses as tools for precision cosmology measurements.

</details>

Result: 摘要报告 FRB 可探测性存在强烈的银纬依赖，在距银道面约 45 度及以上区域探测率高约 4 倍；该项目已发现四个 FRB，这些 FRB 将拥有比此前所有探测多得多的关联信息，发现延迟约为 1 秒而非数月/数年；已翻新的 Molonglo 在 2016 年独立发现了 3 个 FRB。

Conclusion: 作者认为将工作重点放在距银道面约 45 度及以上的高银纬区域，并依靠多望远镜同步观测与后续光学、高能望远镜触发，对于证认 FRB 宿主星系、解开其 progenitor 之谜以及将其用作精密宇宙学测量工具至关重要。根据摘要无法判断该策略对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲发射或磁星—FRB 联系的直接适用性。

Abstract: SUPERBx is an extension to the SUPERB survey which looks at the highest Galactic latitudes in a search for fast radio bursts (FRBs). Our most recent results show that there is a strong Galactic latitude dependence to FRB detectability with the detection rate being 4 times higher ~45 degrees and higher above the plane; this is where SUPERBx will focus its efforts from now on. SUPERBx uses optimised GPU codes to search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs), making discoveries in real time. Handling our data as it comes in is essential for the SKA Phase I era so this work applies directly to the high-data rates of next generation telescopes. The FRBs discovered (we have already discovered four FRBs in this project) will have much more associated information than all previous detections. Firstly our discovery lag is ~1 second, rather than months/years. The Parkes observations will be shadowed by other radio telescopes (in particular the refurbished Molonglo which has now reached a level of performance where it has independently discovered 3 FRBs in 2016) to allow localisation of the discovered FRBs, and a host of optical and high-energy telescopes will then be triggered as appropriate. This is key for identifying FRB host galaxies, so as to solve the mystery of their progenitors and to exploit their many uses as tools for precision cosmology measurements.

</details>

*Keane, Evan,Possenti, Andrea,Green, James,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,Burke-Spolaor, Sarah,Eatough, Ralph,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Jameson, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Tiburzi, Caterina,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Jankowski, Fabian,Caleb, Manisha,Morello, Vincent,Bhandari, Shivani*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: SUPERBx 扩展巡天在最高银纬处搜寻 FRB，最新结果显示银道面以上约 45 度及更高处的 FRB 探测率高出 4 倍；该项目已发现四个 FRB，发现延迟约 1 秒，并将通过其他射电望远镜跟踪定位，以识别宿主星系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要在最高银河系纬度搜索快速射电暴（FRB）；最新结果显示 FRB 可探测性强烈依赖银河系纬度，在银道面以上约 45 度及更高处探测率高出 4 倍，因此 SUPERBx 今后集中于此；同时需处理实时数据流以满足 SKA 第一阶段时代的高数据率，并识别 FRB 宿主星系以解开其 progenitor 之谜。

Method: SUPERBx 在最高银河系纬度上巡天，使用优化的 GPU 代码搜寻脉冲星和快速射电暴（FRB）并实时发现；以约 1 秒的发现延迟处理到达的数据；Parkes 的观测将被其他射电望远镜（特别是经过翻新的 Molonglo）跟踪以定位所发现的 FRB，并酌情触发光学和高能望远镜。摘要未说明观测频率或频段、时间跨度及具体样本大小。

Result: 最新结果显示 FRB 可探测性存在强烈的银河系纬度依赖：在银道面以上约 45 度及更高处，探测率高出 4 倍。该项目已发现四个 FRB，其发现延迟约为 1 秒，而非数月/数年；这些 FRB 将比以往所有探测拥有更多关联信息。经过翻新的 Molonglo 已达到一定性能水平，并于 2016 年独立发现 3 个 FRB。摘要未说明所发现 FRB 的具体性质及统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，SUPERBx 集中于银道面以上约 45 度及更高处，并以实时 GPU 搜寻和约 1 秒的发现延迟处理数据，直接适用于 SKA 第一阶段时代下一代望远镜的高数据率。通过 Parkes 与其他射电望远镜（特别是 Molonglo）的跟踪定位以及光学和高能望远镜的触发，对于识别 FRB 宿主星系至关重要，从而解开其 progenitor 之谜，并利用它们作为精密宇宙学测量工具的诸多用途。根据摘要无法判断这些结论对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲发射或脉冲轮廓演化的具体适用性。

Abstract: SUPERBx is an extension to the SUPERB survey which looks at the highest Galactic latitudes in a search for fast radio bursts (FRBs). Our most recent results show that there is a strong Galactic latitude dependence to FRB detectability with the detection rate being 4 times higher ~45 degrees and higher above the plane; this is where SUPERBx will focus its efforts from now on. SUPERBx uses optimised GPU codes to search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs), making discoveries in real time. Handling our data as it comes in is essential for the SKA Phase I era so this work applies directly to the high-data rates of next generation telescopes. The FRBs discovered (we have already discovered four FRBs in this project) will have much more associated information than all previous detections. Firstly our discovery lag is ~1 second, rather than months/years. The Parkes observations will be shadowed by other radio telescopes (in particular the refurbished Molonglo which has now reached a level of performance where it has independently discovered 3 FRBs in 2016) to allow localisation of the discovered FRBs, and a host of optical and high-energy telescopes will then be triggered as appropriate. This is key for identifying FRB host galaxies, so as to solve the mystery of their progenitors and to exploit their many uses as tools for precision cosmology measurements.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者明确指出，在数据到达时即处理对 SKA 第一阶段时代的重要性，使这项工作直接适用于下一代望远镜的高数据率。通过其他射电望远镜对 Parkes 观测进行覆盖以实现 FRB 定位，并视情况触发光学和高能望远镜，对于证认 FRB 宿主星系至关重要，从而解开其 progenitor 之谜，并利用其作为精密宇宙学测量工具的诸多用途。根据摘要无法判断该工作对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振或射电频谱研究的具体物理意义。

Abstract: SUPERBx is an extension to the SUPERB survey which looks at the highest Galactic latitudes in a search for fast radio bursts (FRBs). Our most recent results show that there is a strong Galactic latitude dependence to FRB detectability with the detection rate being 4 times higher ~45 degrees and higher above the plane; this is where SUPERBx will focus its efforts from now on. SUPERBx uses optimised GPU codes to search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs), making discoveries in real time. Handling our data as it comes in is essential for the SKA Phase I era so this work applies directly to the high-data rates of next generation telescopes. The FRBs discovered (we have already discovered four FRBs in this project) will have much more associated information than all previous detections. Firstly our discovery lag is ~1 second, rather than months/years. The Parkes observations will be shadowed by other radio telescopes (in particular the refurbished Molonglo which has now reached a level of performance where it has independently discovered 3 FRBs in 2016) to allow localisation of the discovered FRBs, and a host of optical and high-energy telescopes will then be triggered as appropriate. This is key for identifying FRB host galaxies, so as to solve the mystery of their progenitors and to exploit their many uses as tools for precision cosmology measurements.

</details>

The Parkes observations will be shadowed by other radio telescopes (in particular the refurbished Molonglo which has now reached a level of performance where it has independently discovered 3 FRBs in 2016) to allow localisation of the discovered FRBs, and a host of optical and high-energy telescopes will then be triggered as appropriate. This is key for identifying FRB host galaxies, so as to solve the mystery of their progenitors and to exploit their many uses as tools for precision cosmology measurements.

### [573] [Parkes observations for project P892 semester 2016OCTS_BPSR_20]()

Conclusion: 作者认为，在数据到达时即进行处理对于 SKA Phase I 时代至关重要，因此这项工作直接适用于下一代望远镜的高数据率。摘要指出，对其他射电望远镜对 Parkes 发现 FRB 的协同定位观测，以及随后视情况触发的光学和高能望远镜，对于证认 FRB 宿主星系十分关键，从而解开其 progenitor 之谜，并利用它们作为精密宇宙学测量工具的诸多用途。摘要未给出具体的宿主星系或 progenitor 证认结果。

Abstract: SUPERBx is an extension to the SUPERB survey which looks at the highest Galactic latitudes in a search for fast radio bursts (FRBs). Our most recent results show that there is a strong Galactic latitude dependence to FRB detectability with the detection rate being 4 times higher ~45 degrees and higher above the plane; this is where SUPERBx will focus its efforts from now on. SUPERBx uses optimised GPU codes to search for pulsars and fast radio bursts (FRBs), making discoveries in real time. Handling our data as it comes in is essential for the SKA Phase I era so this work applies directly to the high-data rates of next generation telescopes. The FRBs discovered (we have already discovered four FRBs in this project) will have much more associated information than all previous detections. Firstly our discovery lag is ~1 second, rather than months/years. The Parkes observations will be shadowed by other radio telescopes (in particular the refurbished Molonglo which has now reached a level of performance where it has independently discovered 3 FRBs in 2016) to allow localisation of the discovered FRBs, and a host of optical and high-energy telescopes will then be triggered as appropriate. Method: 摘要说明将使用 Parkes 射电望远镜与 EP 卫星开展联合观测活动，对五颗已知射电发射的磁星进行同步监测，并另外对十颗磁星提出机会目标（ToO）观测。若 Insight-HXMT 在 24 小时内探测到这些源中任一源的三次爆发，将以 EP、Insight-HXMT 和 Parkes 触发快速响应后续观测。观测频段、时间跨度、数据量及具体分析技术摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要为观测提案，未给出实际观测结果。其明确提出的目标包括：在同步观测下研究射电发射与 X 射线发射之间的相关性，分析脉冲轮廓与通量密度的演化，并搜寻可能与磁星活动相关的 FRB；在触发条件下，探究爆发前后的物理过程，并搜寻额外的射电发射与可能的 FRB 对应体。摘要未报告任何数值、显著性、事件或探测结果。

Conclusion: 摘要表述的是拟通过 Parkes、EP 与 Insight-HXMT 的同步及快速响应观测来研究磁星射电与 X 射线发射的相关性、脉冲轮廓和通量密度演化，并搜寻与磁星活动相关的可能 FRB 对应体；这些属于拟议目标而非已经确立的结论。根据摘要无法判断具体物理机制或可转移性。

Abstract: We propose a joint observing campaign using the Parkes radio telescope and the EP satellite to monitor five magnetars with known radio emission. Under simultaneous observations, we aim to investigate the correlation between their radio and X-ray emissions, analyze the evolution of pulse profiles and flux densities, and search for potential fast radio bursts (FRBs) associated with magnetar activity. In addition, we propose target-of-opportunity (ToO) observations for ten magnetars. If the Insight-HXMT satellite detects three outbursts from any of these sources within a 24-hour period, a rapid-response follow-up will be triggered with EP, Insight-HXMT, and Parkes to probe the physical processes before and after the outbursts and to search for additional radio emission and possible FRB counterparts.

</details>

### [591] [Neutron star masses from electron-capture supernovae under equation-of-state uncertainties]()
*Parmar, Vishal,Scordino, Domenico,Bombaci, Ignazio*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 在无重子质量损失的基准情形下，电子俘获超新星（ECSNe）产生的遗骸中子星引力质量为1.24 - 1.265 M<SUB>⊙</SUB>，EOS引起的弥散很小；要解释PSR J0453+1559的1.174 M<SUB>⊙</SUB>伴星则需接近0.10 M<SUB>⊙</SUB>的极端质量损失，而当前模拟不支持这一点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电子俘获超新星（ECSNe）被认为是形成低质量中子星的一条有前景的通道，但其产生的中子星最小引力质量既取决于前身星核心结构，也取决于中子星物质状态方程（EOS），这一质量下限及EOS不确定性的影响尚需厘清。

Method: 计算具有代表性组分的冷白矮星型O--Ne--Mg核心的电子俘获阈值引力质量，并将相应的阈值重子数映射到由统一壳--核EOS的贝叶斯集合构建的冷中子星位形上；同时考察从EC阈值质量核心到遗骸中子星转变过程中不同重子质量损失情形的影响。摘要未说明具体的观测数据、望远镜或频段。

Result: EC阈值密度对O--Ne--Mg混合物浓度敏感，但O--Ne--Mg核心的阈值重子数仅微弱变化，形成狭窄的遗骸质量窗口。无重子质量损失的基准情形下，标准ECSNe产生的遗骸中子星引力质量为1.24 - 1.265 M<SUB>⊙</SUB>，EOS引起的弥散很小；0.01 - 0.02 M<SUB>⊙</SUB>的小重子质量损失使该范围适度下移；而PSR J0453+1559的1.174 M<SUB>⊙</SUB>伴星需要接近0.10 M<SUB>⊙</SUB>的极端质量损失，当前ECSN模拟并不支持。遗骸质量的残余EOS依赖性主要受核饱和密度附近压强控制，相应潮汐形变能力仍对遗骸半径和致密性敏感。

Conclusion: ECSNe自然地形成低质量中子星，但限于一个受限的质量范围内；最轻的已观测中子星很可能需要低质量铁核坍缩、超剥离超新星或其他非标准通道。低质量双中子星系统原则上可将类ECSN形成通道与引力波对EOS的限制联系起来。根据摘要无法判断该质量窗口与脉冲星单脉冲、模式转换或快速射电暴（FRB）之间的具体联系。

Abstract: Electron-capture supernovae (ECSNe) are a promising formation channel for low-mass neutron stars, but the minimum gravitational mass of the neutron stars they produce depends on both the progenitor core structure and the neutron-star matter equation of state (EOS). In this work, we compute the electron-capture (EC) threshold gravitational mass (<inline-formula> M<SUB>WD</SUB><SUP>★</SUP> <mml:math> <mml:msubsup> <mml:mi>M</mml:mi> <mml:mi>WD</mml:mi> <mml:mo>★</mml:mo> </mml:msubsup> </mml:math> </inline-formula>) of cold white-dwarf-like O--Ne--Mg cores with representative compositions and map the corresponding baryon number onto cold neutron-star configurations constructed from a Bayesian ensemble of unified crust--core EOSs. Although the EC threshold density is sensitive to the concentrations of the O--Ne--Mg mixture, the threshold baryon number of the O--Ne--Mg core varies only weakly, producing a narrow remnant-mass window. In the baseline case with no baryonic mass loss during the transition from the EC threshold mass O--Ne--Mg core to the remnant neutron star, standard ECSNe yield remnant neutron stars with gravitational masses of 1.24 - 1.265 M<SUB>⊙</SUB>, with only a small EOS-induced spread. Small baryonic mass losses of 0.01 - 0.02 M<SUB>⊙</SUB> shift this range modestly downward, but the 1.174 M<SUB>⊙</SUB> companion of PSR J0453+1559 would require an extreme mass loss close to 0.10 M<SUB>⊙</SUB>, which is not favored by current ECSN simulations. We further find that the residual EOS dependence of the remnant mass is controlled mainly by the pressure around nuclear saturation density, while the corresponding tidal deformability remains sensitive to the remnant radius and compactness. Thus, low-mass double neutron star systems can in principle connect ECSN-like formation channels with gravitational-wave constraints on the EOS. Our results show that ECSNe naturally form low-mass neutron stars, but within a restricted mass range; the lightest observed neutron stars likely require low-mass iron-core collapse, ultra-stripped supernovae, or other nonstandard channels.

</details>

Result: 摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 摘要提出，探测到 FRB 和脉冲星将使研究者能够测量环星系介质对 FRB 色散的贡献，以及这些矮星系中的暗物质晕。该结论为提议性展望，实际结果尚待探测；是否可推广至其他脉冲星、磁星或 FRB 群体，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast Radio Bursts(FRBs) are often proposed as useful cosmological probes, however much work is needed to better understand the foreground environment that it propgates through, such as the Galactic ISM and Milky Way Halo. We propose to observe three satellite dwarf spheroidal galaxies of the Milky Way to search for FRBs and pulsars. We plan to take advantage of the new CryoPAF's wide field of view to survey high stellar density dwarf satellite galaxies with substantial angular sizes: Fornax, Sculptor and Sagittarius II. Detections of FRBs and pulsars will allow us to measure the Circumgalactic Medium contribution to FRB dispersion and also the dark matter halos of these dwarf galaxies.

</details>

We plan to take advantage of the new CryoPAF's wide field of view to survey high stellar density dwarf satellite galaxies with substantial angular sizes: Fornax, Sculptor and Sagittarius II. ### [616] [Parkes observations for project P1171 semester 2023APRS_01]()
*Eppel, Florian,James, Clancy,Kadler, Matthias,Wilms, Joern,Shannon, Ryan,Spitler, Laura,Rau, Arne,Niu, Chenhui,Krumpe, Mirko,Bahic, Sabina,Cruces, Marylin*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟利用 Parkes/Murriyang 射电望远镜与 XMM-Newton 的遮蔽观测，在与 X 射线卫星同时覆盖的视场内搜寻新的快速射电暴（FRB），并以邻近（低 z）星系为靶目标，以增加探测到可能相伴 X 射线辐射的机会。摘要报告的是拟议观测方案，尚未给出探测结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 起源仍不清楚且理论模型众多；若干模型预言存在相伴多波段辐射，但此前对 FRB 的光学、X 射线或伽马射线对应体的搜寻均未导致任何探测。银河系磁星 SGR 1935+2154A 被观测到同时发出类 FRB 爆发和 X 射线耀发，这提示河外 FRB 源也可能呈现 X 射线对应体。由于 X 射线卫星成本高、视场小而使 FRB 探测概率相对较低，协调射电与 X 射线观测在后勤上极难安排，因此需要新的观测策略。

Method: 摘要提出使用 X 射线卫星 XMM-Newton 与 Parkes/Murriyang 射电望远镜开展遮蔽（shadowing）观测，用 Parkes 望远镜在与 XMM-Newton 同时覆盖的视场内搜寻新的 FRB，并针对邻近（低 z）星系进行常规 XMM 观测。摘要未说明观测频率或波段、观测时间跨度、样本大小、灵敏度以及具体分析流程。

Result: 摘要未报告任何新的探测结果或测量数值。摘要陈述的背景结果是：此前对 FRB 的光学、X 射线或伽马射线对应体的搜寻均未导致任何探测；银河系磁星 SGR 1935+2154A 已被观测到同时发出类 FRB 爆发和 X 射线耀发。对于拟议观测，摘要仅说明其目标是搜寻新的 FRB 并增加探测到可能相伴 X 射线辐射的机会。

Conclusion: 作者提出的思路是，若在射电波段探测到 FRB，遮蔽观测将保证同时的 X 射线覆盖，并可获得有关相伴 X 射线谱和光变曲线的详细信息，因为所有 XMM-Newton 数据将在观测一年后公开；目标是对 FRB 起源的理论模型施加限制。摘要表明 SGR 1935+2154A 同时发出类 FRB 爆发和 X 射线耀发，暗示河外 FRB 源也可能呈现 X 射线对应体。该方案对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振或射电频谱的适用性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The origin of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) is still unclear with a plethora of theoretical models for their origin. Several models predict associated multi-wavelength emission, but previous searches for optical, X-ray or gamma-ray counterparts of FRBs have not led to any detection. The Galactic magnetar SGR 1935+2154A has been observed to simultaneously emit FRB-like bursts and X-ray flares, which suggests that also extragalactic FRB sources may exhibit X-ray counterparts. Because of the high cost of X-ray satellites and in face of the relatively low FRB detection probability in their small field of view, coordinated radio and X-ray observations are logistically very difficult to set up. We propose a new approach using the X-ray satellite XMM-Newton and the Parkes/Murriyang radio telescope to put constraints on the theoretical models: We aim to conduct shadowing observations with the Parkes telescope to search for new FRBs in fields that are simultaneously covered by XMM-Newton. We hereby target regular XMM observations of nearby (low-z) galaxies, to increase our detection chances of possibly associated X-ray emission. In case of an FRB detection in the radio band, we will have guaranteed simultaneous X-ray coverage and will get detailed information about the associated X-ray spectrum and light curve since all XMM-Newton data will become public a year after the observation.

</details>

*Eppel, Florian,James, Clancy,Kadler, Matthias,Wilms, Joern,Shannon, Ryan,Spitler, Laura,Rau, Arne,Niu, Chenhui,Krumpe, Mirko,Bahic, Sabina,Cruces, Marylin*

Conclusion: 作者期望通过该方法对理论模型施加限制：若在射电波段探测到 FRB，将拥有有保证的同时 X 射线覆盖，并获得相关 X 射线谱和光变曲线的详细信息，因为所有 XMM-Newton 数据将在观测一年后公开。该方案是否能实际限制 FRB 起源模型，根据摘要无法判断。

Several models predict associated multi-wavelength emission, but previous searches for optical, X-ray or gamma-ray counterparts of FRBs have not led to any detection. The Galactic magnetar SGR 1935+2154A has been observed to simultaneously emit FRB-like bursts and X-ray flares, which suggests that also extragalactic FRB sources may exhibit X-ray counterparts. We hereby target regular XMM observations of nearby (low-z) galaxies, to increase our detection chances of possibly associated X-ray emission. In case of an FRB detection in the radio band, we will have guaranteed simultaneous X-ray coverage and will get detailed information about the associated X-ray spectrum and light curve since all XMM-Newton data will become public a year after the observation.

</details>

### [620] [Parkes observations for project P1171 semester 2023APRS_18]()
*Eppel, Florian,James, Clancy,Kadler, Matthias,Wilms, Joern,Shannon, Ryan,Spitler, Laura,Rau, Arne,Niu, Chenhui,Krumpe, Mirko,Bahic, Sabina,Cruces, Marylin*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划用 Parkes/Murriyang 望远镜对同时被 XMM-Newton 覆盖的天区开展遮蔽观测，在邻近（低 z）星系方向搜寻新的 FRB，以便在探测到 FRB 时获得有保证的同时 X 射线覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 起源仍不清楚且存在大量理论模型，若干模型预言伴随多波段辐射，但此前对 FRB 的光学、X 射线或伽马射线对应体搜寻均未探测到。银河系磁星 SGR 1935+2154A 同时发射类 FRB 爆发与 X 射线耀发，提示河外 FRB 源也可能有 X 射线对应体；然而 X 射线卫星成本高、视场小、FRB 探测概率相对较低，使协调射电与 X 射线观测在后勤上极难安排。

Method: 摘要未说明观测频段、时间跨度、样本量和具体分析流程。所描述的方案是：使用 X 射线卫星 XMM-Newton 与 Parkes/Murriyang 射电望远镜，由 Parkes 望远镜开展遮蔽（shadowing）观测，在同时被 XMM-Newton 覆盖的天区中搜寻新的 FRB，并针对对邻近（低 z）星系的常规 XMM 观测；若射电波段探测到 FRB，则利用同时的 X 射线覆盖研究相关的 X 射线谱和光变曲线，所有 XMM-Newton 数据将在观测一年后公开。

Result: 摘要未说明具体的探测结果或数值。摘要报告的是既往情况：此前对 FRB 的光学、X 射线或伽马射线对应体搜寻均未导致任何探测；银河系磁星 SGR 1935+2154A 已被观测到同时发射类 FRB 爆发和 X 射线耀发。本工作提出的是拟开展的观测方案，尚无探测结果或统计显著性可报告。

Conclusion: 作者提出，通过 Parkes 望远镜在同时被 XMM-Newton 覆盖的天区中开展遮蔽观测并在邻近（低 z）星系方向搜寻 FRB，可在探测到 FRB 时获得有保证的同时 X 射线覆盖，从而对相关理论模型施加限制，并获得相关 X 射线谱与光变曲线的详细信息。摘要所述磁星 SGR 1935+2154A 同时发射类 FRB 爆发与 X 射线耀发，提示河外 FRB 源也可能呈现 X 射线对应体；但该方案能否实际限制理论模型，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The origin of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) is still unclear with a plethora of theoretical models for their origin. Several models predict associated multi-wavelength emission, but previous searches for optical, X-ray or gamma-ray counterparts of FRBs have not led to any detection. The Galactic magnetar SGR 1935+2154A has been observed to simultaneously emit FRB-like bursts and X-ray flares, which suggests that also extragalactic FRB sources may exhibit X-ray counterparts. Because of the high cost of X-ray satellites and in face of the relatively low FRB detection probability in their small field of view, coordinated radio and X-ray observations are logistically very difficult to set up. We propose a new approach using the X-ray satellite XMM-Newton and the Parkes/Murriyang radio telescope to put constraints on the theoretical models: We aim to conduct shadowing observations with the Parkes telescope to search for new FRBs in fields that are simultaneously covered by XMM-Newton. We hereby target regular XMM observations of nearby (low-z) galaxies, to increase our detection chances of possibly associated X-ray emission. In case of an FRB detection in the radio band, we will have guaranteed simultaneous X-ray coverage and will get detailed information about the associated X-ray spectrum and light curve since all XMM-Newton data will become public a year after the observation.

Method: 提出使用 XMM-Newton 与 Parkes/Murriyang 射电望远镜开展影子观测：用 Parkes 望远镜在同时被 XMM-Newton 覆盖的视场中搜寻新 FRB，并针对附近（low-z）星系进行常规 XMM 观测以提高探测可能相关 X 射线辐射的机会。摘要未说明具体观测频率、观测时长、样本规模或数据分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告的是拟议观测方案而非已完成的探测结果：此前对 FRB 的光学、X 射线或伽马射线对应体搜寻未导致任何探测；银河系磁星 SGR 1935+2154A 已被观测到同时发出类似 FRB 的暴发和 X 射线耀发。若在射电波段探测到 FRB，将获得有保证的同时 X 射线覆盖，并因 XMM-Newton 数据在观测一年后公开而获得相关 X 射线谱和光变曲线的详细信息。摘要未说明任何新探测结果或数值。

Conclusion: 作者提出的方案旨在通过 Parkes 影子观测与 XMM-Newton 覆盖相结合，对 FRB 起源的理论模型施加限制，并提高发现可能与 FRB 相关的 X 射线辐射的机会。摘要未说明该方案已取得观测结果；其对磁星—FRB 联系的支持仅体现在 SGR 1935+2154A 同时发出类似 FRB 暴发与 X 射线耀发这一已观测事实上，方案本身的物理结论根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The origin of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) is still unclear with a plethora of theoretical models for their origin. Several models predict associated multi-wavelength emission, but previous searches for optical, X-ray or gamma-ray counterparts of FRBs have not led to any detection. The Galactic magnetar SGR 1935+2154A has been observed to simultaneously emit FRB-like bursts and X-ray flares, which suggests that also extragalactic FRB sources may exhibit X-ray counterparts. Because of the high cost of X-ray satellites and in face of the relatively low FRB detection probability in their small field of view, coordinated radio and X-ray observations are logistically very difficult to set up. We propose a new approach using the X-ray satellite XMM-Newton and the Parkes/Murriyang radio telescope to put constraints on the theoretical models: We aim to conduct shadowing observations with the Parkes telescope to search for new FRBs in fields that are simultaneously covered by XMM-Newton. We hereby target regular XMM observations of nearby (low-z) galaxies, to increase our detection chances of possibly associated X-ray emission. In case of an FRB detection in the radio band, we will have guaranteed simultaneous X-ray coverage and will get detailed information about the associated X-ray spectrum and light curve since all XMM-Newton data will become public a year after the observation.

</details>

Result: 这是一项观测提案，摘要未说明实际探测结果。摘要报告的背景性事实是：SGR 1935+2154A 已被观测到同时发射类 FRB 暴发和 X 射线耀发；此前对 FRB 的光学、X 射线或伽马射线对应体搜寻均未导致任何探测。摘要未给出任何新的 FRB 探测、X 射线对应体探测、通量、显著性或其他测量数值。

Conclusion: 作者提出的方案旨在通过对 XMM-Newton 覆盖视场的 Parkes 遮蔽观测，在探测到 FRB 时获得有保证的同时 X 射线覆盖并获取伴随 X 射线谱与光变曲线信息，从而对 FRB 起源的理论模型施加约束。SGR 1935+2154A 同时发射类 FRB 暴发与 X 射线耀发这一事实被作者用于支持河外 FRB 源也可能呈现 X 射线对应体的推测。该方案是否可行及能否实际约束模型，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The origin of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) is still unclear with a plethora of theoretical models for their origin. Several models predict associated multi-wavelength emission, but previous searches for optical, X-ray or gamma-ray counterparts of FRBs have not led to any detection. The Galactic magnetar SGR 1935+2154A has been observed to simultaneously emit FRB-like bursts and X-ray flares, which suggests that also extragalactic FRB sources may exhibit X-ray counterparts. Because of the high cost of X-ray satellites and in face of the relatively low FRB detection probability in their small field of view, coordinated radio and X-ray observations are logistically very difficult to set up. We propose a new approach using the X-ray satellite XMM-Newton and the Parkes/Murriyang radio telescope to put constraints on the theoretical models: We aim to conduct shadowing observations with the Parkes telescope to search for new FRBs in fields that are simultaneously covered by XMM-Newton. We hereby target regular XMM observations of nearby (low-z) galaxies, to increase our detection chances of possibly associated X-ray emission. In case of an FRB detection in the radio band, we will have guaranteed simultaneous X-ray coverage and will get detailed information about the associated X-ray spectrum and light curve since all XMM-Newton data will become public a year after the observation.

</details>

The Galactic magnetar SGR 1935+2154A has been observed to simultaneously emit FRB-like bursts and X-ray flares, which suggests that also extragalactic FRB sources may exhibit X-ray counterparts. Because of the high cost of X-ray satellites and in face of the relatively low FRB detection probability in their small field of view, coordinated radio and X-ray observations are logistically very difficult to set up. We propose a new approach using the X-ray satellite XMM-Newton and the Parkes/Murriyang radio telescope to put constraints on the theoretical models: We aim to conduct shadowing observations with the Parkes telescope to search for new FRBs in fields that are simultaneously covered by XMM-Newton. We hereby target regular XMM observations of nearby (low-z) galaxies, to increase our detection chances of possibly associated X-ray emission. In case of an FRB detection in the radio band, we will have guaranteed simultaneous X-ray coverage and will get detailed information about the associated X-ray spectrum and light curve since all XMM-Newton data will become public a year after the observation.

</details>

Motivation: FRB 起源仍不清楚，已有大量理论模型；若干模型预言伴随的多波段辐射，但此前对光学、X 射线或伽马射线对应体的搜寻均未探测到。银河系磁星 SGR 1935+2154A 同时发出类 FRB 爆发与 X 射线耀发，暗示河外 FRB 源也可能有 X 射线对应体。由于 X 射线卫星成本高、视场小、FRB 探测概率相对低，协调射电与 X 射线观测在组织上极为困难。

Method: 摘要说明：使用 X 射线卫星 XMM-Newton 与 Parkes/Murriyang 射电望远镜；以 Parkes 望远镜开展遮蔽（shadowing）观测，在同时被 XMM-Newton 覆盖的视场中搜寻新的 FRB；针对邻近（低 z）星系开展常规 XMM 观测；若射电探测到 FRB，则具备有保证的同时 X 射线覆盖，XMM-Newton 数据将在观测一年后公开。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度、样本量或分析算法。

Result: 摘要说明：此前对 FRB 的光学、X 射线或伽马射线对应体搜寻均未导致任何探测；银河系磁星 SGR 1935+2154A 已被观测到同时发出类 FRB 爆发和 X 射线耀发。本提案为观测计划，摘要中未报告新的探测结果、事件、数值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者提出通过射电与 X 射线同时覆盖的观测策略对 FRB 起源的理论模型施加限制：一旦在射电波段探测到 FRB，便可获得同时 X 射线覆盖，并因 XMM-Newton 数据一年后公开而获得相关 X 射线谱和光变曲线的详细信息。对脉冲星、磁星单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振或射电频谱等具体议题的适用性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The origin of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) is still unclear with a plethora of theoretical models for their origin. Several models predict associated multi-wavelength emission, but previous searches for optical, X-ray or gamma-ray counterparts of FRBs have not led to any detection. The Galactic magnetar SGR 1935+2154A has been observed to simultaneously emit FRB-like bursts and X-ray flares, which suggests that also extragalactic FRB sources may exhibit X-ray counterparts. Because of the high cost of X-ray satellites and in face of the relatively low FRB detection probability in their small field of view, coordinated radio and X-ray observations are logistically very difficult to set up. We propose a new approach using the X-ray satellite XMM-Newton and the Parkes/Murriyang radio telescope to put constraints on the theoretical models: We aim to conduct shadowing observations with the Parkes telescope to search for new FRBs in fields that are simultaneously covered by XMM-Newton. We hereby target regular XMM observations of nearby (low-z) galaxies, to increase our detection chances of possibly associated X-ray emission. In case of an FRB detection in the radio band, we will have guaranteed simultaneous X-ray coverage and will get detailed information about the associated X-ray spectrum and light curve since all XMM-Newton data will become public a year after the observation.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者提出的新方法旨在对 FRB 起源的理论模型施加约束：若在射电波段探测到 FRB，将拥有有保证的同时 X 射线覆盖，并可获得有关相关联 X 射线谱和光变曲线的详细信息，因为所有 XMM-Newton 数据将在观测一年后公开。该方案针对邻近（低 z）星系的常规 XMM 观测以提高探测到可能相关联 X 射线辐射的机会。至于该方法能否实际约束具体 FRB 物理机制，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The origin of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) is still unclear with a plethora of theoretical models for their origin. Several models predict associated multi-wavelength emission, but previous searches for optical, X-ray or gamma-ray counterparts of FRBs have not led to any detection. The Galactic magnetar SGR 1935+2154A has been observed to simultaneously emit FRB-like bursts and X-ray flares, which suggests that also extragalactic FRB sources may exhibit X-ray counterparts. Because of the high cost of X-ray satellites and in face of the relatively low FRB detection probability in their small field of view, coordinated radio and X-ray observations are logistically very difficult to set up. We propose a new approach using the X-ray satellite XMM-Newton and the Parkes/Murriyang radio telescope to put constraints on the theoretical models: We aim to conduct shadowing observations with the Parkes telescope to search for new FRBs in fields that are simultaneously covered by XMM-Newton. We hereby target regular XMM observations of nearby (low-z) galaxies, to increase our detection chances of possibly associated X-ray emission. In case of an FRB detection in the radio band, we will have guaranteed simultaneous X-ray coverage and will get detailed information about the associated X-ray spectrum and light curve since all XMM-Newton data will become public a year after the observation.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者提出以 Parkes/Murriyang 与 XMM-Newton 协调的 shadowing 观测对 FRB 起源理论模型施加约束，并认为靶向邻近（low-z）星系的常规 XMM 观测可提高探测到可能相关 X 射线辐射的机会；若探测到射电 FRB，将获得有保证的同步 X 射线覆盖及能谱和光变曲线信息。摘要未报告已实现的探测或已得出的物理结论。该方法对单脉冲搜寻或磁星—FRB 联系的适用性属于可能的方法学相关性，并非本文已确立的结果；根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The origin of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) is still unclear with a plethora of theoretical models for their origin. Several models predict associated multi-wavelength emission, but previous searches for optical, X-ray or gamma-ray counterparts of FRBs have not led to any detection. The Galactic magnetar SGR 1935+2154A has been observed to simultaneously emit FRB-like bursts and X-ray flares, which suggests that also extragalactic FRB sources may exhibit X-ray counterparts. Because of the high cost of X-ray satellites and in face of the relatively low FRB detection probability in their small field of view, coordinated radio and X-ray observations are logistically very difficult to set up. We propose a new approach using the X-ray satellite XMM-Newton and the Parkes/Murriyang radio telescope to put constraints on the theoretical models: We aim to conduct shadowing observations with the Parkes telescope to search for new FRBs in fields that are simultaneously covered by XMM-Newton. We hereby target regular XMM observations of nearby (low-z) galaxies, to increase our detection chances of possibly associated X-ray emission. In case of an FRB detection in the radio band, we will have guaranteed simultaneous X-ray coverage and will get detailed information about the associated X-ray spectrum and light curve since all XMM-Newton data will become public a year after the observation.

</details>

Because of the high cost of X-ray satellites and in face of the relatively low FRB detection probability in their small field of view, coordinated radio and X-ray observations are logistically very difficult to set up. We propose a new approach using the X-ray satellite XMM-Newton and the Parkes/Murriyang radio telescope to put constraints on the theoretical models: We aim to conduct shadowing observations with the Parkes telescope to search for new FRBs in fields that are simultaneously covered by XMM-Newton. We hereby target regular XMM observations of nearby (low-z) galaxies, to increase our detection chances of possibly associated X-ray emission. In case of an FRB detection in the radio band, we will have guaranteed simultaneous X-ray coverage and will get detailed information about the associated X-ray spectrum and light curve since all XMM-Newton data will become public a year after the observation.

</details>


### [657] [Parkes observations for project P1171 semester 2024APRS_02]()
*Eppel, Florian,James, Clancy,Kadler, Matthias,Wilms, Joern,Shannon, Ryan,Spitler, Laura,Rau, Arne,Krumpe, Mirko,Bahic, Sabina,Cruces, Marylin,Uttarkar, Pavan,Niu, Chenhui,Jankowski, Fabian*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案提出利用 XMM-Newton 与 Parkes/Murriyang 开展射电与 X 射线影子协同观测，在同时被 XMM-Newton 覆盖的天区中搜寻新的 FRB，以期在探测到 FRB 时获得同时的 X 射线覆盖，从而对 FRB 起源的理论模型施加限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 起源仍不清楚，存在大量理论模型，其中若干模型预言相伴的多波段辐射；但此前对 FRB 的光学、X 射线或伽马射线对应体的搜寻均未探测到。银河系磁星 SGR 1935+2154A 同时发射类 FRB 爆发与 X 射线耀发，提示河外 FRB 源也可能有 X 射线对应体。然而 X 射线卫星成本高、视场小、FRB 探测概率低，使协调射电与 X 射线观测在后勤上极难安排。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测时间、时长与频率。文中说明所提方法使用 X 射线卫星 XMM-Newton 与 Parkes/Murriyang 射电望远镜，在 Parkes 望远镜上开展影子观测，在同时被 XMM-Newton 覆盖的天区中搜寻新的 FRB；并针对邻近（low-z）星系的常规 XMM 观测，以提高探测可能相伴 X 射线辐射的机会。

Result: 摘要未说明已获得的探测结果；其表述为拟议观测：目标是在被 XMM-Newton 同时覆盖的天区中搜寻新的 FRB。摘要提到，此前对 FRB 的光学、X 射线或伽马射线对应体的搜寻均未导致任何探测，且 SGR 1935+2154A 已被观测到同时发射类 FRB 爆发和 X 射线耀发。摘要还说明，若在射电波段探测到 FRB，将有保证的同时 X 射线覆盖，并可获得相伴 X 射线谱与光变曲线的详细信息，因为所有 XMM-Newton 数据将在观测一年后公开。

Conclusion: 作者提出以 XMM-Newton 与 Parkes/Murriyang 的影子协同观测，在同时被 XMM-Newton 覆盖的天区搜寻 FRB，以对 FRB 起源的理论模型施加限制；选择邻近（low-z）星系的常规 XMM 观测是为提高探测可能相伴 X 射线辐射的机会。文中指出，一旦射电波段探测到 FRB，即可获得同时的 X 射线覆盖，并因 XMM-Newton 数据在观测一年后公开而得到相伴 X 射线谱与光变曲线的详细信息。根据摘要无法判断该方案对脉冲星、单脉冲、模式转换、计时或自转减慢力矩变化的可迁移性。

Abstract: The origin of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) is still unclear with a plethora of theoretical models for their origin. Several models predict associated multi-wavelength emission, but previous searches for optical, X-ray or gamma-ray counterparts of FRBs have not led to any detection. The Galactic magnetar SGR 1935+2154A has been observed to simultaneously emit FRB-like bursts and X-ray flares, which suggests that also extragalactic FRB sources may exhibit X-ray counterparts. Because of the high cost of X-ray satellites and in face of the relatively low FRB detection probability in their small field of view, coordinated radio and X-ray observations are logistically very difficult to set up. We propose a new approach using the X-ray satellite XMM-Newton and the Parkes/Murriyang radio telescope to put constraints on the theoretical models: We aim to conduct shadowing observations with the Parkes telescope to search for new FRBs in fields that are simultaneously covered by XMM-Newton. We hereby target regular XMM observations of nearby (low-z) galaxies, to increase our detection chances of possibly associated X-ray emission. In case of an FRB detection in the radio band, we will have guaranteed simultaneous X-ray coverage and will get detailed information about the associated X-ray spectrum and light curve since all XMM-Newton data will become public a year after the observation.

</details>

### [659] [Parkes observations for project P864 semester 2014APRS]()
*Caleb, Manisha,Bailes, Matthew,van Straten, Willem,Keane, Evan,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该试点研究拟检验测定与FRB相似的中等亮度RRAT单脉冲旋转测度（RM）的可行性，以探索通过FRB偏振测量绘制河外磁场乃至理解宇宙网物质分布的可能性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB自2007年被发现以来，虽在冷等离子体色散扫频和窄脉冲宽度上与RRAT的巨型单脉冲相似，但在射电或其他波段的后续观测中尚未被探测到。目前尚不清楚宇宙学磁场是否存在，而RM测量可能为河外磁场与大尺度物质分布研究提供新途径。

Method: 摘要未说明具体的观测、数据、仪器、频率或波段、时间跨度、样本与分析方法；仅说明这是一项试点研究，将检验测定与FRB相似的中等亮度RRAT单脉冲RM的可行性，并假定持续时间极短的高能FRB脉冲是偏振的。

Result: 摘要未报告具体结果。摘要仅指出FRB在射电或其他波段的后续观测中尚未被探测到，并说明该试点研究将检验测定与FRB相似的中等亮度RRAT单脉冲RM的可行性；未给出任何数值、显著性、RM测量值或探测结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出，测量单脉冲RM可能开辟通过FRB偏振测量来绘制宇宙河外磁场的新可能性；若探测到足够强的宇宙学磁场，将打开观测早期宇宙的新窗口；若能通过弥漫的WHIM确定FRB的RM，将是理解宇宙网内物质分布的开端。根据摘要无法判断这些可能性是否已得到观测支持。

Abstract: The Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) discovered in 2007 are the very first detections of extragalactic coherent radio emission. Though similar in nature to the giant single pulses emitted by the Rotating Radio Transients (RRATs) in terms of their cold plasma dispersion sweeps and narrow pulse widths, FRBs have not yet been detected in follow up observations at radio or other wavelengths. Our pilot study will examine the feasibility to determine the Rotation Measures (RM) of moderately bright RRAT single pulses similar to FRBs. Since the FRBs are highly energetic pulses of very short duration, they can be assumed to be polarised. This study to measure single pulse RMs could then open up a whole new possibility to map the extragalactic magnetic field of the Universe through FRB polarimetry. At present, we do not know whether cosmological magnetic fields exist, but the detection of sufficiently strong fields would open up a new observational window into the early Universe. The Warm-Hot Intergalactic Medium (WHIM) is believed to be the residing place of the Universeâs missing baryonic matter. If the RM of an FRB can be determined through the diffuse WHIM, it would be the beginning to our understanding of the matter distribution within the cosmic web.

</details>

Abstract: The Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) discovered in 2007 are the very first detections of extragalactic coherent radio emission. Though similar in nature to the giant single pulses emitted by the Rotating Radio Transients (RRATs) in terms of their cold plasma dispersion sweeps and narrow pulse widths, FRBs have not yet been detected in follow up observations at radio or other wavelengths. Our pilot study will examine the feasibility to determine the Rotation Measures (RM) of moderately bright RRAT single pulses similar to FRBs. Since the FRBs are highly energetic pulses of very short duration, they can be assumed to be polarised. This study to measure single pulse RMs could then open up a whole new possibility to map the extragalactic magnetic field of the Universe through FRB polarimetry. At present, we do not know whether cosmological magnetic fields exist, but the detection of sufficiently strong fields would open up a new observational window into the early Universe. The Warm-Hot Intergalactic Medium (WHIM) is believed to be the residing place of the Universeâs missing baryonic matter. If the RM of an FRB can be determined through the diffuse WHIM, it would be the beginning to our understanding of the matter distribution within the cosmic web.

</details>


### [661] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2019APRS_09]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划在ASKAP探测到的FRB群体中搜寻重复暴，利用完备样本和对定位良好暴的密集监测，在比探测注量极限低60倍以上的注量极限下，检验是否存在更多重复FRB，或FRB 121102是否为该群体中的唯一重复暴。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB仍带来许多未解问题；此前仅有一个重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云，而ASKAP新探测的28个暴中有两个定位到红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系，这些暴及其宿主与重复暴很不相同，提示群体可能存在二分性，因此需要检验是否存在更多重复暴。

Method: 利用ASKAP搜寻已探测到28个FRB，其中两个被定位到红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系；预计未来六个月再探测12个FRB并获得亚角秒定位。提案拟对这一群体搜寻重复，使用完备样本并对定位良好的暴开展密集监测，注量极限比其探测时低60倍以上。其他观测细节摘要未说明。

Result: 此前仅有一个已知重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云（年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云）；过去一年ASKAP探测到28个FRB，其中两个定位到红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系；这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同；预计未来六个月再探测12个FRB并具有亚角秒定位。摘要未给出重复搜寻的实际结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出，对定位良好的暴进行密集监测并在比探测注量极限低60倍以上的水平搜寻重复，将要么确认存在更多重复FRB，要么确认FRB 121102在该群体中的独特性；这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同，提示群体中可能存在二分性。根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星、磁星或单脉冲辐射的具体物理联系。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until a few months ago, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 28 bursts, two of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts &gt; 0.3. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. Over the next six months we expect to detect another 12 FRBs, which will also have sub-arcsecond localisations. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

### [663] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2019APRS_74]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划对ASKAP探测到并具有亚角秒定位的FRB样本开展重复暴搜寻，并用比探测时低60倍以上的注量限进行密集监测，以判定是否存在更多重复FRB，或FRB 121102是否在群体中独一无二。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB带来的问题仍多于答案；此前唯一已知重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云，而ASKAP新探测的28个暴中有两个定位于红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系，这些暴及其宿主与重复暴很不相同，提示群体中可能存在二分性，因此需要检验是否还存在其他重复FRB。

Method: 摘要说明利用ASKAP搜寻已探测到28个FRB，其中两个定位于红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系；预计未来六个月再探测到12个FRB，并具有亚角秒定位。提案拟在这一群体中搜寻重复，并对定位良好的暴开展密集监测，注量限比其探测时低60倍以上。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、时间跨度细节及统计分析细节。

Result: 摘要报告：直到几个月前，只有一个FRB被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云（年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云），且它是唯一已知重复暴；过去一年ASKAP搜寻探测到28个暴，其中两个定位于红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系；这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同，提示群体可能存在二分性；预计未来六个月再探测到12个具亚角秒定位的FRB。

Conclusion: 作者提出，对综合样本及定位良好的暴进行注量限低60倍以上的密集监测，将要么确认存在更多重复FRB，要么确认FRB 121102在群体中的独特性。摘要还提出新探测暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同，可能提示群体存在二分性。根据摘要无法判断这些结果对脉冲星、磁星或单脉冲辐射物理的具体含义。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until a few months ago, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 28 bursts, two of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts &gt; 0.3. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. Over the next six months we expect to detect another 12 FRBs, which will also have sub-arcsecond localisations. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

Result: 摘要报告：过去一年ASKAP搜寻探测到28个暴，其中两个定位到红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系；这些暴及宿主与已知重复暴非常不同。此前唯一已知重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云。预计未来六个月再探测约12个并具亚角秒定位。正式重复搜寻与监测结果尚待开展，摘要未给出。

Conclusion: 作者认为，这些定位良好的FRB及其宿主与重复暴的差异暗示群体中可能存在二分性；拟议的重复搜寻与密集监测将要么确认存在更多重复FRB，要么确认FRB 121102在该群体中的独特性。该预测性结论取决于尚未完成的观测。根据摘要无法判断其对脉冲星、磁星或单脉冲发射研究的直接可迁移性。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until a few months ago, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 28 bursts, two of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts &gt; 0.3. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. Over the next six months we expect to detect another 12 FRBs, which will also have sub-arcsecond localisations. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>
