### [676] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2019APRS_71]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划在 ASKAP 探测到的一批具有亚角秒定位的 FRB 样本中搜寻重复暴，以在比原探测通量极限低 60 倍以上的灵敏度下，确认是否存在更多重复 FRB，或确认 FRB 121102 的独特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 快速射电暴（FRB）提出的问题仍多于答案。此前仅有一个重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云；而 ASKAP 近一年探测到的 28 个暴中有两个已定位到红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系，这些暴与宿主同该重复暴非常不同，提示群体中可能存在二分性，因此需要检验其他 FRB 是否重复。

Method: 摘要说明：该提案拟利用现有及预期的 FRB 样本，包括 ASKAP 探测到的 28 个暴（其中两个已定位到红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系）以及未来六个月预计探测到的 12 个具有亚角秒定位的 FRB，对该群体搜寻重复，并对定位良好的暴开展密集监测，监测通量极限比其探测通量极限低 60 倍以上。具体观测仪器（除 ASKAP 外）、频段、时间跨度与分析流程摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：在过去一年中，利用 ASKAP 的搜寻探测到 28 个暴，其中两个被定位到红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系；此前唯一已知的重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中一个明亮射电星云（年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云）。这些暴及其宿主与该重复暴非常不同，提示群体可能存在二分性。提案预期未来六个月再探测到 12 个 FRB，并具有亚角秒定位；搜寻重复的结果尚未给出。

Conclusion: 作者认为，基于全面样本和对定位良好暴的密集监测（通量极限比探测极限低 60 倍以上），该搜寻将要么确认存在更多重复 FRB，要么确认 FRB 121102 在该群体中的独特性。至于这些 FRB 与脉冲星、磁星或脉冲星风云之间的具体物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until a few months ago, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 28 bursts, two of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts &gt; 0.3. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. Over the next six months we expect to detect another 12 FRBs, which will also have sub-arcsecond localisations. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者提出，利用综合样本和对定位良好爆发、注量极限比探测时低60倍以上的密集监测，将要么证实存在额外的重复FRB，要么证实FRB 121102在该群体中的独特性；这也表明现有爆发及其宿主与重复暴的差异提示群体可能存在二分性。根据摘要无法判断更具体的物理机制或与其他脉冲星、磁星现象的关联。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until a few months ago, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 28 bursts, two of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts &gt; 0.3. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. Over the next six months we expect to detect another 12 FRBs, which will also have sub-arcsecond localisations. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

Motivation: FRB仍带来许多未解问题；此前仅有一个重复暴被定位于遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云。近一年ASKAP探测到28个暴，其中两个定位于红移 > 0.3 的宿主星系，且这些暴及其宿主与那个重复暴非常不同，提示种群中可能存在二分性。因此需要在该样本中搜寻重复，以检验重复FRB是否普遍。

Method: 摘要指出，过去一年使用ASKAP进行搜寻，探测到28个暴，其中两个已定位于红移 > 0.3 的宿主星系；预计接下来六个月再探测到12个FRB，且将具有亚角秒定位。该提案拟对这一种群搜寻重复，并对定位良好的暴进行密集监测，监测的注量极限比其被探测时低60倍以上。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、时间跨度细节、样本筛选与统计分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告：ASKAP在过去一年的搜寻中探测到28个暴，其中两个已定位于红移 > 0.3 的宿主星系；这些暴及其宿主与已知重复暴非常不同，提示种群可能存在二分性。预计未来六个月将再探测到12个FRB，并具有亚角秒定位。拟议的密集监测注量极限比其探测时低60倍以上。摘要未说明重复搜寻的实际结果，因为这些是拟开展的观测。

Conclusion: 作者明确提出的推论是：这些暴及其宿主与那个重复暴非常不同，表明种群中可能存在二分性。所提议的搜寻将要么确认存在额外的重复FRB，要么确认FRB 121102在该种群中的独特性。摘要未说明对具体重复机制或物理起源的解释；根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星、磁星或单脉冲发射等具体物理过程的联系。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until a few months ago, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 28 bursts, two of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts &gt; 0.3. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. Over the next six months we expect to detect another 12 FRBs, which will also have sub-arcsecond localisations. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

Method: 摘要说明拟利用 ASKAP 探测的综合 FRB 样本，并对定位良好的暴开展密集监测搜寻重复暴；预计未来六个月再探测 12 个 FRB，这些 FRB 也将具有亚角秒级定位；搜寻在比其被探测时低 60 倍以上的注量限下进行。具体观测频率、时间跨度、望远镜其他参数及统计方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要说明截至此前仅有一个重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云；过去一年 ASKAP 搜寻探测到 28 个暴，其中两个定位到红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系；这些暴及其宿主与那个重复暴非常不同，暗示种群可能存在二分性；预计未来六个月再探测 12 个 FRB。所提搜寻的结果尚未报告。

Conclusion: 作者提出，对综合样本及定位良好暴的密集监测将要么确认存在额外的重复 FRB，要么确认 FRB 121102 在该种群中的独特性。该断言是对拟议观测所能检验结果的表述；现有暴与重复暴的差异暗示种群二分性，但因果或物理机制根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until a few months ago, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 28 bursts, two of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts &gt; 0.3. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. Over the next six months we expect to detect another 12 FRBs, which will also have sub-arcsecond localisations. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

TL;DR: 该提案计划对ASKAP探测到并具有亚角秒定位的FRB群体开展重复搜寻，用比原探测流量注量极限低60倍以上的密集监测，确认是否还存在其他重复FRB，或确认FRB 121102在该群体中是否独特。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB仍带来多于解答的问题；此前唯一已知重复的暴是唯一被定位到遥远矮星系明亮射电星云（年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云）的暴。ASKAP近一年探测到28个暴，其中两个定位于红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系，这些暴与重复暴很不相同，提示群体可能存在二分性，因此需要检验是否还有更多重复FRB。

Method: 摘要说明这是一项提案：使用ASKAP搜寻所探测到的FRB群体，并对定位良好的暴进行密集监测活动；预计未来六个月再探测12个FRB，且这些FRB也将具有亚角秒定位。监测的流量注量极限比其探测时的极限低60倍以上。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、具体时间跨度、样本数量细节、计时或偏振等分析流程。

Result: 摘要报告：直到几个月前，只有一个暴（唯一已知重复暴）被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云；过去一年ASKAP搜寻探测到28个暴，其中两个定位到红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系；预计接下来六个月再探测12个FRB，也将具有亚角秒定位。摘要指出这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同，暗示群体中可能存在二分性。摘要未给出重复搜寻的最终结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，针对这一群体开展重复搜寻，并以比原探测低60倍以上的流量注量极限进行密集监测，将要么确认存在额外的重复FRB，要么确认FRB 121102在该群体中的独特性；这些暴及其宿主与重复暴的不同暗示群体可能存在二分性。根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、模式转换、偏振或自转减速力矩变化等具体物理机制的关系。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until a few months ago, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 28 bursts, two of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts &gt; 0.3. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. Over the next six months we expect to detect another 12 FRBs, which will also have sub-arcsecond localisations. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

TL;DR: 该提案拟对ASKAP探测并亚角秒定位的FRB样本进行重复暴搜寻与密集监测，监测流量极限比其探测时低60倍以上，以确认是否存在额外重复FRB，或确认FRB 121102在种群中的独特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB带来的问题多于答案。此前仅有一个暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云，而ASKAP在一年内探测到28个暴、其中两个定位于红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系；这些暴及宿主与重复暴非常不同，提示种群可能存在二分性。摘要据此提出需搜寻重复暴。

Method: 摘要说明利用ASKAP探测的28个FRB样本，其中两个已定位到红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系，预计未来六个月再探测12个并具有亚角秒定位；拟对这些定位良好的暴开展密集监测以搜寻重复暴，监测流量极限比其探测时低60倍以上。观测频段、时间跨度、具体分析流程等摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：此前只有一个暴（唯一已知重复暴）被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云，可能是年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云；ASKAP在过去一年探测到28个FRB，其中两个定位到红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系；这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同；预计未来六个月再探测12个FRB并将具有亚角秒定位。重复搜寻结果尚未给出。

Conclusion: 作者认为现有定位暴及其宿主与重复暴的差异提示种群可能存在二分性，并拟通过综合样本与密集监测，要么确认存在额外重复FRB，要么确认FRB 121102的独特性。对脉冲星、磁星或FRB物理机制的进一步推论，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until a few months ago, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 28 bursts, two of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts &gt; 0.3. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. Over the next six months we expect to detect another 12 FRBs, which will also have sub-arcsecond localisations. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. Over the next six months we expect to detect another 12 FRBs, which will also have sub-arcsecond localisations. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

Result: 过去一年ASKAP搜寻探测到28个暴，其中两个被定位到红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系。此前仅有一个暴（唯一已知重复暴）被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云（年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云）。这些暴及其宿主与那个重复暴非常不同，暗示群体中可能存在二分性。预计未来六个月再探测到12个FRB，也将具有亚角秒级定位。所提议监测的流量极限比这些暴被探测时低60倍以上。

Conclusion: 作者提出，对定位良好的FRB群体开展密集监测、在比探测时低60倍以上的流量极限下搜寻重复，将要么确认存在额外的重复FRB，要么确认FRB 121102在该群体中的独特性。摘要所报告的这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同，提示群体中可能存在二分性，但这仍是摘要所述的暗示，而非已确立结论。该工作与重复FRB及其群体性质直接相关；根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换或脉冲星计时之间的具体物理联系。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until a few months ago, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 28 bursts, two of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts &gt; 0.3. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. Over the next six months we expect to detect another 12 FRBs, which will also have sub-arcsecond localisations. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者提出的预期是，对完备样本及定位良好的暴开展的密集监测，在比探测流量限低60倍以上的流量限上，将要么确认存在更多重复FRB，要么确认FRB 121102在该群体中的独特性；摘要并指出这些暴及宿主与重复暴非常不同，提示群体可能存在二分性。根据摘要无法判断更具体的物理机制或对脉冲星、磁星等天体的可迁移结论。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until a few months ago, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 28 bursts, two of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts &gt; 0.3. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. Over the next six months we expect to detect another 12 FRBs, which will also have sub-arcsecond localisations. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测仪器设置、频段、时间跨度与样本细节；仅说明利用ASKAP的搜寻在过去一年探测到28个暴，其中两个定位于红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系，预计未来六个月再探测12个并给出亚角秒定位，并提议对这一群体开展密集监测以搜寻重复暴，监测流量极限比其探测时低超过60倍。

Result: 过去一年ASKAP搜寻探测到28个FRB，其中两个被定位于红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系；此前只有一个重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云。这些暴与宿主和该重复暴很不相同，暗示群体可能存在二分性。预计未来六个月再探测到12个FRB，也将具有亚角秒定位。拟议监测的流量极限比其探测时低超过60倍。

Conclusion: 拟议的密集监测与综合样本将要么确认存在更多重复FRB，要么确认FRB 121102在该群体中的独特性；作者还提出所观测到的暴与宿主和重复暴不同，暗示群体可能存在二分性。根据摘要无法判断具体的物理机制或与脉冲星、磁星等天体的联系。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until a few months ago, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 28 bursts, two of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts &gt; 0.3. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. Over the next six months we expect to detect another 12 FRBs, which will also have sub-arcsecond localisations. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用全面样本和对定位良好的 FRB 进行密集监测，以注量极限比探测时低 60 倍以上的搜寻来检验是否存在更多重复 FRB，或确认 FRB 121102 的独特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 问题仍多于答案；此前仅有一个重复暴被定位于遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云。近一年 ASKAP 探测到 28 个暴，其中两个定位于红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系，这些暴及其宿主与重复暴很不相同，提示种群中可能存在二分性。

Method: 摘要指出已利用 ASKAP 开展搜寻，探测到 28 个暴，其中两个定位于红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系；预期未来六个月再探测到 12 个 FRB，这些也将具有亚角秒定位。该提案拟对定位良好的暴进行密集监测，搜寻注量极限比其探测时低 60 倍以上的重复信号。观测频段、时间跨度、望远镜其他参数及具体分析统计方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要说明此前仅有一个已知重复暴被定位于遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云（年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云）；过去一年 ASKAP 搜寻探测到 28 个暴，其中两个定位于红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系，且这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同；预期未来六个月再探测到 12 个 FRB，并将同样具有亚角秒定位。实际重复搜寻结果摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同，表明 FRB 种群中可能存在二分性。所提议的注量极限比探测时低 60 倍以上的密集监测，要么确认存在额外的重复 FRB，要么确认 FRB 121102 在该种群中的独特性。至于特定物理机制、磁星或脉冲星关联，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until a few months ago, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 28 bursts, two of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts &gt; 0.3. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. Over the next six months we expect to detect another 12 FRBs, which will also have sub-arcsecond localisations. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

Result: 摘要报告，此前仅有一个已知重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云（年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云）。过去一年 ASKAP 搜寻探测到 28 个暴，其中两个定位到红移 &gt; 0.3 的宿主星系；这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同，可能提示群体存在二分性。预计未来六个月再探测 12 个 FRB，并将获得亚角秒定位。

Conclusion: 作者明确提出，通过综合样本以及对定位良好暴的密集监测，并以比探测时低 60 倍以上的流量限搜寻重复，将要么确认存在更多重复 FRB，要么确认 FRB 121102 在该群体中的独特性。这些不同暴与其宿主同重复暴的差异被表述为可能提示群体二分性。对于 FRB 与脉冲星、磁星或单脉冲发射等的具体物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until a few months ago, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 28 bursts, two of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts &gt; 0.3. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. Over the next six months we expect to detect another 12 FRBs, which will also have sub-arcsecond localisations. Here we propose to search this population for repeats. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections, will either confirm the presence of additional repeating FRBs or the uniqueness of FRB 121102 amongst the population.

</details>

### [757] [Plasma flow in force-free magnetospheres: Two-fluid model near pulsars and black holes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.02057)
*Mizuno, Morifumi,Gralla, Samuel E.,Philippov, Alexander*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 作者在双流体近似下提出一种把粒子“绘制”到无作用力解上的方法，其边界条件编码间隙区的粒子输出并决定整个磁层的主导平行电场；该方法在一般时空与 $1+1$ 维场片时空中表述，并应用于径向磁场的脉冲星与黑洞磁层，得到能捕捉完整问题关键特征的完全解析模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无作用力电动力学能描述脉冲星和活动黑洞附近磁主导等离子体的电磁场，却不包含最终产生可观测辐射的底层粒子的信息。摘要指出，间隙区中无作用力近似不成立，而这些间隙区的粒子输出如何以边界条件形式进入无作用力解、如何决定整个磁层的主导平行电场，是需要解决的问题。

Method: 采用双流体近似，把粒子“绘制”到无作用力解上，边界条件编码“间隙区”的粒子输出；处理适用于一般（可能弯曲）时空，并表述为粒子被束缚在磁力线上所经历的 $1+1$ 维“场片时空”语言。作者推导了一般的微扰方法，并将其应用于具有径向磁场的脉冲星和黑洞磁层。摘要未说明观测、仪器、频段、样本或时间跨度。

Result: 作者得到新的结果，并给出一些标准方程的优雅表述：零回旋半径导心近似就是场片上的洛伦兹力定律。他们推导出一般的微扰方法，并将其应用于具有径向磁场的脉冲星和黑洞磁层，产生完全解析模型，这些模型捕捉完整问题的关键特征。边界条件编码间隙区的粒子输出，并决定整个磁层中的主导平行电场。摘要未给出数值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，该双流体处理提供了将粒子信息加入无作用力解的途径，并给出了场片时空中的新表述与解析模型。他们指出，当该方法应用于更真实的磁场位形，并结合由模拟给出的间隙区边界条件时，有潜力提供无需全局粒子模拟的全局磁层模型。根据摘要无法判断其与单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自旋下降转矩变化、偏振、射电频谱、瞬变射电暴或磁星—快速射电暴关联的直接关系。

Abstract: Force-free electrodynamics describes the electromagnetic field of the magnetically dominated plasma found near pulsars and active black holes but gives no information about the underlying particles that ultimately produce the observable emission. Working in the two-fluid approximation, we show how particles can be ``painted on'' to a force-free solution as a function of boundary conditions that encode the particle output of ``gap regions'' where the force-free approximation does not hold. These boundary conditions also determine the leading parallel electric field in the entire magnetosphere. Our treatment holds in a general (possibly curved) spacetime and is phrased in language intrinsic to the <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mn>1</mml:mn><mml:mo>+</mml:mo><mml:mn>1</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> dimensional ``field sheet spacetimes'' experienced by particles stuck to magnetic field lines. Besides the new results, this provides an elegant formulation of some standard equations; for example, we show that the zero-gyroradius guiding center approximation is just the Lorentz force law on the field sheet. We derive a general perturbative method and apply it to pulsar and black hole magnetospheres with radial magnetic fields to produce fully analytic models that capture key features of the full problem. When applied to more realistic magnetic field configurations together with simulation-informed boundary conditions for the gap regions, this approach has the potential to provide global magnetosphere models without the need for global particle-in-cell simulations.

</details>


### [758] [Diocotron Modes in Pulsar Magnetospheres: Charge Diffusion and Implications for Radio Emission Variability]()
*Goodbred, Matthew,Spitkovsky, Anatoly*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 三维粒子模拟（PIC）显示，脉冲星磁层赤道面中的双回旋不稳定性在自转周期量级增长并形成稳定的 m = 1 模式，其引起的跨场扩散可把电荷输运到光柱，且该模式的电场扰动可调制极冠电势降与发射束角，可能关联零脉冲、周期性振幅调制和漂移子脉冲等脉冲星可变性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双回旋不稳定性应当普遍出现在脉冲星磁层差分旋转的赤道面中，但摘要并未说明此前对该不稳定性及其与脉冲星射电可变性联系的认识缺口；根据摘要仅可知，作者希望用三维粒子模拟考察对齐与斜置脉冲星中的该不稳定性及其可能后果。

Method: 摘要说明：对对齐和斜置脉冲星中的双回旋不稳定性开展一系列三维粒子模拟（PIC）模拟；未说明具体仪器、频率或频段、时间跨度、样本量以及计时、单脉冲、偏振、RM、DM、光谱、机器学习、统计或族群分析等细节。

Result: 该不稳定性在自转周期量级的时间尺度上增长，并发展出强的稳定 m = 1 模式，对应于赤道盘中旋转的偶极电荷不对称；双回旋模式振幅和图案速度的随机涨落驱动跨场扩散，可迅速把电荷穿过闭合区输运至光柱；在非线性阶段，m = 1 模式产生电场扰动，可调制极冠电势降和发射束角。

Conclusion: 作者提出，m = 1 模式导致的极冠电势降与发射束角调制可能与脉冲星可变性有关，例如零脉冲、周期性振幅调制和漂移子脉冲；这是摘要明确给出的可能联系，而非已确立的结果。根据摘要无法判断其对磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、计时或自转减速力矩变化等其他课题的可迁移性。

Abstract: The diocotron instability is a nonaxisymmetric plasma instability that should occur generically in the differentially rotating equatorial plane of pulsar magnetospheres. We present a series of 3D particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations of the diocotron instability in aligned and oblique pulsars. The instability grows on timescales of the rotation period and develops a strong, stable m = 1 mode, corresponding to a rotating, dipolar charge asymmetry in the equatorial disk. Stochastic fluctuations in the diocotron-mode amplitude and pattern speed drive cross-field diffusion that can rapidly transport charges through the closed zone toward the light cylinder. In the nonlinear stage, the m = 1 mode produces electric field perturbations which can modulate the polar-cap potential drop and the emission-beam angle, with possible connections to pulsar variability such as nulling, periodic amplitude modulation, and drifting subpulses.

</details>


### [759] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2019OCTS_55]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry,Kumar, Pravir*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟利用ASKAP已探测的31个FRB样本（其中5个已定位到红移0.1–0.5的宿主星系），在比探测通量限低60倍以上的通量限下搜寻并研究重复暴，并用宽带宽观测检验主流暴发射模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB提出的问题仍多于答案。直至去年仅有一个（且是已知唯一重复的）暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云。近两年ASKAP探测到31个暴，5个定位于红移0.1–0.5的宿主星系；这些暴及其宿主与重复暴很不相同，提示群体可能存在二分性，但其中一个角分定位的ASKAP FRB最近被发现会重复，因此需搜寻并研究重复现象。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度与数据处理流程。摘要说明：使用ASKAP探测的31个暴、其中5个已定位到宿主星系；提出对定位良好的暴进行密集监测campaign，在比其探测通量限低60倍以上的通量限下搜寻重复暴以刻画重复比例，并对重复暴使用独特的宽带宽观测来检验主流暴发射模型。

Result: 摘要未说明本提案已获得的观测结果。摘要说明的背景结果包括：直至去年仅有一个（唯一已知重复的）暴被定位于遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云（年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云）；过去两年ASKAP探测到31个暴，其中5个定位到红移0.1–0.5的宿主星系；这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同；最近发现其中一个角分定位的ASKAP FRB会重复。

Conclusion: 作者明确提出的科学含义是：上述暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同，表明FRB群体中可能存在二分性；同时有一个角分定位的ASKAP FRB最近被发现会重复。据此作者提议在更低的通量限下刻画重复暴比例，并用宽带宽观测检验主流暴发射模型。该提案本身的结果尚不可知；与脉冲星、磁星或单脉冲发射的具体关联，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last two year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 31 bursts, five of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>

### [762] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2019OCTS_45]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry,Kumar, Pravir*

Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last two year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 31 bursts, five of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. ### [764] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2019OCTS_69]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry,Kumar, Pravir*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提议旨在利用ASKAP在比原探测注量极限低60倍以上的灵敏度下，密集监测定位良好的快速射电暴（FRB），以刻画重复暴的比例，并用宽带宽观测检验主要的暴辐射模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB带来的问题仍多于答案；去年为止仅有一个重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云。近两年ASKAP探测到31个暴，其中五个定位到红移0.1至0.5的宿主星系，这些暴及宿主与重复暴很不相同，暗示群体可能存在二分性，但一个角分级定位的ASKAP FRB最近被发现重复，因此需要搜寻并研究这一群体中的重复现象。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测时间跨度、样本细节和分析流程，仅说明利用ASKAP的探测与定位结果；提议对定位良好的暴开展密集监测，注量极限比其探测时低60倍以上，并对重复暴采用独特的宽带宽观测。

Result: 摘要未说明实际观测结果，仅给出已有背景：去年之前只有一个已知重复暴被定位到明亮射电星云；过去两年ASKAP探测到31个暴，其中五个定位到红移0.1至0.5的宿主星系，这些暴与宿主与重复暴很不相同；其中一个角分级定位的ASKAP FRB最近被发现会重复。

Conclusion: 作者明确提出的推断是这些定位的暴及其宿主与重复暴很不相同，暗示群体中可能存在二分性；并提议通过搜寻重复来刻画重复暴比例，利用宽带宽观测检验主要的暴辐射模型。对于具体的物理机制或该二分性的可迁移性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last two year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 31 bursts, five of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>

### [770] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2019OCTS_30]()

### [771] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2019OCTS_14]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry,Kumar, Pravir*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划以比原探测低60倍以上的注量极限，对定位良好的ASKAP快速射电暴样本进行密集监测以搜寻重复暴，从而表征重复暴的比例，并用宽带宽观测检验主流辐射模型。目前已探测到31个暴、其中五个定位于红移0.1至0.5的宿主星系，另有一个角分级别定位的ASKAP FRB被发现有重复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 快速射电暴提出的问题仍多于它回答的问题；此前仅有一个重复暴被定位于遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云，而ASKAP探测到的31个暴中五个定位于红移0.1至0.5的宿主星系，这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同，提示群体中可能存在二分性。最近发现一个角分级别定位的ASKAP FRB会重复，因此需要在该群体中搜寻和研究重复现象。

Method: 摘要说明为搜寻并研究这一FRB群体中的重复现象，使用综合样本以及对定位良好的暴进行的密集监测 campaign；观测注量极限比其探测时低60倍以上；对重复暴使用独特的宽带宽观测。所用望远镜为澳大利亚平方公里阵列探路者（ASKAP），具体频率或频段、观测时间跨度、样本数量细节及统计或分析流程摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要说明：直到去年仅有一个暴被定位于一个遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云，并且它是唯一已知会重复的暴；过去两年ASKAP搜寻探测到31个暴，其中五个被定位于红移0.1至0.5的宿主星系；这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同；最近发现其中一个角分级别定位的ASKAP FRB会重复。摘要未说明重复比例的具体数值、注量极限数值、显著性或其他定量结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同，提示群体中可能存在二分性；拟议的搜寻与监测旨在表征会重复的暴所占的比例，并用宽带宽观测检验主流暴辐射模型。关于具体的物理机制或该二分性是否成立，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last two year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 31 bursts, five of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>


### [772] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2019OCTS_25]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry,Kumar, Pravir*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟利用ASKAP对快速射电暴（FRB）群体开展重复搜寻与密集监测，在比原探测通量极限低60倍以上的注量极限下表征重复暴比例，并用宽带观测检验主流的暴发射模型；摘要同时提到现有31个ASKAP探测暴中5个已定位到红移0.1至0.5的宿主星系，且其中一个角分级定位的FRB最近被发现会重复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB带来的问题仍多于答案；此前仅有一个已知重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云。近两年ASKAP探测到31个暴，其中5个定位到红移0.1至0.5的宿主星系，这些暴及其宿主与那个重复暴非常不同，提示群体可能存在二分性；但近期发现一个角分级定位的ASKAP FRB会重复，因此需要搜寻并研究该群体中的重复现象。

Method: 摘要提到使用ASKAP开展搜寻并探测到31个暴，其中有5个被定位到红移0.1至0.5的宿主星系；拟利用综合样本和对定位良好暴的密集监测活动，在比其探测通量极限低60倍以上的注量极限下进行重复搜寻与表征；对重复暴使用独特的宽带观测。具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、分析流程与统计方法：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：过去两年ASKAP搜寻探测到31个暴，其中5个被定位到红移从0.1到0.5的宿主星系；这些暴及其宿主与唯一已知重复暴非常不同，提示群体可能存在二分性；最近发现其中一个经角分级定位的ASKAP FRB会重复。拟议工作在比其探测通量极限低60倍以上的注量极限下表征重复暴比例，并用以检验主流暴发射模型的结果尚属拟议目标。其他具体数值、显著性及单脉冲、偏振、RM、DM等结果：摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为，这些ASKAP探测暴及其宿主与唯一已知重复暴非常不同，提示FRB群体中可能存在二分性；但一个角分级定位的ASKAP FRB最近被发现会重复，因此需要通过搜寻和密集监测表征重复暴比例，并利用宽带观测检验主流的暴发射模型。摘要未给出这些拟议检验的结论。与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化或磁星—FRB联系的关系：根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last two year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 31 bursts, five of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>

### [774] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2019OCTS_27]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry,Kumar, Pravir*

Over the last three years searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 35 bursts, eight of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>


### [778] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2020APRS_08]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry,Kumar, Pravir*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟利用 ASKAP 搜寻并研究 FRB 群体中的重复现象，使用全面样本和密集监测，对定位良好的爆发在比其探测注量极限低 60 倍以上的注量极限下刻画重复爆发的比例，并用宽带宽观测检验主流爆发辐射模型；摘要提到 ASKAP 已探测 35 例爆发，其中八例定位到红移 0.1 至 0.5 的宿主星系，且其中一例角分级定位的 FRB 最近被发现会重复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要指出 FRB 提出的问题多于答案：此前只有唯一已知重复的一例被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云；过去三年 ASKAP 探测到 35 例爆发，其中八例定位到红移 0.1 至 0.5 的宿主星系，这些爆发及其宿主与那例重复暴非常不同，提示群体中可能存在二分性；但其中一例角分级定位的 ASKAP FRB 最近被发现会重复。由此需要搜寻并研究该 FRB 群体中的重复现象。

Method: 摘要说明：使用 ASKAP 进行的搜寻已探测到 35 例爆发，其中八例被定位到红移 0.1 至 0.5 的宿主星系。提议对全面样本以及定位良好的爆发开展密集监测活动，注量极限比其探测时的注量极限低 60 倍以上，用以刻画会重复的爆发的比例；对于重复的爆发，将使用独特的宽带宽观测。具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、日期及数据分析方法，摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：过去三年 ASKAP 搜寻探测到 35 例爆发，其中八例被定位到红移 0.1 至 0.5 的宿主星系；此前只有唯一已知重复的一例被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云。已定位的爆发及其宿主与那例重复暴非常不同，提示群体中可能存在二分性。此外，一例角分级定位的 ASKAP FRB 最近被发现会重复。所提议的监测活动将在比其探测注量极限低 60 倍以上的注量极限下刻画重复爆发的比例。摘要未给出比这更具体的重复比例数值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 摘要提出：全面样本与密集监测有望在极低注量极限下刻画会重复的爆发比例，而对重复爆发使用宽带宽观测可检验主流的爆发辐射模型。已定位爆发与其宿主和那例重复暴十分不同，提示 FRB 群体可能存在二分性；但一例角分级定位的 ASKAP FRB 最近被发现会重复，这一事实对二分性图像的含义，根据摘要无法判断。该工作与脉冲星、磁星或单脉冲发射的具体联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last three years searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 35 bursts, eight of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>


### [779] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2019OCTS_29]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry,Kumar, Pravir*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提议计划利用ASKAP对快速射电暴（FRB）种群开展重复暴搜索与密集监测，在比探测注量极限低60倍以上的注量极限下表征重复暴比例，并用宽带宽观测检验主流暴辐射模型；摘要指出已探测31个暴、其中5个被定位到红移0.1–0.5的宿主星系，且有一个定位到角分精度的ASKAP FRB最近被发现重复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 快速射电暴（FRB）带来的问题仍多于答案。此前仅有一个已知重复暴被定位于遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云；ASKAP探测到的31个暴中5个已定位到红移0.1–0.5的宿主星系，且这些暴及其宿主与那个重复暴非常不同，提示种群可能存在二分性。然而其中一个定位到角分精度的ASKAP FRB最近被发现重复，因此需要在该种群中搜索并研究重复现象。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测日期、时间跨度或样本量的细节。摘要提到使用澳大利亚平方公里阵列探路者（ASKAP）进行搜索并已探测31个暴；提议开展对定位良好的暴的密集监测活动，注量极限比其探测时低60倍以上；对重复的暴使用独特的宽带宽观测。摘要未说明具体分析方法的细节。

Result: 摘要报告：直到去年，只有唯一一个已知重复的暴被定位于遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云（或者是年轻超新星遗迹，或者是脉冲星风云）。过去两年用ASKAP的搜索探测到31个暴，其中5个被定位到红移0.1至0.5的宿主星系。这些暴及其宿主与那个重复暴非常不同，提示种群中可能存在二分性；但其中一个被定位到角分精度的ASKAP FRB最近被发现重复。摘要未说明具体数值显著性、误差或统计量。

Conclusion: 作者认为，这些暴及其宿主与已知重复暴非常不同，提示FRB种群中可能存在二分性；但一个角分精度定位的ASKAP FRB最近被发现重复，因此需要在这一种群中搜索并研究重复，以表征重复暴的比例，并用宽带宽观测检验主流的暴辐射模型。关于磁星、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振或射电谱的具体物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Over the last two year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 31 bursts, five of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>

*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry,Kumar, Pravir*

TL;DR: 该提议拟对定位良好的 ASKAP FRB 样本进行搜寻与密集监测，以期在比探测注量限低 60 倍以上的注量限上表征重复爆发的比例，并利用宽带宽观测检验爆发辐射模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 提出的问题多于回答；此前仅有一个重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中明亮的射电星云，而 ASKAP 探测并定位的爆发及其宿主与重复暴很不相同，暗示种群中可能存在二分性，且其中一个经角分量级定位的 ASKAP FRB 最近被发现会重复。因此需要搜寻并研究该种群中的重复现象。

Method: 摘要提出利用 ASKAP 过去两年探测到的 31 个爆发（其中 5 个已定位到红移 0.1 至 0.5 的主星系）构成的综合样本，并对定位良好的爆发开展密集监测活动，在比其探测注量限低 60 倍以上的注量限下搜寻重复爆发；对重复爆发使用独特的宽带宽观测。具体观测频段、时间跨度与分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：ASKAP 在过去两年的搜寻中探测到 31 个爆发，其中 5 个被定位到红移 0.1 至 0.5 的主星系；这些爆发及其宿主与唯一已知的重复暴很不相同，暗示种群可能存在二分性；一个经角分量级定位的 ASKAP FRB 最近被发现会重复。所提议搜寻与监测的结果尚未给出。

Conclusion: 作者据此提出，该 FRB 种群中可能存在二分性，并提议通过低注量限的重复搜寻表征重复爆发比例、以宽带宽观测检验主流爆发辐射模型。根据摘要无法判断这些检验将得出何种具体物理结论。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last two year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 31 bursts, five of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>


### [791] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2020APRS_30]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry,Kumar, Pravir*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案旨在利用ASKAP对定位良好的快速射电暴（FRB）样本开展重复搜寻与密集监测，在比原探测通量限低60倍以上的通量极限下刻画重复暴比例，并用宽带宽观测检验主流辐射模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB提出的问题仍多于答案；此前仅有一个重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云。ASKAP探测到的35个暴中有8个已定位到红移0.1至0.5的宿主星系，它们与重复暴很不相同，暗示群体可能存在二分性；但其中一个角分级定位的ASKAP FRB最近被发现会重复，因此需要在该群体中搜寻和研究重复现象。

Method: 拟使用ASKAP对FRB群体进行重复搜寻与监测，包含全面样本以及对定位良好的暴开展的密集监测 campaign，观测通量极限比其探测通量限低60倍以上，并利用独特的宽带宽观测检验主流暴辐射模型。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度、源数量细节或统计分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告：ASKAP搜寻在过去三年中探测到35个暴，其中8个被定位到红移0.1至0.5的宿主星系；这些暴及其宿主与唯一已知的重复暴非常不同，暗示群体可能存在二分性；最近发现其中一个角分级定位的ASKAP FRB会重复。拟议监测的通量极限比其探测通量限低60倍以上。摘要未说明重复比例的实测数值或模型检验结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，这些FRB及其宿主与重复暴的差异暗示群体中可能存在二分性，但一个角分级定位的ASKAP FRB被发现重复，因而需要通过搜寻和研究该群体中的重复现象、刻画重复暴比例并检验主流辐射模型来进一步厘清。根据摘要无法判断这些结果对磁星—FRB联系或脉冲星、磁星单脉冲与计时研究的具体意义。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last three years searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 35 bursts, eight of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>

<details>

Method: 摘要说明将搜寻并研究该FRB群体中的重复现象，使用综合样本，对定位良好的暴开展密集监测活动，注量极限比其被探测时低60倍以上；对重复暴使用独特的宽带宽观测。标题提及Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2019OCTS_04。具体仪器、频段、时间跨度、样本量及分析细节：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要说明：此前仅有一个已知重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云（年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云）；过去两年ASKAP搜寻探测到31个暴，其中5个定位到红移0.1至0.5的宿主星系；这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同；其中一个角分尺度定位的ASKAP FRB最近被发现重复。摘要未给出这些结果的统计显著性或其他数值。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同，表明FRB群体中可能存在二分性；计划通过刻画重复暴比例并用宽带宽观测检验主流暴发射模型。这些结论均为该提案所述目标与推测，尚未在本摘要中作为已完成结果呈现。根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星、磁星或单脉冲发射等主题的具体物理联系。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last two year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 31 bursts, five of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>

Method: 摘要说明这是一项搜寻与监测提案：利用澳大利亚平方公里阵列探路者（ASKAP）的探测与定位结果，对综合样本以及对定位良好的暴开展密集监测活动，其注量极限比这些暴被探测到时低60倍以上；对会重复的暴采用独特的宽带宽观测。具体观测频段、时间跨度、样本细节与数据分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：过去三年ASKAP搜寻探测到35个暴，其中8个被定位到红移0.1至0.5的主星系；这些暴及其宿主与那个重复暴非常不同，提示群体可能存在二分性；而其中一个仅被定位到角分尺度精度的ASKAP FRB最近被发现会重复。摘要说明拟开展的监测注量极限比探测时低60倍以上，但未给出监测本身的结果。

Conclusion: 作者据此提出群体可能存在二分性，但一个曾仅作角分尺度定位的ASKAP FRB被证实重复，因此需要通过搜寻与密集监测来刻画重复暴的比例；对重复暴的宽带宽观测将用于检验主要的暴辐射模型。根据摘要无法判断该二分性是否成立，也无法判断这些结果与脉冲星、磁星或单脉冲等其他课题的具体联系。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last three years searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 35 bursts, eight of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>

Conclusion: 摘要提出，通过综合样本与密集监测、在比探测时低60倍以上的注量限下搜寻重复现象，可刻画会发生重复的暴的比例；对发生重复的暴，独特的宽带宽观测将用于检验主流的暴发射模型。摘要所述这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同，提示群体中可能存在二分性。根据摘要无法判断这些结果对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化或计时等具体议题的意义。

Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry,Kumar, Pravir*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟利用 ASKAP 探测的 FRB 样本和密集监测，在比探测注量极限低 60 倍以上的注量极限下搜寻重复暴，以刻画重复暴比例，并用宽带宽观测检验主流暴辐射模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 提出的问题仍多于答案。此前仅有一个重复暴被定位于遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云，而 ASKAP 探测到的 35 个暴中已定位 8 个宿主星系；这些暴及其宿主与重复暴很不相同，提示种群可能存在二分性，但其中一个 ASKAP FRB 又被发现会重复，因此需要搜寻并研究重复现象。

Method: 摘要未说明。摘要仅提到提议搜寻并研究该 FRB 种群中的重复现象，使用综合样本和对定位良好的暴进行密集监测活动，注量极限比其探测注量极限低 60 倍以上，并对重复暴使用独特宽带宽观测；摘要未说明具体望远镜、接收机、频段、时间跨度、样本量或分析流程。

Result: 摘要未说明。摘要未报告本次拟议搜寻的实际结果，只给出背景：ASKAP 在过去三年探测到 35 个暴，其中 8 个定位于红移 0.1 至 0.5 的宿主星系；此前唯一已知重复暴被定位于遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云；这些暴及宿主与重复暴非常不同，提示可能存在二分性；最近发现一个角分定位的 ASKAP FRB 会重复。

Conclusion: 摘要未给出作者基于本文观测得出的结论。摘要提出的解释是这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同，提示该种群中可能存在二分性；并指出最近的重复发现使这一图像复杂化。根据摘要无法判断最终能否刻画重复比例或检验暴辐射模型。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last three years searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 35 bursts, eight of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者基于现有事实提出，FRB群体中可能存在二分性，并计划通过搜寻和监测重复现象来刻画重复暴比例，同时用宽带宽观测检验领先的暴发射模型。根据摘要无法判断这些模型的具体内容及其与脉冲星、磁星或FRB物理联系的适用性。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last two year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 31 bursts, five of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

Conclusion: 作者提出通过大规模样本与密集监测来表征FRB群体中重复暴所占比例，并利用宽带观测检验领先的暴辐射模型。摘要指出这些暴及其寄主与重复暴非常不同，提示群体可能存在二分性；但这一二分性是否成立，根据摘要无法判断。与磁星、脉冲星单脉冲或自转减慢等具体物理联系的适用性，根据摘要无法判断。

Result: 摘要未说明已完成的新观测结果。文中表述的背景结果为：直到去年只有一个已知重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云；过去两年ASKAP搜寻探测到31个暴，其中5个被定位到红移0.1至0.5的宿主星系；这些暴及其宿主与那个重复暴非常不同；其中一个仅被定位到角分尺度的ASKAP FRB最近被发现会重复。摘要未说明该提议的监测灵敏度或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同，提示FRB种群中可能存在二分性；但其中一个仅被定位到角分尺度的ASKAP FRB最近被发现会重复，因此提议通过搜寻和密集监测来表征重复暴比例，并利用宽带宽观测检验主流暴辐射模型。根据摘要无法判断该二分性假设及模型检验的具体物理结论。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last two year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 31 bursts, five of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>


### [816] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2019OCTS_40]()

<details>

Conclusion: 作者提出，这些已定位的暴及其宿主与重复暴很不相同，提示 FRB 群体中可能存在二分性；然而其中一个仅被定位到角分尺度的 ASKAP FRB 最近被发现重复。据此，作者提议通过搜寻与密集监测来刻画重复暴所占比例，并用独特的宽带宽观测检验主流暴辐射模型。根据摘要无法判断重复率的具体数值、该二分性是否成立，以及所用宽带宽观测能否区分各辐射模型。

Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>

### [819] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2020APRS_14]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry,Kumar, Pravir*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 带来的问题仍多于答案；此前仅有一个已知重复暴被定位到明亮射电星云，而 ASKAP 已探测 35 个暴并定位其中 8 个寄主星系，二者性质差异提示种群可能存在二分性。但近期发现一个仅角分级别定位的 ASKAP FRB 会重复，因此需搜寻并研究该种群中的重复现象。

Conclusion: 作者提出的结论是：这些暴及其寄主与已知重复暴非常不同，提示 FRB 种群中可能存在二分性；但一个仅角分级别定位的 ASKAP FRB 最近被发现会重复，因此需要通过低注量极限搜寻与密集监测来表征重复暴比例，并用宽带宽观测检验主流辐射模型。根据摘要无法判断这些结果与脉冲星、磁星或脉冲轮廓演化的具体物理联系。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. </details>

Method: 摘要说明将对这一FRB群体搜寻并研究重复现象，采用综合样本以及对定位良好的暴进行密集监测活动，注量极限比其探测阈值低60倍以上，以刻画会重复的暴所占比例；对会重复的暴将使用独特的宽带宽观测来检验主流暴辐射模型。观测仪器为ASKAP。摘要未说明具体频率或波段、监测时间跨度、样本量细节、统计方法及数据处理流程。

Result: 摘要报告：截至去年，仅有一个暴被定位，即唯一已知的重复暴，定位于遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云（年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云）。过去两年ASKAP搜寻探测到31个暴，其中5个定位到红移0.1–0.5的主星系，这些暴及其宿主与重复暴很不相同，提示群体可能存在二分性。最近发现ASKAP定位到角分尺度的FRB中有一个会重复。所提议的监测将在比其探测低60倍以上的注量极限下刻画重复暴比例。摘要未说明具体数值结果、显著性及统计分析。

Conclusion: 作者据此认为这些ASKAP暴及其宿主与重复暴的差异提示FRB群体可能存在二分性，而一个角分尺度定位的ASKAP FRB被发现重复使这一图景更复杂；作者提议以低注量极限监测来刻画重复暴比例，并用宽带宽观测检验主流暴辐射模型。根据摘要无法判断这些模型检验的具体物理结论及其与脉冲星、磁星或单脉冲发射的关联。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last two year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 31 bursts, five of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>

*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry,Kumar, Pravir*

TL;DR: 该提案拟利用 ASKAP 探测到的 35 个 FRB 样本及对定位良好暴的密集监测，在比原探测低 60 倍以上的流量下限上搜寻重复暴，以刻画重复比例，并用宽带宽观测检验暴辐射模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数 FRB 仍未得到解释，且长期只有唯一一个已知重复暴被定位到明亮射电星云所在的遥远矮星系。近三年 ASKAP 探测到 35 个暴、八个定位于红移 0.1–0.5 的宿主星系，这些暴及其宿主与重复暴很不相同，提示族群可能存在二分性；但一个角分级定位的 ASKAP FRB 最近被发现重复，因此需要系统搜寻和刻画重复现象。

Method: 摘要说明将使用 ASKAP，在覆盖 35 个已探测暴的全面样本上以及针对定位良好的暴开展密集监测活动；监测的流量下限比其被探测时低 60 倍以上，用于刻画重复暴比例。对重复暴将使用独特的宽带宽观测检验主要辐射模型。观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本细节与统计分析方法，摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：此前只有唯一一个已知重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云，可能为年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云；过去三年 ASKAP 探测到 35 个暴，其中八个定位于红移 0.1–0.5 的宿主星系，这些暴及宿主与重复暴非常不同；最近发现一个角分级定位的 ASKAP FRB 重复。摘要中尚未给出本提案的搜寻结果或重复比例数值。

Conclusion: 作者提出，ASKAP 样本中的暴及其宿主与重复暴的差异表明族群可能存在二分性，而一个角分级定位的 ASKAP FRB 最近被发现重复，因此有必要通过低流量下限监测刻画重复暴比例，并用宽带宽观测检验主要辐射模型。该二分性是否成立、以及这些结果对脉冲星或磁星等具体物理图景的启示，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last three years searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 35 bursts, eight of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>

Main category: scix

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Motivation: FRB仍带来多于答案的问题；此前仅有一个重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云。ASKAP近两年探测到31个暴，其中5个定位到红移0.1至0.5的寄主星系，它们与重复暴很不相同，提示群体可能存在二分性，但其中一个角分级定位的ASKAP FRB近期被发现重复，因此需要研究重复现象。

Method: 摘要未说明观测时间跨度、具体频率或频段、样本筛选标准与数据处理细节；仅说明拟利用ASKAP已探测并定位的FRB样本，对定位良好的暴开展密集监测搜寻重复，使用比其探测时低60倍以上的注量限，并利用宽带宽观测检验暴发射模型。

Result: 过去两年ASKAP搜寻探测到31个FRB，其中5个被定位到红移0.1至0.5的寄主星系；这些暴及寄主与已知重复暴非常不同，暗示群体可能存在二分性。近期发现一个角分级定位的ASKAP FRB会重复。摘要未说明拟议观测的具体结果，也未给出重复比例或模型检验结论。

Conclusion: 作者提出通过搜寻和监测重复现象来刻画FRB群体中重复暴所占比例，并以宽带宽观测检验主要的暴发射模型；这些暴及寄主与重复暴的差异暗示群体可能存在二分性。根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星、磁星或单脉冲发射的具体物理联系。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last two year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 31 bursts, five of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>


### [835] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2019OCTS_05]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry,Kumar, Pravir*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划通过搜寻和监测已定位的 ASKAP FRB，在比其探测注量极限低 60 倍以上的注量极限上表征重复暴的比例，并利用宽带宽观测检验主流暴辐射模型；摘要指出，一个此前仅有角分级定位的 ASKAP FRB 最近被发现会重复，而先前已知的 31 个 ASKAP 探测到的暴中有五个被定位于红移 0.1 至 0.5 的寄主星系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 提出的问题仍多于答案；此前唯一被定位到寄主星系并已知重复的暴位于一个遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云。ASKAP 在近两年探测到 31 个暴，其中五个被定位到红移 0.1 至 0.5 的寄主星系，这些暴及其寄主与那个重复暴非常不同，暗示群体中可能存在二分性；而其中一个仅角分级定位的 ASKAP FRB 最近被发现会重复，因此需要搜寻并研究这一群体中的重复现象。

Method: 摘要描述了使用澳大利亚平方公里阵列探路者（ASKAP）的搜寻，以及一项针对定位良好的暴的密集监测活动，注量极限比其探测时的注量极限低 60 倍以上；对该 FRB 群体进行重复现象的搜寻与研究，并对会重复的暴使用宽带宽观测。观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本量、分析流程等具体细节，摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要指出，截至去年只有一个暴被定位到明亮射电星云（年轻的超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云），且该暴是唯一已知会重复的暴；过去两年 ASKAP 搜寻探测到 31 个暴，其中五个被定位到红移 0.1 至 0.5 的寄主星系；这些暴及其寄主与那个重复暴非常不同，表明可能存在群体二分性；最近发现其中一个仅有角分级定位精度的 ASKAP FRB 会重复。提案部分所述的搜寻、监测结果以及重复比例的表征尚未给出。

Conclusion: 摘要提出，这些暴及其寄主与重复暴的差异表明 FRB 群体可能存在二分性，但其中一个角分定位的 ASKAP FRB 最近被发现会重复，因此需要在该群体中搜寻和研究重复现象，以表征重复暴的比例，并用宽带宽观测检验主流暴辐射模型。该二分性以及这些观测对重复暴物理的适用性是否成立，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last two year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 31 bursts, five of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>

*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry,Kumar, Pravir*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提议旨在利用ASKAP搜寻并研究FRB种群中的重复现象：在比探测注量极限低60倍以上的注量极限下，对定位良好的暴开展密集监测以刻画重复暴比例，并用宽带宽观测检验暴发射模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB带来的问题仍多于答案。此前仅有一个重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云；ASKAP近两年探测到31个暴，其中5个定位到红移0.1至0.5的宿主星系，它们与重复暴很不同，暗示种群可能存在二分性，但已有一个角分尺度定位的ASKAP FRB被发现重复。

Method: 摘要提及使用ASKAP在近两年内探测到31个FRB，其中5个定位到红移0.1至0.5的宿主星系；提议搜寻并研究这一FRB种群中的重复现象，对定位良好的暴开展密集监测，注量极限比其探测时低60倍以上，并对重复暴使用宽带宽观测。观测频率、时间跨度、样本统计与具体分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 此前只有一个重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云（年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云）；近两年ASKAP探测到31个暴，其中5个定位到红移0.1至0.5的宿主星系，且这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同，暗示种群可能存在二分性；最近发现角分尺度定位的ASKAP FRB中有一个会重复。摘要未说明注量、显著性或其他定量结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出，这些定位良好的ASKAP暴及其宿主与重复暴的差异暗示FRB种群中可能存在二分性，但一个角分尺度定位的ASKAP FRB被发现重复，因此需要通过低注量极限的密集监测刻画重复暴比例，并用宽带宽观测检验领先的暴发射模型。根据摘要无法判断该二分性及模型检验能否推广到磁星等其他致密星相关解释。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last two year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 31 bursts, five of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>


### [842] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2019OCTS_36]()

Conclusion: 作者提出用全面样本和密集监测刻画重复暴比例，并认为这些结果可能揭示FRB种群的二分性；对重复暴的宽带观测将用于检验主要的暴发射模型。根据摘要无法判断该二分性是否成立，也无法判断其与脉冲星、磁星或FRB起源的直接联系。

Result: 摘要报告：此前仅有一个已知重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云（年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云）；过去两年ASKAP搜寻探测到31个暴，其中五个被定位到红移0.1–0.5的寄主星系；这些暴及寄主与那个重复暴非常不同，提示群体可能存在二分性；近来发现其中一个角分级别定位的ASKAP FRB会重复。所提议的搜寻与监测尚未给出结果，摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者提出的结论是：ASKAP探测到的FRB及其寄主与已知重复暴非常不同，这提示FRB群体中可能存在二分性；但近来发现一个角分级别定位的ASKAP FRB会重复，因此作者提议通过搜寻与密集监测来表征重复暴比例，并用宽带宽观测检验主流暴发射模型。上述为提案目标，尚未有结果支持。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last two year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 31 bursts, five of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>

Over the last three years searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 35 bursts, eight of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>


### [854] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2019OCTS_58]()

### [855] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2019OCTS_54]()

### [861] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2019OCTS_03]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry,Kumar, Pravir*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用ASKAP探测到的31个快速射电暴（FRB）样本，并在通量极限比其探测时低60倍以上的条件下对定位良好的暴进行密集监测，以刻画重复暴的比例；这一工作还得到近期发现其中一个角分定位的ASKAP FRB会重复这一结果的支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB仍提出的问题多于回答的问题。此前仅有一个重复暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云。ASKAP在两年搜寻中探测到31个暴，其中五个定位到红移0.1至0.5的宿主星系，这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同，提示群体中可能存在二分性；而近期又发现一个角分定位的ASKAP FRB会重复，因此需要搜寻并研究该群体中的重复现象。

Method: 摘要未说明该项目的具体观测仪器参数、观测频率或频带、时间跨度、样本筛选与统计分析方法。摘要说明：以全面的样本，对定位良好的暴开展密集监测活动，观测通量极限比其探测时低60倍以上，用于刻画会重复的暴的比例；对会重复的暴使用宽带宽观测来检验主流暴辐射模型。

Result: 摘要说明的历史结果：直到去年，仅有一个暴——唯一已知重复的暴——被定位于一个遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云（要么是年轻超新星遗迹，要么是脉冲星风云）。过去两年ASKAP搜寻探测到31个暴，其中五个定位到红移0.1至0.5的宿主星系；这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同，提示群体可能存在二分性。近期一个角分定位的ASKAP FRB被发现会重复。本项目结果为拟议内容，摘要未给出观测结果。

Conclusion: 作者明确提出的结论是：此前定位的ASKAP暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同，提示FRB群体中可能存在二分性；但近期发现其中一个角分定位的ASKAP FRB会重复。据此，作者提议通过密集监测在更低通量极限下刻画重复暴比例，并用宽带宽观测检验主流暴辐射模型。这些检验是否支持相关物理模型，根据摘要无法判断。

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 快速射电暴（FRB）带来的问题仍多于答案。此前唯一已知重复的暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云，而近三年 ASKAP 探测的 35 个暴中有八个定位于红移 0.1 至 0.5 的宿主星系；这些暴与宿主与重复暴很不相同，暗示群体可能存在二分性，但其中一个角分级定位的 ASKAP FRB 最近被发现重复，因而需要搜寻并研究重复现象。

Method: 摘要未说明所提议观测的具体望远镜、频段、时间跨度或样本数量细节，仅说明这是一项搜寻并研究 FRB 群体中重复现象的观测提案，计划利用综合样本以及对定位良好的暴开展密集监测，在通量密度极限比其探测时低 60 倍以上的条件下刻画重复暴的比例，并对会重复的暴使用独特的宽带宽观测。

Result: 摘要按已有背景说明：直至去年只有一个暴被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云（年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云），且这是唯一已知重复的暴；过去三年 ASKAP 搜寻探测到 35 个暴，其中八个定位于红移从 0.1 到 0.5 的宿主星系。这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同，暗示群体可能存在二分性；最近发现其中一个角分级定位的 ASKAP FRB 会重复。该提案本身的观测结果摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者明确提出的计划是搜寻并研究该 FRB 群体中的重复现象，以刻画重复暴的比例，并用宽带宽观测检验主流暴辐射模型；摘要指出这些暴及其宿主与重复暴非常不同，暗示群体中可能存在二分性，但同时也指出一个角分级定位的 ASKAP FRB 已被发现重复。至于该二分性是否成立、重复机制与辐射模型能否被证实，以及其与脉冲星、磁星或单脉冲发射等的物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last three years searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 35 bursts, eight of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>

Result: 摘要未说明本提案已获得的观测结果。摘要所述背景结果包括：直至去年仅一个重复暴被定位到明亮射电星云；过去两年 ASKAP 搜寻探测到 31 个暴，其中 5 个定位到红移 0.1 至 0.5 的宿主星系；这些暴与宿主与重复暴非常不同，提示可能存在二分性；一个角分级定位的 ASKAP FRB 最近被发现有重复。

Conclusion: 作者提出，通过综合样本和对定位良好的暴进行密集监测，可在低于探测通量极限 60 倍以上的通量极限下刻画重复暴的比例，并利用宽带宽观测检验领先的暴辐射模型。关于这些搜寻或宽带宽观测能否区分群体二分性、或与脉冲星、磁星、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、偏振、计时、自转减慢或磁星—FRB 联系等具体物理图景的关系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last two year searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 31 bursts, five of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>

Method: 摘要说明将使用综合样本，并对定位良好的暴开展密集监测活动，监测流量限比这些暴被探测时低60倍以上，以表征重复暴比例；对会重复的暴使用独特的宽带宽观测。标题提及Parkes观测，项目编号为P958，学期为2020APRS_26。具体观测频率或频段、时间跨度、样本量、分析流程摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要说明，直到去年仅有一个暴（唯一已知重复暴）被定位到遥远矮星系中的明亮射电星云（年轻超新星遗迹或脉冲星风云）；过去三年ASKAP搜寻探测到35个暴，其中8个定位到红移0.1至0.5的宿主星系，这些暴及宿主与重复暴非常不同，提示可能存在群体二分性；最近发现一个角分级定位的ASKAP FRB会重复。摘要未说明监测或搜寻的实际结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出通过低流量限密集监测表征重复暴比例，并用宽带宽观测检验领先的暴发射模型；已定位的ASKAP FRB与重复暴的差异提示群体中可能存在二分性，而一个角分级定位ASKAP FRB被新发现重复。根据摘要无法判断这些观测最终会支持何种具体的物理图景或二分性结论。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) continue to raise more questions than they answer. Until last year, only one burst -- the only one known to repeat - had been localized to a bright radio nebula (either a young supernova remnant or pulsar wind nebulae) in a distant dwarf galaxy. Over the last three years searches with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) have detected 35 bursts, eight of which have been localised to host galaxies at redshifts ranging from 0.1 to 0.5. These bursts and their hosts are very unlike the repeater, suggesting there may be a dichotomy in the population. However one of the arcminute-localised ASKAP FRBs has recently been found to repeat. Here we propose to search and study repetitions in this FRB population. Our comprehensive sample and a dense monitoring campaign of well localised bursts, at a fluence limit more than 60 times lower than that of their detections to characterise the fraction of bursts that repeat. For bursts that repeat the unique wide bandwidth observations will be used to test leading models of burst emission.

</details>

### [881] [Parkes observations for project P958 semester 2019OCTS_86]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Macquart, Jean-Pierre,Dodson, Richard,Phillips, Chris,Deller, Adam,James, Clancy,Bannister, Keith,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Farah, Wael,Qiu, Hao,Zhang, Gerry,Kumar, Pravir*

<details>

### [883] [Modeling large glitches with core superfluidity in a hybrid star](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.02467)
*Yogeesh, N.,Kumar, Anil,Sinha, Monika*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该文将脉冲星建模为混合星，并考虑夸克pasta结构作为超流涡旋的钉扎位点，发现计入核心贡献后计算得到的glitch相对幅度可达 ∆Ω/Ω ~ 10^{-6}，接近Vela类脉冲星的观测值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多脉冲星会出现脉冲轮廓中自转周期突然增加（glitch）的行为，其中一些巨glitch的相对幅度达 ∆Ω/Ω ~ 10^{-6}--10^{-5}；仅用中子星壳层内钉扎的中子涡旋模型迄今无法解释这种大glitch。同时，越来越多大质量脉冲星的证据表明脉冲星内核可能出现奇异自由度，因此需要探索核心涡旋钉扎对glitch的贡献。

Method: 摘要未说明具体的观测或数值方法细节。摘要指出：将脉冲星考虑为混合星，在Gibbs平衡条件下允许强子相与夸克相共存；由于整体电荷中性条件，在强子物质背景中形成夸克pasta结构，并将这些pasta结构作为超流涡旋的钉扎位点；随后在计入核心贡献的情况下进行计算。

Result: 摘要指出，用中子星壳层内钉扎的中子涡旋模型迄今无法解释这种大glitch；而考虑混合星核心中由夸克pasta结构作为钉扎位点所贡献的超流涡旋钉扎后，计算得到的glitch相对幅度达到 ∆Ω/Ω ~ 10^{-6} 的量级，摘要称该结果接近Vela类脉冲星所显示的观测值。

Conclusion: 作者认为，在大质量脉冲星可能存在奇异自由度的背景下，将脉冲星视为混合星并考虑核心内夸克pasta结构对超流涡旋的钉扎，可以给出与Vela类脉冲星观测相近的 ∆Ω/Ω ~ 10^{-6} 量级的glitch幅度，从而为壳层涡旋钉扎模型无法解释的大glitch提供核心贡献的解释途径。根据摘要无法判断该机制对磁星、快速射电暴或其他单脉冲现象是否适用。

Abstract: Many pulsars exhibit a peculiar behavior in their pulse profile of a sudden increase in their rotational period, which is popularly known as a pulsar glitch. Some of them show giant glitches with relative amplitude <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>∆</mml:mi><mml:mi>Ω</mml:mi><mml:mo>/</mml:mo><mml:mi>Ω</mml:mi><mml:mo>~</mml:mo><mml:msup><mml:mrow><mml:mn>10</mml:mn></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:mn>6</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msup><mml:mi>--</mml:mi><mml:msup><mml:mrow><mml:mn>10</mml:mn></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:mn>5</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msup></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula>. With the model of pinned neutron vortices inside the neutron star crust, this large glitch cannot be explained so far. However, the increasing evidence of massive pulsars indicates the appearance of exotic degrees of freedom in the inner core of the pulsars. Given this, we consider the pulsar as a hybrid star. This model opens up the possibility of vortex-pinning inside the core. Under the Gibbs equilibrium conditions, it is possible for hadrons and the quark phase to coexist. Due to the global charge neutrality condition, quark pasta structures are formed in the background of hadronic matter. We consider these pasta structures as pinning sites of superfluid vortices. We show that considering the core contribution, our calculations come to be of the order of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>∆</mml:mi><mml:mi>Ω</mml:mi><mml:mo>/</mml:mo><mml:mi>Ω</mml:mi><mml:mo>~</mml:mo><mml:msup><mml:mn>10</mml:mn><mml:mrow><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:mn>6</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msup></mml:math></inline-formula>, which is close to the observations shown by the Vela-like pulsars.

</details>


### [884] [Mergers Fall Short: Nonmerger Channels Required for Galactic Heavy Element Production]()
*Saleem, Muhammed,Chen, Hsin-Yu,Siegel, Daniel M.,Landry, Philippe,Read, Jocelyn S.,Wang, Kaile*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 通过结合引力波、短伽马射线暴、银河系脉冲星和银河系 [Eu/Fe] 对 [Fe/H] 丰度数据，统一的基于似然的推断表明中子星—黑洞并合和快速并合双中子星系统无法主导银盘所需的额外及时 r 过程增丰，强烈倾向于存在超出这些并合通道的可观及时增丰成分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GW170817 及其千新星确立了中子星并合作为 r 过程元素的关键通道，但银河系盘恒星光谱推断的 r 过程丰度表明可能还需要额外通道；中子星—黑洞并合与快速并合双中子星系统是主要候选，本文评估它们对银盘 r 过程增丰的贡献。

Method: 摘要说明：结合 LIGO—Virgo—KAGRA 引力波观测与短伽马射线暴、银河系脉冲星及银河系 [Eu/Fe] 对 [Fe/H] 丰度观测数据；采用统一的、基于似然的推断框架，一致地传播并合率、延迟时间分布、依赖于质量和自旋的抛射物产额以及恒星丰度测量的不确定性。其余观测细节、频率、时间跨度与样本量摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要指出：除非对并合率或产额作出极端假设，中子星—黑洞并合和快速并合双中子星族群都无法主导盘恒星数据所要求的额外及时增丰；在所采用模型内，结果强烈倾向于一个超出本文所考虑并合通道的可观及时增丰成分。摘要未说明具体数值、显著性水平或单一来源结果。

Conclusion: 作者明确支持的结论是：在所采用模型内，中子星—黑洞并合与快速并合双中子星系统不足以解释银盘恒星数据要求的额外及时增丰，除非对并合率或产额作极端假设，因而强烈倾向于存在超出这些并合通道的可观及时增丰成分。关于该未识别通道的具体物理性质及其与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、模式转换、偏振或快速射电暴的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Since the discovery of the binary neutron star merger GW170817 and its associated kilonova, neutron star mergers have been established as a key production channel for r-process elements in the Universe. However, multiple lines of evidence, including the observations of r-process abundances as inferred from stellar spectra of Milky Way disk stars, suggest that additional channels may be needed to fully account for the r-process element enrichment in the Milky Way. Neutron star--black hole mergers and fast-merging binary neutron star systems are among the leading alternative candidates. In this paper, we combine gravitational-wave observations from LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA with data from short gamma-ray bursts, Galactic pulsars, and Galactic [Eu/Fe] versus [Fe/H] abundance observations to assess the contribution of these mergers to r-process enrichment in the Galactic disk. Our analysis employs a unified, likelihood-based inference framework that consistently propagates uncertainties in merger rates, delay-time distributions, mass- and spin-dependent ejecta yields, and stellar abundance measurements. We find that neither neutron star--black hole mergers nor fast-merging binary neutron star populations can dominate the additional prompt enrichment required by the disk-star data unless one invokes extreme assumptions about merger rates or yields. Within the adopted model, these results strongly favor a substantial prompt enrichment component beyond the merger channels considered here.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 摘要未说明具体的观测数据或仪器。理论上，作者将强磁场作为外部对称性破缺背景引入核子-介子模型，纳入磁催化与朗道量子化效应，分析相结构并重点考察磁化物质中 CDW 的起始与稳定性，同时求解 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程计算相应的中子星质量-半径关系。

Result: 强磁场使 CDW 相起始的临界重子化学势相比零场情形最多降低约 200 MeV，并在相关密度区间使状态方程变硬，从而可能允许存在具有各向异性核心的稳定中子星。

Conclusion: 作者认为，中子星中的强磁场可能使空间调制的手征相在天体物理环境中成为可能。该结论基于核子-介子模型的理论计算与质量-半径关系求解；摘要未说明对脉冲星、磁星观测或快速射电暴的直接观测检验，根据摘要无法判断其与单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振或射电频谱等具体观测量的联系。

Abstract: The possible existence of inhomogeneous chiral condensates, such as chiral density waves (CDWs), in the cores of neutron stars has garnered considerable theoretical interest. However, recent studies using nucleon-meson models incorporating electric charge neutrality, β equilibrium, and fermionic vacuum fluctuations suggest that CDW phases are energetically unfavorable under realistic neutron star conditions due to the softness of the resulting equation of state (EoS). In this work, we reexamine the viability of CDW phases in dense nuclear matter by introducing a strong magnetic field as an external symmetry-breaking background. Motivated by observations of magnetars and theoretical predictions of ultrastrong internal magnetic fields (<inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mo>≳</mml:mo><mml:msup><mml:mn>10</mml:mn><mml:mn>18</mml:mn></mml:msup><mml:mspace></mml:mspace><mml:mi>G</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula>), we extend the nucleon-meson model to include magnetic catalysis and Landau quantization effects. We analyze the phase structure, focusing on the onset and stability of the CDW in magnetized matter, and compute corresponding neutron star mass-radius relations by solving the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations. Our results indicate that strong magnetic fields lower the critical baryon chemical potential for the onset of the CDW phase by up to <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mo>≈</mml:mo><mml:mn>200</mml:mn><mml:mspace></mml:mspace><mml:mi>MeV</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> compared to the zero-field case and stiffen the EoS in the relevant density regime, potentially allowing for stable neutron stars with anisotropic cores. These findings suggest that strong magnetic fields in neutron stars could make spatially modulated chiral phases possible in astrophysical environments.

</details>


### [886] [Thermodynamic versus dynamical description of the neutron-star crust-core instability: Implications for crustal observables]()
*Kunjipurayil, Athul,Piekarewicz, J.*
