### [957] [Parkes observations for project P1344 semester 2024OCTS_05]()
*Uttarkar, Pavan,Deller, Adam,Bannister, Keith,Shannon, Ryan,Glowacki, Marcin,Kumar, Pravir,Wang, Yuanming,Wang, Ziteng,Gupta, Vivek,Gourdji, Kelly,Jahns-Schindler, Joscha*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用 Parkes/Murriyang 上 UWL 的大带宽，在未分配时间/Green Time 内跟踪通过 CRACO 发现的重复源类 FRB 天体，以研究其宽带谱偏振特征；摘要指出，由于 ASKAP 分数带宽有限且具巡天性质，其探测重复源谱偏振特征并非最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管迄今已发表 &gt;700 个 FRB，且重复与非重复 FRB 之间呈现出明显二分性，但关于 FRB 辐射产生的物理机制仍缺乏理解；对重复 FRB 源的后续观测受限于不同望远镜的可用带宽与巡天性质，尤其是 ASKAP 因分数带宽有限并不适合最优地探测重复源的谱偏振特征，因此需要大带宽仪器进行跟踪观测。

Method: 摘要说明拟利用 Parkes/Murriyang 上超宽带低频（UWL）的未分配时间/Green Time，对通过 CRACO 发现的重复源类 FRB 天体进行后续跟踪观测，以研究其宽带谱偏振特征。摘要提到 ASKAP 的 FRB 探测系统相干升级后预计每周探测约 1 个 FRB，并指出 ASKAP 的分数带宽有限且具巡天性质。观测频率范围、时间跨度、样本量、具体数据分析方法等方面摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未报告新的观测结果，而是提出观测建议：利用 Parkes/Murriyang 上 UWL 的未分配时间/Green Time 跟踪 CRACO 发现的重复源类 FRB 天体，以研究其宽带谱偏振特征。摘要陈述的背景结果包括：一些 FRB 已被观测到重复，而另一些没有；过去十年新的专用 FRB 探测系统使探测数量指数增长；迄今已发表 &gt;700 个 FRB；ASKAP 的 FRB 探测系统相干升级后预计每周探测约 1 个 FRB。具体观测数值、显著性、谱偏振测量结果摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为，Parkes/Murriyang 上 UWL 提供的大带宽是跟踪通过 CRACO 发现的重复 FRB 源、研究其宽带谱偏振特征的理想仪器，并建议利用 UWL 上的未分配时间/Green Time 开展此项跟踪观测。关于该跟踪观测能否揭示 FRB 辐射机制或检验前身星模型，摘要仅将其表述为重复 FRB 样本可用于揭示源物理与检验模型的可能性；具体物理结论根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The commissioning of new dedicated FRB detection systems has led to an exponential increase in the detected FRBs over the last decade. Despite &gt;700 FRBs published to date, there is still a lack of understanding about the physical mechanisms through which FRB emission is produced. Due to the possibility of detecting multiple bursts from the same source in a repeating FRB, it forms an ideal sample set to uncover the physics of the source (e.g., emission mechanism, progenitor surrounding media), and test possible progenitor models. The coherent upgrade to the FRB detection system to ASKAP is expected to detect ~1 FRB/week. However, due to the limited fractional bandwidth available with ASKAP and survey nature of the telescope, probing the spectro-polarimetric characteristics of repeating sources is non-optimal. Hence, the large bandwidth offered by the ultra wideband-low (UWL) on Parkes/Murriyang is an ideal instrument to follow-up repeating FRB sources discovered through CRACO. We propose using the unallocated time/Green Time on UWL to follow up repeater-like sources to study their wideband spectro-polarimetric characteristics.

</details>


### [958] [Parkes observations for project P1344 semester 2024OCTS_07]()
*Uttarkar, Pavan,Deller, Adam,Bannister, Keith,Shannon, Ryan,Glowacki, Marcin,Kumar, Pravir,Wang, Yuanming,Wang, Ziteng,Gupta, Vivek,Gourdji, Kelly,Jahns-Schindler, Joscha*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案提出利用Parkes/Murriyang的UWL，对通过CRACO发现的类重复FRB源开展后续跟踪观测，以研究其宽带频谱-偏振特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB是河外毫秒射电暴；自首个FRB在Parkes/Murriyang存档数据中被发现以来，族群中出现了重复与不重复的明显二分性，且即使经不同望远镜大量跟踪观测仍未解决。尽管迄今已发表>700个FRB，其辐射物理机制仍缺乏理解；重复FRB可从同一源探测多个暴，是揭示发射机制与前身星周围介质、检验前身星模型的理想样本。

Method: 该文为观测提案：拟利用Parkes/Murriyang上超宽带-低频（UWL）的未分配时间/Green Time，对通过CRACO发现的类重复源进行后续跟踪观测，以研究其宽带频谱-偏振特性。摘要提到ASKAP的FRB探测系统相干升级预计约1个FRB/周，并指出ASKAP可用分数带宽有限、望远镜具巡天性质，因而探测重复源的频谱-偏振特性并非最优。具体观测频率范围、时间跨度、样本量与分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未说明实际观测结果。摘要报告的是背景与可行性论证：FRB已在Parkes/Murriyang多波束存档数据中被首次发现；族群中呈现重复与不重复的二分性；过去十年新专用FRB探测系统的投入使用使探测到的FRB数量呈指数增长；迄今已发表>700个FRB；ASKAP的相干升级预计探测约1个FRB/周；UWL的大带宽被视为对CRACO发现的重复源开展后续跟踪的理想条件。尚无具体源、暴、频谱或偏振测量结果。

Conclusion: 作者明确提出，UWL的大带宽是后续跟踪CRACO发现的重复FRB源的理想手段，并提议用UWL未分配时间/Green Time跟踪类重复源，以研究其宽带频谱-偏振特性；其目标是揭示源的物理（如发射机制、前身星周围介质）并检验可能的前身星模型。对FRB与脉冲星、磁星或FRB与其他暂现源之间具体物理联系的解释，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The commissioning of new dedicated FRB detection systems has led to an exponential increase in the detected FRBs over the last decade. Despite &gt;700 FRBs published to date, there is still a lack of understanding about the physical mechanisms through which FRB emission is produced. Due to the possibility of detecting multiple bursts from the same source in a repeating FRB, it forms an ideal sample set to uncover the physics of the source (e.g., emission mechanism, progenitor surrounding media), and test possible progenitor models. The coherent upgrade to the FRB detection system to ASKAP is expected to detect ~1 FRB/week. However, due to the limited fractional bandwidth available with ASKAP and survey nature of the telescope, probing the spectro-polarimetric characteristics of repeating sources is non-optimal. Hence, the large bandwidth offered by the ultra wideband-low (UWL) on Parkes/Murriyang is an ideal instrument to follow-up repeating FRB sources discovered through CRACO. We propose using the unallocated time/Green Time on UWL to follow up repeater-like sources to study their wideband spectro-polarimetric characteristics.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 作者提出利用Parkes/Murriyang的UWL大带宽跟进CRACO发现的类重复源，以研究其宽带谱偏振特征，认为这适合弥补ASKAP在重复源谱偏振研究上的非最优条件。摘要未说明。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The commissioning of new dedicated FRB detection systems has led to an exponential increase in the detected FRBs over the last decade. Despite &gt;700 FRBs published to date, there is still a lack of understanding about the physical mechanisms through which FRB emission is produced. Due to the possibility of detecting multiple bursts from the same source in a repeating FRB, it forms an ideal sample set to uncover the physics of the source (e.g., emission mechanism, progenitor surrounding media), and test possible progenitor models. The coherent upgrade to the FRB detection system to ASKAP is expected to detect ~1 FRB/week. However, due to the limited fractional bandwidth available with ASKAP and survey nature of the telescope, probing the spectro-polarimetric characteristics of repeating sources is non-optimal. Hence, the large bandwidth offered by the ultra wideband-low (UWL) on Parkes/Murriyang is an ideal instrument to follow-up repeating FRB sources discovered through CRACO. We propose using the unallocated time/Green Time on UWL to follow up repeater-like sources to study their wideband spectro-polarimetric characteristics.

### [966] [Parkes observations for project P1344 semester 2024OCTS_01]()
*Uttarkar, Pavan,Deller, Adam,Bannister, Keith,Shannon, Ryan,Glowacki, Marcin,Kumar, Pravir,Wang, Yuanming,Wang, Ziteng,Gupta, Vivek,Gourdji, Kelly,Jahns-Schindler, Joscha*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用Parkes/Murriyang上的超宽带低频（UWL）在未分配时间/Green Time对通过CRACO发现的类重复FRB源进行后随观测，以研究其宽带谱偏振特征，因为ASKAP在探测重复源谱偏振特征方面受限于分数带宽和巡天性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB是河外毫秒射电暴，其族群存在重复与不重复的二分性，尽管开展了大量后随观测，仍缺乏对其辐射物理机制的理解；在重复FRB中可能从同一源探测到多次暴发，使其成为揭示源物理并检验前身星模型的理想样本。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测时间跨度与样本大小；摘要说明拟使用Parkes/Murriyang上的超宽带低频（UWL）的未分配时间/Green Time，后随通过CRACO发现的类重复FRB源，并研究其宽带谱偏振特征。

Result: 迄今已发表超过700个FRB；一些FRB被观测到会重复，另一些则不会；对ASKAP的FRB探测系统进行相干升级后预计可探测约1个FRB/周；ASKAP因分数带宽有限及巡天性质，探测重复源谱偏振特征并非最优。摘要未报告本提案的实际观测结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，重复FRB提供了揭示源物理并检验前身星模型的理想样本，而Parkes/Murriyang上UWL的大带宽是后随CRACO发现的重复FRB源的理想仪器，因此提议用UWL未分配时间/Green Time研究其宽带谱偏振特征。根据摘要无法判断本提案对FRB物理机制的最终结论或与脉冲星、磁星的具体联系。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The commissioning of new dedicated FRB detection systems has led to an exponential increase in the detected FRBs over the last decade. Despite &gt;700 FRBs published to date, there is still a lack of understanding about the physical mechanisms through which FRB emission is produced. Due to the possibility of detecting multiple bursts from the same source in a repeating FRB, it forms an ideal sample set to uncover the physics of the source (e.g., emission mechanism, progenitor surrounding media), and test possible progenitor models. The coherent upgrade to the FRB detection system to ASKAP is expected to detect ~1 FRB/week. However, due to the limited fractional bandwidth available with ASKAP and survey nature of the telescope, probing the spectro-polarimetric characteristics of repeating sources is non-optimal. Hence, the large bandwidth offered by the ultra wideband-low (UWL) on Parkes/Murriyang is an ideal instrument to follow-up repeating FRB sources discovered through CRACO. We propose using the unallocated time/Green Time on UWL to follow up repeater-like sources to study their wideband spectro-polarimetric characteristics.

</details>


### [967] [Parkes observations for project P1344 semester 2024OCTS_04]()
*Uttarkar, Pavan,Deller, Adam,Bannister, Keith,Shannon, Ryan,Glowacki, Marcin,Kumar, Pravir,Wang, Yuanming,Wang, Ziteng,Gupta, Vivek,Gourdji, Kelly,Jahns-Schindler, Joscha*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用 Parkes/Murriyang 的超宽带低频（UWL）仪器，在未分配时间/Green Time 内跟进 CRACO 发现的类似重复源的 FRB 源，以研究其宽带谱偏振特征。摘要报告称，尽管迄今已发表超过 700 个 FRB 且探测数量呈指数增长，FRB 辐射的物理机制仍缺乏理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自首个 FRB 在 Parkes/Murriyang 多波束存档数据中被发现以来，FRB 群体呈现出重复与不重复的二分性；尽管使用不同射电望远镜开展了大量后续观测，且十余年来新建专用探测系统使探测到的 FRB 数量指数增长，迄今已发表超过 700 个 FRB，但对其辐射产生的物理机制仍缺乏理解。重复 FRB 源可能提供同一源的多个暴，因而构成揭示源物理并检验前身星模型的理想样本。

Method: 摘要说明这是一项观测提案：使用 Parkes/Murriyang 上的超宽带低频（UWL），并利用未分配的时间/Green Time，跟进由 CRACO 发现的类似重复源的源，以研究其宽带谱偏振特征。摘要将 ASKAP 的 FRB 探测系统升级及其跟踪观测的局限作为使用 UWL 的理由。具体观测频率、时间跨度、样本量、现场观测或分析流程等：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告，自首个 FRB 在 Parkes/Murriyang 多波束存档数据中被发现以来，FRB 群体呈现出明显的二分性：一些 FRB 会重复，另一些则不会重复，尽管人们使用不同射电望远镜开展了大量后续观测。过去十年中，新建的专用 FRB 探测系统使探测到的 FRB 呈指数增长，迄今已发表超过 700 个 FRB。摘要还指出，对 ASKAP 的 FRB 探测系统进行相干升级后预计每周可探测到约 1 个 FRB；但由于 ASKAP 可用的相对带宽有限及其巡天性质，探测重复源的谱偏振特征并非最优。该提案本身的具体观测结果：摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者提出的结论是：尽管已发表超过 700 个 FRB，其辐射产生的物理机制仍缺乏理解；重复 FRB 源因可能从同一源探测到多个暴，是揭示辐射机制和前身星周围介质等源物理、并检验可能前身星模型的理想样本。作者还指出，ASKAP 相对的带宽限制和巡天性质使其不最适合探测重复源的谱偏振特征，而 Parkes/Murriyang 的 UWL 大带宽是跟进 CRACO 发现的重复 FRB 源的理想仪器；因此提议利用未分配时间/Green Time 研究类似重复源的宽带谱偏振特征。与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢转矩变化、偏振或 FRB–磁星联系等主题的具体关系：根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The commissioning of new dedicated FRB detection systems has led to an exponential increase in the detected FRBs over the last decade. Despite &gt;700 FRBs published to date, there is still a lack of understanding about the physical mechanisms through which FRB emission is produced. Due to the possibility of detecting multiple bursts from the same source in a repeating FRB, it forms an ideal sample set to uncover the physics of the source (e.g., emission mechanism, progenitor surrounding media), and test possible progenitor models. The coherent upgrade to the FRB detection system to ASKAP is expected to detect ~1 FRB/week. However, due to the limited fractional bandwidth available with ASKAP and survey nature of the telescope, probing the spectro-polarimetric characteristics of repeating sources is non-optimal. Hence, the large bandwidth offered by the ultra wideband-low (UWL) on Parkes/Murriyang is an ideal instrument to follow-up repeating FRB sources discovered through CRACO. We propose using the unallocated time/Green Time on UWL to follow up repeater-like sources to study their wideband spectro-polarimetric characteristics.

</details>


### [968] [Parkes observations for project P1344 semester 2024OCTS_06]()
*Uttarkar, Pavan,Deller, Adam,Bannister, Keith,Shannon, Ryan,Glowacki, Marcin,Kumar, Pravir,Wang, Yuanming,Wang, Ziteng,Gupta, Vivek,Gourdji, Kelly,Jahns-Schindler, Joscha*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提议计划利用 Parkes/Murriyang 的 UWL 在未分配时间/Green Time 内对通过 CRACO 发现的类似重复源进行后续观测，以研究其宽带谱偏振特征；摘要指出 ASKAP 因分数带宽有限和巡天性质，在探测重复源的谱偏振特征方面并非最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 是河外毫秒时标射电暴；自首个 FRB 在 Parkes/Murriyang 多波束存档数据中被发现以来，其族群出现重复与不重复的二分性，尽管已有大量不同射电望远镜的后续观测。专用 FRB 探测系统使探测数量在近十年指数增长，但迄今已发表 &gt;700 个 FRB，仍缺乏对 FRB 辐射产生物理机制的理解。

Method: 摘要描述的是观测提议：利用 Parkes/Murriyang 上超宽带低频（UWL）的未分配时间/Green Time，对通过 CRACO 发现的类似重复源的源进行后续观测，研究其宽带谱偏振特征。摘要提到 ASKAP 探测系统相干升级后预计每周探测到 ~1 个 FRB，并指出 ASKAP 的分数带宽有限及其巡天性质。具体观测频率、时间跨度、样本大小和分析方法：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未报告该提议的实际观测结果。摘要陈述的背景结果为：自首次在 Parkes/Murriyang 多波束存档数据中发现第一个 FRB 以来，族群中已出现重复与不重复的二分性；尽管进行了大量后续观测，一些 FRB 被观测到会重复，而另一些则不会重复；过去十年中探测到的 FRB 数量呈指数增长；迄今已发表 &gt;700 个 FRB；ASKAP 相干升级的 FRB 探测系统预计每周探测到 ~1 个 FRB。

Conclusion: 作者提出的核心观点是：重复 FRB 因可能从同一源探测到多次爆发，构成理想样本集，可用于揭示源的物理机制（例如辐射机制、前身星周围介质）并检验可能的前身星模型。作者认为，由于 ASKAP 分数带宽有限及巡天性质，探测重复源谱偏振特征并非最优，而 Parkes/Murriyang 的 UWL 大带宽适合后续观测 CRACO 发现的重复 FRB 源，以研究其宽带谱偏振特征。根据摘要无法判断其对脉冲星、磁星或 FRB–磁星联系的具体物理推论。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The commissioning of new dedicated FRB detection systems has led to an exponential increase in the detected FRBs over the last decade. Despite &gt;700 FRBs published to date, there is still a lack of understanding about the physical mechanisms through which FRB emission is produced. Due to the possibility of detecting multiple bursts from the same source in a repeating FRB, it forms an ideal sample set to uncover the physics of the source (e.g., emission mechanism, progenitor surrounding media), and test possible progenitor models. The coherent upgrade to the FRB detection system to ASKAP is expected to detect ~1 FRB/week. However, due to the limited fractional bandwidth available with ASKAP and survey nature of the telescope, probing the spectro-polarimetric characteristics of repeating sources is non-optimal. Hence, the large bandwidth offered by the ultra wideband-low (UWL) on Parkes/Murriyang is an ideal instrument to follow-up repeating FRB sources discovered through CRACO. We propose using the unallocated time/Green Time on UWL to follow up repeater-like sources to study their wideband spectro-polarimetric characteristics.

</details>

### [971] [Parkes observations for project P1068 semester 2020APRS_42]()
*Price, Danny,Deller, Adam,Shannon, Ryan,Lee, Kejia,Kumar, Pravir,Gajjar, Vishal,Siemion, Andrew*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请拟用Parkes的UWL观测重复FRB 180301，以限制其重复率、识别脉冲特性随时间的变化，并为发射机制提供洞见；该源最初探测时无法被常规Faraday rotation模型很好地拟合，并显示出显著的圆偏振。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB领域中“有多大比例的FRB会重复”这一关键问题仍未解决；目前已知约10个重复FRB，其频谱-时间特性暗示与看似不重复的暴存在差异，但统计量不足，无法作出确定判断。FRB 180301是FAST观测到的第一个重复FRB，且具有迄今FRB中第二高的rotation measure。

Method: 申请使用Parkes望远镜的UWL观测FRB 180301，以刻画其宽带发射特性；将并行使用Medusa后端与Breakthrough Listen数据记录器（BL），并在观测后立即把数据传输至BL。摘要未说明观测频率、时间跨度、样本量及具体分析流程细节。

Result: FRB 180301是FAST望远镜看到的第一个重复FRB，并具有迄今FRB中第二高的rotation measure，仅次于最初的重复暴FRB121102。在其最初探测中，该源无法被常规Faraday rotation模型很好地拟合，并显示出显著的圆偏振。摘要未说明重复率、脉冲特性随时间变化的观测结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出的解释是：FRB 180301最初探测中常规Faraday rotation模型拟合不佳以及显著圆偏振，可能表明其前身星嵌入在一个具有复杂磁场结构的极端磁离子环境中，而这样的环境此前从未被观测到。该申请预期通过观测限制重复率、识别脉冲特性随时间的变化并为发射机制提供洞见；所获数据还将被用于为UWL构建FRB流程原型并广泛提供给类似研究。根据摘要无法判断这些目标能否实现。

Abstract: In the fast-moving world of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs), the key question of what fraction (as high as 100%?) of FRBs emit repeat bursts remains unanswered. Of order 10 repeating FRBs are now known, and their spectro-temporal properties hint at differences with apparently non-repeating bursts - but poor statistics preclude a definitive diagnosis. FRB 180301 is a promising source for further study for multiple reasons: it is the first repeating FRB seen by the FAST telescope, and has the second-highest rotation measure ever seen for a FRB (after the original repeater, FRB121102). We request Parkes observations with the UWL to characterise the broadband emission properties of this FRB, with the following key goals: to constrain the repetition rate, identify any variation of pulse characteristics over time, and provide insight into the emission mechanisms. In its initial detection, FRB 180301 was poorly fit by regular Faraday rotation models, and showed significant circular polarization, which may indicate the progenitor is embedded in an extreme magneto-ionic environment with complex field structure that has not been seen before. These observations will generate a large data volume. We will use the Medusa backend in parallel with the Breakthrough Listen data recorder (BL), and will transfer data to BL immediately after observations.These data will be used by P. Kumar to prototype a FRB pipeline for the UWL, that will be made broadly available for similar studies.

</details>

Result: 摘要说明：目前已知约10个重复FRB，其频谱-时间性质暗示与看似非重复的暴存在差异，但统计量不足。FRB 180301是FAST看到的第一个重复FRB，并具有迄今FRB中第二高的旋转测度（仅次于最初的重复暴FRB121102）。在其初始探测中，FRB 180301无法被常规法拉第旋转模型很好地拟合，并显示出显著圆偏振。摘要中给出的观测目标尚无新观测结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出，FRB 180301在初始探测中无法被常规法拉第旋转模型很好地拟合且显示显著圆偏振，这可能表明其progenitor处于一个此前未曾见过的、具有复杂场结构的极端磁离子环境中。所申请的观测旨在约束重复率、识别脉冲特征随时间的变化并为发射机制提供见解。根据摘要无法判断这些观测量能否明确区分不同发射机制。

Abstract: In the fast-moving world of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs), the key question of what fraction (as high as 100%?) of FRBs emit repeat bursts remains unanswered. Of order 10 repeating FRBs are now known, and their spectro-temporal properties hint at differences with apparently non-repeating bursts - but poor statistics preclude a definitive diagnosis. FRB 180301 is a promising source for further study for multiple reasons: it is the first repeating FRB seen by the FAST telescope, and has the second-highest rotation measure ever seen for a FRB (after the original repeater, FRB121102). We request Parkes observations with the UWL to characterise the broadband emission properties of this FRB, with the following key goals: to constrain the repetition rate, identify any variation of pulse characteristics over time, and provide insight into the emission mechanisms. In its initial detection, FRB 180301 was poorly fit by regular Faraday rotation models, and showed significant circular polarization, which may indicate the progenitor is embedded in an extreme magneto-ionic environment with complex field structure that has not been seen before. These observations will generate a large data volume. We will use the Medusa backend in parallel with the Breakthrough Listen data recorder (BL), and will transfer data to BL immediately after observations.These data will be used by P. Kumar to prototype a FRB pipeline for the UWL, that will be made broadly available for similar studies.

</details>

Result: 摘要未说明新的观测结果。摘要提及的既有情况为：在FRB 180301的初始探测中，规则法拉第旋转模型对其拟合很差，且该源显示出显著圆偏振；它是FAST望远镜看到的第一个重复FRB，并具有迄今FRB中第二高的旋转测度（仅次于最初的重复暴FRB121102）。摘要未给出重复率、脉冲特征变化或流水线性能的具体数值。

Conclusion: 摘要提出，该源在初始探测中拟合差且具有显著圆偏振，可能表明其前身天体嵌入在一个具有此前未曾见过的复杂场结构的极端磁离子环境中（用“可能”表述，属待检验推测）。所申请观测旨在限制重复率、识别脉冲特征随时间的变化并为发射机制提供洞见；对于磁星关联或其他前身天体模型，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: In the fast-moving world of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs), the key question of what fraction (as high as 100%?) of FRBs emit repeat bursts remains unanswered. Of order 10 repeating FRBs are now known, and their spectro-temporal properties hint at differences with apparently non-repeating bursts - but poor statistics preclude a definitive diagnosis. FRB 180301 is a promising source for further study for multiple reasons: it is the first repeating FRB seen by the FAST telescope, and has the second-highest rotation measure ever seen for a FRB (after the original repeater, FRB121102). We request Parkes observations with the UWL to characterise the broadband emission properties of this FRB, with the following key goals: to constrain the repetition rate, identify any variation of pulse characteristics over time, and provide insight into the emission mechanisms. In its initial detection, FRB 180301 was poorly fit by regular Faraday rotation models, and showed significant circular polarization, which may indicate the progenitor is embedded in an extreme magneto-ionic environment with complex field structure that has not been seen before. These observations will generate a large data volume. We will use the Medusa backend in parallel with the Breakthrough Listen data recorder (BL), and will transfer data to BL immediately after observations.These data will be used by P. Kumar to prototype a FRB pipeline for the UWL, that will be made broadly available for similar studies.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者认为，FRB 180301最初探测中难以用常规法拉第旋转模型拟合并伴有显著圆偏振，可能表明其前身星嵌入在一个具有此前未曾见过的复杂场结构的极端磁离子环境中；这些观测旨在为发射机制提供洞见。所提议的流程原型化工作，属于方法学层面的潜在相关性，摘要未说明其已确立的结果。

Abstract: In the fast-moving world of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs), the key question of what fraction (as high as 100%?) of FRBs emit repeat bursts remains unanswered. Of order 10 repeating FRBs are now known, and their spectro-temporal properties hint at differences with apparently non-repeating bursts - but poor statistics preclude a definitive diagnosis. FRB 180301 is a promising source for further study for multiple reasons: it is the first repeating FRB seen by the FAST telescope, and has the second-highest rotation measure ever seen for a FRB (after the original repeater, FRB121102). We request Parkes observations with the UWL to characterise the broadband emission properties of this FRB, with the following key goals: to constrain the repetition rate, identify any variation of pulse characteristics over time, and provide insight into the emission mechanisms. In its initial detection, FRB 180301 was poorly fit by regular Faraday rotation models, and showed significant circular polarization, which may indicate the progenitor is embedded in an extreme magneto-ionic environment with complex field structure that has not been seen before. These observations will generate a large data volume. We will use the Medusa backend in parallel with the Breakthrough Listen data recorder (BL), and will transfer data to BL immediately after observations.These data will be used by P. Kumar to prototype a FRB pipeline for the UWL, that will be made broadly available for similar studies.

</details>

Conclusion: 显著圆偏振以及常规法拉第旋转模型拟合不佳，可能表明FRB 180301的前身星嵌于一个具有复杂场结构的极端磁离子环境中，而这是此前未曾见过的；所申请观测旨在限制重复率、识别脉冲特征随时间的变化并揭示发射机制。这些数据还将被P. Kumar用于为UWL构建FRB流水线原型，并广泛提供用于类似研究。根据摘要无法判断该解释是否可推广到其他重复FRB或FRB整体。

Abstract: In the fast-moving world of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs), the key question of what fraction (as high as 100%?) of FRBs emit repeat bursts remains unanswered. Of order 10 repeating FRBs are now known, and their spectro-temporal properties hint at differences with apparently non-repeating bursts - but poor statistics preclude a definitive diagnosis. FRB 180301 is a promising source for further study for multiple reasons: it is the first repeating FRB seen by the FAST telescope, and has the second-highest rotation measure ever seen for a FRB (after the original repeater, FRB121102). We request Parkes observations with the UWL to characterise the broadband emission properties of this FRB, with the following key goals: to constrain the repetition rate, identify any variation of pulse characteristics over time, and provide insight into the emission mechanisms. In its initial detection, FRB 180301 was poorly fit by regular Faraday rotation models, and showed significant circular polarization, which may indicate the progenitor is embedded in an extreme magneto-ionic environment with complex field structure that has not been seen before. These observations will generate a large data volume. We will use the Medusa backend in parallel with the Breakthrough Listen data recorder (BL), and will transfer data to BL immediately after observations.These data will be used by P. Kumar to prototype a FRB pipeline for the UWL, that will be made broadly available for similar studies.

</details>

Of order 10 repeating FRBs are now known, and their spectro-temporal properties hint at differences with apparently non-repeating bursts - but poor statistics preclude a definitive diagnosis. FRB 180301 is a promising source for further study for multiple reasons: it is the first repeating FRB seen by the FAST telescope, and has the second-highest rotation measure ever seen for a FRB (after the original repeater, FRB121102). We request Parkes observations with the UWL to characterise the broadband emission properties of this FRB, with the following key goals: to constrain the repetition rate, identify any variation of pulse characteristics over time, and provide insight into the emission mechanisms. In its initial detection, FRB 180301 was poorly fit by regular Faraday rotation models, and showed significant circular polarization, which may indicate the progenitor is embedded in an extreme magneto-ionic environment with complex field structure that has not been seen before. These observations will generate a large data volume. We will use the Medusa backend in parallel with the Breakthrough Listen data recorder (BL), and will transfer data to BL immediately after observations.These data will be used by P. Kumar to prototype a FRB pipeline for the UWL, that will be made broadly available for similar studies.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者提出，FRB 180301初始探测中非寻常的法拉第旋转拟合与显著圆偏振可能表明其前身天体处于具有复杂场结构的极端磁电离环境中，而这种环境此前未曾见过；拟议观测旨在限制重复率、识别脉冲特征随时间的变化并洞察辐射机制。上述环境解释属于可能性表述，摘要未给出确定性结论。该工作提出的UWL FRB处理流程为类似研究提供方法上的潜在价值，但并非本提案已建立的结果。

Abstract: In the fast-moving world of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs), the key question of what fraction (as high as 100%?) of FRBs emit repeat bursts remains unanswered. Of order 10 repeating FRBs are now known, and their spectro-temporal properties hint at differences with apparently non-repeating bursts - but poor statistics preclude a definitive diagnosis. FRB 180301 is a promising source for further study for multiple reasons: it is the first repeating FRB seen by the FAST telescope, and has the second-highest rotation measure ever seen for a FRB (after the original repeater, FRB121102). We request Parkes observations with the UWL to characterise the broadband emission properties of this FRB, with the following key goals: to constrain the repetition rate, identify any variation of pulse characteristics over time, and provide insight into the emission mechanisms. In its initial detection, FRB 180301 was poorly fit by regular Faraday rotation models, and showed significant circular polarization, which may indicate the progenitor is embedded in an extreme magneto-ionic environment with complex field structure that has not been seen before. These observations will generate a large data volume. We will use the Medusa backend in parallel with the Breakthrough Listen data recorder (BL), and will transfer data to BL immediately after observations.These data will be used by P. Kumar to prototype a FRB pipeline for the UWL, that will be made broadly available for similar studies.

</details>

### [1013] [Parkes observations for project P1363 semester 2025APRS_07]()
*Shaji, Kavya,Murphy, Tara,Stappers, Benjamin,Caleb, Manisha,Rajwade, Kaustubh,Tian, Jun,Pastor-Marazuela, Inés*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提议提出用 Murriyang UWL 接收机在六个月期间监测超活跃重复快速射电暴 FRB 20240619D，以研究爆发活动与偏振性质随频率和时间的演化并寻找可能的周期性；此前 2024 年 8 月至 11 月的 15 小时观测探测到超过 1300 个爆发，且基于 Murriyang 和 MeerKAT 的爆发率表明该源活跃至 9 月 2 日之后转为不活跃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该研究旨在通过监测超活跃重复快速射电暴 FRB 20240619D，研究爆发活动与偏振性质随频率和时间的变化，并寻找爆发活动中的可能周期性；摘要指出，鉴于另外两个重复快速射电暴已表现出周期性活动循环，FRB 20240619D 可能再次活跃，因此需要持续监测。

Method: 提议使用 Murriyang UWL 接收机对 FRB 20240619D 进行为期六个月的监测；2024 年 8 月至 11 月已用 UWL 接收机观测 15 小时，探测到超过 1300 个爆发，并结合 Murriyang 和 MeerKAT 观测给出的爆发率，强调 UWL 接收机的宽频率覆盖、灵敏度以及不同频率的同时观测能力。

Result: 2024 年 8 月至 11 月共 15 小时观测中，UWL 接收机探测到超过 1300 个爆发；一些爆发显示复杂的时频辐射图样；基于 Murriyang 和 MeerKAT 观测的爆发率表明该源活跃到 9 月 2 日，其后变得不活跃。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些观测将增进对 FRB 20240619D 前身天体、辐射物理及其邻近磁电离环境的理解，并可推广至一般 FRB 族群；鉴于其他两个重复快速射电暴已有周期性活动循环，该源可能再次活跃，持续监测至关重要，而这些结果将有助于理解 FRB 20240619D 在更广泛重复源族群中的位置及其与更广泛 FRB 前身天体模型的潜在联系。

Abstract: We propose to monitor the bursts from the hyperactive repeating fast radio burst FRB 20240619D over six months using the Murriyang UWL receiver. The primary aim is to study the evolution of burst activity and polarization properties with frequency and time, and to discover any potential periodicity in the burst activity. These insights will enhance our understanding of the progenitor, emission physics, and the immediate magneto-ionic environment of FRB 20240619D, thereby informing the general FRB population. A total of 15 hours of observing between August and November 2024 resulted in over 1300 bursts detected using the UWL receiver. Some bursts exhibit complex spectro-temporal emission patterns. The burst rate, based on Murriyang and MeerKAT observations, indicates that the source was active until September 2nd, after which it became inactive. Given that two other repeating FRBs have exhibited periodic activity cycles, it is reasonable to expect that FRB 20240619D could become active again, making continued monitoring crucial. The UWL receiver's broad frequency coverage and sensitivity are essential for detecting many bursts and enabling simultaneous observations at different frequencies. This is important for understanding the burst activity evolution with time and frequency, spectral properties, and underlying emission mechanisms. The combination of sensitivity and wide bandwidth makes Murriyang the ideal telescope for monitoring this FRB. Results from these observations will be pivotal in understanding FRB 20240619D's place within the broader repeater population and its potential connection to broader FRB progenitor models.

</details>

Motivation: 该提案旨在研究超活跃重复快速射电暴 FRB 20240619D 的暴发活动与偏振性质随频率和时间的演化，并寻找暴发活动中可能的周期性，以增进对前身星、辐射物理及周围磁电离环境的理解；鉴于另外两个重复快速射电暴已表现出周期性活动循环，持续监测被认为至关重要。

Method: 摘要说明：拟使用 Murriyang UWL 接收机对 FRB 20240619D 的暴发进行为期六个月的监测；2024 年 8 月至 11 月共 15 小时观测，使用 UWL 接收机探测暴发，并基于 Murriyang 和 MeerKAT 观测给出暴发率。具体分析流程、观测频率范围、时间分辨率与统计方法摘要未说明。

Result: 在 2024 年 8 月至 11 月共 15 小时的观测中，使用 UWL 接收机探测到超过 1300 个暴发，一些暴发表现出复杂的频谱-时间辐射图样。基于 Murriyang 和 MeerKAT 观测的暴发率表明，该源一直活跃到 9 月 2 日，之后变得不活跃。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些观测将有助于理解暴发活动随时间与频率的演化、频谱性质与潜在辐射机制，并增进对 FRB 20240619D 前身星、辐射物理及周围磁电离环境的理解，从而为一般快速射电暴群体提供信息；同时认为鉴于另外两个重复快速射电暴已表现出周期性活动循环，FRB 20240619D 可能再次变得活跃，持续监测至关重要，结果将有助于理解其在重复暴群体中的位置及与前身星模型的潜在联系。根据摘要无法判断该源与磁星的具体物理联系。

Abstract: We propose to monitor the bursts from the hyperactive repeating fast radio burst FRB 20240619D over six months using the Murriyang UWL receiver. The primary aim is to study the evolution of burst activity and polarization properties with frequency and time, and to discover any potential periodicity in the burst activity. These insights will enhance our understanding of the progenitor, emission physics, and the immediate magneto-ionic environment of FRB 20240619D, thereby informing the general FRB population. A total of 15 hours of observing between August and November 2024 resulted in over 1300 bursts detected using the UWL receiver. Some bursts exhibit complex spectro-temporal emission patterns. The burst rate, based on Murriyang and MeerKAT observations, indicates that the source was active until September 2nd, after which it became inactive. Given that two other repeating FRBs have exhibited periodic activity cycles, it is reasonable to expect that FRB 20240619D could become active again, making continued monitoring crucial. The UWL receiver's broad frequency coverage and sensitivity are essential for detecting many bursts and enabling simultaneous observations at different frequencies. This is important for understanding the burst activity evolution with time and frequency, spectral properties, and underlying emission mechanisms. The combination of sensitivity and wide bandwidth makes Murriyang the ideal telescope for monitoring this FRB. Results from these observations will be pivotal in understanding FRB 20240619D's place within the broader repeater population and its potential connection to broader FRB progenitor models.

</details>

The primary aim is to study the evolution of burst activity and polarization properties with frequency and time, and to discover any potential periodicity in the burst activity. These insights will enhance our understanding of the progenitor, emission physics, and the immediate magneto-ionic environment of FRB 20240619D, thereby informing the general FRB population. A total of 15 hours of observing between August and November 2024 resulted in over 1300 bursts detected using the UWL receiver. Some bursts exhibit complex spectro-temporal emission patterns. The burst rate, based on Murriyang and MeerKAT observations, indicates that the source was active until September 2nd, after which it became inactive. Given that two other repeating FRBs have exhibited periodic activity cycles, it is reasonable to expect that FRB 20240619D could become active again, making continued monitoring crucial. The UWL receiver's broad frequency coverage and sensitivity are essential for detecting many bursts and enabling simultaneous observations at different frequencies. This is important for understanding the burst activity evolution with time and frequency, spectral properties, and underlying emission mechanisms. The combination of sensitivity and wide bandwidth makes Murriyang the ideal telescope for monitoring this FRB. Results from these observations will be pivotal in understanding FRB 20240619D's place within the broader repeater population and its potential connection to broader FRB progenitor models.

</details>

### [1028] [Characterizing the quark-hadron mixed phase in compact star cores: Sensitivity to nuclear saturation and quark-model parameters at finite temperature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05005)
*Pal, Suman,Chaudhuri, Gargi*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该工作用 Gibbs 构造研究有限温度下夸克-强子混合相热力学，发现混合相宽度主要由有效核子质量和对称能控制，温度升高因 Gibbs 相平衡约束而减小混合相宽度并软化共存区物态方程；强矢量排斥对协调大质量脉冲星观测与 NICER 约束至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深入理解热密物质中的夸克-强子相变对于约束中子星物态方程十分关键；本文关注有限温度下夸克-强子混合相的热力学及其对混合星物质的影响，并考察混合相性质对核饱和性质与夸克物质参数的敏感性。

Method: 摘要说明采用 Gibbs 构造研究有限温度下夸克-强子混合相的热力学。摘要说明系统性地变化核饱和性质（有效核子质量 \(m^{*}/m\)、不可压缩性 \(K_{\mathrm{sat}}\)、对称能系数 \(J\) 及其斜率 \(L\)）和夸克物质参数（口袋常数 \(B_{0}^{1/4}\)、矢量耦合强度 \(G_{V}\)）。摘要未说明具体的观测数据、仪器、频段、时间跨度、样本或统计分析方法。

Result: 混合相宽度主要由有效质量和对称能控制，不可压缩性和对称能斜率的作用相对较弱，尤其在较高温度下。温度升高减小混合相宽度，并因 Gibbs 相平衡约束软化共存区物态方程。这些效应反映在声速、迹反常及其导数的行为中。对称能、有效质量和夸克参数的变化显著影响强子-夸克转变、恒星半径和最大质量；有限温度软化物态方程并增强混合相中的半径跳变。强矢量排斥对于使大质量脉冲星观测与 NICER 约束相协调至关重要，较弱排斥则有利于更致密、低质量的构型。

Conclusion: 作者认为有限温度下的热效应会通过 Gibbs 相平衡约束显著改变混合相结构并软化共存区物态方程，且混合相及整体星体性质对核饱和性质与夸克参数敏感；强矢量排斥是协调大质量脉冲星观测与 NICER 约束所必需的，而弱矢量排斥倾向给出更致密、低质量的构型。该结论基于摘要所述的模型研究；其对脉冲星单脉冲、模式转换、计时、偏振、射电谱或磁星-快速射电暴联系的适用性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: A thorough knowledge of the quark-hadron phase transition in hot and dense matter is essential for constraining the equation of state of neutron stars. In this work, we study the thermodynamics of the quark-hadron mixed phase at finite temperature using the Gibbs construction and examine its impact on hybrid star matter. We systematically explore the role of nuclear saturation properties, including the effective nucleon mass <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msup><mml:mi>m</mml:mi><mml:mo>*</mml:mo></mml:msup><mml:mo>/</mml:mo><mml:mi>m</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula>, incompressibility <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>K</mml:mi><mml:mi>sat</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula>, symmetry energy coefficient <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>J</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula>, and its slope <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>L</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula>, together with quark-matter parameters such as the bag constant <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msubsup><mml:mi>B</mml:mi><mml:mn>0</mml:mn><mml:mrow><mml:mn>1</mml:mn><mml:mo>/</mml:mo><mml:mn>4</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msubsup></mml:math></inline-formula> and the vector coupling strength <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>G</mml:mi><mml:mi>V</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula>. We find that the width of the mixed phase is mainly controlled by the effective mass and symmetry energy, while the roles of incompressibility and symmetry energy slope are comparatively weak, particularly at higher temperatures. Thermal effects substantially modify the phase structure: Increasing temperature reduces the mixed-phase width and softens the equation of state in the coexistence region due to Gibbs phase equilibrium constraints. These effects are reflected in the behavior of the speed of sound, the trace anomaly, and its derivative. Variations in the symmetry energy, effective mass, and quark parameters significantly affect the hadron-quark transition, stellar radii, and maximum mass, while finite temperature softens the equation of state and enhances radius jumps in the mixed phase. Strong vector repulsion is essential to reconcile massive pulsar observations with NICER constraints, whereas weaker repulsion favors more compact, low-mass configurations.

</details>


### [1029] [Impact of magnetic field topology on electromagnetic and gravitational waves from binary neutron star merger remnants]()
*Rainho, Inês,Bamber, Jamie,Guerra, Davide,Miravet-Tenés, Miquel,Ruiz, Milton,Tsokaros, Antonios,Shapiro, Stuart L.*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 通过广义相对论磁流体动力学模拟，作者发现磁场拓扑显著影响双中子星并合遗迹的引力波谱：类脉冲星位形中因 m=0 与 m=2 模式非线性耦合出现明显次级峰，而其他拓扑中没有；邻近（<50 Mpc）事件在未来引力波探测器下可能据此区分磁场结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该研究旨在探究磁场拓扑如何影响双中子星并合遗迹的电磁与引力波发射，并首次在双中子星并合研究中探索从受限混合核心平滑过渡到类脉冲星结构的拓扑，同时首次评估磁化遗迹的对流稳定性，以扩展此前对未磁化情形的分析。

Method: 采用广义相对论磁流体动力学模拟，对双中子星并合使用四种磁场拓扑，包括类脉冲星偶极位形、极向与环向分量的混合线性叠加，以及两种在 0.95 R_NS 和 0.5 R_NS 内过渡的拓扑。使用 SLy 与 WFF1 两套状态方程，ADM 质量分别为 2.7 和 2.6，并额外纳入一个质量较低的 SLy 双星以探究长寿命遗迹。对电磁与引力波发射性质，以及遗迹的频率模式、密度本征函数、自转、温度和 convective stability 进行了广泛分析。

Result: 报告三项关键结果：(1) 首次评估了磁化遗迹的 convective stability，扩展了此前未磁化分析；(2) 在类脉冲星位形的引力波谱中识别出明显次级峰，与 m=0 和 m=2 模式的非线性耦合一致，该峰在其他拓扑中不存在；(3) 磁场拓扑强烈影响引力波发射性质，邻近（<50 Mpc）事件在未来引力波探测器下可能观测区分不同磁场结构。所有模型的光度与短 γ 射线暴相容，纯极向位形在驱动可能的相对论性喷流方面最高效。

Conclusion: 作者认为磁场拓扑对双中子星并合遗迹的引力波发射有强烈影响，类脉冲星位形的次级峰与 m=0 和 m=2 模式非线性耦合一致，邻近事件或可在未来引力波探测器中用于区分磁场结构；所有模型光度与短 γ 射线暴相容，纯极向位形最有利于驱动可能的相对论性喷流。根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、快速射电暴等具体观测现象的直接联系。

Abstract: We perform general relativistic magnetohydrodynamic simulations of binary neutron star (BNS) mergers with four distinct magnetic field topologies: (i) a dipole pulsarlike configuration, (ii) a mixed linear superposition of poloidal and toroidal components inside the star, and (iii--iv) two topologies featuring a smooth transition from a confined mixed core to a pulsarlike structure at radii <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mn>0.95</mml:mn><mml:msub><mml:mi>R</mml:mi><mml:mi>NS</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> and <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mn>0.5</mml:mn><mml:msub><mml:mi>R</mml:mi><mml:mi>NS</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula>, with <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>R</mml:mi><mml:mi>NS</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> the radius of the star. The latter topologies are explored in BNS merger studies for the first time. We evolve systems with two equations of state, Skyrme-Lyon (SLy) and WFF1, with Arnowitt-Deser-Misner masses 2.7 and 2.6, respectively, and include an additional lower-mass SLy binary to probe the behavior of long-lived remnants. We perform an extensive analysis of the emission properties of the systems, both electromagnetic and gravitational waves, and of the properties of the remnants, namely their frequency modes, density eigenfunctions, rotation, temperature, and convective stability. We report three key results: (1) for the first time, we assess the convective stability of magnetized remnants, extending previous unmagnetized analyses; (2) we identify a clear secondary peak in the gravitational-wave spectrum of pulsarlike configurations, consistent with the nonlinear coupling of the <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>m</mml:mi><mml:mo>=</mml:mo><mml:mn>0</mml:mn></mml:math></inline-formula> and <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>m</mml:mi><mml:mo>=</mml:mo><mml:mn>2</mml:mn></mml:math></inline-formula> modes, which is absent in other topologies; and (3) the magnetic field topology strongly influences the gravitational wave emission properties to the extent that nearby (<inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mo>&lt;</mml:mo><mml:mn>50</mml:mn><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>Mpc</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula>) events could allow one to observationally distinguish between different field structures with future gravitational-wave detectors. Across all models, we obtain luminosities compatible with short <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>γ</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula>-ray bursts, with purely poloidal configurations being the most efficient in driving possible relativistic jets.

</details>

Abstract: After nearly three years of monitoring, comprising with the Parkes telescope and the FAST telescopes, FRB 20220529 is proven to be an extremely interesting repeater. It exhibits one of the longest activity durations and a potential ~200-day RM period. Due to frequent observations scheduled with both Parkes and FAST, an abrupt rotation measure (RM) flare has been observed in this source. This is the first detection of such an ``RM flare'' in a fast radio burst (FRB), suggesting that the source is in an environment with occasionally erupting coronal mass ejection. This presents a unique opportunity to study the eruption environment of FRBs and investigate the relation between burst activity and other burst parameters. If confirmed, the periodicity and the ``RM flare'' of FRB 20220529 would corroborate each other and become a ``smoking gun'' of the binary origin of FRB. In previous analysis, both Parkes and FAST observations have proven essential. While FAST's higher sensitivity has enabled the capture of many bursts, Parkes' wideband receiver has provided a good burst detection rate even during low-rate phases. Notably, during the RM flare, two high signal-to-noise ratio bursts from Parkes have been crucial in understanding the RM variations. To further investigate FRB 20220529, we have scheduled regular FAST observations every fortnight, monitoring the source for 20 minutes each time. Therefore, we also propose to monitor FRB 20220529 using the Parkes UWL receiver, ensuring high-time resolution and employing full-polarization observations.

</details>

Method: 摘要说明：使用Parkes望远镜和FAST望远镜对FRB 20220529进行了近三年监测；安排每两周一次的FAST常规观测，每次监测20分钟；提议用Parkes UWL接收机监测，以确保高时间分辨率和全偏振观测。摘要未说明具体频率、处理流程和统计分析方法。

Abstract: After nearly three years of monitoring, comprising with the Parkes telescope and the FAST telescopes, FRB 20220529 is proven to be an extremely interesting repeater. It exhibits one of the longest activity durations and a potential ~200-day RM period. Due to frequent observations scheduled with both Parkes and FAST, an abrupt rotation measure (RM) flare has been observed in this source. This is the first detection of such an ``RM flare'' in a fast radio burst (FRB), suggesting that the source is in an environment with occasionally erupting coronal mass ejection. This presents a unique opportunity to study the eruption environment of FRBs and investigate the relation between burst activity and other burst parameters. If confirmed, the periodicity and the ``RM flare'' of FRB 20220529 would corroborate each other and become a ``smoking gun'' of the binary origin of FRB. In previous analysis, both Parkes and FAST observations have proven essential. While FAST's higher sensitivity has enabled the capture of many bursts, Parkes' wideband receiver has provided a good burst detection rate even during low-rate phases. Notably, during the RM flare, two high signal-to-noise ratio bursts from Parkes have been crucial in understanding the RM variations. To further investigate FRB 20220529, we have scheduled regular FAST observations every fortnight, monitoring the source for 20 minutes each time. Therefore, we also propose to monitor FRB 20220529 using the Parkes UWL receiver, ensuring high-time resolution and employing full-polarization observations.

Motivation: FRB 20220529 表现出极长的活动持续时间与潜在约 200 天 RM 周期；首次在 FRB 中探测到的 RM 耀发，提示该源可能处于偶尔发生日冕物质抛射的环境。这为研究 FRB 爆发环境、暴活动与其他暴参数的关系以及检验 FRB 双星起源提供了机会。

Method: 基于近三年 Parkes 与 FAST 望远镜的监测，安排频繁观测；FAST 以更高灵敏度捕获许多暴，Parkes 宽带接收机在低活动率阶段保持良好探测率；在 RM 耀发期间，Parkes 的两个高信噪比暴用于理解 RM 变化。为进一步研究，已安排每两周一次 FAST 观测，每次 20 分钟，并提议用 Parkes UWL 接收机进行高时间分辨率全极化监测。

Result: 摘要报告 FRB 20220529 是一个极其有趣的中继暴，具有最长的活动持续时间之一和一个潜在的约 200 天 RM 周期；在该源中观测到一次突然的 RM 耀发，这是首次在 FRB 中探测到此类“RM 耀发”；在 RM 耀发期间，来自 Parkes 的两个高信噪比暴对理解 RM 变化至关重要。

Conclusion: 作者认为该 RM 耀发表明该源处于一个偶尔发生日冕物质抛射的环境，为研究 FRB 爆发环境及暴活动与其他暴参数的关系提供独特机会；若得到确认，周期性与“RM 耀发”将相互佐证，并成为 FRB 双星起源的“确凿证据”。根据摘要无法判断。”

Abstract: After nearly three years of monitoring, comprising with the Parkes telescope and the FAST telescopes, FRB 20220529 is proven to be an extremely interesting repeater. It exhibits one of the longest activity durations and a potential ~200-day RM period. Due to frequent observations scheduled with both Parkes and FAST, an abrupt rotation measure (RM) flare has been observed in this source. This is the first detection of such an ``RM flare'' in a fast radio burst (FRB), suggesting that the source is in an environment with occasionally erupting coronal mass ejection. This presents a unique opportunity to study the eruption environment of FRBs and investigate the relation between burst activity and other burst parameters. If confirmed, the periodicity and the ``RM flare'' of FRB 20220529 would corroborate each other and become a ``smoking gun'' of the binary origin of FRB. In previous analysis, both Parkes and FAST observations have proven essential. While FAST's higher sensitivity has enabled the capture of many bursts, Parkes' wideband receiver has provided a good burst detection rate even during low-rate phases. Notably, during the RM flare, two high signal-to-noise ratio bursts from Parkes have been crucial in understanding the RM variations. To further investigate FRB 20220529, we have scheduled regular FAST observations every fortnight, monitoring the source for 20 minutes each time. Therefore, we also propose to monitor FRB 20220529 using the Parkes UWL receiver, ensuring high-time resolution and employing full-polarization observations.

</details>

Result: FRB 20220529被确认为极有趣的重复暴，表现出最长的活动持续时间之一和潜在约200天RM周期；观测到一次突然的RM耀发，这是首次在FRB中探测到此类“RM耀发”；在RM耀发期间，Parkes探测到两个高信噪比爆发，对理解RM变化至关重要。摘要未给出RM变化幅度、耀发时刻或显著性等数值。

Conclusion: 作者认为，该RM耀发表明该源处于一个偶尔爆发日冕物质抛射的环境中；若周期性得到证实，其与“RM耀发”将相互佐证，并成为FRB双星起源的“确凿证据”。这为研究FRB的爆发环境及爆发活动与其他爆发参数的关系提供了独特机会。根据摘要无法判断其对脉冲星、磁星或其他FRB群体的具体可迁移性。

Abstract: After nearly three years of monitoring, comprising with the Parkes telescope and the FAST telescopes, FRB 20220529 is proven to be an extremely interesting repeater. It exhibits one of the longest activity durations and a potential ~200-day RM period. Due to frequent observations scheduled with both Parkes and FAST, an abrupt rotation measure (RM) flare has been observed in this source. This is the first detection of such an ``RM flare'' in a fast radio burst (FRB), suggesting that the source is in an environment with occasionally erupting coronal mass ejection. This presents a unique opportunity to study the eruption environment of FRBs and investigate the relation between burst activity and other burst parameters. If confirmed, the periodicity and the ``RM flare'' of FRB 20220529 would corroborate each other and become a ``smoking gun'' of the binary origin of FRB. In previous analysis, both Parkes and FAST observations have proven essential. While FAST's higher sensitivity has enabled the capture of many bursts, Parkes' wideband receiver has provided a good burst detection rate even during low-rate phases. Notably, during the RM flare, two high signal-to-noise ratio bursts from Parkes have been crucial in understanding the RM variations. To further investigate FRB 20220529, we have scheduled regular FAST observations every fortnight, monitoring the source for 20 minutes each time. Therefore, we also propose to monitor FRB 20220529 using the Parkes UWL receiver, ensuring high-time resolution and employing full-polarization observations.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 20220529 经过近三年监测后显示出异常有趣的重复活动特征，包括很长的活动持续时间与可能的约 200 天 RM 周期。该源中出现的突变 RM 耀发为研究 FRB 的爆发环境以及爆发活动与其他爆发参数之间的关系提供了独特机会。

Method: 摘要说明使用 Parkes 望远镜与 FAST 望远镜对 FRB 20220529 进行了近三年的联合监测。FAST 的高灵敏度用于捕获许多爆发，Parkes 的宽带接收机在低活动率阶段仍保持良好探测率；RM 耀发期间有两个来自 Parkes 的高信噪比爆发。后续计划每两周一次的 FAST 常规观测，每次 20 分钟，并提议使用 Parkes UWL 接收机进行高时间分辨率、全极化监测。具体频段与时间跨度细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告 FRB 20220529 表现出最长的活动持续时间之一，并可能存在约 200 天的 RM 周期。由于 Parkes 与 FAST 频繁观测，在该源中观测到一次突发的 RM 耀发；这是首次在 FRB 中探测到此类“RM 耀发”。RM 耀发期间，来自 Parkes 的两个高信噪比爆发对理解 RM 变化至关重要。具体数值、置信度或统计显著性摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为该 RM 耀发表明源处于偶尔发生日冕物质抛射的环境，并带来研究 FRB 爆发环境及爆发活动与其他爆发参数关系的独特机会。若得到证实，FRB 20220529 的周期性与“RM 耀发”将相互佐证，并成为 FRB 双星起源的“确凿证据”。

Abstract: After nearly three years of monitoring, comprising with the Parkes telescope and the FAST telescopes, FRB 20220529 is proven to be an extremely interesting repeater. It exhibits one of the longest activity durations and a potential ~200-day RM period. Due to frequent observations scheduled with both Parkes and FAST, an abrupt rotation measure (RM) flare has been observed in this source. This is the first detection of such an ``RM flare'' in a fast radio burst (FRB), suggesting that the source is in an environment with occasionally erupting coronal mass ejection. This presents a unique opportunity to study the eruption environment of FRBs and investigate the relation between burst activity and other burst parameters. If confirmed, the periodicity and the ``RM flare'' of FRB 20220529 would corroborate each other and become a ``smoking gun'' of the binary origin of FRB. In previous analysis, both Parkes and FAST observations have proven essential. While FAST's higher sensitivity has enabled the capture of many bursts, Parkes' wideband receiver has provided a good burst detection rate even during low-rate phases. Notably, during the RM flare, two high signal-to-noise ratio bursts from Parkes have been crucial in understanding the RM variations. To further investigate FRB 20220529, we have scheduled regular FAST observations every fortnight, monitoring the source for 20 minutes each time. Therefore, we also propose to monitor FRB 20220529 using the Parkes UWL receiver, ensuring high-time resolution and employing full-polarization observations.

</details>

### [1056] [Parkes observations for project P1343 semester 2025APRS_10]()
*Uttarkar, Pavan,Deller, Adam,Bannister, Keith,Shannon, Ryan,Glowacki, Marcin,Kumar, Pravir,Wang, Yuanming,Wang, Ziteng,Gupta, Vivek,Gourdji, Kelly,Jahns-Schindler, Joscha,Dial, Tyson*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用Parkes/Murriyang的UWL，对通过CRACO发现的重复FRB候选源进行宽带谱-偏振后续观测，预计在约6个月内使经UWL研究的重复源数量翻倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管迄今已发表超过700个FRB，且重复源可用于研究辐射机制、前身星周围介质并检验前身星模型，但FRB辐射的物理机制仍缺乏理解；同时，ASKAP的有限分数带宽与巡天性质不利于探测重复源的谱-偏振特性。

Method: 使用Parkes/Murriyang的超宽带-低（UWL）对通过CRACO发现的类重复源进行后续观测，研究其宽带谱-偏振特性；计划在接下来的约6个月内开展，目标是使经UWL研究的重复源数量翻倍。摘要未说明具体观测频率范围、时间分辨、样本量或分析步骤。

Result: 摘要为观测提案，报告的是预期而非已完成的观测结果：ASKAP的FRB探测系统在相干升级后预计每周探测到约1-2个FRB；在接下来的约6个月里，预期将通过UWL研究的重复源数量翻倍，从而为重复FRB的前身星环境和周围介质提供前所未有的见解。

Conclusion: 作者认为，Parkes/Murriyang的UWL大带宽适合后续观测通过CRACO发现的重复FRB源，其宽带谱-偏振研究有望揭示重复FRB的前身星环境与周围介质。根据摘要无法判断这一预期是否已经实现，也无法判断其与脉冲星、磁星或FRB物理机制的具体联系。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The commissioning of new dedicated FRB detection systems has led to an exponential increase in the detected FRBs over the last decade. Despite &gt;700 FRBs published to date, there is still a lack of understanding about the physical mechanisms through which FRB emission is produced. Due to the possibility of detecting multiple bursts from the same source in a repeating FRB, it forms an ideal sample set to uncover the physics of the source (e.g., emission mechanism, progenitor surrounding media), and test possible progenitor models. The coherent upgrade to the FRB detection system to ASKAP is expected to detect ~1-2 FRB/week. However, due to the limited fractional bandwidth available with ASKAP and survey nature of the telescope, probing the spectro-polarimetric characteristics of repeating sources is non-optimal. Hence, the large bandwidth offered by the ultra wideband-low (UWL) on Parkes/Murriyang is an ideal instrument to follow-up repeating FRB sources discovered through CRACO. Over the next ~6 months, we expect to double the number of repeaters that have been studied through the UWL. This will provide unprecedented insight into the progenitor environment and the surrounding media of repeating FRBs. We propose using the UWL to follow up repeater-like sources to study their wideband spectro-polarimetric characteristics.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者提出，使用UWL跟进类重复源并研究其宽带谱偏振特征，将为重复FRB的前身星环境和周围介质提供前所未有的洞察；所提议的观测预期使通过UWL研究的重复源数量翻倍。摘要未报告已完成的测量或检验结果，因此对FRB辐射机制或前身星模型是否得到支持，根据摘要无法判断。

The coherent upgrade to the FRB detection system to ASKAP is expected to detect ~1 FRB/week. However, due to the limited fractional bandwidth available with ASKAP and survey nature of the telescope, probing the spectro-polarimetric characteristics of repeating sources is non-optimal. Hence, the large bandwidth offered by the ultra wideband-low (UWL) on Parkes/Murriyang is an ideal instrument to follow-up repeating FRB sources discovered through CRACO. Over the next ~6 months, we expect to double the number of repeaters that have been studied through the UWL. This will provide unprecedented insight into the progenitor environment and the surrounding media of repeating FRBs. We propose using the UWL to follow up repeater-like sources to study their wideband spectro-polarimetric characteristics.

</details>

### [1067] [Parkes observations for project P1338 semester 2024OCTS_49]()
*Uttarkar, Pavan,Deller, Adam,Shannon, Ryan,Lower, Marcus,Kumar, Pravir,Wang, Yuanming,Gourdji, Kelly,Jahns-Schindler, Joscha*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用 Parkes/Murriyang 的 UWL 接收机定期后续观测具有异常高暴发活动性的重复 FRB 20240114A，以确定其谱时特性的长期演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重复 FRB 20240114A 具有其他源未见过的异常高暴发活动性；重复 FRB 为研究环暴环境、约束祖源模型和检验辐射机制提供了窗口，且此前的后续观测揭示了频率依赖的中心频率演化或色度、可能的活动窗口、显著的圆偏振及其频率依赖等谱偏振特性，因此需要宽带观测追踪其长期演化。

Method: 提出利用 Parkes/Murriyang 超宽带低（UWL）接收机对 FRB 20240114A 开展定期后续观测的观测计划，以探索其宽带谱时与偏振行为。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度、采样或分析细节。此前工作使用 Parkes/Murriyang 对该源进行后续观测。

Result: FRB 20240114A 最近由 CHIME/FRB 发现，并已被观测到具有异常高的暴发活动性，如此极端的活动性尚未见于任何其他源。此前 Parkes/Murriyang 对该源的后续观测揭示了引人注目的谱偏振特性：暴发中心频率的频率依赖演化或色度、可能的活动窗口、显著大的圆偏振（CP）以及频率依赖的 CP。摘要未给出具体数值。

Conclusion: 这些谱偏振特性是理解 FRB 环暴环境并检验可能祖源模型的关键，具有可靠偏振测量的宽带仪器对揭示这些特性至关重要；因此作者提出定期后续观测 FRB 20240114A 以确定其谱时特性的长期演化。根据摘要无法判断该方法对脉冲星、磁星或单脉冲研究的可迁移性。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The repeating FRB 20240114A was recently discovered by CHIME/FRB, which has been seen to have an exceptionally high burst activity. Such extreme burst activity has not been seen in any other source. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20240114A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed intriguing spectro-polarimetric properties, such as frequency-dependent evolution of burst central frequency or chromaticity, a possible activity window, significantly large circular polarisation (CP), and frequency-dependent CP. These properties hold the key towards understanding the circumburst environment of the FRBs, and test possible progenitor models. A large bandwidth instrument with reliable polarimetry has been critical in uncovering these properties. The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the source's wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour. We propose a campaign to regularly follow up FRB 20240114A to ascertain its long-term evolution of spectro-temporal properties.

</details>

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The repeating FRB 20240114A was recently discovered by CHIME/FRB, which has been seen to have an exceptionally high burst activity. Such extreme burst activity has not been seen in any other source. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20240114A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. A large bandwidth instrument with reliable polarimetry has been critical in uncovering these properties. The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the source's wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour. TL;DR: 该提案计划利用 Parkes/Murriyang 的 UWL 接收机对重复 FRB 20240114A 开展定期后续观测，以确定其谱-时域性质的长期演化；该源由 CHIME/FRB 发现，具有迄今未见于其他源的异常高暴发活动性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 族群呈现出重复与不重复的明显二分性；重复源因其重复特性而成为研究暴周环境的独特窗口，可用于约束祖代模型并检验辐射机制。此前 Parkes/Murriyang 对 FRB 20240114A 的后续观测揭示出频率依赖的中心频率演化（色度）、可能的活动窗口以及显著且频率依赖的圆偏振等谱偏振性质，但摘要未说明其长期谱-时域演化是否已被确定。

Method: 摘要说明这是一项观测提案：拟利用 Parkes/Murriyang 上的超宽带低（UWL）接收机，对由 CHIME/FRB 发现的重复 FRB 20240114A 开展定期后续观测活动，以确定其谱-时域性质的长期演化。摘要强调具有可靠偏振测量的大带宽仪器对于揭示相关性质至关重要。具体观测频率或频段、观测时间跨度、采样或统计分析方法，摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要指出，FRB 20240114A 由 CHIME/FRB 发现，具有异常高的暴发活动性，且这种极端暴发活动尚未在任何其他源中被观测到。此前 Parkes/Murriyang 的后续观测揭示出引人注目的谱偏振性质，包括暴发中心频率的频率依赖演化或色度、一个可能的活动窗口、显著大的圆偏振（CP），以及频率依赖的 CP。摘要未给出这些性质的具体数值、显著性或定量表征。

Conclusion: 作者认为，重复 FRB（如 FRB 20240114A）的重复特性提供了研究其暴周环境的无可比拟的窗口，可用于约束可能的祖代模型并检验潜在的辐射机制；上述谱偏振性质是理解 FRB 暴周环境和检验祖代模型的关键，而大带宽且偏振测量可靠的仪器对揭示这些性质至关重要。作者据此提出对 FRB 20240114A 进行定期后续观测，以确定其谱-时域性质的长期演化。该源是否与磁星或脉冲星存在物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The repeating FRB 20240114A was recently discovered by CHIME/FRB, which has been seen to have an exceptionally high burst activity. Such extreme burst activity has not been seen in any other source. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20240114A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed intriguing spectro-polarimetric properties, such as frequency-dependent evolution of burst central frequency or chromaticity, a possible activity window, significantly large circular polarisation (CP), and frequency-dependent CP. These properties hold the key towards understanding the circumburst environment of the FRBs, and test possible progenitor models. A large bandwidth instrument with reliable polarimetry has been critical in uncovering these properties. The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the source's wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour. We propose a campaign to regularly follow up FRB 20240114A to ascertain its long-term evolution of spectro-temporal properties.

</details>

Method: 摘要说明将使用 Parkes/Murriyang 上的超宽带低频（UWL）接收机，提出一项对 FRB 20240114A 进行定期后续观测的活动，以确定其谱时性质的长期演化；并称此前已使用 Parkes/Murriyang 进行源后续观测。具体观测频率、时间跨度、样本量和分析流程摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未报告新的观测结果，而是总结已有发现：此前 Parkes/Murriyang 后续观测揭示了频率依赖的爆发中心频率演化或色度、可能的活动窗口、显著大的圆偏振（CP）以及频率依赖的 CP；FRB 20240114A 由 CHIME/FRB 发现，并具有异常高的爆发活动，这种极端活动在其他源中未见。

Conclusion: 作者认为，上述谱偏振性质是理解 FRB 暴周环境和检验可能祖源模型的关键，具有可靠偏振测量的大带宽仪器对此至关重要，而 Parkes/Murriyang 的 UWL 接收机适合探索该源的宽带谱时与偏振行为，因此提出定期后续观测以确定其长期演化。根据摘要无法判断这些性质对磁星、脉冲星或 FRB 物理的具体物理指向。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The repeating FRB 20240114A was recently discovered by CHIME/FRB, which has been seen to have an exceptionally high burst activity. Such extreme burst activity has not been seen in any other source. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20240114A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed intriguing spectro-polarimetric properties, such as frequency-dependent evolution of burst central frequency or chromaticity, a possible activity window, significantly large circular polarisation (CP), and frequency-dependent CP. These properties hold the key towards understanding the circumburst environment of the FRBs, and test possible progenitor models. A large bandwidth instrument with reliable polarimetry has been critical in uncovering these properties. The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the source's wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour. We propose a campaign to regularly follow up FRB 20240114A to ascertain its long-term evolution of spectro-temporal properties.

### [1093] [Parkes observations for project P1338 semester 2024OCTS_47]()
*Uttarkar, Pavan,Deller, Adam,Shannon, Ryan,Lower, Marcus,Kumar, Pravir,Wang, Yuanming,Gourdji, Kelly,Jahns-Schindler, Joscha*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟利用Parkes/Murriyang的UWL接收机定期后续观测高活动重复FRB 20240114A，以确定其谱时性质的长期演化，并借助其重复性研究暴周环境与可能的progenitor模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB是河外毫秒射电暴，自Parkes/Murriyang多波束档案数据中发现首个FRB以来，群体呈现重复与不重复的二分性。重复FRB 20240114A由CHIME/FRB发现，具有异常高的爆发活动，而此前Parkes/Murriyang后续观测已揭示中心频率频率依赖演化或色度、可能的活动窗口、显著大圆偏振及频率依赖圆偏振等谱偏振性质，这些性质对理解暴周环境与检验progenitor模型至关重要，因而需要探究其长期演化。

Method: 摘要说明提出使用Parkes/Murriyang上的超宽带低（UWL）接收机开展定期后续观测，以探测FRB 20240114A的宽带谱时与偏振行为，并确定其谱时性质的长期演化。摘要提到该仪器为大带宽且具有可靠偏振测量。具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、采样量、爆发数目以及分析细节，摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未报告新的观测结果。摘要陈述的背景结果包括：重复FRB 20240114A由CHIME/FRB发现，已被观测到具有异常高的爆发活动，且这种极端爆发活动尚未在任何其他源中被观测到；此前Parkes/Murriyang对源的后续观测揭示出频率依赖的爆发中心频率演化或色度、可能的活动窗口、显著大的圆偏振（CP）以及频率依赖的CP。

Conclusion: 摘要提出，重复FRB因其重复性质为研究暴周环境提供无与伦比的窗口，可用于约束可能的progenitor模型并检验潜在辐射机制；大带宽且具可靠偏振测量的仪器对于揭示上述谱偏振性质至关重要，因此Parkes/Murriyang的UWL接收机适合探测该源宽带谱时与偏振行为，并拟通过定期后续观测确定其谱时性质的长期演化。根据摘要无法判断这些性质最终支持何种具体progenitor模型或辐射机制。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The repeating FRB 20240114A was recently discovered by CHIME/FRB, which has been seen to have an exceptionally high burst activity. Such extreme burst activity has not been seen in any other source. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20240114A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed intriguing spectro-polarimetric properties, such as frequency-dependent evolution of burst central frequency or chromaticity, a possible activity window, significantly large circular polarisation (CP), and frequency-dependent CP. These properties hold the key towards understanding the circumburst environment of the FRBs, and test possible progenitor models. A large bandwidth instrument with reliable polarimetry has been critical in uncovering these properties. The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the source's wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour. We propose a campaign to regularly follow up FRB 20240114A to ascertain its long-term evolution of spectro-temporal properties.

</details>

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. Conclusion: 作者认为，重复 FRB 的重复性质为研究其环爆环境提供无与伦比的窗口，可用于限制可能的祖源模型并检验潜在发射机制；上述频谱-偏振特性是理解环爆环境和检验祖源模型的关键，而大带宽且偏振可靠的仪器对揭示这些特性至关重要，因此 Parkes/Murriyang 的 UWL 接收机适合用于该源的长期宽带追踪。与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、模式转换、计时、自转减慢、射电频谱或其他瞬变射电关联的具体物理诠释，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The repeating FRB 20240114A was recently discovered by CHIME/FRB, which has been seen to have an exceptionally high burst activity. Such extreme burst activity has not been seen in any other source. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20240114A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed intriguing spectro-polarimetric properties, such as frequency-dependent evolution of burst central frequency or chromaticity, a possible activity window, significantly large circular polarisation (CP), and frequency-dependent CP. These properties hold the key towards understanding the circumburst environment of the FRBs, and test possible progenitor models. The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the source's wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour. We propose a campaign to regularly follow up FRB 20240114A to ascertain its long-term evolution of spectro-temporal properties.

TL;DR: 该观测计划提出利用Parkes/Murriyang的UWL接收机定期后续观测重复FRB 20240114A，以确定其频谱-时域特性的长期演化；该源由CHIME/FRB发现，具有迄今任何其他源都未观测到的异常高暴发活动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB族群存在重复与不重复的二分性；重复FRB 20240114A由CHIME/FRB发现，具有异常高的暴发活动，而此前对Parkes/Murriyang源的后续观测揭示了频率依赖的中心频率演化或色度、可能的活动窗口、显著较大的圆偏振及频率依赖圆偏振等特性。摘要指出，重复FRB为研究暴周环境提供窗口，可用于限制祖源模型并检验辐射机制。

Method: 摘要说明这是一项利用Parkes/Murriyang上超宽带低（UWL）接收机对重复FRB 20240114A进行定期后续观测的观测计划，旨在确定其频谱-时域特性的长期演化；摘要强调具有可靠偏振测量的大带宽仪器对于揭示相关性质至关重要。具体观测频率或频段、时间跨度、样本量及分析细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告，此前对Parkes/Murriyang源的后续观测揭示了频谱-偏振特性，包括暴发中心频率的频率依赖演化或色度、可能的活动窗口、显著较大的圆偏振（CP）以及频率依赖的CP；FRB 20240114A由CHIME/FRB发现，被观测到具有异常高的暴发活动，且这种极端暴发活动尚未在任何其他源中被观测到。摘要未给出具体数值、显著性或长期演化结果。

Conclusion: 摘要指出，重复FRB（如FRB 20240114A）由于其重复性质，为研究暴周环境提供了无与伦比的窗口，可用于限制可能的祖源模型并检验潜在的辐射机制；上述频谱-偏振特性是理解FRB暴周环境和检验可能祖源模型的关键，而具有可靠偏振测量的大带宽仪器对揭示这些性质至关重要。该计划拟通过定期后续观测确定FRB 20240114A频谱-时域特性的长期演化。根据摘要无法判断该源与磁星或FRB祖源的具体联系。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The repeating FRB 20240114A was recently discovered by CHIME/FRB, which has been seen to have an exceptionally high burst activity. Such extreme burst activity has not been seen in any other source. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20240114A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed intriguing spectro-polarimetric properties, such as frequency-dependent evolution of burst central frequency or chromaticity, a possible activity window, significantly large circular polarisation (CP), and frequency-dependent CP. These properties hold the key towards understanding the circumburst environment of the FRBs, and test possible progenitor models. A large bandwidth instrument with reliable polarimetry has been critical in uncovering these properties. The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the source's wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour. We propose a campaign to regularly follow up FRB 20240114A to ascertain its long-term evolution of spectro-temporal properties.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者认为，像 FRB 20240114A 这样的重复 FRB 因其重复特性，为研究其暴周环境提供了无可比拟的窗口，可用于约束可能的 progenitor 模型并检验潜在的辐射机制；此前揭示的谱偏振特性是理解 FRB 暴周环境并检验可能 progenitor 模型的关键。作者提出，Parkes/Murriyang 的 UWL 接收机非常适合探索该源的宽带谱时与偏振行为，并拟通过定期后续观测确定其谱时特性的长期演化。与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、模式转换或计时等的直接联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The repeating FRB 20240114A was recently discovered by CHIME/FRB, which has been seen to have an exceptionally high burst activity. Such extreme burst activity has not been seen in any other source. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20240114A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed intriguing spectro-polarimetric properties, such as frequency-dependent evolution of burst central frequency or chromaticity, a possible activity window, significantly large circular polarisation (CP), and frequency-dependent CP. These properties hold the key towards understanding the circumburst environment of the FRBs, and test possible progenitor models. A large bandwidth instrument with reliable polarimetry has been critical in uncovering these properties. The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the source's wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour. We propose a campaign to regularly follow up FRB 20240114A to ascertain its long-term evolution of spectro-temporal properties.

</details>

Motivation: FRB群体存在重复与非重复的二分性；重复FRB因其重复性可为了解爆发周围环境提供窗口，并用于限制祖源模型、检验辐射机制。FRB 20240114A由CHIME/FRB发现且爆发活动异常高，此前Parkes/Murriyang后续观测揭示的谱偏振性质是理解其爆发周围环境、检验祖源模型的关键。

Method: 摘要说明这是一项观测提案：提出一项对FRB 20240114A进行定期后续观测的活动，以确定其谱时性质的长期演化。摘要指出Parkes/Murriyang上的超宽带低（UWL）接收机适合探索该源的宽带谱时与偏振行为，并称具有可靠偏振测量的大带宽仪器对揭示这些性质至关重要。具体观测频率、时间跨度、样本量、分析流程与统计方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告，重复FRB 20240114A由CHIME/FRB发现，并具有异常高的爆发活动，这种极端爆发活动尚未在任何其他源中见到。此前Parkes/Murriyang对该源的后续观测揭示了若干谱偏振性质：爆发中心频率的频率依赖演化或色度、可能存在活动窗口、显著大的圆偏振（CP），以及频率依赖的CP。摘要称具有可靠偏振测量的大带宽仪器对揭示这些性质至关重要。具体数值、显著性水平与定量结果摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为，重复FRB（如FRB 20240114A）的重复性为了解其爆发周围环境提供了无与伦比的窗口，可用于限制可能的祖源模型并检验潜在辐射机制；此前揭示的频率依赖中心频率（色度）、可能的活动窗口、显著大CP与频率依赖CP等性质是理解FRB爆发周围环境并检验祖源模型的关键。因此提出对FRB 20240114A的定期后续观测以确定其谱时性质的长期演化。基于摘要，UWL接收机或所提活动能否实际实现这些目标尚无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The repeating FRB 20240114A was recently discovered by CHIME/FRB, which has been seen to have an exceptionally high burst activity. Such extreme burst activity has not been seen in any other source. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20240114A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed intriguing spectro-polarimetric properties, such as frequency-dependent evolution of burst central frequency or chromaticity, a possible activity window, significantly large circular polarisation (CP), and frequency-dependent CP. These properties hold the key towards understanding the circumburst environment of the FRBs, and test possible progenitor models. A large bandwidth instrument with reliable polarimetry has been critical in uncovering these properties. The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the source's wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour. We propose a campaign to regularly follow up FRB 20240114A to ascertain its long-term evolution of spectro-temporal properties.

</details>

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用Parkes/Murriyang的UWL接收机定期后续观测高活动重复FRB 20240114A，以确定其频谱-时间性质的长期演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重复FRB因其重复特性为研究环绕爆发环境提供了独特窗口，可用于约束祖源模型并检验辐射机制。此前Parkes/Murriyang后续观测已揭示该源的频率依赖中心频率演化、可能的活动窗口以及显著且频率依赖的圆偏振等频谱-偏振特性，这些性质是理解其环绕爆发环境的关键。

Method: 摘要说明这是一项观测提案，计划使用Parkes/Murriyang上的超宽带低频（UWL）接收机，对由CHIME/FRB发现的重复FRB 20240114A开展定期后续观测。摘要强调该接收机具有大带宽和可靠偏振测量，适合探究该源的宽带频谱-时间与偏振行为。观测频率、时间跨度、样本量和具体分析流程摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未报告新的观测结果，仅回顾了背景：重复FRB 20240114A由CHIME/FRB发现，具有异常高的爆发活动，且尚未在任何其他源中见到如此极端活动；重复与非重复FRB在大量后续观测下仍呈二分性；此前Parkes/Murriyang后续观测揭示出爆发中心频率的频率依赖演化或色度、可能的活动窗口、显著的大圆偏振（CP）以及频率依赖的CP。

Conclusion: 作者认为重复FRB的频谱-偏振特性有助于理解其环绕爆发环境并检验可能祖源模型，而大带宽、可靠偏振测量的UWL接收机适合追踪这些性质；因此提出定期后续观测FRB 20240114A以确定其频谱-时间性质的长期演化。论文尚未给出观测结论。根据摘要无法判断这些性质与其他脉冲星、磁星或FRB群体机制的具体物理联系。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The repeating FRB 20240114A was recently discovered by CHIME/FRB, which has been seen to have an exceptionally high burst activity. Such extreme burst activity has not been seen in any other source. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20240114A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed intriguing spectro-polarimetric properties, such as frequency-dependent evolution of burst central frequency or chromaticity, a possible activity window, significantly large circular polarisation (CP), and frequency-dependent CP. These properties hold the key towards understanding the circumburst environment of the FRBs, and test possible progenitor models. A large bandwidth instrument with reliable polarimetry has been critical in uncovering these properties. The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the source's wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour. We propose a campaign to regularly follow up FRB 20240114A to ascertain its long-term evolution of spectro-temporal properties.

</details>
