TL;DR: 本提案计划利用Parkes/Murriyang的UWL接收机对高活动重复快速射电暴FRB 20240114A开展定期后续观测，以确定其频谱-时间特性的长期演化；此前观测已揭示频率依赖的中心频率演化、可能的活动窗口以及显著且频率依赖的圆偏振。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB是河外毫秒级射电爆发，自Parkes/Murriyang首次发现以来，其群体呈现重复与不重复的二分性。FRB 20240114A由CHIME/FRB发现，具有其他源未见的高爆发活动；重复FRB为研究暴周环境、约束progenitor模型和检验辐射机制提供窗口，而此前Parkes/Murriyang观测揭示的频谱-偏振特性需要长期监测。

Method: 摘要描述的是一项利用Parkes/Murriyang超宽带低频（UWL）接收机对重复FRB 20240114A开展定期后续观测的提案，以确定其频谱-时间特性的长期演化。摘要强调该仪器具有大带宽和可靠偏振测量能力，适于探索该源的宽带频谱-时间与偏振行为。观测频率范围、时间跨度、样本量及具体分析流程摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要指出，FRB 20240114A由CHIME/FRB发现，并被观测到具有异常高的爆发活动，这种极端活动尚未在任何其他源中见到。此前Parkes/Murriyang的后续观测揭示了引人入胜的频谱-偏振特性，包括爆发中心频率的频率依赖演化或色度、可能的活动窗口、显著大的圆偏振（CP）以及频率依赖的CP。其他定量结果与统计显著性摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为，重复FRB的重复特性为研究其暴周环境提供无可比拟的窗口，可用于约束可能的progenitor模型并检验潜在的辐射机制；所揭示的频谱-偏振特性是理解FRB暴周环境和检验progenitor模型的关键，而大带宽、可靠偏振测量仪器至关重要。作者提出对FRB 20240114A进行定期后续观测以确定其频谱-时间特性的长期演化。这些解释与FRB及其暴周环境直接相关；根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星、磁星及单脉冲发射的具体联系。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The repeating FRB 20240114A was recently discovered by CHIME/FRB, which has been seen to have an exceptionally high burst activity. Such extreme burst activity has not been seen in any other source. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20240114A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed intriguing spectro-polarimetric properties, such as frequency-dependent evolution of burst central frequency or chromaticity, a possible activity window, significantly large circular polarisation (CP), and frequency-dependent CP. These properties hold the key towards understanding the circumburst environment of the FRBs, and test possible progenitor models. A large bandwidth instrument with reliable polarimetry has been critical in uncovering these properties. The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the source's wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour. We propose a campaign to regularly follow up FRB 20240114A to ascertain its long-term evolution of spectro-temporal properties.

</details>

Result: 摘要未说明本次拟开展 campaign 的具体结果；仅报告此前后续观测揭示了引人注目的谱偏振性质，包括爆发中心频率的频率依赖演化或色度、可能的活动窗口、显著较大的圆偏振（CP）以及频率依赖的 CP，并指出 FRB 20240114A 由 CHIME/FRB 发现且具有异常高的爆发活动性，这种极端活动性尚未在任何其他源中被观测到，同时重复与非重复 FRB 的二分性已在大量不同射电望远镜后随观测下显现。

Conclusion: 摘要指出，重复 FRB 的重复性质为了解其环暴环境提供了无可比拟的窗口，可用于约束可能的 progenitors 模型并检验潜在的辐射机制；所揭示的谱偏振性质是理解 FRB 环暴环境和检验可能 progenitors 模型的关键，而具有可靠偏振测量的大带宽仪器对揭示这些性质至关重要。提议的定期后随观测旨在确定 FRB 20240114A 谱时性质的长期演化。根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星、磁星或单脉冲发射的具体物理联系。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The repeating FRB 20240114A was recently discovered by CHIME/FRB, which has been seen to have an exceptionally high burst activity. Such extreme burst activity has not been seen in any other source. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20240114A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed intriguing spectro-polarimetric properties, such as frequency-dependent evolution of burst central frequency or chromaticity, a possible activity window, significantly large circular polarisation (CP), and frequency-dependent CP. These properties hold the key towards understanding the circumburst environment of the FRBs, and test possible progenitor models. A large bandwidth instrument with reliable polarimetry has been critical in uncovering these properties. The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the source's wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour. We propose a campaign to regularly follow up FRB 20240114A to ascertain its long-term evolution of spectro-temporal properties.

</details>

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the source's wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour. We propose a campaign to regularly follow up FRB 20240114A to ascertain its long-term evolution of spectro-temporal properties.

### [1149] [Parkes observations for project P1338 semester 2025APRS_03]()
*Uttarkar, Pavan,Deller, Adam,Shannon, Ryan,Lower, Marcus,Kumar, Pravir,Wang, Yuanming,Gourdji, Kelly,Jahns-Schindler, Joscha*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB群体存在重复与不重复的明显二分性，而已发现重复暴FRB 20240114A具有异常高的暴发活动，这种极端活动尚未在其他源中见到。重复FRB为研究暴周环境提供无可比拟的窗口，可约束祖源模型并检验发射机制；此前Parkes/Murriyang的后续观测已揭示频率依赖演化、可能的活动窗口以及显著和频率依赖的圆偏振等频谱-偏振性质，而大带宽且偏振测量可靠的仪器对揭示这些性质至关重要。

Result: 摘要未说明该拟议计划已获得的新观测结果。摘要报告的背景结果包括：FRB 20240114A由CHIME/FRB发现，已被观测到具有异常高的暴发活动，这种极端暴发活动尚未在任何其他源中见到；此前Parkes/Murriyang对源的后续观测揭示了频率依赖的暴发中心频率演化或色度性、可能的活动窗口、显著大的圆偏振（CP）以及频率依赖的CP。摘要未给出具体数值、显著性水平或时间尺度。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The repeating FRB 20240114A was recently discovered by CHIME/FRB, which has been seen to have an exceptionally high burst activity. Such extreme burst activity has not been seen in any other source. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20240114A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed intriguing spectro-polarimetric properties, such as frequency-dependent evolution of burst central frequency or chromaticity, a possible activity window, significantly large circular polarisation (CP), and frequency-dependent CP. These properties hold the key towards understanding the circumburst environment of the FRBs, and test possible progenitor models. A large bandwidth instrument with reliable polarimetry has been critical in uncovering these properties. The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the source's wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour. We propose a campaign to regularly follow up FRB 20240114A to ascertain its long-term evolution of spectro-temporal properties.

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The repeating FRB 20240114A was recently discovered by CHIME/FRB, which has been seen to have an exceptionally high burst activity. Such extreme burst activity has not been seen in any other source. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20240114A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed intriguing spectro-polarimetric properties, such as frequency-dependent evolution of burst central frequency or chromaticity, a possible activity window, significantly large circular polarisation (CP), and frequency-dependent CP. A large bandwidth instrument with reliable polarimetry has been critical in uncovering these properties. The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the source's wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour. We propose a campaign to regularly follow up FRB 20240114A to ascertain its long-term evolution of spectro-temporal properties.

Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The repeating FRB 20240114A was recently discovered by CHIME/FRB, which has been seen to have an exceptionally high burst activity. Such extreme burst activity has not been seen in any other source. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20240114A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed intriguing spectro-polarimetric properties, such as frequency-dependent evolution of burst central frequency or chromaticity, a possible activity window, significantly large circular polarisation (CP), and frequency-dependent CP. These properties hold the key towards understanding the circumburst environment of the FRBs, and test possible progenitor models. A large bandwidth instrument with reliable polarimetry has been critical in uncovering these properties. The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the source's wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour. We propose a campaign to regularly follow up FRB 20240114A to ascertain its long-term evolution of spectro-temporal properties.

</details>

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The repeating FRB 20240114A was recently discovered by CHIME/FRB, which has been seen to have an exceptionally high burst activity. Such extreme burst activity has not been seen in any other source. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20240114A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed intriguing spectro-polarimetric properties, such as frequency-dependent evolution of burst central frequency or chromaticity, a possible activity window, significantly large circular polarisation (CP), and frequency-dependent CP. These properties hold the key towards understanding the circumburst environment of the FRBs, and test possible progenitor models. A large bandwidth instrument with reliable polarimetry has been critical in uncovering these properties. The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the source's wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour. We propose a campaign to regularly follow up FRB 20240114A to ascertain its long-term evolution of spectro-temporal properties.

### [1177] [Parkes observations for project P1338 semester 2024OCTS_45]()

<details>

Motivation: 快速射电暴（FRB）存在重复与不重复的群体二分性，重复源 FRB 20240114A 由 CHIME/FRB 发现且爆发活动异常高，此前其他源未见。其重复性质为研究环暴环境、约束祖源模型和检验辐射机制提供窗口，此前 Parkes/Murriyang 后续观测已揭示频率依赖的爆发中心频率演化（色度）、可能的活动窗口及显著圆偏振等特性，但这些特性的长期演化尚待确定。

Result: 摘要未报告新的观测结果。其背景性陈述包括：FRB 20240114A由CHIME/FRB最近发现，被观测到具有异常高的暴发活动，且这种极端活动尚未在任何其他源中见到；此前Parkes/Murriyang后续观测揭示出频率依赖的暴发中心频率演化或色度、可能的活动窗口、显著大的圆偏振（CP）以及频率依赖的CP。摘要未给出具体数值、时间跨度或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，重复FRB的重复特性及其谱偏振性质是理解FRB环暴环境和检验可能祖源模型、辐射机制的关键，而大带宽且具备可靠偏振测量的仪器对此不可或缺；因此提出用Parkes/Murriyang的UWL接收机定期跟踪FRB 20240114A以确定其谱-时性质的长期演化。与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲计时或FRB-磁星联系的具体结论，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio bursts of extragalactic origin. Since the discovery of the first FRB in the archival Parkes/Murriyang multibeam data, a broad dichotomy in population has emerged. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others are not, despite a significant amount of follow-up using different radio telescopes. The repeating FRB 20240114A was recently discovered by CHIME/FRB, which has been seen to have an exceptionally high burst activity. Such extreme burst activity has not been seen in any other source. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20240114A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed intriguing spectro-polarimetric properties, such as frequency-dependent evolution of burst central frequency or chromaticity, a possible activity window, significantly large circular polarisation (CP), and frequency-dependent CP. These properties hold the key towards understanding the circumburst environment of the FRBs, and test possible progenitor models. A large bandwidth instrument with reliable polarimetry has been critical in uncovering these properties. The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the source's wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour. We propose a campaign to regularly follow up FRB 20240114A to ascertain its long-term evolution of spectro-temporal properties.

</details>

### [1186] [Parkes observations for project P1328 semester 2024APRS_09]()
*Uttarkar, Pavan,Deller, Adam,Shannon, Ryan,Price, Danny,Kumar, Pravir,Luo, Rui,Gourdji, Kelly,Zhao, Shiqian*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用Parkes/Murriyang的UWL接收机对重复FRB 20180301A开展定期监测，以建模其磁场演化、通过退偏振行为研究其暴周介质，并约束DM与RM的相关性；此前跟踪观测已揭示该源DM的时间演化以及DM与RM相关的初步证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB被发现为河外起源的微毫秒暂现源，其群体存在重复与未见重复的二分性。重复FRB如FRB 20180301A因其重复性而可用于约束祖源模型并检验发射机制；该源还表现出RM符号切换和低频退偏振等偏振特征，此前跟踪观测也显示DM时间演化及DM与RM相关的初步证据。

Method: 摘要未说明具体的观测时间、时间跨度、样本量或数据分析细节；摘要表明此前使用Parkes/Murriyang进行过源跟踪观测，并提议使用该望远镜上的超宽带低频（UWL）接收机对FRB 20180301A进行定期监测，以探索宽带谱-时域和偏振行为，并用于建模磁场演化、研究退偏振行为以及约束DM与RM的相关性。

Result: 摘要报告：FRB为河外起源的微毫秒暂现源；其群体中存在已观测到重复与未被观测到重复的二分性；重复FRB 20180301A表现出偏振性质，包括RM符号切换，表明磁场方向反转，以及线偏振度随频率降低而显著下降（退偏振）；此前的Parkes/Murriyang跟踪观测揭示了该源DM的时间演化，以及DM与RM相关的初步证据。摘要未说明具体数值、显著性或监测时长。

Conclusion: 作者提出利用UWL定期监测FRB 20180301A，以建模其磁场演化、通过退偏振行为研究其暴周介质，并约束DM与RM的相关性；其依据是重复FRB可为暴周环境和祖源模型提供约束。所提议监测能否实现这些目标以及具体物理机制，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts are peculiar micro-millisecond duration transients, which have been seen to be extragalactic in origin. Since their discovery, a dichotomy has emerged in their population. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others have not been seen to be repeating. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20180301A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. Additionally, FRB 20180301A has been seen to have interesting polarisation properties, such as a switch in the sign of RM, indicating a reversal in the magnetic field and a marked reduction in the linear polarisation fraction towards lower frequencies (depolarisation). The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed a temporal evolution in the dispersion measure (DM) of the source and tentative evidence for correlation in the DM and rotation measure (RM). The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour of the source. We propose regular monitoring of FRB 20180301A using UWL to model the magnetic field evolution, study its circumburst media using depolarisation behaviour, and constrain any correlation of DM and RM.

</details>

Motivation: 重复快速射电暴（如 FRB 20180301A）的重复性为研究其暴周环境提供了窗口，可用于约束可能的 progenitor 模型并检验潜在辐射机制。该源已显示 RM 符号翻转和低频退偏振等偏振性质，且此前 Parkes/Murriyang 后续观测揭示了 DM 时间演化及 DM 与 RM 相关的暂定证据，因此需要进一步监测以理解其磁场与暴周介质演化。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测时间跨度、样本量或分析方法细节。摘要明确说明：提议使用 Parkes/Murriyang 上的 ultra-wideband low（UWL）接收机对 FRB 20180301A 进行定期监测；并提及此前 Parkes/Murriyang 对该源的后续观测，以及利用 UWL 探索该源的宽带频谱-时间与偏振行为。分析目标包括模拟磁场演化、利用退偏振行为研究暴周介质，以及约束 DM 与 RM 的相关性。

Result: 摘要报告：快速射电暴为微毫秒持续时间暂现源，已观测到起源于河外；其群体存在重复与未观测到重复的二分性。FRB 20180301A 已被观测到具有偏振性质，包括 RM 符号翻转，表明磁场反转，以及线偏振度随频率降低而显著下降（退偏振）。此前 Parkes/Murriyang 后续观测揭示了该源 DM 的时间演化，以及 DM 与 RM 相关的暂定证据。摘要未说明具体数值、时间跨度或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者提议对 FRB 20180301A 开展 UWL 定期监测，以模拟其磁场演化、利用退偏振行为研究其暴周介质，并约束 DM 与 RM 的任何相关性。根据摘要无法判断更具体的物理机制或 progenitor 结论。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts are peculiar micro-millisecond duration transients, which have been seen to be extragalactic in origin. Since their discovery, a dichotomy has emerged in their population. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others have not been seen to be repeating. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20180301A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. Additionally, FRB 20180301A has been seen to have interesting polarisation properties, such as a switch in the sign of RM, indicating a reversal in the magnetic field and a marked reduction in the linear polarisation fraction towards lower frequencies (depolarisation). The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed a temporal evolution in the dispersion measure (DM) of the source and tentative evidence for correlation in the DM and rotation measure (RM). The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour of the source. We propose regular monitoring of FRB 20180301A using UWL to model the magnetic field evolution, study its circumburst media using depolarisation behaviour, and constrain any correlation of DM and RM.

The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20180301A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. Additionally, FRB 20180301A has been seen to have interesting polarisation properties, such as a switch in the sign of RM, indicating a reversal in the magnetic field and a marked reduction in the linear polarisation fraction towards lower frequencies (depolarisation). The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed a temporal evolution in the dispersion measure (DM) of the source and tentative evidence for correlation in the DM and rotation measure (RM). The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour of the source. We propose regular monitoring of FRB 20180301A using UWL to model the magnetic field evolution, study its circumburst media using depolarisation behaviour, and constrain any correlation of DM and RM.

Motivation: 快速射电暴的重复与非重复二分性使重复源成为研究暴周环境的独特窗口；FRB 20180301A 已显示出 RM 符号切换、低频线偏振度下降（退偏振），以及此前 Parkes/Murriyang 后续观测揭示的 DM 时间演化和 DM 与 RM 相关的初步证据，因此需要进一步监测以约束祖源模型并检验辐射机制。

Method: 摘要说明了这是一份观测提案，拟使用 Parkes/Murriyang 的超宽带低（UWL）接收机对 FRB 20180301A 进行定期监测。摘要提到利用该接收机探索宽带频谱-时间与偏振行为，以建模磁场演化、通过退偏振行为研究暴周介质并约束 DM 与 RM 的相关性。具体观测频率范围、时间跨度、监测频率、样本量和统计分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要指出，FRB 20180301A 已被观测到具有 RM 符号切换，表明磁场反转，并在线偏振度上随频率降低而出现显著下降（退偏振）。先前的 Parkes/Murriyang 后续观测还揭示了该源 DM 的时间演化，以及 DM 与 RM 相关的初步证据。重复快速射电暴中已有部分源被观测到重复，而另一部分未被观测到重复。摘要未给出具体数值、不确定度或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，重复快速射电暴的重复性质可用于约束可能的祖源模型并检验潜在的辐射机制；FRB 20180301A 的 RM 符号切换表明磁场反转，低频线偏振度下降被解释为退偏振。基于此，作者提出对 FRB 20180301A 进行定期监测，以建模磁场演化、利用退偏振行为研究其暴周介质，并约束 DM 与 RM 的相关性。这些结论目前属于拟开展的观测目标，而非已由本摘要确立的结果；与磁星—FRB 联系或单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化的关联根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts are peculiar micro-millisecond duration transients, which have been seen to be extragalactic in origin. Since their discovery, a dichotomy has emerged in their population. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others have not been seen to be repeating. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20180301A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. Additionally, FRB 20180301A has been seen to have interesting polarisation properties, such as a switch in the sign of RM, indicating a reversal in the magnetic field and a marked reduction in the linear polarisation fraction towards lower frequencies (depolarisation). The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed a temporal evolution in the dispersion measure (DM) of the source and tentative evidence for correlation in the DM and rotation measure (RM). The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour of the source. We propose regular monitoring of FRB 20180301A using UWL to model the magnetic field evolution, study its circumburst media using depolarisation behaviour, and constrain any correlation of DM and RM.

</details>

The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20180301A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. Additionally, FRB 20180301A has been seen to have interesting polarisation properties, such as a switch in the sign of RM, indicating a reversal in the magnetic field and a marked reduction in the linear polarisation fraction towards lower frequencies (depolarisation). The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed a temporal evolution in the dispersion measure (DM) of the source and tentative evidence for correlation in the DM and rotation measure (RM). The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20180301A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. Additionally, FRB 20180301A has been seen to have interesting polarisation properties, such as a switch in the sign of RM, indicating a reversal in the magnetic field and a marked reduction in the linear polarisation fraction towards lower frequencies (depolarisation). The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed a temporal evolution in the dispersion measure (DM) of the source and tentative evidence for correlation in the DM and rotation measure (RM). The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour of the source. We propose regular monitoring of FRB 20180301A using UWL to model the magnetic field evolution, study its circumburst media using depolarisation behaviour, and constrain any correlation of DM and RM.

Conclusion: 作者提出通过UWL定期监测FRB 20180301A，以模拟磁场演化、利用退偏振行为研究其暴周介质，并约束DM与RM的相关性；这些目标被表述为拟议工作，而非已确立结果。所涉具体物理机制以及结论是否可推广至其他重复FRB、磁星或FRB群体，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts are peculiar micro-millisecond duration transients, which have been seen to be extragalactic in origin. Since their discovery, a dichotomy has emerged in their population. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others have not been seen to be repeating. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20180301A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. Additionally, FRB 20180301A has been seen to have interesting polarisation properties, such as a switch in the sign of RM, indicating a reversal in the magnetic field and a marked reduction in the linear polarisation fraction towards lower frequencies (depolarisation). The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed a temporal evolution in the dispersion measure (DM) of the source and tentative evidence for correlation in the DM and rotation measure (RM). The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour of the source. We propose regular monitoring of FRB 20180301A using UWL to model the magnetic field evolution, study its circumburst media using depolarisation behaviour, and constrain any correlation of DM and RM.

</details>

Result: 摘要未说明本次提案的观测结果。所引用的既往前期结果包括：FRB 20180301A被观测到具有有趣的偏振性质，如RM符号的切换，表明磁场反转，以及线性偏振分数向低频显著降低（退偏振）；此前Parkes/Murriyang的源跟踪观测揭示了该源色散量（DM）的时间演化，以及DM与旋转测度（RM）相关的初步证据。数值、显著性及时间跨度摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者提出通过UWL对FRB 20180301A定期监测，以模拟磁场演化、利用退偏振行为研究其暴周介质，并约束DM与RM的相关性。重复FRB被认为可用于约束可能的前身星模型并检验潜在辐射机制。关于磁场反转、退偏振及DM-RM相关的物理起源，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts are peculiar micro-millisecond duration transients, which have been seen to be extragalactic in origin. Since their discovery, a dichotomy has emerged in their population. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others have not been seen to be repeating. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20180301A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. Additionally, FRB 20180301A has been seen to have interesting polarisation properties, such as a switch in the sign of RM, indicating a reversal in the magnetic field and a marked reduction in the linear polarisation fraction towards lower frequencies (depolarisation). The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed a temporal evolution in the dispersion measure (DM) of the source and tentative evidence for correlation in the DM and rotation measure (RM). The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour of the source. We propose regular monitoring of FRB 20180301A using UWL to model the magnetic field evolution, study its circumburst media using depolarisation behaviour, and constrain any correlation of DM and RM.

</details>

Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others have not been seen to be repeating. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20180301A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. Additionally, FRB 20180301A has been seen to have interesting polarisation properties, such as a switch in the sign of RM, indicating a reversal in the magnetic field and a marked reduction in the linear polarisation fraction towards lower frequencies (depolarisation). Result: 此前Parkes/Murriyang的源跟踪观测已揭示FRB 20180301A的DM存在时间演化，并给出DM与RM相关的初步证据；该源还被观测到RM符号切换，指示磁场反转，以及朝向较低频率线偏振度显著降低（退偏振）。摘要未说明具体数值、显著性、频率范围或时间跨度。

Conclusion: 作者提议通过UWL定期监测FRB 20180301A，以建模其磁场演化、利用退偏振行为研究其暴周介质，并约束DM与RM的任何相关性；这些目标属于拟开展研究，而非已确立结论。根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星、磁星或FRB群体其他成员的具体联系。

Abstract: Fast radio bursts are peculiar micro-millisecond duration transients, which have been seen to be extragalactic in origin. Since their discovery, a dichotomy has emerged in their population. Some FRBs have been seen to be repeating, while others have not been seen to be repeating. The repeating FRBs, such as FRB 20180301A, provide an unparalleled window into their circumburst environment due to their repeating nature, which can be used to constrain possible progenitor models and test underlying emission mechanisms. Additionally, FRB 20180301A has been seen to have interesting polarisation properties, such as a switch in the sign of RM, indicating a reversal in the magnetic field and a marked reduction in the linear polarisation fraction towards lower frequencies (depolarisation). The previous Parkes/Murriyang source follow-up has also revealed a temporal evolution in the dispersion measure (DM) of the source and tentative evidence for correlation in the DM and rotation measure (RM). The ultra-wideband low (UWL) receiver on Parkes/Murriyang is ideally suited to explore the wideband spectro-temporal and polarimetric behaviour of the source. We propose regular monitoring of FRB 20180301A using UWL to model the magnetic field evolution, study its circumburst media using depolarisation behaviour, and constrain any correlation of DM and RM.

</details>

### [1246] [Parkes observations for project P1183 semester 2024OCTS_16]()
*Zhang, Songbo,Hobbs, George,Toomey, Lawrence,Dai, Shi,Russell, Christopher,Wu, Xuefeng,Li, Ye,Yang, Xuan,Tang, Zhenfan,Chang, Chenming,Geng, Jinjun,Yang, Yuanpei*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 对 FRB 20220529 近两年的 Parkes 和 FAST 监测表明，它是一个活动极其频繁的重复暴，具有最长的活动持续时间之一和一个可能的周期，并首次在 FRB 中探测到突然的 RM 爆发。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该研究旨在通过长期监测 FRB 20220529，确定其重复暴活动特征并检验可能的周期性，同时利用新探测到的 RM 爆发研究 FRB 的爆发环境及其与暴活动和其他暴参数的关系；若能确认，周期性与 RM 爆发可相互印证，指向 FRB 的双星起源。

Method: 摘要说明：近两年监测 FRB 20220529，包括 Parkes 望远镜 57 次观测共 126.7 小时，FAST 望远镜 101 次观测共 49.4 小时，使用 Parkes 宽带接收机和 FAST 进行频繁观测；此前分析中两望远镜均不可或缺。为进一步研究，已安排每两周一次、每次 20 分钟的常规 FAST 观测，并提议使用 Parkes UWL 接收机进行高时间分辨率和全偏振监测。

Result: 摘要报告：FRB 20220529 是活动极其频繁的重复暴，表现出最长的活动持续时间之一和一个可能的周期；最近观测到该源一次突然的 RM 爆发，这是首次在 FRB 中探测到这种“RM 爆发”。FAST 更高的灵敏度使许多暴得以被捕获，Parkes 宽带接收机在低活动率阶段仍提供了良好的暴探测率；在 RM 爆发期间，Parkes 的两个高信噪比暴对理解 RM 变化至关重要。

Conclusion: 作者认为，该源处于一个偶发爆发日冕物质抛射的环境中，这为研究 FRB 爆发环境及暴活动与其他暴参数的关系提供了独特机会；若周期性与“RM 爆发”得到确认，二者将相互印证并成为 FRB 双星起源的“确凿证据”。根据摘要无法判断该解释的全部物理细节及对其他源的适用性。

Abstract: After nearly two years of monitoring, comprising 126.7 hours over 57 observations with the Parkes telescope and 49.4 hours across 101 observations with the FAST telescopes, we have determined that FRB 20220529 is an extremely active repeater. It exhibits one of the longest activity durations and a potential period. Due to frequent observations scheduled with both Parkes and FAST, we recently observed an abrupt rotation measure (RM) flare in this source. This is the first detection of such an ``RM flare'' in a fast radio burst (FRB), suggesting that the source is in an environment with occasionally erupting coronal mass ejection. ### [1253] [Parkes observations for project P1183 semester 2025APRS_06]()
*Zhang, Songbo,Hobbs, George,Toomey, Lawrence,Dai, Shi,Russell, Christopher,Wu, Xuefeng,Li, Ye,Yang, Xuan,Tang, Zhenfan,Chang, Chenming,Geng, Jinjun,Yang, Yuanpei*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 经过近两年 Parkes 与 FAST 联合监测，FRB 20220529 被确定为一个活动极其频繁的重复暴，表现出最长的活动持续时间之一和可能的周期，并首次在 FRB 中探测到突然的 RM 耀发。若周期性与 RM 耀发得到证实，二者将相互佐证，成为该 FRB 双星起源的“确凿证据”。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该研究旨在长期监测并刻画重复暴 FRB 20220529 的活动特征：其活动持续时间与可能的周期，以及新出现的 RM 变化。摘要指出，RM 耀发为研究 FRB 的爆发环境和爆发活动与其他爆发参数的关系提供了独特机会，并可能检验该源的双星起源假说。

Method: 使用 Parkes 望远镜进行 57 次观测共 126.7 小时，使用 FAST 望远镜进行 101 次观测共 49.4 小时，监测时间跨度近两年。摘要提到 Parkes 的宽带接收机和 FAST 更高的灵敏度，并说明在 RM 耀发期间 Parkes 探测到两个高信噪比爆发。未来计划包括每两周一次、每次 20 分钟的 FAST 观测，以及使用 Parkes UWL 接收机进行高时间分辨率和全偏振监测。具体分析技术（如计时、单脉冲、偏振或 RM 拟合方法）摘要未说明。

Result: 经近两年监测，FRB 20220529 被确定为一个活动极其频繁的重复暴，具有最长的活动持续时间之一以及一个可能的周期。联合观测中最近探测到该源的突然 RM 耀发，这是首次在 FRB 中探测到此类“RM 耀发”。摘要还指出，在 RM 耀发期间，Parkes 的两个高信噪比爆发对理解 RM 变化至关重要；FAST 因灵敏度更高捕捉到许多爆发，Parkes 宽带接收机在低爆发率阶段仍保持良好探测率。RM 耀发的具体数值、变化幅度及周期性显著性摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为，首次探测到的 RM 耀发表明 FRB 20220529 处于一个偶尔爆发日冕物质抛射的环境中，这为研究 FRB 的爆发环境以及爆发活动与其他爆发参数的关系提供了独特机会。若该源的周期性与 RM 耀发均得到证实，二者将相互佐证，并成为 FRB 双星起源的“确凿证据”。至于该双星起源图像的具体物理机制，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: After nearly two years of monitoring, comprising 126.7 hours over 57 observations with the Parkes telescope and 49.4 hours across 101 observations with the FAST telescopes, we have determined that FRB 20220529 is an extremely active repeater. It exhibits one of the longest activity durations and a potential period. Due to frequent observations scheduled with both Parkes and FAST, we recently observed an abrupt rotation measure (RM) flare in this source. This is the first detection of such an ``RM flare'' in a fast radio burst (FRB), suggesting that the source is in an environment with occasionally erupting coronal mass ejection. This presents a unique opportunity to study the eruption environment of FRBs and investigate the relation between burst activity and other burst parameters. If confirmed, the periodicity and the ``RM flare'' of FRB 20220529 would corroborate each other and become a ``smoking gun'' of the binary origin of FRB. In our previous analysis, both Parkes and FAST observations have proven essential. While FAST's higher sensitivity has enabled the capture of many bursts, Parkes' wideband receiver has provided a good burst detection rate even during low-rate phases. Notably, during the RM flare, two high signal-to-noise ratio bursts from Parkes have been crucial in understanding the RM variations. To further investigate FRB 20220529, we have scheduled regular FAST observations every fortnight, monitoring the source for 20 minutes each time. Therefore, we also propose to monitor FRB 20220529 using the Parkes UWL receiver, ensuring high-time resolution and employing full-polarization observations.

</details>

### [1265] [Parkes observations for project P1183 semester 2025APRS_21]()
*Zhang, Songbo,Hobbs, George,Toomey, Lawrence,Dai, Shi,Russell, Christopher,Wu, Xuefeng,Li, Ye,Yang, Xuan,Tang, Zhenfan,Chang, Chenming,Geng, Jinjun,Yang, Yuanpei*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 经过 Parkes 和 FAST 近两年、共计约 176 小时的监测，FRB 20220529 被确定为极为活跃的重复暴，表现出极长的活动持续时间、一个潜在周期，并首次在 FRB 中被观测到突发的旋转测度（RM）耀发。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该研究旨在长期监测并刻画重复暴 FRB 20220529 的活动特征，探究其爆发活动与其他爆发参数之间的关系，并检验其潜在周期性与 RM 耀发是否相互佐证，从而为 FRB 的双星起源提供证据。

Method: 使用 Parkes 望远镜（57 次观测，126.7 小时）和 FAST 望远镜（101 次观测，49.4 小时）对 FRB 20220529 进行了近两年的监测；先前分析结合了两台望远镜的观测，其中 Parkes 宽带接收机在低爆发率阶段提供探测率，FAST 灵敏度更高。还提议使用 Parkes UWL 接收机进行高时间分辨率、全极化监测，FAST 每两周观测一次、每次 20 分钟。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该研究旨在长期监测 FRB 20220529，以确认其极端活跃性、潜在周期性，并理解其周围喷发环境以及暴活动与其他暴参数之间的关系。摘要指出，若周期性与 RM 耀发得到证实，二者可相互佐证并成为 FRB 双星起源的 “smoking gun”。

Method: 摘要说明：使用 Parkes 望远镜进行了 57 次观测共 126.7 小时的监测，使用 FAST 望远镜进行了 101 次观测共 49.4 小时的监测，总计近两年。先前分析结合了两台望远镜的观测；提出继续使用 Parkes UWL 接收机监测，以确保高时间分辨率并进行全偏振观测；已安排每两周一次的常规 FAST 观测，每次 20 分钟。

Result: 摘要报告：FRB 20220529 是极其活跃的重复暴，表现出最长的活动持续时间之一以及一个潜在周期；最近观测到一次突然的 rotation measure (RM) 耀发，这是首次在 FRB 中探测到这种 “RM flare”；FAST 的更高灵敏度捕获了许多暴，Parkes 的宽带接收机在低活动率阶段也提供了良好的暴探测率；在 RM flare 期间，Parkes 的两个高信噪比暴对理解 RM 变化至关重要。

Conclusion: 作者认为，首次在 FRB 中探测到的 “RM flare” 表明该源处于一个偶尔喷发 coronal mass ejection 的环境中，为研究 FRB 的喷发环境以及暴活动与其他暴参数之间的关系提供了独特机会；如果得到证实，周期性与 “RM flare” 将相互佐证，并成为 FRB 双星起源的 “smoking gun”。根据摘要无法判断更具体的物理机制。

Abstract: After nearly two years of monitoring, comprising 126.7 hours over 57 observations with the Parkes telescope and 49.4 hours across 101 observations with the FAST telescopes, we have determined that FRB 20220529 is an extremely active repeater. It exhibits one of the longest activity durations and a potential period. Due to frequent observations scheduled with both Parkes and FAST, we recently observed an abrupt rotation measure (RM) flare in this source. This is the first detection of such an ``RM flare'' in a fast radio burst (FRB), suggesting that the source is in an environment with occasionally erupting coronal mass ejection. This presents a unique opportunity to study the eruption environment of FRBs and investigate the relation between burst activity and other burst parameters. If confirmed, the periodicity and the ``RM flare'' of FRB 20220529 would corroborate each other and become a ``smoking gun'' of the binary origin of FRB. In our previous analysis, both Parkes and FAST observations have proven essential. While FAST's higher sensitivity has enabled the capture of many bursts, Parkes' wideband receiver has provided a good burst detection rate even during low-rate phases. Notably, during the RM flare, two high signal-to-noise ratio bursts from Parkes have been crucial in understanding the RM variations. To further investigate FRB 20220529, we have scheduled regular FAST observations every fortnight, monitoring the source for 20 minutes each time. Therefore, we also propose to monitor FRB 20220529 using the Parkes UWL receiver, ensuring high-time resolution and employing full-polarization observations.

</details>

This is the first detection of such an ``RM flare'' in a fast radio burst (FRB), suggesting that the source is in an environment with occasionally erupting coronal mass ejection. This presents a unique opportunity to study the eruption environment of FRBs and investigate the relation between burst activity and other burst parameters. If confirmed, the periodicity and the ``RM flare'' of FRB 20220529 would corroborate each other and become a ``smoking gun'' of the binary origin of FRB. While FAST's higher sensitivity has enabled the capture of many bursts, Parkes' wideband receiver has provided a good burst detection rate even during low-rate phases. Notably, during the RM flare, two high signal-to-noise ratio bursts from Parkes have been crucial in understanding the RM variations. Method: 摘要说明：使用 Parkes 望远镜开展 57 次观测、共 126.7 小时，使用 FAST 望远镜开展 101 次观测、共 49.4 小时，监测近两年；结合 Parkes 宽带接收机与 FAST 更高灵敏度进行暴探测，并在 RM flare 期间利用 Parkes 的两个高信噪比暴分析 RM 变化。拟继续每两周进行 20 分钟 FAST 观测，并提议以 Parkes UWL 接收机开展高时间分辨率、全偏振监测。具体分析流程摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要明确报告：FRB 20220529 是极为活跃的重复暴，表现出最长的活动持续时间之一和一个潜在周期；近期观测到该源突然的 rotation measure (RM) 耀发，这是在 FRB 中首次探测到此类 "RM flare"。FAST 更高灵敏度使许多暴被捕获，Parkes 宽带接收机在低发生率阶段仍提供良好探测率；在 RM flare 期间，Parkes 的两个高信噪比暴对理解 RM 变化至关重要。周期性是否达到显著确认、RM 耀发的数值幅度与时间尺度摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为，该 RM flare 表明 FRB 20220529 处于偶尔发生日冕物质抛射的爆发环境中；若周期性得到确认，周期性与 "RM flare" 将相互印证，并成为 FRB 双星起源的 "smoking gun"。Parkes 与 FAST 的联合监测在探测暴和理解 RM 变化方面被证明不可或缺。RM 耀发与环境、双星起源之间因果关系的具体物理机制，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: After nearly two years of monitoring, comprising 126.7 hours over 57 observations with the Parkes telescope and 49.4 hours across 101 observations with the FAST telescopes, we have determined that FRB 20220529 is an extremely active repeater. It exhibits one of the longest activity durations and a potential period. Due to frequent observations scheduled with both Parkes and FAST, we recently observed an abrupt rotation measure (RM) flare in this source. This is the first detection of such an ``RM flare'' in a fast radio burst (FRB), suggesting that the source is in an environment with occasionally erupting coronal mass ejection. This presents a unique opportunity to study the eruption environment of FRBs and investigate the relation between burst activity and other burst parameters. If confirmed, the periodicity and the ``RM flare'' of FRB 20220529 would corroborate each other and become a ``smoking gun'' of the binary origin of FRB. In our previous analysis, both Parkes and FAST observations have proven essential. While FAST's higher sensitivity has enabled the capture of many bursts, Parkes' wideband receiver has provided a good burst detection rate even during low-rate phases. Notably, during the RM flare, two high signal-to-noise ratio bursts from Parkes have been crucial in understanding the RM variations. To further investigate FRB 20220529, we have scheduled regular FAST observations every fortnight, monitoring the source for 20 minutes each time. Therefore, we also propose to monitor FRB 20220529 using the Parkes UWL receiver, ensuring high-time resolution and employing full-polarization observations.

</details>

Method: 利用 Parkes 望远镜进行 57 次观测共 126.7 小时，利用 FAST 望远镜进行 101 次观测共 49.4 小时，合计近两年监测；采用 Parkes 宽带接收机与 FAST 观测 FRB 20220529，并测量 RM；新提议使用 Parkes UWL 接收机开展高时间分辨率、全偏振监测，同时安排每两周一次、每次 20 分钟的常规 FAST 观测。具体分析方法的细节摘要未说明。

Result: 确定 FRB 20220529 是极为活跃的重复暴，表现出最长的活动持续时间之一和一个潜在周期；最近观测到一次突然的 RM 耀发，这是首次在 FRB 中探测到此类“RM 耀发”；在 RM 耀发期间，Parkes 的两个高信噪比暴对理解 RM 变化至关重要；FAST 的高灵敏度捕获了许多暴，Parkes 宽带接收机在低活动率阶段仍保持良好探测率。数值显著性摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为该 RM 耀发表明 FRB 20220529 所处环境偶尔发生日冕物质抛射爆发，并认为这为研究 FRB 爆发环境及其与其他暴参数的关系提供了独特机会；若周期性与 RM 耀发得到证实，二者将相互印证，成为 FRB 双星起源的“确凿证据”。对脉冲星、磁星或 FRB 与磁星联系的直接推论，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: After nearly two years of monitoring, comprising 126.7 hours over 57 observations with the Parkes telescope and 49.4 hours across 101 observations with the FAST telescopes, we have determined that FRB 20220529 is an extremely active repeater. It exhibits one of the longest activity durations and a potential period. Due to frequent observations scheduled with both Parkes and FAST, we recently observed an abrupt rotation measure (RM) flare in this source. This is the first detection of such an ``RM flare'' in a fast radio burst (FRB), suggesting that the source is in an environment with occasionally erupting coronal mass ejection. This presents a unique opportunity to study the eruption environment of FRBs and investigate the relation between burst activity and other burst parameters. If confirmed, the periodicity and the ``RM flare'' of FRB 20220529 would corroborate each other and become a ``smoking gun'' of the binary origin of FRB. In our previous analysis, both Parkes and FAST observations have proven essential. While FAST's higher sensitivity has enabled the capture of many bursts, Parkes' wideband receiver has provided a good burst detection rate even during low-rate phases. Notably, during the RM flare, two high signal-to-noise ratio bursts from Parkes have been crucial in understanding the RM variations. To further investigate FRB 20220529, we have scheduled regular FAST observations every fortnight, monitoring the source for 20 minutes each time. Therefore, we also propose to monitor FRB 20220529 using the Parkes UWL receiver, ensuring high-time resolution and employing full-polarization observations.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 20220529 在近四年 Parkes 和 FAST 监测中表现出极长活动持续时间和潜在周期性，并出现两次史无前例的 RM 爆发；若周期性与 RM 爆发相互印证，将成为双星起源的确凿证据，因此需要继续高频监测以进一步研究该源。

Result: 经过近四年监测，FRB 20220529 被确立为极其活跃的重复源，具有已知最长活动持续时间之一并显示潜在周期性证据。由于 Parkes 和 FAST 的频繁观测，探测到两次突然的 RM 爆发，这是首次在 FRB 中观测到的 RM 爆发，表明致密、磁化的等离子体团穿过了视线。第二次 RM 爆发尤其使双星起源场景特别有说服力。此前分析表明 Parkes 与 FAST 的观测均必不可少：FAST 灵敏度高可探测许多爆发，Parkes UWL 在低活动阶段仍提供稳定爆发探测率。

Conclusion: 作者认为，首次观测到的 RM 爆发表明致密、磁化等离子体团穿过视线；第二次 RM 爆发尤其使 FRB 20220529 的双星起源场景特别有说服力，若周期性与 RM 爆发得到证实将相互印证，成为双星起源的确凿证据。此前分析还表明 Parkes 和 FAST 的观测对研究该源均必不可少，约一周的观测节奏有望捕捉 RM 下降开始期间的详细结构。根据摘要无法判断更具体的物理机制。

Abstract: After nearly four years of monitoring with both the Parkes and FAST telescopes, FRB 20220529 has been established as an extremely active repeater. It exhibits one of the longest known activity durations and shows evidence for a potential periodicity. Owing to the frequent observations carried out with Parkes and FAST, two abrupt rotation-measure (RM) flares have been detected in this source. These constitute the first RM flares ever observed in a fast radio burst (FRB), indicating that a dense, magnetised plasma clump passed across the line of sight. The second RM flare in particular makes a binary-origin scenario for FRB 20220529 especially compelling. If confirmed, the periodicity and RM flares would mutually reinforce one another, serving as a smoking gun for a binary origin. Previous analyses have shown that observations from both Parkes and FAST are essential. FAST's exceptional sensitivity enables the detection of many bursts, whereas the Parkes UWL receiver provides a stable burst-detection rate even during low-activity phases. To further investigate FRB 20220529, we have scheduled regular FAST observations every fortnight. We therefore propose to continue monitoring FRB 20220529 with the Parkes UWL receiver as well. The FAST and Parkes sessions are expected to be separated by a few days, ideally about one week. A cadence of approximately one week offers an excellent opportunity to capture detailed structure during the onset of RM decreases, as demonstrated by previous monitoring.

</details>

*Zhang, Songbo,Hobbs, George,Toomey, Lawrence,Dai, Shi,Russell, Christopher,Wu, Xuefeng,Wang, Ziteng,Li, Ye,Yang, Xuan,Chang, Chenming,Geng, Jinjun,Yang, Yuanpei,Wang, Jiarui*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 经过近四年 Parkes 和 FAST 监测，FRB 20220529 被确认为活动极为频繁的重复暴，并首次在 FRB 中探测到两次突然的 RM 耀发，可能支持双星起源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 20220529 表现出已知最长的活动持续时间之一，并显示出可能存在周期性的证据；此前分析表明 Parkes 和 FAST 的观测对研究该源都必不可少，因此需要继续联合监测以进一步研究该源。

Method: 摘要说明：使用 Parkes 和 FAST 两台望远镜对 FRB 20220529 进行了近四年监测，并频繁观测；已安排每两周进行一次定期 FAST 观测，提议继续使用 Parkes UWL 接收机监测，FAST 与 Parkes 观测时段预计相隔几天，理想约为一周，观测节奏约为一周。

Result: 摘要说明：FRB 20220529 被确认为活动极为频繁的重复暴，表现出已知最长的活动持续时间之一，并有潜在周期性证据；探测到两次突然的 RM 耀发，这是首次在 FRB 中观测到的 RM 耀发，表明一个致密、磁化的等离子体团穿过视线方向，其中第二次 RM 耀发尤其使双星起源情景令人信服。FAST 灵敏度卓越，可探测到许多暴；Parkes UWL 接收机在低活动阶段仍提供稳定暴探测率。

Conclusion: 作者认为，一个致密、磁化的等离子体团穿过视线方向导致了首次在 FRB 中观测到的两次 RM 耀发；第二次 RM 耀发尤其使 FRB 20220529 的双星起源情景令人信服，若得到证实，周期性与 RM 耀发将相互印证，成为双星起源的确凿证据。继续以约一周节奏联合 Parkes 和 FAST 监测，有望在 RM 下降开始期间捕获详细结构。根据摘要无法判断与磁星、FRB 之外其他暂现源或脉冲星单脉冲、模式转换、计时及偏振等主题的关系。

Abstract: After nearly four years of monitoring with both the Parkes and FAST telescopes, FRB 20220529 has been established as an extremely active repeater. It exhibits one of the longest known activity durations and shows evidence for a potential periodicity. Owing to the frequent observations carried out with Parkes and FAST, two abrupt rotation-measure (RM) flares have been detected in this source. These constitute the first RM flares ever observed in a fast radio burst (FRB), indicating that a dense, magnetised plasma clump passed across the line of sight. The second RM flare in particular makes a binary-origin scenario for FRB 20220529 especially compelling. If confirmed, the periodicity and RM flares would mutually reinforce one another, serving as a smoking gun for a binary origin. Previous analyses have shown that observations from both Parkes and FAST are essential. FAST's exceptional sensitivity enables the detection of many bursts, whereas the Parkes UWL receiver provides a stable burst-detection rate even during low-activity phases. To further investigate FRB 20220529, we have scheduled regular FAST observations every fortnight. We therefore propose to continue monitoring FRB 20220529 with the Parkes UWL receiver as well. The FAST and Parkes sessions are expected to be separated by a few days, ideally about one week. A cadence of approximately one week offers an excellent opportunity to capture detailed structure during the onset of RM decreases, as demonstrated by previous monitoring.

</details>

Method: 摘要说明：利用 Parkes 和 FAST 两台望远镜对 FRB 20220529 进行了近四年的监测；Parkes 使用 UWL 接收机，FAST 提供高灵敏度探测；已安排每两周一次的 FAST 常规观测，并建议继续用 Parkes UWL 监测，两者观测时段相隔几天、最好约一周。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、观测日期与具体时长，也未说明数据分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告：FRB 20220529 被确立为极为活跃的重复暴，具有已知最长的活动持续时间之一并显示出可能存在周期性的证据；探测到两次突然的 RM 耀发，这是首次在 FRB 中观测到 RM 耀发，表明一个致密、磁化的等离子体团穿过视线方向；第二次 RM 耀发尤其使双星起源情景格外有说服力。此前分析显示 FAST 的灵敏度可探测到许多爆发，Parkes UWL 接收机在低活动阶段仍能提供稳定的爆发探测率。

Conclusion: 作者认为，如果周期性与 RM 耀发得到证实，二者将相互印证，成为 FRB 20220529 双星起源的决定性证据；由于 Parkes 与 FAST 的观测互补，作者建议继续以 Parkes UWL 接收机联合 FAST 监测该源，并利用约一周的观测节奏捕捉 RM 下降开始期间的精细结构。上述解释是否成立取决于后续确认，根据摘要无法判断其最终物理结论。

Abstract: After nearly four years of monitoring with both the Parkes and FAST telescopes, FRB 20220529 has been established as an extremely active repeater. It exhibits one of the longest known activity durations and shows evidence for a potential periodicity. Owing to the frequent observations carried out with Parkes and FAST, two abrupt rotation-measure (RM) flares have been detected in this source. These constitute the first RM flares ever observed in a fast radio burst (FRB), indicating that a dense, magnetised plasma clump passed across the line of sight. The second RM flare in particular makes a binary-origin scenario for FRB 20220529 especially compelling. If confirmed, the periodicity and RM flares would mutually reinforce one another, serving as a smoking gun for a binary origin. Previous analyses have shown that observations from both Parkes and FAST are essential. FAST's exceptional sensitivity enables the detection of many bursts, whereas the Parkes UWL receiver provides a stable burst-detection rate even during low-activity phases. To further investigate FRB 20220529, we have scheduled regular FAST observations every fortnight. We therefore propose to continue monitoring FRB 20220529 with the Parkes UWL receiver as well. The FAST and Parkes sessions are expected to be separated by a few days, ideally about one week. A cadence of approximately one week offers an excellent opportunity to capture detailed structure during the onset of RM decreases, as demonstrated by previous monitoring.

</details>

*Zhang, Songbo,Hobbs, George,Toomey, Lawrence,Dai, Shi,Russell, Christopher,Wu, Xuefeng,Wang, Ziteng,Li, Ye,Yang, Xuan,Chang, Chenming,Geng, Jinjun,Yang, Yuanpei,Wang, Jiarui*

Conclusion: 作者认为，两次 RM 耀发表明一个致密、磁化的等离子体团穿过了视线方向；第二次 RM 耀发使 FRB 20220529 的双星起源情景尤其具有说服力，如果得到确认，周期性与 RM 耀发将相互加强，成为双星起源的决定性证据。因此提议继续用 Parkes UWL 接收机监测该源，以配合 FAST 观测进一步研究。

Abstract: After nearly four years of monitoring with both the Parkes and FAST telescopes, FRB 20220529 has been established as an extremely active repeater. It exhibits one of the longest known activity durations and shows evidence for a potential periodicity. Owing to the frequent observations carried out with Parkes and FAST, two abrupt rotation-measure (RM) flares have been detected in this source. These constitute the first RM flares ever observed in a fast radio burst (FRB), indicating that a dense, magnetised plasma clump passed across the line of sight. The second RM flare in particular makes a binary-origin scenario for FRB 20220529 especially compelling. If confirmed, the periodicity and RM flares would mutually reinforce one another, serving as a smoking gun for a binary origin. Previous analyses have shown that observations from both Parkes and FAST are essential. FAST's exceptional sensitivity enables the detection of many bursts, whereas the Parkes UWL receiver provides a stable burst-detection rate even during low-activity phases. To further investigate FRB 20220529, we have scheduled regular FAST observations every fortnight. We therefore propose to continue monitoring FRB 20220529 with the Parkes UWL receiver as well. The FAST and Parkes sessions are expected to be separated by a few days, ideally about one week. A cadence of approximately one week offers an excellent opportunity to capture detailed structure during the onset of RM decreases, as demonstrated by previous monitoring.

</details>


### [1303] [Parkes observations for project P1195 semester 2023APRS_01]()
*Kaczmarek, Jane,Li, Dongzi,Meyers, Bradley,Pearlman, Aaron,Andersen, Bridget,Lazda, Mattias,Mckinven, Ryan,Cassanelli, Tomas,Pleunis, Ziggy*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该 proposal 旨在利用 Parkes/Murriyang 在未分配时间中观测由 CHIME/FRB 发现、且具有向下漂移子暴和窄带宽发射特征的 FRB 事件，以识别更多重复 FRB；摘要未报告实际观测结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已知的数千个 FRB 中只有少数被确认重复，而重复事件可能具有与一次性事件根本不同的发射性质，例如向下漂移的子暴和窄带宽发射。尚不清楚这类特征在重复 FRB 中所占比例，也不清楚所观测差异源自群体内在差异、局部环境相关的传播效应，还是未理解的选择效应。作者认为更大的重复 FRB 样本可用于统计研究，并确定重复事件在更大 FRB 体系中的位置。

Method: 该 proposal 提出瞄准由 Canadian Hydrogen Intensity Mapping Experiment FRB（CHIME/FRB）观测到、且已表现出向下漂移子暴和窄带宽发射特征的事件，以观测和识别更多重复 FRB。摘要指出 Parkes/Murriyang 与 CHIME 的视场在 +25 至 -11 度纬度之间重叠，并称 Project P1195 semester 2023APRS_01 仅在原本会闲置的未分配时间中观测。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、时间跨度、样本量、目标数量及分析或统计方法。

Result: 摘要未说明任何已获得的观测结果。摘要所述为项目动机与计划：与数千个已知 FRB 相比，已知重复的 FRB 只有少数几个；在这一小样本中，重复 FRB 表现出向下漂移的子暴和窄带宽发射；Parkes/Murriyang 与 CHIME 的视场在 +25 至 -11 度纬度之间重叠，且 CHIME 已探测到数千个 FRB，因此存在许多对两台望远镜都可见的目标；摘要还说明鉴于非探测的可能性，观测将只在未分配时间进行。摘要未给出探测、重复事件数量、显著性、计时或自转减慢、偏振、频谱或单脉冲测量结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，更大的重复 FRB 群体将有助于统计研究这些发射现象，并回答重复事件在更大 FRB 体系中处于什么位置；通过仅在原本会闲置的未分配时间观测，该项目可提高 Murriyang 的科学影响力，并增进对这些事件的理解。摘要未报告该策略是否已成功识别出新的重复 FRB，也未给出对这些 FRB 物理性质的具体结论；根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Repeating sources of fast radio bursts (FRBs) have enabled numerous breakthroughs in our understanding of the universe, as well as key insight into the progenitors of these enigmatic events. Compared to the thousands of known FRBs, there are only a handful that are known to repeat. From this small sample, it has become apparent that the emission properties of repeating events may be fundamentally different from one-off events, with repeating FRBs demonstrating downward-drifting sub-bursts and narrow bandwidth emission. It is unclear what percentage of repeating FRBs have these characteristics and if the observed differences represent intrinsic differences in FRB populations, if it is caused by a propagation effect related to local environments, or if it is due to as yet to be understood selection effects. A larger population of repeating FRBs would enable statistical studies of these phenomena and answer where repeat events fit in the larger FRB ecosystem. This proposal aims to observe and identify additional repeat FRBs by targeting events that have demonstrated the aforementioned emission properties, as observed by Canadian Hydrogen Intensity Mapping Experiment FRB (CHIME/FRB). Parkes/Murriyang's and CHIME's fields of view overlap between +25 and -11 degrees latitude and given CHIME's success at detecting thousands of FRBs, there are many targets that are visible to both telescopes. Given the likelihood of non-detections, this project proposes to only observe in unallocated time which would otherwise go unused, therefore increasing the scientific impact of Murriyang while also building upon our understanding of these enigmatic events.

</details>


### [1304] [Constraining axionlike particle mediated dark matter with observational constraints: A statistical and machine learning approach]()
*Thakur, Prashant,Taridalu, Aravind,Rather, Ishfaq Ahmad,Klangburam, Tanech,Pongkitivanichkul, Chakrit*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 通过生成超过 30,000 个状态方程并结合多信使观测约束，该研究用统计筛选与机器学习方法约束 ALP 媒介暗物质参数，发现 ALP 媒介暗物质可作为解释低质量致密天体的可行候选者，同时仍支持 2 M⊙ 中子星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究旨在考察轴子类粒子（ALP）媒介的暗物质对中子星结构产生的现象学后果，并在核物理数据与现代天体物理观测已约束的相对论平均场框架下，系统探索暗物质参数空间，以判断此类暗物质模型能否在满足多信使观测量约束的同时解释低质量致密天体并仍支持 2 M⊙ 中子星。

Method: 基于受核物理数据与现代天体物理观测约束、含非线性介子自相互作用的相对论平均场框架，系统探索 DM 粒子质量 mχ∈[0,1000] GeV 与 DM 费米动量 qf∈[0,0.06] GeV 的参数空间，生成超过 30,000 个 EoS，使用硬 EoS1 与软 EoS18 两个代表性强子 EoS 并纳入地壳 EoS；采用结合投票、似然和核密度估计得分的多层统计筛选方案，应用射电和 X 射线脉冲星、GW170817 及 HESS J1731-347 的约束；并使用 AutoGluon 开发监督插值模型从重建的 NS 质量-半径曲线推断 DM 参数。

Result: 满足 PSR J0614-3329 半径界限的模型天然符合 HESS 约束；硬 EoS 给出 mχ≳43 GeV 的下界，得分加权后验偏好 qf=0.034_{-0.012}^{+0.020} 和 mχ∈[101,949] GeV（中位数 ~466 GeV）；软 EoS 不给出 mχ 的严格下界，但同时具有大 mχ 和大 qf 的情形被强烈排除；AutoGluon 监督插值模型达到 R²>0.998，特征重要性分析表明 mχ 主要受半径比 R1.6/R1.4 等全局形状指标约束，qf 主要由潮汐形变率 Λ1.4 决定。

Conclusion: 作者认为，ALP 媒介的暗物质是解释低质量致密天体的可行候选者，同时仍支持 2 M⊙ 的中子星；满足 PSR J0614-3329 半径界限的模型天然符合 HESS 约束。基于重建 NS 质量-半径曲线的高精度监督插值模型可作为从质量-半径曲线推断 DM 参数的统计方法；但该机器学习方法的可迁移性根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We present a comprehensive investigation into the phenomenological consequences of axionlike particle (ALP) mediated dark matter (DM) on the structure of neutron stars (NSs). Our analysis is grounded in a well-established relativistic mean-field framework, featuring nonlinear mesonic self-interactions constrained by nuclear physics data and modern astrophysical observations. We systematically explore the DM parameter space, spanning DM particle masses <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>m</mml:mi><mml:mi>χ</mml:mi></mml:msub><mml:mo>∈</mml:mo><mml:mo>[</mml:mo><mml:mn>0</mml:mn><mml:mo>,</mml:mo><mml:mn>1000</mml:mn><mml:mo>]</mml:mo><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>GeV</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> and DM fermi momenta <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>q</mml:mi><mml:mi>f</mml:mi></mml:msub><mml:mo>∈</mml:mo><mml:mo>[</mml:mo><mml:mn>0</mml:mn><mml:mo>,</mml:mo><mml:mn>0.06</mml:mn><mml:mo>]</mml:mo><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>GeV</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula>, by generating a vast ensemble of over 30,000 equations of state (EoSs). This analysis is carried out using two representative hadronic EoSs, a stiff one (EoS1) and a soft one (EoS18), with the explicit inclusion of the crustal EoS to properly account for the low-density regime of NSs. Employing a multitiered statistical filtering scheme, combining voting, likelihood, and kernel density estimation scores, we apply stringent constraints from a suite of multimessenger observations, including radio and x-ray pulsars, GW170817, and low-mass compact object HESS J1731-347, revealing that models satisfying the PSR J0614-3329 radius bound inherently comply with the HESS constraints, positioning ALP-mediated DM as a viable candidate for explaining low-mass compact objects while still supporting <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mn>2</mml:mn><mml:msub><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mo>⊙</mml:mo></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> NSs. For the stiff EoS, we obtain a lower bound of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:msub><mml:mrow><mml:mi>m</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mi>χ</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub><mml:mo>≳</mml:mo><mml:mn>43</mml:mn><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>GeV</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula>, with score-weighted posteriors favoring <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>q</mml:mi><mml:mi>f</mml:mi></mml:msub><mml:mo>=</mml:mo><mml:mn>0.03</mml:mn><mml:msubsup><mml:mn>4</mml:mn><mml:mrow><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:mn>0.012</mml:mn></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>+</mml:mo><mml:mn>0.020</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msubsup></mml:math></inline-formula> and a broad allowed DM mass range <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>m</mml:mi><mml:mi>χ</mml:mi><mml:mo>∈</mml:mo><mml:mo>[</mml:mo><mml:mn>101</mml:mn><mml:mo>,</mml:mo><mml:mn>949</mml:mn><mml:mo>]</mml:mo><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>GeV</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> (median <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mo>~</mml:mo><mml:mn>466</mml:mn><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>GeV</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula>). In contrast, the soft EoS yields no strict lower bound on <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>m</mml:mi><mml:mi>χ</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula>, although scenarios with simultaneously large <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>m</mml:mi><mml:mi>χ</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> and <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>q</mml:mi><mml:mi>f</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> are strongly disfavored. We developed a high-precision supervised interpolation model using AutoGluon to infer DM parameters from reconstructed NS mass-radius curves, achieving <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msup><mml:mi>R</mml:mi><mml:mn>2</mml:mn></mml:msup><mml:mo>&gt;</mml:mo><mml:mn>0.998</mml:mn></mml:math></inline-formula>. Feature-importance analysis indicates that the DM mass <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>m</mml:mi><mml:mi>χ</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> is mainly constrained by global shape indicators such as the radius ratio <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>R</mml:mi><mml:mn>1.6</mml:mn></mml:msub><mml:mo>/</mml:mo><mml:msub><mml:mi>R</mml:mi><mml:mn>1.4</mml:mn></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula>, whereas the Fermi momentum <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>q</mml:mi><mml:mi>f</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> is primarily determined by the tidal deformability <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>Λ</mml:mi><mml:mn>1.4</mml:mn></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula>.

</details>


### [1305] [Parkes observations for project P1139 semester 2022APRS_01]()
*Hurley-Walker, Natasha,Bhat, Ramesh,Anderson, Gemma,Galvin, Tim,Price, Danny,Heald, George*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 利用MWA低频巡天，首次直接探测到一颗超长周期磁星，其射电辐射高度偏振，周期约为20分钟，动态谱中存在高注量、窄时间尺度的未分辨“尖峰”，注量接近银心磁星产生的FRB；该源在2018年第一季度可见后已进入宁静状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该源若再次开启，仅凭MWA监测不足以确定其准确位置、宽带谱指数、精确DM、高频偏振特性及短时间尺度辐射行为，因此需要ATCA和Parkes的触发观测；本学期还希望把触发标准扩展至即将开展的MWA银道面监测中探测到的任何类似源。

Method: 摘要说明使用MWA低频天空巡天进行探测与监测，并请求基于MWA监测、使用ATCA和Parkes进行触发观测。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本大小及分析方法的细节。

Result: 首次直接探测到一颗超长周期磁星；其射电辐射高度偏振，并在约20分钟的时间尺度上呈现周期性。其动态谱显示高注量、窄时间尺度的“尖峰”，这些“尖峰”在数据中未被分辨，注量接近银心磁星产生的FRB。该源于2018年第一季度可见，此后进入宁静状态。

Conclusion: 作者将该源解释为超长周期磁星，并指出其辐射高度偏振、约20分钟周期，动态谱中未分辨的高注量窄时间尺度“尖峰”注量接近银心磁星产生的FRB。为在源重新开启时确定准确位置、宽带谱指数、精确DM、高频偏振特性并理解短时间尺度辐射，需要ATCA和Parkes的触发观测；本学期请求将触发标准扩展至即将开展的MWA银道面监测中探测到的任何类似源。

Abstract: We have made the first direct detection of an ultra-long period magnetar, using a low-frequency sky survey performed by the Murchison Widefield Array (MWA). Its radio emission is highly polarised and periodic on a timescale of ~20 minutes. Its dynamic spectrum shows high-fluence narrow-timescale ``spikes'' which are unresolved by our data, with fluence approaching the Fast Radio Bursts generated by the Galactic centre magnetar. The source was visible in Q1 2018 but has since entered a quiescent state. In the event that it switches back on, we requre follow-up of this source to determine an accurate position, a wide-band spectral index, a precise dispersion measure, determination of its polarisation properties at high frequencies, and to better understand the emission on short timescales. Therefore, we are requesting triggered observations with ATCA and Parkes based on MWA monitoring. This semester we request to extend the triggering criterion to any similar source detected in an upcoming monitoring campaign of the Galactic plane using the MWA.

</details>


### [1306] [Parkes observations for project P1139 semester 2022APRS_05]()
*Hurley-Walker, Natasha,Bhat, Ramesh,Anderson, Gemma,Galvin, Tim,Price, Danny,Heald, George*

Main category: scix

### [1312] [The effect of evaporation on the formation and evolution of Huntsman systems]()
*Yang, Hao-Ran,Gao, Shi-Jie,Li, Xiang-Dong,Guo, Yun-Lang,Tang, Wen-Shi*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 对Huntsman系统（MSP双星的一个罕见子类）的详细双星演化与族合成计算表明，MSP驱动的蒸发仅起次要作用，不会显著改变其形成参数空间或预期族群（约十个系统），但会在低质量端造成白矮星质量-轨道周期关系的系统性偏移，使给定白矮星质量下的最终轨道更宽。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Huntsman系统是最近识别出的罕见毫秒脉冲星（MSP）双星子类，由处于分离状态的中子星与演化后的巨星伴星在较宽轨道上组成。其形成被认为涉及红团簇引起的分离，但MSP驱动的蒸发在这一演化阶段的作用此前尚未被定量评估，因此需要量化蒸发对其形成与演化以及可观测性质的影响。

Method: 在广泛的初始双星参数范围内进行包含MSP驱动蒸发的详细双星演化计算，并与双星族合成相结合，以预测Huntsman系统的可观测族群。摘要未说明具体使用的程序名称、观测数据或观测频段。

Result: Huntsman系统主要起源于经历Case B质量转移和红团簇引起的分离的双星，初始供体质量为1.0 - 2.5 M<SUB>⊙</SUB>，轨道周期高于分叉周期。蒸发的作用是次要的：它略微改变轨道演化和分离阶段的持续时间，但不显著改变形成参数空间或预期族群，预期族群包含约十个Huntsman系统。此外，蒸发能在低质量端引起白矮星质量-轨道周期关系的系统性偏移，使给定白矮星质量下的最终轨道系统性地更宽。

Conclusion: 作者认为，对于Huntsman系统的形成参数空间和预期族群（约十个系统），MSP驱动的蒸发只带来轻微影响，而不会显著改变它们；不过在低质量端，蒸发可以系统性地改变白矮星质量与轨道周期的关系，使给定白矮星质量对应更宽的最终轨道。这提示在利用白矮星质量-轨道周期关系解释此类系统时需要考虑蒸发的影响。是否与脉冲星单脉冲发射、模式转换、计时、偏振或快速射电暴（FRB）等有直接联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Context. Huntsman systems are a recently identified and rare subclass of millisecond pulsar (MSP) binaries, which are characterized by a detached neutron star and an evolved giant companion on relatively wide orbits. Their formation has been proposed to involve red-bump-induced detachment, whereas the effect of MSP-driven evaporation during this evolutionary stage has not yet been quantitatively assessed. Aims. We quantify the effect of MSP-driven evaporation on the formation and evolution of Huntsman systems and assess its effects on their observable properties. Methods. We performed detailed binary evolution calculations including MSP-driven evaporation over a wide range of initial binary parameters and combined them with binary population synthesis to predict the observable population of Huntsman systems. Results. Huntsman systems primarily originate in binaries undergoing Case B mass transfer and red-bump-induced detachment, with initial donor masses of 1.0 - 2.5 M<SUB>⊙</SUB> and orbital periods above the bifurcation period. Evaporation has a secondary effect that slightly modifies the orbital evolution and duration of the detached phase, but does not significantly alter the formation parameter space or the expected population, which contains about ten Huntsman systems. We further show that evaporation can produce systematic shifts in the white dwarf mass-orbital period relation at the low-mass end, leading to systematically wider final orbits for a given white dwarf mass.

</details>


### [1313] [Parkes observations for project P1068 semester 2021APRS_15]()
*Kumar, Pravir,Hobbs, George,Deller, Adam,Shannon, Ryan,Price, Danny,Dai, Shi,Lee, Kejia,Zhang, Songbo,Luo, Rui,Feng, Yi,Gajjar, Vishal,Siemion, Andrew*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请提出继续用Parkes的UWL接收机监测活跃重复暴FRB 180301，以限制其重复率、识别脉冲特征随时间的变化并测量其偏振性质；摘要指出其多样的偏振性质暗示前身星处于极端磁离子环境中，且可能有助于区分重复与非重复FRB源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB领域中，多大比例的FRB发射重复暴仍未解答；已知约20个重复FRB，其频谱-时间性质暗示与看似非重复的暴存在差异，但统计量太少，无法定论。FRB 180301是活跃重复暴、类似FRB 121102、是Parkes可见的最活跃FRB源，且在各重复暴中表现出多样偏振性质，因而值得进一步研究。

Method: 摘要说明上一学期开展观测活动并探测到多个重复暴，但这些探测的信噪比不足以测量频谱-偏振性质；申请使用Parkes的UWL接收机继续监测该FRB源，以表征宽带发射性质。摘要未说明观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本量及具体分析方法。

Result: 上一学期的观测活动已从FRB 180301探测到多个重复暴，但其信噪比（S/N）不足以显著到可测量频谱-偏振性质。摘要提到FAST探测中存在多样的偏振角摆动，最初的Parkes探测中存在显著圆偏振。摘要未说明重复率、脉冲特征随时间变化、偏振测量数值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者依据FAST探测中多样的偏振角摆动和最初Parkes探测中显著的圆偏振，认为该前身星嵌于具有复杂场结构的极端磁离子环境中，这是此前未曾见过的；理解该源多样的偏振性质可能是区分重复暴源与看似非重复暴源的关键。所提未来观测旨在限制重复率、识别脉冲特征变化并测量偏振性质，从而为发射机制提供见解。

Abstract: In the fast-moving world of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs), the critical question of what fraction of FRBs emit repeat bursts remains unanswered. Of order 20 repeating FRBs are now known, and their spectro-temporal properties hint at differences with apparently non-repeating bursts - the poor statistics preclude a definitive diagnosis. FRB 180301 is a promising source for further study for multiple reasons: it is an active repeater similar to the FRB 121102 and the most active FRB source visible to Parkes, and it shows diverse polarization properties across the repeat bursts. We have detected multiple repeat bursts from this source in our campaign last semester. The signal-to-noise ratio (S/N) of these detections are not sufficiently significant to measure their spectro-polarimetric properties. We request Parkes observations with the UWL receiver to continue the monitoring of this FRB source in order to characterize the broadband emission properties. Some of the key goals for these future observations are: to constrain the repetition rate, identify any variation of pulse characteristics over time, measure the polarimetric properties and provide insight into the emission mechanisms. The diverse polarization angle swings in the FAST detections and significant circular polarization in the original Parkes detection indicate the progenitor is embedded in an extreme magneto-ionic environment with complex field structure that has not been seen before. Understanding these diverse polarization properties from this source could be the key to distinguish repeater sources from the apparent non-repeaters ones.

</details>

Motivation: FRB领域中“有多大比例的FRB会发出重复暴”这一关键问题仍未解答；已知约20个重复FRB，其频谱-时间特性暗示与表观非重复暴存在差异，但统计量差，无法定论。FRB 180301活跃、类似FRB 121102、是Parkes可见最活跃的FRB源，且重复暴间偏振特性多样，因而值得进一步研究。

Method: 申请使用Parkes的UWL接收机继续监测FRB 180301；上一学期的观测活动已从该源探测到多个重复暴，但这些探测的S/N不足以测量其频谱-偏振特性。未来观测的目标包括限制重复率、识别脉冲特性随时间的变化、测量偏振特性。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度、样本量或数据分析方法。

Result: 上一学期的观测活动已从FRB 180301探测到多个重复暴，但这些探测的S/N不足以显著到可以测量其频谱-偏振特性。摘要还提及该源在FAST探测中表现出多样的偏振角摆动，最初Parkes探测中表现出显著圆偏振；此外，其各重复暴之间表现出多样的偏振特性。摘要未给出具体的S/N数值、重复率数值或偏振测量数值。

Conclusion: 作者依据FAST探测中多样的偏振角摆动与最初Parkes探测中的显著圆偏振，认为该前身星嵌于一个具有前所未见的复杂场结构的极端磁离子环境中；并认为理解该源多样的偏振特性可能是区分重复暴源与表观非重复暴源的关键。根据摘要无法判断重复率、脉冲特性随时间变化及发射机制的具体结论。

Abstract: In the fast-moving world of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs), the critical question of what fraction of FRBs emit repeat bursts remains unanswered. Of order 20 repeating FRBs are now known, and their spectro-temporal properties hint at differences with apparently non-repeating bursts - the poor statistics preclude a definitive diagnosis. FRB 180301 is a promising source for further study for multiple reasons: it is an active repeater similar to the FRB 121102 and the most active FRB source visible to Parkes, and it shows diverse polarization properties across the repeat bursts. We have detected multiple repeat bursts from this source in our campaign last semester. The signal-to-noise ratio (S/N) of these detections are not sufficiently significant to measure their spectro-polarimetric properties. We request Parkes observations with the UWL receiver to continue the monitoring of this FRB source in order to characterize the broadband emission properties. Some of the key goals for these future observations are: to constrain the repetition rate, identify any variation of pulse characteristics over time, measure the polarimetric properties and provide insight into the emission mechanisms. The diverse polarization angle swings in the FAST detections and significant circular polarization in the original Parkes detection indicate the progenitor is embedded in an extreme magneto-ionic environment with complex field structure that has not been seen before. Understanding these diverse polarization properties from this source could be the key to distinguish repeater sources from the apparent non-repeaters ones.

</details>

Method: 摘要未说明。

FRB 180301 is a promising source for further study for multiple reasons: it is an active repeater similar to the FRB 121102 and the most active FRB source visible to Parkes, and it shows diverse polarization properties across the repeat bursts. We have detected multiple repeat bursts from this source in our campaign last semester. The signal-to-noise ratio (S/N) of these detections are not sufficiently significant to measure their spectro-polarimetric properties. We request Parkes observations with the UWL receiver to continue the monitoring of this FRB source in order to characterize the broadband emission properties. Some of the key goals for these future observations are: to constrain the repetition rate, identify any variation of pulse characteristics over time, measure the polarimetric properties and provide insight into the emission mechanisms. The diverse polarization angle swings in the FAST detections and significant circular polarization in the original Parkes detection indicate the progenitor is embedded in an extreme magneto-ionic environment with complex field structure that has not been seen before. Motivation: 关键科学问题是多大比例的FRB会发出重复暴。目前已知约20个重复FRB，其频谱-时间性质暗示与看似非重复的暴存在差异，但统计量不足，无法给出确定性结论。FRB 180301是活跃重复源，类似FRB 121102，也是Parkes可见的最活跃FRB源，并在重复暴中展现多样偏振性质，因而值得进一步研究。

Method: 摘要说明：上一学期观测活动中已从该源探测到多次重复暴，但其信噪比（S/N）不足以测量频谱-偏振性质；为此申请使用Parkes的UWL接收机继续监测FRB 180301，以刻画其宽带发射性质。未来观测目标包括限制重复率、识别脉冲特征随时间的变化、测量偏振性质并为发射机制提供洞见。具体观测频率、时间跨度、样本量与分析方法：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：上一学期的观测活动中已从FRB 180301探测到多次重复暴；这些探测的信噪比（S/N）不足以显著到可以测量其频谱-偏振性质。摘要提及FAST探测中存在多样的偏振角摆动，以及最初Parkes探测中存在显著的圆偏振。摘要指出已知约20个重复FRB，其频谱-时间性质暗示与看似非重复的暴存在差异，但统计量不足。具体数值、不确定度与显著性：摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者由FAST探测中多样的偏振角摆动和最初Parkes探测中显著的圆偏振推断，该前身星嵌于一个具有复杂场结构的极端磁离子环境中，这是此前未曾见过的；理解该源这些多样的偏振性质可能是区分重复源与看似非重复源的关键。作者还指出，重复暴与非重复暴之间由频谱-时间性质暗示的差异因统计量不足而无法得到确定性诊断。所申请监测旨在限制重复率、识别脉冲特征随时间的变化并测量偏振性质。根据摘要无法判断其对脉冲星、磁星或FRB其他具体物理机制的适用性。

Abstract: In the fast-moving world of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs), the critical question of what fraction of FRBs emit repeat bursts remains unanswered. Of order 20 repeating FRBs are now known, and their spectro-temporal properties hint at differences with apparently non-repeating bursts - the poor statistics preclude a definitive diagnosis. FRB 180301 is a promising source for further study for multiple reasons: it is an active repeater similar to the FRB 121102 and the most active FRB source visible to Parkes, and it shows diverse polarization properties across the repeat bursts. We have detected multiple repeat bursts from this source in our campaign last semester. The signal-to-noise ratio (S/N) of these detections are not sufficiently significant to measure their spectro-polarimetric properties. We request Parkes observations with the UWL receiver to continue the monitoring of this FRB source in order to characterize the broadband emission properties. Some of the key goals for these future observations are: to constrain the repetition rate, identify any variation of pulse characteristics over time, measure the polarimetric properties and provide insight into the emission mechanisms. The diverse polarization angle swings in the FAST detections and significant circular polarization in the original Parkes detection indicate the progenitor is embedded in an extreme magneto-ionic environment with complex field structure that has not been seen before. Understanding these diverse polarization properties from this source could be the key to distinguish repeater sources from the apparent non-repeaters ones.

</details>
