### [1544] [Parkes Pulsar Timing Array Third Data Release (part 2 of 2)]()
*Zic, Andrew,Reardon, Daniel John,Kapur, Agastya,Hobbs, George,Mandow, Rami,Curylo, Malgorzata,Shannon, Ryan,Askew, Jacob,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,Cameron, Andrew,Chen, Zu-Cheng,Dai, Shi,Di Marco, Valentina,Feng, Yi,Kerr, Matthew,Kulkarni, Atharva,Lower, Marcus,Luo, Rui,Manchester, Dick,Miles, Matthew,Nathan, Rowina,Oslowski, Stefan,Rogers, Axl,Russell, Chris,Shamohamaddi, Mohsen,Spiewak, Renee,Thyagarajan, Nithyanandan,Toomey, Lawrence,Wang, Shuangqiang,Zhang, Lei,Zhang, Songbo,Zhu, Xingjiang*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: PPTA 第三批数据发布包含 32 颗脉冲星最长 18 年的 Parkes "Murriyang" 64 米望远镜观测，典型采样间隔 3 周，并提供了校准脉冲轮廓、流量密度动态谱、脉冲到达时间和初始计时模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该工作旨在给出 Parkes 脉冲星计时阵列（PPTA）的第三批数据发布，其背景是此前已有第二数据发布；摘要说明本发布通过结合第二数据发布的更新版本与约 3 年较新数据来形成，并需要描述处理宽带观测的方法并与此前发布进行比较。

Method: 摘要说明：使用 64 米 Parkes "Murriyang" 射电望远镜对 32 颗脉冲星进行观测；数据时间跨度最长可达 18 年，典型采样间隔为 3 周；由第二数据发布的更新版本与约 3 年较新数据结合而成，较新数据主要使用工作在 704 至 4032 MHz 之间的超宽带接收机系统获得；描述了处理此类宽带观测的方法，并与此前发布进行比较。其他分析或统计方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告该数据发布包含 32 颗脉冲星的观测，数据时间跨度最长可达 18 年，典型采样间隔为 3 周，由第二数据发布的更新版本与约 3 年较新数据结合而成，较新数据主要来自 704 至 4032 MHz 的超宽带接收机系统；并提供了校准后的脉冲轮廓、流量密度动态谱、脉冲到达时间以及初始脉冲星计时模型。摘要未给出具体数值结果或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者明确呈现了 PPTA 第三批数据发布及其内容，并说明了处理宽带观测的方法以及与该阵列此前发布的比较；摘要未给出关于脉冲星自转、偏振或辐射物理等具体科学解释。关于磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）的关联，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We present the third data release from the Parkes Pulsar Timing Array (PPTA) project. The release contains observations of 32 pulsars obtained using the 64-m Parkes "Murriyang" radio telescope. The data span is up to 18 years with a typical cadence of 3 weeks. This data release is formed by combining an updated version of our second data release with ~3 years of more recent data primarily obtained using an ultra-wide-bandwidth receiver system that operates between 704 and 4032 MHz. We provide calibrated pulse profiles, flux-density dynamic spectra, pulse times of arrival, and initial pulsar timing models. We describe methods for processing such wide-bandwidth observations, and compare this data release with our previous release.

</details>

### [1823] [Parkes observations for project P511 semester 2007OCTS]()
*McLaughlin, Maura,Manchester, Dick,Kramer, Michael,Lyne, A.,O'Brien, J.,Camilo, Fernando,Stairs, Ingrid,Faulkner, A.,Lorimer, Duncan Ross*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请提出继续对6个旋转射电暂现源（RRAT）进行计时与监测，以维持相位连接计时解、进一步限制爆发流量分布与谱指数，并搜寻新的爆发和/或自转突变现象。这些观测被视为理解其辐射机制及其与其他中子星族群关系的关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旋转射电暂现源只能通过零星射电爆发被探测到，其辐射机制尚待理解，与其他中子星族群的关系也不明确；先前观测已取得相位连接计时解，需要继续观测以维持并深化相关研究。

Method: 对6个旋转射电暂现源进行持续的计时与监测观测；延续上一观测学期的观测工作，以维持相位连接计时解、限制爆发流量分布与谱指数，并搜寻新的爆发和/或自转突变现象。摘要未说明具体望远镜、仪器、频率或波段、时间跨度及数据分析方法。

Result: 摘要为观测申请，未报告已获得的观测结果；文中提出旨在维持上一观测学期取得的相位连接计时解，进一步限制爆发流量分布与谱指数，并搜寻任何新的、未预期的爆发和/或自转突变现象。摘要未说明具体数值、显著性、偏振或光谱结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些持续观测对于理解这些源的辐射机制、确定它们与其他中子星族群的关系至关重要，并作为在X射线、射电和红外波段开展的一项广泛联合观测活动的基石。根据摘要无法判断与磁星、快速射电暴或脉冲轮廓演化等的具体物理联系。

Abstract: We request continuing timing and monitoring observations of 6 rotating radio transients. These sources are rotating neutron stars which are detectable only through their sporadic radio bursts. The observations proposed here are crucial for understanding the emission mechanism of these sources and for determining how they relate to other neutron star populations. Through the proposed observations, we aim to maintain the phase-connected timing solutions achieved during the last observing semester, further contrain burst flux distributions and spectral indices, and search for any new and unexpected bursting and/or glitching phenomena. These observations are the cornerstone of an extensive campaign at X-ray, radio and infrared wavelengths.

</details>

Abstract: We request continuing timing and monitoring observations of 7 rotating radio transients. These sources are rotating neutron stars which are detectable only through their sporadic radio bursts. The observations proposed here are crucial for understanding the emission mechanism of these sources and for determining how they relate to other neutron star populations. Through monthly observations, we aim to maintain the phase-connected timing solutions achieved during the last observing semester, further contrain burst flux distributions and spectral indices, and search for any new and unexpected bursting and/or glitching phenomena. These observations are the cornerstone of an extensive campaign at X-ray, radio and infrared wavelengths.

</details>


### [1825] [Parkes observations for project P885 semester 2019OCTS_07]()
*Camilo, Fernando,Johnston, Simon,Sarkissian, John,Reynolds, John,Scholz, Paul,Lower, Marcus*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟每周观测磁星 1E 1547.0-5408 和 PSR J1622-4950 以追踪其自转、流量密度和偏振，并指出 XTE J1810-197 在沉寂 10 年后再次成为射电磁星，UWL 接收机的每周观测正提供对其射电频谱和宽带行为的独特测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 磁星具有极其动态的磁层，其射电辐射机制至少在若干重要方面不同于普通脉冲星。持续追踪磁星的自转、流量密度和偏振，以及 XTE J1810-197 在沉寂 10 年后重新成为射电磁星，为表征射电辐射发生的条件并对辐射机制施加约束提供了契机。

Method: 摘要未说明观测时间跨度、样本量或具体分析方法细节。摘要说明：提议对磁星 1E 1547.0-5408 和 PSR J1622-4950 大约每周观测一次，以追踪自转、流量密度和偏振；对 XTE J1810-197 使用 UWL 接收机进行每周观测，但其混沌自转在其他地方得到更详细追踪。

Result: 摘要未说明具体测量数值或统计结果。摘要指出：截至 2018 年末，XTE J1810-197 在沉寂 10 年后再次成为射电磁星；使用 UWL 接收机的每周观测已经在提供对其射电频谱和宽带行为的独特测量。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些观测为极其动态的磁星磁层提供了一个重要窗口，并表征了其中发生射电辐射的条件，从而对辐射机制施加约束，这些机制至少在若干重要方面不同于普通脉冲星的辐射机制。根据摘要无法判断这些观测对快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲、偏振、射电频谱等具体结果的进一步推论。

Abstract: We propose to observe the magnetars 1E 1547.0-5408 and PSR J1622-4950 approximately weekly, to track their rotation, flux density, and polarisation, as we have been doing through this project. Also, as of late 2018, XTE J1810-197 is again a radio magnetar after 10 years dormant! Its chaotic rotation is better tracked in detail elsewhere, but weekly observations with the UWL receiver are already providing unique measurements of its radio spectrum and broad-band behaviour. Our observations provide an important window into remarkably dynamic magnetar magnetospheres, and characterise the conditions under which radio emission takes place therein, placing constraints on the emission mechanisms, which in at least some significant respects differ from those of ordinary pulsars.

</details>


### [1826] [Parkes observations for project P885 semester 2019OCTS_08]()
*Camilo, Fernando,Johnston, Simon,Sarkissian, John,Reynolds, John,Scholz, Paul,Lower, Marcus*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划对磁星 1E 1547.0-5408、PSR J1622-4950 以及 2018 年末重新进入射电活跃期的 XTE J1810-197 进行约每周一次的多波段跟踪观测，以刻画其自转、流量密度、偏振与宽带射电行为，并为磁星磁层中的射电发射机制提供约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 磁星磁层极为动态，其射电发射所处的条件与发射机制尚需刻画，且至少在若干重要方面不同于普通脉冲星。该项目长期跟踪磁星的射电性质，而 XTE J1810-197 在休眠 10 年后于 2018 年末重新成为射电磁星，为进一步研究其射电频谱与宽带行为提供了新契机。

Method: 摘要提到对磁星 1E 1547.0-5408 和 PSR J1622-4950 约每周观测，以跟踪自转、流量密度和偏振；使用 UWL 接收机对 XTE J1810-197 进行每周观测，测量其射电频谱和宽带行为。观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本量及具体分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要指出，截至 2018 年末，XTE J1810-197 在休眠 10 年后再次成为射电磁星；使用 UWL 接收机的每周观测已为其射电频谱和宽带行为提供独特的测量。项目持续对 1E 1547.0-5408 和 PSR J1622-4950 进行跟踪，以观测其自转、流量密度和偏振。具体测量数值、显著性及趋势摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为，这些观测为了解极其动态的磁星磁层提供了重要窗口，并刻画了其中发生射电发射的条件，从而对发射机制施加限制；这些机制至少在一些重要方面不同于普通脉冲星的发射机制。摘要未给出具体机制或定量约束。

Abstract: We propose to observe the magnetars 1E 1547.0-5408 and PSR J1622-4950 approximately weekly, to track their rotation, flux density, and polarisation, as we have been doing through this project. Also, as of late 2018, XTE J1810-197 is again a radio magnetar after 10 years dormant! Its chaotic rotation is better tracked in detail elsewhere, but weekly observations with the UWL receiver are already providing unique measurements of its radio spectrum and broad-band behaviour. Our observations provide an important window into remarkably dynamic magnetar magnetospheres, and characterise the conditions under which radio emission takes place therein, placing constraints on the emission mechanisms, which in at least some significant respects differ from those of ordinary pulsars.

</details>

Result: 摘要指出，截至 2018 年末，XTE J1810-197 在休眠 10 年后再次成为射电磁星。其混沌自转在其他地方得到更详细的追踪，而使用 UWL 接收机的每周观测已经在提供对其射电频谱和宽带行为的独特测量。摘要未给出通量密度、偏振、频谱或自转的具体测量数值与显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，这些观测为了解极其动态的磁星磁层提供了重要窗口，并刻画了其中发生射电辐射的条件，从而对辐射机制施加约束；这些机制至少在若干重要方面不同于普通脉冲星的辐射机制。根据摘要无法判断其与快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲、模式转换等具体现象的直接联系。

Abstract: We propose to observe the magnetars 1E 1547.0-5408 and PSR J1622-4950 approximately weekly, to track their rotation, flux density, and polarisation, as we have been doing through this project. Also, as of late 2018, XTE J1810-197 is again a radio magnetar after 10 years dormant! Its chaotic rotation is better tracked in detail elsewhere, but weekly observations with the UWL receiver are already providing unique measurements of its radio spectrum and broad-band behaviour. Our observations provide an important window into remarkably dynamic magnetar magnetospheres, and characterise the conditions under which radio emission takes place therein, placing constraints on the emission mechanisms, which in at least some significant respects differ from those of ordinary pulsars.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 摘要说明将约每周观测磁星 1E 1547.0-5408 和 PSR J1622-4950，以追踪自转、流量密度和偏振；并使用 UWL 接收机对 XTE J1810-197 进行每周观测。观测频率、时间跨度、数据量和具体分析流程摘要未说明。该项目名称为 P885，学期为 2019OCTS_14。

Result: 摘要说明，截至 2018 年末，XTE J1810-197 在休眠 10 年后再次成为射电磁星；其混沌自转在别处得到更详细的追踪，而 UWL 接收机的每周观测已提供对其射电频谱和宽带行为的独特测量。对 1E 1547.0-5408 和 PSR J1622-4950 的具体自转、流量密度或偏振结果，摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为，这些观测为极其动态的磁星磁层提供了重要窗口，并刻画了其中发生射电辐射的条件，从而对辐射机制施加限制；这些机制至少在若干重要方面不同于普通脉冲星的辐射机制。至于这些观测是否可直接推广到单脉冲、模式转换或快速射电暴（FRB）等问题，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose to observe the magnetars 1E 1547.0-5408 and PSR J1622-4950 approximately weekly, to track their rotation, flux density, and polarisation, as we have been doing through this project. Also, as of late 2018, XTE J1810-197 is again a radio magnetar after 10 years dormant! Its chaotic rotation is better tracked in detail elsewhere, but weekly observations with the UWL receiver are already providing unique measurements of its radio spectrum and broad-band behaviour. Our observations provide an important window into remarkably dynamic magnetar magnetospheres, and characterise the conditions under which radio emission takes place therein, placing constraints on the emission mechanisms, which in at least some significant respects differ from those of ordinary pulsars.

</details>

Result: 摘要提出并延续对 1E 1547.0-5408 和 PSR J1622-4950 的近似每周观测，以追踪自转、流量密度和偏振；指出截至 2018 年末，XTE J1810-197 在休眠 10 年后再次成为射电磁星；并指出其混沌自转在其他地方得到更详细追踪，而使用 UWL 接收机的每周观测已在提供其射电频谱和宽带行为的独特测量。摘要未给出具体数值结果或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些观测为了解极其动态的磁星磁层提供了重要窗口，并刻画了其中发生射电辐射的条件，从而对辐射机制施加限制；这些机制至少在若干重要方面不同于普通脉冲星。根据摘要无法判断其对快速射电暴（FRB）或其他具体物理图像的可迁移性。

Abstract: We propose to observe the magnetars 1E 1547.0-5408 and PSR J1622-4950 approximately weekly, to track their rotation, flux density, and polarisation, as we have been doing through this project. Also, as of late 2018, XTE J1810-197 is again a radio magnetar after 10 years dormant! Its chaotic rotation is better tracked in detail elsewhere, but weekly observations with the UWL receiver are already providing unique measurements of its radio spectrum and broad-band behaviour. Our observations provide an important window into remarkably dynamic magnetar magnetospheres, and characterise the conditions under which radio emission takes place therein, placing constraints on the emission mechanisms, which in at least some significant respects differ from those of ordinary pulsars.

</details>

### [1845] [Parkes observations for project P1153 semester 2022APRS_03]()
*Caleb, Manisha,Stappers, Benjamin,Barr, Ewan,Jankowski, Fabian,Malenta, Mateusz,Rajwade, Kaustubh,Driessen, Laura,Bezuidenhout, Mechiel Christiaan,Morello, Vincent,Surnis, Mayuresh,Kramer, Michael*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: MeerKAT 的 ThunderKAT 和 MeerTRAP 团队发现了一个缓慢脉动的射电源，其最佳拟合周期 P = 75.88 s、Pdot = 2.9 x 10^-13 s/s，位于脉冲星 P-Pdot 参数相空间的“死亡谷”中；MeerKAT 在 L 波段和 UHF 波段的单脉冲分析显示出与已知射电中子星不同的频谱-时间性质，部分脉冲具有准周期性子脉冲成分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该源位于 P-Pdot 脉冲星参数相空间的“死亡谷”中，而根据文献中的模型，此处不预期中子星产生射电辐射；其单脉冲频谱-时间性质与已知射电中子星中所见的任何情况相当不同，因此需要对其脉冲形状演化、频谱-时间-偏振性质及与已知类型中子星的区分进行研究。

Method: ThunderKAT 和 MeerTRAP 团队利用 MeerKAT 射电望远镜的图像和时域数据进行发现；对 MeerKAT 数据在 L 波段和 UHF 波段进行单脉冲分析，并给出周期与周期导数的最佳拟合。摘要还说明申请在 2022 年 4 月学期使用 9 小时 Parkes 观测，以研究脉冲形状演化和频谱-时间-偏振性质、探究子脉冲成分的宽带性质和演化，并研究任何频率-半径映射。

Result: 发现了一个缓慢脉动的射电源，最佳拟合周期 P = 75.88 s，周期导数 Pdot = 2.9 x 10^-13 s/s；该源位于 P-Pdot 脉冲星参数相空间的“死亡谷”中。对 MeerKAT 数据在 L 波段和 UHF 波段的单脉冲分析揭示了显著且不同寻常的频谱-时间性质，与已知射电中子星中所见的任何情况都相当不同，其中一些脉冲显示出准周期性子脉冲成分。

Conclusion: 作者认为该源的频谱-时间性质与已知射电中子星中所见的任何情况都相当不同，并计划利用 Parkes 的超宽带灵敏度研究其脉冲形状演化、频谱-时间-偏振性质、子脉冲成分的宽带性质和演化以及任何频率-半径映射，以表征该源和/或将其与已知类型的其他中子星区分开来。根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）的具体物理联系。

Abstract: The ThunderKAT and MeerTRAP teams at the MeerKAT radio telescope have discovered a slow, pulsating radio source in the image and time domain data. We estimate a best fit period P = 75.88 s and period derivative Pdot = 2.9 x 10^-13 s/s. The source is seen to lie in the P-Pdot pulsar parameter phase space "death valley" where radio emission from neutron stars is not expected according to models in the literature. Single pulse analysis of MeerKAT data in the L- and UHF-bands reveals remarkable and unusual spectro-temporal properties, quite unlike anything seen in known radio neutron stars, with some pulses showing quasi-periodic sub-pulse components. We request 9 hours in the April 2022 semester to utilise the excellent ultra wide-band sensitivity of Parkes to study the pulse shape evolution and spectro-tempo-polarimetric properties of the source, probe the broadband nature and evolution of the sub-pulse components, and investigate any radius-to-frequency mapping, allowing us to characterise and/or distinguish it from other types of known neutron stars.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该源位于 P-Pdot 参数相空间的“死亡谷”，按文献模型中子星在此不应有射电辐射，且其单脉冲频谱-时间特性与已知射电中子星不同，因此需要进一步观测以表征该源并判断其与已知中子星类型的关系。摘要未说明该源与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或自转减速力矩变化之间的具体联系。

Method: 基于 MeerKAT 射电望远镜的 ThunderKAT 和 MeerTRAP 团队图像与时域数据发现该源；估计最佳拟合周期 P = 75.88 s 和周期导数 Pdot = 2.9 x 10^-13 s/s；对 MeerKAT L 波段和 UHF 波段数据进行单脉冲分析。申请在 2022 年 4 月学期使用 Parkes 9 小时，利用其超宽带灵敏度研究脉冲形状演化、频谱-时间-偏振特性、子脉冲成分的宽带性质与演化以及半径-频率映射。摘要未说明具体的计时、偏振、频谱或统计分析方法细节。

Result: 在图像和时域数据中发现一个缓慢脉动射电源，最佳拟合周期 P = 75.88 s，Pdot = 2.9 x 10^-13 s/s，位于 P-Pdot 相空间的“死亡谷”。MeerKAT L 波段和 UHF 波段单脉冲分析显示显著且不寻常的频谱-时间特性，与已知射电中子星所见的任何特性都相当不同，其中一些脉冲显示出准周期子脉冲成分。摘要未说明该源的偏振、射电谱、到达时间（TOA）或爆发辐射结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为该源位于中子星按文献模型不应产生射电辐射的“死亡谷”，其频谱-时间特性与已知射电中子星相当不同，需要通过 Parkes 超宽带观测来表征该源和/或将其与其它类型的已知中子星区分开来；所申请的观测拟研究脉冲形状演化、频谱-时间-偏振特性、子脉冲成分的宽带性质与演化以及可能的半径-频率映射。摘要未说明该源与磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）存在联系，也未给出确定其物理本质的结论；根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星模式转换、自转减速力矩变化或 FRB 的关联。

Abstract: The ThunderKAT and MeerTRAP teams at the MeerKAT radio telescope have discovered a slow, pulsating radio source in the image and time domain data. We estimate a best fit period P = 75.88 s and period derivative Pdot = 2.9 x 10^-13 s/s. The source is seen to lie in the P-Pdot pulsar parameter phase space "death valley" where radio emission from neutron stars is not expected according to models in the literature. Single pulse analysis of MeerKAT data in the L- and UHF-bands reveals remarkable and unusual spectro-temporal properties, quite unlike anything seen in known radio neutron stars, with some pulses showing quasi-periodic sub-pulse components. We request 9 hours in the April 2022 semester to utilise the excellent ultra wide-band sensitivity of Parkes to study the pulse shape evolution and spectro-tempo-polarimetric properties of the source, probe the broadband nature and evolution of the sub-pulse components, and investigate any radius-to-frequency mapping, allowing us to characterise and/or distinguish it from other types of known neutron stars.

</details>

Method: ThunderKAT 和 MeerTRAP 团队使用 MeerKAT 射电望远镜在图像域和时域数据中发现该源；对其 MeerKAT 数据在 L 波段和 UHF 波段进行了单脉冲分析。申请在 2022 年 4 月学期使用 Parkes 的超宽带灵敏度观测 9 小时，以研究脉冲形状演化和频谱-时间-偏振性质、探测子脉冲成分的宽带性质和演化，并研究半径-频率映射。

Result: 估计最佳拟合周期 P = 75.88 s，周期导数 Pdot = 2.9 x 10^-13 s/s。该源位于 P-Pdot 脉冲星参数相空间的“死亡谷”中。MeerKAT 数据在 L 波段和 UHF 波段的单脉冲分析显示显著且不同寻常的频谱-时间性质，与已知射电中子星所见截然不同，其中一些脉冲显示出准周期性的子脉冲成分。

Conclusion: 作者提出该源的频谱-时间性质与已知射电中子星截然不同，计划通过 Parkes 的超宽带观测研究其脉冲形状演化和频谱-时间-偏振性质、子脉冲成分的宽带性质与演化以及半径-频率映射，从而对该源进行表征和/或将其与其他类型的已知中子星区分开来。根据摘要无法判断作者是否给出了该源物理本质的最终结论。

Abstract: The ThunderKAT and MeerTRAP teams at the MeerKAT radio telescope have discovered a slow, pulsating radio source in the image and time domain data. We estimate a best fit period P = 75.88 s and period derivative Pdot = 2.9 x 10^-13 s/s. The source is seen to lie in the P-Pdot pulsar parameter phase space "death valley" where radio emission from neutron stars is not expected according to models in the literature. Single pulse analysis of MeerKAT data in the L- and UHF-bands reveals remarkable and unusual spectro-temporal properties, quite unlike anything seen in known radio neutron stars, with some pulses showing quasi-periodic sub-pulse components. We request 9 hours in the April 2022 semester to utilise the excellent ultra wide-band sensitivity of Parkes to study the pulse shape evolution and spectro-tempo-polarimetric properties of the source, probe the broadband nature and evolution of the sub-pulse components, and investigate any radius-to-frequency mapping, allowing us to characterise and/or distinguish it from other types of known neutron stars.

</details>

Abstract: Cosmic magnetic structures have in common that they are anchored in a dynamo, that an external driver converts kinetic energy into internal magnetic energy, that this magnetic energy is transported as Poynting flux across the magnetically dominated structure, and that the magnetic energy is released in the form of particle acceleration, heating, bulk motion, MHD waves, and radiation. The investigation of the electric current system is particularly illuminating as to the course of events and the physics involved. We demonstrate this for the radio pulsar wind, the solar flare, and terrestrial magnetic storms.

### [1864] [Black Holes as Telescopes: Discovering Supermassive Binaries through Quasiperiodic Lensed Starlight](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.16544)
*Wang, Hanxi,Zumalacárregui, Miguel,Kocsis, Bence*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该文提出，非活动星系核中的超大质量黑洞双星可通过其后方单颗亮星被引力透镜产生的准周期星光透镜效应（QPLS）来发现与刻画，其光变曲线可像引力波波形一样追踪双星轨道演化；群体模型预测红移 z<0.3 且周期小于 10[40] yr 的 QPLS 双星数量为 1–50 [190–5000](n⋆/pc^{-3})。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已发现许多间距 pc–kpc 的 SMBH 双星，但亚秒差距双星仍未确认；识别这类系统有助于理解双星如何越过“最后秒差距”并在引力辐射驱动下并合，也能为宿主星系核组成、星系演化与引力性质提供信息，并可能开启新的多信使通道。

Method: 摘要提出利用宿主星系中位于 SMBH 双星后方单颗亮星受到的引力透镜效应来识别和刻画非活动星系核中的 SMBH 双星；焦散的旋转导致星光的准周期引力透镜效应（QPLS），极端放大造成宿主星系光度显著变化，其光变曲线被用于追踪双星轨道与演化。摘要说明可在现有和即将到来的时域测光数据中搜寻准周期星系光变；具体观测仪器、频段、时间跨度与样本未说明。

Result: 摘要报告，QPLS 可用于探测脉冲星计时阵列和空间探测器（LISA、TianQin）可观测的源群体，并为并合 SMBH 提供提前预警触发，以用于符合或后续 GW 探测。SMBH 群体模型预测，在红移 z<0.3、质量相当的情况下，周期小于 10[40] yr 的 QPLS 双星数量为 1–50 [190–5000](n⋆/pc^{-3})，其中 n⋆ 为恒星数密度。此外，恒星与轨道运动将导致由更长周期 SMBH 双星造成的频繁单次或双次耀发。

Conclusion: 作者认为，SMBH 双星对单颗亮星的引力透镜所产生的准周期星光变化，可作为识别和刻画非活动星系核中紧密双星的一种新特征，其光变曲线类似引力波探测器记录的波形，并可提供并合 SMBH 的提前预警。识别星系光变曲线中的准周期变化有望揭示一组双星系统并阐明相关问题。与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、脉冲星计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱及 FRB 的直接联系：根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Supermassive black hole (SMBH) binary systems are an unavoidable outcome of galaxy mergers. Their dynamics encode valuable information about their formation and growth, the composition of their host galactic nuclei, the evolution of galaxies, and the nature of gravity. Many SMBH binaries with separations pc-kpc have been found, but closer (subparsec) binaries remain to be confirmed. Identifying these systems may elucidate how binaries evolve past the ``final parsec'' until gravitational radiation drives them to coalescence. Methods to discover and characterize SMBH binaries can shed light on these important questions and potentially open new multimessenger channels. Here we show that SMBH binaries in nonactive galactic nuclei can be identified and characterized by the gravitational lensing of individual bright stars, located behind them in the host galaxy. The rotation of ``caustics''---regions where sources are hugely magnified due to the SMBH binary's orbit and inspiral---leads to quasiperiodic lensing of starlight (QPLS). The extreme lensing magnification of individual bright stars produces a significant variation in the host galaxies' luminosity; their lightcurve traces the orbit of the SMBH binary and its evolution, analogous to the waveforms recorded by gravitational-wave (GW) detectors. QPLS probes the population of sources observable by pulsar timing arrays and space detectors (LISA, TianQin), offering advance warning triggers for merging SMBHs for coincident or follow-up GW detections. SMBH population models predict 1--50 <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mo>[</mml:mo><mml:mn>190</mml:mn><mml:mi>--</mml:mi><mml:mn>5000</mml:mn><mml:mo>]</mml:mo><mml:mrow><mml:mo>(</mml:mo><mml:msub><mml:mrow><mml:mi>n</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>⋆</mml:mo></mml:mrow></mml:msub><mml:mo>/</mml:mo><mml:msup><mml:mrow><mml:mi>pc</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:mn>3</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msup><mml:mo>)</mml:mo></mml:mrow></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> QPLS binaries with period less than 10[40] yr with comparable masses and redshift <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>z</mml:mi><mml:mo>&lt;</mml:mo><mml:mn>0.3</mml:mn></mml:math></inline-formula>, where <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>n</mml:mi><mml:mo>⋆</mml:mo></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> is the stellar number density. Additionally, stellar and orbital motion will lead to frequent instances of single or double flares caused by SMBHBs with longer periods. This novel signature can be searched for in a wealth of existing and upcoming time-domain photometric data: identifying quasiperiodic variability in galactic lightcurves will reveal an ensemble of binary systems and illuminate outstanding questions around them.

</details>

Result: 摘要未说明。

Abstract: We request continuing timing and monitoring observations of 6 rotating radio transients and confirmation of 8 others. These sources are rotating neutron stars which are detectable only through their sporadic radio bursts. The observations proposed here are crucial for understanding the emission mechanism of these sources and for determining how they relate to other neutron star populations. we also aim to maintain the phase-connected timing solutions achieved during the last observing semester to determine positions, ages and magnretic fields. These observations are the cornerstone of an extensive campaign at X-ray, radio and infrared wavelengths. We have also reinspected our survey databases and found 8 new candidate RRATs which we propose to confirm and to start characterisation of their properties.

</details>

Abstract: This collection contains data files from the Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver system of the Parkes radio telescope for the pulsar PSR J1803-3002A, which is within the globular cluster NGC 6522. This data collection contains (1) the integrated profiles for each of the observations and the same after flagging the radio frequency interference (with the file extension .zap and .calib_zap), and (2) the timing model file of PSR J1803-3002A (with the file extension .par).

</details>


### [1867] [Parkes observations for project P885 semester 2019APRS_15]()
*Camilo, Fernando,Johnston, Simon,Sarkissian, John,Reynolds, John,Scholz, Paul*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该项目提议每周观测磁星 1E 1547.0-5408 和 PSR J1622-4950，以跟踪其自转、流量密度和偏振；截至2018年12月8日，XTE J1810-197 在沉寂10年后再次成为射电磁星，其每周 UWL 观测将提供射电频谱和宽带行为的独特测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 磁星磁层极为动态，射电辐射在其中发生的条件及机制至少在若干重要方面不同于普通脉冲星；XTE J1810-197 在沉寂10年后再次成为射电磁星，为在射电波段研究磁星磁层和辐射机制提供了时机。

Method: 提议对 1E 1547.0-5408 和 PSR J1622-4950 大约每周观测一次，跟踪自转、流量密度和偏振；使用 UWL 接收机对 XTE J1810-197 进行每周观测，以测量其射电频谱和宽带行为。摘要未说明望远镜名称、具体频段、时间跨度、样本量和数据分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告：截至本周（2018年12月8日），XTE J1810-197 在沉寂10年后再次成为射电磁星；该项目此前在其低态期间对其进行零星观测。摘要未说明自转、流量密度、偏振、射电频谱或宽带行为的具体测量结果或数值。

Conclusion: 作者认为，这些观测为极其动态的磁星磁层提供了一个重要窗口，并刻画了其中发生射电辐射的条件，从而对辐射机制施加限制，这些机制至少在若干重要方面不同于普通脉冲星的辐射机制。XTE J1810-197 可能混沌的自转将在别处得到更详细跟踪。根据摘要无法判断该工作与快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲辐射的具体联系。

Abstract: We propose to observe the magnetars 1E 1547.0-5408 and PSR J1622-4950 approximately weekly, to track their rotation, flux density, and polarisation, as we have been doing through this project. As of this week (8 Dec 2018), XTE J1810-197 is again a radio magnetar, after 10 years dormant! (We have been observing it sporadically during its low state waiting for such an event.) Its likely chaotic rotation will be better tracked in detail elsewhere, but weekly observations with the UWL receiver will provide unique measurements of its radio spectrum and broad-band behaviour. Our observations provide an important window into remarkably dynamic magnetar magnetospheres, and characterise the conditions under which radio emission takes place therein, placing constraints on the emission mechanisms, which in at least some significant respects differ from those of ordinary pulsars.

</details>

Its likely chaotic rotation will be better tracked in detail elsewhere, but weekly observations with the UWL receiver will provide unique measurements of its radio spectrum and broad-band behaviour. Our observations provide an important window into remarkably dynamic magnetar magnetospheres, and characterise the conditions under which radio emission takes place therein, placing constraints on the emission mechanisms, which in at least some significant respects differ from those of ordinary pulsars.

Conclusion: 作者认为，这些观测为了解极其动态的磁星磁层提供了一个重要窗口，并刻画了其中发生射电辐射的条件，从而对辐射机制施加限制，而这些机制至少在某些重要方面不同于普通脉冲星的辐射机制。作者还指出，XTE J1810-197 可能混沌的自转将在别处得到更细致地追踪，但每周观测将为其射电频谱和宽带行为提供独特的测量。根据摘要无法判断这些结果与快速射电暴（FRB）的联系。

Abstract: We propose to observe the magnetars 1E 1547.0-5408 and PSR J1622-4950 approximately weekly, to track their rotation, flux density, and polarisation, as we have been doing through this project. As of this week (8 Dec 2018), XTE J1810-197 is again a radio magnetar, after 10 years dormant! (We have been observing it sporadically during its low state waiting for such an event.) Its likely chaotic rotation will be better tracked in detail elsewhere, but weekly observations with the UWL receiver will provide unique measurements of its radio spectrum and broad-band behaviour. Our observations provide an important window into remarkably dynamic magnetar magnetospheres, and characterise the conditions under which radio emission takes place therein, placing constraints on the emission mechanisms, which in at least some significant respects differ from those of ordinary pulsars.

</details>

### [1885] [Parkes observations for project P1054 semester 2023APRS_09]()
*Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Freire, Paulo,Weltevrede, Patrick,Stappers, Benjamin,Keane, Evan,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Buchner, Sarah,Barr, Ewan,Venkatraman Krishnan, Vivek,Boettcher, Markus,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Clark, Colin James,Breton, Rene,Desvignes, Gregory,Ridolfi, Alessandro,Cognard, Ismaël,Grießmeier, Jean-Mathias,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel,Thongmeearkom, Tinn,Sengupta, Shalini,Voraganti Padmanabh, Prajwal,Carli, Emma,Parthasarathy, Aditya,Men, Yunpeng,Turner, James,Vleeschower, Laila*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 本文是为 Parkes 项目 P1054 学期 2023APRS_09 提出的申请，旨在继续对 MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星开展计时后续观测；摘要指出 UWL 接收机正使这些处于 TRAPUM 发现源亮端的新源得以成功计时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MeerKAT 已在 Fermi 未识别点源、超新星遗迹、麦哲伦云、球状星团和银河系平面巡天中发现大量脉冲星，其中许多为再生脉冲星（含双中子星系统和“蜘蛛”双星）或年轻脉冲星。要发掘这些新发现的全部潜力，需要计时后续观测，但摘要未说明现有计时存在的具体不足。

Method: 摘要说明这是一项申请继续对 MeerKAT 发现脉冲星进行计时后续观测的提案，使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机；涉及 20 个 Fermi 未识别点源发现源、1 个与超新星遗迹成协的源、13 个麦哲伦云源、71 个球状星团源和 74 个银河系平面巡天源。观测频段、时间跨度、具体计时方法等摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告 MeerKAT 已发现 20 个与 Fermi 未识别点源相关的源、1 个与超新星遗迹成协的源、13 个位于麦哲伦云的源、71 个位于球状星团的源和 74 个银河系平面巡天源；新发现中很大一部分是再生脉冲星，包括至少一个双中子星系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星系统，或是年轻脉冲星。摘要指出 Parkes UWL 接收机正在成功对这些新源（处于 TRAPUM 发现源亮端）进行计时，但未给出具体计时结果或参数数值。

Conclusion: 作者认为计时观测对充分利用脉冲星发现至关重要，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而改进对极端环境物理和中子星总体的理解；Parkes UWL 接收机使他们能成功计时这些新源。对单脉冲发射、模式转换、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱或磁星/快速射电暴（FRB）联系的直接支持，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Twenty sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, one in association with a Supernova Remnant, 13 in the Magellanic Clouds, 71 in Globular Clusters and 74 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including at least one double neutron star system and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

Motivation: MeerKAT已在Fermi未识别点源定向观测、超新星遗迹、麦哲伦云、球状星团和银河系平面巡天中发现了大量脉冲星，其中很大一部分是循环脉冲星或年轻脉冲星。为充分发挥这些新发现的潜力，需要通过计时观测精确测量其自转、天体测量和轨道参数。摘要未说明该领域尚缺的具体知识细节。

Method: 摘要说明这是继续对MeerKAT发现的脉冲星进行计时跟踪观测的申请；使用Parkes望远镜的UWL接收机对这些新源进行计时。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、时间跨度、观测日期、样本筛选细节以及所采用的计时或统计分析流程。

Result: 摘要报告了新发现源的数量与分布：Fermi未识别点源定向观测中发现三十六个源，两个与超新星遗迹成协，14个在麦哲伦云中，94个在球状星团中，81个在银河系平面巡天中。新发现源中很大一部分是循环脉冲星，包括至少一个双中子星系统和若干“spider”双星，或者是年轻脉冲星。摘要还指出Parkes的UWL接收机已成功对这些新源进行计时，这些源处于TRAPUM发现的亮端。摘要未给出具体计时参数数值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为计时观测对于充分发挥任何脉冲星发现的潜力不可或缺，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，并据此增进对极端环境物理以及中子星整体族群的理解；Parkes UWL接收机是灵敏且多用途的仪器，使这些处于TRAPUM发现亮端的新源得以成功计时。摘要未说明这些源与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱或自转减慢力矩变化的具体联系；根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Thirtysix sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two in association with a Supernova Remnant, 14 in the Magellanic Clouds, 94 in Globular Clusters and 81 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including at least one double neutron star system and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. <details>

Conclusion: 作者明确主张，计时观测对于充分挖掘任何脉冲星发现的潜力具有不可或缺的作用，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，这些参数是增进理解极端环境物理及中子星整体族群的强有力的工具；Parkes望远镜的UWL接收机作为灵敏、多用途的仪器，正在成功地对这些新源进行计时。根据摘要无法判断该工作与单脉冲发射、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱、自转减速力矩变化、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）之间的具体物理联系。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Thirty sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two in association with a Supernova Remnant, 13 in the Magellanic Clouds, 87 in Globular Clusters and 78 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including at least one double neutron star system and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

Motivation: MeerKAT望远镜已发现大量脉冲星，但仅靠发现不足以发挥其科学价值；需要计时后续观测来精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，这些参数是理解极端环境物理和中子星族群整体性质的关键工具。摘要指出申请时间正是为继续这一计时后续观测活动。摘要未说明该领域更具体的研究空白。

Method: 摘要说明使用Parkes望远镜的UWL接收机对MeerKAT发现的新脉冲星进行计时观测。已发现的源包括针对Fermi未识别点源定向观测中的三十个源、两个与超新星遗迹成协的源、13个麦哲伦云中的源、87个球状星团中的源，以及78个银河系平面巡天中的源。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、分析流程或统计方法。

Result: 摘要报告，在针对Fermi未识别点源的定向观测中已发现三十个源，两个与超新星遗迹成协，13个在麦哲伦云中，87个在球状星团中，78个在银河系平面巡天中。新发现源中很大一部分是再循环脉冲星，其中包括至少一个双中子星系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星系统，其余为年轻脉冲星。Parkes望远镜UWL接收机正成功地对这些新源进行计时，这些源处于TRAPUM发现源的亮端。摘要未给出计时精度、参数测量值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，计时观测对于充分发挥任何脉冲星发现的全部潜力具有不可或缺的作用，能够精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，并由此增进对极端环境中物理的理解以及对中子星族群整体的理解。摘要指出Parkes望远镜UWL接收机是灵敏、多用途的仪器，使这些新源能够被成功计时。摘要未涉及磁星、快速射电暴、单脉冲发射、偏振或射电频谱等主题，根据摘要无法判断其相关性。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Thirty sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two in association with a Supernova Remnant, 13 in the Magellanic Clouds, 87 in Globular Clusters and 78 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including at least one double neutron star system and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

Result: 摘要报告称 MeerKAT 已在定向观测 Fermi 未识别点源中发现 20 个源，其中 1 个与超新星遗迹成协，另有 13 个在麦哲伦云、71 个在球状星团、74 个在银河系平面巡天中发现；新发现中很大一部分是循环脉冲星，包括至少一个双中子星系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星，或为年轻脉冲星。摘要称 Parkes 的 UWL 接收机正在成功对这些新源（TRAPUM 发现的亮端）进行计时，但未给出具体计时结果、参数数值、精度或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为计时观测对充分发挥脉冲星发现潜力不可或缺，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，并据此增进对极端环境物理以及中子星整体种群的理解；Parkes 的 UWL 接收机灵敏且多用途，能够成功计时这些处于 TRAPUM 发现亮端的新源。摘要未给出具体物理结论。根据摘要无法判断该计时后续活动与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、单脉冲发射或模式转换等主题的直接联系。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Twenty sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, one in association with a Supernova Remnant, 13 in the Magellanic Clouds, 71 in Globular Clusters and 74 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including at least one double neutron star system and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

Result: 在针对 Fermi 未识别点源的定向观测中发现二十个源，一个与超新星遗迹成协，13 个在麦哲伦云中，71 个在球状星团中，74 个在银河系平面巡天中。新发现源中很大一部分是回收脉冲星（包括至少一个双中子星系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星系统），或者是年轻脉冲星。摘要称 Parkes 的 UWL 接收机正在使这些处于 TRAPUM 发现源亮端的源得到成功计时。

Conclusion: 作者认为，计时观测能够精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而为理解极端环境中的物理以及中子星整体族群提供有力工具；Parkes 的 UWL 接收机灵敏且多用途，可用于对这些新发现源进行计时。根据摘要无法判断其对脉冲星单脉冲、模式转换、自旋下降力矩变化或磁星—FRB 联系的具体意义。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Twenty sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, one in association with a Supernova Remnant, 13 in the Magellanic Clouds, 71 in Globular Clusters and 74 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including at least one double neutron star system and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

*Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Freire, Paulo,Weltevrede, Patrick,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Buchner, Sarah,Barr, Ewan,Berezina, Marina,Venkatraman Krishnan, Vivek,Boettcher, Markus,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Clark, Colin James,Breton, Rene,Desvignes, Gregory,Ridolfi, Alessandro,Cognard, Ismaël,Grießmeier, Jean-Mathias,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel,Thongmeearkom, Tinn,Sengupta, Shalini,Voraganti Padmanabh, Prajwal,Carli, Emma,Parthasarathy, Aditya,Men, Yunpeng,Turner, James,Vleeschower, Laila,Prayag, Venu,Pillay, Denisha,Sergio, Belmonte Dìaz*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案申请继续对 MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星开展 Parkes UWL 计时后续观测，以精确测量其自转、天体测量和轨道参数；已发现源包括 Fermi 未识别点源、超新星遗迹、麦哲伦云、球状星团和银河系平面巡天中的大量新脉冲星，其中许多为 recycle 脉冲星或年轻脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MeerKAT 已在多种目标中发现了大量新脉冲星，但摘要指出，要充分发挥任何脉冲星发现源的潜力，需要计时观测来精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数；这些参数可用于研究极端环境物理和中子星总体族群。因此需要继续计时后续观测活动。

Method: 摘要说明这是对 MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星继续开展计时后续观测的提案，使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机对这些新源进行计时。观测目标来自对 Fermi 未识别点源、超新星遗迹、麦哲伦云、球状星团和银河系平面的观测或巡天。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、时间跨度、分析流程或统计方法。

Result: 摘要报告已发现的源包括：Fermi 未识别点源定向观测中三十个源、与超新星遗迹成协的两个源、麦哲伦云中 13 个源、球状星团中 87 个源以及银河系平面巡天中 78 个源。新发现源中很大一部分是 recycle 脉冲星，包括至少一个双中子星系统和若干“spider”双星，或年轻脉冲星。摘要还指出 Parkes UWL 接收机正在成功地对这些新源进行计时，这些源处于 TRAPUM 发现源的亮端。摘要未给出计时精度、参数数值或显著性。

Conclusion: 摘要指出，计时观测对充分发挥脉冲星发现源的潜力必不可少，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而改进对极端环境物理以及中子星总体族群的理解；Parkes UWL 接收机是灵敏、多用途的仪器，使这些新源能够被成功计时。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、自旋下降力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱、暂现射电发射或磁星—FRB 联系的直接关系。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Thirty sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two in association with a Supernova Remnant, 13 in the Magellanic Clouds, 87 in Globular Clusters and 78 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including at least one double neutron star system and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

Result: 摘要报告：在针对Fermi未识别点源的定向观测中发现25个源，其中1个与超新星遗迹相关联；在麦哲伦云中发现13个，在球状星团中发现72个，在银河系盘面巡天中发现78个。新发现源的很大一部分是再循环脉冲星，包括至少一个双中子星系统和若干个"spider"双星，或者是年轻脉冲星。摘要还指出，Parkes望远镜的UWL接收机正在使其能够成功对这些新源进行计时，这些源处于TRAPUM发现中较明亮的一端。摘要未给出计时精度、自转或轨道参数的具体数值。

Conclusion: 作者明确支持的观点是：计时观测是充分发挥任何脉冲星发现全部潜力的必要环节，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而帮助理解极端环境下的物理以及中子星整体族群。作者还认为，Parkes望远镜的UWL接收机是一台灵敏、多用途的仪器，使其能够成功对这些TRAPUM发现中较明亮的新源进行计时。摘要未给出具体的物理参数结果或对脉冲星、磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）之间联系的解释。根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Twentyfive sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, one in association with a Supernova Remnant, 13 in the Magellanic Clouds, 72 in Globular Clusters and 78 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including at least one double neutron star system and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

TL;DR: 使用更长时间的 Fermi-LAT 数据在 1--1000 GeV 重新分析 Geminga 的 GeV 晕辐射，发现更宽能段下晕辐射显著性较低；推导出的暂定晕辐射谱能量分布在 1--10 GeV 呈非常硬的谱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 邻近（~1 kpc 以内）脉冲星被认为是 PAMELA 和 AMS-02 测得 10--500 GeV 宇宙线正电子超出的可能来源；Geminga 周围由 High-Altitude Water Cherenkov Observatory 探测到的 TeV 晕及其表面亮度廓指示缓慢粒子扩散，挑战了正电子超出的脉冲星解释。此前的 GeV 晕分析仅聚焦 8 GeV 以上能段，需要在更宽能段检验。

Method: 使用来自 Fermi Large Area Telescope（LAT）的更长时间数据集，重新分析 Geminga 的 GeV 晕辐射，并将分析能量范围扩展至 1--1000 GeV；推导暂定晕辐射的谱能量分布。摘要未说明具体观测时间跨度、样本筛选或拟合统计方法。

Result: 在 1--1000 GeV 更宽能段内分析得到晕辐射的显著性较低。作者将其归因于银河系星际辐射模型无法在该更宽能段完美拟合背景，以及 <10 GeV 处测得的晕流量偏低，造成观测与模型预期不匹配。推导的暂定晕辐射谱能量分布在 1--10 GeV 显示出非常硬的谱。摘要未给出具体显著性数值或流量数值。

Conclusion: 作者指出，更宽能段的 GeV 分析导致晕辐射显著性偏低，原因在于背景模型拟合不完善与低能段晕流量偏低导致的观测—模型不匹配；所推导的暂定晕辐射谱能量分布在 1--10 GeV 非常硬。这些结果对正电子超出起源及脉冲星晕解释的具体含义，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Nearby pulsars within <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mo>~</mml:mo><mml:mn>1</mml:mn><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>kpc</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> are considered to be possible sources of 10--500 GeV cosmic-ray positron excess measured by PAMELA and AMS-02. A TeV halo around Geminga is detected by High-Altitude Water Cherenkov Observatory, and the measurements of its surface brightness profile indicate a slow particle diffusion surrounding the source. This result challenges the pulsar interpretation of the positron excess. The observations at GeV energies provide direct information on the electron/positron density in the GeV nebula, which can offer more direct constraints on the origin of the positron excess. Two previous works have performed analyses on the GeV emission of the pulsar halo but focused on the energy band above 8 GeV. In this work, we use a longer dataset from the Fermi Large Area Telescope (LAT) to reanalyze the GeV halo emission of Geminga, extending the analysis to cover the energy range of 1--1000 GeV. We find that the analysis in this wider energy range results in a low significance of the halo emission. This can be attributed to the Galactic interstellar emission model being unable to perfectly fit the background over this broader energy range and due to the low measured halo flux at <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mo>&lt;</mml:mo><mml:mn>10</mml:mn><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>GeV</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> energies leading to a mismatch between the observation and model expectation. We also derive the spectral energy distribution of the tentative halo emission, which shows a very hard spectrum in the 1--10 GeV range.

</details>


### [1962] [Parkes observations for project P511 semester 2006OCTS]()
*McLaughlin, Maura,Manchester, Dick,Kramer, Michael,Lyne, A.,O'Brien, J.,Camilo, Fernando,Stairs, Ingrid,Faulkner, A.,Lorimer, Duncan Ross*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请计划继续用Parkes对11个旋转射电暂现源（RRAT）进行观测，以限制其爆发通量分布、寻找新的爆发现象，并通过计时测量周期导数，从而推断位置、磁场和特征年龄。作者认为这些观测对理解其发射机制及其与其他中子星族群的关系至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 这些源看来是旋转中子星，但只能通过零星的射电爆发被探测到；其发射机制以及它们与其他中子星族群的关系尚不清楚，需要持续监测、计时以及多波段配合观测来理解这些神秘天体。

Method: 摘要说明为继续对11个旋转射电暂现源开展观测的申请：对所有源进行监测观测；对四个已测得周期导数的源进行进一步计时观测；对其他源采用新的计时策略；并额外申请一次旨在测量爆发谱指数的观测。观测被描述为X射线、射电和红外波段广泛campaign的一部分。具体望远镜、频率、时间跨度、样本细节与统计方法：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要说明的既有情况为：这些源只能通过零星的射电爆发被探测到；其中四个源已测得周期导数。申请拟通过监测观测进一步限制爆发通量分布和性质，并搜寻新的、出乎意料的爆发现象；通过进一步计时观测改进这四个源的位置、搜寻glitch或其他计时异常并限制任何潜在的正常脉冲射电发射；对其他源的新计时策略应当能够给出周期导数，从而确定精确位置并推断磁场和特征年龄。具体数值与显著性：摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者明确支持的结论是：所申请的观测对于理解这些源的发射机制、确定它们与其他中子星族群的关系，以及限制爆发通量分布和性质是至关重要的；对已测得周期导数的源继续计时有助于改进位置、搜寻glitch或计时异常并限制潜在正常脉冲射电发射，对其他源获得周期导数可推断磁场和特征年龄，用于与其他中子星类别比较。作者还认为这些观测是X射线、射电和红外广泛campaign的基石。这些源是否与脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）存在具体物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We request continuing observations of 11 rotating radio transients. These sources appear to be rotating neutron stars, but they are detectable only through their sporadic radio bursts. The observations proposed here are crucial for understanding the emission mechanism of these sources and for determining how they relate to other neutron star populations. Through monitoring observations of all sources, we aim to further contrain burst flux distributions and properties and search for any new and unexpected bursting phenomena. Further timing observations of the four sources with measured period derivatives are essential for refining positions, searching for glitches or other timing abnormalities and placing limits on any underlying normal pulsed radio emission. For the other sources, our new timing strategy should yield period derivatives, which will allow us to determine accurate positions and infer magnetic fields and characteristic ages, essential for comparing these sources with other classes of neutron stars. We also request an additional observation aimed at measuring burst spectral indices. These observations are the cornerstone of an extensive campaign at X-ray, radio and infrared wavelengths and are absolutely essential if we are to understand these mysterious objects.

</details>


### [1963] [Parkes observations for project P1392 semester 2026APRS_02]()
*Uttarkar, Pavan,Deller, Adam,Deshpande, Avinash,Shannon, Ryan,Lower, Marcus,Kumar, Pravir,Wang, Yuanming,Wang, Ziteng,Gourdji, Kelly,Ho, Simon,Kaushik, Aditi S. S.,Jahns-Schindler, Joscha,Kulkarni, Atharva,Mandaogane, Viren,Anna-Thomas, Reshma*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用自2018年上次 Murriyang 搜寻以来软硬件仪器的进步，在 SN 1987A 中心开展一次新的脉冲星射电搜寻；此前跨越约30年的多次搜寻均未发现色散信号，而未探测到信号主要被归因于周围致密星云。若探测到任何射电脉冲，将为脉冲星在如此早期阶段的诞生和演化提供关键认识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脉冲星自1968年发现以来被用作研究极端物理的实验室，但其早期生命和后续演化仍认识不足。SN 1987A 的中微子探测强烈暗示诞生了一颗年轻脉冲星，且跨越约30年的多次射电观测活动迄今未发现任何色散信号；未探测到信号主要被归因于可能遮蔽射电辐射的致密星云，而该星云预期会随膨胀变得不那么致密。

Method: 计划使用 Murriyang 在 SN 1987A 中心开展新的脉冲星搜寻。摘要提到的仪器与算法进展包括宽带仪器（如 UWL）、高频 MARS 接收机以及稳健的子带搜寻算法。摘要提及此前多次射电观测活动跨越约30年，上一次脉冲星搜寻使用 Murriyang 在2018年进行。具体的观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本与统计分析方法，摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告，跨越约30年的多次射电观测活动迄今未从该源发现任何色散射电脉冲，缺乏探测主要被归因于周围致密星云可能遮蔽射电辐射，但预期该星云会随膨胀而变得不那么致密。摘要还报告，最近 JWST 观测在该源中心附近发现了氩发射线，这暗示存在一颗中心中子星。拟议搜寻的结果尚未给出。

Conclusion: 作者认为，结合存在中心中子星可能性的证据以及自2018年使用 Murriyang 进行上一次搜寻以来软硬件仪器的进步，值得在 SN 1987A 中心开展一次新的脉冲星搜寻；在拟议搜寻中探测到任何射电脉冲，都将为脉冲星在此类早期阶段的诞生和演化提供关键认识。该计划能否实际探测到脉冲星以及相关物理可转移性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Since their discovery in 1968, pulsars have served as laboratories to study extreme physics. Pulsars are born out of core-collapse supernovae, however their early life and subsequent evolution are still poorly understood. SN 1987A was a core-collapse supernova from a blue supergiant star in the Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC), which was discovered in 1987. The discovery of this source was associated with neutrino detection, which strongly suggested the birth of a young pulsar. There have been multiple radio campaigns spanning ~3 decades to find dispersed radio pulsations from the source. However, no dispersed signal has been found to date. The lack of detection has mainly been attributed to the dense surrounding nebula, which could obscure radio emission, though the nebula is expected to become less dense over time as it expands. Recently, James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) observations revealed Argon emission lines near the centre of the source, which suggests the presence of a central neutron star. Hence, coupled with evidence of the possibility of a central neutron star and the advances in the software and hardware instrumentation since the last search for a pulsar using Murriyang in 2018 (e.g., wide bandwidth instruments such as the UWL, high-frequency MARS receiver, robust subbanded search algorithms), we plan to conduct a fresh search for a pulsar at the center of SN 1987A. A detection of any radio pulses in the proposed search will provide crucial insights into the birth and evolution of a pulsar from such early stages.

</details>

Motivation: 脉冲星自1968年被发现以来被用作研究极端物理的实验室，但其早期生命与后续演化仍未被充分理解。SN 1987A 是1987年发现于 LMC 的蓝超巨星核心坍缩超新星，其发现伴随中微子探测，强烈暗示诞生了一颗年轻脉冲星。约3十年的多次射电观测活动尚未找到色散射电脉冲，缺少探测主要被归因于可能遮蔽射电辐射的致密星云。

Method: 拟利用 Murriyang 在 SN 1987A 中心开展新的脉冲星搜寻，并采用自2018年上次搜寻以来进步的软硬件仪器，包括宽带宽仪器如 UWL、高频 MARS 接收机以及稳健的子带搜寻算法。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、时间跨度、灵敏度、样本量或统计分析方法。

Result: 摘要指出，既往跨越约3十年的多次射电观测活动迄今未发现任何来自该源的色散信号；未探测到信号主要被归因于周围致密星云可能遮蔽射电辐射，但预计星云会随膨胀而变得不那么致密。近期 JWST 观测在源中心附近揭示氩发射线，表明存在一颗中心中子星。拟议搜寻的结果尚未给出。

Conclusion: 作者认为，JWST 氩发射线表明源中心存在中子星，结合仪器与搜寻算法的进步，值得对 SN 1987A 中心重新开展脉冲星搜寻；若探测到任何射电脉冲，将为脉冲星从如此早期阶段的诞生与演化提供关键见解。根据摘要无法判断该搜寻对磁星、单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢、偏振、射电频谱或快速射电暴（FRB）的具体意义。

Abstract: Since their discovery in 1968, pulsars have served as laboratories to study extreme physics. Pulsars are born out of core-collapse supernovae, however their early life and subsequent evolution are still poorly understood. SN 1987A was a core-collapse supernova from a blue supergiant star in the Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC), which was discovered in 1987. The discovery of this source was associated with neutrino detection, which strongly suggested the birth of a young pulsar. There have been multiple radio campaigns spanning ~3 decades to find dispersed radio pulsations from the source. However, no dispersed signal has been found to date. The lack of detection has mainly been attributed to the dense surrounding nebula, which could obscure radio emission, though the nebula is expected to become less dense over time as it expands. Recently, James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) observations revealed Argon emission lines near the centre of the source, which suggests the presence of a central neutron star. Hence, coupled with evidence of the possibility of a central neutron star and the advances in the software and hardware instrumentation since the last search for a pulsar using Murriyang in 2018 (e.g., wide bandwidth instruments such as the UWL, high-frequency MARS receiver, robust subbanded search algorithms), we plan to conduct a fresh search for a pulsar at the center of SN 1987A. A detection of any radio pulses in the proposed search will provide crucial insights into the birth and evolution of a pulsar from such early stages.

</details>


### [1965] [Parkes observations for project P1054 semester 2022APRS_01]()
*Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Freire, Paulo,Weltevrede, Patrick,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Buchner, Sarah,Barr, Ewan,Venkatraman Krishnan, Vivek,Boettcher, Markus,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Clark, Colin James,Breton, Rene,Desvignes, Gregory,Ridolfi, Alessandro,Cognard, Ismaël,Grießmeier, Jean-Mathias,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel,Thongmeearkom, Tinn,Sengupta, Shalini,Voraganti Padmanabh, Prajwal,Carli, Emma,Parthasarathy, Aditya,Men, Yunpeng*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案申请继续用Parkes望远镜UWL接收机对MeerKAT发现的脉冲星开展计时后续观测，目标源包括Fermi未识别点源中14个、小麦哲伦云中3个、球状星团中37个和银道面巡天中34个，其中很大一部分为再生脉冲星或年轻脉冲星，约三分之一为“蜘蛛”脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要指出，计时观测对充分发挥脉冲星发现的潜力不可或缺；MeerKAT已发现大量新脉冲星，需要后续计时以精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而增进对极端环境物理和中子星总体族群的理解。因此需要申请时间继续这一计时后续观测活动。

Method: 摘要说明本提案申请时间继续对MeerKAT发现的脉冲星进行计时后续观测；发现的源来自Fermi未识别点源的定向观测、小麦哲伦云、球状星团和银道面巡天，包括14、3、37和34个源。观测使用Parkes望远镜的UWL接收机；摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、时间跨度、分析细节。

Result: 摘要报告：在Fermi未识别点源的定向观测中发现14个源，在小麦哲伦云中发现3个，在球状星团中发现37个，在银道面巡天中发现34个；很大一部分新发现是再生脉冲星，包括至少一个双中子星系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星，另有一些年轻脉冲星。UWL接收机使这些处于TRAPUM发现较亮一端的新源能够被成功计时，并具有详细研究“蜘蛛”脉冲星食的独特优势；这些“蜘蛛”脉冲星约占拟后续观测源的三分之一。

Conclusion: 作者认为，计时观测可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而提供研究极端环境物理以及中子星总体族群的有力工具；Parkes的UWL接收机灵敏、多功能，能够成功计时这些新源并详细研究“蜘蛛”脉冲星的食。摘要未给出具体物理测量结果或对磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）等的直接联系；根据摘要无法判断其与单脉冲发射、模式转换、自转减慢力矩变化或磁星—FRB关联的解释。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourteen sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, three in the Small Magellanic Cloud, 37 in Globular Clusters and 34 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including at least one double neutron star system and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries. The UWL has also the unique advantage of allowing detailed studies of the eclipses of the so-called 'spider' pulsars, which make up about 1/3rd of the sources we aim at following-up with this project.

</details>

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Eighteen sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, six in the Small Magellanic Cloud, 54 in Globular Clusters and 66 in a survey of the Galactic plane. The UWL has also the unique advantage of allowing detailed studies of the eclipses of the so-called 'spider' pulsars, which make up about 1/3rd of the sources we aim at following-up with this project.

Result: 摘要未说明。摘要报告已发现的源：Fermi 未识别点源的定向观测中 14 个，小麦哲伦云中 3 个，球状星团中 37 个，银盘巡天中 34 个。新发现中有很大一部分是再循环脉冲星或年轻脉冲星，包括至少一个双中子星系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星；摘要称 UWL 正使这些新源（处于 TRAPUM 发现的亮端）的计时得以成功进行，但未给出计时结果、参数数值或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者明确支持的结论是：计时观测对于充分发挥脉冲星发现的潜力不可或缺，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而增进对极端环境物理及中子星族群的理解；UWL 是灵敏、多用途的仪器，并具有详细研究“蜘蛛”脉冲星食的独特优势。关于本项目能否推广至其他脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴研究，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourteen sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, three in the Small Magellanic Cloud, 37 in Globular Clusters and 34 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including at least one double neutron star system and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries. The UWL has also the unique advantage of allowing detailed studies of the eclipses of the so-called 'spider' pulsars, which make up about 1/3rd of the sources we aim at following-up with this project.

</details>

Motivation: MeerKAT 已在 Fermi 未识别点源定向观测、小麦哲伦云、球状星团和银河系盘巡天中发现大量脉冲星，其中许多是循环再造脉冲星（含双中子星系统和“蜘蛛”双星）或年轻脉冲星。计时观测对充分发挥这些新发现源的潜力不可或缺，可提供理解极端环境物理和中子星族群所需的精确参数。摘要未说明更具体的知识空白。

Method: 使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机继续对 MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星进行计时随访观测。摘要给出的发现样本包括：Fermi 未识别点源定向观测 14 个源、小麦哲伦云 3 个、球状星团 37 个、银河系盘巡天 34 个。计时观测用于测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数；UWL 还用于详细研究“蜘蛛”脉冲星的食。摘要未说明具体观测频率、频段、时间跨度、时间分辨率和统计分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告了新发现源的分布：Fermi 未识别点源定向观测 14 个，小麦哲伦云 3 个，球状星团 37 个，银河系盘巡天 34 个。新发现源中很大一部分是循环再造脉冲星，包括至少一个双中子星系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星，或是年轻脉冲星；“蜘蛛”脉冲星约占本项目拟随访源的三分之一。摘要指出 UWL 正使这些新源（位于 TRAPUM 发现源亮端）的计时得以成功进行，并可用于详细研究“蜘蛛”脉冲星的食。摘要未给出具体的计时精度、参数数值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，计时观测能充分发挥脉冲星发现源的潜力，精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而增进对极端环境物理以及中子星整体族群的理解；Parkes UWL 是灵敏且多功能的仪器，可成功计时这些新源并具有详细研究“蜘蛛”脉冲星食的独特优势。这些结论主要基于所提项目的科学目标与仪器能力，摘要未报告已完成的计时结果，因此无法就具体测量结果作进一步判断。根据摘要无法判断该工作与磁星、快速射电暴、单脉冲发射或偏振等的直接联系。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourteen sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, three in the Small Magellanic Cloud, 37 in Globular Clusters and 34 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including at least one double neutron star system and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries. The UWL has also the unique advantage of allowing detailed studies of the eclipses of the so-called 'spider' pulsars, which make up about 1/3rd of the sources we aim at following-up with this project.

</details>

Method: 摘要说明申请时间以继续对 MeerKAT 发现脉冲星开展计时后续观测活动，使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机；新发现源包括对 Fermi 未识别点源的定向观测中 14 个、小麦哲伦云中 3 个、球状星团中 37 个、银河系平面巡天中 34 个。具体观测频率、时间跨度及分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告已在定向观测 Fermi 未识别点源中发现 14 个源、在小麦哲伦云中发现 3 个、在球状星团中发现 37 个、在银河系平面巡天中发现 34 个；新发现源中很大一部分是再生脉冲星（包括至少一个双中子星系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星）或年轻脉冲星；“蜘蛛”脉冲星约占拟后续观测源的三分之一。摘要未报告计时结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为计时观测对充分发挥脉冲星发现的潜力不可或缺，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而增进对极端环境物理及中子星整体族群的理解；Parkes 的 UWL 接收机是灵敏且多用途的仪器，已使这些新源得以成功计时，并具有详细研究“蜘蛛”脉冲星食现象的独特优势。根据摘要无法判断其与单脉冲、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱、磁星或 FRB 的具体联系。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourteen sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, three in the Small Magellanic Cloud, 37 in Globular Clusters and 34 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including at least one double neutron star system and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries. The UWL has also the unique advantage of allowing detailed studies of the eclipses of the so-called 'spider' pulsars, which make up about 1/3rd of the sources we aim at following-up with this project.

Conclusion: 作者认为，计时观测对于充分发掘任何脉冲星发现的潜力不可或缺，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，并进而增进对极端环境物理以及中子星整体族群的理解。作者还认为，Parkes 的 UWL 接收机灵敏且多用途，并具有详细研究“蜘蛛”脉冲星食的独特优势。根据摘要无法判断该工作与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射的直接联系。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Eighteen sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, six in the Small Magellanic Cloud, 54 in Globular Clusters and 66 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including at least one double neutron star system and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries. The UWL has also the unique advantage of allowing detailed studies of the eclipses of the so-called 'spider' pulsars, which make up about 1/3rd of the sources we aim at following-up with this project.

Conclusion: 作者认为，计时观测对于充分发挥脉冲星发现的全部潜力至关重要，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，进而增进对极端环境物理及中子星总体族群的理解；Parkes UWL 是灵敏且多用途的仪器，能够成功计时这些新源，并具有详细研究“蜘蛛”脉冲星食的独特优势。根据摘要无法判断与磁星、单脉冲、快速射电暴（FRB）等的具体物理联系。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourteen sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, three in the Small Magellanic Cloud, 37 in Globular Clusters and 34 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including at least one double neutron star system and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries. The UWL has also the unique advantage of allowing detailed studies of the eclipses of the so-called 'spider' pulsars, which make up about 1/3rd of the sources we aim at following-up with this project.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者认为，计时观测对充分发挥脉冲星发现的潜力至关重要：精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数可增进对极端环境物理和中子星整体族群的理解。UWL 的灵敏度和多用途性使其适合对这些较亮的 TRAPUM 发现源进行计时，并独特地支持对“蜘蛛”脉冲星食的详细研究。对于磁星、快速射电暴或其他具体物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourteen sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, three in the Small Magellanic Cloud, 37 in Globular Clusters and 34 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including at least one double neutron star system and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries. The UWL has also the unique advantage of allowing detailed studies of the eclipses of the so-called 'spider' pulsars, which make up about 1/3rd of the sources we aim at following-up with this project.

Result: 摘要报告了发现源数量：Fermi 未识别点源定向观测 18 个，小麦哲伦云 6 个，球状星团 54 个，银河系平面巡天 66 个。新发现源中很大一部分是再循环脉冲星，包括至少一个双中子星系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星，或是年轻脉冲星。“蜘蛛”脉冲星约占本项目计划跟踪源的三分之一。摘要未给出计时、自转、轨道或天体测量参数的具体数值，也未给出食的研究结果。

Conclusion: 摘要的结论是：计时观测对于充分挖掘任何脉冲星发现的潜力必不可少，其精确测量的自转、天体测量和轨道参数可为理解极端环境物理和中子星族群提供有力工具；Parkes 的 UWL 接收机灵敏且多用途，已成功用于对处于 TRAPUM 发现亮端的这些新源进行计时，并具有详细研究“蜘蛛”脉冲星食的独特优势。根据摘要无法判断这些源与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射的具体物理联系。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Eighteen sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, six in the Small Magellanic Cloud, 54 in Globular Clusters and 66 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including at least one double neutron star system and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries. The UWL has also the unique advantage of allowing detailed studies of the eclipses of the so-called 'spider' pulsars, which make up about 1/3rd of the sources we aim at following-up with this project.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MeerKAT 已在 Fermi 未识别点源定向观测、小麦哲伦云、球状星团和银河系平面巡天中发现大量脉冲星，其中很大一部分是再循环脉冲星（包括至少一个双中子星系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星）或年轻脉冲星。为充分发挥这些发现的潜力并精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，需要持续开展计时后续观测。摘要未说明具体的研究缺口。

Method: 摘要说明继续对 MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星开展计时后续观测，使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机，目标是 TRAPUM 发现源亮端的源；提及的发现源包括定向观测 Fermi 未识别点源的十八个源、小麦哲伦云六个、球状星团 54 个、银河系平面巡天 66 个。摘要还提及对“蜘蛛”脉冲星食的详细研究。具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、数据量和分析流程摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告 MeerKAT 在定向观测 Fermi 未识别点源中发现十八个源、小麦哲伦云六个、球状星团 54 个、银河系平面巡天 66 个；新发现源中很大一部分为再循环脉冲星（包括至少一个双中子星系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星）或年轻脉冲星。摘要称 Parkes 望远镜 UWL 接收机正成功对这些新源进行计时，并具有对“蜘蛛”脉冲星食开展详细研究的独特优势；这类脉冲星约占拟后续观测源的三分之一。摘要未给出具体计时结果、参数数值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，计时观测对充分发挥脉冲星发现潜力至关重要，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而增进对极端环境物理和中子星整体族群的理解。作者还认为 Parkes 望远镜 UWL 接收机灵敏、多用途，能够成功计时这些新源，并可用于详细研究“蜘蛛”脉冲星的食。根据摘要无法判断与磁星、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、自转减速力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱、暂现射电发射或磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）联系的直接关系。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Eighteen sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, six in the Small Magellanic Cloud, 54 in Globular Clusters and 66 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including at least one double neutron star system and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries. The UWL has also the unique advantage of allowing detailed studies of the eclipses of the so-called 'spider' pulsars, which make up about 1/3rd of the sources we aim at following-up with this project.

</details>

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourteen sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, three in the Small Magellanic Cloud, 37 in Globular Clusters and 34 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including at least one double neutron star system and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries. The UWL has also the unique advantage of allowing detailed studies of the eclipses of the so-called 'spider' pulsars, which make up about 1/3rd of the sources we aim at following-up with this project.

### [2006] [Parkes observations for project P455 semester 2012APRS_01]()
*Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Manchester, Dick,Kramer, Michael,Lyne, Andrew,McLaughlin, Maura,D'Amico, N.,Camilo, Fernando,Stairs, Ingrid,Lorimer, Duncan Ross,Ferdman, Robert,Yuen, Rai*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该项目继续对首个双脉冲星系统开展计时与脉冲轮廓研究，主要目标是给出迄今最强的广义相对论检验、首次测量中子星转动惯量，并确定系统几何结构、通过测地进动绘制脉冲星辐射束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 首个双脉冲星系统是引力物理学的独特实验室。研究缺口在于：需要继续计时与脉冲轮廓研究，以实现迄今最强的广义相对论检验，并首次测量中子星转动惯量；同时尚需确定系统几何结构并绘制脉冲星辐射束。

Method: 摘要说明该项目将开展计时（timing）和脉冲轮廓（profile）研究，并利用测地进动来确定系统几何结构、绘制脉冲星辐射束。摘要未说明具体的观测仪器、观测频段、时间跨度、样本量或数据分析细节。标题提及 Parkes 观测与项目 P455 semester 2012APRS_01，但摘要未说明相关细节。

Result: 摘要未说明。摘要为项目申请性质的描述，未给出已完成观测的计时结果、脉冲轮廓演化、偏振、频谱或统计显著性等具体发现。摘要仅陈述计划目标：提供迄今最强的广义相对论检验、首次测量中子星转动惯量，以及确定系统几何结构并通过测地进动绘制脉冲星辐射束。

Conclusion: 作者明确表述的科学意义是：首个双脉冲星系统可作为引力物理学的独特实验室，继续计时与脉冲轮廓研究有望给出迄今最强的广义相对论检验，并首次测量中子星转动惯量；通过测地进动还可确定系统几何结构并绘制脉冲星辐射束。就与脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）主题的关联而言，摘要仅支持其属于脉冲星计时与脉冲轮廓研究；是否涉及单脉冲、模式转换、自转减慢转矩变化、偏振、射电频谱、暂现射电辐射或磁星—FRB 联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: This project is to continue timing and profile studies of the first double-pulsar system, a unique laboratory for gravitational physics. The main aims of this proposal are to provide the strongest tests to date for general relativity and to measure for the first time the moment-of-inertia of a neutron star. Additionally, we will determine the system geometry and map the pulsar beams via geodetic precession.

</details>

Method: 摘要说明：这是对 MeerKAT 望远镜发现的脉冲星继续开展计时后续观测的时间申请。发现来源包括 Fermi 未识别点源的目标观测、小麦哲伦云、球状星团以及银河系平面巡天。观测使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机，并用于研究蜘蛛脉冲星的食。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、时间跨度、观测时长和数据分析方法。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Nine sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, three in the Small Magellanic Cloud, 34 in Globular Clusters and six in a survey of the Galactic plane. Excluding GC sources (too dim to be followed up in the framework of this proposal), at least 12 new discoveries are recycled pulsars, one possibly with a neutron star companion, and two more have spin periods around 70 ms, making them potential mildly recycled or young pulsars. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries. The UWL has also the unique advantage of allowing detailed studies of the eclipses of the so-called 'spider' pulsars, which make up about 1/3rd of the sources we aim at following-up with this project.

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MeerKAT 已发现一批新脉冲星，但任何脉冲星发现的全部潜力都需要通过计时跟踪观测才能充分发挥。精确测定自转、天体测量与轨道参数，有助于理解极端环境中的物理以及中子星整体族群；同时，对约占跟踪目标三分之一的“spider”脉冲星食现象也需借助合适仪器开展详细研究。

Method: 摘要说明这是为 Parkes 望远镜项目 P1054 学期 2021OCTS_11 申请时间的提案，拟继续对 MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星进行计时跟踪观测，使用的仪器为 Parkes 的 UWL 接收机。已发现的源来自针对 Fermi 未识别点源的定向观测、Small Magellanic Cloud、Globular Clusters 以及银河系平面巡天。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本总数以及统计或分析方法的细节。

Result: 在定向观测 Fermi 未识别点源中发现九个源，在 Small Magellanic Cloud 中发现三个，在 Globular Clusters 中发现 34 个，在银河系平面巡天中发现六个。除去因太暗而无法在本提案框架内跟踪的 GC 源，至少有 12 个新发现是循环脉冲星，其中一个可能带有中子星伴星；另有两个自转周期约为 70 ms，是潜在的轻度循环或年轻脉冲星。摘要指出 UWL 接收机已使这些新源（处于 TRAPUM 发现中较亮一端）的计时得以成功进行，并可用于详细研究“spider”脉冲星的食，这类源约占拟跟踪源的三分之一。

Conclusion: 摘要明确支持的结论是：计时观测对于充分利用新发现的脉冲星至关重要，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而增进对极端环境物理和中子星族群的理解；Parkes 的 UWL 接收机灵敏且多用途，能够成功对新源计时，并具有详细研究“spider”脉冲星食的独特优势。关于这些计时结果与磁星、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱、自旋下降力矩变化或快速射电暴（FRB）之间的具体物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Nine sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, three in the Small Magellanic Cloud, 34 in Globular Clusters and six in a survey of the Galactic plane. Excluding GC sources (too dim to be followed up in the framework of this proposal), at least 12 new discoveries are recycled pulsars, one possibly with a neutron star companion, and two more have spin periods around 70 ms, making them potential mildly recycled or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries. The UWL has also the unique advantage of allowing detailed studies of the eclipses of the so-called 'spider' pulsars, which make up about 1/3rd of the sources we aim at following-up with this project.

</details>

Result: 在 MeerKAT 的发现中，对 Fermi 未识别点源的定向观测发现九个源，麦哲伦小云中发现三个，球状星团中发现 34 个，银河系盘面巡天中发现六个。排除球状星团源后，至少有 12 个新发现是再循环脉冲星，其中一个可能有一颗中子星伴星，另外两个的自转周期约为 70 ms，可能为轻度再循环或年轻脉冲星。摘要称 UWL 接收机正使这些新源（TRAPUM 发现中较亮的那些）得到成功的计时，并称“蜘蛛”脉冲星约占该提案计划后续观测源的三分之一。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Nine sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, three in the Small Magellanic Cloud, 34 in Globular Clusters and six in a survey of the Galactic plane. Excluding GC sources (too dim to be followed up in the framework of this proposal), at least 12 new discoveries are recycled pulsars, one possibly with a neutron star companion, and two more have spin periods around 70 ms, making them potential mildly recycled or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries. The UWL has also the unique advantage of allowing detailed studies of the eclipses of the so-called 'spider' pulsars, which make up about 1/3rd of the sources we aim at following-up with this project.

</details>

<details>

Motivation: MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星需要计时后续观测才能充分发挥其科学潜力。计时观测可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而增进对极端环境物理和中子星族群的理解。摘要指出，约三分之一的目标源为“蜘蛛”脉冲星，其食现象值得详细研究，而 Parkes UWL 适合这一工作。

Excluding GC sources (too dim to be followed up in the framework of this proposal), at least 12 new discoveries are recycled pulsars, one possibly with a neutron star companion, and two more have spin periods around 70 ms, making them potential mildly recycled or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL has also the unique advantage of allowing detailed studies of the eclipses of the so-called 'spider' pulsars, which make up about 1/3rd of the sources we aim at following-up with this project.
