### [2025] [Higher-order statistics of the stochastic gravitational wave background from supermassive black hole binaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17983)
*Hisamatsu, Hinano,Kyutoku, Koutarou*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该文通过引入由单源探测灵敏度定义的物理红移积分下限 $z_{\rm min}$，解决了超大质量黑洞双星随机引力波背景高阶统计量的发散问题，并表明除期望值外的高阶统计量仅通过啁啾质量加权平均 $\langle M^{10/3}\rangle$ 依赖质量函数，且超额峰度与偏度平方存在一致性关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脉冲星计时阵列已成为在纳赫兹频段探测随机引力波背景的关键工具，该背景被认为主要来自超大质量黑洞双星。传统分析多关注谱振幅与频率依赖，而方差、偏度、超额峰度等高阶统计量或可提取更多物理信息，但这些统计矩在红移积分下延至 $z=0$ 时会发散，需要新的处理策略。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测数据、仪器、频段、样本或时间跨度。方法为理论分析：引入由单源探测灵敏度定义的物理积分下限 $z_{\rm min}$，并在高阶统计量计算中采用关于红移的最低阶近似，因为高阶统计量主要由本地源决定；随后推导高阶统计量与质量函数的关系。

Result: 摘要未说明数值结果或显著性。在所采用的最低阶近似下，除期望值之外的所有高阶统计量仅通过啁啾质量的加权平均 $\langle M^{10/3}\rangle$ 依赖质量函数，且与红移演化模型无关；方差与期望值之比可提供关于 $\langle M^{10/3}\rangle/\langle M^{5/3}\rangle$ 的信息，且独立于并合总数；此外发现超额峰度与偏度平方之间存在一致性关系。

Conclusion: 作者认为高阶统计量为解释引力波背景提供了新窗口，可用于打破现有简并并改进对质量函数的理解；超额峰度与偏度平方的一致性关系为检验引力波背景的双星起源假说开辟了道路。该文关注引力波背景统计，其与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲发射或快速射电暴的具体物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Recent progress in gravitational wave observations has positioned pulsar timing arrays as a key tool for detecting the stochastic gravitational wave background in the nanohertz band. It is widely believed that this background is primarily attributed to the cosmic ensemble of inspiraling supermassive black hole binaries. While traditional analyses have predominantly focused on the spectral amplitude and frequency dependence of the gravitational wave background, higher-order statistics such as variance, skewness, and excess kurtosis could potentially be useful for extracting further physical information. However, these statistical moments are known to diverge when the redshift integration is extended down to <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>z</mml:mi><mml:mo>=</mml:mo><mml:mn>0</mml:mn></mml:math></inline-formula>. In this study, we propose a strategy to resolve this issue by introducing a physically motivated lower integration limit, <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>z</mml:mi><mml:mi>min</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula>, defined by the sensitivity for detecting individual sources. Since higher-order statistics are primarily determined by local sources, we may adopt the lowest-order approximation with respect to redshift in their computations. Under this approximation, we demonstrate that all higher-order statistics beyond the expectation value depend on the mass function only through a weighted average of the chirp mass, <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mo>⟨</mml:mo><mml:msup><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mn>10</mml:mn><mml:mo>/</mml:mo><mml:mn>3</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msup><mml:mo>⟩</mml:mo></mml:math></inline-formula>, irrespective of the redshift evolution model. We show that the ratio of the variance to the expectation value provides information on <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mo>⟨</mml:mo><mml:msup><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mn>10</mml:mn><mml:mo>/</mml:mo><mml:mn>3</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msup><mml:mo>⟩</mml:mo><mml:mo>/</mml:mo><mml:mo>⟨</mml:mo><mml:msup><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mn>5</mml:mn><mml:mo>/</mml:mo><mml:mn>3</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msup><mml:mo>⟩</mml:mo></mml:math></inline-formula> independently of the total number of mergers. We also find a consistency relation between the excess kurtosis and the squared skewness, paving the way for testing the binary-origin hypothesis of the gravitational wave background. Our findings demonstrate that higher-order statistics provide a new window for interpreting the gravitational wave background, offering a methodology to break existing degeneracies and refine our understanding of the mass function.

</details>


### [2026] [Parkes observations for project P934 semester 2016OCTS_BPSR_02]()
*Shannon, Ryan,Hobbs, George,Coles, William,Ravi, Vikram,Kerr, Matthew,Reardon, Daniel John*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划观测高银纬脉冲星，以检验星际散射区域是否局限于银河系平面或延伸至银晕，并搜寻散射区域和离散结构中的磁场变化，同时为快速射电暴的闪烁提供约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 温暖星际介质在最小尺度上具有复杂结构，存在可维持数月的极端过密等离子体纤维和团块，而磁化可能参与约束这些等离子体。这类AU尺度等离子体最适合通过脉冲星和类星体等致密背景射电源的闪烁来探测，但既有研究主要集中于太阳系邻域和银河系平面，样本视线有限。

Method: 摘要说明这是一项观测提议：观测高银纬脉冲星，以扩展闪烁研究的样本视线，并分析闪烁以刻画散射区域和离散结构。摘要未说明具体望远镜、观测频段、观测时长、样本大小、观测频率或数据分析细节；仅提及闪烁分析在过去十年中的改进。

Result: 摘要未报告已完成观测的具体结果。摘要指出，近期观测显示过密区域局限于视线方向上的狭窄区域；过去十年闪烁分析的改进使这些结构得到更好刻画；既有研究集中于太阳系邻域和银河系平面。本提案拟确定散射区域是否局限于银河系平面或延伸到银晕，并搜寻或限制散射区域及离散结构中的磁场变化，同时为快速射电暴的闪烁提供约束。

Conclusion: 作者提出，通过观测高银纬脉冲星可检验散射区域是否局限于银河系平面或持续延伸到银晕，并搜寻或限制这些散射区域和离散结构中的磁场变化；这些观测还可能为快速射电暴的闪烁提供重要约束，因为快速射电暴作为河外源可能被与此处所研究结构类似的结构放大。根据摘要无法判断这些预期的物理机制和磁化约束是否会被证实。

Abstract: On the smallest scales, the warm interstellar medium contains surprisingly complex structure, including extremely overdense filaments and blobs of plasma that remain intact for months, despite physical processes that should cause them to disperse on short (week) time scales. It is possible that magnetization plays a role in confining this plasma. On these AU length scales the plasma is best probed by observing the scintillations of compact background radio sources such as pulsars and quasars. Recent observations show that overdensities are confined to narrow regions along lines of sight. Over the last decade, improvements in the analysis of scintillation have enabled better characterization of these structures. These studies however have focused on the ISM in the solar-system neighbourhood and the Galactic plane. Here we propose to observe pulsars at high galactic latitudes to extend the sample lines of sight. We will determine if the scattering regions are confined to the Galactic plane or persist into the halo of the galaxy. We will also search for (or place limits on) magnetic field variations within these scattering regions and discrete structures. Our observations will also provide important constraints on the scintillation of fast radio bursts, extragalactic sources which may be magnified by the similar structures to those studied here.

</details>

Method: 摘要说明将观测高银纬脉冲星以扩展视线样本，并利用致密背景射电源（脉冲星和类星体）的闪烁探测 AU 尺度等离子体结构，此外将搜寻或限制这些散射区域及离散结构内部的磁场变化。具体望远镜、观测频率、时间跨度、样本量及分析细节：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未说明。该文为观测提议，摘要中未报告已获得的结果；仅陈述近期观测表明过密区被限制在沿视线方向的狭窄区域，以及过去十年闪烁分析的改进使这些结构得到更好表征。

Conclusion: 作者拟通过高银纬脉冲星观测确定散射区是仅限于银河系平面还是延伸到银晕，并对磁场变化给出限制，同时为可能被类似结构放大的快速射电暴的闪烁提供重要约束。这些为提议目标而非已确立结论；上述物理图像在多大程度上可推广至磁星与快速射电暴的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: On the smallest scales, the warm interstellar medium contains surprisingly complex structure, including extremely overdense filaments and blobs of plasma that remain intact for months, despite physical processes that should cause them to disperse on short (week) time scales. It is possible that magnetization plays a role in confining this plasma. On these AU length scales the plasma is best probed by observing the scintillations of compact background radio sources such as pulsars and quasars. Recent observations show that overdensities are confined to narrow regions along lines of sight. Over the last decade, improvements in the analysis of scintillation have enabled better characterization of these structures. These studies however have focused on the ISM in the solar-system neighbourhood and the Galactic plane. Here we propose to observe pulsars at high galactic latitudes to extend the sample lines of sight. We will determine if the scattering regions are confined to the Galactic plane or persist into the halo of the galaxy. We will also search for (or place limits on) magnetic field variations within these scattering regions and discrete structures. Our observations will also provide important constraints on the scintillation of fast radio bursts, extragalactic sources which may be magnified by the similar structures to those studied here.

</details>

### [2034] [Constraints on ultralight scalar and dark photon dark matter from PPTA DR3 and EPTA DR2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.02172)
*Hu, Xiao-Song,Chen, Siyuan,Liu, Kuo,Zhu, Xingjiang,Zhao, Shi-Yi,Jiang, Wu,Antoniadis, John,Bhat, N. D. Ramesh,Carleo, Amodio,Dai, Shi,Di Marco, Valentina,Hu, Huanchen,Ling, Wenhua,Liu, Yang,Mishra, Saurav,Russell, Christopher J.,Shannon, Ryan M.,Smarra, Clemente,Wang, Jingbo,Wang, Lin,Zic, Andrew*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 利用PPTA DR3与EPTA DR2脉冲星计时阵列数据进行贝叶斯搜寻，未发现超轻标量暗物质或暗光子暗物质的统计显著证据，并对相关参数给出95%置信水平上限；对标量ULDM而言，未排除其构成全部暗物质的可能，同时首次给出EPTA的DPDM限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冷暗物质模型在大尺度上成功，但在亚星系尺度面临挑战；粒子质量约 \(10^{-22}\ \mathrm{eV}\) 的超轻暗物质（ULDM）有望解决这些小尺度问题。脉冲星计时阵列本用于探测纳赫兹引力波，也可灵敏探测ULDM信号，因此需要利用PTA数据对标量ULDM和暗光子暗物质（DPDM）信号进行搜寻并给出参数限制。

Method: 本文使用脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）数据集对ULDM进行贝叶斯搜寻，分析中引入脉冲星距离以更好地对ULDM密度建模。关注两类信号：标量ULDM产生的振荡引力势，以及由暗光子暗物质（DPDM）介导的第五种力相互作用。具体使用的脉冲星数、数据集构成细节及观测频率等摘要未说明。

Result: 未发现ULDM存在统计上显著的证据，因而对相关参数给出了95%置信水平上限。对于标量ULDM，分析未排除ULDM构成全部暗物质的情形。PPTA-DR3给出的限制在大部分质量范围内相较此前的PPTA-DR2（2018 Preview）有显著改进，并与近期其他PTA的非相关限制一致。此外，首次给出了使用EPTA数据的DPDM限制，且EPTA-DR2与PPTA-DR3得到的DPDM上限与已有约束相当。

Conclusion: 作者基于PTA数据未发现ULDM的统计显著证据，因此给出95%置信水平参数上限；对标量ULDM，指出现有分析尚不能排除其构成全部暗物质的可能，且PPTA-DR3限制优于早前PPTA-DR2并与其他PTA的非相关限制一致。作者还首次报告EPTA数据给出的DPDM限制，其与现有约束相当。至于ULDM与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲发射或快速射电暴之间的物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The cold dark matter model successfully describes the Universe on large scales, yet faces challenges at subgalactic scales. Ultralight dark matter (ULDM), with particle masses around <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msup><mml:mn>10</mml:mn><mml:mrow><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:mn>22</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msup><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>eV</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula>, offers a promising solution to these small-scale issues. Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs), designed to detect nanohertz gravitational waves, can also provide a sensitive probe for ULDM signals. In this work, we perform a Bayesian search for ULDM using PTA datasets, focusing on two types of signals: the oscillatory gravitational potential from scalar ULDM and the fifth-force interaction mediated by dark photon dark matter (DPDM). We incorporate pulsar distances in the analysis to better model the ULDM density. No statistically significant evidence for ULDM has been found; therefore, we place 95% confidence level upper limits on the relevant parameters. For scalar ULDM, our analysis does not exclude the scenario in which ULDM constitutes all of dark matter. The constraints from PPTA-DR3 show significant improvements over the earlier PPTA-DR2 (2018 Preview) across most of the mass range, and are consistent with the recent uncorrelated limits from other PTAs. We also present for the first time the DPDM constraints using EPTA data. The obtained bounds on the DPDM from the EPTA-DR2 and PPTA-DR3 are comparable to existing constraints.

</details>

*Hurley-Walker, Natasha,McSweeney, Samuel James,Meyers, Bradley,Kumar, Pratik*

TL;DR: 一颗新发现的高银纬脉冲星兼具旋转射电暂现源式的明亮稀疏爆发和典型脉冲星式的暗淡稳定脉冲成分，可能是两类族群之间的“缺失环节”；作者申请两次8小时观测对其进行计时并积累脉冲流量样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新发现的高银纬脉冲星同时具有旋转射电暂现源式的明亮、偶发、变化的爆发和典型脉冲星式的暗淡、相对稳定的脉冲成分，因而可能属于两个族群之间数量少但不断增长的“缺失环节”天体，需要更好地限制其磁场与特征年龄并扩大脉冲流量样本以与其他脉冲星比较。

Method: 摘要说明提出两次8小时观测，以对该脉冲星进行计时（timing），并积累更完整的脉冲流量（pulse fluences）样本。望远镜、接收机、观测频率或波段、观测日期与时间跨度起止、样本大小以及具体分析流程，摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要说明一颗新发现的高银纬脉冲星显示出两类辐射特征：明亮、偶发且变化的爆发，以及暗淡、相对稳定的脉冲成分。摘要未说明计时结果、磁场或特征年龄的具体数值、脉冲流量的具体测量、爆发率、偏振或频谱结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为该源属于一小群但不断增长的、可能在旋转射电暂现源与典型脉冲星两个族群之间充当“缺失环节”的天体；所申请的观测旨在更好地限制其磁场和特征年龄，并建立更完整的脉冲流量样本，以便将该源与其他脉冲星比较。根据摘要无法判断更长远的物理含义。

Abstract: A newly-discovered pulsar at high Galactic latitude displays both bright, sporadic, variable bursts characteristic of Rotating Radio Transients, and a dim, relatively stable pulse component that is typical of canonical pulsars. This makes it part of a small but growing group of objects that may be "missing links" between the two populations. We propose two 8-hour observations to properly time the pulsar in order to better constrain its magnetic field and characteristic age, and to build up a more complete sample of its pulse fluences, that would then enable comparisons between this source and other pulsars.

</details>

### [2037] [Parkes observations for project P1420 semester 2026APRS_06]()
*Ravi, Vikram,Johnston, Simon,Kerr, Matthew,Ng, Cherry,Shannon, Ryan,Caleb, Manisha,Dai, Shi,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Lower, Marcus,Clavel, Maïca,Ahmad, Adeel,Berteaud, Joanna,Calore, Francesca,Kaushik, Aditi S. S.,Faber, Jakob,Limaye, Pranav,Verdi, Frank*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划在南银河平面富集区域（-15deg < l < -10deg, |b| < 3deg）使用 Murriyang 的 CryoPAF 接收机开展 CPS-LowLat 试点巡天，预计发现多达约 90 颗脉冲星（含 5-10 颗毫秒脉冲星），并验证 CryoPAF 的端到端性能与脉冲星族群模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CryoPAF 接收机可提供南半球最高的脉冲星巡天速度，超过 MeerKAT 的 L 波段能力约 2x，且数据率足够低以支持归档与重新处理；族群合成预测完整 CPS-LowLat 将发现约 300 颗新脉冲星，因此有必要先在富集区域开展试点。

Method: 拟在 -15deg < l < -10deg, |b| < 3deg 区域开展 2.5 小时指向观测的 Murriyang CryoPAF 脉冲星巡天试点，频率范围 1.3-1.85 GHz 以减轻色散致展宽和散射；部署成熟的基于 GPU 的加速/双星系统搜索以及高效相干折叠算法；使用族群合成进行预测。摘要未说明观测时间跨度与样本量细节。

Result: 族群合成预测完整 CPS-LowLat 将发现约 300 颗新脉冲星；本试点在该银河平面富集区域预计发现多达约 90 颗脉冲星，其中包括 5-10 颗毫秒脉冲星。CryoPAF 的巡天速度超过 MeerKAT 的 L 波段能力约 2x，且数据率足够低以支持归档和重新处理。摘要未说明是否已有实际探测结果。

Conclusion: CPS-LowLat 的新发现有望支持广义相对论强场检验、由大质量中子星约束状态方程、更准确建模中子星并合率，并探测奇异恒星演化路径与电离星际介质；该试点将在启动完整 CPS-LowLat 之前展示 CryoPAF 用于脉冲星巡天的端到端性能并验证脉冲星族群模型。根据摘要无法判断其对脉冲星单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢转矩变化、偏振、射电频谱、瞬变射电发射或磁星与 FRB 联系的具体意义。

Abstract: We propose the pilot of a Murriyang CryoPAF Pulsar Survey of the Southern Galactic Plane (CPS-LowLat Pilot). The revolutionary CryoPAF receiver delivers the highest pulsar survey speed in the Southern Hemisphere, exceeding L-band capability of MeerKAT by ~2x, with a sufficiently low data rate to enable archiving and reprocessing essential to maximizing survey yields. Population synthesis predicts ~300 new pulsars in the full CPS-LowLat. Up to ~90 pulsars are predicted from this Pilot in a rich region of the Galactic Plane (-15deg &lt; l &lt; -10deg, |b| &lt; 3deg), including 5-10 millisecond pulsars. 2.5-hr pointings are proposed to provide the requisite transformational pulsar detection rate, while maintaining sensitivity across a wide range of binary orbital periods, including ultra-compact systems. A frequency range of 1.3-1.85 GHz will mitigate dispersion smearing and scattering. Well-developed GPU-based searches for accelerated / binary systems and efficient coherent folding algorithms will be deployed. New discoveries from CPS-LowLat will enable strong-field tests of general relativity, equation-of-state constraints from massive neutron stars, more accurate modeling of the neutron star merger rate, and probes of exotic stellar-evolution pathways and of the ionised interstellar medium. Besides its impressive pulsar yield and the associated scientific possibilities, the proposed pilot will demonstrate the end-to-end performance of the CryoPAF for pulsar surveys prior to commencing the full CPS-LowLat, and validate pulsar population models.

</details>


### [2038] [Parkes observations for project P1420 semester 2026APRS_05]()
*Ravi, Vikram,Johnston, Simon,Kerr, Matthew,Ng, Cherry,Shannon, Ryan,Caleb, Manisha,Dai, Shi,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Lower, Marcus,Clavel, Maïca,Ahmad, Adeel,Berteaud, Joanna,Calore, Francesca,Kaushik, Aditi S. S.,Faber, Jakob,Limaye, Pranav,Verdi, Frank*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该文提出 Murriyang CryoPAF 南银道面低纬度脉冲星巡天（CPS-LowLat）的先导项目，预计在 -15deg < l < -10deg、|b| < 3deg 区域发现多达约 ~90 颗脉冲星（含 5-10 颗毫秒脉冲星），并验证 CryoPAF 用于脉冲星巡天的端到端性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 完整的 CPS-LowLat 巡天有望产出约 ~300 颗新脉冲星，而开展巡天前需要先在银道面富集区域验证 CryoPAF 接收机的端到端脉冲星巡天性能，并检验脉冲星种群模型。摘要指出，CryoPAF 提供南半球最高脉冲星巡天速度，且数据率足够低以支持存档与再处理，这被视为最大化巡天产出的必要条件。

Method: 摘要说明拟使用 Murriyang 的 CryoPAF 接收机开展 CPS-LowLat 先导巡天，观测区域为 -15deg < l < -10deg、|b| < 3deg；频率范围为 1.3-1.85 GHz；采用 2.5 小时指向观测；部署基于 GPU 的加速/双星系统搜索和高效相干折叠算法。巡天速度、数据率与灵敏度的具体技术参数，以及观测时间跨度与样本规模，摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告的是预测而非实际探测结果：种群合成预测完整 CPS-LowLat 将发现约 ~300 颗新脉冲星；本先导项目在该银道面区域预计发现多达 ~90 颗脉冲星，其中包括 5-10 颗毫秒脉冲星。摘要还称 CryoPAF 的巡天速度超过 MeerKAT 的 L 波段能力约 ~2 倍，其数据率足够低以支持存档与再处理，1.3-1.85 GHz 的频率范围可减轻色散致展宽和散射。实际的巡天结果、脉冲星样本与统计显著性，摘要未说明。

Abstract: We propose the pilot of a Murriyang CryoPAF Pulsar Survey of the Southern Galactic Plane (CPS-LowLat Pilot). The revolutionary CryoPAF receiver delivers the highest pulsar survey speed in the Southern Hemisphere, exceeding L-band capability of MeerKAT by ~2x, with a sufficiently low data rate to enable archiving and reprocessing essential to maximizing survey yields. Population synthesis predicts ~300 new pulsars in the full CPS-LowLat. Up to ~90 pulsars are predicted from this Pilot in a rich region of the Galactic Plane (-15deg &lt; l &lt; -10deg, |b| &lt; 3deg), including 5-10 millisecond pulsars. 2.5-hr pointings are proposed to provide the requisite transformational pulsar detection rate, while maintaining sensitivity across a wide range of binary orbital periods, including ultra-compact systems. New discoveries from CPS-LowLat will enable strong-field tests of general relativity, equation-of-state constraints from massive neutron stars, more accurate modeling of the neutron star merger rate, and probes of exotic stellar-evolution pathways and of the ionised interstellar medium. Result: 族群合成预测完整 CPS-LowLat 可发现约 ~300 颗新脉冲星，本次试点在该银河系盘富集区域最多可发现约 ~90 颗脉冲星，其中包括 5-10 颗毫秒脉冲星；CryoPAF 的巡天速度超过 MeerKAT 的 L 波段能力约 ~2x，数据率足够低以支持存档与重处理。摘要未说明已获得的观测结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出 CPS-LowLat 的新发现可用于广义相对论强场检验、大质量中子星给出的物态方程约束、更准确的中子星并合率建模，以及探测奇异恒星演化途径和电离星际介质；该试点还将在完整 CPS-LowLat 开始前展示 CryoPAF 的端到端性能并验证脉冲星族群模型。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、单脉冲发射、模式转换、自转减速力矩变化、偏振或快速射电暴（FRB）之间的具体联系。

Abstract: We propose the pilot of a Murriyang CryoPAF Pulsar Survey of the Southern Galactic Plane (CPS-LowLat Pilot). Population synthesis predicts ~300 new pulsars in the full CPS-LowLat. Up to ~90 pulsars are predicted from this Pilot in a rich region of the Galactic Plane (-15deg &lt; l &lt; -10deg, |b| &lt; 3deg), including 5-10 millisecond pulsars. 2.5-hr pointings are proposed to provide the requisite transformational pulsar detection rate, while maintaining sensitivity across a wide range of binary orbital periods, including ultra-compact systems. A frequency range of 1.3-1.85 GHz will mitigate dispersion smearing and scattering. Well-developed GPU-based searches for accelerated / binary systems and efficient coherent folding algorithms will be deployed. New discoveries from CPS-LowLat will enable strong-field tests of general relativity, equation-of-state constraints from massive neutron stars, more accurate modeling of the neutron star merger rate, and probes of exotic stellar-evolution pathways and of the ionised interstellar medium. Besides its impressive pulsar yield and the associated scientific possibilities, the proposed pilot will demonstrate the end-to-end performance of the CryoPAF for pulsar surveys prior to commencing the full CPS-LowLat, and validate pulsar population models.

Result: 族群合成预测完整 CPS-LowLat 将发现约 300 颗新脉冲星；本试点预计在该银道面区域发现最多约 90 颗脉冲星，其中包括 5-10 颗毫秒脉冲星。摘要称 CryoPAF 提供南半球最高脉冲星巡天速度，超过 MeerKAT 的 L 波段能力约 2 倍，且数据率足够低以支持存档和重处理。1.3-1.85 GHz 频率范围用于减轻色散致散和散射。摘要未给出已验证的探测结果或统计显著性。

Abstract: We propose the pilot of a Murriyang CryoPAF Pulsar Survey of the Southern Galactic Plane (CPS-LowLat Pilot). The revolutionary CryoPAF receiver delivers the highest pulsar survey speed in the Southern Hemisphere, exceeding L-band capability of MeerKAT by ~2x, with a sufficiently low data rate to enable archiving and reprocessing essential to maximizing survey yields. Population synthesis predicts ~300 new pulsars in the full CPS-LowLat. Up to ~90 pulsars are predicted from this Pilot in a rich region of the Galactic Plane (-15deg &lt; l &lt; -10deg, |b| &lt; 3deg), including 5-10 millisecond pulsars. 2.5-hr pointings are proposed to provide the requisite transformational pulsar detection rate, while maintaining sensitivity across a wide range of binary orbital periods, including ultra-compact systems. A frequency range of 1.3-1.85 GHz will mitigate dispersion smearing and scattering. Well-developed GPU-based searches for accelerated / binary systems and efficient coherent folding algorithms will be deployed. New discoveries from CPS-LowLat will enable strong-field tests of general relativity, equation-of-state constraints from massive neutron stars, more accurate modeling of the neutron star merger rate, and probes of exotic stellar-evolution pathways and of the ionised interstellar medium. Besides its impressive pulsar yield and the associated scientific possibilities, the proposed pilot will demonstrate the end-to-end performance of the CryoPAF for pulsar surveys prior to commencing the full CPS-LowLat, and validate pulsar population models.

</details>

New discoveries from CPS-LowLat will enable strong-field tests of general relativity, equation-of-state constraints from massive neutron stars, more accurate modeling of the neutron star merger rate, and probes of exotic stellar-evolution pathways and of the ionised interstellar medium. Besides its impressive pulsar yield and the associated scientific possibilities, the proposed pilot will demonstrate the end-to-end performance of the CryoPAF for pulsar surveys prior to commencing the full CPS-LowLat, and validate pulsar population models.

</details>


### [2054] [Parkes observations for project P1066 semester 2020APRS_04]()
*Gupta, Vivek,Price, Danny,Flynn, Chris,Cooke, Jeff,Webb, Sara,Andreoni, Igor,Gajjar, Vishal,Siemion, Andrew,Zhang, Jielai*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要指出，快速暂现源和FRB的本质尚未解决，而在毫秒至小时时间尺度上，具有显著深度的多波段观测几乎没有开展，这一参数空间尚未得到充分探索。因此需要协调同视场、同时的多波段深度快速观测，以在射电探测前后捕捉对应体。

Method: 申请36小时Parkes观测，作为DWF计划的一部分。DWF协调全球60多个天文台，覆盖从射电到伽马射线的波段，并与Parkes对同一视场同时开展深度、快速节奏、宽视场观测。参与设施包括South Pole Telescope（毫米/亚毫米波）、GROND（红外）、CTIO Dark Energy Camera（光学）、Astrosat（紫外/X射线）、HXMT（X射线）、HESS（伽马射线）、Pierre Auger（高能）。对所有波段进行实时数据处理和暂现源识别，以触发数分钟内响应的深度后随观测，使用Keck、VLT、Gemini、SALT、ATCA进行深度光谱和成像。

Result: 摘要未说明已完成的具体探测结果或数值性发现。摘要仅报告该申请计划继续此前成功的DWF计划，并说明DWF已协调60多个天文台、涵盖射电至伽马射线波段，具备实时数据处理与暂现源识别能力，可触发数分钟内的快速后随观测。摘要未给出探测到的暂现源、FRB对应体、持续时间、灵敏度或统计显著性等具体结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出，通过DWF协调的同视场、同时多波段深度快速观测，能够在射电探测之前、期间和之后实现多波段探测，从而帮助解决快速暂现源和FRB的本质问题。作者还指出，该时间尺度上具有显著深度的多波段观测极少，因此这一参数空间值得探索。至于该计划对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、偏振、射电频谱或磁星—FRB联系的具体意义，摘要未说明，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose 36 hrs of Parkes observations to continue our successful Deeper, Wider, Faster (DWF) program to detect fast transients and fast radio burst (FRB) counterparts and help resolve their nature. DWF coordinates over 60 observatories worldwide at all wavelengths, from radio to gamma-ray to detect and follow-up FRBs and other elusive fast (millisecond-to-hours duration) transients. Crucially, we coordinate simultaneous deep, fast-cadenced, wide-field observations at all wavelengths to observe the same field at the same time as Parkes, enabling multi-wavelength detection before, during, and after the radio detection. Little to no multi-wavelength observations to any significant depth have been done on these timescales, leaving this parameter space underexplored. DWF coordinates major facilities such as South Pole Telescope (mm/sub-mm), GROND (infrared), CTIO Dark Energy Camera (optical), Astrosat (UV/X-ray), HXMT (X-ray), HESS (gamma-ray), and Pierre Auger (high-energy). We perform realtime data processing and transient identification at all wavelengths that enables triggering our deep, rapid-response (within minutes) follow up programs for deep spectroscopy and imaging using the world's largest telescopes (e.g., Keck, VLT, Gemini, SALT, ATCA).

</details>

### [2064] [Comparing gravitational wave background predictions from cosmological simulations to pulsar timing observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05208)
*Buttigieg, Stephanie,Sijacki, Debora,Moore, Christopher J.,Bourne, Martin A.,Sesana, Alberto*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该文提出首个全面的统计框架，用于量化PTA引力波背景测量与理论预测之间的张力，并将其应用于FABLE宇宙学模拟与NANOGrav 15年数据的比较；对基准黑洞族群得到$1\sigma$--$2.5\sigma$的张力值，表明与观测无统计上显著的分歧，而提高高红移黑洞质量或更近等质量并合的情形可显著提高预测的GWB振幅。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PTA最近对GWB的探测可能是超大质量黑洞双星并合引力波的首个证据，但大多数理论模型似乎预测的振幅略低于观测值。需要量化PTA测量与理论预测之间张力的统计框架，并检验观测推断中的假设（如GWB谱的幂律模型）是否会引入偏倚。

Method: 提出首个全面的统计框架以量化PTA测量与理论预测之间的张力，并研究观测推断中不同假设（尤其是对GWB谱采用幂律模型）的影响；将该框架用于把FABLE宇宙学模拟的预测与NANOGrav 15年数据集进行比较，并探索由电磁观测和理论不确定性引导的对并合黑洞族群的物理动机修改，还研究了黑洞质量函数高质量端与有限模拟体积的影响。

Result: 对基准黑洞族群，与NANOGrav 15年数据比较得到张力值为$1\sigma$--$2.5\sigma$，表明没有统计上显著的分歧。高红移处黑洞质量被提升以及更近等质量并合的情形会显著提高预测的GWB振幅，改善与PTA数据的一致性。$(100 \, \mathrm{cMpc} \, h^{-1})^3$的FABLE盒子足以在最具约束力的频率上稳健预测GWB信号。

Conclusion: 作者认为，其统计框架可最大化当前数据的约束能力并可直接应用于未来PTA数据集；基准黑洞族群与观测无统计上显著分歧，而提高高红移黑洞质量、更近等质量并合等物理动机修改可改善与PTA数据的一致性；FABLE模拟体积足以在最具约束力的频率上稳健预测GWB信号。观测推断中幂律谱模型可能使张力估计产生偏倚并夸大与理论的差异。根据摘要无法判断其对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲发射或FRB的具体物理联系。

Abstract: The recent detection of a gravitational wave background (GWB) by pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) may represent the first evidence of gravitational waves from merging supermassive black hole binaries, opening a new window on the low-frequency end of the gravitational wave spectrum. These inspiralling binaries are expected to dominate the signal, although most theoretical models seem to predict somewhat lower amplitudes than what is observed. We present the first comprehensive statistical framework to quantify the tension between PTA measurements and theoretical predictions, maximizing the constraining power of current data and allowing straightforward application to future PTA data sets. We further investigate how different assumptions in the observational inference, particularly the use of a power-law model for the GWB spectrum, can bias tension estimates and potentially overstate discrepancies with theory. We apply our framework to compare predictions from the FABLE cosmological simulation with the North American Nanohertz Observatory for Gravitational Waves (NANOGrav) 15-yr data set. For our fiducial black hole population, we find tension values of <inline-formula><tex-math>$1\sigma$</tex-math></inline-formula>--<inline-formula><tex-math>$2.5\sigma$</tex-math></inline-formula>, indicating no statistically significant disagreement with the observations. We further explore physically motivated modifications to the merging black hole population, guided by electromagnetic observations and theoretical uncertainties. In particular, scenarios with boosted black hole masses at high redshift and more equal-mass mergers substantially increase the predicted GWB amplitude, improving agreement with PTA data. Finally, we investigate the high-mass end of the black hole mass function and the impact of finite simulation volume. We find that the <inline-formula><tex-math>$(100 \, \mathrm{cMpc} \, h^{-1})^3$</tex-math></inline-formula> FABLE box is sufficient to robustly predict the GWB signal at the most constraining frequency.

</details>


### [2065] [Energy-dependent extension of the Crab Nebula as a diagnostic of ultrahigh-energy hadronic emission](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.25497)
*Lu, Fang-Wu,Zhu, Bo-Tao,Ren, Ji-Yang,Zhang, Li*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 蟹状星云表观尺度随能量的延展与纯轻子预期不符，可在空间分辨的轻子-强子情景下解释：高于 $\sim 400$ TeV 转为强子主导，1.1 PeV处预测68%包含半径 $\sim 1.4'$，约为纯轻子情景的六倍，可作为脉冲星风云超高能伽马射线起源的判别依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蟹状星云表观尺度随能量变化，在X射线与TeV波段之间与纯轻子预期不一致，需要一个能自然解释该现象并判别脉冲星风云中超高能伽马射线起源的方案。

Method: 摘要未说明。摘要仅提及采用空间分辨的轻子-强子情景，未说明所用望远镜或仪器、观测频段、时间跨度、样本及具体分析或统计方法。

Result: 在空间分辨的轻子-强子情景中，高于 $\sim 400$ TeV 发生向强子主导的转变，PeV能量处为近乎纯强子辐射。1.1 PeV处预测的68%包含半径为 $\sim 1.4'$，约为纯轻子情景的六倍。

Conclusion: 作者认为，随能量变化的延展为脉冲星风云中超高能伽马射线辐射的起源提供了可观测的判别依据，并为蟹状星云中的PeV强子加速提供诊断。该结论基于空间分辨轻子-强子情景的预测，摘要未给出与观测的直接对比或统计显著性；关于其与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、模式转换或FRB研究的关联，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The energy-dependent apparent extension of the Crab Nebula, inconsistent with leptonic expectations between x-ray and TeV bands, can be naturally accounted for in a spatially resolved lepto-hadronic scenario. A transition to hadronic dominance occurs above <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mo>~</mml:mo><mml:mn>400</mml:mn><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>TeV</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula>, with nearly pure hadronic emission at PeV energies. The predicted 68% containment radius at 1.1 PeV is <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mo>~</mml:mo><mml:msup><mml:mn>1.4</mml:mn><mml:mo>'</mml:mo></mml:msup></mml:math></inline-formula>, about six times larger than in purely leptonic scenarios. This energy-dependent extension therefore provides an observable discriminator of the origin of ultrahigh-energy gamma-ray emission in pulsar wind nebulae, offering a diagnostic of PeV hadronic acceleration in the Crab Nebula.

</details>


### [2066] [Searching for gravitational waves with Gaia and its cross-correlation with PTA: Absolute vs differential astrometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.18593)
*Vaglio, Massimo,Falxa, Mikel,Mentasti, Giorgio,Renzini, Arianna I.,Kuntz, Adrien,Barausse, Enrico,Contaldi, Carlo R.,Sesana, Alberto*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 本文计算了差分天体测量搜寻随机引力波背景的响应与重叠约化函数，并用 Fisher 矩阵分析表明其对紧密恒星对灵敏度有限，仅大角间距恒星对具有竞争力，且与脉冲星计时阵列数据结合可在 $\gtrsim 10^{-7}\ \mathrm{Hz}$ 频率处带来轻微灵敏度改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Gaia 等天体测量任务可精确测量恒星位置、视差和自行，引力波引起的天体测量偏转可用于搜寻随机引力波背景；但空间天体测量的灵敏度受卫星绝对姿态重建系统误差限制，本文考察以恒星对相对角间距的差分方法缓解共模取向噪声，并比较其与绝对天体测量的灵敏度。

Method: 摘要指出，本文计算差分方法的天体测量响应与重叠约化函数，并修正文献中先前给出的表达式；采用 Fisher 矩阵分析比较差分天体测量与常规绝对天体测量的灵敏度；并考察将天体测量数据与脉冲星计时阵列观测相结合。摘要未说明具体数据、时间跨度或样本。

Result: 差分方法在理论上是合理的，但对紧密间隔恒星对灵敏度有限；大角间距恒星对可提供有竞争力的灵敏度，但结合 Gaia 时，由于仪器系统误差预计不会在如此尺度上保持相关，差分策略是否有效尚不清楚。将天体测量数据与脉冲星计时阵列观测结合，在频率 $\gtrsim 10^{-7}\ \mathrm{Hz}$ 处带来灵敏度的轻微改善。

Conclusion: 作者认为差分天体测量方法理论合理，但用于 Gaia 时受系统误差相关尺度限制，有效性尚不明确；天体测量与脉冲星计时阵列的联合观测可在 $\gtrsim 10^{-7}\ \mathrm{Hz}$ 频率处略微提高灵敏度。该结果与脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）搜索随机引力波背景的方法论相关，但不涉及脉冲星单脉冲、磁星或快速射电暴。根据摘要无法判断其在磁星/FRB 方面的物理联系。

Abstract: Astrometric missions like Gaia provide exceptionally precise measurements of stellar positions, parallaxes, and proper motions. Gravitational waves traveling between the observer and distant stars can induce small, correlated shifts in their apparent positions, a phenomenon known as astrometric deflection. The precision and scale of astrometric datasets make them well suited for searching for a stochastic gravitational-wave background, whose signature appears in the two-point correlation function of the deflection field across the sky. In space-based astrometry, the ultimate sensitivity of such measurements is reduced by systematic uncertainties in the satellite's absolute attitude reconstruction, which constrain the accuracy of absolute astrometry. These orientation errors can be mitigated by focusing on relative angular separation between pairs of stars, which effectively cancel out common-mode orientation noise. In this work, we compute the astrometric response and the overlap reduction functions for this differential approach, correcting previous expressions presented in the literature. We use a Fisher matrix analysis to compare the sensitivity of differential astrometry to that of conventional absolute astrometry. Our analysis shows that while the differential method is theoretically sound, its sensitivity is limited for closely spaced star pairs. Pairs with large angular separations provide competitive sensitivity, but, when considered in connection with Gaia, it is unclear whether the differential strategy would be effective, since instrumental systematics are not expected to remain correlated on such scales. Finally, we demonstrate that combining astrometric data with observations from pulsar-timing arrays leads to slight improvements in sensitivity at frequencies <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mo>≳</mml:mo><mml:msup><mml:mn>10</mml:mn><mml:mrow><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:mn>7</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msup><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>Hz</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula>.

</details>

O.,Zhu, Z.-H.,Zimmermann, L.,Zucker, M. E.,Zweizig, J.,Ligo Scientific Collaboration, VIRGO Collaboration,,Kagra Collaboration*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 对 O4a（2023 年 5 月 24 日至 2024 年 1 月 16 日）数据的全天长持续时间引力波搜索未发现显著探测，其参考波形根和平方振幅灵敏度极限平均比 O3 结果改进约 30%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长持续时间（≳1 s）引力波暂现源预期来自多种天体物理过程，包括磁星中的非轴对称形变或偏心双星并合。该搜索旨在以对波形形态和持续时间的最少假设，在 O4a 数据中全天搜寻持续约 1--1000 s 的此类信号，并检验相对 O3 的灵敏度进展。

Method: 使用 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 第四次观测运行第一部分 O4a 的数据，时间范围为 2023 年 5 月 24 日至 2024 年 1 月 16 日。进行全天搜索，对发射的 GW 波形在形态和持续时间上作最少假设，目标信号持续时间为 ~1--1000 s，频率内容为 16--2048 Hz。结果以参考波形的根和平方信号振幅 \(h_{rss}\) 表示灵敏度极限，并与 O3 结果比较。摘要未说明具体流水线、统计分析方法或样本细节。

Result: 未发现显著探测。以参考波形的根和平方信号振幅 \(h_{rss}\) 表示的灵敏度极限平均比第三次 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 观测运行（O3）的结果改进约 30%。分析还表明，由于流水线探测效率的提升，搜索长持续时间 GW 信号的能力取得了实质性进展。

Conclusion: 作者报告在 O4a 中未出现显著探测，并给出优于 O3 约 30% 的灵敏度极限；他们认为流水线探测效率的提升带来了长持续时间 GW 搜索能力的实质性进展。随着探测器灵敏度继续提高和观测运行延长，未建模的长持续时间搜索将越来越能够探索涉及中子星和黑洞的多种天体物理场景。该搜索明确提及磁星非轴对称形变作为目标源类之一；根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星单脉冲、模式转换、计时、偏振、射电频谱或快速射电暴（FRB）的具体联系。

Abstract: We present an all-sky search for long-duration gravitational waves (GWs) from the first part of the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA fourth observing run (O4), called O4a and comprising data taken between May 24, 2023, and January 16, 2024. The GW signals targeted by this search are the so-called ``long-duration'' (<inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mo>≳</mml:mo><mml:mn>1</mml:mn><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>s</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula>) transients expected from a variety of astrophysical processes, including nonaxisymmetric deformations in magnetars or eccentric binary coalescences. We make minimal assumptions on the emitted GW waveforms in terms of morphologies and durations. Overall, our search targets signals with durations of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mo>~</mml:mo><mml:mn>1</mml:mn><mml:mi>--</mml:mi><mml:mn>1000</mml:mn><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>s</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> and frequency content in the range 16--2048 Hz. In the absence of significant detections, we report the sensitivity limits of our search in terms of root-sum-square signal amplitude (<inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>h</mml:mi><mml:mi>rss</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula>) of reference waveforms. These limits improve upon the results from the third LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA observing run (O3) by about 30% on average. Moreover, this analysis demonstrates substantial progress in our ability to search for long-duration GW signals owing to enhancements in pipeline detection efficiencies. As detector sensitivities continue to advance and observational runs grow longer, unmodeled long-duration searches will increasingly be able to explore a range of compelling astrophysical scenarios involving neutron stars and black holes.

</details>


### [2068] [Parkes observations for project P1165 semester 2023OCTS_01]()
*Bai, Juntao,Dai, Shi,Wang, Shuangqiang,Zhi, QiJun,Xu, xin*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 在 FAST 巡天 PT2020_0141 中发现的中等银纬脉冲星 J1849+1001（35.1 ms）经后续计时显示处于带大质量伴星的圆轨道，可能属于中等质量双脉冲星（IMBP），并有望用于测量“Post-Keplerian”参数以测定中子星与伴星质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新发现脉冲星 J1849+1001 的后续计时显示其处在带大质量伴星的圆轨道上，可能属于中等质量双脉冲星（IMBP）；此类大质量伴星系统有望用于测量“Post-Keplerian”参数并进而测量中子星和伴星质量。摘要未说明更具体的科学背景或知识空白。

Method: 摘要提及 FAST 脉冲星巡天 PT2020_0141 以及后续计时观测，并说明将把 Parkes 观测与 FAST 常规计时观测结合，用于测量“Post-Keplerian”参数并进而测量中子星和伴星质量。观测频段、时间跨度、样本量与数据分析细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告在 FAST 脉冲星巡天 PT2020_0141 中发现脉冲星 J1849+1001，其周期为 35.1 ms，位于中等银纬；后续计时观测表明其处于带大质量伴星的圆轨道。摘要据此认为 PSR J1849+1001 可被归类为中等质量双脉冲星（IMBP），并指出其大质量伴星使其成为有望通过脉冲星计时测量“Post-Keplerian”参数的系统。摘要未给出质量或“Post-Keplerian”参数的测量数值、显著性或其他定量结果。

Conclusion: 作者明确支持的结论是：PSR J1849+1001 处于带大质量伴星的圆轨道，可归类为中等质量双脉冲星（IMBP），并且是有望通过脉冲星计时测量“Post-Keplerian”参数的系统；将 Parkes 观测与 FAST 常规计时结合可测量“Post-Keplerian”参数，进而测量中子星和伴星质量。这些结果对脉冲星计时方法与双星系统质量测量的相关性直接体现在摘要中；对磁星、单脉冲、模式转换、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱或 FRB 的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We recently discovered a new pulsar J1849+1001 (35.1 ms) in a FAST pulsar survey at intermediate Galactic latitudes (PT2020_0141). Follow-up timing observations show that they are in circular orbits with massive companions. This suggests that PSR J1849+1001 can be classified as an intermediate-mass binary pulsar (IMBP). Their massive companions also make them promising systems to measure "Post-Keplerian" parameters through pulsar timing. These Parkes observations will be combined with regular timing observations with FAST to measure "Post-Keplerian" parameters and then measure both neutron star and companion masses.

</details>

Abstract: We recently discovered a new pulsar J1849+1001 (35.1 ms) in a FAST pulsar survey at intermediate Galactic latitudes (PT2020_0141). Their massive companions also make them promising systems to measure "Post-Keplerian" parameters through pulsar timing. These Parkes observations will be combined with regular timing observations with FAST to measure "Post-Keplerian" parameters and then measure both neutron star and companion masses.

</details>

### [2077] [Nuclear parameter inference with semi-agnostic priors]()
*Suleiman, Lami,Fantina, Anthea F.,Gulminelli, Francesca,Read, Jocelyn*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该研究评估了在基于半不可知物态方程先验的推断中，低质量（约 $1\,M_{\SUB{\odot}}$）或高质量（约 $1.9\,M_{\SUB{\odot}}$）中子星的质量、半径和潮汐形变性探测对核经验参数的约束能力，发现并非所有核经验参数都与压强显著相关，且它们在高密度区域相互竞争；半不可知构造比假设核子成分延伸至核心最高密度更能准确恢复真实核经验参数，但许多参数即使测量精度极高也难以独立推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 射电脉冲星计时、X射线脉冲轮廓建模以及涉及至少一颗中子星的并合引力波探测，可探测核实验室无法达到的热力学区域中的致密富中子物质属性；此类推断依赖合适的物态方程先验。近期提出的半不可知构造纳入低至中等密度区域的核理论与实验信息，并在高密度区域保持必要灵活性，但目前尚不清楚对低质量或高质量中子星的质量、半径和潮汐形变性探测能在多大程度上约束核经验参数，这是本文要评估的问题。

Method: 摘要指出，作者首先评估了核经验参数与不同密度区域中零温和 β 平衡压强之间的相关因子；随后针对三种核子物态方程模拟观测，以检验相应核经验参数的恢复情况。摘要未说明所用望远镜或仪器、观测频段、时间跨度、样本数量以及具体统计方法。

Result: 作者表明，并非所有核经验参数都与压强显著相关，且这些参数在高密度区域相互竞争，从而对其推断构成挑战。模拟三种核子物态方程的观测显示，相较于假设核子成分一直延伸到中子星核心最高密度，使用半不可知构造有助于更准确地恢复真实的核经验参数。摘要未给出具体的相关因子数值、参数数值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，用核子元模型参数化物态方程的高密度区域可能会使核经验参数的推断产生偏差，而半不可知构造为这一问题提供了解决方案。他们还指出，许多核物质经验参数对重子压强的构建贡献相似，即使测量精度极高也难以被独立推断。这些结论基于模拟观测；根据摘要无法判断其如何直接推广到脉冲星、磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲观测等具体情形。

Abstract: Context. Radio pulsar timing, X-ray pulse profile modeling, and gravitational-wave detections of binary mergers involving at least one neutron star probe the properties of dense, neutron-rich matter in thermodynamic regimes inaccessible to nuclear laboratories. Such inference relies on building appropriate equation-of-state priors, such as the recently introduced semi-agnostic constructions that incorporate nuclear theory and experimental information available in low- to intermediate-density regimes, while offering the necessary flexibility at high density. Aims. In this paper, we assess how detections of mass, radius, and tidal deformability for low-mass (~1 M<SUB>⊙</SUB>) or high-mass (~1.9 M<SUB>⊙</SUB>) neutron stars contribute to constraining nuclear empirical parameters in an inference based on semi-agnostic equation-of-state priors. Methods. We first assessed the correlation factors between nuclear empirical parameters and the zero-temperature and β-equilibrated pressure in different density regimes. We then simulated observations for three nucleonic equations of state to test the recovery of the corresponding nuclear empirical parameters. Results. We show that not all nuclear empirical parameters significantly correlate with the pressure and find that they compete in the high-density regime, which challenges their inference. We also find that using semi-agnostic constructions instead of assuming a nucleonic content up to the highest densities in the neutron-star core can help recover the true nuclear empirical parameters with more accuracy. Conclusions. Parametrizing the high-density regime of the equation of state with the nucleonic meta-model can bias the inference of nuclear empirical parameters; semi-agnostic constructions provide a solution to this problem. However, many nuclear matter empirical parameters contribute similarly to the construction of the baryonic pressure. We find that they are difficult to infer independently, even with extremely precise measurements.

</details>


### [2078] [Parkes observations for project P1420 semester 2026OCTS_01]()
*Ravi, Vikram,Johnston, Simon,Kerr, Matthew,Ng, Cherry,Shannon, Ryan,Caleb, Manisha,Dai, Shi,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Lower, Marcus,Clavel, Maïca,Ahmad, Adeel,Berteaud, Joanna,Calore, Francesca,Kaushik, Aditi S. S.,Faber, Jakob,Limaye, Pranav,Verdi, Frank*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟将南银道面 Murriyang CryoPAF 脉冲星巡天（CPS-LowLat）从试运行转为全规模巡天，并利用 2026OCTS 将主处理迁移至 CSIRO HPC；群体合成预测全规模巡天可发现约 ~300 颗新脉冲星，而试运行前三个指向的快视处理已产生三个极佳的候选脉冲星发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CPS-LowLat 需要从试运行过渡到全规模巡天，以充分发挥 CryoPAF 接收机在南半球提供的高脉冲星巡天速度；摘要同时指出，新发现可用于广义相对论强场检验、大质量中子星状态方程约束、中子星并合率建模，以及探测奇异恒星演化途径和电离星际介质。

Method: 摘要说明的观测为 Murriyang CryoPAF 脉冲星巡天 CPS-LowLat 的五个指向，自 4 月 29 日起在 2026APRS 中观测，并对前三个指向进行了初步、快视处理；提议 2026OCTS 期间将主处理迁移至 CSIRO HPC 资源并继续巡天，采用 2.5 小时指向观测，频率范围 1.3-1.85 GHz。此外使用群体合成预测脉冲星数量。摘要未说明其他具体分析细节。

Result: 摘要报告：CryoPAF 接收机的脉冲星巡天速度超过 MeerKAT 的 L 波段能力约 ~2x，且数据率足够低以支持归档和再处理；群体合成预测全规模 CPS-LowLat 发现约 ~300 颗新脉冲星；前三个已观测指向的快视处理已产生三个极佳的候选脉冲星发现；对已知脉冲星的再探测表明正在达到预期的端到端巡天灵敏度；预测 30 deg^2 的 2026OCTS 巡天区域可发现多达 ~50 颗脉冲星，包括 3-6 颗毫秒脉冲星。

Conclusion: 作者提出在 2026OCTS 将主处理迁移至 CSIRO HPC 资源并继续巡天，为 2027APRS 以更高观测节奏开始全规模 CPS-LowLat 做准备；摘要认为 2.5 小时指向可提供所需的变革性探测率并在广泛双星轨道周期范围内保持灵敏度，1.3-1.85 GHz 可减轻色散致展宽和散射。关于这些结果与脉冲星单脉冲、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振或磁星—FRB 联系的具体关联，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose a transition from a Pilot to the full Murriyang CryoPAF Pulsar Survey of the Southern Galactic Plane (CPS-LowLat). The revolutionary CryoPAF receiver delivers the highest pulsar survey speed in the Southern Hemisphere, exceeding L-band capability of MeerKAT by ~2x, with a sufficiently low data rate to enable archiving and reprocessing essential to maximizing survey yields. Population synthesis predicts ~300 new pulsars in the full CPS-LowLat. New discoveries from CPS-LowLat will enable strong-field tests of General Relativity, equation-of-state constraints from massive neutron stars, more accurate modeling of the neutron star merger rate, and probes of exotic stellar-evolution pathways and of the ionised interstellar medium. Five pointings for the CPS-LowLat have been observed in 2026APRS since April 29, and preliminary, quick-look processing of the first three pointings has already yielded three excellent candidate pulsar discoveries. Re-detections of known pulsars suggests that we are achieving the expected end-to-end survey sensitivity. We propose to use 2026OCTS to transition our primary processing to CSIRO HPC resources, while continuing the survey, in preparation for commencement of the full CPS-LowLat in 2027APRS with a higher observation cadence. Up to ~50 pulsars are predicted from the 30 deg^2 2026OCTS survey region, including 3-6 millisecond pulsars, representing in itself an impressive yield and associated scientific promise. 2.5-hr pointings are proposed to provide the requisite transformational pulsar detection rate, while maintaining sensitivity across a wide range of binary orbital periods, including ultra-compact systems. A frequency range of 1.3-1.85 GHz will mitigate dispersion smearing and scattering.

</details>

Abstract: The association of pulsars and supernova remnants (SNR) has been an intriguing question even after decades of research. By comparing radio-band images with X-ray images, we have selected four SNR candidates in which an unresolved X-ray point source is present, suggesting the presence of a compact object, either a neutron star or a pulsar, associated with our candidate. We propose follow-up observations of these sources with Parkes/Murriyang to measure their periods, or determine whether they are a different class of objects. Finding the associated pulsar would allow us to give an estimate of the age and the distance at which the SNR is located.

Abstract: This project is to continue timing and profile studies of the first double-pulsar system, a unique laboratory for gravitational physics. Recent results, including the first measurements of higher-order light-propagation effects and of the relativistic deformation of the orbit, highlight the importance of a long term observational campaign for this remarkable system. The main aims of this proposal are to provide the strongest tests to date for general relativity and to measure for the first time the moment-of-inertia of a neutron star. Additionally, we will determine the system geometry and map the pulsar beams via geodetic precession.

### [2082] [Parkes observations for project P1375 semester 2025OCTS_04]()
*Zhang, Songbo,Staveley-Smith, Lister,Hobbs, George,Toomey, Lawrence,Dai, Shi,Wang, Shuangqiang,Wu, Xuefeng,Wei, Junjie,Yang, Xuan,Wang, Jieshuang*

TL;DR: 对Parkes档案观测的搜寻在年老疏散星团方向上发现了三个RRAT候选体（RRAT J1749-25、RRAT J1702-44、RRAT J1237-60），其DM分析为星团成员身份提供了有力证据；这些基于信噪比约7-8的有限单脉冲观测的探测仍需延长观测确认。若得到确认，将对恒星演化模型、中子星保留机制及不同恒星环境中的双星演化理解产生深远影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 疏散星团历史上显著缺乏中子星，因为其较浅的引力势阱无法在具有大诞生踢速度的超新星爆炸后保留这些致密天体。该工作针对这一知识空白，报告在年老疏散星团方向上新发现的RRAT候选体，并检验其与星团的关联。

Method: 摘要说明：对Parkes观测档案进行搜寻，发现三个RRAT候选体RRAT J1749-25、RRAT J1702-44和RRAT J1237-60，并开展DM分析以检验其与年老疏散星团的关联。探测基于有限的单脉冲观测，信噪比约为7-8。提议使用Parkes Ultra-Wideband Low接收机进行后续观测，积分时间加倍，每个源2小时、重复两次。摘要未说明具体观测频率范围、时间跨度及样本大小等更多细节。

Result: 在年老疏散星团方向上发现三个有前景的RRAT候选体：RRAT J1749-25、RRAT J1702-44和RRAT J1237-60。DM分析提供了有力证据支持其星团成员身份，RRAT J1749-25的DM与Theia 1661的预测值一致，RRAT J1237-60的DM与Trumpler 20的预期值相当。这些探测基于有限的单脉冲观测，信噪比约为7-8，因此仍需通过延长观测加以确认。摘要未说明其余候选体RRAT J1702-44的DM关联对象及其他数值细节。

Conclusion: 作者提出通过使用Parkes Ultra-Wideband Low接收机的后续观测（每个源2小时、重复两次）确认这些候选体的天体物理性质并刻画其辐射特性。若能在疏散星团中确认中子星，将对恒星演化模型、中子星保留机制以及不同恒星环境中双星演化的理解产生深远影响。这些候选体目前仍属需要确认的暂现源探测，其物理性质根据摘要无法进一步判断。

Abstract: Open clusters have historically shown a striking absence of neutron stars due to their shallow gravitational potential wells that cannot retain these compact objects after supernova explosions with large natal kicks. However, our recent archival search of Parkes observations has discovered three promising Rotating Radio Transient (RRAT) candidates, RRAT J1749-25, RRAT J1702-44, and RRAT J1237-60, in the direction of old open clusters. The dispersion measure (DM) analysis provides compelling evidence for cluster membership, with RRAT J1749-25 showing DM consistent with Theia 1661's predicted values, and RRAT J1237-60 exhibiting DM comparable to Trumpler 20's expectations. These detections are based on limited single-pulse observations with signal-to-noise ratios of ~7-8, requiring confirmation through extended observations. We propose follow-up observations using the Parkes Ultra-Wideband Low receiver with doubled integration times (2 hours per source, repeated twice) to confirm the astrophysical nature of these candidates and characterise their emission properties. Confirmation of neutron stars in open clusters would have profound implications for stellar evolution models, neutron star retention mechanisms, and our understanding of binary evolution in different stellar environments.

</details>

Result: 在年老疏散星团方向发现三个有前景的 RRAT 候选体：RRAT J1749-25、RRAT J1702-44 和 RRAT J1237-60。DM 分析提供了支持星团成员关系的证据：RRAT J1749-25 的 DM 与 Theia 1661 的预测值一致，RRAT J1237-60 的 DM 与 Trumpler 20 的预期值相当。探测基于有限的单脉冲观测，信噪比约为 ~7-8，需要扩展观测确认。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些候选体需通过扩展观测确认其天体物理性质并刻画发射特性；若确认疏散星团中存在中子星，将对恒星演化模型、中子星保留机制以及不同恒星环境中双星演化的理解产生深远影响。根据摘要无法判断这些候选体的具体物理性质。

Abstract: Open clusters have historically shown a striking absence of neutron stars due to their shallow gravitational potential wells that cannot retain these compact objects after supernova explosions with large natal kicks. However, our recent archival search of Parkes observations has discovered three promising Rotating Radio Transient (RRAT) candidates, RRAT J1749-25, RRAT J1702-44, and RRAT J1237-60, in the direction of old open clusters. The dispersion measure (DM) analysis provides compelling evidence for cluster membership, with RRAT J1749-25 showing DM consistent with Theia 1661's predicted values, and RRAT J1237-60 exhibiting DM comparable to Trumpler 20's expectations. These detections are based on limited single-pulse observations with signal-to-noise ratios of ~7-8, requiring confirmation through extended observations. We propose follow-up observations using the Parkes Ultra-Wideband Low receiver with doubled integration times (2 hours per source, repeated twice) to confirm the astrophysical nature of these candidates and characterise their emission properties. Confirmation of neutron stars in open clusters would have profound implications for stellar evolution models, neutron star retention mechanisms, and our understanding of binary evolution in different stellar environments.

</details>

### [2088] [Parkes observations for project P1066 semester 2021APRS_16]()
*Gupta, Vivek,Price, Danny,Flynn, Chris,Dobie, Dougal,Kumar, Pravir,Cooke, Jeff,Webb, Sara,Zhang, Jielai,Goode, Simon*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: DWF计划申请36小时Parkes观测，通过协调全球80多个台站对同一视场进行同时、快速采样的多波段观测，以探测快速瞬变源和FRB对应体并帮助揭示其本质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 快速瞬变源与FRB的本质尚未解决。此类毫秒至小时量级的瞬变在射电探测前后的多波段对应信号，在显著深度上几乎未被观测，导致这一参数空间尚未得到充分探索，因此需要同时、快速采样、宽视场的多波段协同观测。

Method: 申请36小时Parkes观测以继续DWF计划。DWF协调全球80多个覆盖射电至伽马射线的观测站，与Parkes同时同视场观测；参与设施包括South Pole Telescope（毫米/亚毫米波）、GROND（红外）、CTIO Dark Energy Camera（光学）、Astrosat（紫外/X射线）、HXMT（X射线）、HESS（伽马射线）、Pierre Auger（高能）。进行全波段实时数据处理与瞬变源识别，触发数分钟内的快速响应后随观测，用Keck、VLT、Gemini、SALT、ATCA等进行深度光谱与成像。

Result: 摘要为一观测申请，未报告已完成观测的结果。摘要称DWF计划此前是成功的，并说明该计划协调80多个观测站、具备全波段实时处理与瞬变源识别能力，可触发数分钟内的快速响应后随观测；未给出任何探测数目、显著性、数值或具体瞬变事件。

Conclusion: 作者主张，通过在射电探测前后与Parkes同步进行深度、快速采样、宽视场的多波段观测，并借助实时触发快速后随，可探测FRB对应体和其他快速瞬变源，从而帮助揭示其本质。这一主张基于该参数空间此前几乎未被探索的判断；摘要未给出可验证的结果性证据。对脉冲星、磁星或单脉冲发射研究的具体适用性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose 36 hrs of Parkes observations to continue our successful Deeper, Wider, Faster (DWF) program to detect fast transients and fast radio burst (FRB) counterparts and help resolve their nature. DWF coordinates over 80 observatories worldwide at all wavelengths, from radio to gamma-ray to detect and follow-up FRBs and other elusive fast (millisecond-to-hours duration) transients. Crucially, we coordinate simultaneous deep, fast-cadenced, wide-field observations at all wavelengths to observe the same field at the same time as Parkes, enabling multi-wavelength detection before, during, and after the radio detection. Little to no multi-wavelength observations to any significant depth have been done on these timescales, leaving this parameter space underexplored. DWF coordinates major facilities to observe with Parkes, such as South Pole Telescope (mm/sub-mm), GROND (infrared), CTIO Dark Energy Camera (optical), Astrosat (UV/X-ray), HXMT (X-ray), HESS (gamma-ray), and Pierre Auger (high-energy). We perform realtime data processing and transient identification at all wavelengths that enables triggering our deep, rapid-response (within minutes) follow up programs for deep spectroscopy and imaging using the world's largest telescopes (e.g., Keck, VLT, Gemini, SALT, ATCA).

</details>

Abstract: We propose 36 hrs of Parkes observations to continue our successful Deeper, Wider, Faster (DWF) program to detect fast transients and fast radio burst (FRB) counterparts and help resolve their nature. DWF coordinates over 80 observatories worldwide at all wavelengths, from radio to gamma-ray to detect and follow-up FRBs and other elusive fast (millisecond-to-hours duration) transients. Crucially, we coordinate simultaneous deep, fast-cadenced, wide-field observations at all wavelengths to observe the same field at the same time as Parkes, enabling multi-wavelength detection before, during, and after the radio detection. DWF coordinates over 80 observatories worldwide at all wavelengths, from radio to gamma-ray to detect and follow-up FRBs and other elusive fast (millisecond-to-hours duration) transients. Crucially, we coordinate simultaneous deep, fast-cadenced, wide-field observations at all wavelengths to observe the same field at the same time as Parkes, enabling multi-wavelength detection before, during, and after the radio detection. Little to no multi-wavelength observations to any significant depth have been done on these timescales, leaving this parameter space underexplored. ### [2108] [Parkes observations for project P1066 semester 2021APRS_04]()

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB及其他毫秒至小时持续时间的快速暂现源本质尚未解决，需要多波段对应体信息。摘要指出，在这些时间尺度上几乎没有进行过达到任何显著深度的多波段观测，这一参数空间尚未被充分探索，因此需要协调同步的深度、快速节奏、宽视场多波段观测。

Method: 申请36小时Parkes观测继续DWF计划。DWF协调全球80多个观测台站，覆盖射电到伽马射线，并与Parkes对同一视场同时进行深度、快速节奏、宽视场观测；参与设施包括South Pole Telescope（毫米/亚毫米波）、GROND（红外）、CTIO Dark Energy Camera（光学）、Astrosat（紫外/X射线）、HXMT（X射线）、HESS（伽马射线）和Pierre Auger（高能）。所有波段进行实时数据处理和暂现源识别，以触发数分钟内的快速响应后随观测，使用Keck、VLT、Gemini、SALT、ATCA等进行深度光谱和成像。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度细节或样本量。

Conclusion: 作者认为，通过DWF在Parkes观测同一视场同时进行多波段同步观测，并配合实时触发的大望远镜快速后随光谱与成像，可探测FRB对应体及其他快速暂现源，从而帮助解决它们的本质，并探索此前未被充分探索的时间尺度参数空间。根据摘要无法判断该计划对脉冲星、磁星或单脉冲发射等具体物理问题的适用性。

DWF coordinates over 80 observatories worldwide at all wavelengths, from radio to gamma-ray to detect and follow-up FRBs and other elusive fast (millisecond-to-hours duration) transients. Crucially, we coordinate simultaneous deep, fast-cadenced, wide-field observations at all wavelengths to observe the same field at the same time as Parkes, enabling multi-wavelength detection before, during, and after the radio detection. Little to no multi-wavelength observations to any significant depth have been done on these timescales, leaving this parameter space underexplored. Method: 摘要说明申请36小时Parkes观测，DWF协调全球80多个天文台，在从射电到伽马射线的全部波段对同一Parkes天区进行同步、深度、快速采样、宽视场观测；参与设施包括South Pole Telescope（毫米/亚毫米波）、GROND（红外）、CTIO Dark Energy Camera（光学）、Astrosat（紫外/X射线）、HXMT（X射线）、HESS（伽马射线）、Pierre Auger（高能）。摘要还说明进行全波段实时数据处理与暂现源识别，并可触发深度、快速响应（数分钟内）后随计划，用世界最大望远镜（如Keck、VLT、Gemini、SALT、ATCA）进行深度光谱和成像。摘要未说明具体的触发阈值、采样率、灵敏度或观测时间跨度。

Result: 摘要未报告任何观测结果或探测事件；它是一份观测时间申请。摘要陈述的既有事实是：DWF计划此前是成功的，并协调80多个天文台在从射电到伽马射线波段进行观测；可以触发数分钟内的快速响应后随观测。摘要未给出任何已探测的FRB对应体、快速暂现源、多波段探测数量、显著性、数值结果或时间跨度。

Conclusion: 作者明确支持的结论是：通过DWF在Parkes观测期间协调从射电到伽马射线的同步、深度快速多波段观测，可在射电探测前后捕捉对应体，从而帮助解决FRB和其他快速暂现源的本质；此类时间尺度上的多波段观测此前几乎没有，因此该参数空间值得探索。摘要本身并未给出已完成的探测或物理结论，因此对具体FRB或暂现源本质的判断为：根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose 36 hrs of Parkes observations to continue our successful Deeper, Wider, Faster (DWF) program to detect fast transients and fast radio burst (FRB) counterparts and help resolve their nature. DWF coordinates over 80 observatories worldwide at all wavelengths, from radio to gamma-ray to detect and follow-up FRBs and other elusive fast (millisecond-to-hours duration) transients. Crucially, we coordinate simultaneous deep, fast-cadenced, wide-field observations at all wavelengths to observe the same field at the same time as Parkes, enabling multi-wavelength detection before, during, and after the radio detection. Little to no multi-wavelength observations to any significant depth have been done on these timescales, leaving this parameter space underexplored. DWF coordinates major facilities to observe with Parkes, such as South Pole Telescope (mm/sub-mm), GROND (infrared), CTIO Dark Energy Camera (optical), Astrosat (UV/X-ray), HXMT (X-ray), HESS (gamma-ray), and Pierre Auger (high-energy). We perform realtime data processing and transient identification at all wavelengths that enables triggering our deep, rapid-response (within minutes) follow up programs for deep spectroscopy and imaging using the world's largest telescopes (e.g., Keck, VLT, Gemini, SALT, ATCA).

</details>

TL;DR: 该文提出，其真空期望值设定强耦合的 QCD 膨胀子场可使 QCD 禁闭相变成为一级相变，由此产生的等离子体声波所生成的随机引力波信号与脉冲星计时阵列最近探测到的引力波背景惊人地相似。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期由脉冲星计时阵列探测到的引力波背景需要解释，而该文探讨 QCD 膨胀子——其真空期望值设定强耦合——是否能够改变 QCD 禁闭相变的性质，并由此产生可与之比较的引力波信号。

Method: 摘要所述为理论/宇宙学分析：引入其真空期望值设定强耦合的 QCD 膨胀子场，讨论其在早期宇宙中被吸引到弱耦合假真空以及向真真空的量子隧穿；并计算该膨胀子诱导的一级 QCD 相变中等离子体声波产生的随机引力波信号。观测数据、频段、时间跨度与统计方法均摘要未说明。

Result: QCD 膨胀子可使 QCD 禁闭相变变为一级相变；在早期宇宙中该膨胀子被宇宙学地吸引到弱耦合处的假真空，向真真空的量子隧穿触发瞬时的手征对称性破缺和 QCD 禁闭，形成强子相的爆燃气泡；由这些等离子体声波产生的随机引力波信号与最近由脉冲星计时阵列探测到的引力波背景惊人地相似。摘要未给出引力波频率、振幅、信号显著性或其他数值。

Conclusion: 作者认为，等离子体声波产生的随机引力波信号与脉冲星计时阵列新近探测到的背景的相似性，为该膨胀子诱导的一级 QCD 相变提供了可检验的引力波特征；他们并简要指出这一理论可通过对撞机实验和宇宙学加以检验。其与脉冲星计时观测之间的定量符合程度、以及对单个脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴的物理含义，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We show that a QCD dilaton field, whose vacuum expectation value sets the strong coupling, can render the quantum chromodynamic (QCD) confinement transition first order. The QCD dilaton is cosmologically attracted to a false vacuum at weak coupling in the early Universe. Quantum tunneling toward the true vacuum triggers prompt chiral symmetry breaking and confinement of QCD, leading to detonating bubbles of the hadronic phase. We find that plasma sound waves produced by this dilaton-induced, first-order QCD phase transition generate a stochastic gravitational wave signal strikingly similar to the recently detected gravitational wave background from pulsar timing arrays. We briefly comment on how this theory can be probed through collider experiments and cosmology.

</details>


### [2120] [Observing micro-black-hole dark matter]()
*Ettengruber, Manuel,Kühnel, Florian*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 在短距离引力被额外维度或大量粒子种类修改且记忆负担效应充分抑制霍金蒸发的情形下，原初微黑洞暗物质仍可在受限参数区域内保持现象学可行；中子星存活提供最稳健限制，中微子望远镜与并合特征提供互补检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原初微黑洞在短距离引力被额外维度或大量粒子种类修改、且记忆负担效应足以抑制霍金蒸发时，可构成暗物质；这类处于过渡区域的黑洞在质量—半径关系、温度、熵和寿命上不同于四维爱因斯坦对应物，甚至可能使极轻天体在宇宙学上稳定。问题在于此类微黑洞暗物质有哪些最有希望的观测后果，以及哪些观测能对其参数空间给出限制或检验。

Method: 摘要仅说明本文分析此类微黑洞暗物质最有希望的观测后果，并比较中子星存活、中微子望远镜中的弥漫蒸发信号以及并合诱导蒸发暴等检验途径；摘要未说明具体观测数据、望远镜或仪器名称、频段、时间跨度、样本、统计或模拟分析方法。

Result: 中子星存活给出最稳健的限制；参数空间中一个狭窄区域可同时保持可行并解释银河系中心缺失脉冲星问题。中微子望远镜中的弥漫蒸发信号主要与额外维度情形相关，而在一般粒子种类模型中，可见发射因蒸发进入暗部门而受到强烈抑制。若并合后遗迹短暂回到半经典阶段，并合诱导的蒸发暴可在额外维度实现中提供额外探针。摘要未给出具体数值、显著性或其他定量结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，微黑洞暗物质在受限区域内仍在现象学上可行，中子星、中微子望远镜和并合特征可提供互补检验。与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、脉冲星计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱、暂现射电发射或磁星—快速射电暴（FRB）联系相关的物理含义，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Primordial micro black holes can constitute dark matter if short-distance gravity is modified by extra dimensions or a large number of species and if the memory-burden effect sufficiently suppresses Hawking evaporation. The resulting black holes in the transition regime differ from their four-dimensional Einsteinian counterparts through their mass---radius relation, temperature, entropy, and lifetime, which can render even very light objects cosmologically stable. The most promising observational consequences of such micro black hole dark matter are analyzed. Neutron star survival yields the most robust constraints, while a narrow region of parameter space can simultaneously remain viable and address the missing-pulsar problem in the Galactic Center. Diffuse evaporation signals in neutrino telescopes are found to be relevant mainly in extradimensional scenarios, whereas in generic species models, visible emission is strongly suppressed by evaporation into dark sectors. Merger-induced evaporation bursts can provide an additional probe in extradimensional realizations if the postmerger remnant briefly returns to the semiclassical phase. Overall, micro-black-hole dark matter remains phenomenologically viable in constrained regions, with neutron stars, neutrino telescopes, and merger signatures providing complementary tests.

</details>


### [2121] [Parkes observations for project P1165 semester 2024OCTS_04]()
*Bai, Juntao,Wang, Na,Dai, Shi,Wang, Shuangqiang,Zhi, QiJun,Xu, xin*

TL;DR: 在FAST脉冲星巡天（PT2020_0141）中发现的两颗新脉冲星 J1849+1001（35.1 ms）和 J1839+0542（57.9 ms）经后续计时观测显示处于具有大质量伴星的圆轨道上，因此可归类为中等质量双脉冲星（IMBP）；结合Parkes与FAST计时观测有望测量“后开普勒”参数，进而测量中子星和伴星质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文报告了两颗在中等银纬FAST脉冲星巡天中新发现的脉冲星，并指出其大质量伴星使其成为通过脉冲星计时测量“后开普勒”参数、进而测量中子星与伴星质量的理想系统。摘要未进一步说明更广泛的知识空白或研究背景。

Method: 利用FAST脉冲星巡天（PT2020_0141）发现两颗新脉冲星，并进行后续计时观测以确定其轨道特征；本工作另开展Parkes观测（项目 P1165，学期 2024OCTS_04），并计划将其与FAST的常规计时观测相结合，用于测量“后开普勒”参数。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度、样本量或数据分析方法。

Result: 在中等银纬FAST脉冲星巡天（PT2020_0141）中发现两颗新脉冲星 J1849+1001（35.1 ms）和 J1839+0542（57.9 ms）。后续计时观测显示它们处于具有大质量伴星的圆轨道上。摘要据此将两颗源归类为候选的中等质量双脉冲星（IMBP），并指出其大质量伴星使其成为通过脉冲星计时测量“后开普勒”参数的理想系统。

Conclusion: 作者认为 PSR J1849+1001 和 J1839+0542 可归类为中等质量双脉冲星（IMBP）；其大质量伴星使其成为通过脉冲星计时测量“后开普勒”参数的理想系统。将Parkes观测与FAST常规计时观测结合，预期可测量“后开普勒”参数，并进而测量中子星和伴星的质量。根据摘要无法判断这些测量对脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）相关物理的具体意义。

Abstract: We recently discovered two new pulsars J1849+1001 (35.1 ms) and J1839+0542 (57.9 ms) in a FAST pulsar survey at intermediate Galactic latitudes (PT2020_0141). Follow-up timing observations show that they are in circular orbits with massive companions. This suggests that PSR J1849+1001 and J1839+0542 can be classified as the intermediate-mass binary pulsar (IMBP). Their massive companions also make them promising systems to measure "Post-Keplerian" parameters through pulsar timing. These Parkes observations will be combined with regular timing observations with FAST to measure "Post-Keplerian" parameters and then measure both neutron star and companion masses.

</details>

Abstract: We recently discovered two new pulsars J1849+1001 (35.1 ms) and J1839+0542 (57.9 ms) in a FAST pulsar survey at intermediate Galactic latitudes (PT2020_0141). Follow-up timing observations show that they are in circular orbits with massive companions. This suggests that PSR J1849+1001 and J1839+0542 can be classified as the intermediate-mass binary pulsar (IMBP). Their massive companions also make them promising systems to measure "Post-Keplerian" parameters through pulsar timing. These Parkes observations will be combined with regular timing observations with FAST to measure "Post-Keplerian" parameters and then measure both neutron star and companion masses.

Result: 摘要报告在FAST脉冲星巡天（PT2020_0141）中于中等银纬新发现两颗脉冲星 J1849+1001（周期 35.1 ms）和 J1839+0542（周期 57.9 ms）。后续计时观测显示，二者处于具有大质量伴星的圆轨道上。作者据此指出，PSR J1849+1001 和 J1839+0542 可被归类为中等质量双脉冲星（IMBP），并且其大质量伴星使其成为通过脉冲星计时测量“Post-Keplerian”参数的 promising 系统。

Conclusion: 作者认为，PSR J1849+1001 和 J1839+0542 处于具有大质量伴星的圆轨道上，可被归类为中等质量双脉冲星（IMBP）。其大质量伴星使其成为通过脉冲星计时测量“Post-Keplerian”参数的 promising 系统；将 Parkes 观测与 FAST 常规计时观测结合，可测量“Post-Keplerian”参数并进而测量中子星与伴星的质量。根据摘要无法判断这些系统与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或其他单脉冲现象的联系。

Abstract: We recently discovered two new pulsars J1849+1001 (35.1 ms) and J1839+0542 (57.9 ms) in a FAST pulsar survey at intermediate Galactic latitudes (PT2020_0141). Follow-up timing observations show that they are in circular orbits with massive companions. This suggests that PSR J1849+1001 and J1839+0542 can be classified as the intermediate-mass binary pulsar (IMBP). Their massive companions also make them promising systems to measure "Post-Keplerian" parameters through pulsar timing. These Parkes observations will be combined with regular timing observations with FAST to measure "Post-Keplerian" parameters and then measure both neutron star and companion masses.

</details>

Motivation: 在新发现的脉冲星中识别双星系统并测定其质量，有助于理解脉冲星—伴星系统的性质。摘要指出，两颗新脉冲星处于具有大质量伴星的圆轨道上，这使其可被归类为中等质量双脉冲星，并使其成为通过脉冲星计时测量“Post-Keplerian”参数、进而测量中子星和伴星质量的极具前景的系统。

Method: 摘要说明，两颗新脉冲星是在FAST脉冲星巡天（PT2020_0141）中于中等银纬区域发现的，后续计时观测表明它们处于具有大质量伴星的圆轨道上。该研究将把题名所述Parkes观测与FAST的常规计时观测相结合，以测量“Post-Keplerian”参数，并进而测量中子星和伴星的质量。摘要未说明Parkes观测的具体频率或频段、时间跨度、样本量以及详细的计时或统计分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告在FAST脉冲星巡天（PT2020_0141）中发现了两颗新脉冲星J1849+1001（35.1 ms）和J1839+0542（57.9 ms）。后续计时观测表明，它们处于具有大质量伴星的圆轨道上。摘要指出，这表明PSR J1849+1001和J1839+0542可被归类为中等质量双脉冲星（IMBP），并且它们的大质量伴星使其成为通过脉冲星计时测量“Post-Keplerian”参数的极具前景的系统。摘要未说明已测得的质量、“Post-Keplerian”参数数值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 摘要明确支持的结论是：PSR J1849+1001和J1839+0542处于具有大质量伴星的圆轨道上，因此可被归类为中等质量双脉冲星（IMBP）；其大质量伴星使其成为通过脉冲星计时测量“Post-Keplerian”参数的极具前景的系统。计划将这些Parkes观测与FAST的常规计时观测相结合，以测量“Post-Keplerian”参数，进而测量中子星和伴星的质量。根据摘要无法判断这些系统与磁星、快速射电暴、单脉冲发射、模式转换、偏振或射电频谱等的具体联系。

Abstract: We recently discovered two new pulsars J1849+1001 (35.1 ms) and J1839+0542 (57.9 ms) in a FAST pulsar survey at intermediate Galactic latitudes (PT2020_0141). Follow-up timing observations show that they are in circular orbits with massive companions. This suggests that PSR J1849+1001 and J1839+0542 can be classified as the intermediate-mass binary pulsar (IMBP). Their massive companions also make them promising systems to measure "Post-Keplerian" parameters through pulsar timing. These Parkes observations will be combined with regular timing observations with FAST to measure "Post-Keplerian" parameters and then measure both neutron star and companion masses.

</details>

Abstract: We recently discovered two new pulsars J1849+1001 (35.1 ms) and J1839+0542 (57.9 ms) in a FAST pulsar survey at intermediate Galactic latitudes (PT2020_0141). Follow-up timing observations show that they are in circular orbits with massive companions. This suggests that PSR J1849+1001 and J1839+0542 can be classified as the intermediate-mass binary pulsar (IMBP). Their massive companions also make them promising systems to measure "Post-Keplerian" parameters through pulsar timing. These Parkes observations will be combined with regular timing observations with FAST or MeerKAT to measure "Post-Keplerian" parameters and then measure both neutron star and companion masses.

Conclusion: 作者认为，PSR J1849+1001和J1839+0542可被归类为中等质量双脉冲星（IMBP），它们的大质量伴星使其成为有望通过脉冲星计时测量“Post-Keplerian”参数的候选系统。作者计划将Parkes观测与FAST或MeerKAT的常规计时观测结合，以测量“Post-Keplerian”参数，并进而测量中子星和伴星的质量。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴、单脉冲、模式转换或自转减速力矩变化的具体联系。

Abstract: We recently discovered two new pulsars J1849+1001 (35.1 ms) and J1839+0542 (57.9 ms) in a FAST pulsar survey at intermediate Galactic latitudes (PT2020_0141). Follow-up timing observations show that they are in circular orbits with massive companions. This suggests that PSR J1849+1001 and J1839+0542 can be classified as the intermediate-mass binary pulsar (IMBP). Their massive companions also make them promising systems to measure "Post-Keplerian" parameters through pulsar timing. These Parkes observations will be combined with regular timing observations with FAST or MeerKAT to measure "Post-Keplerian" parameters and then measure both neutron star and companion masses.

</details>


### [2160] [Parkes observations for project P455 semester 2020OCTS_04]()
*Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Manchester, Dick,Kramer, Michael,McLaughlin, Maura,Stairs, Ingrid,Lorimer, Duncan Ross,Ferdman, Robert,Wex, Norbert,Hu, Huanchen*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟继续对首个双脉冲星系统进行计时与脉冲轮廓研究，利用 UWL 接收机的高灵敏度提供迄今最强的广义相对论检验，并首次测量中子星的转动惯量，同时搜寻 B 脉冲星的再次出现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 首个双脉冲星系统是引力物理的独特实验室。近期已首次测得高阶光传播效应和轨道的相对论性形变，这表明需要对该系统开展长期观测，以推进对广义相对论的检验并测量中子星转动惯量；摘要未说明该领域更具体的知识空白。

Method: 摘要说明本项目继续对该双脉冲星系统进行计时和脉冲轮廓研究，利用 UWL 接收机的高灵敏度，并搜寻 B 脉冲星。观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本量、统计或数据分析方法等具体细节：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：近期结果包括首次测量高阶光传播效应以及轨道的相对论性形变，这些结果凸显了对该双脉冲星系统开展长期观测活动的重要性。摘要给出的主要目标是提供迄今最强的广义相对论检验并首次测量中子星转动惯量，并搜寻 B 脉冲星再次出现；摘要未报告具体的检验结果、转动惯量数值、探测显著性、脉冲轮廓或偏振结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，基于近期包括首次测量高阶光传播效应和轨道相对论性形变的结果，长期持续观测该双脉冲星系统具有重要意义；其拟利用 UWL 接收机的高灵敏度给出迄今最强的广义相对论检验，并首次测量中子星的转动惯量，同时搜寻 B 脉冲星的再次出现。这些关于中子星性质与引力理论的推论仍属提案目标，相关物理含义是否成立根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: This project is to continue timing and profile studies of the first double-pulsar system, a unique laboratory for gravitational physics. Recent results, including the first measurements of higher-order light-propagation effects and of the relativistic deformation of the orbit, highlight the importance of a long term observational campaign for this remarkable system. The main aims of this proposal are to exploit the high sensitivity of the UWL receiver to provide the strongest tests to date for general relativity and to measure for the first time the moment-of-inertia of a neutron star. Additionally, we will search for the reappearance of the B pulsar.

</details>

Motivation: 首个双脉冲星系统是引力物理学的独特实验室。近期已首次测量高阶光传播效应并测得轨道的相对论变形，这些结果凸显了对该非凡系统进行长期观测campaign的重要性，但摘要未进一步说明当前存在的具体知识缺口。

Method: 摘要说明本项目为Parkes观测项目P455 semester 2021APRS_04下的提案，将利用UWL接收机的高灵敏度继续对该双脉冲星系统进行计时与脉冲轮廓研究，并搜寻B脉冲星的重新出现。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、时间跨度、样本量及统计分析方法。

Result: 摘要提及近期结果包括对高阶光传播效应的首次测量以及轨道相对论变形的测量，并指出这些结果凸显了长期观测campaign的重要性。摘要未说明这些测量所涉及的数值、精度或显著性，也未报告本提案已获得的观测结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出，本提案的主要目标是利用UWL接收机的高灵敏度，提供迄今最强的广义相对论检验，并首次测量中子星的转动惯量；此外将搜寻B脉冲星的重新出现。摘要未给出这些目标的实现结果或其物理含义；根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射等主题的联系。

Abstract: This project is to continue timing and profile studies of the first double-pulsar system, a unique laboratory for gravitational physics. Recent results, including the first measurements of higher-order light-propagation effects and of the relativistic deformation of the orbit, highlight the importance of a long term observational campaign for this remarkable system. The main aims of this proposal are to exploit the high sensitivity of the UWL receiver to provide the strongest tests to date for general relativity and to measure for the first time the moment-of-inertia of a neutron star. Additionally, we will search for the reappearance of the B pulsar.

</details>

### [2186] [New test of modified gravity with gravitational wave experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.08273)
*Jiménez Cruz, N. M.,Sánchez, Flavio C.,Tasinato, Gianmassimo*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 对随机引力波背景的极化角取平均后，张量模和矢量模的三点关联消失而标量模一般非零，因此引力波双谱可作为标量极化的稳健诊断；作者为地面干涉仪、脉冲星计时阵列和天体测量观测量推导响应函数并构造最优估计量，并以原初磁成因产生的二阶引力波作为原理验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探测随机引力波背景中的非张量极化，是检验超越广义相对论理论的重要手段。摘要指出张量模与矢量模的三点关联在极化角平均后会消失，而标量模一般留下非零印记，因此需要一种能利用这一差异来区分标量极化的诊断工具，为超越广义相对论的物理提供新的观测窗口。

Method: 摘要说明：提出一种探测随机引力波背景中非张量极化的新策略，对极化角取平均并分析引力波信号的三点关联；推导地面干涉仪、脉冲星计时阵列和天体测量观测量对应的响应函数；构造最优估计量，并给出针对脉冲星计时灵敏度的简单Fisher预报。具体观测频段、时间跨度与样本未在摘要中说明。作为原理验证，分析了由原初磁成因产生的二阶引力波。

Result: 摘要报告：对极化角取平均后，引力波信号的三点关联对张量模和矢量模消失，而标量模一般会留下非零印记；由此引力波双谱成为标量极化的独特且稳健的诊断工具。作者推导了地面干涉仪、脉冲星计时阵列和天体测量观测量对应的响应函数，并构造最优估计量与针对脉冲星计时灵敏度的简单Fisher预报。作为原理验证，由原初磁成因产生的二阶引力波可以通过大的三点函数来表征。

Conclusion: 作者结论：引力波三点关联为超越广义相对论的物理提供了一个新的观测窗口，其中引力波双谱可作为理论所预言的标量极化的独特且稳健的诊断；由原初磁成因产生的二阶引力波可通过大的三点函数表征。关于这些响应函数或估计量在真实脉冲星计时数据上的适用性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose a new strategy to probe nontensorial polarizations in the stochastic gravitational wave (GW) background. Averaging over polarization angles, we find that three-point correlations of the GW signal vanish for tensor and vector modes, while scalar modes generically leave a nonzero imprint. This property makes the GW bispectrum a distinctive and robust diagnostic of scalar polarizations predicted in theories beyond general relativity. We derive the corresponding response functions for ground-based interferometers, pulsar timing arrays, and astrometric observables, and we construct an optimal estimator together with simple Fisher forecasts for pulsar timing sensitivity. As a proof of principle, we show that second-order GWs sourced by primordial magnetogenesis can be characterized by large three-point functions. Our results demonstrate that GW three-point correlations provide a novel observational window on physics beyond general relativity.

</details>

C.,Zuo, X.,Lhaaso Collaboration*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: LHAASO对超新星遗迹IC 443的高能$\gamma$射线观测显示一个能谱延伸至超过$~30\text{ }\text{ }\mathrm{TeV}$且无明显截断的点源，在强子起源假设下被加速质子95%置信下限约为300 TeV，为SNR激波高效加速sub-PeV宇宙线提供了证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超新星遗迹被认为是银河系宇宙线的主要贡献者，但其激波可加速粒子的最高能量不确定，且其对PeV附近能量宇宙线的贡献不清楚。需要观测检验SNR能否高效加速到亚PeV乃至更高能量，以厘清这一知识空白。

Method: 利用高海拔宇宙线观测站（LHAASO）对超新星遗迹IC 443的高能$\gamma$射线辐射进行观测，并开展形态分析，将结果与Fermi-LAT探测到的源以及一个新发现的Fermi源进行比较；对点源源谱作幂律拟合，并在强子起源假设下估计被加速质子的能量下限。具体观测时间跨度、能段划分和样本量摘要未说明。

Result: 形态分析揭示一个点状源，其位置和能谱与Fermi-LAT探测到的具有$\pi^0$衰变特征的致密源一致，另有一个更延展的源，与一个新发现的Fermi源成协。点源源谱可用指数约为$~3.0$的幂律描述，延伸至超过$~30\text{ }\text{ }\mathrm{TeV}$且无明显截断；假设$\gamma$射线为强子起源，被加速质子的95%置信下限约为300 TeV。延展源可能与IC 443、SNR $G189.6+3.3$或假定的脉冲星风云CXOU $J061705.3+222127$成协，并可由强子或轻子模型解释，粒子达到数百TeV。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些LHAASO结果提供了令人信服的证据，表明sub-PeV宇宙线可被超新星遗迹的激波高效加速。摘要提及延展源可能成协于假定的脉冲星风云，但未就此给出进一步物理判断，根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴的关联。

Abstract: Supernova remnants (SNRs) have been considered as the primary contributors to cosmic rays (CRs) in our Galaxy. However, the maximum energy of particles that can be accelerated by shocks of SNRs is uncertain, and SNRs' contribution to CRs around PeV energies is unclear. In this Letter, we present observations of high-energy <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>γ</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula>-ray emission from the SNR IC 443 using the Large High Altitude Air Shower Observatory (LHAASO). The morphological analysis reveals a pointlike source whose location and spectrum are consistent with those of the Fermi-LAT-detected compact source with <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msup><mml:mi>π</mml:mi><mml:mn>0</mml:mn></mml:msup></mml:math></inline-formula>-decay signature, and a more extended source that is associated with a newly discovered Fermi source. The spectrum of the point source can be described by a power-law function with an index of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mo>~</mml:mo><mml:mn>3.0</mml:mn></mml:math></inline-formula>, extending beyond <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mo>~</mml:mo><mml:mn>30</mml:mn><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>TeV</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> without apparent cutoff. Assuming a hadronic origin of the <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>γ</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula>-ray emission, the 95% lower limit of accelerated protons reaches about 300 TeV. The extended source might be associated with IC 443, SNR <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>G</mml:mi><mml:mn>189.6</mml:mn><mml:mo>+</mml:mo><mml:mn>3.3</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula>, or the putative pulsar wind nebula CXOU <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>J</mml:mi><mml:mn>061705.3</mml:mn><mml:mo>+</mml:mo><mml:mn>222127</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula>, and can be explained by either a hadronic or a leptonic model with particles reaching hundreds of TeV. These LHAASO results provide compelling evidence that sub-PeV CRs can be accelerated efficiently by shocks of SNRs.

</details>

*Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Manchester, Dick,Kramer, Michael,McLaughlin, Maura,Stairs, Ingrid,Lorimer, Duncan Ross,Ferdman, Robert,Wex, Norbert*

Result: 摘要提及近期结果，包括对高阶光传播效应的首次测量以及轨道相对论形变的首次测量，并强调这些结果凸显了对该双脉冲星系统开展长期观测活动的重要性。摘要未给出具体数值、显著性、时间跨度或定量趋势。

Conclusion: 作者提出，通过持续计时和轮廓研究，该项目旨在提供迄今最强的广义相对论检验，并首次测量中子星转动惯量；同时通过测地进动确定系统几何并绘制脉冲星波束，还可能利用新 UWL 接收机的高灵敏度。所提及的近期首次测量被视为支持长期观测活动重要性的依据。根据摘要无法判断其结果对其他脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）群体的可迁移性。

Abstract: This project is to continue timing and profile studies of the first double-pulsar system, a unique laboratory for gravitational physics. Recent results, including the first measurements of higher-order light-propagation effects and of the relativistic deformation of the orbit, highlight the importance of a long term observational campaign for this remarkable system. The main aims of this proposal are to provide the strongest tests to date for general relativity and to measure for the first time the moment-of-inertia of a neutron star. Additionally, we will determine the system geometry and map the pulsar beams via geodetic precession. Whenever possible, we will exploit the high sensitivity of the new UWL receiver.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 首个双脉冲星系统是引力物理的独特实验室；近期已首次测量高阶光传播效应和轨道的相对论性形变，这些结果表明有必要对该系统开展长期观测，以推进广义相对论检验并测量中子星转动惯量。

Method: 摘要说明将开展计时与脉冲轮廓研究，并提到利用新 UWL 接收机的高灵敏度；观测项目名称为 Parkes 项目 P455 semester 2019OCTS_05。具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本、分析流程与统计方法：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告近期结果包括首次测量高阶光传播效应以及轨道的相对论性形变。所提出的主要目标是为广义相对论提供迄今最强的检验、首次测量中子星的转动惯量，以及通过测地进动确定系统几何结构并绘制脉冲星波束。具体数值、精度或显著性：摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为该双脉冲星系统值得长期观测，并计划以此推进广义相对论的最强检验和首次中子星转动惯量测量，同时利用测地进动确定系统几何并绘制脉冲星波束，可能时利用新 UWL 接收机的高灵敏度。关于该工作对脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴研究的具体物理启示：根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: This project is to continue timing and profile studies of the first double-pulsar system, a unique laboratory for gravitational physics. Recent results, including the first measurements of higher-order light-propagation effects and of the relativistic deformation of the orbit, highlight the importance of a long term observational campaign for this remarkable system. The main aims of this proposal are to provide the strongest tests to date for general relativity and to measure for the first time the moment-of-inertia of a neutron star. Additionally, we will determine the system geometry and map the pulsar beams via geodetic precession. Whenever possible, we will exploit the high sensitivity of the new UWL receiver.

</details>

### [2234] [Parkes observations for project P1087 semester 2020OCTS_02]()
*Kerr, Matthew,Johnston, Simon,Castro, Daniel,Dai, Shi,EAgle, Jordan*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟对 SNR/PWN B0453?685 开展深度射电观测，因为其预期脉冲流量密度比现有巡天低 3 倍或更多；若该源类似其他年轻 SNR/PWN 复合体，观测可探测到脉冲，从而确定脉冲星能量学并理解该系统与 LMC 中 PWN 的知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要指出，探测 SNR/PWN B0453?685 的伽马射线辐射并判断其来自 PWN、SNR 还是嵌入脉冲星，有助于理解该系统；中央 X 射线源几乎确定是超新星诞生的中子星，但尚无脉冲信号被探测到，且预期脉冲流量密度比现有巡天低 3 倍或更多，因此需要更深观测。

Method: 摘要提出对 SNR/PWN B0453?685 进行深度观测，以期探测其脉冲信号；文中提到现有巡天与预期脉冲流量密度，但未说明所用望远镜或仪器、观测频段、观测时间跨度、样本量或具体分析流程。标题“Parkes observations for project P1087 semester 2020OCTS_02”提到 Parkes 观测及项目 P1087 与学期 2020OCTS_02。

Conclusion: 摘要认为，了解脉冲星的能量学是理解该系统当前状态与演化历史的关键，并会进一步增进对 LMC 恒星形成的认识；若该源类似其他年轻 SNR/PWN 复合体，深度观测应能探测到脉冲信号。根据摘要无法判断该伽马射线辐射究竟来自 PWN、SNR 还是嵌入脉冲星，也无法判断其与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、模式转换、FRB 或自转减速力矩变化之间的具体物理联系。

Abstract: The detection of gamma-ray emission from the SNR/PWN B0453?685 could help us understand this system, especially if we know whether that emission is likely to arise from the PWN, the SNR, or the embedded pulsar. No pulsations have been detected from the central X-ray source that is almost certainly the neutron star birthed in the supernova, but the expected pulsed flux density is a factor of 3 or more below existing surveys. We propose deep observations that should detect pulsations if the source is analogous to other young SNR/PWN complexes. Knowing the pulsar energetics is key to understanding the current state and evolutionary history of the system, which in turn will increase our knowledge of star formation in the LMC, where only five PWNe are known to date.

</details>

Method: 摘要未说明。摘要仅说明使用一种完全协变的形式体系来研究宇宙学扰动，并对比非协变处理方式；未说明具体观测、数据、仪器、频段、时间跨度、样本或统计方法。

Conclusion: 作者明确支持的结论是：在计入规范依赖性后，原初黑洞与标量诱导引力波信号被强烈抑制，这对将脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）信号解释为一阶相变（FOPT）来源具有直接影响。至于对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、快速射电暴等具体观测方向的可迁移性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Understanding whether primordial black holes form during strong first-order phase transition (FOPT) is a crucial open question in cosmology. We address this using a fully covariant formalism to study cosmological perturbations, highlighting previously overlooked gauge dependencies. We show that non-covariant treatments can overestimate primordial black holes and scalar-induced gravitational waves. Once gauge dependencies are accounted for, both signals are strongly suppressed, with direct implications for the FOPT interpretation of the Pulsar Timing Array signal.
