### [2238] [Self-interacting dark-matter spikes and the final-parsec problem: Bayesian constraints from the NANOGrav 15-year gravitational-wave background](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.18153)
*Tiruvaskar, Shreyas,Gordon, Chris*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该研究将SIDM密度尖峰与双星-晕宇宙学族群模型结合，用NANOGrav 15年脉冲星计时数据进行六参数贝叶斯分析，发现所得SIDM参数后验约束与独立星系旋转和星系团透镜限制一致，且模型能匹配NANOGrav信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文关注长期存在的“最终秒差距问题”：并合超大质量黑洞双星如何从~1缩小到~10^{-2} pc。摘要提出，围绕并合超大质量黑洞的自相互作用暗物质（SIDM）密度尖峰或许能提供所需的动力学摩擦，因此需要检验该情景能否产生与NANOGrav 15年脉冲星计时数据相符的纳赫兹引力波背景。

Method: 摘要说明：将双星-晕系统嵌入宇宙学族群模型，在引力波辐射与SIDM拖曳的共同影响下演化旋近过程，计算纳赫兹引力波背景，并与NANOGrav 15年脉冲星计时数据对照；采用六参数贝叶斯分析，使用高斯过程加速的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛。观测频段、时间跨度、样本量等细节摘要未说明。

Result: 六参数贝叶斯分析给出单位质量截面与最大圆速度值的后验约束，这些约束与独立的星系旋转和星系团透镜限制一致。在该参数空间内，SIDM尖峰保持完好，能提供足够摩擦以克服恒星耗竭屏障，并产生一个特征应变谱；该谱对NANOGrav信号的匹配程度与唯象天体物理模型相当。摘要未给出具体数值、不确定度或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，在贝叶斯分析所得参数空间内，SIDM尖峰可以保持完好并提供足够摩擦来克服恒星耗竭屏障，从而支持该情景作为“最终秒差距问题”的一种可能解决方案，且其产生的纳赫兹引力波背景与NANOGrav 15年信号匹配程度与唯象天体物理模型相当。该结论基于摘要所述的族群模型演化与贝叶斯拟合；关于其与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、模式转换或快速射电暴（FRB）的具体物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: A self-interacting dark-matter (SIDM) density spike around merging supermassive black holes may be able to supply the dynamical friction needed to shrink binaries from <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mo>~</mml:mo><mml:mn>1</mml:mn></mml:math></inline-formula> to <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mo>~</mml:mo><mml:msup><mml:mn>10</mml:mn><mml:mrow><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:mn>2</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msup><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>pc</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula>, thereby resolving the long-standing ``final-parsec problem.'' Embedding the binary-halo system in a cosmological population model, we evolve the inspiral under the combined influence of gravitational-wave emission and SIDM drag, compute the resulting nanohertz gravitational-wave background, and confront it with the NANOGrav 15-year pulsar-timing data. A six-parameter Bayesian analysis, performed with a Gaussian-process-accelerated Markov chain Monte Carlo, yields posterior constraints on the cross section per unit mass and maximum circular velocity values that were consistent with independent galaxy-rotation and cluster-lensing limits. Within this parameter space, the SIDM spike remains intact, supplies sufficient friction to overcome the stellar depletion barrier, and produces a characteristic-strain spectrum that matches the NANOGrav signal as well as phenomenological astrophysical models.

</details>


### [2239] [Parkes observations for project P417 semester 2008APRS_01]()
*Kramer, Michael,Manchester, Dick,Lyne, Andrew,O'Brien, J.,McLaughlin, Maura,Lorimer, Duncan Ross*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案希望继续确认并研究一类新型射电源：它们在长时间内无可探测射电辐射，却以明亮射电脉冲星形式准周期性出现；提案拟在Parkes以每颗脉冲星每次合适观测时段5 min的监测模式，确定相关时间尺度并测量“关”与“开”期间的spin-down rates。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 这类射电源在长时间内无可探测射电辐射，却准周期性地以明亮射电脉冲星形式出现，且出现时间尺度推测较短；它们极难被探测和确认。作者认为其存在对脉冲星搜寻、中子星族群研究及其与超新星事件率的关系具有重要影响，并可检验基本磁层理论，因此希望继续研究这一新型射电源类别。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测数据、时间跨度或样本量。作者建议采用一种不同寻常的监测模式：在Parkes的每一次合适脉冲星观测时段中，对每颗脉冲星监测5 min，以确定所涉及的时间尺度，并测量其在“关”与“开”期间的spin-down rates。（标题提及Parkes project P417 semester 2008APRS_01。）

Result: 摘要未说明已获得的具体观测结果、探测数目、时间尺度数值、spin-down rates数值或统计显著性。摘要仅报告已确认存在这类新型射电源，它们长时间无可探测射电辐射、准周期性地以明亮射电脉冲星形式出现，且出现时间尺度推测较短；作者据此推断此类天体还有许多存在，因为它们极难被探测和确认。

Conclusion: 作者认为，这类新型射电源的存在对脉冲星搜寻、中子星族群研究及其与超新星事件率的关系具有重要影响，同时可用于检验基本磁层理论；但其具体物理机制或与脉冲星、磁星、FRB等对象的联系，根据摘要无法判断。摘要未说明该监测方案的可迁移性。

Abstract: We would like to establish the properties of further confirmed members of an elusive new kind of radio sources which do not exhibit any detectable radio emission for a long period of time, while they appear quasi-periodically as bright radio pulsars for a presumably short time-scale. Our discovery implies that many more such objects exist as they are extremely difficult to detect and confirm. We would like to continue our study of this new class of radio sources as their existence bears important implications for pulsar searches, population studies of neutron stars and their relation to supernova event rates, while at the same time test fundamental magnetospheric theories. We suggest an unusual monitoring mode of 5min per pulsar for every suitable pulsar session at Parkes, in order to determine the involved timescales and to measure the spin-down rates for off and on periods.

</details>


### [2240] [Parkes observations for project P1423 semester 2026APRS_14]()
*Sahoo, Sapan Kumar,Bhattacharyya, Bhaswati,Roy, Jayanta,Sharan, Rahul,Ghosh, Ankita*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟用Parkes 64-m望远镜和UWL接收机对六颗GMRT发现的脉冲星（三颗MSPs、三颗NPs）进行21小时宽带频谱-偏振观测，以提供稳健的RM测量、宽带偏振轮廓和依赖于频率的波束测绘，填补这些脉冲星缺乏宽带偏振测量的观测空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脉冲星射电辐射是探测极端引力、等离子体物理和磁层过程的独特探针。MSPs的转动稳定性使其成为脉冲星计时阵列探测纳赫兹引力波的基础，并可用于检验广义相对论与研究星际介质；NPs则有助于研究中子星内部、超新星遗迹、磁层物理、脉冲星风和glitch现象。偏振测量可约束发射几何、磁场位形和法拉第旋转传播效应，并有助于RM测定和计时模板保真度。然而许多GMRT发现的脉冲星缺乏宽带偏振测量，其发射几何与依赖于频率的轮廓演化受到的约束很差。

Method: 摘要说明这是一项观测提案：拟使用Parkes 64-m望远镜以及UWL接收机进行21小时观测，对六颗GMRT发现的脉冲星开展频谱-偏振研究，其中包括三颗MSPs（J1207-5050、J1227-4853、J1646-2142）和三颗NPs（J0514-4407、J0418-4154、J0702-4956）。这些目标表现出未分辨或相互矛盾的偏振行为，包括轮廓演化、食驱动的相互作用特征、不完整的探测或缺乏全斯托克斯信息。所提议的观测为宽带、高灵敏度观测。摘要未说明具体的观测频率、时间跨度、数据处理方法或统计分析细节。

Result: 摘要未说明实际观测结果。摘要陈述的背景性结果包括：GMRT低频巡天显著扩展了已知脉冲星种群，但许多GMRT发现的脉冲星缺乏宽带偏振测量，使发射几何和依赖于频率的轮廓演化受到的约束很差。所提议目标表现出的未分辨或相互矛盾的偏振行为包括轮廓演化、食驱动的相互作用特征、不完整的探测或缺乏全斯托克斯信息。所提议观测预期将提供稳健的RM测量、宽带偏振轮廓和依赖于频率的波束测绘。

Conclusion: 摘要提出，所提议的宽带、高灵敏度观测将填补关键的观测空白，并提升GMRT发现的脉冲星对磁层研究和脉冲星计时科学的科学价值。根据摘要无法判断这些观测是否已经实施、是否取得成功，也无法判断对所提议六颗脉冲星的具体物理推断，因为这些是提案性预期而非已确立的结果。

Abstract: Pulsars are rapidly rotating, highly magnetized neutron stars whose radio emission provides unique probes of extreme gravity, plasma physics, and magnetospheric processes. Millisecond pulsars(MSPs) exhibit exceptional rotational stability, making them fundamental components of Pulsar Timing Arrays used to detect nanohertz gravitational waves, while also enabling precision tests of general relativity, binary evolution, and studies of the interstellar medium(ISM). Normal pulsars(NPs), on the other hand, serve as powerful laboratories for investigating neutron-star interiors, supernova remnants, magnetospheric physics, pulsar winds, and glitch phenomena. Their polarization measurements are crucial, as they constrain emission geometry, magnetic-field configuration, and propagation effects such as Faraday rotation, while enabling robust determination of rotation measures(RM). For MSPs in particular, polarization studies improve timing-template fidelity and help correct frequency-dependent propagation effects that impact high-precision timing experiments. GMRT low-frequency surveys have significantly expanded the known pulsar population, yet many GMRT-discovered pulsars lack broadband polarization measurements, leaving their emission geometry and frequency-dependent profile evolution poorly constrained. We propose 21 hours of observations with the Parkes 64-m telescope using UWL receiver to conduct a spectro-polarimetric study of six GMRT-discovered pulsars: three MSPs(J1207-5050, J1227-4853, J1646-2142) and three NPs(J0514-4407, J0418-4154, J0702-4956) to conduct a spectro-polarimetric study. These targets exhibit unresolved or contradictory polarization behaviour, including profile evolution, eclipse-driven interaction signatures, incomplete detections, or absence of full-Stokes information. The proposed wideband, high-sensitivity observations will provide robust RM measurements, broadband polarization profiles, and frequency-dependent beam mapping, filling key observational gaps and enhancing the scientific value of GMRT-discovered pulsars for magnetospheric studies and pulsar timing science.

</details>

### [2243] [Parkes observations for project P1423 semester 2026APRS_06]()

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多由GMRT低频巡天发现的脉冲星缺乏宽带偏振测量，其发射几何与频率相关的轮廓演化因此约束不足；本提案所选的六颗目标还表现出未分辨或相互矛盾的偏振行为，包括轮廓演化、食致相互作用特征、不完整的探测或缺乏全斯托克斯信息，这些观测空白削弱了它们在磁层研究与高精度脉冲星计时中的科学价值。

Method: 提议使用Parkes 64米望远镜的UWL接收机进行21小时观测，对六颗GMRT发现的脉冲星——三颗MSP（J1207-5050、J1227-4853、J1646-2142）和三颗NP（J0514-4407、J0418-4154、J0702-4956）——开展频谱偏振研究。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、观测时间跨度、数据获取与定标流程以及偏振、RM或轮廓分析的具体方法。

Result: 摘要未报告已完成的观测结果；其所述目标脉冲星当前表现出未分辨或相互矛盾的偏振行为，包括轮廓演化、食致相互作用特征、不完整的探测，或缺乏全斯托克斯信息。摘要以预期方式说明，所提议的宽带、高灵敏度观测将提供稳健的RM测量、宽带偏振轮廓以及频率相关的波束成图。摘要未给出任何数值结果、显著性水平或统计量。

Conclusion: 作者明确提出，所提议的观测将填补关键观测空白，并提升GMRT发现脉冲星在磁层研究和脉冲星计时科学中的科学价值；在更广泛的背景下，偏振测量可约束发射几何、磁场构型与传播效应（如法拉第旋转），并支持RM测定，而对MSP而言，偏振研究可提高计时模板保真度并有助于校正影响高精度计时的频率相关传播效应。这些预期结果尚未由观测证实。根据摘要无法判断该提案与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲发射之间存在直接联系。

Abstract: Pulsars are rapidly rotating, highly magnetized neutron stars whose radio emission provides unique probes of extreme gravity, plasma physics, and magnetospheric processes. Millisecond pulsars(MSPs) exhibit exceptional rotational stability, making them fundamental components of Pulsar Timing Arrays used to detect nanohertz gravitational waves, while also enabling precision tests of general relativity, binary evolution, and studies of the interstellar medium(ISM). Normal pulsars(NPs), on the other hand, serve as powerful laboratories for investigating neutron-star interiors, supernova remnants, magnetospheric physics, pulsar winds, and glitch phenomena. Their polarization measurements are crucial, as they constrain emission geometry, magnetic-field configuration, and propagation effects such as Faraday rotation, while enabling robust determination of rotation measures(RM). For MSPs in particular, polarization studies improve timing-template fidelity and help correct frequency-dependent propagation effects that impact high-precision timing experiments. GMRT low-frequency surveys have significantly expanded the known pulsar population, yet many GMRT-discovered pulsars lack broadband polarization measurements, leaving their emission geometry and frequency-dependent profile evolution poorly constrained. We propose 21 hours of observations with the Parkes 64-m telescope using UWL receiver to conduct a spectro-polarimetric study of six GMRT-discovered pulsars: three MSPs(J1207-5050, J1227-4853, J1646-2142) and three NPs(J0514-4407, J0418-4154, J0702-4956) to conduct a spectro-polarimetric study. These targets exhibit unresolved or contradictory polarization behaviour, including profile evolution, eclipse-driven interaction signatures, incomplete detections, or absence of full-Stokes information. The proposed wideband, high-sensitivity observations will provide robust RM measurements, broadband polarization profiles, and frequency-dependent beam mapping, filling key observational gaps and enhancing the scientific value of GMRT-discovered pulsars for magnetospheric studies and pulsar timing science.

</details>

TL;DR: 该提案申请使用Parkes 64-m望远镜与UWL接收机进行21小时观测，对六颗GMRT发现的脉冲星（三颗MSP：J1207-5050、J1227-4853、J1646-2142；三颗NP：J0514-4407、J0418-4154、J0702-4956）开展分光偏振研究，以获得稳健的RM测量、宽带偏振轮廓和频率相关波束映射，填补其因缺乏宽带偏振测量而导致的观测空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脉冲星射电辐射可探测极端引力、等离子体物理与磁层过程；MSP的转动稳定性使其成为脉冲星计时阵列探测纳赫兹引力波的关键，并可用于检验广义相对论、双星演化和研究ISM；NP则可用于研究中子星内部、超新星遗迹、磁层物理、脉冲星风与glitch现象。偏振测量可约束发射几何、磁场构型与法拉第旋转等传播效应，并测定RM；对MSP还可提高计时模板保真度、校正频率相关传播效应。GMRT低频巡天扩展了已知脉冲星族群，但许多GMRT发现的脉冲星缺乏宽带偏振测量，其发射几何与频率相关轮廓演化约束不足。

Method: 申请使用Parkes 64-m望远镜搭配UWL接收机进行21小时观测，对六颗GMRT发现的脉冲星开展分光偏振研究，包括三颗MSP（J1207-5050、J1227-4853、J1646-2142）与三颗NP（J0514-4407、J0418-4154、J0702-4956）。计划进行宽带、高灵敏度观测，以获取RM测量、宽带偏振轮廓和频率相关波束映射。具体的观测频段、时间跨度、数据处理与偏振分析方法：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要主要陈述观测申请与目标特征，而非已完成的观测结果。所申请观测针对的六颗GMRT发现脉冲星表现出未分辨或相互矛盾的偏振行为，包括轮廓演化、食驱动相互作用特征、不完整探测或缺乏全Stokes信息。摘要预期所申请的宽带、高灵敏度观测将提供稳健的RM测量、宽带偏振轮廓和频率相关波束映射。摘要未报告具体测量数值、显著性或已获得的观测结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，所申请的宽带、高灵敏度观测将填补关键观测空白，并提升GMRT发现脉冲星在磁层研究和脉冲星计时科学中的科学价值。至于这些观测能否解决各目标的具体偏振行为并推广到更一般的脉冲星族群，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Pulsars are rapidly rotating, highly magnetized neutron stars whose radio emission provides unique probes of extreme gravity, plasma physics, and magnetospheric processes. Millisecond pulsars(MSPs) exhibit exceptional rotational stability, making them fundamental components of Pulsar Timing Arrays used to detect nanohertz gravitational waves, while also enabling precision tests of general relativity, binary evolution, and studies of the interstellar medium(ISM). Normal pulsars(NPs), on the other hand, serve as powerful laboratories for investigating neutron-star interiors, supernova remnants, magnetospheric physics, pulsar winds, and glitch phenomena. Their polarization measurements are crucial, as they constrain emission geometry, magnetic-field configuration, and propagation effects such as Faraday rotation, while enabling robust determination of rotation measures(RM). For MSPs in particular, polarization studies improve timing-template fidelity and help correct frequency-dependent propagation effects that impact high-precision timing experiments. GMRT low-frequency surveys have significantly expanded the known pulsar population, yet many GMRT-discovered pulsars lack broadband polarization measurements, leaving their emission geometry and frequency-dependent profile evolution poorly constrained. We propose 21 hours of observations with the Parkes 64-m telescope using UWL receiver to conduct a spectro-polarimetric study of six GMRT-discovered pulsars: three MSPs(J1207-5050, J1227-4853, J1646-2142) and three NPs(J0514-4407, J0418-4154, J0702-4956) to conduct a spectro-polarimetric study. These targets exhibit unresolved or contradictory polarization behaviour, including profile evolution, eclipse-driven interaction signatures, incomplete detections, or absence of full-Stokes information. The proposed wideband, high-sensitivity observations will provide robust RM measurements, broadband polarization profiles, and frequency-dependent beam mapping, filling key observational gaps and enhancing the scientific value of GMRT-discovered pulsars for magnetospheric studies and pulsar timing science.

</details>

*Sahoo, Sapan Kumar,Bhattacharyya, Bhaswati,Roy, Jayanta,Sharan, Rahul,Ghosh, Ankita*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案申请使用Parkes 64-m望远镜UWL接收机进行21小时观测，对六颗GMRT发现的脉冲星（三颗MSP和三颗NP）开展频谱偏振研究，这些目标存在未分辨或相互矛盾的偏振行为，观测将提供稳健的RM测量、宽带偏振轮廓和频率相关的波束测绘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GMRT低频巡天显著扩展了已知脉冲星族群，但许多GMRT发现的脉冲星缺乏宽带偏振测量，其发射几何与频率相关的轮廓演化约束很差。六颗目标脉冲星呈现未分辨或相互矛盾的偏振行为，包括轮廓演化、食驱动的相互作用特征、不完整探测或缺乏全斯托克斯信息，亟需填补观测空白。

Method: 申请使用Parkes 64-m望远镜搭配UWL接收机进行21小时观测，对六颗GMRT发现的脉冲星开展频谱偏振研究，目标包括三颗MSP（J1207-5050、J1227-4853、J1646-2142）和三颗NP（J0514-4407、J0418-4154、J0702-4956）。摘要未说明具体观测频率范围、频率分辨率、时间跨度或数据分析方法的细节。

Result: 该提案拟开展的观测旨在提供稳健的RM测量、宽带偏振轮廓以及频率相关的波束测绘。摘要未报告已获得的观测结果、数值、显著性或偏振测量结论；所描述的内容为拟议观测的预期产出。

Conclusion: 作者认为，拟议的宽带、高灵敏度观测将填补关键观测空白，并提升GMRT发现脉冲星在磁层研究和脉冲星计时科学中的科学价值；偏振研究可改善MSP的计时模板保真度并有助于校正影响高精度计时的频率相关传播效应。根据摘要无法判断具体的目标物理性质或结论。

Abstract: Pulsars are rapidly rotating, highly magnetized neutron stars whose radio emission provides unique probes of extreme gravity, plasma physics, and magnetospheric processes. Millisecond pulsars(MSPs) exhibit exceptional rotational stability, making them fundamental components of Pulsar Timing Arrays used to detect nanohertz gravitational waves, while also enabling precision tests of general relativity, binary evolution, and studies of the interstellar medium(ISM). Normal pulsars(NPs), on the other hand, serve as powerful laboratories for investigating neutron-star interiors, supernova remnants, magnetospheric physics, pulsar winds, and glitch phenomena. Their polarization measurements are crucial, as they constrain emission geometry, magnetic-field configuration, and propagation effects such as Faraday rotation, while enabling robust determination of rotation measures(RM). For MSPs in particular, polarization studies improve timing-template fidelity and help correct frequency-dependent propagation effects that impact high-precision timing experiments. GMRT low-frequency surveys have significantly expanded the known pulsar population, yet many GMRT-discovered pulsars lack broadband polarization measurements, leaving their emission geometry and frequency-dependent profile evolution poorly constrained. We propose 21 hours of observations with the Parkes 64-m telescope using UWL receiver to conduct a spectro-polarimetric study of six GMRT-discovered pulsars: three MSPs(J1207-5050, J1227-4853, J1646-2142) and three NPs(J0514-4407, J0418-4154, J0702-4956) to conduct a spectro-polarimetric study. These targets exhibit unresolved or contradictory polarization behaviour, including profile evolution, eclipse-driven interaction signatures, incomplete detections, or absence of full-Stokes information. The proposed wideband, high-sensitivity observations will provide robust RM measurements, broadband polarization profiles, and frequency-dependent beam mapping, filling key observational gaps and enhancing the scientific value of GMRT-discovered pulsars for magnetospheric studies and pulsar timing science.

</details>

We propose 21 hours of observations with the Parkes 64-m telescope using UWL receiver to conduct a spectro-polarimetric study of six GMRT-discovered pulsars: three MSPs(J1207-5050, J1227-4853, J1646-2142) and three NPs(J0514-4407, J0418-4154, J0702-4956) to conduct a spectro-polarimetric study. ### [2255] [Parkes observations for project P1362 semester 2025APRS_05]()
*Colom I Bernadich, Miquel,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Lyne, Andrew,Bailes, Matthew,Stappers, Benjamin,Cameron, Andrew,Carleo, Amodio,Perrodin, Delphine*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 针对最相对论性的银河系双中子星系统 PSR J1757-1854，作者提议用 Parkes UWL 每两个月观测以追踪脉冲轮廓演化，从而约束几何进动速率并导出到达时间，供未来探测受影响的后开普勒参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1757-1854 是最相对论性的银河系双中子星系统，其偏心率使其成为脉冲星计时引力实验的理想目标；观测其脉冲轮廓演化可用于约束几何进动速率，而几何进动与 Lense-Thirring 效应最终可能在未来十年内体现于后开普勒参数并带来两项进一步的引力检验。

Method: 摘要说明将利用 Parkes UWL 每两个月观测 PSR J1757-1854，追踪其脉冲轮廓演化并导出到达时间，以用于最终探测受影响的后开普勒参数；这些观测将加入 GBT 与（此前的）MeerKAT 的联合观测，并属于一项长期、全球性观测计划。摘要未说明具体观测频段、时间跨度、样本量或数据处理流程。

Result: 摘要报告，目前有四种可能的几何构型可以解释该脉冲星偏振摆动的时间演化；通过观测其脉冲轮廓演化可以约束几何进动速率；几何进动与 Lense-Thirring 效应最终将在未来十年内体现在后开普勒参数中，从而允许开展两项进一步的引力检验。摘要未说明已获得的测量数值、精度或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，对 PSR J1757-1854 脉冲轮廓演化的长期追踪可用于约束几何进动速率，并有望在未来十年内通过后开普勒参数实现两项进一步的引力检验；所提议的 Parkes UWL 观测将纳入与 GBT 及（此前的）MeerKAT 的联合、长期全球观测计划。根据摘要无法判断该工作与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲辐射等主题的具体联系。

Abstract: PSR J1757-1854 is the most relativistic galactic double neutron star system. Its eccentricity makes it an ideal playground for gravity experiments with pulsar timing. Via observations of its profile evolution, we can constraint its rate of geodetic precession. Currently, there are four possible geometric configurations that explain the time evolution of the polarisation swing. The geodetic precession and the Lense-Thirring effect will eventually manifest themselves in the post-Keplerian parameters within the next decade, allowing for two further tests of gravity. We propose to observe it with Parkes UWL every two months to track the profile evolution in this pulsar, and to derive times of arrival for an eventual detection of the affected Post-Keplerian parameters. These observations will be added to joint GBT and (past) MeerKAT observations, and they will be part of a long-term, global observational program of this pulsar.

</details>

Via observations of its profile evolution, we can constraint its rate of geodetic precession. Currently, there are four possible geometric configurations that explain the time evolution of the polarisation swing. The geodetic precession and the Lense-Thirring effect will eventually manifest themselves in the post-Keplerian parameters within the next decade, allowing for two further tests of gravity. We propose to observe it with Parkes UWL every two months to track the profile evolution in this pulsar, and to derive times of arrival for an eventual detection of the affected Post-Keplerian parameters. These observations will be added to joint GBT and (past) MeerKAT observations, and they will be part of a long-term, global observational program of this pulsar.

*Colom I Bernadich, Miquel,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Lyne, Andrew,Bailes, Matthew,Stappers, Benjamin,Cameron, Andrew,Carleo, Amodio,Perrodin, Delphine*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟用 Parkes UWL 每两个月观测 PSR J1757-1854，追踪其脉冲轮廓演化，以约束测地进动率，并为未来十年内后开普勒参数中可能显现的测地进动与 Lense-Thirring 效应提供 TOA，从而进行两项进一步的引力检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1757-1854 是最具相对论性的银河系双中子星系统，其偏心率使它成为引力实验的理想平台。目前有四种可能的几何构型可解释偏振摆动的时间演化，而测地进动率仍需通过轮廓演化加以约束。

Method: 摘要说明：提议用 Parkes UWL 每两个月观测 PSR J1757-1854，追踪其脉冲轮廓演化，并推导 TOA；这些观测将加入 GBT 联合观测和（过去的）MeerKAT 观测，并成为长期全球观测计划的一部分。观测频段、时间跨度与样本量摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未说明已获得的观测结果或结论。摘要仅指出：目前有四种可能的几何构型可以解释偏振摆动的时间演化；测地进动和 Lense-Thirring 效应最终将在未来十年内体现在后开普勒参数中，从而允许进行两项进一步的引力检验。

Conclusion: 摘要提出的结论是：通过轮廓演化可约束测地进动率，且测地进动与 Lense-Thirring 效应预计将在未来十年内体现于后开普勒参数中，从而提供两项进一步的引力检验；持续观测并推导 TOA 旨在最终探测受影响的这些参数。与脉冲星、磁星或 FRB 的联系：该对象为脉冲星，但摘要未涉及磁星或 FRB；根据摘要无法判断其与 FRB 的关联。

Abstract: PSR J1757-1854 is the most relativistic galactic double neutron star system. Its eccentricity makes it an ideal playground for gravity experiments with pulsar timing. Via observations of its profile evolution, we can constraint its rate of geodetic precession. Currently, there are four possible geometric configurations that explain the time evolution of the polarisation swing. The geodetic precession and the Lense-Thirring effect will eventually manifest themselves in the post-Keplerian parameters within the next decade, allowing for two further tests of gravity. We propose to observe it with Parkes UWL every two months to track the profile evolution in this pulsar, and to derive times of arrival for an eventual detection of the affected Post-Keplerian parameters. These observations will be added to joint GBT and (past) MeerKAT observations, and they will be part of a long-term, global observational program of this pulsar.

</details>


### [2260] [Parkes observations for project P885 semester 2020APRS_11]()
*Camilo, Fernando,Johnston, Simon,Sarkissian, John,Reynolds, John,Scholz, Paul,Lower, Marcus*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟以约每周一次的频率观测磁星 1E 1547.0-5408 和 PSR J1622-4950，追踪其自转、流量密度和偏振；并指出使用 UWL 对休眠 10 年后再次成为射电磁星的 XTE J1810-197 的跟踪观测，正在提供关于其射电频谱和偏振的独特测量结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 磁星中射电辐射机制仍然神秘，需要长期监测以追踪磁星的自转、流量密度和偏振；UWL 的革命性能力被寄望于为解开这些机制提供新机会。

Method: 摘要所述为一项观测提议：拟对磁星 1E 1547.0-5408 和 PSR J1622-4950 大约每周进行观测，以追踪其自转、流量密度和偏振，并延续该项目长期做法。摘要提到使用 UWL 能力和 UWL 接收机对 XTE J1810-197 进行跟踪观测。具体的望远镜、频段、时间跨度与样本细节：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告，在该项目长期跟踪的基础上，XTE J1810-197 在休眠 10 年后再次成为射电磁星；使用 UWL 接收机对其进行的观测正在提供关于其射电频谱和偏振的独特且诱人的测量结果。对 1E 1547.0-5408 和 PSR J1622-4950 的具体观测结果：摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为，UWL 的革命性能力有望为解开磁星中仍然神秘的射电辐射机制带来新机会，这一前景得到对 XTE J1810-197 近期跟踪观测的支持。该源在休眠 10 年后再次成为射电磁星，而使用 UWL 接收机的观测正在提供关于其射电频谱和偏振的独特且诱人的测量结果。至于这些结果是否能推广到单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自旋下降转矩变化或磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose to observe the magnetars 1E 1547.0-5408 and PSR J1622-4950 approximately weekly, to track their rotation, flux density, and polarisation, as we have long been doing through this project. The revolutionary UWL capabilities promise new opportunities to disentangle still mysterious radio emission mechanisms in magnetars. This promise is supported by the recent follow up of XTE J1810-197, again a radio magnetar after 10 years dormant, for which our observations with the UWL receiver are providing unique and tantalizing measurements of its radio spectrum and polarisation.

</details>

Method: 提议对磁星 1E 1547.0-5408 和 PSR J1622-4950 大约每周进行观测，以追踪它们的自转、通量密度和偏振，并延续本项目长期以来的做法；使用 UWL 接收机能力，并对 XTE J1810-197 进行跟进观测以测量其射电频谱和偏振。具体望远镜名称、观测频段、时间跨度、样本量和分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要将主要结果表述为拟议观测及其预期前景：作者计划每周追踪 1E 1547.0-5408 和 PSR J1622-4950 的自转、通量密度和偏振；并称 UWL 接收机对 XTE J1810-197 的观测正在提供其射电频谱和偏振的独特而引人入胜的测量，该源在沉寂 10 年后再次成为射电磁星。摘要未给出具体数值、误差或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为 UWL 的革命性能力有望为厘清磁星中仍然神秘的射电发射机制带来新机遇，并以 XTE J1810-197 的 UWL 跟进观测作为支持。由此看，该提案的科学意义在于通过对磁星自转、通量密度和偏振的持续追踪以及频谱与偏振测量，推动对磁星射电发射机制的理解；所涉具体物理机制则根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose to observe the magnetars 1E 1547.0-5408 and PSR J1622-4950 approximately weekly, to track their rotation, flux density, and polarisation, as we have long been doing through this project. The revolutionary UWL capabilities promise new opportunities to disentangle still mysterious radio emission mechanisms in magnetars. This promise is supported by the recent follow up of XTE J1810-197, again a radio magnetar after 10 years dormant, for which our observations with the UWL receiver are providing unique and tantalizing measurements of its radio spectrum and polarisation.

</details>

Abstract: We propose to observe the magnetars 1E 1547.0-5408 and PSR J1622-4950 approximately weekly, to track their rotation, flux density, and polarisation, as we have long been doing through this project. The revolutionary UWL capabilities promise new opportunities to disentangle still mysterious radio emission mechanisms in magnetars. This promise is supported by the recent follow up of XTE J1810-197, again a radio magnetar after 10 years dormant, for which our observations with the UWL receiver are providing unique and tantalizing measurements of its radio spectrum and polarisation.

</details>


### [2282] [Ultralight dark matter constraints from nano-Hertz gravitational waves](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.15292)
*Tiruvaskar, Shreyas,Boey, Russell,Easther, Richard,Gordon, Chris*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该文用当前脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）测量限制超轻暗物质（ULDM），给出 ULDM 粒子质量中位数为 $7\times10^{-22}\ \mathrm{eV}$，并指出该限制允许的较低 ULDM 分数与其它限制一致，未来脉冲星计时测量可灵敏探测 ULDM 对宇宙暗物质含量的贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ULDM 会形成带致密中心孤子的星系晕，从而增加双 SMBH 所受阻力，缩短并合时标并可能抑制其低频引力辐射。摘要指出，需要利用当前的 PTA 测量来限制 ULDM 粒子质量及其占宇宙暗物质含量的分数，以检验这一模型。

Method: 摘要说明：发展了描述 SMBH 双星在 ULDM 晕中衰减的半解析模型，并使用当前的脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）测量来限制 ULDM 粒子质量及其对宇宙暗物质含量的分数贡献。具体观测数据、望远镜、频段、时间跨度、样本大小与统计方法：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：ULDM 粒子质量的中位数为 $7\times10^{-22}\ \mathrm{eV}$；标度关系提示该阻力在相对较低的 ULDM 分数下仍然有效；这些分数与对该模型的所有其他限制一致。ULDM 会增加双 SMBH 所受阻力、缩短并合时标，并可能抑制双星在低频处的引力辐射。

Conclusion: 作者认为，这一模型结合当前 PTA 测量可限制 ULDM 粒子质量及其对宇宙暗物质含量的分数贡献，并且结论是：未来的脉冲星计时测量将成为探测 ULDM 对宇宙总体暗物质含量所作任何贡献的灵敏探针。关于该结果是否可推广到脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲发射、快速射电暴等具体现象：根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We investigate the impact of ultralight dark matter (ULDM) on the mergers of supermassive black holes (SMBH) and the resulting stochastic gravitational wave background. ULDM is based on exceptionally light particles and yields galactic halos with dense central solitons. This increases the drag experienced by binary SMBH, decreasing merger times and potentially suppressing gravitational radiation from the binary at low frequencies. We develop semianalytic models for the decay of SMBH binaries in ULDM halos and use current pulsar timing array (PTA) measurements to constrain the ULDM particle mass and its fractional contribution to the dark matter content of the universe. We find a median ULDM particle mass of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mn>7</mml:mn><mml:mo>×</mml:mo><mml:msup><mml:mn>10</mml:mn><mml:mrow><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:mn>22</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msup><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>eV</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> and show that scaling relations suggest that the drag remains effective at relatively low ULDM fractions, which are consistent with all other constraints on the model. Consequently, future pulsar timing measurements will be a sensitive probe of any ULDM contribution to the overall dark matter content of the Universe.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 磁星是拥有强磁场并快速自转的中子星，观测其射电脉冲具有重大科学意义；摘要指出该项目旨在推进对磁星磁场结构、辐射机制和偏振现象的理解。摘要未说明具体的知识空白。

Conclusion: 作者明确提出，该项目将显著推动对磁星磁场结构、辐射机制和偏振现象的理解。这是摘要中陈述的科学意义；由于尚未报告探测或分析结果，对SGR J1833-0832的具体物理性质根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Magnetars are neutron stars with intense magnetic fields that undergo rapid rotation. The observation of their radio pulses carries great scientific significance. With the high sensitivity and wide frequency coverage of the Parkes telescope, we propose to search for radio pulse signals of the magnetar SGR J1833-0832 and (if detected) conduct a detailed analysis of its pulse characteristics, radio flux density, and polarization. This project will contribute significantly to advancing our understanding of magnetars' magnetic field structure, radiation mechanisms, and polarization phenomena.

</details>

### [2286] [Parkes observations for project P1362 semester 2025OCTS_02]()
*Colom I Bernadich, Miquel,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Lyne, Andrew,Bailes, Matthew,Stappers, Benjamin,Cameron, Andrew,Carleo, Amodio,Perrodin, Delphine*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请提出对最具相对论性的银河系双中子星系统 PSR J1757-1854 进行一次最大积分约 8 小时的偏振观测，并加入全球计时 campaign，以限制其测地进动速率，并为未来十年内两项进一步的引力检验作准备。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1757-1854 是最具相对论性的银河系双中子星系统，其高偏心率使其非常适合用脉冲星计时开展引力实验。当前需要通过脉冲轮廓演化来限制其测地进动速率，且偏振摆动的时间演化存在四种可能的几何构型，因此需要更多偏振观测；同时，测地进动与 Lense-Thirring 效应预计将在未来十年内体现于 post-Keplerian 参数中。

Method: 摘要说明将进行一次观测，最大积分时间约为 LST 时间所允许的 8 小时；将检查该观测的偏振性质，并把 ToAs 加入全球计时 campaign，这些观测将加入 GBT 与（过去的）MeerKAT 联合观测，并属于该脉冲星的长期全球观测计划。具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本及统计分析细节，摘要未说明。

Result: 这是一份观测申请，摘要未报告已完成的观测结果或测量数值。摘要陈述的是：PSR J1757-1854 是最具相对论性的银河系双中子星系统；其偏心率使其适合脉冲星计时引力实验；通过脉冲轮廓演化可限制测地进动速率；目前有四种可能的几何构型可解释偏振摆动的时间演化；测地进动与 Lense-Thirring 效应最终将在未来十年内体现于 post-Keplerian 参数中。

Conclusion: 作者提出的结论是：对 PSR J1757-1854 的偏振观测与计时可限制其测地进动速率，并有助于区分解释偏振摆动时间演化的四种可能几何构型；测地进动与 Lense-Thirring 效应预计将在未来十年内体现于 post-Keplerian 参数中，从而允许进行两项进一步的引力检验。该观测将纳入长期全球观测计划。关于这些结果与脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）相关现象的物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: PSR J1757-1854 is the most relativistic galactic double neutron star system. Its eccentricity makes it an ideal playground for gravity experiments with pulsar timing. Via observations of its profile evolution, we can constraint its rate of geodetic precession. Currently, there are four possible geometric configurations that explain the time evolution of the polarisation swing. The geodetic precession and the Lense-Thirring effect will eventually manifest themselves in the post-Keplerian parameters within the next decade, allowing for two further tests of gravity. We propose a single observation with a maximum integration of ~8 hours allowed by LST time for this semester. We will inspect the polarisation properties of this observation, and we will add the ToAs to a global timing campaign. These observations will be added to joint GBT and (past) MeerKAT observations, and they will be part of a long-term, global observational program of this pulsar.

</details>

Via observations of its profile evolution, we can constraint its rate of geodetic precession. Currently, there are four possible geometric configurations that explain the time evolution of the polarisation swing. The geodetic precession and the Lense-Thirring effect will eventually manifest themselves in the post-Keplerian parameters within the next decade, allowing for two further tests of gravity. We will inspect the polarisation properties of this observation, and we will add the ToAs to a global timing campaign. These observations will be added to joint GBT and (past) MeerKAT observations, and they will be part of a long-term, global observational program of this pulsar.

### [2288] [Parkes observations for project P1177 semester 2023APRS_06]()
*Ahmad, Adeel,Filipovic, Miroslav,Dai, Shi,Barnes, Luke*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划用 Parkes 对高银纬毫秒脉冲星 J1947–18 进行计时，因为重新处理 Parkes 存档数据（P1059）显示它并非此前认为的孤立脉冲星，而是处于双星系统中，从而可确认该系统性质并测量其自旋与轨道参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: J1947–18 此前被认定为孤立毫秒脉冲星，但在重新处理 Parkes 存档数据（P1059）时发现它处于双星系统中。该脉冲星最初发现于南天高时间分辨率宇宙脉冲星巡天的中、高银纬部分存档数据，周期 2.60 ms、DM 25 pc cm-3。需要确认这一潜在双星系统的性质。

Method: 摘要提出利用 Parkes 非银道面观测时间对该高银纬毫秒脉冲星 J1947–18 进行计时，以确认其潜在双星系统性质并测量自旋与轨道参数。该脉冲星是在南天高时间分辨率宇宙脉冲星巡天中、高银纬部分的存档数据中发现的；摘要提及此前对 Parkes 存档数据（项目代码 P1059）的重新处理。具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本量与分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：J1947–18 此前被认定为孤立脉冲星，但重新处理 Parkes 存档数据（P1059）后发现其处于双星系统中。该脉冲星最初发现于南天高时间分辨率宇宙脉冲星巡天的中、高银纬部分存档数据，其自转周期为 2.60 ms，DM 为 25 pc cm-3。摘要未给出确认双星性质或测量自旋与轨道参数的结果，因为这些观测尚属提议。

Conclusion: 摘要提出，利用 Parkes 非银道面观测时间确认该潜在双星系统性质并测量其自旋与轨道参数，这些信息可能为测量中子星质量、检验引力理论以及研究高银纬毫秒脉冲星的形成通道带来新机会。上述可能的科学回报均为摘要所述的可能性，并非已确立结论。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射的具体物理联系。

Abstract: We propose to time a high Galactic latitude millisecond pulsar, J1947-18, which was previously identified as isolated. ### [2296] [Parkes observations for project P455 semester 2023APRS_03]()
*Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Manchester, Dick,Kramer, Michael,McLaughlin, Maura,Deller, Adam,Stairs, Ingrid,Coles, William,Lorimer, Duncan Ross,Ferdman, Robert,Wex, Norbert,Hu, Huanchen*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 本项目继续对首个双脉冲星系统开展计时与脉冲轮廓研究，目标是为广义相对论提供迄今最强检验并首次测量中子星转动惯量，同时通过测地进动确定系统几何并绘制脉冲星波束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 首个双脉冲星系统是引力物理学的独特实验室；此前发表的53页 Phys. Rev. X 论文（Kramer et al., December 2021）已首次测量高阶光传播效应和轨道相对论形变，并凸显长期观测campaign（包括VLBI观测）对该系统的重要性，因此需要继续推进相关研究。

Result: 摘要回顾了已发表成果：在 Phys. Rev. X 的 53 页论文（Kramer et al., 2021 年 12 月）中首次测量了高阶光传播效应以及轨道的相对论形变。摘要同时指出，这些结果凸显了长期观测 campaña（包括 VLBI 观测）对该系统的重要性。摘要未给出具体数值、不确定度或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者提出的目标是：为广义相对论提供迄今最强的检验，首次测量中子星的惯性矩，并通过测地进动确定系统几何结构、绘制脉冲星波束，同时利用 UWL 接收机的高灵敏度和宽带宽。上述目标本身即为该提案所陈述的科学意义；是否与脉冲星计时、单脉冲、磁星或快速射电暴等具体现象存在联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: This project is to continue timing and profile studies of the first double-pulsar system, a unique laboratory for gravitational physics. Important results published in our 53-page Phys. Rev. X paper (Kramer et al., December 2021) include the first measurements of higher-order light-propagation effects and of the relativistic deformation of the orbit and highlight the importance of a long term observational campaign, including VLBI observations, for this remarkable system. The main aims of this proposal are to provide the strongest tests to date for general relativity and to measure for the first time the moment-of-inertia of a neutron star. Additionally, we will determine the system geometry and map the pulsar beams via geodetic precession. We will exploit the high sensitivity and broad bandwidth of the UWL receiver.

</details>

### [2308] [Parkes observations for project P116 semester 2024APRS_02]()
*Lower, Marcus,Johnston, Simon*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划在 2024 年近星点通过期间，利用 Ultra-Wideband Low 接收机系统对 PSR B1259-63/LS 2883 开展每日节奏观测，以精确绘制 LS 2883 星风在脉冲星冲入星周盘前后的带电粒子密度与磁场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR B1259-63/LS 2883 是三十多年前发现、至今仍最适合回答基本问题的双星脉冲星系统，涉及大质量恒星星风的结构和起源，以及双星伴星是否为重复 FRB 源中极端光谱偏振变化的来源；摘要指出该提案旨在借助即将到来的近星点通过回答这些问题。

Method: 摘要说明将在 2024 年近星点通过期间，使用 Ultra-Wideband Low 接收机系统对 PSR B1259-63 开展每日节奏观测行动，以绘制 LS 2883 星风在脉冲星冲入星周盘前后的带电粒子密度与磁场。更具体的望远镜、频段、时间跨度、样本与分析方法：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要仅提出即将开展的观测计划：在 2024 年近星点通过期间以每日节奏观测 PSR B1259-63，目标是在脉冲星冲入 LS 2883 星周盘之前和之后精确绘制星风的带电粒子密度与磁场。摘要未报告任何实际观测结果、数量、趋势或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者提出，这一每日节奏观测行动将使他们能够精确绘制 LS 2883 星风的带电粒子密度与磁场，并据此回答大质量恒星星风的结构和起源，以及双星伴星是否为重复 FRB 源中极端光谱偏振变化来源等问题。这是提案计划的预期目标，而非已取得的观测结论；其余物理推断根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Radio pulsars in orbit around high-mass main-sequence stellar companions offer a rich source of extreme physics for both observational astronomers and theorists alike. First discovered over 30 years ago, PSR B1259-63/LS 2883 remains the best system that to answer fundamental questions such as: What is the structure and origin of the stellar winds of high-mass stars? Are binary companions the source of extreme spectropolarimetric variations in repeating FRB sources? In this proposal, we will conduct an unprecedented daily-cadence observing campaign on PSR B1259-63 with the Ultra-Wideband Low receiver system throughout the upcoming 2024 periastron passage. This will allow us to precisely map the charged particle density and magnetic field of the stellar wind from LS 2883 before and after the pulsar plunges through its circumstellar disc, and thereby answer the above questions.

</details>

Result: 摘要未说明已获得的观测结果。摘要仅陈述提案计划：开展前所未有的每日节奏观测，以精确绘制LS 2883恒星风在脉冲星冲入其星周盘之前和之后的带电粒子密度与磁场。未给出任何数值、显著性、偏振、频谱或脉冲轮廓结果。

Conclusion: 作者明确提出的科学目标是，通过精确定位LS 2883恒星风的带电粒子密度与磁场，回答大质量恒星风的结构与起源问题，以及双星伴星是否为重复FRB源极端分光偏振变化的来源这一问题。上述问题是否得到解答，根据摘要无法判断；摘要未报告任何已完成的分析或结论。

Abstract: Radio pulsars in orbit around high-mass main-sequence stellar companions offer a rich source of extreme physics for both observational astronomers and theorists alike. First discovered over 30 years ago, PSR B1259-63/LS 2883 remains the best system that to answer fundamental questions such as: What is the structure and origin of the stellar winds of high-mass stars? Are binary companions the source of extreme spectropolarimetric variations in repeating FRB sources? In this proposal, we will conduct an unprecedented daily-cadence observing campaign on PSR B1259-63 with the Ultra-Wideband Low receiver system throughout the upcoming 2024 periastron passage. This will allow us to precisely map the charged particle density and magnetic field of the stellar wind from LS 2883 before and after the pulsar plunges through its circumstellar disc, and thereby answer the above questions.

</details>

### [2312] [String-induced vacuum decay and its gravitational wave signatures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.27579)
*Chatrchyan, Aleksandr,Niedermann, Florian,Richman-Taylor, Phoebe*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该工作推导出由宇宙弦催化的拉长气泡反弹解（具有 \(O(2)\times O(2)\) 对称性），给出了宇宙弦量子衰变的明确机制，并初步讨论了相关引力波信号与脉冲星计时阵列随机信号的可能联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 假真空衰变通常被视为通过 \(O(4)\) 对称球形气泡成核进行的过程；本文关注的问题是，宇宙弦的存在能否催化这一衰变过程。摘要并未进一步说明该问题的具体观测背景或知识空白，仅指出要在文献已有结果基础上考察这一替代衰变通道。

Method: 摘要说明考虑一个在整体或局域 \(U(1)\) 对称性下带荷的复标量场，并假设存在非平庸的真空流形，例如可在简单的六次势中实现；据此推导具有 \(O(2)\times O(2)\) 对称性的相对论性反弹解，并识别真空衰变主要通过该通道进行的参数空间区域。摘要未说明具体的观测、仪器、频段、时间跨度、样本或统计分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告推导出具有 \(O(2)\times O(2)\) 对称性的相对论性反弹解，对应于由同一标量场的宇宙弦所催生的拉长气泡；并确定了真空衰变主要通过这一替代通道进行的参数空间区域。摘要还给出对这一类真空衰变相关引力波信号的初步讨论及其与脉冲星计时阵列中最近观测到的随机信号之间可能联系的讨论。具体数值、显著性及其他定量结果摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为，所识别的参数空间区域为宇宙弦的量子衰变提供了一个明确的机制。对于该类真空衰变相关的引力波信号及其与脉冲星计时阵列中最近观测到的随机信号之间的联系，摘要仅表述为初步讨论和可能联系，未给出确定结论；具体的物理解释根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: False vacuum decay typically proceeds via the nucleation of spherical bubbles of true vacuum, described by <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>O</mml:mi><mml:mo>(</mml:mo><mml:mn>4</mml:mn><mml:mo>)</mml:mo></mml:math></inline-formula> symmetric field configurations in Euclidean time. In this work, we investigate how the presence of cosmic strings can catalyze the decay process. To this end, we consider a complex scalar field charged under a global or local <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>U</mml:mi><mml:mo>(</mml:mo><mml:mn>1</mml:mn><mml:mo>)</mml:mo></mml:math></inline-formula> symmetry. Assuming a nontrivial vacuum manifold, realizable for example in a simple sextic potential, we derive relativistic bounce solutions with <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>O</mml:mi><mml:mo>(</mml:mo><mml:mn>2</mml:mn><mml:mo>)</mml:mo><mml:mo>×</mml:mo><mml:mi>O</mml:mi><mml:mo>(</mml:mo><mml:mn>2</mml:mn><mml:mo>)</mml:mo></mml:math></inline-formula> symmetry, corresponding to elongated bubbles seeded by a cosmic string of the same scalar field. Building up on earlier results in the literature, we identify the region of parameter space where vacuum decay predominantly proceeds via this alternative channel, thereby providing an explicit mechanism for the quantum decay of cosmic strings. Finally, we present an initial discussion of the gravitational wave signal associated with this type of vacuum decay and its possible connection to the recently observed stochastic signal in pulsar timing arrays.

</details>


### [2313] [Parkes observations for project P1054 semester 2020OCTS_04]()
*Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Freire, Paulo,Weltevrede, Patrick,Stappers, Benjamin,Keane, Evan,Levin, Lina,Buchner, Sarah,Joseph, Tana,Boettcher, Markus,Wex, Norbert,Deneva, Julia,Breton, Rene,Ridolfi, Alessandro,Cognard, Ismaël,Grießmeier, Jean-Mathias*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案申请利用 Parkes 望远镜 UWL 接收机对 TRAPUM 巡天潜在新发现脉冲星开展触发式后续计时观测，预计该巡天下一学期在超新星遗迹、脉冲星风云和 Fermi 未认证点源方向发现约 10 颗新脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TRAPUM 巡天观测最近才开始，预计在即将到来的运行学期会发现约 10 颗新脉冲星；需要后续计时观测来充分挖掘这些潜在发现的科学价值，因为精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数有助于理解极端环境中的物理以及整体中子星族群。由于撰写时尚无目标列表，需要一种可触发的观测申请方式。

Method: 摘要说明这是一份为 Parkes 项目 P1054 semester 2020OCTS_04 提交的 NAPA 提案，计划在发现感兴趣的新脉冲星后立即触发；观测使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机；目标来自 TRAPUM（TRAnsients and PUlsars with Meerkat）巡天，观测方式为指向超新星遗迹、脉冲星风云和 Fermi 未认证点源的定向指向观测；分析手段包括计时观测以测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数。具体频率、频段、时间跨度、样本大小和统计方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未报告已完成的观测结果或新发现，而是说明 TRAPUM 巡天的观测最近已经开始，预计在即将到来的运行学期中发现约 10 颗新脉冲星；这些预期发现来自指向超新星遗迹、脉冲星风云和 Fermi 未认证点源的定向观测。摘要指出计时观测可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，并称 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机将使其能够对 TRAPUM 发现的亮端进行成功计时。尚无具体脉冲星、参数数值或显著性结果。

Conclusion: 摘要明确表述的结论是：计时观测对于充分发挥任何脉冲星发现的潜力至关重要，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而帮助改进对极端环境中物理以及整体中子星族群的理解；Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机将使其能够对 TRAPUM 发现的亮端成功计时。根据摘要无法判断该提案是否已实施、预期发现是否实现，以及对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、模式转换、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱、暂现射电或磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）联系的直接适用性。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time for a follow-up campaign of potential new discoveries from the TRAPUM (TRAnsients and PUlsars with Meerkat) survey, whiose observations are recently started. About 10 new pulsars are expected to be found during the upcoming semester of operations, in targeted pointings towards supernova remnants, pulsar wind nebulae and Fermi unidentified point sources. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that will allow us to successfully time the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries. Since we do not have a target list at the time of writing, we are submitting a NAPA proposal, for this semester, to be triggered as soon as a new pulsar of interest is discovered.

</details>

Method: 摘要说明这是一份 NAPA 提案，申请在发现感兴趣的新脉冲星后立即触发的后续观测时间；观测目标为 TRAPUM 巡天在指向超新星遗迹、脉冲星风云和 Fermi 未识别点源的定点观测中的潜在新发现；计时观测将用于测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，并使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机对 TRAPUM 发现中较亮的一端进行计时。观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本量、具体分析流程摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者提出的结论是：计时观测对充分发挥脉冲星发现的潜力至关重要，可实现自转、天体测量和轨道参数的精确测量，从而有助于理解极端环境中的物理以及中子星总体族群；Parkes 的 UWL 接收机适合对 TRAPUM 发现中较亮的一端进行计时，因此申请以 NAPA 形式在该学期内一旦发现感兴趣的新脉冲星即触发观测。摘要未给出已完成观测所支持的物理结论，也未说明与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、单脉冲、模式转换或偏振的具体联系；根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time for a follow-up campaign of potential new discoveries from the TRAPUM (TRAnsients and PUlsars with Meerkat) survey, whiose observations are recently started. About 10 new pulsars are expected to be found during the upcoming semester of operations, in targeted pointings towards supernova remnants, pulsar wind nebulae and Fermi unidentified point sources. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that will allow us to successfully time the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries. Since we do not have a target list at the time of writing, we are submitting a NAPA proposal, for this semester, to be triggered as soon as a new pulsar of interest is discovered.

### [2316] [Parkes observations for project P1054 semester 2020OCTS_01]()

Motivation: TRAPUM 巡天观测最近才开始，预计在即将到来的运行学期中通过指向超新星遗迹、脉冲星风云和 Fermi 未识别点源发现约 10 颗新脉冲星。计时观测对充分利用脉冲星发现至关重要，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而增进对极端环境物理和中子星群体的理解。由于撰写时没有目标列表，需要以 NAPA 方式申请可触发观测时间。

Method: 摘要说明这是一份针对 Parkes 望远镜 UWL 接收机的 NAPA 申请，将在 TRAPUM 巡天发现感兴趣的新脉冲星后触发后续计时观测；TRAPUM 的定向观测指向超新星遗迹、脉冲星风云和 Fermi 未识别点源。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本细节及分析流程。

Result: 摘要未说明：这是一份申请类摘要，未报告已完成的观测结果。其明确陈述的是预期性内容：TRAPUM 巡天观测最近已开始，预计在即将到来的运行学期中发现约 10 颗新脉冲星；Parkes 的 UWL 接收机将用于对 TRAPUM 发现的亮端进行计时。

Conclusion: 作者主张计时观测对发挥脉冲星发现的全部潜力具有关键作用，能精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而有助于理解极端环境物理与中子星整体群体；Parkes 的 UWL 接收机灵敏且多用途，可成功计时 TRAPUM 发现的亮端。该文未给出关于脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴的具体物理结论；根据摘要无法判断其与单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱、暂现射电发射或磁星–FRB 联系的可迁移性。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time for a follow-up campaign of potential new discoveries from the TRAPUM (TRAnsients and PUlsars with Meerkat) survey, whiose observations are recently started. About 10 new pulsars are expected to be found during the upcoming semester of operations, in targeted pointings towards supernova remnants, pulsar wind nebulae and Fermi unidentified point sources. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that will allow us to successfully time the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries. Since we do not have a target list at the time of writing, we are submitting a NAPA proposal, for this semester, to be triggered as soon as a new pulsar of interest is discovered.

</details>

### [2319] [Parkes observations for project P885 semester 2018APRS_09]()
*Camilo, Fernando,Johnston, Simon,Sarkissian, John,Reynolds, John,Scholz, Paul*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提议拟每周观测两颗仍在射电波段脉冲发射的磁星 PSR J1622-4950 与 1E1547.0-5408，追踪其自转、流量密度和偏振，并较低频次监测 XTE J1810-197 以留意其射电脉冲复苏，从而获得力矩的连续记录。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已知有三颗磁星目前发射射电脉冲，其中两颗需要连续追踪其自转、流量密度与偏振；此外 XTE J1810-197 曾发射射电脉冲，而 PSR J1622-4950 已在休眠超过 2 年后于 2017 年 4 月重新开启，因此有必要监测其可能的复苏，并借此研究磁星磁层动力学与射电发射条件。

Method: 摘要说明将每周观测 PSR J1622-4950 和 1E1547.0-5408，较低频次监测 XTE J1810-197；追踪内容包括自转、流量密度和偏振，并由此获得力矩的连续记录。观测项目为 Parkes 项目 P885，2018APRS 学期。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度、望远镜细节及数据分析方法细节。

Result: 摘要未说明本提议已取得的观测结果。摘要给出的既有事实是：已知目前在射电波段发射脉冲的三颗磁星中包括 PSR J1622-4950 和 1E1547.0-5408；XTE J1810-197 过去曾发射射电脉冲；PSR J1622-4950 在休眠超过 2 年后于 2017 年 4 月重新开启。摘要未报告流量密度、偏振或力矩的具体测量值。

Conclusion: 作者明确提出的目标是：更好地理解磁星磁层的动力学行为，确定其中射电发射发生的条件，并刻画磁星可变的射电发射以对发射机制施加限制；这些机制至少在某些方面不同于普通脉冲星的发射机制。摘要指出这些观测将产生力矩的连续记录，从而揭示磁能的持续释放。至于磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）之间的具体联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose to observe PSR J1622-4950 and 1E1547.0-5408 weekly, two of three magnetars known to currently emit radio pulsations, to track their rotation, flux density, and polarisation. Less frequently we will monitor XTE J1810-197, which used to emit radio pulsations, to be on the lookout for its revival - as just happened with PSR J1622-4950, which turned on in April 2017 after more than 2 years dormant! These observations yield a continuous record of torque, illuminating the continued release of magnetic energy. Our broader aims are to develop a better understanding of the dynamical behaviour of magnetar magnetospheres, and to establish the conditions under which radio emission takes place therein, in addition to characterising their variable radio emission in order to place constraints on the emission mechanisms, which in at least some respects differ from those of ordinary pulsars.

</details>

These observations yield a continuous record of torque, illuminating the continued release of magnetic energy. Our broader aims are to develop a better understanding of the dynamical behaviour of magnetar magnetospheres, and to establish the conditions under which radio emission takes place therein, in addition to characterising their variable radio emission in order to place constraints on the emission mechanisms, which in at least some respects differ from those of ordinary pulsars.

TL;DR: 该提案拟每周观测磁星 PSR J1622-4950 和 1E1547.0-5408，以追踪其自转、流量密度和偏振，并较低频次监测 XTE J1810-197 以寻找其射电脉冲复苏，从而获得连续的力矩记录并研究磁星磁层动力学与射电辐射机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已知会发出射电脉冲的三颗磁星中，两颗需要持续追踪，另一颗曾发出射电脉冲但当前状态不明，且 PSR J1622-4950 在休眠超过 2 年后于 2017 年 4 月重新开启，说明其射电活动可能复苏。摘要指出，需要连续记录以揭示磁能的持续释放，并理解磁星磁层的动力学行为及射电辐射发生的条件。

Method: 摘要说明拟每周观测 PSR J1622-4950 和 1E1547.0-5408，并以较低频次监测 XTE J1810-197，用于追踪自转、流量密度和偏振并搜寻射电脉冲复苏。题目提及 Parkes 观测与项目 P885 semester 2018APRS_16。观测频段、时间跨度、样本量及具体分析流程摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告，PSR J1622-4950 在休眠超过 2 年之后于 2017 年 4 月重新开启；1E1547.0-5408 和 PSR J1622-4950 是目前已知会发出射电脉冲的三颗磁星中的两颗；XTE J1810-197 曾发出射电脉冲。摘要提出这些观测将产生连续的力矩记录，揭示磁能的持续释放，但未给出具体测量数值或统计结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，通过追踪这些磁星的自转、流量密度和偏振，可以获得连续的力矩记录，从而揭示磁能的持续释放，并有助于理解磁星磁层的动力学行为、确定其中发生射电辐射的条件，以及刻画其变化的射电辐射以限制辐射机制，这些机制至少在若干方面不同于普通脉冲星。根据摘要无法判断具体的辐射机制或与快速射电暴的联系。

Abstract: We propose to observe PSR J1622-4950 and 1E1547.0-5408 weekly, two of three magnetars known to currently emit radio pulsations, to track their rotation, flux density, and polarisation. Less frequently we will monitor XTE J1810-197, which used to emit radio pulsations, to be on the lookout for its revival - as just happened with PSR J1622-4950, which turned on in April 2017 after more than 2 years dormant! These observations yield a continuous record of torque, illuminating the continued release of magnetic energy. Our broader aims are to develop a better understanding of the dynamical behaviour of magnetar magnetospheres, and to establish the conditions under which radio emission takes place therein, in addition to characterising their variable radio emission in order to place constraints on the emission mechanisms, which in at least some respects differ from those of ordinary pulsars.

</details>

Less frequently we will monitor XTE J1810-197, which used to emit radio pulsations, to be on the lookout for its revival - as just happened with PSR J1622-4950, which turned on in April 2017 after more than 2 years dormant! These observations yield a continuous record of torque, illuminating the continued release of magnetic energy. Our broader aims are to develop a better understanding of the dynamical behaviour of magnetar magnetospheres, and to establish the conditions under which radio emission takes place therein, in addition to characterising their variable radio emission in order to place constraints on the emission mechanisms, which in at least some respects differ from those of ordinary pulsars.

Result: 摘要未说明已获得的观测结果。摘要明确报告的相关背景是：PSR J1622-4950 在休眠超过 2 年之后于 2017 年重新开启射电脉冲；XTE J1810-197 过去曾发射射电脉冲，因此值得监测其复苏。摘要还提出这些观测将产生对力矩的连续记录，揭示磁能的持续释放。

Conclusion: 作者的明确目标是更好地理解磁星磁层的动力学行为，确定其中发生射电发射的条件，并表征其变化的射电发射以对发射机制施加约束，指出这些机制至少在某些方面不同于普通脉冲星。上述物理图像能否推广到其他磁星、脉冲星或 FRB，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose to observe PSR J1622-4950 and 1E1547.0-5408 weekly, two of three magnetars known to currently emit radio pulsations, to track their rotation, flux density, and polarisation. Less frequently we will monitor XTE J1810-197, which used to emit radio pulsations, to be on the lookout for its revival - as recently happened with PSR J1622-4950, which turned on in 2017 after more than 2 years dormant! These observations yield a continuous record of torque, illuminating the continued release of magnetic energy. Our broader aims are to develop a better understanding of the dynamical behaviour of magnetar magnetospheres, and to establish the conditions under which radio emission takes place therein, in addition to characterising their variable radio emission in order to place constraints on the emission mechanisms, which in at least some respects differ from those of ordinary pulsars.

</details>

Method: 对 PSR J1622-4950 和 1E1547.0-5408 进行每周观测，以追踪其自转、流量密度和偏振；对 XTE J1810-197 进行较低频率的监测，以留意其复活。摘要未说明具体望远镜名称、观测频段、时间跨度、样本量或分析方法。

Result: 摘要提出对 PSR J1622-4950 和 1E1547.0-5408 的每周观测以及对 XTE J1810-197 的较不频繁监测，以追踪自转、流量密度和偏振，并留意 XTE J1810-197 的复活；摘要提到 PSR J1622-4950 在休眠超过 2 年后于 2017 年重新开启。摘要未说明具体观测结果、数值、统计显著性或射电发射探测。

Conclusion: 这些观测将产生连续的力矩记录，揭示磁能的持续释放；更广泛的目标是更好地理解磁星磁层的动力学行为，确定其中发生射电发射的条件，并表征其变化的射电发射以对发射机制施加限制，这些机制至少在某些方面不同于普通脉冲星的发射机制。与快速射电暴（FRB）的联系：根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose to observe PSR J1622-4950 and 1E1547.0-5408 weekly, two of three magnetars known to currently emit radio pulsations, to track their rotation, flux density, and polarisation. Less frequently we will monitor XTE J1810-197, which used to emit radio pulsations, to be on the lookout for its revival - as recently happened with PSR J1622-4950, which turned on in 2017 after more than 2 years dormant! These observations yield a continuous record of torque, illuminating the continued release of magnetic energy. Our broader aims are to develop a better understanding of the dynamical behaviour of magnetar magnetospheres, and to establish the conditions under which radio emission takes place therein, in addition to characterising their variable radio emission in order to place constraints on the emission mechanisms, which in at least some respects differ from those of ordinary pulsars.

</details>

### [2348] [Parkes observations for project P1364 semester 2025APRS_02]()
*Squillace, Reynier,Ransom, Scott,Mostow, Olivia*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划使用 Murriyang 64m Parkes 射电望远镜的 UWL 接收机对银河系平面内三颗强偏振脉冲星进行 4 个指向、共 10 小时的观测，以尝试探测造成计时噪声的色散色差；未探测则将对 IISM 中的磁场强度和电子密度给出上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IISM 对脉冲星的传播效应尚未被很好地理解，并增加了脉冲星计时测量的不确定性。高精度脉冲星计时对于利用脉冲星探测引力波和中子星自转突变等现象至关重要，因此需要改进对这些传播效应的理解。其中色散色差会造成计时噪声，但迄今仅被探测到过一次。

Method: 摘要提出使用 Murriyang 64m Parkes 射电望远镜的 Ultrawide bandwidth Low frequency receiver（UWL）进行 4 个指向的观测，总计 10 小时望远镜时间。三个目标均为银河系平面内强偏振的脉冲星，选择目标是最大化探测到两类色散色差中一种或两种的机会。摘要未说明具体的观测频率、时间跨度、分析流程及统计方法。

Result: 摘要未报告已取得的观测结果；文中说明色散色差会造成计时噪声且迄今仅被探测到过一次。所提出的观测旨在探测两类色散色差中的一种或两种，并指出未探测将给出 IISM 中磁场强度和电子密度的上限。摘要未给出任何数值上限、灵敏度或显著性结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出的观测若探测到色散色差，将有助于理解 IISM 的传播效应及其对脉冲星计时噪声的贡献；若未探测到，则可对 IISM 中的磁场强度和电子密度给出上限。这些结果对高精度脉冲星计时具有潜在意义，但摘要尚未给出实际结论。根据摘要无法判断色散色差的具体物理机制及其与磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）的联系。

Abstract: The propagation effects of the ionized interstellar medium (IISM) on pulsars are not well understood, and increase uncertainty on pulsar timing measurements. As high-precision pulsar timing is critical for using pulsars to detect phenomena as varied as gravitational waves and neutron star glitches, it is important to improve our understanding of these propagation effects. One such effect is chromatic dispersion, which contributes to timing noise but has been detected only once. We propose a set of 4 pointings with the Murriyang 64m Parkes Radio Telescope Ultra-Wide bandwidth Low frequency receiver (UWL), totaling 10 hours of telescope time. Our three targets are all strongly polarized pulsars in the Galactic plane, selected to maximize our chances of detecting one or both of the two types of chromatic dispersion. Non-detections will place upper limits on magnetic field strength and electron density in the IISM.

</details>

Non-detections will place upper limits on magnetic field strength and electron density in the IISM.

As high-precision pulsar timing is critical for using pulsars to detect phenomena as varied as gravitational waves and neutron star glitches, it is important to improve our understanding of these propagation effects. One such effect is chromatic dispersion, which contributes to timing noise but has been detected only once. We propose a set of 4 pointings with the Murriyang 64m Parkes Radio Telescope Ultra-Wide bandwidth Low frequency receiver (UWL), totaling 10 hours of telescope time. Our three targets are all strongly polarized pulsars in the Galactic plane, selected to maximize our chances of detecting one or both of the two types of chromatic dispersion. Non-detections will place upper limits on magnetic field strength and electron density in the IISM.

</details>

Abstract: The propagation effects of the ionized interstellar medium (IISM) on pulsars are not well understood, and increase uncertainty on pulsar timing measurements. As high-precision pulsar timing is critical for using pulsars to detect phenomena as varied as gravitational waves and neutron star glitches, it is important to improve our understanding of these propagation effects. One such effect is chromatic dispersion, which contributes to timing noise but has been detected only once. We propose a set of 4 pointings with the Murriyang 64m Parkes Radio Telescope Ultra-Wide bandwidth Low frequency receiver (UWL), totaling 10 hours of telescope time. Our three targets are all strongly polarized pulsars in the Galactic plane, selected to maximize our chances of detecting one or both of the two types of chromatic dispersion. Non-detections will place upper limits on magnetic field strength and electron density in the IISM.

</details>


### [2353] [Parkes observations for project P1406 semester 2026OCTS_02]()
*Ridolfi, Alessandro,Burgay, Marta,Corongiu, Alessandro,Freire, Paulo,Possenti, Andrea,Risbud, Dhanraj*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 对球状星团 NGC 362 中偏心双星毫秒脉冲星 NGC 362B 继续计时观测，旨在探测第二个后开普勒参数爱因斯坦延迟，从而结合已高精度测量的近星点进动率精确测定系统各分量质量，并改进对已精确测量中子星质量的统计；相同观测还将维持星团内其他脉冲星的计时并搜索新脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NGC 362 是核坍缩后的南天球状星团，最近发现 12 颗脉冲星，族群多样性显著，且 12 颗中 11 颗位于轨道周期和偏心率差异很大的双星系统中。NGC 362B 的偏心双星系统近星点进动率已被高精度测量，这提供了探测第二个后开普勒参数的契机，但摘要未说明该参数尚未探测所构成的具体知识空白。

Method: 摘要提出对 NGC 362B 继续进行计时观测，用于探测第二个后开普勒参数——爱因斯坦延迟；相同观测还将用于持续对星团中所有其他脉冲星进行计时，以及搜索新的脉冲星。摘要未说明所用望远镜或仪器、观测频率或波段、观测时间跨度、样本规模及具体分析流程。

Result: 摘要报告：NGC 362 中最近发现 12 颗脉冲星，族群包含极快自转、轻度循环和慢速脉冲星；12 颗中 11 颗属于轨道周期和偏心率差异很大的双星系统；NGC 362B 是一颗位于偏心双星系统中的毫秒脉冲星，其相对论性近星点进动率已被高精度测量。摘要未说明探测量子延迟、系统质量测量或新脉冲星搜索的任何实际结果，因为这些属于所提出的观测目标。

Conclusion: 摘要明确提出：探测爱因斯坦延迟并与近星点进动率结合，将能够精确测量该系统的各分量质量，从而改进对已精确测量中子星质量的统计；相同观测还将支持星团内其他脉冲星的持续计时和新脉冲星搜索。这些是基于拟议观测的预期结果。对可能与磁星、单脉冲发射、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱或快速射电暴（FRB）的关联，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: NGC 362 is a post-core-collapse southern globular cluster (GC) where 12 pulsars have recently been discovered. The pulsar population is very diverse, containing extremely fast-spinning, mildly recycled and slow pulsars, the vast majority of which (11 out of 12) are part of binary systems with very different orbital periods and eccentricities. One of these pulsars, NGC 362B, is a millisecond pulsar in an eccentric binary system, for which the relativistic rate of advance of periastron is already measured to high precision. We propose continued timing observations of NGC 362B aimed at detecting a second post-Keplerian parameter, the Einstein delay. This, in combination with the advance of periastron, will enable precise measurements of the component masses of the system, improving our statistics of precisely measured neutron star masses. The same observations will be used to keep timing all the other pulsars in the clusters, as well as to search for new ones.

</details>


### [2354] [Parkes observations for project P1406 semester 2026OCTS_01]()
*Ridolfi, Alessandro,Burgay, Marta,Corongiu, Alessandro,Freire, Paulo,Possenti, Andrea,Risbud, Dhanraj*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟继续对球状星团 NGC 362 中的偏心双星毫秒脉冲星 NGC 362B 进行计时观测，以探测第二个后开普勒参数爱因斯坦延迟，并结合已高精度测量的近星点进动率来精确测量系统各组分质量，同时继续计时星团内其他脉冲星并搜寻新脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NGC 362 是核心坍缩后星团，其中新发现的 12 颗脉冲星族群高度多样，且 11 颗处于轨道周期和偏心率各异的双星系统。NGC 362B 的偏心轨道使其近星点进动率已被高精度测量，因此有望进一步探测第二个后开普勒参数，以在中子星质量测量统计上取得进展。

Method: 摘要未说明具体望远镜、接收机、观测频段、观测时间跨度与灵敏度；明确描述的是提议继续对 NGC 362B 开展计时观测，以探测第二个后开普勒参数爱因斯坦延迟，并将同一批观测用于持续计时该星团内所有其他脉冲星以及搜寻新脉冲星。

Result: 摘要报告 NGC 362 中最近发现了 12 颗脉冲星，族群包含极端快自转、轻度再循环和慢速脉冲星；12 颗中有 11 颗位于双星系统，轨道周期和偏心率差异很大。NGC 362B 是偏心双星系统中的毫秒脉冲星，其相对论性近星点进动率已被高精度测量。爱因斯坦延迟尚处于拟通过继续计时探测的阶段，摘要未报告该参数的数值或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，对 NGC 362B 的持续计时若探测到爱因斯坦延迟，结合近星点进动率将能精确测量该系统各组分质量，从而改善已精确测量中子星质量的统计；同一观测还可继续计时星团内其他脉冲星并搜寻新脉冲星。对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、模式转换、自转减慢转矩变化、偏振、射电频谱或磁星—快速射电暴（FRB）联系的适用性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: NGC 362 is a post-core-collapse southern globular cluster (GC) where 12 pulsars have recently been discovered. The pulsar population is very diverse, containing extremely fast-spinning, mildly recycled and slow pulsars, the vast majority of which (11 out of 12) are part of binary systems with very different orbital periods and eccentricities. One of these pulsars, NGC 362B, is a millisecond pulsar in an eccentric binary system, for which the relativistic rate of advance of periastron is already measured to high precision. We propose continued timing observations of NGC 362B aimed at detecting a second post-Keplerian parameter, the Einstein delay. This, in combination with the advance of periastron, will enable precise measurements of the component masses of the system, improving our statistics of precisely measured neutron star masses. The same observations will be used to keep timing all the other pulsars in the clusters, as well as to search for new ones.

</details>


### [2355] [Parkes observations for project P1028 semester 2019OCTS_03]()
*Spitler, Laura,Johnston, S.,Kramer, Michael,Eatough, Ralph,Noutsos, Aristeidis,Main, Robert,Wharton, Robert,Shao, Lijing,Desvignes, Gregory,Torne, Pablo,Liu, Kuo*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划用 UWL 在 700-4000 MHz 对 Sgr A* 30 arcmin 内五颗脉冲星开展深度宽带观测，以精确测量脉冲展宽时间及其频率演化，从而约束视线方向散射物质的大小与分布，并服务于未来银河系中心脉冲星搜寻。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有效搜寻 Sgr A* 附近脉冲星，需要理解银河系中心脉冲星族群及其所处的磁离子环境。射电磁星 J1745-2900 自 2013 年发现以来研究充分，但 Sgr A* 30 arcmin（约 70 pc）内另外五颗脉冲星所知甚少；过去约 10 年仅有少量、少数频率、不同历元的流量密度与散射测量，尚无系统性宽带研究。

Method: 受 J1746-2850 自 2012 年以来首次被重新探测的推动，提议使用 UWL 在 700-4000 MHz 对这五颗脉冲星进行深度观测。摘要未说明观测时间跨度、样本量、具体望远镜、数据处理流程或统计分析方法；所述科学目标包括测量脉冲展宽时间及频率演化，并开展散射参数的宽带测量。

Result: 摘要描述的是观测提议，未报告已获得的观测结果。摘要明确提到 J1746-2850 自 2012 年以来首次被重新探测，并指出对 Sgr A* 30 arcmin（约 70 pc）内五颗脉冲星过去约 10 年中仅有少量流量密度和散射测量，尚未有系统性宽带研究。拟通过 UWL 700-4000 MHz 观测精确测量每颗脉冲星的脉冲展宽时间及频率演化。摘要未说明其他结果、数值或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，对散射参数的宽带测量可约束沿视线方向散射物质的大小与分布，并为未来的银河系中心脉冲星搜寻提供依据；同时，理解银河系中心脉冲星族群和磁离子环境有助于有效搜寻 Sgr A* 附近的脉冲星。根据摘要无法判断该提议与磁星—快速射电暴（FRB）联系、单脉冲辐射、模式转换、偏振、计时或自转减慢力矩变化之间的具体物理关联。

Abstract: In order to effectively target searches for pulsars near the black hole Sgr A*, we need a better understanding of both the Galactic center pulsar population and the magneto-ionic environment in which they reside. The radio-emitting magnetar J1745-2900 has been studied in great detail since it was discovered in 2013, but far less is known of the other five pulsars within 30 arcmin (~70 pc) of Sgr A*. A few flux density and scattering measurements have been made over the last ~10 years at a few frequencies at different epochs, but no systematic wide-band study has yet been performed. Motivated by the first re-detection of J1746-2850 since 2012, we propose deep observations of these five pulsars using the UWL from 700-4000 MHz. From these observations, we will precisely measure the pulse broadening times for each pulsar as well as their frequency evolution in the range where scattering becomes dominant. Wide-band measurements of the scattering parameters will constrain the size and distribution of scattering material along the line of sight and inform future Galactic center pulsar searches.

</details>

*Spitler, Laura,Johnston, S.,Kramer, Michael,Eatough, Ralph,Noutsos, Aristeidis,Main, Robert,Wharton, Robert,Shao, Lijing,Desvignes, Gregory,Torne, Pablo,Liu, Kuo*

Result: 摘要未说明实际观测结果或测量数值。摘要指出 J1745-2900 自 2013 年被发现以来已被极为详细地研究；Sgr A* 周围 30 arcmin（约 70 pc）内的另外五颗脉冲星仅有过去约 10 年间在不同历元的少量通量密度和散射测量；J1746-2850 自 2012 年以来首次被重新探测到；目前尚未开展系统性宽带研究。

Conclusion: 作者认为，散射参数的宽带测量将约束沿视线方向散射物质的大小和分布，并可为未来的银河系中心脉冲星搜寻提供信息。该工作是否可用于脉冲星计时、单脉冲、模式转换、自旋下降转矩变化或磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）联系等具体方向，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: In order to effectively target searches for pulsars near the black hole Sgr A*, we need a better understanding of both the Galactic center pulsar population and the magneto-ionic environment in which they reside. Wide-band measurements of the scattering parameters will constrain the size and distribution of scattering material along the line of sight and inform future Galactic center pulsar searches.

</details>

### [2358] [Parkes observations for project P455 semester 2024OCTS_05]()
*Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Manchester, Dick,Kramer, Michael,McLaughlin, Maura,Deller, Adam,Stairs, Ingrid,Coles, William,Lorimer, Duncan Ross,Ferdman, Robert,Wex, Norbert,Hu, Huanchen*

TL;DR: 该项目继续对首个双脉冲星系统进行 Parkes 计时与脉冲轮廓研究，目标是在既有 Phys. Rev. X 成果基础上提供迄今最强的广义相对论检验，并首次测量中子星的转动惯量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 首个双脉冲星系统是引力物理学的独特实验室。此前发表于 Phys. Rev. X 的 53 页论文报告了高阶光传播效应和轨道相对论性形变的首次测量，说明需要长期观测 campaña（包括 VLBI 观测）才能推进研究。

Method: 摘要说明本项目继续对该双脉冲星系统开展计时与脉冲轮廓研究，并使用 UWL 接收机的高灵敏度与宽带宽；还提到与最近启动的 MeerKAT 计时观测形成重叠，并包含 VLBI 观测。观测频率、时间跨度、样本量和具体分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要指出，已发表的 53 页 Phys. Rev. X 论文（Kramer 等，第 11 卷，2021 年 10 月）包含高阶光传播效应和轨道相对论性形变的首次测量，并强调长期观测 campaña（包括 VLBI 观测）对该系统的重要性。本提案的目标是提供迄今最强的广义相对论检验、首次测量中子星转动惯量、确定系统几何结构、通过测地进动绘制脉冲星波束，并搜寻脉冲星 B 的重新出现；具体新观测结果摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为延续该项目对于推进该双脉冲星系统的研究至关重要，并强调需与最近启动的 MeerKAT 计时观测保持重叠。其明确目标是检验广义相对论、首次测量中子星转动惯量，并通过测地进动研究系统几何结构与脉冲星波束，同时搜寻脉冲星 B 的重新出现。与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、快速射电暴（FRB）或脉冲星自转减慢力矩变化的物理联系：根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: This project is to continue timing and profile studies of the first double-pulsar system, a unique laboratory for gravitational physics. Important results published in our 53-page Phys. Rev. X paper (Kramer et al., Vol 11, October 2021) include the first measurements of higher-order light-propagation effects and of the relativistic deformation of the orbit and highlight the importance of a long term observational campaign, including VLBI observations, for this remarkable system. The main aims of this proposal are to provide the strongest tests to date for general relativity and to measure for the first time the moment-of-inertia of a neutron star. Additionally, we will determine the system geometry, map the pulsar beams via geodetic precession, and search for the reappearance of Pulsar B. We exploit the high sensitivity and broad bandwidth of the UWL receiver. Continuation of this project is vital to provide overlap with MeerKAT timing observations of the Double Pulsar system which commenced recently.

Rev. The main aims of this proposal are to provide the strongest tests to date for general relativity and to measure for the first time the moment-of-inertia of a neutron star. *Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Manchester, Dick,Kramer, Michael,McLaughlin, Maura,Deller, Adam,Stairs, Ingrid,Coles, William,Lorimer, Duncan Ross,Ferdman, Robert,Wex, Norbert,Hu, Huanchen*

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双脉冲星系统是引力物理的独特实验室；已发表结果凸显长期观测campaign（包括 VLBI 观测）的重要性，因此需要继续观测以提供迄今最强的广义相对论检验、首次测量中子星转动惯量，并与最近开始的 MeerKAT 计时观测形成重叠。

Conclusion: 作者认为继续该项目对于为广义相对论提供迄今最强检验、首次测量中子星转动惯量，以及与最近开始的 MeerKAT 对双脉冲星系统的计时观测形成重叠至关重要。该系统的研究还用于确定系统几何结构、通过测地进动绘制脉冲星波束并搜寻脉冲星 B 的再次出现。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射等主题的具体物理联系。

Abstract: This project is to continue timing and profile studies of the first double-pulsar system, a unique laboratory for gravitational physics. Important results published in our 53-page Phys. Rev. X paper (Kramer et al., Vol 11, October 2021) include the first measurements of higher-order light-propagation effects and of the relativistic deformation of the orbit and highlight the importance of a long term observational campaign, including VLBI observations, for this remarkable system. The main aims of this proposal are to provide the strongest tests to date for general relativity and to measure for the first time the moment-of-inertia of a neutron star. Additionally, we will determine the system geometry, map the pulsar beams via geodetic precession, and search for the reappearance of Pulsar B. We exploit the high sensitivity and broad bandwidth of the UWL receiver. Continuation of this project is vital to provide overlap with MeerKAT timing observations of the Double Pulsar system which commenced recently.

</details>

### [2376] [Parkes observations for project P1005 semester 2020APRS_03]()
*Cameron, Andrew,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Bailes, Matthew,Stappers, Benjamin,Champion, David,Balakrishnan, Vishnu*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案旨在通过高节奏观测计划测定呈现零脉冲行为的约1 s脉冲星PSR J1812-15的轨道，以克服此前无法获得轨道解或相位连接解的困难，从而研究这一处于双星系统中的长周期脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1812-15是约1 s的脉冲星，表现出零脉冲行为并有加速度证据，暗示处于双星系统。双星脉冲星可用于检验引力、探测中子星物态方程和研究恒星演化；双星中的长自转周期脉冲星通常比快速自转的再循环脉冲星罕见，属于脉冲星双星演化中尚未充分探索的区域。由于零脉冲，确定轨道或相位连接解迄今不可能，但这两步对该脉冲星的持续研究至关重要。

Method: 摘要提出对PSR J1812-15开展一项有针对性的高节奏观测计划，用于描绘其轨道，并同时计入克服其零脉冲行为所需的冗余。标题显示该计划属于Parkes的P1005项目、2020APRS_03学期。摘要未说明具体观测频段、观测时长、望远镜配置、数据量或分析流程等细节；计时、单脉冲、偏振或谱分析等具体方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要描述的是观测提议，尚未报告观测结果。摘要指出PSR J1812-15的周期约为1 s，表现出零脉冲行为，并有明确的加速度证据，暗示其处于双星系统。由于该脉冲星的零脉冲行为，确定其轨道解或相位连接解迄今被证明是不可能的。摘要未给出轨道参数、自转或自转减慢参数、偏振、谱、脉冲轮廓或任何定量结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出，通过该高节奏观测计划描绘PSR J1812-15的轨道并计入克服零脉冲行为所需的冗余，可望为该不寻常的脉冲星双星类别提供新见解，并限制该脉冲星的零脉冲性质。作者认为确定轨道解或相位连接解对其持续研究至关重要。根据摘要无法判断该目标是否最终能被确认为双星系统，也无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲辐射的物理联系。

Abstract: We propose to conduct observations of PSR J1812-15, a of 1-s pulsar which exhibits both nulling behaviour and clear evidence of acceleration, suggesting that it is in a binary system. Binary pulsars are valuable objects of scientific study, allowing for a wide range of applications, including tests of gravity, probes of the neutron star equation of state and fossil records of stellar evolution. Long spin-period pulsars in binary systems are generally much rarer than faster-spinning recycled pulsars, and represent an under-explored region of pulsar binary evolution. Due to the nulling behaviour of PSRs J1812-15, determination of an orbital or phase-connected solution has so far proved impossible, but both of these steps are vital in allowing for the pulsar's continued study. We propose a targeted, high-cadence observing campaign designed to map the orbits of this pulsar while simultaneously factoring in the redundancy required in order to overcome its nulling behaviour. By studying this pulsar, we hope to provide new insight into an unusual class of pulsar binary, as well to constrain the nulling properties of the pulsar.

</details>

Binary pulsars are valuable objects of scientific study, allowing for a wide range of applications, including tests of gravity, probes of the neutron star equation of state and fossil records of stellar evolution. Due to the nulling behaviour of PSRs J1812-15, determination of an orbital or phase-connected solution has so far proved impossible, but both of these steps are vital in allowing for the pulsar's continued study. We propose a targeted, high-cadence observing campaign designed to map the orbits of this pulsar while simultaneously factoring in the redundancy required in order to overcome its nulling behaviour. ### [2378] [Sensitivity of weak lensing surveys to gravitational waves from inspiraling supermassive black hole binaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21392)
*Adi, Tal,Pardo, Kris,Doré, Olivier*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该论文建立了一个纳入巡天采样节奏、角分辨率和深度的信噪比框架，用于评估弱透镜巡天对纳赫兹至微赫兹频段超大质量黑洞双星引力波的灵敏度；结果表明当前巡天受限于角分辨率和测量噪声，只有理想化的宇宙方差极限巡天原则上才能探测该频率范围。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超大质量黑洞双星在纳赫兹至微赫兹频段发出的引力波处于脉冲星计时阵列与空间干涉仪之间的探测空白频段，需要探索弱透镜巡天对此类引力波的灵敏度。

Method: 基于引力波引起的剪切畸变形式体系，建立纳入巡天采样节奏、角分辨率和深度等特征的信噪比框架；对有效星系族群建模以评估噪声功率谱密度并推导特征应变灵敏度曲线；将该框架应用于类 LSST 和理想化的巡天配置。摘要未说明具体观测频段数值、时间跨度、样本量或统计显著性。

Result: 当前巡天受限于角分辨率和测量噪声；理想化的、宇宙方差极限的巡天原则上可以探测该频率范围。摘要未给出具体数值、灵敏度曲线数值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 该灵敏度需要远超现有或计划中设施的观测能力，因此结果应被解读为通过弱透镜测量可获取信息的最终极限，而非现有或计划设施可实现的探测。根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴具体观测的进一步联系。

Abstract: We explore the sensitivity of weak lensing surveys to gravitational waves (GWs) emitted by inspiraling supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs) in the nanohertz to microhertz frequency band, bridging the gap between pulsar timing arrays and space-based interferometers. Building on the formalism for GW-induced shear distortions, we develop a signal-to-noise framework that incorporates survey characteristics such as cadence, angular resolution, and depth. We model the effective galaxy population to evaluate the noise power spectral density and derive characteristic strain sensitivity curves. Applying this framework to both LSST-like and idealized survey configurations, we show that current surveys are limited by angular resolution and measurement noise, while an idealized, cosmic-variance-limited survey could in principle probe this frequency range. We emphasize that such sensitivity requires observational capabilities far beyond those of existing or planned facilities, and our results should be interpreted as an ultimate limit on the information accessible through weak lensing measurements.

</details>


### [2379] [Parkes observations for project P574 semester 2019APRS_05]()
*Sobey, Charlotte,Possenti, Andrea,Manchester, Dick,Johnston, Simon,Hobbs, George,Weltevrede, Patrick,Kerr, Matthew,Shannon, Ryan,Dai, Shi,Ilie, Cristina-Diana,Kumamoto, Hiroki*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请请求对260颗脉冲星进行定期观测，以提供精确星历表，用于Fermi卫星对伽马射线脉冲星的探测与刻画；射电观测同时用于研究脉冲星辐射、glitch、脉冲计时参数以及ISM的DM、RM和闪烁。迄今该合作与P574数据已产生75篇论文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需要精确星历表以支持Fermi卫星对伽马射线脉冲星的探测和刻画，并增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量（射电噪与射电安静）、确定精确脉冲轮廓、刻画高能相位分辨谱；在射电波段还需研究脉冲星辐射、glitch、脉冲计时参数以及ISM性质。

Method: 申请时间以定期观测260颗脉冲星，提供精确星历表；射电观测用于探测glitch、确定脉冲计时参数，并测量和监测色散量、Faraday旋转测度和闪烁。摘要未说明望远镜名称、观测频段、时间跨度及具体分析方法。

Result: 摘要未报告具体观测结果或数值，仅说明申请定期观测260颗脉冲星，并将射电观测用于探测glitch、确定脉冲计时参数以及测量和监测DM、RM和闪烁；迄今该合作与P574数据已产生75篇论文，并支持了来自Bordeaux、Manchester、Oxford、Stanford和Swinburne学生的博士论文。

Conclusion: 该申请旨在通过定期射电计时观测提供精确星历表，以支持Fermi卫星对伽马射线脉冲星的探测与刻画，并扩展对脉冲星辐射、glitch、脉冲计时参数和ISM性质的研究；其积累的数据已产生75篇论文并支持多个机构的博士论文。根据摘要无法判断这些观测对磁星、单脉冲发射、模式转换或FRB的具体意义。

Abstract: We request time to observe 260 pulsars on a regular basis to provide the accurate ephemerides necessary for the detection and characterisation of gamma-ray pulsars with the Fermi satellite. The primary science goals are to increase the number of known gamma-ray pulsars (both radio loud and radio quiet), to determine accurate pulse profiles, and to characterise their high energy (phase-resolved) spectra. In the radio, the observations will also allow us to investigate: neutron stars and pulsar emission via detecting glitches and determining pulse timing parameters; and the ISM via measuring and monitoring dispersion measures, Faraday rotation measures, and scintillation. To date, we are (co-)authors on 75 papers arising from the collaboration and P574 data. The data have contributed to the PhD theses of students from Bordeaux, Manchester, Oxford, Stanford, and Swinburne.

</details>

In the radio, the observations will also allow us to investigate: neutron stars and pulsar emission via detecting glitches and determining pulse timing parameters; and the ISM via measuring and monitoring dispersion measures, Faraday rotation measures, and scintillation. Motivation: 该申请旨在提供精确星历表，以支持利用Fermi卫星探测和表征伽马射线脉冲星，并增加已知伽马射线脉冲星（包括射电响亮和射电安静）的数量。摘要还指出，射电观测可用于研究中子星和脉冲星发射以及ISM，但未进一步说明具体的知识空白。

Method: 摘要说明申请时间以定期观测260颗脉冲星，为利用Fermi卫星探测和表征伽马射线脉冲星提供精确星历表。射电观测将用于探测glitch并确定脉冲计时（timing）参数，以及测量和监测色散量、法拉第旋转量和闪烁。摘要未说明具体望远镜、接收机、频段、时间跨度或分析方法的细节。

Result: 摘要说明截至目前，作者（共同）撰写了75篇源自该合作和P574数据的论文，且这些数据已为来自Bordeaux、Manchester、Oxford、Stanford和Swinburne的学生的博士论文做出了贡献。摘要未报告具体的脉冲星、伽马射线脉冲星、glitch、脉冲轮廓、偏振、色散量、法拉第旋转量或闪烁的观测结果或数值。

Conclusion: 作者提出的主要科学目标是增加已知伽马射线脉冲星的数量（包括射电响亮和射电安静两类），确定精确的脉冲轮廓，并表征其高能（相位分辨）能谱；射电观测还将用于研究中子星和脉冲星发射以及ISM。摘要未给出进一步的物理机制解释或对脉冲星、磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）之间联系的推论；根据摘要无法判断此类联系。

Abstract: We request time to observe 260 pulsars on a regular basis to provide the accurate ephemerides necessary for the detection and characterisation of gamma-ray pulsars with the Fermi satellite. The primary science goals are to increase the number of known gamma-ray pulsars (both radio loud and radio quiet), to determine accurate pulse profiles, and to characterise their high energy (phase-resolved) spectra. In the radio, the observations will also allow us to investigate: neutron stars and pulsar emission via detecting glitches and determining pulse timing parameters; and the ISM via measuring and monitoring dispersion measures, Faraday rotation measures, and scintillation. To date, we are (co-)authors on 75 papers arising from the collaboration and P574 data. The data have contributed to the PhD theses of students from Bordeaux, Manchester, Oxford, Stanford, and Swinburne.

### [2395] [Parkes observations for project P1054 semester 2020APRS_06]()
*Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Freire, Paulo,Weltevrede, Patrick,Stappers, Benjamin,Keane, Evan,Levin, Lina,Buchner, Sarah,Joseph, Tana,Boettcher, Markus,Wex, Norbert,Deneva, Julia,Breton, Rene,Cognard, Ismaël,Grießmeier, Jean-Mathias*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请请求利用 Parkes 望远镜 UWL 接收机，对 TRAPUM 巡天预计在 2020 年第一学期发现的新脉冲星开展后续计时观测，目标为 1.4 GHz 流量密度高于 $\sim 60 \mu$Jy 的源，每月至多 2 小时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TRAPUM 巡天预计于 2020 年 1 月开始，第一学期预计在超新星遗迹、脉冲星风云和 Fermi 未识别点源的定向指向中发现约 10 颗新脉冲星；需要后续计时观测以充分发挥这些发现的潜力，精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而增进对极端环境物理和中子星族群的理解。

Method: 使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机，对任何 1.4 GHz 流量密度高于 $\sim 60 \mu$Jy 的新 TRAPUM 脉冲星开展后续计时观测；请求（至多）2 小时长的每月观测。摘要未说明具体观测时间跨度、实际样本数、数据分析流程或统计方法。

Result: 这是一项观测时间申请，摘要陈述的预期而非已获得的结果：TRAPUM 巡天预计于 2020 年 1 月开始，第一学期预计发现约 10 颗新脉冲星，指向超新星遗迹、脉冲星风云和 Fermi 未识别点源；请求对 1.4 GHz 流量密度高于 $\sim 60 \mu$Jy 的新发现进行（至多）2 小时长的每月计时观测。摘要未说明任何已完成的计时、脉冲轮廓、偏振、频谱或脉冲星参数测量结果。

Conclusion: 摘要表明，计时观测是充分发挥脉冲星发现潜力的必要手段，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，并据此增进对极端环境物理和中子星族群的理解；Parkes 的 UWL 接收机被认为能够成功计时 TRAPUM 发现中较亮的一端。摘要未说明磁星、单脉冲发射、模式转换、自转减慢力矩变化或磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）联系的具体结果；根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to begin a follow-up campaign of potential new discoveries from the TRAPUM (TRAnsients and PUlsars with Meerkat) survey, which is due to start in January 2020. About 10 new pulsars are expected to be found during the first semester of operations, in targeted pointings towards supernova remnants, pulsar wind nebulae and Fermi unidentified point sources. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that will allow us to successfully time the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries. We here request (up to) 2-hr long monthly observations of any new TRAPUM pulsar with a flux density at 1.4 GHz above $\sim 60 \mu$Jy.

</details>

Method: 摘要说明这是一项观测时间申请，拟启动针对 TRAPUM 潜在新发现的后续观测活动；拟使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机，对任何 1.4 GHz 通量密度高于 $\sim 60 \mu$Jy 的新 TRAPUM 脉冲星请求最多 2 小时长的每月观测。摘要未说明具体开始日期、单次观测时长以外的采样细节、数据分析流程或统计方法。

Result: 摘要为观测申请，未报告已获得的观测结果。摘要陈述的预期为：TRAPUM 巡天预计于 2020 年 1 月开始，首个学期运行期间预计发现约 10 颗新脉冲星；拟议的计时观测将针对 1.4 GHz 通量密度高于 $\sim 60 \mu$Jy 的新 TRAPUM 脉冲星，并请求最多 2 小时长的每月观测。摘要未给出任何已测量数值或显著性结果。

Conclusion: 摘要指出，计时观测可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而为理解极端环境中的物理以及整体中子星族群提供有力工具；Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机灵敏且多用途，将能够成功地对 TRAPUM 发现中较亮的一端进行计时。摘要未报告观测结果，也未提及磁星、快速射电暴、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、偏振或射电频谱等具体内容；根据摘要无法判断这些方面的联系。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to begin a follow-up campaign of potential new discoveries from the TRAPUM (TRAnsients and PUlsars with Meerkat) survey, which is due to start in January 2020. About 10 new pulsars are expected to be found during the first semester of operations, in targeted pointings towards supernova remnants, pulsar wind nebulae and Fermi unidentified point sources. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that will allow us to successfully time the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries. We here request (up to) 2-hr long monthly observations of any new TRAPUM pulsar with a flux density at 1.4 GHz above $\sim 60 \mu$Jy.

</details>
