### [2408] [Parkes observations for project P511 semester 2009OCTS]()
*McLaughlin, Maura,Manchester, Dick,Kramer, Michael,Lyne, A.,Camilo, Fernando,Stairs, Ingrid,Lorimer, Duncan Ross,Keane, Evan,Miller, Josh*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请拟继续对八个旋转射电暂现源（RRAT）进行计时观测，并新增三个RRAT，旨在维持相位连接解、搜寻glitches或计时异常并理解其辐射机制及与其他中子星族群的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需要继续对RRAT进行计时观测：自上一观测学期以来已为另外四个源获得相位连接解并提交三篇基于该计划Parkes数据的论文；继续观测对理解这些源的辐射机制及其与其他中子星族群的关系至关重要。

Method: 使用Parkes数据进行计时观测，继续观测八个旋转射电暂现源，并申请对三个新的RRAT进行计时观测；目标是维持相位连接解并搜寻glitches或其他计时异常。观测波段、时间跨度、具体分析方法以及X射线与红外波段的观测细节摘要未说明。

Result: 自上一个观测学期以来，已为另外四个源获得相位连接解，并已提交三篇使用该计划Parkes数据的论文；此前在J1819-1458中曾见到glitches。其他具体计时结果、显著性及数值摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为所申请的观测对继续这一进展、理解这些源的辐射机制以及确定它们与其他中子星族群的关系至关重要，并可作为X射线、射电和红外波段广泛观测活动的基石。根据摘要无法判断更具体的物理机制或族群联系结论。

Abstract: We request continuing timing observations of eight rotating radio transients. Since the last observing semester, we have achieved phase-connected solutions for four additional sources, and have submitted three papers which make use of the Parkes data from this program. The observations proposed here are crucial for continuing with this progress, and for understanding the emission mechanism of these sources and for determining how they relate to other neutron star populations. We aim to continue to time the sources with phase-connected solutions to search for glitches (as seen for J1819-1458) or other timing abnormalities. We also request timing observations of three new RRATs. These observations are the cornerstone of an extensive campaign at X-ray, radio and infrared wavelengths.

</details>


### [2409] [Parkes observations for project P1141 semester 2021OCTS_06]()
*Lewandowska, Natalia,Johnston, Simon,Harding, Alice,Ho, Wynn,Marshall, Frank,Enoto, Teruaki*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟联合NICER对PSR J0540-6919（蟹状星云脉冲星的双胞胎）开展射电巨脉冲与X射线辐射的相关性研究，以检验与X射线辐射的相关性是否是具有射电巨脉冲的普通脉冲星的特征，并探讨普通脉冲星与毫秒脉冲星中是否存在不同的射电巨脉冲群体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 射电巨脉冲自50多年前发现蟹状星云脉冲星以来即被观测，但其看似不规则的辐射形式起源仍不清楚；其特征提示存在相干辐射机制，而通过多波段相关性研究搜寻非相干辐射成分，可用于识别脉冲星磁层中可能的辐射区域。对蟹状星云脉冲星的此类研究近期被证明成功，因此有必要将类似研究扩展到普通脉冲星。

Method: 摘要未说明具体的观测频率、频段、时间跨度、样本量和数据分析方法；摘要仅说明这是一项提案，拟针对PSR J0540-6919研究其射电巨脉冲辐射，并搜寻其与X射线辐射的相关性，且与中子星内部组成探测器（NICER）联合开展。

Result: 摘要未说明已获得的观测结果。摘要仅指出，近期针对蟹状星云脉冲星的此类研究被证明是成功的（Enoto et al.\,2021），并称据作者所知，该拟议研究是首次针对PSR J0540-6919、与其X射线辐射联合开展的此类研究。

Conclusion: 作者提出，该研究将阐明与X射线辐射的相关性是否是具有射电巨脉冲辐射的普通脉冲星的一个特征；此类知识将有助于揭示在普通脉冲星和毫秒脉冲星的情况下是否存在不同的射电巨脉冲群体。至于PSR J0540-6919是否存在该相关性、其辐射区域如何，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Radio giant pulses (GPs) have been observed since the discovery of the Crab pulsar more than 50 years ago. Nevertheless the origins of this apparently irregular form of radio emission are still not understood. While their characteristics indicate the existence of a coherent emission mechanism, the search for an incoherent emission component via multi-wavelength correlation studies provides one way to identify potential emission regions in the magnetosphere of the pulsar. With the present proposal, we address the radio GP emission from PSR J0540-6919 (the Crab twin) and seek to search for a correlation with its X-ray emission. A recent study of this kind for the Crab pulsar proved to be successful (Enoto et al.\,2021). Our proposed study is to the best of our knowledge the first of its kind together with the Neutron Star Interior Composition ExploreR (NICER) for this particular source and will shed light on the question of whether correlations with X-ray emission are a characteristic of ordinary pulsars with radio GP emission. Such knowledge will be useful in unraveling whether there are different populations of radio GPs in the case of ordinary and millisecond pulsars.

</details>

### [2411] [Parkes observations for project P1141 semester 2021OCTS_08]()

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度、数据量或分析流程细节。摘要明确说明的是：这是一份观测申请，针对 PSR J0540-6919 的射电巨脉冲，与中子星内部成分探索者（NICER）联合，搜寻其射电巨脉冲与 X 射线辐射之间的相关性；据作者所知，这是首个针对该源开展此类研究的申请。

Result: 摘要未说明。摘要中未报告任何观测结果、相关性数值、显著性、辐射区域或族群特征；所引用的成功先例为 Enoto et al.\,2021 对 Crab 脉冲星开展的同类型研究。

Conclusion: 作者认为，该研究将阐明与 X 射线辐射的相关性是否是具有射电巨脉冲的普通脉冲星的一个特征，并有助于揭示普通脉冲星与毫秒脉冲星是否存在不同的射电巨脉冲族群。这是尚未执行的申请所提出的预期科学意义，摘要未报告任何实际物理结论；其与脉冲星计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱、单脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换或磁星–快速射电暴联系的关联，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Radio giant pulses (GPs) have been observed since the discovery of the Crab pulsar more than 50 years ago. Nevertheless the origins of this apparently irregular form of radio emission are still not understood. While their characteristics indicate the existence of a coherent emission mechanism, the search for an incoherent emission component via multi-wavelength correlation studies provides one way to identify potential emission regions in the magnetosphere of the pulsar. With the present proposal, we address the radio GP emission from PSR J0540-6919 (the Crab twin) and seek to search for a correlation with its X-ray emission. A recent study of this kind for the Crab pulsar proved to be successful (Enoto et al.\,2021). Our proposed study is to the best of our knowledge the first of its kind together with the Neutron Star Interior Composition ExploreR (NICER) for this particular source and will shed light on the question of whether correlations with X-ray emission are a characteristic of ordinary pulsars with radio GP emission. Such knowledge will be useful in unraveling whether there are different populations of radio GPs in the case of ordinary and millisecond pulsars.

</details>


### [2418] [CMB and Energy Conservation Limits on Nanohertz Gravitational Waves](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.15572)
*Wright, David,Giblin, John T., Jr.,Hazboun, Jeffrey*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该文论证，采用一条简单的能量守恒规则并结合CMB对辐射能量密度的限制，可以对被提出用于解释纳赫兹随机引力波背景的模型参数给出严格限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PTA合作组宣布的纳赫兹频段随机引力波背景证据，被认为可能来自超大质量黑洞双星群体，或来自暴胀时期附近时空扰动所代表的新物理模型；后者需要宇宙学标准模型乃至粒子物理标准模型的扩展。PTA数据集虽可刻画这些模型的参数空间，但摘要指出可利用能量守恒和CMB限制预先约束这些参数空间。

Method: 摘要未说明具体的观测、数据集、仪器、频段、时间跨度或样本；仅说明使用一条简单的能量守恒规则，并利用CMB对辐射能量密度的限制，来先验地约束那些被提出解释纳赫兹随机引力波背景的模型参数空间，而非使用PTA数据集进行参数刻画。

Result: 摘要报告称，采用一条简单的能量守恒规则并利用CMB对辐射能量密度的限制，可以对这些模型的参数设定严格限制。摘要未给出具体模型、数值限制、置信水平或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者明确支持的结论是：能量守恒与CMB对辐射能量密度的限制可在先验层面严格约束那些被提出解释纳赫兹随机引力波背景的模型参数空间。摘要未说明这些限制对具体模型或具体物理情形的进一步含义；根据摘要无法判断其与单脉冲、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱或磁星—快速射电暴联系等具体观测主题的关联。

Abstract: The recent evidence for a stochastic gravitational wave background (GWB) in the nanohertz band, announced by pulsar timing array (PTA) collaborations around the world, has been posited to be sourced by either a population of supermassive black holes binaries or perturbations of spacetime near the inflationary era, generated by a zoo of various new physical phenomena. Gravitational waves (GWs) from these latter models would be explained by extensions to the standard model of cosmology and possibly to the standard model of particle physics. While PTA datasets can be used to characterize the parameter spaces of these models, energy conservation and limits from the cosmic microwave background (CMB) can be used a priori to bound those parameter spaces. Here we demonstrate that taking a simple rule for energy conservation and using CMB bounds on the radiation energy density can set stringent limits on the parameters for these models.

</details>


### [2419] [Parkes observations for project P869 semester 2014APRS_01]()
*Eatough, Ralph,Johnston, S.,Kramer, Michael,Keane, Evan,Shannon, Ryan*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟对银河系中心超大质量黑洞候选体 Sgr A* 附近的脉冲星进行深度搜寻；摘要指出，此类脉冲星可用于检验引力理论并测量黑洞的质量与自旋，而 Sgr A* 紧邻区域一颗磁星的近期发现证明脉冲星存在于该区域且可在比以前认为更低的频率上被探测到。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 Sgr A* 附近紧密轨道上的脉冲星可对引力理论做最精确检验，并测量黑洞质量与自旋，从而用于在广义相对论中检验无毛定理和宇宙监督猜想。此前尚不确定该区域是否存在可探测脉冲星；近期在 Sgr A* 紧邻区域发现的磁星表明脉冲星确实存在，且可在比以前认为更低的频率上被探测到。

Method: 摘要未说明。摘要仅提出对 Sgr A* 附近此类脉冲星进行深度搜寻，未给出望远镜或仪器名称、观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本、以及具体数据分析方法（如计时、单脉冲、脉冲轮廓、偏振、RM、DM、谱分析、模式转换、机器学习、模拟、布居或统计分析）。

Result: 摘要未说明。摘要未报告任何观测结果、搜寻结果、脉冲星探测、计时或自旋减慢行为、脉冲轮廓、偏振、谱或暴发结果，也未给出任何数值或显著性。摘要提到的唯一发现是：近期在 Sgr A* 紧邻区域发现了一颗磁星，这被认为证明脉冲星确实存在于该区域，并可在比以前认为更低的频率上被探测到。

Conclusion: 作者明确提出，Sgr A* 附近紧密轨道上的脉冲星可用于最精确地检验引力理论并测量黑洞的质量和自旋，进而在爱因斯坦的广义相对论中检验无毛定理和宇宙监督猜想；Sgr A* 紧邻区域磁星的近期发现证明脉冲星存在于该区域且可在比以前认为更低的频率上被探测到。因此作者提议对此类脉冲星进行深度搜寻。至于与磁星—快速射电暴（FRB）联系等更广泛的物理含义，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Pulsars found closely orbiting the supermassive black hole candidate at the centre of our Galaxy, Sgr A*, could be used to perform the most precise tests of theories of gravity, and to accurately measure the properties of the black hole itself, such as the mass and spin. These measurements can be used to test the no hair theorem and cosmic censorship conjecture in Einsteins theory of General Relativity. The recent discovery of a magnetar in the immediate vicinity of Sgr A* prooves pulsars are indeed present in this region and detectable at lower frequencies than previously thought. We propose to perfom deep searches for such pulsars.

</details>

### [2421] [Parkes observations for project P1054 semester 2026APRS_03]()
*Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Freire, Paulo,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Buchner, Sarah,Barr, Ewan,Venkatraman Krishnan, Vivek,Karuppusamy, Ramesh,Clark, Colin James,Breton, Rene,Ridolfi, Alessandro,Cognard, Ismaël,Grießmeier, Jean-Mathias,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel,Thongmeearkom, Tinn,Carli, Emma,Turner, James,Prayag, Venu,Sergio, Belmonte Dìaz*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案申请继续用 Parkes 望远镜 UWL 接收机对 MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星开展计时后随观测，以精确测量其自转、天体测量和轨道参数。摘要指出新发现源中很大一部分是再生脉冲星或年轻脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MeerKAT 在定向观测中已发现大量脉冲星，其中很大一部分是再生脉冲星或年轻脉冲星。要充分挖掘这些新发现的科学潜力，需要计时后随观测来精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而加深对极端环境物理和中子星族群的理解。摘要未说明当前计时覆盖的具体缺口。

Method: 摘要描述的是一份观测时间申请：继续对 MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星开展计时后随观测。已发现的 53 个源来自 Fermi 未识别点源定向观测，另有 2 个朝向超新星遗迹、27 个在麦哲伦云、109 个在球状星团、96 个来自银河系平面巡天。使用的仪器为 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机。具体的观测频率、时间跨度、样本细节和数据处理方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告已发现大量脉冲星：Fermi 未识别点源定向观测中 53 个，朝超新星遗迹 2 个，麦哲伦云 27 个，球状星团 109 个，银河系平面巡天 96 个。新发现源中很大一部分是再生脉冲星，包括少数相对论系统、一颗带有行星伴星的脉冲星以及若干“蜘蛛”双星，另有一部分是年轻脉冲星。摘要未给出计时观测的具体测量结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为计时观测是充分发挥脉冲星发现全部潜力的关键，可精确测定自转、天体测量和轨道参数，进而增进对极端环境物理和中子星族群的理解；Parkes 望远镜 UWL 接收机灵敏且多用途，已能成功对 TRAPUM 发现的亮端新源进行计时。摘要未报告具体科学结论；对该样本与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲物理的关联，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fiftythree sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 27 in the Magellanic Clouds, 109 in Globular Clusters and 96 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems, a pulsar with a planetary companion and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

Result: 摘要报告已发现五十三个源，其中两个朝向超新星遗迹，27 个位于麦哲伦云，109 个位于球状星团，96 个位于银河系盘面巡天。新发现源中很大一部分是循环脉冲星，包括少数相对论性系统、一颗具有行星伴星的脉冲星以及若干“spider”双星，另有一些年轻脉冲星。摘要指出 UWL 接收机正使这些源得到成功计时，这些源处于 TRAPUM 发现源的亮端。摘要未说明计时精度、参数数值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者明确指出，计时观测对充分利用脉冲星发现成果不可或缺，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而增进对极端环境物理以及中子星整体族群的理解；Parkes 的 UWL 接收机被描述为灵敏、多用途的仪器，正在成功计时这些新源。摘要未给出可判断其与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射等具体联系的物理诠释，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fiftythree sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 27 in the Magellanic Clouds, 109 in Globular Clusters and 96 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems, a pulsar with a planetary companion and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems, a pulsar with a planetary companion and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Motivation: 为充分发挥 MeerKAT 新发现脉冲星的科学潜力，需要长期计时后续观测来精确测量自转、天体测量与轨道参数，从而增进对极端环境物理和中子星整体族群的理解。摘要列举的发现包括 Fermi 未识别点源、超新星遗迹、麦哲伦云、球状星团与银河系平面巡天中的源。

Method: 这是一项对 MeerKAT 发现脉冲星继续开展计时（timing）后续观测的申请，使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机。摘要说明的发现样本为：Fermi 未识别点源定向观测中五十三个源、两个朝向超新星遗迹、27 个在麦哲伦云、109 个在球状星团、96 个在银河系平面巡天。观测频率或频段、时间跨度、具体分析流程摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告，MeerKAT 定向观测已发现这些源：Fermi 未识别点源中五十三个，两个朝向超新星遗迹，27 个在麦哲伦云，109 个在球状星团，96 个在银河系平面巡天。新发现中很大一部分是再循环脉冲星，包括几个相对论性系统、一颗具有行星伴星的脉冲星以及若干个“spider”双星，另有一部分为年轻脉冲星。摘要称 UWL 接收机使得对这些新源（处于 TRAPUM 发现的亮端）的计时得以成功进行。

Conclusion: 作者主张，计时观测是充分挖掘任何脉冲星发现潜力的必要条件，可提供精确的自转、天体测量和轨道参数，并作为理解极端环境物理与中子星整体族群的工具；Parkes 的 UWL 接收机是灵敏、多用途的仪器，正使这些 TRAPUM 新源得以成功计时。摘要未给出具体物理结果。就脉冲星计时方法与样本而言，摘要直接支持其与脉冲星计时研究相关；与磁星、单脉冲、模式转换、偏振或 FRB 的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fiftythree sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 27 in the Magellanic Clouds, 109 in Globular Clusters and 96 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems, a pulsar with a planetary companion and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

Result: 摘要报告已发现 53 个源（Fermi 未识别点源定点观测），2 个朝向超新星遗迹，27 个在麦哲伦云，109 个在球状星团，96 个在银河系盘巡天。新发现中很大一部分是循环脉冲星，包括少数相对论性系统、一颗具有行星伴星的脉冲星以及若干"蜘蛛"双星，或者是年轻脉冲星。摘要称 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机正在使其成功地对这些新源进行计时，这些源处于 TRAPUM 发现的亮端。

Conclusion: 作者主张，计时观测对充分发挥脉冲星发现的潜力不可或缺，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而为理解极端环境中的物理以及中子星整体族群提供有力工具。摘要未报告具体的物理测量结果或对磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、单脉冲、模式转换、偏振或射电频谱的解释；根据摘要无法判断这些方面。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fiftythree sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 27 in the Magellanic Clouds, 109 in Globular Clusters and 96 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems, a pulsar with a planetary companion and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者认为，计时观测对于挖掘任何脉冲星发现的全部潜力具有不可或缺的作用：它使自转、天体测量和轨道参数得以被精确测量，而这些参数是理解极端环境物理和整体中子星族群的强有力工具；Parkes 望远镜灵敏且多用途的 UWL 接收机使这些处于 TRAPUM 发现亮端的新源能够被成功计时。摘要未报告具体物理参数结果，也未涉及单脉冲、模式转换、自转减速力矩变化、射电频谱或磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）联系；根据摘要无法判断这些方面的适用性。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fiftythree sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 27 in the Magellanic Clouds, 109 in Globular Clusters and 96 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems, a pulsar with a planetary companion and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

Method: 摘要说明这是一项申请观测时间的提议：继续对 MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星开展计时后续观测，使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机；摘要列出了发现源的观测背景与数量，但未说明具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本筛选、数据处理或统计分析细节。摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告已发现的源数量为：对 Fermi 未识别点源的定向观测中发现四十四（Fourtyfour）个源，两个朝向超新星遗迹，26 个在麦哲伦云中，106 个在球状星团中，87 个在银河系平面巡天中；新发现源中很大一部分是回收脉冲星，包括若干相对论性系统、一颗带有行星伴星的脉冲星和若干“spider”双星，或者是年轻脉冲星；并称 Parkes 的 UWL 接收机正使其能够成功对这些处于 TRAPUM 发现亮端的新源进行计时。

Conclusion: 作者认为计时观测对充分挖掘脉冲星发现潜力不可或缺，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而改进对极端环境物理和中子星总体族群的理解；并认为 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机灵敏且多用途，能够成功计时这些新源。根据摘要无法判断这些新源与磁星、单脉冲发射、快速射电暴（FRB）或其他具体物理机制的关联。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourtyfour sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 26 in the Magellanic Clouds, 106 in Globular Clusters and 87 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems, a pulsar with a planetary companion and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本筛选细节及具体分析流程；仅说明这是一项延续 MeerKAT 发现脉冲星的计时后续观测活动的申请，使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机对 TRAPUM 发现中较亮端的新源进行计时观测。

Result: 摘要报告已发现源的位置分布：针对 Fermi 未识别点源的定向观测中发现四十四（Fourtyfour）个源，两个朝向超新星遗迹，26 个在麦哲伦云中，106 个在球状星团中，87 个在银河系盘巡天中；新发现中很大一部分是再循环脉冲星（包括少数相对论性系统、一颗带行星伴星的脉冲星和若干“spider”双星）或年轻脉冲星。摘要未给出计时测量数值或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为计时观测对充分发挥脉冲星发现的价值不可或缺，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而增进对极端环境物理及中子星整体族群的理解；并认为 Parkes 的 UWL 接收机适合对 TRAPUM 发现中较亮端的新源进行计时。根据摘要无法判断这些源与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲／模式转换等具体物理问题的联系。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourtyfour sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 26 in the Magellanic Clouds, 106 in Globular Clusters and 87 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems, a pulsar with a planetary companion and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

*Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Freire, Paulo,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Buchner, Sarah,Barr, Ewan,Venkatraman Krishnan, Vivek,Karuppusamy, Ramesh,Clark, Colin James,Breton, Rene,Ridolfi, Alessandro,Cognard, Ismaël,Grießmeier, Jean-Mathias,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel,Thongmeearkom, Tinn,Carli, Emma,Turner, James,Prayag, Venu,Sergio, Belmonte Dìaz*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MeerKAT 在定向观测与巡天中已发现大量脉冲星，其中很大一部分为再生脉冲星（含相对论性系统、行星伴星系统和“spider”双星）或年轻脉冲星。要充分发挥这些新发现的科学价值，需要持续的计时观测来获得精确的自转、天体测量与轨道参数，以研究极端环境中的物理和中子星总体族群。摘要未说明此前计时跟踪的具体缺口或完成程度。

Fiftythree sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 27 in the Magellanic Clouds, 109 in Globular Clusters and 96 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems, a pulsar with a planetary companion and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

TL;DR: 本提案申请继续使用 Parkes 望远镜 UWL 接收机对 MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星开展计时随访，以精确测量其自转、天体测量和轨道参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该提案的动机是延续对 MeerKAT 所发现脉冲星的计时随访计划，充分利用这些新发现源（包括再循环脉冲星、相对论性系统、带行星伴星脉冲星、spider 双星和年轻脉冲星）的潜力，通过精确参数测量增进对极端环境物理和中子星族群的理解。

Method: 使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机继续对 MeerKAT（TRAPUM）发现的脉冲星开展计时观测；摘要提到新源来自针对 Fermi 未识别点源、超新星遗迹、麦哲伦云、球状星团和银道面巡天的观测，但具体观测频段、时间跨度、样本筛选和分析流程摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告了 MeerKAT 定向观测中的发现数目：Fermi 未识别点源发现五十三个源，两个朝向超新星遗迹，麦哲伦云中 27 个，球状星团中 109 个，银道面巡天中 96 个；新发现中很大一部分是再循环脉冲星（包括少数相对论性系统、一颗带行星伴星的脉冲星以及若干 spider 双星），或年轻脉冲星。摘要称 UWL 接收机正使这些新源得到成功计时。

Conclusion: 作者认为计时观测对充分挖掘脉冲星发现潜力至关重要，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而为理解极端环境物理以及中子星整体族群提供有力工具；Parkes 的 UWL 接收机适用于对处于 TRAPUM 发现亮端的这些新源进行计时。根据摘要无法判断其对单脉冲、模式转换、自旋下降力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱或磁星—FRB 联系的具体含义。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fiftythree sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 27 in the Magellanic Clouds, 109 in Globular Clusters and 96 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems, a pulsar with a planetary companion and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

Result: 摘要报告 MeerKAT 发现源的分布：Fermi 未识别点源定向观测中五十三个，超新星遗迹方向两个，麦哲伦云 27 个，球状星团 109 个，银河系平面巡天 96 个。新发现中很大一部分是再生脉冲星，包括少数相对论性系统、一颗具有行星伴星的脉冲星以及若干"蜘蛛"双星，此外还有年轻脉冲星。摘要指出 Parkes 的 UWL 接收机正在使这些处于 TRAPUM 发现亮端的新源得到成功计时。摘要未说明具体的计时结果、参数数值或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为计时观测对发挥脉冲星发现的全部潜力至关重要，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而提供改进对极端环境物理以及整体中子星族群理解的工具。因此他们请求继续该计时计划，并认为 Parkes 的 UWL 接收机是灵敏、多用途的仪器，能够成功计时这些新源。根据摘要无法判断与单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、自旋下降力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱、暂现射电或磁星—FRB 联系的具体关系。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fiftythree sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 27 in the Magellanic Clouds, 109 in Globular Clusters and 96 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems, a pulsar with a planetary companion and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

### [2486] [Parkes observations for project P1005 semester 2020APRS_02]()
*Cameron, Andrew,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Bailes, Matthew,Stappers, Benjamin,Champion, David,Balakrishnan, Vishnu*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟对表现出nulling且可能有双星加速证据的1 s脉冲星PSR J1812-15开展高节奏观测，以描绘其轨道并克服nulling造成的困难，从而为这类不寻常的长周期双星脉冲星提供新认识并限制其nulling性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双星脉冲星可用于检验引力、探测中子星状态方程并作为恒星演化化石记录；双星中的长自转周期脉冲星通常比快速自转的再循环脉冲星稀有，是脉冲星双星演化中尚未充分探索的区域。PSR J1812-15为1 s脉冲星，表现出nulling和加速证据，可能处于双星系统，但nulling使轨道解或相位连接解迄今无法确定。

Method: 摘要提出一项有针对性的高节奏观测行动，用于描绘PSR J1812-15的轨道，并在设计中纳入克服其nulling行为所需的冗余；标题表明观测来自Parkes、项目P1005、学期2020APRS_02。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本量、仪器配置及分析方法。

Result: 摘要未报告观测结果。所陈述的情况是PSR J1812-15为1 s脉冲星，表现出nulling行为和明确的加速证据，提示其处于双星系统；由于其nulling行为，确定轨道解或相位连接解迄今被证明不可能。摘要未给出任何测量数值、显著性、脉冲轮廓、偏振、频谱或计时结果。

Conclusion: 作者希望通过对PSR J1812-15的研究，为一个不寻常的脉冲星双星类别提供新见解，并限制该脉冲星的nulling性质。该结论基于所提议的观测，尚未报告观测结果；根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星计时、自旋下降力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱、单脉冲发射、磁星或FRB的联系。

Abstract: We propose to conduct observations of PSR J1812-15, a of 1-s pulsar which exhibits both nulling behaviour and clear evidence of acceleration, suggesting that it is in a binary system. Binary pulsars are valuable objects of scientific study, allowing for a wide range of applications, including tests of gravity, probes of the neutron star equation of state and fossil records of stellar evolution. Long spin-period pulsars in binary systems are generally much rarer than faster-spinning recycled pulsars, and represent an under-explored region of pulsar binary evolution. Due to the nulling behaviour of PSRs J1812-15, determination of an orbital or phase-connected solution has so far proved impossible, but both of these steps are vital in allowing for the pulsar?s continued study. We propose a targeted, high-cadence observing campaign designed to map the orbits of this pulsar while simultaneously factoring in the redundancy required in order to overcome its nulling behaviour. By studying this pulsar, we hope to provide new insight into an unusual class of pulsar binary, as well to constrain the nulling properties of the pulsar.

</details>


### [2487] [Relativistic Magnetic Reconnection in Pair Plasmas and Its Astrophysical Applications]()
*Kagan, D.,Sironi, L.,Cerutti, B.,Giannios, D.*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该综述指出，成对等离子体中相对论磁重联的研究由理论进展与粒子模拟（particle-in-cell）程序的成熟推动，电流片中的碎裂不稳定性可关键地决定重联速度并影响粒子加速、各向异性、体流与辐射，并将该理解应用于脉冲星、脉冲星风云和活动星系核喷流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要指出，需综述相对论区域成对等离子体中磁重联的物理，即磁场拓扑改变并将磁能转化为动能的过程；其研究动力来自理论进展和粒子模拟（particle-in-cell）程序的成熟，并希望把对相对论重联的新理解用于高能天体物理现象。

Method: 摘要说明这是一篇综述，聚焦理论进展和粒子模拟（particle-in-cell）程序成熟所推动的近期进展，并讨论电流片中的碎裂不稳定性及将相对论重联理解应用于高能天体物理现象；具体观测、数据、仪器、频段、时间跨度、样本与统计分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告，近期进展表明电流片中的碎裂不稳定性可以在决定重联速度方面发挥关键作用，并影响由此产生的粒子加速、各向异性、体流和辐射；摘要还说明讨论了如何把这种对相对论重联的新理解应用于高能天体物理现象，重点为脉冲星、脉冲星风云和活动星系核喷流。摘要未给出具体数值、显著性或其他定量结果。

Conclusion: 摘要支持作者将成对等离子体中相对论磁重联的新理解应用于高能天体物理现象，尤其强调脉冲星、脉冲星风云和活动星系核喷流；并指出碎裂不稳定性可关键地影响重联速度以及粒子加速、各向异性、体流和辐射。至于该框架对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、模式转换、计时、自转减速力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱、暂现射电或磁星—快速射电暴（FRB）联系的具体适用性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: This review discusses the physics of magnetic reconnection—a process in which the magnetic field topology changes and magnetic energy is converted to kinetic energy—in pair plasmas in the relativistic regime. We focus on recent progress in the field driven by theory advances and the maturity of particle-in-cell codes. This work shows that fragmentation instabilities at the current sheet can play a critical role in setting the reconnection speed and affect the resulting particle acceleration, anisotropy, bulk flows, and radiation. Then, we discuss how this novel understanding of relativistic reconnection can be applied to high-energy astrophysical phenomena, with an emphasis on pulsars, pulsar wind nebulae, and active galactic nucleus jets.

</details>


### [2488] [Parkes observations for project P574 semester 2023APRS_06]()
*Lower, Marcus,Manchester, Dick,Johnston, Simon,Weltevrede, Patrick,Kerr, Matthew,Shannon, Ryan,Dai, Shi,Sobey, Charlotte,Oswald, Lucy,Parthasarathy, Aditya*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案申请定期观测260颗脉冲星，以为Fermi卫星探测和刻画伽马射线脉冲星提供精确星历表，并推进脉冲轮廓、高能相位分辨谱以及射电波段中子星、脉冲星辐射与ISM研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为利用Fermi卫星探测和刻画伽马射线脉冲星，需要精确的星历表；主要科学目标是增加已知伽马射线脉冲星（射电响亮与射电宁静）数量、确定精确脉冲轮廓并刻画高能相位分辨谱。摘要未说明更具体的知识空白。

Method: 摘要说明申请时间定期观测260颗脉冲星；在射电波段开展观测，用于探测glitches、确定脉冲计时参数，并测量和监测色散量、Faraday旋转量和闪烁；提及P574数据及四篇使用UWL观测的论文。摘要未说明具体望远镜、频率或频段、时间跨度及分析细节。

Result: 摘要报告迄今该合作与P574数据产生95篇以上论文，其中四篇使用UWL观测；这些数据已为来自Bordeaux、Manchester、Oxford、Stanford和Swinburne的学生的博士论文作出贡献。摘要未给出具体脉冲星、glitch、脉冲轮廓、偏振、高能谱或ISM监测的观测结果数值。

Conclusion: 作者认为该定期观测可为Fermi伽马射线脉冲星的探测与刻画提供必要星历表，并有助于增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量、确定精确脉冲轮廓和刻画高能相位分辨谱；射电观测还可支持通过glitches和计时参数研究中子星与脉冲星辐射，以及通过DM、RM和闪烁研究ISM。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、单脉冲、模式转换或FRB的直接物理联系。

Abstract: We request time to observe 260 pulsars on a regular basis in order to provide the accurate ephemerides necessary for the detection and characterisation of gamma-ray pulsars with the Fermi satellite. The main science goals are to increase the number of known gamma-ray pulsars (both radio loud and radio quiet), to determine accurate pulse profiles, and to characterise their high energy (phase-resolved) spectra. In the radio, the observations will also allow us to investigate: neutron stars and pulsar emission via detecting glitches and determining pulse timing parameters; and the ISM via measuring and monitoring dispersion measures, Faraday rotation measures, and scintillation. To date, we are (co-)authors on over 95 papers arising from the collaboration and P574 data, including four which use UWL observations. The data have contributed to the PhD theses of students from Bordeaux, Manchester, Oxford, Stanford, and Swinburne.

</details>

TL;DR: 该申请请求定期观测 260 颗脉冲星（pulsar），以提供精确的星历表，用于 Fermi 卫星对伽马射线脉冲星的探测与刻画，并增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量、确定脉冲轮廓、刻画高能相位分辨谱；射电观测同时用于研究周期跃变与计时参数以及星际介质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为利用 Fermi 卫星探测和刻画伽马射线脉冲星需要精确星历表；当前仍需增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量（含射电噪与射电宁静），并刻画其高能相位分辨谱；同时希望通过射电观测研究周期跃变、计时参数以及星际介质。

Method: 摘要说明：申请时间定期观测 260 颗脉冲星（pulsar），以提供 Fermi 卫星探测和刻画伽马射线脉冲星所需的精确星历表；射电观测将用于探测周期跃变、确定脉冲计时（timing）参数、测量并监测色散量（DM）、法拉第旋转量（RM）和闪烁；提及三篇论文使用 UWL 观测。具体望远镜、频段、时间跨度及分析细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要说明：申请定期观测 260 颗脉冲星（pulsar）；主要目标包括增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量（射电噪和射电宁静）、确定精确脉冲轮廓、刻画高能（相位分辨）谱；射电观测可研究周期跃变、计时参数以及星际介质（ISM）；迄今该合作和 P574 数据已产生 90 多篇论文，其中包括三篇使用 UWL 观测；数据也为来自 Bordeaux、Manchester、Oxford、Stanford 和 Swinburne 的学生的博士论文作出贡献。

Conclusion: 摘要说明：这些观测旨在为 Fermi 卫星探测和刻画伽马射线脉冲星提供所需精确星历表，以增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量（射电噪和射电宁静）、确定精确脉冲轮廓并刻画高能相位分辨谱；射电观测还可通过探测周期跃变、确定计时参数及测量监测 DM、RM、闪烁来研究中子星、脉冲星发射和星际介质。摘要未给出具体的物理推论或 FRB/磁星关联，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We request time to observe 260 pulsars regularly in order to provide the accurate ephemerides necessary for the detection and characterisation of gamma-ray pulsars with the Fermi satellite. The main science goals are to increase the number of known gamma-ray pulsars (both radio-loud and radio-quiet), to determine accurate pulse profiles, and to characterise their high energy (phase-resolved) spectra. In the radio, the observations will also allow us to investigate: neutron stars and pulsar emission via detecting glitches and determining pulse timing parameters; and the ISM via measuring and monitoring dispersion measures, Faraday rotation measures, and scintillation. To date, we are (co-)authors on over 90 papers arising from the collaboration and P574 data, including three which use UWL observations. The data have contributed to the PhD theses of students from Bordeaux, Manchester, Oxford, Stanford, and Swinburne.

</details>

### [2499] [Parkes observations for project P1054 semester 2025APRS_18]()
*Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Freire, Paulo,Weltevrede, Patrick,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Buchner, Sarah,Barr, Ewan,Berezina, Marina,Venkatraman Krishnan, Vivek,Boettcher, Markus,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Clark, Colin James,Breton, Rene,Desvignes, Gregory,Ridolfi, Alessandro,Cognard, Ismaël,Grießmeier, Jean-Mathias,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel,Thongmeearkom, Tinn,Sengupta, Shalini,Voraganti Padmanabh, Prajwal,Carli, Emma,Parthasarathy, Aditya,Men, Yunpeng,Turner, James,Vleeschower, Laila,Prayag, Venu,Pillay, Denisha,Sergio, Belmonte Dìaz,Hurter, Heinrich*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请请求继续用 Parkes 望远镜 UWL 接收机对 MeerKAT 发现的新脉冲星开展计时跟踪，以精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而研究极端环境物理与中子星种群。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MeerKAT 已在 Fermi 未识别点源、超新星遗迹、麦哲伦云、球状星团和银道面巡天中发现大量脉冲星，其中许多为再循环脉冲星或年轻脉冲星；但摘要指出，只有通过计时观测才能充分挖掘这些发现的潜力。

Method: 摘要说明这是一项请求观测时间的申请，拟继续对 MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星进行计时后续跟踪观测，使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机；摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本筛选细节以及数据分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告已发现四十二个源，其中 19 个在麦哲伦云、105 个在球状星团、81 个在银道面巡天，2 个朝向超新星遗迹；新发现中很大一部分是再循环脉冲星（包括少数相对论性系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星）或年轻脉冲星。摘要还称 Parkes 的 UWL 接收机正使这些新源（处于 TRAPUM 发现源的亮端）的计时得以成功进行，但未给出具体计时结果或数值。

Conclusion: 作者认为计时观测对发挥脉冲星发现的全部潜力至关重要，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，并据此增进对极端环境物理和中子星种群的理解；根据摘要无法判断本文所述样本与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射的具体物理联系。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourtytwo sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 19 in the Magellanic Clouds, 105 in Globular Clusters and 81 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者认为，定期观测260颗脉冲星可提供Fermi伽马射线脉冲星探测与表征所需的精确星历，并有助于增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量、确定脉冲轮廓、表征高能相位分辨谱，以及在射电波段研究脉冲星发射与ISM。根据摘要无法判断其对磁星、单脉冲、模式转换、FRB或磁星–FRB联系的直接适用性。

Abstract: We request time to observe 260 pulsars on a regular basis in order to provide the accurate ephemerides necessary for the detection and characterisation of gamma-ray pulsars with the Fermi satellite. The main science goals are to increase the number of known gamma-ray pulsars (both radio loud and radio quiet), to determine accurate pulse profiles, and to characterise their high energy (phase-resolved) spectra. In the radio, the observations will also allow us to investigate: neutron stars and pulsar emission via detecting glitches and determining pulse timing parameters; and the ISM via measuring and monitoring dispersion measures, Faraday rotation measures, and scintillation. To date, we are (co-)authors on over 95 papers arising from the collaboration and P574 data, including four which use UWL observations. The data have contributed to the PhD theses of students from Bordeaux, Manchester, Oxford, Stanford, and Swinburne.

</details>

To date, we are (co-)authors on over 95 papers arising from the collaboration and P574 data, including four which use UWL observations. ### [2502] [Parkes observations for project P1054 semester 2025APRS_09]()
*Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Freire, Paulo,Weltevrede, Patrick,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Buchner, Sarah,Barr, Ewan,Berezina, Marina,Venkatraman Krishnan, Vivek,Boettcher, Markus,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Clark, Colin James,Breton, Rene,Desvignes, Gregory,Ridolfi, Alessandro,Cognard, Ismaël,Grießmeier, Jean-Mathias,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel,Thongmeearkom, Tinn,Sengupta, Shalini,Voraganti Padmanabh, Prajwal,Carli, Emma,Parthasarathy, Aditya,Men, Yunpeng,Turner, James,Vleeschower, Laila,Prayag, Venu,Pillay, Denisha,Sergio, Belmonte Dìaz,Hurter, Heinrich*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案申请继续利用 Parkes 望远镜 UWL 接收机对 MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星开展计时后续观测，以精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而增进对极端环境物理和中子星族群的理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MeerKAT 已发现大量脉冲星，新发现中很大一部分是再循环脉冲星（含少数相对论性系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星）或年轻脉冲星；计时观测对充分发挥这些发现的潜力不可或缺，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数。

Method: 摘要描述了申请 Parkes 望远镜时间继续对 MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星进行计时后续观测，使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机；发现的源包括对 Fermi 未识别点源、超新星遗迹、麦哲伦云、球状星团和银河系盘巡天的观测结果。具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度及分析流程摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告在定向观测中已发现四十二个源：两个朝向超新星遗迹、19 个在麦哲伦云、105 个在球状星团、81 个在银河系盘巡天；新发现源中很大一部分是再循环脉冲星（包括少数相对论性系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星）或年轻脉冲星；Parkes 的 UWL 接收机正在成功对这些新源进行计时，这些源处于 TRAPUM 发现源的亮端。

Conclusion: 作者认为，计时观测能够精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而提供强有力的工具，增进对极端环境中物理以及中子星整体族群的理解；Parkes 的 UWL 接收机灵敏且多用途，可用于对这些新源进行计时。关于磁星、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、极化、射电频谱、自转减慢力矩变化、暂现射电发射或磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourtytwo sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 19 in the Magellanic Clouds, 105 in Globular Clusters and 81 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者的结论是，定期观测260颗脉冲星可提供精确星历表，服务于Fermi卫星对伽马射线脉冲星的探测与刻画，并支持增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量、确定脉冲轮廓和刻画高能相位分辨谱；射电观测也将有助于通过glitch和计时参数研究中子星与脉冲星发射，以及通过色散量、Faraday旋转量和闪烁研究ISM。关于磁星、FRB或单脉冲发射的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We request time to observe 260 pulsars regularly in order to provide the accurate ephemerides necessary for the detection and characterisation of gamma-ray pulsars with the Fermi satellite. The main science goals are to increase the number of known gamma-ray pulsars (both radio-loud and radio-quiet), to determine accurate pulse profiles, and to characterise their high energy (phase-resolved) spectra. In the radio, the observations will also allow us to investigate: neutron stars and pulsar emission via detecting glitches and determining pulse timing parameters; and the ISM via measuring and monitoring dispersion measures, Faraday rotation measures, and scintillation. To date, we are (co-)authors on over 90 papers arising from the collaboration and P574 data, including three which use UWL observations. The data have contributed to the PhD theses of students from Bordeaux, Manchester, Oxford, Stanford, and Swinburne.

</details>

### [2509] [Parkes observations for project P1054 semester 2025APRS_12]()
*Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Freire, Paulo,Weltevrede, Patrick,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Buchner, Sarah,Barr, Ewan,Berezina, Marina,Venkatraman Krishnan, Vivek,Boettcher, Markus,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Clark, Colin James,Breton, Rene,Desvignes, Gregory,Ridolfi, Alessandro,Cognard, Ismaël,Grießmeier, Jean-Mathias,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel,Thongmeearkom, Tinn,Sengupta, Shalini,Voraganti Padmanabh, Prajwal,Carli, Emma,Parthasarathy, Aditya,Men, Yunpeng,Turner, James,Vleeschower, Laila,Prayag, Venu,Pillay, Denisha,Sergio, Belmonte Dìaz,Hurter, Heinrich*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 本提案申请继续利用 Parkes 望远镜 UWL 接收机对 MeerKAT 新发现的脉冲星开展计时后续观测，这些新源包括再生脉冲星、年轻脉冲星以及少数相对论性系统和“蜘蛛”双星，计时观测对精确测量其自转、天体测量和轨道参数至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MeerKAT 已在多种定向观测和巡天中发现大量脉冲星，但任何脉冲星发现的全部潜力都需要计时后续观测才能发挥。摘要指出，精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数有助于理解极端环境中的物理以及中子星总体族群，因此需要继续开展计时观测。

Method: 使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机，对 MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星继续开展计时后续观测。摘要提到的发现来源包括 Fermi 未识别点源定向观测、朝向超新星遗迹的观测、麦哲伦云、球状星团以及银河系平面巡天。摘要未说明观测频率或波段、具体时间跨度、采样细节或计时分析流程。

Result: 摘要报告在定向观测和巡天中已发现四十二个源，其中两个朝向超新星遗迹，19 个在麦哲伦云中，105 个在球状星团中，81 个在银河系平面巡天中。新发现中很大一部分是再生脉冲星，包括少数相对论性系统和几个“蜘蛛”双星，或年轻脉冲星。摘要称 Parkes 的 UWL 接收机使这些新源能够得到成功计时，这些源处于 TRAPUM 发现的亮端。

Conclusion: 作者认为计时观测对于充分利用脉冲星发现至关重要，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而增进对极端环境物理和中子星总体族群的理解；Parkes UWL 接收机的灵敏性和多用途性使其能够成功对这些新源计时。根据摘要无法判断这些结果对单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、自旋下降力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱或磁星与 FRB 联系的具体意义。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourtytwo sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 19 in the Magellanic Clouds, 105 in Globular Clusters and 81 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者认为，定期观测 260 颗脉冲星并提供精确星历表，可用于探测和表征 Fermi 伽马射线脉冲星，并有助于增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量、确定精确脉冲轮廓和表征高能相位分辨能谱；射电观测还使研究中子星与脉冲星辐射以及 ISM 成为可能。该申请与脉冲星计时、glitches、色散量、法拉第旋转量和闪烁等方法相关，但根据摘要无法判断其对磁星、单脉冲发射、模式转换或 FRB 的具体意义。

Abstract: We request time to observe 260 pulsars on a regular basis in order to provide the accurate ephemerides necessary for the detection and characterisation of gamma-ray pulsars with the Fermi satellite. The main science goals are to increase the number of known gamma-ray pulsars (both radio loud and radio quiet), to determine accurate pulse profiles, and to characterise their high energy (phase-resolved) spectra. In the radio, the observations will also allow us to investigate: neutron stars and pulsar emission via detecting glitches and determining pulse timing parameters; and the ISM via measuring and monitoring dispersion measures, Faraday rotation measures, and scintillation. To date, we are (co-)authors on over 95 papers arising from the collaboration and P574 data, including four which use UWL observations. The data have contributed to the PhD theses of students from Bordeaux, Manchester, Oxford, Stanford, and Swinburne.

</details>

TL;DR: 该申请旨在继续利用 Parkes 望远镜 UWL 接收机对 MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星开展计时后续观测，其中相当一部分新发现为再生脉冲星（含相对论系统和“蜘蛛”双星）或年轻脉冲星，计时观测是充分发挥这些发现科学潜力的关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MeerKAT 已在针对 Fermi 未识别点源、超新星遗迹、麦哲伦云、球状星团和银河系平面巡天中大量发现脉冲星，但仅凭发现本身不足以充分利用其科学价值；摘要指出计时观测对充分发挥脉冲星发现潜力具有关键作用，因此需要继续计时后续观测活动。

Method: 申请为继续 MeerKAT 发现脉冲星的计时后续观测活动请求时间，使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机对这些新源进行计时。摘要提到的新发现来源包括针对 Fermi 未识别点源的定向观测、朝向超新星遗迹的观测、麦哲伦云、球状星团以及银河系平面巡天。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、单次观测时长及详细分析流程。

Result: 摘要报告了 MeerKAT 的发现数目：针对 Fermi 未识别点源的定向观测发现四十二个源，两个朝向超新星遗迹，19 个在麦哲伦云，105 个在球状星团，81 个在银河系平面巡天。新发现中很大一部分为再生脉冲星（包括少数相对论系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星），或年轻脉冲星。摘要称 Parkes 望远镜 UWL 接收机能够成功对这些新源进行计时，这些源处于 TRAPUM 发现的亮端。

Conclusion: 作者认为，计时观测可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而为理解极端环境中的物理以及中子星总体族群提供有力工具；Parkes 望远镜 UWL 接收机的灵敏性和多用途性使其能够成功计时这些处于 TRAPUM 发现亮端的新源。根据摘要无法判断该工作与磁星、快速射电暴、单脉冲发射或偏振等主题的具体联系。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourtytwo sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 19 in the Magellanic Clouds, 105 in Globular Clusters and 81 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>


### [2520] [Parkes observations for project P574 semester 2023OCTS_01]()
*Lower, Marcus,Manchester, Dick,Johnston, Simon,Weltevrede, Patrick,Kerr, Matthew,Shannon, Ryan,Dai, Shi,Sobey, Charlotte,Oswald, Lucy,Parthasarathy, Aditya*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请请求定期观测260颗脉冲星，以提供精确星历表，用于Fermi卫星伽马射线脉冲星的探测与刻画，并增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量、确定精确脉冲轮廓、刻画高能（相位分辨）谱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要指出，需要精确星历表来探测和刻画Fermi卫星的伽马射线脉冲星；主要科学目标包括增加已知伽马射线脉冲星（射电响亮和射电宁静）数量、确定精确脉冲轮廓并刻画其高能（相位分辨）谱。射电观测还可用于通过探测glitches和确定脉冲计时参数研究中子星与脉冲星辐射，并通过测量和监测色散量、Faraday旋转测度和闪烁研究ISM。

Method: 摘要说明申请观测260颗脉冲星并定期观测，以提供精确星历表；提及Fermi卫星、射电观测、UWL观测，以及通过探测glitches、确定脉冲计时参数、测量和监测色散量、Faraday旋转测度和闪烁开展研究。摘要未说明具体望远镜、频率或频段、时间跨度、样本筛选、统计方法或计时算法细节。

Result: 摘要称请求时间以定期观测260颗脉冲星；迄今，作者称其（共同）作者了95篇以上源于该合作和P574数据的论文，其中包括四篇使用UWL观测的论文；数据已为来自Bordeaux、Manchester、Oxford、Stanford和Swinburne的学生的博士论文做出贡献。摘要未给出脉冲星具体性质、脉冲轮廓、偏振、射电谱、单脉冲、模式转换、爆发或计时结果的数值或显著性。

Conclusion: 摘要明确的目标是通过这些观测提供精确星历表，支持Fermi卫星伽马射线脉冲星的探测与刻画，增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量、确定精确脉冲轮廓并刻画其高能（相位分辨）谱；射电观测还用于通过glitches和脉冲计时参数研究中子星与脉冲星辐射，并通过DM、RM和闪烁研究ISM。根据摘要无法判断该申请是否已获得观测时间或已产生新的脉冲星、磁星或FRB相关物理结果。

Abstract: We request time to observe 260 pulsars on a regular basis in order to provide the accurate ephemerides necessary for the detection and characterisation of gamma-ray pulsars with the Fermi satellite. The main science goals are to increase the number of known gamma-ray pulsars (both radio loud and radio quiet), to determine accurate pulse profiles, and to characterise their high energy (phase-resolved) spectra. In the radio, the observations will also allow us to investigate: neutron stars and pulsar emission via detecting glitches and determining pulse timing parameters; and the ISM via measuring and monitoring dispersion measures, Faraday rotation measures, and scintillation. To date, we are (co-)authors on over 95 papers arising from the collaboration and P574 data, including four which use UWL observations. The data have contributed to the PhD theses of students from Bordeaux, Manchester, Oxford, Stanford, and Swinburne.

</details>

Result: 摘要报告已发现四十二个源：两个朝向超新星遗迹，19 个在麦哲伦云中，105 个在球状星团中，81 个在银河系平面巡天中。新发现源中很大一部分是再循环脉冲星，包括少数相对论系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星，或为年轻脉冲星。摘要称 Parkes 的 UWL 接收机已成功对这些新源进行计时，这些源处于 TRAPUM 发现源的亮端。摘要未给出具体的计时精度、参数数值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，计时观测能够精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而为理解极端环境中的物理以及整体中子星族群提供有力工具；Parkes 的 UWL 接收机灵敏且多用途，使其能够成功对这些处于 TRAPUM 发现源亮端的 MeerKAT 新发现源进行计时。摘要未给出这些源的进一步物理性质或单个天体的具体结果。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourtytwo sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 19 in the Magellanic Clouds, 105 in Globular Clusters and 81 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

### [2527] [Parkes observations for project P574 semester 2022OCTS_02]()
*Lower, Marcus,Manchester, Dick,Johnston, Simon,Weltevrede, Patrick,Kerr, Matthew,Shannon, Ryan,Dai, Shi,Sobey, Charlotte,Oswald, Lucy,Song, Xiaoxi,Parthasarathy, Aditya*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请请求定期观测 260 颗脉冲星，以提供探测和表征 Fermi 伽马射线脉冲星所需的精确星历表，并增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量、确定脉冲轮廓及表征其高能相位分辨能谱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该文旨在为 Fermi 卫星探测和表征伽马射线脉冲星提供精确星历表；其科学背景是增加已知伽马射线脉冲星（射电明亮与射电宁静）的数量、确定精确脉冲轮廓并表征高能相位分辨能谱，同时利用射电观测研究中子星、脉冲星辐射与 ISM。

Method: 申请对 260 颗脉冲星进行定期观测，以提供精确星历表；摘要提到射电观测、UWL 观测，并涉及探测周期跃变、确定脉冲计时参数、测量和监测色散量（DM）、法拉第旋转量（RM）与闪烁。具体仪器、频段、时间跨度及分析细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告该合作和 P574 数据迄今已产生超过 95 篇论文，其中四篇使用 UWL 观测；这些数据也贡献了来自 Bordeaux、Manchester、Oxford、Stanford 和 Swinburne 学生的博士论文。关于脉冲星计时、周期跃变、脉冲轮廓、高能能谱、DM、RM 或闪烁的具体结果，摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为，对 260 颗脉冲星的定期射电观测可提供探测和表征 Fermi 伽马射线脉冲星所需的精确星历表，并有助于增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量、确定精确脉冲轮廓、表征高能相位分辨能谱，以及通过周期跃变、计时参数、DM、RM 和闪烁研究中子星、脉冲星辐射与 ISM。该申请与脉冲星计时和射电观测方法相关；但与磁星、单脉冲发射、模式转换、自转减慢力矩变化或 FRB 的直接联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We request time to observe 260 pulsars on a regular basis in order to provide the accurate ephemerides necessary for the detection and characterisation of gamma-ray pulsars with the Fermi satellite. The main science goals are to increase the number of known gamma-ray pulsars (both radio loud and radio quiet), to determine accurate pulse profiles, and to characterise their high energy (phase-resolved) spectra. In the radio, the observations will also allow us to investigate: neutron stars and pulsar emission via detecting glitches and determining pulse timing parameters; and the ISM via measuring and monitoring dispersion measures, Faraday rotation measures, and scintillation. To date, we are (co-)authors on over 95 papers arising from the collaboration and P574 data, including four which use UWL observations. The data have contributed to the PhD theses of students from Bordeaux, Manchester, Oxford, Stanford, and Swinburne.

</details>

### [2530] [Parkes observations for project P1054 semester 2025APRS_14]()
*Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Freire, Paulo,Weltevrede, Patrick,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Buchner, Sarah,Barr, Ewan,Berezina, Marina,Venkatraman Krishnan, Vivek,Boettcher, Markus,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Clark, Colin James,Breton, Rene,Desvignes, Gregory,Ridolfi, Alessandro,Cognard, Ismaël,Grießmeier, Jean-Mathias,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel,Thongmeearkom, Tinn,Sengupta, Shalini,Voraganti Padmanabh, Prajwal,Carli, Emma,Parthasarathy, Aditya,Men, Yunpeng,Turner, James,Vleeschower, Laila,Prayag, Venu,Pillay, Denisha,Sergio, Belmonte Dìaz,Hurter, Heinrich*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请请求继续利用 Parkes 望远镜 UWL 接收机对 MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星开展计时后续监测，以精确测量其自转、天体测量与轨道参数；这些新源中很大一部分是再循环脉冲星（含少数相对论性系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星）或年轻脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MeerKAT 已在针对 Fermi 未认证点源、超新星遗迹、麦哲伦云、球状星团及银河系盘巡天中发现大量脉冲星，但要充分发挥这些发现的潜力，需要计时后续观测以精确测量其自转、天体测量和轨道参数；本申请即请求时间继续这一计时后续监测活动。

Method: 利用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机对 MeerKAT 发现的新源开展计时观测，重点针对 TRAPUM 发现源中较亮的一端。摘要提到的发现来源包括针对 Fermi 未认证点源的定向观测、朝向超新星遗迹的观测、麦哲伦云、球状星团以及银河系盘巡天。观测频段、时间跨度与具体分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告已在针对 Fermi 未认证点源的定向观测中发现四十二个源，两个朝向超新星遗迹，19 个在麦哲伦云中，105 个在球状星团中，81 个在银河系盘巡天中。新发现源中有很大一部分是再循环脉冲星，包括少数相对论性系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星，或者是年轻脉冲星。作者表示 Parkes 的 UWL 接收机使他们能够成功地对这些新源计时。摘要未给出计时精度、自转或轨道参数数值。

Conclusion: 作者认为计时观测对充分发挥任何脉冲星发现的潜力具有关键作用，可精确测量自转、天体测量与轨道参数，从而为理解极端环境中的物理以及中子星整体族群提供有力工具；Parkes 的 UWL 接收机是灵敏且多用途的仪器，使他们能够成功对 TRAPUM 发现源亮端的这些新源计时。根据摘要无法判断本研究与磁星、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、自旋下降力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱或快速射电暴（FRB）之间的具体联系。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourtytwo sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 19 in the Magellanic Clouds, 105 in Globular Clusters and 81 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourtytwo sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 19 in the Magellanic Clouds, 105 in Globular Clusters and 81 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

### [2532] [Parkes observations for project P574 semester 2021OCTS_11]()
*Sobey, Charlotte,Manchester, Dick,Johnston, Simon,Weltevrede, Patrick,Kerr, Matthew,Shannon, Ryan,Dai, Shi,Parthasarathy, Aditya,Oswald, Lucy,Lower, Marcus*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请提出以Parkes定期观测260颗脉冲星，为Fermi卫星探测和表征伽马射线脉冲星提供精确星历表，同时用于脉冲星glitch、计时参数以及ISM的DM、RM和闪烁研究；迄今已产生90多篇合作论文并支持多所机构学生的博士论文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为利用Fermi卫星探测和表征伽马射线脉冲星，需要精确的脉冲星星历表；希望通过定期观测增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量（包括射电响亮和射电宁静者），确定精确脉冲轮廓并表征其高能相位分辨谱；同时借射电观测研究中子星、脉冲星辐射及ISM。

Method: 申请时间对260颗脉冲星进行定期观测，以提供Fermi卫星探测和表征伽马射线脉冲星所需的精确星历表；射电观测用于探测glitch、确定脉冲计时参数，并测量和监测色散量、Faraday旋转测度与闪烁。UWL观测被提及用于已发表成果。具体观测频段、时间跨度、观测仪器细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要说明该申请拟定期观测260颗脉冲星；迄今研究者是该合作及P574数据产生的90多篇论文的（共同）作者，其中三篇使用了UWL观测；这些数据也为来自Bordeaux、Manchester、Oxford、Stanford和Swinburne的学生的博士论文做出了贡献。摘要未说明具体的脉冲星glitch、计时参数、DM、RM或闪烁测量结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，定期观测260颗脉冲星可提供探测和表征Fermi伽马射线脉冲星所需的精确星历表，并有助于增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量、确定精确脉冲轮廓和表征高能相位分辨谱；射电观测还可研究中子星和脉冲星辐射以及ISM。根据摘要无法判断与FRB或磁星-快速射电暴关联的具体物理结论。

Abstract: We request time to observe 260 pulsars regularly in order to provide the accurate ephemerides necessary for the detection and characterisation of gamma-ray pulsars with the Fermi satellite. The main science goals are to increase the number of known gamma-ray pulsars (both radio-loud and radio-quiet), to determine accurate pulse profiles, and to characterise their high energy (phase-resolved) spectra. In the radio, the observations will also allow us to investigate: neutron stars and pulsar emission via detecting glitches and determining pulse timing parameters; and the ISM via measuring and monitoring dispersion measures, Faraday rotation measures, and scintillation. To date, we are (co-)authors on over 90 papers arising from the collaboration and P574 data, including three which use UWL observations. The data have contributed to the PhD theses of students from Bordeaux, Manchester, Oxford, Stanford, and Swinburne.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者认为，对260颗脉冲星的定期射电观测可为Fermi卫星探测和表征伽马射线脉冲星提供所需的精确星历表，并可通过探测glitch、确定脉冲计时参数以及测量和监测星际介质效应，用于研究脉冲星发射和星际介质。根据摘要无法判断该工作与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲模式转换之间的关系。

Conclusion: 作者认为，计时观测对于充分发挥任何脉冲星发现的价值不可或缺，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而提供改进对极端环境物理以及中子星整体族群理解的工具；Parkes 的 UWL 接收机是一台灵敏、多用途的仪器，使他们能够成功对这些新源计时。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、单脉冲、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱或快速射电暴（FRB）的联系。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourtytwo sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 19 in the Magellanic Clouds, 105 in Globular Clusters and 81 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. Fourtytwo sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 19 in the Magellanic Clouds, 105 in Globular Clusters and 81 in a survey of the Galactic plane. *Lower, Marcus,Manchester, Dick,Johnston, Simon,Weltevrede, Patrick,Kerr, Matthew,Shannon, Ryan,Dai, Shi,Sobey, Charlotte,Oswald, Lucy,Song, Xiaoxi,Parthasarathy, Aditya*

TL;DR: 该提案申请定期观测 260 颗脉冲星，以提供精确星历表，用于 Fermi 卫星对伽马射线脉冲星的探测与刻画，并同时研究脉冲星发射与 ISM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为利用 Fermi 卫星探测和刻画伽马射线脉冲星，需要精确的星历表；主要科学目标是增加已知伽马射线脉冲星（包括射电响亮与射电宁静）的数量、确定精确脉冲轮廓并刻画其高能（相位分辨）谱。此外还希望借助射电观测研究中子星与脉冲星发射以及 ISM，但摘要未说明所针对的具体知识空白或未解决问题。

Method: 摘要说明申请时间，以定期观测 260 颗脉冲星，为 Fermi 卫星探测和刻画伽马射线脉冲星提供精确星历表；射电观测包括探测 glitches、确定脉冲计时（timing）参数，以及测量和监测色散量、法拉第旋转量和闪烁。摘要未说明望远镜、仪器、观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本选择细节和具体分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告，迄今为止该合作与 P574 数据已（共同）作者发表超过 95 篇论文，其中四篇使用 UWL 观测；这些数据也为来自 Bordeaux、Manchester、Oxford、Stanford 和 Swinburne 的学生的博士论文做出了贡献。摘要未给出具体的脉冲星、glitch、脉冲轮廓、计时参数、色散量、法拉第旋转量或闪烁的测量结果，也未给出数值或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者提出的目标是提供精确星历表以支持 Fermi 卫星探测和刻画伽马射线脉冲星、增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量、确定精确脉冲轮廓并刻画其高能（相位分辨）谱；同时通过射电观测研究中子星和脉冲星发射以及 ISM。摘要未说明关于磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、单脉冲发射、模式转换、自转减慢力矩变化或偏振的具体结论；根据摘要无法判断其与这些主题的物理联系或可迁移性。

Abstract: We request time to observe 260 pulsars on a regular basis in order to provide the accurate ephemerides necessary for the detection and characterisation of gamma-ray pulsars with the Fermi satellite. The main science goals are to increase the number of known gamma-ray pulsars (both radio loud and radio quiet), to determine accurate pulse profiles, and to characterise their high energy (phase-resolved) spectra. In the radio, the observations will also allow us to investigate: neutron stars and pulsar emission via detecting glitches and determining pulse timing parameters; and the ISM via measuring and monitoring dispersion measures, Faraday rotation measures, and scintillation. To date, we are (co-)authors on over 95 papers arising from the collaboration and P574 data, including four which use UWL observations. The data have contributed to the PhD theses of students from Bordeaux, Manchester, Oxford, Stanford, and Swinburne.

</details>

### [2545] [Parkes observations for project P1054 semester 2025APRS_02]()
*Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Freire, Paulo,Weltevrede, Patrick,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Buchner, Sarah,Barr, Ewan,Berezina, Marina,Venkatraman Krishnan, Vivek,Boettcher, Markus,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Clark, Colin James,Breton, Rene,Desvignes, Gregory,Ridolfi, Alessandro,Cognard, Ismaël,Grießmeier, Jean-Mathias,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel,Thongmeearkom, Tinn,Sengupta, Shalini,Voraganti Padmanabh, Prajwal,Carli, Emma,Parthasarathy, Aditya,Men, Yunpeng,Turner, James,Vleeschower, Laila,Prayag, Venu,Pillay, Denisha,Sergio, Belmonte Dìaz,Hurter, Heinrich*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请提出继续对 MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星开展计时后续观测，利用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机对处于 TRAPUM 发现中较亮一端的新源进行计时，以精确测量其自转、天体测量和轨道参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要指出，MeerKAT 在针对 Fermi 未认证点源、超新星遗迹、麦哲伦云、球状星团和银河系盘的观测中已发现大量脉冲星，其中很大一部分是再生脉冲星（含少数相对论系统和若干「spider」双星）或年轻脉冲星。计时观测对于充分利用这些发现、精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数不可或缺，而这些参数可帮助理解极端环境中的物理以及中子星族群的总体情况。

Method: 本申请请求时间以继续对 MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星开展计时后续观测。摘要提到的发现来源包括针对 Fermi 未认证点源的定向观测、朝向南天超新星遗迹的观测、麦哲伦云、球状星团以及一项银河系盘巡天，共涉及不同数量的源。观测使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机对处于 TRAPUM 发现中较亮一端的新源进行计时。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、计时数据采样细节或统计分析流程。

Result: 摘要报告，在针对 Fermi 未认证点源的定向观测中已发现四十二个源，两个朝向南天超新星遗迹，19 个位于麦哲伦云，105 个位于球状星团，81 个位于银河系盘巡天。新发现源中很大一部分是再生脉冲星，包括少数相对论系统和若干「spider」双星，或者是年轻脉冲星。Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机正在使这些新源（处于 TRAPUM 发现中较亮的一端）的计时得以成功进行。摘要未给出具体计时精度、参数测量数值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，计时观测对于充分利用任何脉冲星发现至关重要，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，这些参数是增进对极端环境物理以及中子星整体族群理解的强大工具；Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机灵敏且多用途，能够成功对处于 TRAPUM 发现中较亮一端的新源进行计时。根据摘要无法判断该工作对单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱、暂现射电发射或磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）联系的直接含义。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourtytwo sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 19 in the Magellanic Clouds, 105 in Globular Clusters and 81 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

Motivation: 为利用 Fermi 卫星探测和表征伽马射线脉冲星，需要精确的脉冲星星历表；摘要提出的知识缺口包括增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量（含射电暗与射电宁静者）、确定精确脉冲轮廓并表征其高能相位分辨谱。射电观测还旨在研究脉冲星辐射相关现象和星际介质。

Method: 申请对 260 颗脉冲星进行定期观测，以提供精确星历表；摘要提到将确定脉冲轮廓并表征高能（相位分辨）谱，并计划通过探测周期跃变和确定脉冲计时参数研究脉冲星辐射，通过测量和监测 DM、RM 与闪烁研究 ISM。摘要提及使用 UWL 观测的论文及 P574 数据。观测频率或波段、时间跨度、具体望远镜/仪器名称等：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要所述的主要结果是提出对 260 颗脉冲星进行定期观测的申请；预期科学产出包括增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量、确定精确脉冲轮廓、表征高能相位分辨谱，以及探测周期跃变、确定脉冲计时参数和监测 DM、RM、闪烁。摘要还称，迄今该合作与 P574 数据已产生 90 多篇论文，作者为（共同）作者，其中包括三篇使用 UWL 观测的论文，并已为来自 Bordeaux、Manchester、Oxford、Stanford 和 Swinburne 的学生的博士论文做出贡献。具体观测或分析结果：摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者主张，定期射电观测可获得精确星历表，从而支持 Fermi 卫星对伽马射线脉冲星的探测与表征，并有助于增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量、确定脉冲轮廓和表征高能相位分辨谱；射电数据还可用于研究与脉冲星辐射及 ISM 相关的现象。对磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、单脉冲发射或模式转换的具体联系：根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We request time to observe 260 pulsars regularly in order to provide the accurate ephemerides necessary for the detection and characterisation of gamma-ray pulsars with the Fermi satellite. The main science goals are to increase the number of known gamma-ray pulsars (both radio-loud and radio-quiet), to determine accurate pulse profiles, and to characterise their high energy (phase-resolved) spectra. In the radio, the observations will also allow us to investigate: neutron stars and pulsar emission via detecting glitches and determining pulse timing parameters; and the ISM via measuring and monitoring dispersion measures, Faraday rotation measures, and scintillation. To date, we are (co-)authors on over 90 papers arising from the collaboration and P574 data, including three which use UWL observations. The data have contributed to the PhD theses of students from Bordeaux, Manchester, Oxford, Stanford, and Swinburne.

</details>

### [2550] [Parkes observations for project P1054 semester 2025APRS_10]()
*Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Freire, Paulo,Weltevrede, Patrick,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Buchner, Sarah,Barr, Ewan,Berezina, Marina,Venkatraman Krishnan, Vivek,Boettcher, Markus,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Clark, Colin James,Breton, Rene,Desvignes, Gregory,Ridolfi, Alessandro,Cognard, Ismaël,Grießmeier, Jean-Mathias,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel,Thongmeearkom, Tinn,Sengupta, Shalini,Voraganti Padmanabh, Prajwal,Carli, Emma,Parthasarathy, Aditya,Men, Yunpeng,Turner, James,Vleeschower, Laila,Prayag, Venu,Pillay, Denisha,Sergio, Belmonte Dìaz,Hurter, Heinrich*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案申请时间继续用Parkes望远镜UWL接收机对MeerKAT发现的一批脉冲星开展计时后续观测，这些发现源包括大量毫秒脉冲星（含相对论性系统和“蜘蛛”双星）及年轻脉冲星。摘要强调计时观测对精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数、从而理解极端环境物理和中子星族群至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MeerKAT望远镜在针对Fermi未识别点源、超新星遗迹、麦哲伦云、球状星团和银河系平面巡天中已发现大量脉冲星，其中包括毫秒脉冲星、相对论性系统、“蜘蛛”双星和年轻脉冲星。为充分发挥这些发现的潜力，需要对这些新源开展计时后续观测。摘要未说明此前计时覆盖的具体缺口。

Method: 这是一份申请观测时间的提案，申请继续对MeerKAT发现的脉冲星开展计时后续观测活动，使用Parkes望远镜的UWL接收机对这些位于TRAPUM发现源亮端的新源进行计时。已发现源按观测目标分布为：Fermi未识别点源定向观测42个、朝向超新星遗迹2个、麦哲伦云19个、球状星团105个、银河系平面巡天81个。摘要未说明观测频率或频段、时间跨度、具体分析流程及样本筛选细节。

Result: 摘要报告了MeerKAT已发现的源数分布：针对Fermi未识别点源的定向观测发现42个源，2个朝向超新星遗迹，19个在麦哲伦云中，105个在球状星团中，81个在银河系平面巡天中。新发现源中有很大一部分是毫秒脉冲星，包括少数相对论性系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星，或者是年轻脉冲星。Parkes望远镜的UWL接收机使这些位于TRAPUM发现源亮端的新源能够被成功计时。摘要未给出具体计时结果、数值参数、不确定度或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为计时观测对充分利用脉冲星发现的潜力不可或缺，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，进而增进对极端环境物理和整体中子星族群的理解。摘要表明Parkes望远镜UWL接收机的灵敏性和多用途性使其能够成功对这些新源计时。与磁星、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、自旋下降力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱、暂现射电发射以及磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）之间可能联系的相关性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourtytwo sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 19 in the Magellanic Clouds, 105 in Globular Clusters and 81 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者认为计时观测对于充分发挥任何脉冲星发现的潜力至关重要，可实现自转、天体测量和轨道参数的精确测量，并进而增进对极端环境物理以及中子星族群整体的理解；Parkes UWL接收机使这些新源能够被成功计时。根据摘要无法判断与磁星、快速射电暴、单脉冲发射或脉冲轮廓演化的具体联系。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourtytwo sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 19 in the Magellanic Clouds, 105 in Globular Clusters and 81 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

Motivation: 该申请的科学背景是为Fermi卫星探测和表征伽马射线脉冲星提供精确星历表。其知识缺口在于需要增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量（包括射电响亮和射电安静者）、确定精确脉冲轮廓并表征高能相位分辨谱；射电观测还可研究中子星和脉冲星发射及ISM。

Method: 摘要说明申请时间以定期观测260颗脉冲星，为Fermi卫星探测和表征伽马射线脉冲星提供精确星历表。射电方面将探测glitches、确定脉冲计时参数，并测量和监测色散量、Faraday旋转量和闪烁。摘要提到P574数据及UWL观测，但未说明具体望远镜、接收机、频率或频段、时间跨度、分析流程或统计方法。

Conclusion: 作者明确表述的科学目标是增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量、确定精确脉冲轮廓并表征高能相位分辨谱；射电观测将允许研究中子星和脉冲星发射以及ISM。摘要还陈述了P574数据已产生的论文数量和博士论文贡献。根据摘要无法判断具体物理结论、样本性质或与磁星、FRB等主题的联系。

Abstract: We request time to observe 260 pulsars on a regular basis in order to provide the accurate ephemerides necessary for the detection and characterisation of gamma-ray pulsars with the Fermi satellite. The main science goals are to increase the number of known gamma-ray pulsars (both radio loud and radio quiet), to determine accurate pulse profiles, and to characterise their high energy (phase-resolved) spectra. In the radio, the observations will also allow us to investigate: neutron stars and pulsar emission via detecting glitches and determining pulse timing parameters; and the ISM via measuring and monitoring dispersion measures, Faraday rotation measures, and scintillation. To date, we are (co-)authors on over 95 papers arising from the collaboration and P574 data, including four which use UWL observations. The data have contributed to the PhD theses of students from Bordeaux, Manchester, Oxford, Stanford, and Swinburne.

The main science goals are to increase the number of known gamma-ray pulsars (both radio loud and radio quiet), to determine accurate pulse profiles, and to characterise their high energy (phase-resolved) spectra. In the radio, the observations will also allow us to investigate: neutron stars and pulsar emission via detecting glitches and determining pulse timing parameters; and the ISM via measuring and monitoring dispersion measures, Faraday rotation measures, and scintillation. To date, we are (co-)authors on over 95 papers arising from the collaboration and P574 data, including four which use UWL observations. The data have contributed to the PhD theses of students from Bordeaux, Manchester, Oxford, Stanford, and Swinburne.

</details>

### [2562] [Parkes observations for project P1054 semester 2025APRS_07]()
*Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Freire, Paulo,Weltevrede, Patrick,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Buchner, Sarah,Barr, Ewan,Berezina, Marina,Venkatraman Krishnan, Vivek,Boettcher, Markus,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Clark, Colin James,Breton, Rene,Desvignes, Gregory,Ridolfi, Alessandro,Cognard, Ismaël,Grießmeier, Jean-Mathias,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel,Thongmeearkom, Tinn,Sengupta, Shalini,Voraganti Padmanabh, Prajwal,Carli, Emma,Parthasarathy, Aditya,Men, Yunpeng,Turner, James,Vleeschower, Laila,Prayag, Venu,Pillay, Denisha,Sergio, Belmonte Dìaz,Hurter, Heinrich*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案申请继续对 MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星开展 Parkes UWL 计时后续观测，目标覆盖 Fermi 未识别点源、超新星遗迹、麦哲伦云、球状星团和银道面巡天中发现的新脉冲星，其中许多为再循环脉冲星或年轻脉冲星。计时观测用于精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MeerKAT 已在针对 Fermi 未识别点源、超新星遗迹、麦哲伦云、球状星团和银道面巡天的观测中发现大量脉冲星，其中很大一部分为再循环脉冲星（含相对论性系统和“spider”双星）或年轻脉冲星；要充分利用这些发现，需要持续的计时观测来精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数。

Method: 摘要说明这是一项请求时间以继续对 MeerKAT 所发现脉冲星进行计时后续观测的提案，使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机；发现源来自针对 Fermi 未识别点源的定向观测、朝向超新星遗迹的观测、麦哲伦云、球状星团和银道面巡天，涉及 42、2、19、105、81 个源。观测频率或波段、时间跨度、分析细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：MeerKAT 在针对 Fermi 未识别点源的定向观测中发现四十二个源，两个朝向超新星遗迹，19 个在麦哲伦云，105 个在球状星团，81 个在银道面巡天；新发现源中很大一部分是再循环脉冲星（包括少数相对论性系统和若干“spider”双星）或年轻脉冲星；Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机使这些位于 TRAPUM 发现源亮端的新源得以成功计时。摘要未给出具体计时结果、数值或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者明确支持的是：计时观测对充分挖掘脉冲星发现的潜力不可或缺，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数；这些参数是改进对极端环境物理以及中子星整体族群理解的有力工具，Parkes UWL 接收机则使这些新源的成功计时成为可能。该工作与磁星、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱、自旋减慢力矩变化、瞬变射电发射或磁星与 FRB 的联系是否相关，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourtytwo sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 19 in the Magellanic Clouds, 105 in Globular Clusters and 81 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>


### [2563] [Parkes observations for project P1054 semester 2025APRS_15]()
*Burgay, Marta,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Freire, Paulo,Weltevrede, Patrick,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Buchner, Sarah,Barr, Ewan,Berezina, Marina,Venkatraman Krishnan, Vivek,Boettcher, Markus,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Clark, Colin James,Breton, Rene,Desvignes, Gregory,Ridolfi, Alessandro,Cognard, Ismaël,Grießmeier, Jean-Mathias,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel,Thongmeearkom, Tinn,Sengupta, Shalini,Voraganti Padmanabh, Prajwal,Carli, Emma,Parthasarathy, Aditya,Men, Yunpeng,Turner, James,Vleeschower, Laila,Prayag, Venu,Pillay, Denisha,Sergio, Belmonte Dìaz,Hurter, Heinrich*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 本申请请求继续利用 Parkes 望远镜 UWL 接收机对 MeerKAT（TRAPUM）新发现的脉冲星开展计时后续观测，以精确测量其自转、天体测量和轨道参数；摘要报告新发现源包括大量循环脉冲星（含若干相对论系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星）或年轻脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MeerKAT 已在针对 Fermi 未识别点源、超新星遗迹、麦哲伦云、球状星团和银河系盘巡天中发现了大量脉冲星，其中很大一部分为循环脉冲星（包括若干相对论系统和若干“蜘蛛”双星）或年轻脉冲星。要充分发挥这些新发现的潜力，需要持续计时观测以精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，从而增进对极端环境物理和中子星族群整体的理解。

Method: 摘要说明这是一份请求继续计时后续观测活动的申请，对 MeerKAT 发现的脉冲星进行计时；发现来源包括针对 Fermi 未识别点源的定向观测、朝向超新星遗迹的观测、麦哲伦云、球状星团以及银河系盘巡天。观测使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机。观测频率或波段、时间跨度、具体分析流程（如单脉冲、偏振、RM、DM、频谱或统计方法）摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告在针对 Fermi 未识别点源的定向观测中已发现四十二个源，两个朝向超新星遗迹，19 个在麦哲伦云中，105 个在球状星团中，81 个在银河系盘巡天中。新发现源中很大一部分是循环脉冲星（包括若干相对论系统以及若干“蜘蛛”双星），或者是年轻脉冲星。摘要还指出，Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机是灵敏、多用途的仪器，正使这些处于 TRAPUM 发现源亮端的新源能够被成功计时。摘要未说明具体计时结果、参数数值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，计时观测在充分挖掘任何脉冲星发现潜力方面具有不可或缺的作用，可精确测量自转、天体测量和轨道参数，这些参数为改进对极端环境物理以及中子星整体族群的理解提供了有力工具；Parkes 望远镜灵敏且多用途的 UWL 接收机使这些处于 TRAPUM 发现源亮端的新源得以成功计时。摘要未报告具体的物理机制、单脉冲或模式转换行为、偏振或频谱结果，也未涉及其与磁星或快速射电暴的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: With this proposal we ask time to continue our timing follow-up campaign of pulsars discovered with the MeerKAT telescope. Fourtytwo sources have been discovered in targeted observations of Fermi unidentified point sources, two towards Supernova Remnants, 19 in the Magellanic Clouds, 105 in Globular Clusters and 81 in a survey of the Galactic plane. A large fraction of the new discoveries are recycled pulsars (including a few relativistic systems and several 'spider' binaries), or young pulsars. Timing observations have an essential role in exploiting the full potential of any pulsar discovery, allowing for the precise measurement of rotational, astrometric and orbital parameters which, in turn, give us powerful tools to improve our understanding of the physics in extreme environments as well as of the population of neutron stars as a whole. The UWL receiver of the Parkes telescope is a sensitive, versatile instrument that is allowing us to successfully time these new sources, in the bright-end of TRAPUM discoveries.

</details>

To date, we are (co-)authors on over 90 papers arising from the collaboration and P574 data, including three which use UWL observations. The data have contributed to the PhD theses of students from Bordeaux, Manchester, Oxford, Stanford, and Swinburne.

Conclusion: 作者认为，对260颗脉冲星的定期射电观测可提供探测和刻画伽马射线脉冲星所需的精确星历表，并有助于增加已知伽马射线脉冲星数量、确定脉冲轮廓和刻画高能相位分辨谱；同时可用于通过跃变和计时参数研究中子星与脉冲星发射，并通过色散量、法拉第旋转量和闪烁研究星际介质。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲模式转换的具体联系。

Abstract: We request time to observe 260 pulsars regularly in order to provide the accurate ephemerides necessary for the detection and characterisation of gamma-ray pulsars with the Fermi satellite. The main science goals are to increase the number of known gamma-ray pulsars (both radio-loud and radio-quiet), to determine accurate pulse profiles, and to characterise their high energy (phase-resolved) spectra. In the radio, the observations will also allow us to investigate: neutron stars and pulsar emission via detecting glitches and determining pulse timing parameters; and the ISM via measuring and monitoring dispersion measures, Faraday rotation measures, and scintillation. To date, we are (co-)authors on over 90 papers arising from the collaboration and P574 data, including three which use UWL observations. The data have contributed to the PhD theses of students from Bordeaux, Manchester, Oxford, Stanford, and Swinburne.

</details>
