### [2716] [Parkes observations for project P1012 semester 2019APRS_02]()
*Wang, Shen,Hobbs, George,Cordes, Jim,Lorimer, Duncan Ross,Chatterjee, Shami,Li, Di,Cameron, Andrew,Wang, Pei,Qian, Lei,Zhu, Weiwei,Pan, Zhichen,Lynch, Ryan*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请计划在某一DM范围内确认10颗候选脉冲星，这些候选体是利用新的机器学习排序和图像处理方法在Parkes多波束脉冲星巡天（PMPS）数据中识别出的相对低DM候选体；此前的观测已表明其中两颗排序候选体是先前巡天处理所遗漏的脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PMPS初始处理将相对低S/N候选体归入“tier 2”且从未跟进重观测，因此一批S/N约为8的较弱脉冲星可能尚未被确认为真实脉冲星；需要确认这些低DM候选体，以改善对近邻中子星种群、低DM脉冲星巡天完备性以及未来搜寻巡天设计的认识。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测仪器参数、频率或波段、时间跨度与样本统计细节。摘要说明：使用新的机器学习排序和图像处理方法，在Parkes多波束脉冲星巡天（PMPS）数据中识别出相对低DM候选体；申请对排名最高的接下来十颗候选体开展确认观测。上一轮分配了5小时但因NASA Voyager Voyager跟踪被取消。

Result: 摘要报告：已识别出相对低DM的新候选体，其中10颗拟予以确认；多波束巡天初始处理中被归入“tier 2”的相对低S/N候选体从未跟进重观测；预期大量S/N约为8的相对较弱脉冲星随后会被确认为真实脉冲星。先前观测已表明，排序候选体中的两颗是此前巡天处理所遗漏的脉冲星。上一轮获分配的5小时观测时间因NASA Voyager Voyager跟踪而被取消。

Conclusion: 作者预期确认这些低DM候选脉冲星将显著改善对近邻中子星种群的理解，该种群可能产生影响所有相关实验的伽马射线背景；同时将增进对现有巡天中低DM脉冲星完备性的认识，进而有助于改进未来脉冲星搜寻巡天的设计与性能。根据摘要无法判断该伽马射线背景与FRB或磁星-脉冲星联系的具体关系。

Abstract: This proposal intends to confirm 10 candidate pulsars in a certain dispersion measures (DMs) range. Using new machine learning ranking and image processing methods, we have identified new candidates (with relatively low dispersion measures) in the Parkes Multibeam Pulsar Survey (PMPS) data. The initial processing of the multibeam survey was so successful that relatively low S/N candidates were placed in a "tier 2" category and never followed-up for re-observation. We, therefore, expect that a large number of relatively weak pulsars with S/N ratios around 8 will later be identified as "real" pulsars. We have already shown, with previous observations, that two of our ranked candidates are pulsars that were missed by the previous processing of the survey and wish to carry out confirmation observation of the next ten of our top-ranked candidates. The new discoveries of low-DM pulsars will significantly improve our understanding of the nearby neutron star population, which may generate a gamma-ray background affecting all related experiments. Additionally, it will also improve our knowledge of the completeness of low DM pulsars in existing surveys, and in turn, help improve the design and performance of further pulsar search surveys. In the last round we were allocated 5 hours, but unfortunately, these were canceled because of the NASA Voyager Voyager tracking.

</details>


### [2717] [Parkes observations for project P1012 semester 2019APRS_01]()
*Wang, Shen,Hobbs, George,Cordes, Jim,Lorimer, Duncan Ross,Chatterjee, Shami,Li, Di,Cameron, Andrew,Wang, Pei,Qian, Lei,Zhu, Weiwei,Pan, Zhichen,Lynch, Ryan*

<details>

Conclusion: 作者认为低DM脉冲星的新发现将显著增进对邻近中子星种群的了解，这可能产生影响所有相关实验的伽马射线背景，并将增进对现有巡天中低DM脉冲星完备性的认识，进而有助于改进后续脉冲星搜寻巡天的设计和性能。

Abstract: This proposal intends to confirm 10 candidate pulsars in a certain dispersion measures (DMs) range. Using new machine learning ranking and image processing methods, we have identified new candidates (with relatively low dispersion measures) in the Parkes Multibeam Pulsar Survey (PMPS) data. The initial processing of the multibeam survey was so successful that relatively low S/N candidates were placed in a "tier 2" category and never followed-up for re-observation. We, therefore, expect that a large number of relatively weak pulsars with S/N ratios around 8 will later be identified as "real" pulsars. We have already shown, with previous observations, that two of our ranked candidates are pulsars that were missed by the previous processing of the survey and wish to carry out confirmation observation of the next ten of our top-ranked candidates. The new discoveries of low-DM pulsars will significantly improve our understanding of the nearby neutron star population, which may generate a gamma-ray background affecting all related experiments. Additionally, it will also improve our knowledge of the completeness of low DM pulsars in existing surveys, and in turn, help improve the design and performance of further pulsar search surveys. In the last round we were allocated 5 hours, but unfortunately, these were canceled because of the NASA Voyager Voyager tracking.

</details>


### [2718] [Parkes observations for project P1021 semester 2019OCTS_01]()
*Cameron, Andrew,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Bailes, Matthew,Stappers, Benjamin,Champion, David,Balakrishnan, Vishnu*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划对长轨道（1.5-yr）、951-ms脉冲星PSR J1653-45开展高节奏观测，以监测其长达半个轨道周期的延长食并获取轨道与计时信息；摘要未给出实际观测结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长自转周期脉冲星双星比快速自转的“再循环”脉冲星罕见得多，是脉冲星双星演化中探索不足的区域。PSR J1653-45处于1.5-yr长轨道且存在本质不明的延长食，这些食还阻碍了轨道和相位连接计时解的确定，因此需要专门观测以继续研究该系统。

Method: 摘要提出开展针对PSR J1653-45的高节奏观测 campaña，监测其进入食态的过程，以研究食对脉冲星辐射特性的影响，并在其最少被探索的轨道区域提取轨道信息。摘要未说明具体望远镜、观测频率或频段、观测时间跨度、数据量、样本规模及具体分析方法。

Result: 该摘要为观测提案，未报告实际观测结果。摘要中明确给出的系统性质包括：PSR J1653-45自转周期为951-ms，处于1.5-yr轨道中，并经历持续时间可长达轨道周期一半的延长食；这些食已阻碍轨道与相位连接计时解的确定。摘要未说明食的具体性质、辐射特性变化或计时结果。

Conclusion: 作者期望通过监测食对脉冲星辐射特性的影响来揭示食本身的性质，并通过在最少被探索的轨道区域提取信息来约束并有望解出轨道，进而建立计时解，从而更好地理解该脉冲星及其在这类未再循环脉冲星双星中的位置。这些均为拟议目标，而非已确立结论；根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲偏振等主题的具体联系。

Abstract: We propose to conduct observations of PSR J1653-45, a 951-ms pulsar in a long, 1.5-yr orbit. Binary pulsars are valuable objects of scientific study, allowing for a wide range of applications, including tests of gravity, probes of the neutron star equation of state, and fossil records of stellar evolution. Long spin-period pulsars in binary systems are generally much rarer than faster-spinning `recycled' pulsars, and represent an under-explored region of pulsar binary evolution. In addition to its long orbital period, PSR J1653-45 also experiences extended eclipses, lasting up to half of the orbital period and whose nature is not well understood. These eclipses have also prevented the determination of an orbital of phase-connected timing solution, both vital steps in allowing for the continued study of this system. We propose a targeted, high-cadence observing campaign designed to monitor this pulsar as it transition into its eclipsing state. The campaign has the twin goals of both monitoring how the eclipse affects the pulsar's emission properties, thereby revealed more about the nature of the eclipses themselves, and of extracting as much information regarding the pulsar's orbit during its least-explored regions, thereby constrained and hopefully solving the pulsar's orbit and ideally leading to the development of a timing solution. In both instances, we hope to gain a greater understanding of this pulsar's properties and how it fits into this under-explored class of unrecycled pulsar binaries.

</details>


### [2719] [Parkes observations for project P1021 semester 2019OCTS_14]()
*Cameron, Andrew,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, S.,Kramer, Michael,Bailes, Matthew,Stappers, Benjamin,Champion, David,Balakrishnan, Vishnu*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划用Parkes对951 ms脉冲星PSR J1653-45开展高节奏观测，在其进入延长的食（可达轨道周期一半）期间同时监测食对发射性质的影响，并约束、有望求解其1.5 yr轨道进而建立计时解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双星脉冲星可用于引力检验、中子星状态方程探测和恒星演化研究；长自转周期的双星脉冲星远比快速自转的“再生”脉冲星稀有，是脉冲星双星演化中尚未被充分探索的区域。PSR J1653-45的延长食（可达轨道周期一半）性质不清，并阻碍了轨道解与相位连接计时解的确定。

Method: 摘要未说明具体望远镜与接收机、观测频率或波段、观测时间跨度、样本量与数据分析方法。所提议的是针对PSR J1653-45的一项有目标的、高节奏观测运动，设计用于在该脉冲星向其实食状态转变时对其进行监测。

Result: 摘要未报告观测结果。摘要陈述的背景信息为：PSR J1653-45自转周期为951 ms，处于一个长达1.5 yr的轨道中，并经历持续时间可达轨道周期一半的延长食；这些食阻碍了轨道解以及相位连接的计时解的确定。

Conclusion: 提案作者希望，通过监测食对脉冲星发射性质的影响，可揭示更多关于食本身性质的信息；同时通过在该脉冲星最少被探索的轨道区域提取轨道信息，可约束并有望求解其轨道，并理想情况下促成计时解的建立。作者希望由此更好地理解该脉冲星的性质及其在尚未被充分探索的未再生脉冲星双星类中的地位。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、单脉冲发射、模式转换、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱、瞬变射电发射或快速射电暴（FRB）的关联。

Abstract: We propose to conduct observations of PSR J1653-45, a 951-ms pulsar in a long, 1.5-yr orbit. Binary pulsars are valuable objects of scientific study, allowing for a wide range of applications, including tests of gravity, probes of the neutron star equation of state, and fossil records of stellar evolution. Long spin-period pulsars in binary systems are generally much rarer than faster-spinning `recycled' pulsars, and represent an under-explored region of pulsar binary evolution. In addition to its long orbital period, PSR J1653-45 also experiences extended eclipses, lasting up to half of the orbital period and whose nature is not well understood. These eclipses have also prevented the determination of an orbital of phase-connected timing solution, both vital steps in allowing for the continued study of this system. We propose a targeted, high-cadence observing campaign designed to monitor this pulsar as it transition into its eclipsing state. The campaign has the twin goals of both monitoring how the eclipse affects the pulsar's emission properties, thereby revealed more about the nature of the eclipses themselves, and of extracting as much information regarding the pulsar's orbit during its least-explored regions, thereby constrained and hopefully solving the pulsar's orbit and ideally leading to the development of a timing solution. In both instances, we hope to gain a greater understanding of this pulsar's properties and how it fits into this under-explored class of unrecycled pulsar binaries.

</details>

### [2722] [Parkes observations for project P1021 semester 2019OCTS_05]()
*Cameron, Andrew,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Bailes, Matthew,Stappers, Benjamin,Champion, David,Balakrishnan, Vishnu*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟对951-ms脉冲星PSR J1653-45开展高节奏观测，以研究其处于1.5-yr轨道中的延展食如何影响其发射性质，并约束其轨道、争取建立计时解，从而增进对未再循环脉冲星双星这一尚少探索类别的理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双星脉冲星可用于引力检验、中子星状态方程探测和恒星演化研究；长自转周期脉冲星双星比再循环脉冲星稀少，属脉冲星双星演化中尚未被充分探索的区域。PSR J1653-45轨道周期长且经历性质不明的延展食，食还妨碍了轨道相位连通计时解的确定，需持续研究。

Method: 摘要提到拟开展针对PSR J1653-45的有针对性、高节奏观测活动，在该脉冲星过渡进入食状态时进行监测，以研究食对其发射性质的影响并提取其最少被探索轨道区域的信息。观测所用望远镜或仪器、频率或波段、时间跨度、样本量以及具体分析或计时方法：摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者提出的目标是：通过监测食如何影响脉冲星发射性质来揭示更多关于食本身性质的信息；同时尽可能提取该脉冲星最少被探索轨道区域的信息，从而约束并有望求解其轨道，理想情况下建立计时解；最终希望更深入理解该脉冲星性质及其在这一尚未被充分探索的未再循环脉冲星双星类别中的位置。这是提议的目标与预期，摘要未报告已实现的结果；对磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、单脉冲发射、自转减慢力矩变化或偏振等主题：根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose to conduct observations of PSR J1653-45, a 951-ms pulsar in a long, 1.5-yr orbit. Binary pulsars are valuable objects of scientific study, allowing for a wide range of applications, including tests of gravity, probes of the neutron star equation of state, and fossil records of stellar evolution. Long spin-period pulsars in binary systems are generally much rarer than faster-spinning `recycled' pulsars, and represent an under-explored region of pulsar binary evolution. In addition to its long orbital period, PSR J1653-45 also experiences extended eclipses, lasting up to half of the orbital period and whose nature is not well understood. Motivation: 处于双星系统中的长自转周期脉冲星比自转更快的“再循环”脉冲星稀少得多，是脉冲星双星演化中探索不足的区域。PSR J1653-45 还经历最长可达轨道周期一半的食，其性质尚不清楚，并妨碍了其轨道和相位连接计时解的确定。

Method: 摘要未说明具体的观测仪器、接收机、频率或频段、观测时长、数据量与分析流程。摘要仅说明拟开展一项针对 PSR J1653-45 的有针对性、高节奏观测 campaña，用于监测该脉冲星进入食状态的过程，并用于提取关于其轨道的更多信息、约束并有望求解其轨道，进而建立计时解；未说明具体采用计时、单脉冲、脉冲轮廓、偏振、RM、DM 或频谱分析等方法。

Result: 摘要未报告已获得的观测结果。摘要说明 PSR J1653-45 的自转周期为 951-ms，轨道周期为 1.5-yr，其食持续时间较长，最长可达轨道周期的一半；这些食的性质尚未被很好地理解。摘要还说明这些食一直妨碍该脉冲星轨道以及相位连接计时解的确定。摘要未给出任何探测显著性、数值测量结果或统计分析结论。

Conclusion: 作者提出的观测 campaña 预期通过监测食对脉冲星辐射性质的影响来揭示更多关于食性质的信息，并通过在最少被探索的轨道区域获取轨道信息来约束并有望求解该脉冲星的轨道，理想情况下促成计时解的建立。作者希望由此更好地理解该脉冲星的性质，以及它在探索不足的未再循环脉冲星双星类别中的位置。根据摘要无法判断这些目标能否实现，也无法判断该工作与磁星、快速射电暴、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、偏振或射电频谱之间的联系。

Abstract: We propose to conduct observations of PSR J1653-45, a 951-ms pulsar in a long, 1.5-yr orbit. Binary pulsars are valuable objects of scientific study, allowing for a wide range of applications, including tests of gravity, probes of the neutron star equation of state, and fossil records of stellar evolution. Long spin-period pulsars in binary systems are generally much rarer than faster-spinning `recycled' pulsars, and represent an under-explored region of pulsar binary evolution. In addition to its long orbital period, PSR J1653-45 also experiences extended eclipses, lasting up to half of the orbital period and whose nature is not well understood. These eclipses have also prevented the determination of an orbital of phase-connected timing solution, both vital steps in allowing for the continued study of this system. We propose a targeted, high-cadence observing campaign designed to monitor this pulsar as it transition into its eclipsing state. The campaign has the twin goals of both monitoring how the eclipse affects the pulsar's emission properties, thereby revealed more about the nature of the eclipses themselves, and of extracting as much information regarding the pulsar's orbit during its least-explored regions, thereby constrained and hopefully solving the pulsar's orbit and ideally leading to the development of a timing solution. In both instances, we hope to gain a greater understanding of this pulsar's properties and how it fits into this under-explored class of unrecycled pulsar binaries.

</details>

Abstract: We propose to continue our observations of PSR J1653-45, a 951-ms pulsar in a long, 1.5-yr orbit. Binary pulsars are valuable objects of scientific study, allowing for a wide range of applications, including tests of gravity, probes of the neutron star equation of state, and fossil records of stellar evolution. Long spin-period pulsars in binary systems are generally much rarer than faster-spinning `recycled' pulsars, and represent an under-explored region of pulsar binary evolution. In addition to its long orbital period, PSR J1653-45 also experiences extended eclipses, lasting up to half of the orbital period and whose nature is not well understood. These eclipses have also prevented the determination of an orbital or phase-connected timing solution, both vital steps in allowing for the continued study of this system. We propose a targeted, high-cadence observing campaign designed to monitor this pulsar as it transitions out of its eclipsing state. The campaign has the twin goals of both monitoring how the eclipse affects the pulsar's emission properties, thereby revealed more about the nature of the eclipses themselves, and of extracting as much information regarding the pulsar's orbit during its least-explored regions, thereby constrained and hopefully solving the pulsar's orbit and ideally leading to the development of a timing solution. In both instances, we hope to gain a greater understanding of this pulsar's properties and how it fits into this under-explored class of unrecycled pulsar binaries.

</details>

Result: 摘要未报告实际观测结果。作为提案背景，摘要陈述：PSR J1653-45为951-ms脉冲星，轨道周期1.5 yr；其延长食最长可占轨道周期的一半，本质尚不很清楚；这些食已妨碍轨道及相位连接计时解的确定。所提议观测活动的预期产出为监测食对辐射特性的影响，并约束和有望解出轨道，理想情况下建立计时解。

Conclusion: 作者希望通过高节奏监测理解食的本质及其对脉冲星辐射特性的影响，约束并有望解出PSR J1653-45的轨道，理想情况下建立计时解，从而增进对这颗脉冲星性质的理解及其在未循环再造脉冲星双星这一尚未被充分探索类别中的位置。根据摘要无法判断该工作与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射的具体物理联系。

Abstract: We propose to conduct observations of PSR J1653-45, a 951-ms pulsar in a long, 1.5-yr orbit. Binary pulsars are valuable objects of scientific study, allowing for a wide range of applications, including tests of gravity, probes of the neutron star equation of state, and fossil records of stellar evolution. Long spin-period pulsars in binary systems are generally much rarer than faster-spinning `recycled' pulsars, and represent an under-explored region of pulsar binary evolution. In addition to its long orbital period, PSR J1653-45 also experiences extended eclipses, lasting up to half of the orbital period and whose nature is not well understood. These eclipses have also prevented the determination of an orbital of phase-connected timing solution, both vital steps in allowing for the continued study of this system. We propose a targeted, high-cadence observing campaign designed to monitor this pulsar as it transition into its eclipsing state. The campaign has the twin goals of both monitoring how the eclipse affects the pulsar's emission properties, thereby revealed more about the nature of the eclipses themselves, and of extracting as much information regarding the pulsar's orbit during its least-explored regions, thereby constrained and hopefully solving the pulsar's orbit and ideally leading to the development of a timing solution. In both instances, we hope to gain a greater understanding of this pulsar's properties and how it fits into this under-explored class of unrecycled pulsar binaries.

</details>

Abstract: We propose to continue our observations of PSR J1653-45, a 951-ms pulsar in a long, 1.5-yr orbit, and experiences apparent eclipses whose duration and nature have yet to be fully understood. Binary pulsars are valuable objects of scientific study, allowing for a wide range of applications, including tests of gravity, probes of the neutron star equation of state, and fossil records of stellar evolution. Long spin-period pulsars in binary systems are generally much rarer than faster-spinning `recycled' pulsars, and represent an under-explored region of pulsar binary evolution. Based upon previous Parkes proposals, our understanding of this pulsar has significantly increased. We have detected the pulsar in previously unexplored regions of its orbit, and have constrained the duration of the eclipse, such that a targeted campaign in the 2021APRS semester (during which the next eclipse is expected) will provide the breakthrough needed to solve and understand this pulsar. For the 2020OCTS semester, we propose a lower-cadence monitoring campaign, intended to allow these future observations to be successfully-phase connected with the existing dataset, maximising their scientific utility. We also propose to conduct a small set of high-cadence observations of PSR J1653-45 intended to characterise its emission and explore any short-term variability which may be inhibiting our ability to determine a timing solution. Through this, we hope to gain a greater understanding of this pulsar's properties and how it fits into this under-explored class of unrecycled pulsar binaries.

Result: 摘要报告：基于此前 Parkes 提案，对该脉冲星的理解已显著增加；已在该脉冲星轨道此前未探索的区域探测到它，并已约束食的持续时间；预计下次食发生于 2021APRS 学期。提案认为 2021APRS 学期的针对性观测活动将提供解决和理解该脉冲星所需的突破；2020OCTS 学期的低 cadence 监测旨在使未来观测与现有数据集成功相位连接，最大化其科学效用；高 cadence 观测旨在刻画辐射并探索可能妨碍确定计时解的短时标变化。具体数值、显著性及食的物理性质：摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者明确提出，2021APRS 学期针对下次预计食的观测活动将提供解决和理解该脉冲星所需的突破；2020OCTS 学期的低 cadence 监测将有助于未来观测与现有数据集进行相位连接，从而最大化科学效用；一小组高 cadence 观测旨在刻画其辐射并探索可能妨碍确定计时解的短时标变化；通过这些工作，作者希望更好地理解该脉冲星特性以及它如何融入尚未被充分探索的未再循环脉冲星双星类别。该脉冲星食的物理机制及对磁星、FRB 或其他领域的意义：根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose to continue our observations of PSR J1653-45, a 951-ms pulsar in a long, 1.5-yr orbit, and experiences apparent eclipses whose duration and nature have yet to be fully understood. Binary pulsars are valuable objects of scientific study, allowing for a wide range of applications, including tests of gravity, probes of the neutron star equation of state, and fossil records of stellar evolution. Long spin-period pulsars in binary systems are generally much rarer than faster-spinning `recycled' pulsars, and represent an under-explored region of pulsar binary evolution. Based upon previous Parkes proposals, our understanding of this pulsar has significantly increased. We have detected the pulsar in previously unexplored regions of its orbit, and have constrained the duration of the eclipse, such that a targeted campaign in the 2021APRS semester (during which the next eclipse is expected) will provide the breakthrough needed to solve and understand this pulsar. For the 2020OCTS semester, we propose a lower-cadence monitoring campaign, intended to allow these future observations to be successfully-phase connected with the existing dataset, maximising their scientific utility. We also propose to conduct a small set of high-cadence observations of PSR J1653-45 intended to characterise its emission and explore any short-term variability which may be inhibiting our ability to determine a timing solution. Through this, we hope to gain a greater understanding of this pulsar's properties and how it fits into this under-explored class of unrecycled pulsar binaries.

</details>

Abstract: We propose to continue our observations of PSR J1653-45, a 951-ms pulsar in a long, 1.5-yr orbit, and experiences apparent eclipses whose duration and nature have yet to be fully understood. Binary pulsars are valuable objects of scientific study, allowing for a wide range of applications, including tests of gravity, probes of the neutron star equation of state, and fossil records of stellar evolution. Based upon previous Parkes proposals, our understanding of this pulsar has significantly increased. We have detected the pulsar in previously unexplored regions of its orbit, and have constrained the duration of the eclipse, such that a targeted campaign in the 2021APRS semester (during which the next eclipse is expected) will provide the breakthrough needed to solve and understand this pulsar. For the 2020OCTS semester, we propose a lower-cadence monitoring campaign, intended to allow these future observations to be successfully-phase connected with the existing dataset, maximising their scientific utility. ### [2750] [Parkes observations for project P602 semester 2009APRS_01]()
*Camilo, Fernando,Johnston, Simon,Sarkissian, John,Reynolds, John,Ransom, Scott,Halpern, Jules*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案申请继续用Parkes研究已知仅有的两颗发射射电脉冲的磁星，重点是以近每周计时追踪1E 1547.0-5408的自转，该星在2008年10月3日发生大X射线爆发和非常大的周期突变后射电辐射停止，并于12月11日被重新探测到射电活动，同时其力矩继续发生巨大变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已知仅有两颗磁星发射射电脉冲；需要更具体地理解其超强磁场的动力学行为，因为该磁场与X射线和伽马射线爆发、磁层电流和粒子加速以及中子星表面加热有关。1E 1547.0-5408无法用北半球望远镜观测，且近期异常活跃，因此需要持续跟踪。

Method: 摘要未说明。摘要提到在Parkes申请近乎每周的计时以可靠追踪1E 1547.0-5408的自转，同时用Swift卫星监测其X射线通量；对两颗磁星申请每两月一次的偏振测量和通量测量。摘要未给出具体接收机、观测频段、观测频率、样本量或时间跨度细节。

Result: 1E 1547.0-5408在过去几个月中异常活跃：2008年10月3日该脉冲星出现一次大X射线爆发，并伴随一次非常大的周期突变（glitch）；与此同时射电辐射停止。X射线通量正在逐渐衰减，12月11日重新探测到射电活动。与此同时，该星所受的力矩继续发生巨大变化。摘要未给出其他定量结果。

Conclusion: 作者提议继续研究仅有的两颗射电脉冲磁星，以发展对其超强磁场动力学行为更具体的理解，并将这些磁场与X射线和伽马射线爆发、磁层电流和粒子加速以及中子星表面加热联系起来。根据摘要无法判断更具体的物理机制，也无法判断该工作对脉冲星、磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）关联的可迁移性。

Abstract: Here we propose to continue studying the only two magnetars known to emit radio pulsations. The aim is to develop a more specific understanding of the dynamical behavior of their ultra-strong magnetic fields, which are responsible for X-ray and gamma-ray outbursts, magnetospheric currents and particle acceleration, and heating of the neutron star surface. Most of our time request is for 1E 1547.0-5408, which cannot be observed with northern telescopes, and has been remarkably active over the past few months: on October 3, 2008, the pulsar displayed a large X-ray outburst, accompanied by a very large period glitch; at the same time radio emission ceased. The X-ray flux is gradually decaying, and on December 11 we have redetected radio activity. Meanwhile, the torque on the star continues to vary enormously. At Parkes we will require nearly weekly timing to reliably track its rotation, while we monitor its X-ray flux with the Swift satellite. For both magnetars we also request bi-monthly polarimetry and flux measurements.

</details>


### [2751] [Parkes observations for project P1050 semester 2021APRS_17]()
*Sengar, Rahul,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Morello, Vincent,Bhandari, Shivani,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Wongphechauxsorn, Jompoj,Chen, Weiwei,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请提出在 2021APRS 学期对 HTRU 银道面巡天（P630）重新处理中新发现和待确认的脉冲星开展后续计时；目前已用 GPU 相干加速度搜索、模板库和 fast folding algorithm 流程完成巡天 80 %，新发现 68 颗脉冲星和 21 颗等待确认的 “class A” 脉冲星。该计时计划将对新发现的 DNS 系统 J1325-6253 以及已确认/待确认脉冲星进行计时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新脉冲星的有趣科学通常只有在确认并开展后续计时后才能获得；一年初始计时是充分刻画新发现脉冲星、推导特征年龄、磁场强度和自转减慢率等参数并探测可能由发射不稳定性引起意外行为的最短时间跨度。该计时项目对上一学期发现的 DNS 系统 J1325-6253 的计时，以及跟进 HTRU 银道面巡天已确认/待确认新脉冲星是必要的。

Method: 摘要说明这是为 2021APRS 学期申请观测时间的计时项目；使用基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、模板库和 fast folding algorithm 流程重新处理 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域，目前已完成 80 %。观测列表上的脉冲星已确认，其余候选体将在 2020OCTS 学期确认。具体观测仪器、频率或波段、时间跨度细节和统计方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告已使用基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、模板库和 fast folding algorithm 流程完成 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域的 80 %，发现 68 颗此前未知的脉冲星和 21 颗等待确认的 “class A” 脉冲星。上一学期发现了新双中子星（DNS）系统 J1325-6253。其余候选体将在当前 2020OCTS 学期确认；摘要未说明已获得的计时结果、数值参数或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，一年的初始计时是充分刻画新发现脉冲星、推导特征年龄、磁场强度和自转减慢率等参数并探测可能由发射不稳定性引起意外行为的最短时间跨度；2021APRS 的后续计时将产生全新的、令人兴奋的结果。该计时项目将使作者能够测量 PSR J1325-6253 的近星点进动、真实的银道面脉冲星族群以及银道面中脉冲星参数空间的边界。摘要未提及与磁星、快速射电暴、单脉冲发射或偏振的直接联系；根据摘要无法判断这些联系。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the timing campaign of new pulsar discoveries from the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed 80 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search, template bank and fast folding algorithm pipelines, and now have discovered 68 previously unknown pulsars and 21 "class A" pulsars awaiting confirmation. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This timing project is necessary for the timing of the new double neutron star (DNS) system J1325-6253 discovered last semester and for following up our confirmed/to-be confirmed new pulsars from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. Pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed and remaining candidates will be confirmed in the current 2020OCTS semester, the follow-up timing in 2021APRS will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will allow us to measure the advance of periastron of PSR J1325-6253, true Galactic plane pulsar population and boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

</details>


### [2752] [Parkes observations for project P1050 semester 2021APRS_07]()
*Sengar, Rahul,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Morello, Vincent,Bhandari, Shivani,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Wongphechauxsorn, Jompoj,Chen, Weiwei,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请请求为 HTRU 银道面巡天（P630）重处理新发现的脉冲星开展计时观测，已发现 68 颗新脉冲星和 21 颗待确认的“class A”脉冲星，并需对上一学期发现的双中子星系统 J1325-6253 进行计时。一年的初始计时是推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率并探测发射不稳定性所致异常行为的最低要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新发现脉冲星通常需在确认后经过计时 campaña 才能获得有意义的科学结果；一年的初始计时是充分刻画新脉冲星、推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率并探测可能由发射不稳定性引起异常行为所需的最短时间跨度，因此需要对 HTRU 银道面巡天的新脉冲星及 DNS 系统 J1325-6253 开展后续计时。

Method: 摘要说明这是为 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域重处理所发现新脉冲星提出的计时 campaña 观测时间申请；巡天已使用基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、模板库以及快速折叠算法流程完成 80 %；观测清单中的脉冲星已被确认，其余候选体将在 2020OCTS 学期确认；计划于 2021APRS 进行后续计时。具体望远镜、频率、数据量、统计方法等摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告已发现 68 颗此前未知的脉冲星和 21 颗等待确认的“class A”脉冲星，巡天已完成 80 %；上一学期发现了新双中子星（DNS）系统 J1325-6253；观测清单上的脉冲星已确认，其余候选体将在 2020OCTS 学期确认，2021APRS 后续计时预计产生全新结果，并测量 J1325-6253 的近星点进动、真实银道面脉冲星族群和银道面脉冲星参数空间边界。

Conclusion: 作者认为应对新发现脉冲星进行确认与计时，一年的初始计时是充分刻画脉冲星、推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率并探测发射不稳定性所致异常行为的最低要求；该计时项目对 DNS 系统 J1325-6253 的计时和 HTRU 银道面巡天新脉冲星的跟踪是必要的，并将测量 J1325-6253 的近星点进动、真实银道面脉冲星族群和银道面脉冲星参数空间边界。对单脉冲、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱或磁星/FRB 联系的适用性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the timing campaign of new pulsar discoveries from the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed 80 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search, template bank and fast folding algorithm pipelines, and now have discovered 68 previously unknown pulsars and 21 "class A" pulsars awaiting confirmation. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This timing project is necessary for the timing of the new double neutron star (DNS) system J1325-6253 discovered last semester and for following up our confirmed/to-be confirmed new pulsars from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. Pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed and remaining candidates will be confirmed in the current 2020OCTS semester, the follow-up timing in 2021APRS will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will allow us to measure the advance of periastron of PSR J1325-6253, true Galactic plane pulsar population and boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

</details>


### [2753] [Parkes observations for project P1050 semester 2021APRS_11]()

TL;DR: 本申请为 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域重新处理中新发现的脉冲星申请 2021APRS 学期的后续计时观测；该巡天已利用基于 GPU 的相干加速搜索、模板库和快速折叠算法流水线完成 80%，发现 68 颗此前未知脉冲星和 21 颗等待确认的“class A”脉冲星，计时旨在表征新脉冲星并测量新 DNS 系统 J1325-6253 的近星点进动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新发现的脉冲星通常只有在确认并开展后续计时观测后才能得出有意义的科学结果；一年初始计时是充分表征新脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度，否则无法推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等参数，也无法探测可能由发射不稳定性导致的意外行为。因此需要为 HTRU 银道面巡天重新处理所得的新脉冲星申请计时观测。

Method: 摘要说明这是一份 2021APRS 学期的计时观测申请，针对 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域重新处理所发现的新脉冲星；巡天数据处理采用基于 GPU 的相干加速搜索、模板库和快速折叠算法流水线，并已完成巡天的 80%。观测列表中的脉冲星已被确认，其余候选体将在 2020OCTS 学期确认；拟开展一年初始计时以表征新脉冲星。其余具体观测细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告，利用基于 GPU 的相干加速搜索、模板库和快速折叠算法流水线，已（在 2020OCTS 前）完成 HTRU 低银纬银道面区域巡天的 80%，发现 68 颗此前未知的脉冲星和 21 颗等待确认的“class A”脉冲星；上一学期发现了新的双中子星系统 J1325-6253。摘要未说明计时观测的最终结果、来源参数数值或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，一年的初始计时是充分表征新脉冲星的必要条件，可推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等参数，并探测可能由发射不稳定性导致的意外行为；该计时项目将测量 PSR J1325-6253 的近星点进动、真实银道面脉冲星族群以及银道面中脉冲星参数空间的边界。对脉冲星计时、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、偏振、射电谱、自转减慢力矩变化或磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）联系的直接相关性，摘要均未说明，因此根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the timing campaign of new pulsar discoveries from the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed 80 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search, template bank and fast folding algorithm pipelines, and now have discovered 68 previously unknown pulsars and 21 "class A" pulsars awaiting confirmation. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This timing project is necessary for the timing of the new double neutron star (DNS) system J1325-6253 discovered last semester and for following up our confirmed/to-be confirmed new pulsars from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. Pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed and remaining candidates will be confirmed in the current 2020OCTS semester, the follow-up timing in 2021APRS will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will allow us to measure the advance of periastron of PSR J1325-6253, true Galactic plane pulsar population and boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

</details>

Method: 摘要说明这是一份观测时间申请，用于新发现脉冲星的计时 campaign；数据来自 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域数据再处理，已使用基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、template bank 和 fast folding algorithm 流水线完成巡天的 80 %。计时计划的最短时间跨度为一年初始计时，并包含对 J1325-6253 的计时及对新脉冲星的后续跟踪。具体望远镜、观测频率或波段、观测日期、样本量和统计方法均摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告已在 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域再处理中发现 68 颗此前未知的脉冲星和 21 颗等待确认的“class A”脉冲星，并已利用基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、template bank 和 fast folding algorithm 流水线完成该巡天的 80 %。上一学期发现了新双中子星（DNS）系统 J1325-6253；观测列表上的脉冲星已得到确认，其余候选体将在当前 2020OCTS 学期确认。摘要还指出该计时项目将测量 PSR J1325-6253 的近星点进动、真实的银道面脉冲星种群以及银道面中脉冲星参数空间的边界，但未给出相应数值或显著性。

Conclusion: 摘要明确指出，一年的初始计时是充分刻画新发现脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度，对于推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等脉冲星参数以及探测可能由发射不稳定性导致的异常行为至关重要；该计时项目对 J1325-6253 的计时和新脉冲星后续跟踪是必要的，并将使测量 PSR J1325-6253 的近星点进动、真实银道面脉冲星种群以及银道面中脉冲星参数空间边界成为可能。摘要未给出这些测量的结果。根据摘要无法判断该工作与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲极化的具体联系。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the timing campaign of new pulsar discoveries from the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed 80 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search, template bank and fast folding algorithm pipelines, and now have discovered 68 previously unknown pulsars and 21 "class A" pulsars awaiting confirmation. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This timing project is necessary for the timing of the new double neutron star (DNS) system J1325-6253 discovered last semester and for following up our confirmed/to-be confirmed new pulsars from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. Pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed and remaining candidates will be confirmed in the current 2020OCTS semester, the follow-up timing in 2021APRS will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will allow us to measure the advance of periastron of PSR J1325-6253, true Galactic plane pulsar population and boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

</details>

Result: 摘要报告：已完成 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面部分的 80 %，发现 68 颗此前未知的脉冲星和 21 颗等待确认的 "class A" 脉冲星；上一学期发现 DNS 系统 J1325-6253；观测列表上的脉冲星已确认。摘要预期 2021APRS 的后续计时将产生全新结果，并称该计时项目将允许测量 PSR J1325-6253 的近星点进动、真实银道面脉冲星族群以及银道面中脉冲星参数空间的边界。

Conclusion: 作者明确支持：对新发现脉冲星需经确认和至少一年初始计时才能充分刻画，导出特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率并探测发射不稳定性导致的意外行为；该计时项目对 DNS 系统 J1325-6253 的跟踪及 HTRU 银道面巡天脉冲星的后续观测是必要的，并将用于测量 PSR J1325-6253 的近星点进动、真实银道面脉冲星族群及脉冲星参数空间边界。关于单脉冲发射、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱、磁星与 FRB 的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the timing campaign of new pulsar discoveries from the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed 80 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search, template bank and fast folding algorithm pipelines, and now have discovered 68 previously unknown pulsars and 21 "class A" pulsars awaiting confirmation. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This timing project is necessary for the timing of the new double neutron star (DNS) system J1325-6253 discovered last semester and for following up our confirmed/to-be confirmed new pulsars from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. Pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed and remaining candidates will be confirmed in the current 2020OCTS semester, the follow-up timing in 2021APRS will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will allow us to measure the advance of periastron of PSR J1325-6253, true Galactic plane pulsar population and boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

</details>


### [2768] [Parkes observations for project P1050 semester 2021APRS_05]()
*Sengar, Rahul,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Morello, Vincent,Bhandari, Shivani,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Wongphechauxsorn, Jompoj,Chen, Weiwei,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel*

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the timing campaign of new pulsar discoveries from the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed 80 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search, template bank and fast folding algorithm pipelines, and now have discovered 68 previously unknown pulsars and 21 "class A" pulsars awaiting confirmation. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This timing project is necessary for the timing of the new double neutron star (DNS) system J1325-6253 discovered last semester and for following up our confirmed/to-be confirmed new pulsars from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. Pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed and remaining candidates will be confirmed in the current 2020OCTS semester, the follow-up timing in 2021APRS will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will allow us to measure the advance of periastron of PSR J1325-6253, true Galactic plane pulsar population and boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

</details>


### [2769] [Probing gravitational-wave four-point correlators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15514)
*Ciprini, Martina,Marcelli, Maria Lucia,Tasinato, Gianmassimo*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该工作研究由矢量涨落二阶产生的宇宙学随机引力波背景的非高斯特征，计算产生引力波三阶谱连通贡献的四点函数，表明三阶谱振幅按引力波功率谱的平方标度并在折叠动量构型处达到峰值，且连通三阶谱对两点重叠归算函数的方差有贡献，包括脉冲星计时阵列相关的Hellings-Downs曲线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原初随机引力波背景可探测早期宇宙物理与可能的暗扇区动力学；大多数搜寻关注引力波功率谱，而高阶关联函数可刻画信号统计性质并提供额外信息。论文旨在研究由矢量涨落二阶产生的宇宙学随机引力波背景的非高斯特征，并发展刻画高阶引力波关联函数的工具，以利用非高斯统计作为探测引力波背景起源的互补可观测量。

Method: 摘要说明研究由矢量涨落在二阶产生的宇宙学SGWB的非高斯特征，发展刻画高阶引力波关联函数的工具，计算产生引力波三阶谱连通贡献的代表性四点函数，并探讨观测意义。摘要未说明具体观测数据、望远镜或探测器名称（除地面干涉仪与脉冲星计时阵列两类设施的泛指外）、频段、时间跨度、样本量或统计分析方法细节。

Result: 摘要报告：连通三阶谱振幅按引力波功率谱的平方标度，并在特征性的折叠动量构型处达到峰值，反映非线性源的结构；连通三阶谱对两点重叠归算函数的方差有贡献，包括与脉冲星计时阵列相关的Hellings-Downs曲线；作者构建了用地面干涉仪测量连通三阶谱的最优估计量。摘要未说明具体数值、显著性水平或不确定性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，非高斯SGWB统计提供了探测引力波背景起源的互补可观测量，并可用于区分宇宙学源与天体物理源。摘要中与脉冲星计时阵列相关的部分仅体现在连通三阶谱对两点重叠归算函数方差的贡献，包括Hellings-Downs曲线；至于该结果对脉冲星计时、单脉冲发射或磁星与快速射电暴联系的具体意义，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Stochastic gravitational-wave backgrounds (SGWBs) of primordial origin offer a powerful probe of early-Universe physics and possible dark-sector dynamics. While most searches focus on the GW power spectrum, additional information is encoded in higher-order correlators that characterize the statistical properties of the signal. In this work we study non-Gaussian features of a cosmological SGWB generated at second order by vector fluctuations, a class of sources well motivated in early-Universe scenarios. Within this framework we develop tools to characterize higher-order GW correlators and compute representative four-point functions that generate a connected contribution to the GW trispectrum. We show that the trispectrum amplitude scales as the square of the GW power spectrum and peaks in characteristic folded momentum configurations, reflecting the structure of the nonlinear source. We then explore the observational implications. First, we demonstrate that the connected trispectrum contributes to the variance of two-point overlap reduction functions, including the Hellings-Downs curve relevant for pulsar timing arrays. We then construct the optimal estimator to measure the connected trispectrum with ground-based interferometers. Our results highlight how non-Gaussian SGWB statistics provide a complementary observable to probe the origin of GW backgrounds and to distinguish cosmological from astrophysical sources.

</details>


### [2770] [Parkes observations for project P1428 semester 2026OCTS_01]()
*Ridolfi, Alessandro,Burgay, Marta,Corongiu, Alessandro,Pilia, Maura,Possenti, Andrea*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该文申请22小时观测时间，用超宽带低频接收机与APOLLO后端重新观测10个球状星团，以确认或否定通过重新处理Parkes存档数据发现的56个候选脉冲星。确认至少一颗脉冲星将给出该星团的近似DM，简化后续搜寻并增加已知宿主射电脉冲星的星团数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 球状星团中心极端恒星密度促进双星形成与中子星再循环，并利于形成极端或非常规性质的脉冲星与双星，因此球状星团是脉冲星搜寻的主要目标，目前已在46个星团中发现超过360颗脉冲星。现代算力与算法使Parkes存档球状星团数据得以重新处理，已发现少数新脉冲星和若干候选体，需要观测确认。

Method: 申请22小时观测时间，重新观测10个球状星团，这些星团中56个有希望的候选脉冲星来自对Parkes存档数据的重新处理。使用最近安装的超宽带低频接收机（Ultra-Wide-band Low receiver）并结合现代APOLLO后端，相比存档数据灵敏度显著提升。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度、分析流程细节。

Result: 此前对Parkes存档球状星团数据的重新处理已发现少数新脉冲星以及若干有希望的候选体；最近在该组10个球状星团中发现56个有希望的候选脉冲星。摘要未说明候选体的具体性质、显著性、DM或计时结果。关于确认或否定候选体、以及可能发现更多脉冲星，属于本次申请的预期目标，而非已获得的结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，确认球状星团中至少一颗脉冲星具有重大科学价值：可获得该星团的近似DM，从而大大简化在该星团中搜寻更多脉冲星的工作；并可增加已知宿主射电脉冲星的星团总数，有助于理解球状星团中的脉冲星族群。所申请的观测预计可确认或否定候选体，并有可能发现更多脉冲星。与磁星、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱或快速射电暴的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Globular Clusters (GCs) are renowned to be the host of a wealth of radio pulsars, most of which are millisecond pulsars. The extreme stellar densities characterizing the central regions of GCs promote the formation of binary systems where neutron stars can be recycled, and the formation of pulsars and binaries with extreme or unconventional properties. GCs have therefore been prime targets for pulsar searching and, as of today, more than 360 pulsars have been found in 46 different clusters. The much larger computing power and much more modern algorithms available today have recently fostered the re-processing of archival Parkes GC data. This has led to the discovery of a few new pulsars, and several promising candidates. Here, we request 22 hours of observing time to re-observe a set of 10 GCs where 56 promising candidate pulsars have recently been found via reprocessing of archival Parkes data. The recently installed Ultra-Wide-band Low receiver, in combination with the modern APOLLO backend, will provide a sharp increase in sensitivity compared to the archival data. This will allow us to confirm or refute the candidates, and potentially even discover additional pulsars. Confirming at least one pulsar in a GC has a great scientific value, since it would allow us to know the approximate dispersion measure associated with cluster, greatly easing the search for additional pulsars in the cluster, and it would increase the total number of clusters known to host radio pulsars, contributing to our understanding of the population of pulsars in GCs.

</details>


### [2771] [Parkes observations for project P1021 semester 2022APRS_01]()
*Cameron, Andrew,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Bailes, Matthew,Stappers, Benjamin,Champion, David,Kaczmarek, Jane,Flynn, Chris,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Freeburn, James,Madrid, Juan*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划继续用 Parkes 对长自转周期双星脉冲星 PSR J1653-4518 和 PSR J1812-15 进行低节奏计时观测，以维持相位连接并探究其随轨道变化的变异性；PSR J1812-15 的相位连接问题可能由未诊断的 glitch 或其他未建模的计时效应引起。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双星脉冲星可用于引力检验、探测中子星状态方程以及作为恒星演化的化石记录。双星系统中的长自转周期脉冲星比自转更快的“再生”脉冲星稀有得多，是脉冲星双星演化中探索不足的区域；PSR J1812-15 尤其如此，似乎只有 B1718-19 能与之勉强相比。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测频率、波段、时间跨度与样本细节，仅说明提议继续对 PSR J1653-4518 和 PSR J1812-15 开展最低限度的低节奏 Parkes 计时 campaña；并提到一项针对 PSR J1653-4518 下一次预期食期间高频发射的多频观测 campaña，以及此前的 Parkes 提案和已建立的计时解。摘要未说明。

Result: 两颗脉冲星均表现出随轨道变化的变异性；此前的 Parkes 提案使理解显著增加，包括为 PSR J1653-4518 建立了计时解，预期于 2022 年初发表。PSR J1812-15 仍存在相位连接方面的持续问题，可能由未诊断的 glitch 或其他未建模的计时效应引起；PSR J1653-4518 需维持相位连接以支持多频观测。摘要未给出具体数值、显著性、时间跨度或样本量。

Conclusion: 作者认为仍需最低限度的低节奏计时 campaña 以解决遗留问题，并预期这些观测将在 2022 年初的近期发表之外带来更多可发表结果；对 PSR J1812-15 的相位连接问题提出了未诊断 glitch 或其他未建模计时效应的可能性解释。根据摘要无法判断这些结果对脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴研究的更广泛物理含义。

Abstract: We propose to continue our observations of PSR J1653-4518 and PSR J1812-15, a pair of long spin-period binary pulsars which both show degrees of orbitally-dependent variability. Binary pulsars are valuable objects of scientific study, allowing for multiple applications including tests of gravity, probes of the neutron star equation of state, and fossil records of stellar evolution. Long spin-period pulsars in binary systems are generally much rarer than faster-spinning `recycled' pulsars, and represent an under-explored region of pulsar binary evolution. This is particularly true of PSR J1812-15, for which only one other pulsar (B1718-19) seems remotely comparable. Based on previous Parkes proposals, our understanding of these pulsars has significantly increased (including the development of a timing solution for PSR J1653-4518), such that we anticipate their publication in early 2022. However, a minimal low-cadence timing campaign is still required to pursue lingering questions regarding both pulsars. For PSR J1812-15, this data is required to address ongoing problems with phase connection, which may be caused by an undiagnosed glitch or other un-modelled timing effect. For PSR J1653-4518, this data is required to maintain phase-connection in support of a multifrequency observing campaign targeting high-frequency emission during the pulsar's next anticipated eclipse in November 2022 (an effect seen in similar binary systems). These observations will set up additional publishable results beyond the anticipated near-term publications in early 2022.

</details>


### [2772] [Parkes observations for project P1021 semester 2022APRS_03]()
*Cameron, Andrew,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Bailes, Matthew,Stappers, Benjamin,Champion, David,Kaczmarek, Jane,Flynn, Chris,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Freeburn, James,Madrid, Juan*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟继续用 Parkes 对长自转周期双星脉冲星 PSR J1653-4518 和 PSR J1812-15 进行最低限度的低节奏计时观测，以解决 PSR J1812-15 的相位连接问题，并在 PSR J1653-4518 预期于 2022 年 11 月发生的食期间维持相位连接以支持多频率观测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双星脉冲星可用于引力检验、探测中子星物态方程并记录恒星演化；双星中的长自转周期脉冲星比自转更快的“再生”脉冲星罕见得多，是脉冲星双星演化中探索不足的区域。PSR J1812-15 尤甚，仅 B1718-19 似乎勉强可比。此前 Parkes 提案已增进理解（含 PSR J1653-4518 的计时解），预期 2022 年初发表，但仍需最低限度的低节奏计时以追查遗留问题。

Method: 摘要提及继续对 PSR J1653-4518 和 PSR J1812-15 开展 Parkes 观测，并采用最低限度的低节奏计时 campaña；对 PSR J1653-4518 提及一项针对其下一次预期于 2022 年 11 月发生的食期间高频发射的多频率观测 campaña。摘要未说明具体仪器、频率或频段、时间跨度、样本量或统计分析方法。

Result: 摘要指出两颗长自转周期双星脉冲星均表现出程度与轨道相关的可变性。基于此前 Parkes 提案，对这两颗脉冲星的理解已显著增加，包括为 PSR J1653-4518 建立了计时解，作者预期于 2022 年初发表。PSR J1812-15 仍存在相位连接方面的持续问题，可能由未诊断出的 glitch 或其他未建模的计时效应引起。PSR J1653-4518 下一次预期将于 2022 年 11 月发生食，类似双星系统中曾见到该效应。

Conclusion: 作者认为，需要最低限度的低节奏计时 campaña：对 PSR J1812-15 用以解决相位连接问题，对 PSR J1653-4518 用以维持相位连接并支持其 2022 年 11 月预期食期间的多频率高频发射观测；这些观测将在 2022 年初预期发表之外产生更多可发表成果。摘要未给出关于其物理机制或脉冲星、磁星与 FRB 关联的直接结论，根据摘要无法判断。

### [2777] [Parkes observations for project P897 semester 2015OCTS]()
*Kerr, Matthew,Johnston, Simon,Hobbs, George,Shannon, Ryan*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 在一个由150颗年轻脉冲星组成的样本中，有六颗脉冲星被探测到TOA周期性调制；作者提议用Parkes获取多历元、深度、校准良好的10 cm脉冲轮廓，以检验轮廓变异性是否与TOA调制相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脉冲星TOA调制可能由行星伴星、中子星自由进动或磁层状态切换引起；为区分这些机制，需要检验是否存在与TOA调制相关的脉冲轮廓变化。摘要指出磁层状态切换了解甚少但至关重要，而现有证据尚不足以判定其作用。

Method: 摘要为观测提议：在一个150颗年轻脉冲星的样本中已探测到六颗脉冲星的周期性TOA调制；拟使用Parkes获取多历元、深度、校准良好的10 cm脉冲轮廓，以搜寻轮廓变异性，特别是与TOA调制相关的变异性。摘要未说明观测时间跨度、具体分析流程或统计方法。

Result: 在150颗年轻脉冲星样本中，检测到6颗脉冲星存在周期性TOA调制。摘要未给出这些调制的周期数值、显著性、具体脉冲星名称，也未报告已获得的脉冲轮廓变异性结果；轮廓变异性及与TOA调制的相关性属于拟搜寻目标，而非已报告发现。

Conclusion: 作者提出，若未发现轮廓变异性，可能支持行星解释；若探测到变异性，则有助于刻画磁层状态并确定自由进动是否参与其中。由于这些脉冲星多为南天目标，且10 cm波段基本不受RFI和散射影响，作者认为Parkes独特地适合开展该研究。根据摘要无法判断最终物理机制。

Abstract: Modulation of pulse times of arrival (TOAs) from pulsars often heralds excitement: planetary companions, neutron star free precession, and the poorly understood but crucially important process of magnetospheric state switching can all produce quasi-periodic TOA modulation. In a sample of 150 young pulsars, we have detected periodic modulation in six pulsars. We propose to obtain multi-epoch, deep, well-calibrated 10 cm pulse profiles to search for profile variability, particularly variability correlated with TOA modulation. The absence of such variation may lend credence to a planet interpretation, while detection will help characterize the magnetospheric states and determine if free precession plays a role. Because the pulsars are largely southern sky objects, and because the 10cm band is largely free from RFI and scattering, Parkes is uniquely capable to deliver this science.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者提出，若未观测到轮廓变化，可能支持行星解释；若探测到轮廓变化，则有助于刻画磁层状态，并确定自由进动是否发挥作用。这些脉冲星大多为南天目标，且 10 cm 波段基本不受 RFI 和散射影响，因此 Parkes 被认为特别适合开展该研究。

Abstract: Modulation of pulse times of arrival (TOAs) from pulsars often heralds excitement: planetary companions, neutron star free precession, and the poorly understood but crucially important process of magnetospheric state switching can all produce quasi-periodic TOA modulation. In a sample of 150 young pulsars, we have detected periodic modulation in six pulsars. We propose to obtain multi-epoch, deep, well-calibrated 10 cm pulse profiles to search for profile variability, particularly variability correlated with TOA modulation. The absence of such variation may lend credence to a planet interpretation, while detection will help characterize the magnetospheric states and determine if free precession plays a role. Because the pulsars are largely southern sky objects, and because the 10cm band is largely free from RFI and scattering, Parkes is uniquely capable to deliver this science.

</details>


### [2779] [Parkes observations for project P1005 semester 2021APRS_10]()
*Cameron, Andrew,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Bailes, Matthew,Stappers, Benjamin,Champion, David,Balakrishnan, Vishnu*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟对双星脉冲星 PSR J1812-15 开展 6 个月计时监测和连续轨道覆盖观测，以建立相位连接的计时解，并利用 UWL 接收机的宽带宽检验其可变发射是否与轨道相位及食或伴星相互作用相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长自转周期双星脉冲星比快速自转的再循环脉冲星稀少，是脉冲星双星演化中尚未被充分探索的区域；PSR J1812-15 为 1 秒脉冲星，处于 20.3 小时圆形轨道且发射可变，此前 P1005 观测虽给出双星解，却仍无法获得相位连接的计时解，其可变发射的成因也不明确。

Method: 摘要未说明观测频段、时间跨度与望远镜名称，但明确提议：开展为期 6 个月的监测计划以获得确定唯一计时解所需的额外约束；并监测一系列连续轨道以完整覆盖轨道相位，利用 UWL 接收机的宽带宽区分源于双星伴星的可变性或其他来源（例如内禀脉冲 nulling）。

Result: 此前 P1005 观测已发展出 PSR J1812-15 的双星解，但仍无法建立相位连接的计时解；作者还发现该脉冲星的可探测性与轨道相位之间存在相关性，提示食或该脉冲星与其双星伴星之间的其他复杂相互作用至少部分导致其可变发射。

Conclusion: 作者认为需要额外约束才能确定唯一计时解，并据此提出 6 个月监测；可探测性与轨道相位的相关性提示食或伴星相互作用至少部分解释可变发射，连续轨道观测结合 UWL 宽带宽可用于区分伴星致变与内禀脉冲 nulling 等来源。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲偏振等主题的具体联系。

Abstract: We propose to conduct observations of PSR J1812-15, a 1-s pulsar in a 20.3-hr circular orbit around a light companion which also exhibits variable emission (turning `on' and `off'). Binary pulsars are valuable objects of scientific study, allowing for a wide range of applications, including tests of gravity, probes of the neutron star equation of state and fossil records of stellar evolution. Long spin-period pulsars in binary systems are generally much rarer than faster-spinning recycled pulsars, and represent an under-explored region of pulsar binary evolution. We propose a two-pronged campaign designed to address individual aspects of PSR J1812-15's behaviour. Firstly, although we have developed a binary solution as a consequence of previous P1005 observations, we are still unable to develop a phase-connected timing solution, a key step in understanding this pulsar and its binary formation process. We therefore propose a 6-month monitoring campaign intended to provide the additional constraint required to determine a unique solution. Secondly, we have identified a correlation between the pulsar's detectability and its orbital phase, suggesting that an eclipse or other complex interaction between the pulsar and its binary companion is at least partially responsible for its variable emission. We propose to monitor a series of consecutive orbits so as to fully cover the pulsar's orbital phase, exploiting the wide bandwidth of the UWL receiver to distinguish between variability due to the binary companion or other sources (e.g. intrinsic pulse nulling).

</details>

Method: 摘要说明：提出对PSR J1812-15开展两项观测计划——为期6个月的监测以提供确定唯一计时解所需的额外约束；并监测一系列连续轨道以完整覆盖脉冲星轨道相位，利用UWL接收机的宽带宽区分变异来源。摘要提及此前P1005观测已建立双星解。具体望远镜、接收机全称、观测频率或波段、时间跨度细节及分析方法，摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要说明：PSR J1812-15为1秒自转周期脉冲星，位于20.3小时圆轨道，绕一颗轻质量伴星运行，并表现出“开启”和“关闭”的变化发射。与此前P1005观测相比，已建立双星解，但仍无法建立相位连接的计时解。已确认该脉冲星的可探测性与轨道相位之间存在相关性，提示食或脉冲星与伴星间的其他复杂相互作用至少部分导致了发射变化。具体数值、显著性与时间跨度，摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者提出，通过6个月监测获取额外约束以确定唯一计时解，是理解该脉冲星及其双星形成过程的关键一步；并提出通过连续轨道监测覆盖轨道相位，借助UWL接收机宽带宽区分变化发射来自双星伴星还是其他来源（例如内禀脉冲熄灭）。这些是基于摘要所述相关性提出的待检验解释，最终物理结论取决于拟议观测。注意：摘要未涉及磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲偏振等主题，根据摘要无法判断其与这些方向的联系。

Abstract: We propose to conduct observations of PSR J1812-15, a 1-s pulsar in a 20.3-hr circular orbit around a light companion which also exhibits variable emission (turning `on' and `off'). Binary pulsars are valuable objects of scientific study, allowing for a wide range of applications, including tests of gravity, probes of the neutron star equation of state and fossil records of stellar evolution. Long spin-period pulsars in binary systems are generally much rarer than faster-spinning recycled pulsars, and represent an under-explored region of pulsar binary evolution. We propose a two-pronged campaign designed to address individual aspects of PSR J1812-15's behaviour. Firstly, although we have developed a binary solution as a consequence of previous P1005 observations, we are still unable to develop a phase-connected timing solution, a key step in understanding this pulsar and its binary formation process. We therefore propose a 6-month monitoring campaign intended to provide the additional constraint required to determine a unique solution. Secondly, we have identified a correlation between the pulsar's detectability and its orbital phase, suggesting that an eclipse or other complex interaction between the pulsar and its binary companion is at least partially responsible for its variable emission. We propose to monitor a series of consecutive orbits so as to fully cover the pulsar's orbital phase, exploiting the wide bandwidth of the UWL receiver to distinguish between variability due to the binary companion or other sources (e.g. intrinsic pulse nulling).

</details>

Secondly, we have identified a correlation between the pulsar's detectability and its orbital phase, suggesting that an eclipse or other complex interaction between the pulsar and its binary companion is at least partially responsible for its variable emission. Method: 摘要描述了拟议观测：对球状星团 NGC6441 中的四颗脉冲星开展观测，并沿 PSRJ1750-3703A 的轨道运动对其进行均匀观测。分析上拟通过测量 Einstein 延迟 gamma 参数，或通过处理 gamma 与脉冲星投影半长轴时间导数之间的协方差来测量轨道倾角，从而测量脉冲星质量；对于 PSRJ1750-3703B 拟降低其总质量不确定度，并改进 PSRJ1750-3703C 与 PSRJ1750-3703E 的自转参数和天体测量参数。具体望远镜、接收机、观测频率或波段、时间跨度与样本规模摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告的既有信息为：PSRJ1750-3703A 是周期 111 毫秒的脉冲星，处于非常偏心且长周期的轨道上，总质量为 2.18Msun；现有数据分析提示它可能是已知最轻的中子星，但因以往观测未均匀覆盖所有轨道相位、集中于远星点，尚不能给出确认该说法的严格上限。PSRJ1750-3703B 是另一颗偏心双星脉冲星，其近星点进动的探测使首次估计双星总质量成为可能，但精度不足以确定伴星性质。PSRJ1750-3703C 与 PSRJ1750-3703E 为孤立脉冲星，自转周期分别为 26.6 和 251 毫秒；PSRJ1750-3703C、PSRJ1750-3703E 以及 PSRJ1750-3703A 处于球状星团中最慢脉冲星的前 10%。

Conclusion: 作者认为，沿 PSRJ1750-3703A 轨道运动的均匀观测将可通过测量 Einstein 延迟 gamma 参数或测量轨道倾角来测得脉冲星质量，从而有望确立其是否为已知最轻中子星；拟议观测还可将 PSRJ1750-3703B 总质量的不确定度降低为原来的二分之一，并改进 PSRJ1750-3703C 和 PSRJ1750-3703E 的自转与天体测量参数。关于球状星团中最慢脉冲星（包括这三颗）如何形成的问题，摘要仅提出问题而未给出解释。该工作与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、单脉冲发射、模式转换或自转减速力矩变化的关系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: This project is focussed on four pulsars in the globular cluster NGC6441. PSRJ1750-3703A is a 111 millisecond pulsar in a very eccentric and long period orbit around a companion star, with a total mass of 2.18Msun. The analysis of the available data gives indication that PSRJ1750-3703A can be the lightest neutron star known so far, but a firm upper limit that confirms this statement cannot be placed yet, because all previous observations do not uniformly cover all orbital phases: in fact, they are clustered around the the apoastron. PSRJ1750-3703B is another eccentric binary pulsar, for which the detection of the periastron advance allowed a first estimation of the total mass of the binary, but non precisely enough to determine the nature of the companion. PSRJ1750-3703C and PSRJ1750-3703E are two isolated pulsars with spin periods of 26.6 and 251 milliseconds, respectively. PSRJ1750-3703C, PSRJ1750-3703E, and also PSRJ1750-3703A, are in the top 10% of the slowest pulsars in globular clusters, thus raising the question on how these pulsars can be formed in some globular clusters. The proposed observations aim to observe PSRJ1750-3703A uniformly along its orbital motion, thus allowing us to measure the pulsar mass, by measuring either the Einstein delay gamma parameter, or the orbital inclination by addressing the covariance between gamma and the time derivative of the projected semi-mayor axis of the pulsar. The proposed observations will also allow to reduce by a factor of two the uncertainty on the total mass of PSRJ1750-3703B, and to improve the rotational and astrometric parameters for PSRJ1750-3703C and PSRJ1750-3703E.

</details>

### [2832] [Long-term project observations for project P1032 semester 2026OCTS_01]()
*Grunthal, Kathrin,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Freire, Paulo,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,Venkatraman Krishnan, Vivek,Ridolfi, Alessandro,Lower, Marcus,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel,Pillay, Denisha,Geyer, Marisa,Dutta, Arunima,Senzel, Robert,Bhatnagar, Devika,Risbud, Dhanraj*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划继续 P1032，利用 Parkes UWL 接收机对南天双星脉冲星系统进行长期计时观测，以快速测量相对论性参数和轨道参数，从而检验广义相对论、约束双星演化情景，并主要通过中子星质量测量增进对中子星内部结构的理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该提案旨在延续 P1032，测量南天双星脉冲星系统的相对论性参数。MeerKAT 射电望远镜上的 MeerTime 项目于 2024 年初结束，因此 UWL 接收机观测成为延长许多相关脉冲星计时基线的支柱；此前学期的时间源选择已使 UWL 接收机成为实现既定科学目标最合适仪器。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测时长、时间跨度、样本数量或分析细节。摘要说明将继续使用 Parkes Ultra Wideband Low（UWL）接收机的数据，针对南天双星脉冲星系统开展长期项目观测，以快速测量相对论性参数及指示轨道构型的参数，并获得显著的轨道覆盖和计时基线，以及轨道和时变 DM 变化的约束。

Result: 摘要未说明已有观测结果或数值。摘要提出将利用 UWL 数据在这些脉冲星上获得显著的轨道覆盖和计时基线，并获得对轨道和时变 DM 变化的重要约束，从而有助于识别伴星性质；还将增加已测量 NS 质量的数量并改进现有约束。

Conclusion: 作者提出的科学目标是通过这些观测检验广义相对论（GR）并约束双星演化情景，主要通过中子星（NS）质量测量实现；增加已测量 NS 质量数量和改进现有约束对理解 NS 内部结构具有深远意义。摘要未给出已经完成的物理结论，因此根据摘要无法判断已获得的具体检验结果或内部结构约束。

Abstract: With this proposal, we aim to continue P1032; measuring timing parameters of relativistic parameters of southern binary pulsar systems, by using data from the Parkes Ultra Wideband Low (UWL) receiver. With this Long Term Project, focus on rapid measurements of relativistic parameters, as well as parameters informing their orbital configuration, in order to enable tests of the theory of GR and constrain binary evolution scenarios, mainly via Neutron Star (NS) mass measurements. As the MeerTime project at the MeerKAT radio telescope ended in early 2024, observations with the UWL receiver now form the backbone for extending the timing baselines of many pulsars that have been part of this project. Since the source selection in the previous semesters was tailored such that the UWL receiver is the most (versatile and) suited instrument to achieve the proposed scientific goals for the chosen pulsars, we propose to continue these observations. We will use the UWL data to obtain significant orbital coverage and timing baselines on these pulsars and obtain important constraints on orbital and temporal DM variations that will help in identifying the nature of the companion stars. In addition to our main science goals, increasing the number of measured NS masses, as well as improving on current constraints has profound implications for understanding the NS internal structure.

</details>

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测时间跨度、样本大小或分析方法细节。摘要说明利用 Parkes Ultra Wideband Low (UWL) 接收机的数据对南天双脉冲星系统开展长期计时观测，继续 P1032 项目，以获得显著的轨道覆盖和计时基线，并据此测量相对论性参数、轨道构型参数、中子星质量，以及约束轨道和随时间变化的 DM 变化。

Result: 摘要未说明已获得的观测结果或定量数值。摘要说明将利用 UWL 数据在这些脉冲星上获得显著的轨道覆盖和计时基线，并获得对轨道和随时间变化的 DM 变化的重要约束，有助于识别伴星的性质；此外，增加已测量的中子星质量数目和改进当前约束，对理解中子星内部结构具有深远意义。

Conclusion: 作者提出的科学目标是：经由中子星质量测量来检验广义相对论并约束双星演化情形，并利用 UWL 数据约束轨道和随时间变化的 DM 变化以帮助识别伴星性质；同时，增加已测量的中子星质量数目和改进当前约束对理解中子星内部结构具有深远意义。该提案本身不报告已完成结果，根据摘要无法判断这些目标的实际达成情况，也无法判断其与脉冲星单脉冲、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）的具体联系。

Abstract: With this proposal, we aim to continue P1032; measuring timing parameters of relativistic parameters of southern binary pulsar systems, by using data from the Parkes Ultra Wideband Low (UWL) receiver. With this Long Term Project, focus on rapid measurements of relativistic parameters, as well as parameters informing their orbital configuration, in order to enable tests of the theory of GR and constrain binary evolution scenarios, mainly via Neutron Star (NS) mass measurements. As the MeerTime project at the MeerKAT radio telescope ended in early 2024, observations with the UWL receiver now form the backbone for extending the timing baselines of many pulsars that have been part of this project. Since the source selection in the previous semesters was tailored such that the UWL receiver is the most (versatile and) suited instrument to achieve the proposed scientific goals for the chosen pulsars, we propose to continue these observations. We will use the UWL data to obtain significant orbital coverage and timing baselines on these pulsars and obtain important constraints on orbital and temporal DM variations that will help in identifying the nature of the companion stars. In addition to our main science goals, increasing the number of measured NS masses, as well as improving on current constraints has profound implications for understanding the NS internal structure.

</details>


### [2835] [Probing warm inflation via correlated gravitational waves from first order phase transitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.23279)
*Sui, Xiao-Bin,Liu, Jing,Cai, Rong-Gen*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该文研究温暴胀中加热诱导相变产生的引力波，指出两个相互关联的一阶相变所导致的引力波谱特征（振幅、峰值频率和振荡行为）可用于区分温暴胀与冷暴胀模型并约束耗散耦合强度与暴胀能标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文关注温暴胀中加热与随后宇宙冷却所触发的相变及其引力波信号，试图利用相互关联的引力波谱特征来区分温暴胀与冷暴胀模型，并约束耗散耦合强度与暴胀能标，从而揭示早期宇宙的耗散动力学。

Method: 摘要未说明具体的观测数据、仪器、频段、时间跨度或样本；所述工作为对温暴胀中加热诱导相变的引力波性质的理论研究，采用一个支配两个相变的统一模型来刻画引力波谱特征，并讨论未来引力波天文台（BBO、Ultimate-DECIGO、μAres、谐振腔、脉冲星计时阵列实验）对理论预言的检验能力。

Result: 摘要指出，在该情景下加热阶段及其后的宇宙冷却可触发两个相互关联的一阶相变并产生特征引力波；其引力波谱特征包括振幅、峰值频率和振荡行为，且这些特征来自一个统一模型。摘要称这些特征可区分温暴胀与冷暴胀模型，并约束耗散耦合强度和暴胀能标。摘要未给出具体的数值、频率、显著性或其他定量结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，来自这两个相互关联一阶相变的引力波谱特征可用于区分温暴胀与冷暴胀模型，并对耗散耦合强度和暴胀能标给出约束，从而共同揭示早期宇宙的耗散动力学；未来引力波天文台如 BBO、Ultimate-DECIGO、μAres、谐振腔以及脉冲星计时阵列实验将在检验这些理论预言中发挥重要作用。关于该情景与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲辐射或快速射电暴的具体物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We investigate the properties of gravitational waves generated by heating-induced phase transitions in warm inflation. In this scenario, the heating phase of inflation followed by subsequent cosmological cooling can trigger two associated first-order phase transitions and generate characteristic gravitational waves. The correlated gravitational wave spectral features---amplitude, peak frequencies, and oscillatory behavior---originate from a unified model governing both phase transitions. These signatures allow discrimination between warm and cold inflation models, and give constraint on the key parameters including the dissipative coupling strength and the inflationary energy scale, collectively illuminating early-Universe dissipative dynamics. Future gravitational wave observatories such as BBO, Ultimate-DECIGO, <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>μ</mml:mi><mml:mi>Ares</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula>, resonant cavities, and Pulsar Timing Array experiments, will play a important role in testing these theoretical predictions.

</details>


### [2836] [Stochastic limit of growing gravitational wave memory from sources in the early Universe and astrophysical sources](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.06548)
*Bieri, Lydia*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 增长型引力波记忆的随机背景导致分数布朗运动，当 <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msup><mml:mi>t</mml:mi><mml:mi>H</mml:mi></mml:msup></mml:math></inline-formula> 很大时按该量级增长且 <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mfrac><mml:mn>1</mml:mn><mml:mn>2</mml:mn></mml:mfrac><mml:mo>&lt;</mml:mo><mml:mi>H</mml:mi><mml:mo>&lt;</mml:mo><mml:mn>1</mml:mn></mml:math></inline-formula>，快于布朗运动的 <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msqrt><mml:mi>t</mml:mi></mml:msqrt></mml:math></inline-formula> 标度律；在膨胀宇宙中记忆被膨胀增强，该记忆特征可用于尤其是脉冲星计时阵列数据中提取此类引力波源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 早期宇宙和天体物理环境中的引力波记忆随机背景如何随时间增长，其标度行为与文献中多按布朗运动 <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msqrt><mml:mi>t</mml:mi></mml:msqrt></mml:math></inline-formula> 标度律处理的记忆事件、噪声极限不同；已有观测到的脉冲星计时阵列数据中如何提取记忆信号也是长期存在的问题。

Method: 摘要未说明具体的观测、仪器、频段、时间跨度、样本或数据分析流程；摘要提到研究对象为早期宇宙中以及天体物理环境中的引力波源，可能包括原初黑洞或大爆炸后紧接时期存在热物质团块与大的密度涨落时的其他源，并提到原初黑洞并合产生的引力波记忆，以及随机极限、长程依赖性和概率分析等分析方向。

Result: 增长型引力波记忆的随机背景导致分数布朗运动，对于大的 <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>t</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> 按 <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msup><mml:mi>t</mml:mi><mml:mi>H</mml:mi></mml:msup></mml:math></inline-formula> 量级增长，其中 <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mfrac><mml:mn>1</mml:mn><mml:mn>2</mml:mn></mml:mfrac><mml:mo>&lt;</mml:mo><mml:mi>H</mml:mi><mml:mo>&lt;</mml:mo><mml:mn>1</mml:mn></mml:math></inline-formula>，快于布朗运动的标度律；来自原初黑洞并合的引力波产生记忆，并且由于这些过程发生的条件，引力波记忆会随时间按某一幂律增长；对周围条件类似的来自宇宙学源的任何引力波记忆，相应结果成立；这些记忆的随机极限是比布朗运动 <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msqrt><mml:mi>t</mml:mi></mml:msqrt></mml:math></inline-formula> 标度律增长更快的随机过程，后者也是噪声以及文献中大多考虑的记忆事件极限的典型特征；在膨胀宇宙中记忆被膨胀本身增强。

Conclusion: 作者明确结论是：这些结果为利用该记忆特征从数据中提取此类引力波源提供了工具，对已经观测到的脉冲星计时阵列数据尤其有用，可回答如何从数据中提取记忆信号的长期存在问题；此外，新结果为利用长程依赖性和进一步的概率分析探索大爆炸之后紧接时期的条件打开新的大门。根据摘要无法判断该记忆特征对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、模式转换、自旋下降转矩变化、偏振、射电谱或磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）联系的具体适用性。

Abstract: We show that the stochastic background of gravitational wave memory of growing type leads to a fractional Brownian motion increasing at the order of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msup><mml:mi>t</mml:mi><mml:mi>H</mml:mi></mml:msup></mml:math></inline-formula> for large <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>t</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> where <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mfrac><mml:mn>1</mml:mn><mml:mn>2</mml:mn></mml:mfrac><mml:mo>&lt;</mml:mo><mml:mi>H</mml:mi><mml:mo>&lt;</mml:mo><mml:mn>1</mml:mn></mml:math></inline-formula>. This beats the scaling law of Brownian motion. In this article, we investigate sources of gravitational waves in the early Universe as well as in astrophysical settings. Cosmological sources may include primordial black holes or other sources immediately after the big bang when there were pockets of hot material and large density fluctuations. Gravitational waves from mergers of primordial black holes produce memory. We show that, due to the conditions in which these are taking place, the gravitational wave memory will be increasing in time following a certain power law. Corresponding results hold for any gravitational wave memory from a cosmological source where the surrounding conditions are similar. The stochastic limit of these memories is a stochastic process growing in time faster than the <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msqrt><mml:mi>t</mml:mi></mml:msqrt></mml:math></inline-formula> scaling law of Brownian motion. The latter is also typical for noise and for the limit of memory events as they have been mostly considered in the literature. In an expanding Universe, the memory is enhanced by the expansion itself. Our results provide a tool to extract gravitational wave sources of this type from data using this memory signature. This would be particularly useful for the pulsar timing array data that have been already observed, answering the long-standing question about how to extract memory signals from the data. Further, the new results open up a new door to explore the conditions right after the big bang using the long-range dependence and further probability analysis.

</details>


### [2837] [Parkes observations for project P1410 semester 2026APRS_13]()
*Botnariuc, Alexandra,Clark, Colin James,Sengar, Rahul*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 通过重新处理 Parkes Multibeam Pulsar Survey 的档案数据并针对窄占空比信号，作者识别出 12 个此前分析遗漏的高度可信的新慢脉冲星候选体，并申请后随观测以确认和计时这些候选体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已知脉冲星种群不完整：目前编目约 4,800 颗，而种群研究预测现有仪器应能观测到约 10,000 颗或更多射电可探测脉冲星。缺失部分预期包含难以用标准搜索流程探测的慢速自转脉冲星，其窄脉冲占空比与长自转周期导致信噪比低，并易受傅里叶搜索中低频（“红”）噪声污染，可能仍隐藏于档案巡天数据中。

Method: 重新处理 Parkes Multibeam Pulsar Survey 的档案数据，针对窄占空比信号进行搜索，并允许对这些候选体考察更低的信噪比。摘要未说明具体观测频段、时间跨度、样本量或统计分析方法；后续计划是申请针对性的后随观测以确认并对候选体进行计时。

Result: 该方法识别出 12 个高度可信的新的慢脉冲星候选体，它们在先前的分析中被遗漏。其中若干候选体显示出很强的折叠信噪比和物理上合理的色散量，表明它们很可能是真实的脉冲星。摘要未给出具体信噪比数值、色散量数值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，对这些新候选体进行确认和计时将有助于缩小预测脉冲星族群与观测脉冲星族群之间的差距，并证明档案射电巡天数据持续具有科学价值。候选体因具有很强的折叠信噪比和物理上合理的色散量而被认为很可能是真实脉冲星，但最终确认仍依赖拟议的后随观测。该工作与脉冲星计时、单脉冲及脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱以及磁星—快速射电暴（FRB）联系之间的关系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Neutron stars are compact remnants formed in core-collapse supernovae of massive stars. A subset of these objects, known as pulsars, emit highly regular pulses of radiation that make them powerful tools for studying fundamental physics, stellar evolution, and the structure of our Galaxy. Despite decades of surveys, the known pulsar population remains incomplete: while about 4,800 pulsars are currently catalogued, population studies predict that roughly 10,000 or more radio-detectable pulsars should be observable with our current instrumentation. A significant fraction of the missing population is expected to consist of slowly rotating pulsars, which are difficult to detect with standard search pipelines. These pulsars often have very narrow pulse duty cycles and long spin periods, making them susceptible to reduced signal-to-noise ratios and contamination by low-frequency ("red") noise in Fourier-based searches. As a result, many such objects may remain hidden in archival survey data. Motivated by this, we reprocessed archival data from the Parkes Multibeam Pulsar Survey targeting narrow-duty-cycle signals and allowing to investigate lower signal to noise ratios for these candidates. This approach led to the identification of 12 highly credible new slow pulsar candidates that were missed in previous analyses. Several of these candidates show strong folded signal-to-noise ratios and physically plausible dispersion measures, indicating they are likely genuine pulsars. The primary goal of this proposal is to obtain targeted follow-up observations to confirm and time these newly identified pulsar candidates. Confirming them will help close the gap between predicted and observed pulsar populations and demonstrate the continued scientific value of archival radio survey data.

</details>

Abstract: Neutron stars are compact remnants formed in core-collapse supernovae of massive stars. A subset of these objects, known as pulsars, emit highly regular pulses of radiation that make them powerful tools for studying fundamental physics, stellar evolution, and the structure of our Galaxy. Despite decades of surveys, the known pulsar population remains incomplete: while about 4,800 pulsars are currently catalogued, population studies predict that roughly 10,000 or more radio-detectable pulsars should be observable with our current instrumentation. Abstract: Neutron stars are compact remnants formed in core-collapse supernovae of massive stars. A subset of these objects, known as pulsars, emit highly regular pulses of radiation that make them powerful tools for studying fundamental physics, stellar evolution, and the structure of our Galaxy. Despite decades of surveys, the known pulsar population remains incomplete: while about 4,800 pulsars are currently catalogued, population studies predict that roughly 10,000 or more radio-detectable pulsars should be observable with our current instrumentation. A significant fraction of the missing population is expected to consist of slowly rotating pulsars, which are difficult to detect with standard search pipelines. These pulsars often have very narrow pulse duty cycles and long spin periods, making them susceptible to reduced signal-to-noise ratios and contamination by low-frequency ("red") noise in Fourier-based searches. As a result, many such objects may remain hidden in archival survey data. Motivated by this, we reprocessed archival data from the Parkes Multibeam Pulsar Survey targeting narrow-duty-cycle signals and allowing to investigate lower signal to noise ratios for these candidates. This approach led to the identification of 12 highly credible new slow pulsar candidates that were missed in previous analyses. Several of these candidates show strong folded signal-to-noise ratios and physically plausible dispersion measures, indicating they are likely genuine pulsars. The primary goal of this proposal is to obtain targeted follow-up observations to confirm and time these newly identified pulsar candidates. Confirming them will help close the gap between predicted and observed pulsar populations and demonstrate the continued scientific value of archival radio survey data.

</details>

Abstract: Neutron stars are compact remnants formed in core-collapse supernovae of massive stars. A subset of these objects, known as pulsars, emit highly regular pulses of radiation that make them powerful tools for studying fundamental physics, stellar evolution, and the structure of our Galaxy. Despite decades of surveys, the known pulsar population remains incomplete: while about 4,800 pulsars are currently catalogued, population studies predict that roughly 10,000 or more radio-detectable pulsars should be observable with our current instrumentation. A significant fraction of the missing population is expected to consist of slowly rotating pulsars, which are difficult to detect with standard search pipelines. These pulsars often have very narrow pulse duty cycles and long spin periods, making them susceptible to reduced signal-to-noise ratios and contamination by low-frequency ("red") noise in Fourier-based searches. As a result, many such objects may remain hidden in archival survey data. Motivated by this, we reprocessed archival data from the Parkes Multibeam Pulsar Survey targeting narrow-duty-cycle signals and allowing to investigate lower signal to noise ratios for these candidates. This approach led to the identification of 12 highly credible new slow pulsar candidates that were missed in previous analyses. Several of these candidates show strong folded signal-to-noise ratios and physically plausible dispersion measures, indicating they are likely genuine pulsars. The primary goal of this proposal is to obtain targeted follow-up observations to confirm and time these newly identified pulsar candidates. Confirming them will help close the gap between predicted and observed pulsar populations and demonstrate the continued scientific value of archival radio survey data.

</details>

### [2851] [GFH-v2 pipeline for searches of long-transient gravitational waves from newborn magnetars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.09878)
*Sajith Menon, Sandhya,Pierini, Lorenzo,Astone, Pia,Palomba, Cristiano,Silvestri, Lorenzo,D'Antonio, Sabrina,Dall'Osso, Simone,Safai Tehrani, Francesco,Dal Pra, Stefano,Dinatale, Gaetano,Frasca, Sergio,Guetta, Dafne,Leaci, Paola,Orlandi, Alessio*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 本文提出改进的 GFH-v2 流水线，用于搜寻新生磁星产生的长暂现引力波，其理论灵敏度与向 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA O4a 数据注入模拟信号得到的经验灵敏度估计进行了比较，更新后的框架在灵敏度和计算性能上均有改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文关注新生磁星相关的长暂现引力波搜寻，尤其是早期自转减慢由引力波辐射主导的区间；其背景是对原始广义频率霍夫变换实现进行增强并优化参数空间选择，以支持当前及未来观测运行中的定向搜寻。

Method: 使用显著改进的广义频率霍夫变换算法 GFH-v2；描述了相对于原始实现的主要进展，并概述搜寻中采用的优化参数空间选择；计算方法的理论灵敏度，并通过向 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA O4a 数据注入模拟信号获得经验灵敏度估计。摘要未说明具体观测频段、时间跨度、样本量或统计方法。

Result: GFH-v2 相对于原始实现引入了主要改进；更新后的框架实现了改进的灵敏度和计算性能；理论灵敏度与基于向 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA O4a 数据注入模拟信号得到的经验灵敏度估计进行了比较。摘要未给出具体数值、不确定度或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果为未来在当前及即将进行的观测运行中，对来自核心坍缩超新星和其他暂现事件的长暂现引力波信号开展定向搜寻提供了稳健基础。根据摘要无法判断该框架与脉冲星、磁星单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、偏振、射电频谱或快速射电暴（FRB）观测之间的具体联系。

Abstract: This paper presents an enhanced methodology for searching long transient gravitational w aves associated with a newborn magnetar, with particular focus on the regime in which the early spin down is dominated by gravitational-wave emission. The analysis is performed using a strongly improved version of the generalized Frequency Hough Transform algorithm, called GFH-v2. We describe the main developments introduced relative to the original implementation and outline the optimized parameter-space selection used in the search. We then compute the theoretical sensitivity of the method and compare it with an empirical sensitivity estimate obtained by injecting simulated signals into LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA O4a data. The updated framework achieves improved sensitivity and computational performance. These results provide a robust basis for future directed searches for long-transient gravitational-wave signals from core-collapse supernovae and other transient events in current and upcoming observing runs.

</details>

*Shang, Lunhua,Hobbs, George,Ravi, Vikram,Zic, Andrew,Luo, Rui*

Conclusion: 作者的明确主张是拟通过检验 CU Virginis 脉冲的频率-时间依赖关系、偏振和频谱来测试解释其圆偏振射电脉冲的模型，并证明 Parkes 望远镜能够观测分钟至小时时间尺度的暂现事件。该提案与脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）的物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: CU Virginis is the best-studied member of the class of stellar radio transients known as stellar pulsars. Its circularly polarised radio pulses are explained by a model, which has consequences for the frequency-time dependence, polarisation and spectra of the pulses which can be tested using the Parkes ultra-wide-bandwidth receiver system. We propose to perform these tests and to demonstrate that the Parkes telescope can be used to observe transient events on time scales of minutes to hours.

</details>
