Result: 这是一份巡天提议，摘要未报告已获得的观测结果。摘要说明该深度巡天预期将发现银河系核球中的毫秒脉冲星群体，并揭示它们的分布与伽马射线辐射。摘要给出的项目参数为：使用 cryoPAF 共需 200 次观测，覆盖 400 平方度区域（|gl|<10 deg，|gb|<10 deg），预计在四个学期内实施，从 2026 年 4 月到 2027 年 10 月。摘要未说明任何已探测到的脉冲星、脉冲轮廓、偏振、DM、RM 或谱指数结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出的结论是：该巡天将主导关于银河系核球伽马射线辐射起源的开创性研究，其成果将显著推进对银河系核球中毫秒脉冲星形成与演化、高能辐射的起源与性质，以及银河系中心暗物质湮灭本质的认识。与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、快速射电暴（FRB）或计时等具体方向的方法学关联，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose to carry out a deep Galactic Bulge pulsar survey (GBps), covering the core of the Bulge region using the new cryoPAF system on Murriyang, the Parkes radio telescope. Such a deep survey is expected to discover a population of millisecond pulsars in the Galactic Bulge and reveal their distribution and gamma-ray emissions. With these, we will lead pioneering studies on the origin of gamma-ray emission in the Galactic Bulge, a longstanding mystery in modern astronomy. The outcome of this project will significantly advance our knowledge of the formation and evolution of millisecond pulsars in the Galactic Bulge, the origin and properties of high-energy emissions, and the nature of dark matter annihilation in the Galactic Centre. A total of 200 observations with the cryoPAF is required to cover a 400 square degree region (|gl|&lt;10 deg, |gb|&lt;10 deg). The survey is expected to be carried out over four semesters, from April 2026 to October 2027.

</details>


### [3007] [Parkes observations for project P1050 semester 2023OCTS_16]()
*Sengar, Rahul,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Morello, Vincent,Bhandari, Shivani,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Wongphechauxsorn, Jompoj,Chen, Weiwei,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该观测时间申请总结了在 HTRU-S LowLat 与 PMPS 重新处理中新发现的 112 颗脉冲星（其中 18 颗来自 PMPS），并提出 2023OCTS 学期的后续计时观测，以获得特征年龄、磁场强度和自转减慢率等参数并刻画若干特殊脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新发现的脉冲星通常需经确认和后续计时才能获得有意义的科学结果；至少 1-2 年的初始计时被视为充分表征新脉冲星、导出特征年龄、磁场强度和自转减慢率等参数以及探测发射不稳定性所致意外行为的最低要求，因此需要申请 2023OCTS 学期的观测时间。

Method: 申请在 Parkes 开展后续计时 campaign。摘要说明已利用基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、template bank 和 fast folding algorithm 流程完成零加速度 PMPS 搜索，并已完成 90% 的 HTRU-S LowLat 巡天；此外还计划通过专门观测 campaign 研究一个独特双星脉冲星系统。具体观测频率、时长、样本选择与计时分析细节：摘要未说明。

Result: 在 HTRU-S LowLat 与 PMPS 的重新处理中已发现 112 颗此前未知的脉冲星，其中 18 颗发现于 PMPS；HTRU-S LowLat 巡天已完成 90%，零加速度 PMPS 搜索已借助基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、template bank 和 fast folding algorithm 流程完成。待计时的目标包括双星脉冲星、高 DM 脉冲星、散射轮廓脉冲星，以及在 UWL 波段更大带宽上显示发射的明亮脉冲星。

Conclusion: 作者认为，至少 1-2 年的初始计时是充分表征新发现脉冲星、导出特征年龄、磁场强度和自转减慢率，并探测可能源于发射不稳定性的意外行为的必要条件；2023OCTS 学期的后续计时将有助于完成多项长期科学目标，包括通过专门观测 campaign 查明一个独特双星脉冲星系统的性质。根据摘要无法判断具体的物理机制或与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）等课题的联系。

Abstract: This is a request for the observation time for the timing campaign of new pulsars discovered in the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU-S survey (HTRU-S LowLat) and the Parkes Multibeam Pulsar Survey (PMPS). We have completed 90 % of the HTRU-S LowLat survey and completed zero acceleration PMPS search with GPU-based coherent acceleration search, template bank, and fast folding algorithm pipelines and now have discovered 112 previously unknown pulsars among which 18 were found in the PMPS. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation, and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. At least 1-2 year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, and spin-down rate, as well as for detecting any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This project is necessary for the timing of several interesting pulsars, including binary pulsars, high DM pulsars, scattered profile pulsars, and bright ones that show emissions in larger bandwidths in the UWL band. Apart from this, finding the nature of a unique binary pulsar system via a dedicated observing campaign is also another goal. The follow-up timing in semester 2023OCTS will assist in completing many exciting large-term science goals.

</details>


### [3008] [Calculation of overlap reduction functions for isotropic stochastic gravitational-wave background with alternative polarizations]()
*Hu, Yu,Wang, Pan-Pan,Tan, Yu-Jie,Shao, Cheng-Gang*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该工作将此前对张量极化随机引力波背景重叠约化函数（ORF）的无近似计算方法推广到矢量极化和标量极化，并给出 PTA、地面干涉仪和空间干涉仪的 ORF 表达式；该普适公式可提高第三代地面干涉仪和空间干涉仪高频区 ORF 计算的精度，并可打破小天线近似下标量呼吸与标量纵向极化之间的简并。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探测随机引力波背景（SGWB）的标准方法是探测器对之间的互相关分析，相关信号取决于 SGWB 强度与探测器对的几何灵敏度，后者由重叠约化函数（ORF）量化。此前工作已给出脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）和激光干涉仪探测器在张量极化下的无近似 ORF 计算公式，但替代引力理论中可能存在的矢量极化和标量极化尚需推广计算。

Method: 摘要未说明具体的观测数据、观测频率或频段、时间跨度与样本。方法上，作者将此前针对张量极化、用于脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）和激光干涉仪探测器的无近似 ORF 计算公式推广到矢量极化和标量极化；该公式适用于任何测量由引力波引起的两点之间光传播时间变化的实验；并据此推导 PTA、地面干涉仪和空间干涉仪对所有极化的 ORF 表达式。

Result: 作者给出了适用于矢量极化和标量极化的 ORF 计算公式，该公式适用于任何测量由引力波引起的两点之间光传播时间变化的实验；据此推导了脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）、地面干涉仪和空间干涉仪对所有极化的 ORF 表达式。摘要指出，这一普适公式为第三代地面干涉仪和空间干涉仪在高频区域的 ORF 计算提供了更高的精度，并能打破小天线近似中出现的标量呼吸极化与标量纵向极化之间的简并。

Conclusion: 作者认为，所提出的普适公式可提高第三代地面干涉仪和空间干涉仪在高频区域进行 ORF 计算的精度；其重要实际意义在于能够打破小天线近似下标量呼吸极化与标量纵向极化之间的简并，从而为在数据分析中区分这两种极化提供基础。关于该结果对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲发射、快速射电暴或磁星–FRB 联系的具体物理含义，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Cross-correlation analysis of detector pairs is a standard method for probing the stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB). The correlation signal is determined by the SGWB intensity and the geometric sensitivity of the detector pair, which can be quantified by the overlap reduction function (ORF). In our previous work [Phys. Rev. D 111, 084065 (2025)PRVDAQ2470-001010.1103/PhysRevD.111.084065], we developed a formula to calculate the ORF of the SGWB with tensor polarization for pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) and laser interferometer detectors without approximation. In this work, we generalize the method to calculate the ORF for vector and scalar polarizations that may be present in alternative theories of gravity. This formula is valid for any experiment measuring variations in light travel time between two points due to gravitational waves. Using this formula, we derive expressions for the ORFs of PTAs, ground-based interferometers, and space-based interferometers for all polarizations. Furthermore, this universal formula provides enhanced accuracy for ORF calculations in high-frequency regimes of third-generation ground-based interferometers and space-based interferometers. An important practical implication is its ability to break the degeneracy between scalar-breathing and scalar-longitudinal polarizations that arises in the small-antenna approximation, thereby providing a foundation for distinguishing them in data analysis.

</details>


### [3009] [Searching for GeV gamma-ray polarization and axionlike particles with AMS-02](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.10531)
*Zhang, Xiuyuan,Jia, Yi,Slatyer, Tracy R.*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该文估计 AMS-02 仅能对最明亮稳态银河系源（如 Vela、Geminga 脉冲星）探测 GeV 伽马射线偏振，而 AMS-100 观测 NGC1275 有望在即使不利的 B 场模型下探测 ALP 新参数空间并测量信号能量依赖性；十年 AMS-100 数据对银河系源的可探测参数空间在无明亮暂现源时已被其他实验名义排除，但特定 ALP 模型可避免该冲突。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究问题是利用 AMS-02 与 AMS-100 从银河系和河外源探测 GeV 能段伽马射线偏振是否可行；该能段偏振可揭示源中伽马射线发射机制，超出标准模型的 ALPs 也可能通过磁场中的传播效应产生独特能量依赖偏振信号，因此需要评估最小可探测偏振与 ALP 探测范围。

Method: 摘要说明研究针对 AMS-02 实验及其拟议后续 AMS-100，研究银河系和河外源 GeV 能段伽马射线偏振的可探测性；给出明亮源最小可探测偏振的估计以及 ALPs 的预报探测范围。摘要未说明具体观测时长、样本、能段细节或统计分析方法；银河系源情形提及十年 AMS-100 数据。

Result: AMS-02 仅对最明亮的稳态银河系源（如 Vela 和 Geminga 脉冲星）具有伽马射线偏振灵敏度，预计无法探测此前被提出作为利用伽马射线强度测量进行 ALP 搜索良好目标的银河系或河外源中的偏振。AMS-100 观测河外源 NGC1275 预计即使对不利的 B 场模型也能探测新参数空间，并有望测量信号能量依赖性。在无明亮暂现源时，十年 AMS-100 数据可探测的银河系源参数空间已被其他实验名义上排除。

Conclusion: 作者认为 Gev 能段伽马射线偏振可检验伽马射线发射机制及 ALPs 传播效应；银河系源偏振测量可独特检验 ALPs 诱导光子强度能量依赖特征的场景，AMS-100 观测 NGC1275 有望探测新参数空间。但无明亮暂现源时十年 AMS-100 数据涵盖的参数空间已被其他实验名义排除，虽特定 ALP 模型可避免该冲突。与脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、FRB 等的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We study the detectability of GeV-band gamma-ray polarization with the AMS-02 experiment and its proposed successor AMS-100, from Galactic and extragalactic sources. Characterizing gamma-ray polarization in this energy range could shed light on gamma-ray emission mechanisms in the sources; physics beyond the Standard Model, such as the presence of axionlike particles (ALPs), could also induce a distinctive energy-dependent polarization signal due to propagation effects in magnetic fields. We present estimates for the minimum detectable polarization from bright sources and the forecast reach for ALPs. We show that AMS-02 will have sensitivity to gamma-ray polarization only for the brightest steady-state Galactic sources, such as the Vela and Geminga pulsars; it is not expected to be capable of detecting polarization in Galactic or extragalactic sources that have been previously proposed as good targets for ALP searches with gamma-ray intensity measurements. However, AMS-100 observing the extragalactic source NGC1275 would be expected to probe new parameter space even for unfavorable <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>B</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula>-field models, with prospects to measure the energy-dependence of such a signal. For Galactic sources, polarization measurements could provide a unique test of scenarios where ALPs induce energy-dependent features in the photon intensity. However, in the absence of a bright transient source (such as a Galactic supernova), the parameter space that would be probed by this approach with ten years of AMS-100 data is already nominally excluded by other experiments, although this conflict may be avoided in specific ALP models.

</details>


### [3010] [Bimetric MOND as a framework for variable-<inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>G</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> theories: Local systems and cosmology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.09353)
*Milgrom, Mordehai*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该文将双度规 MOND（BIMOND）用作变 $G$ 理论的框架，提出牛顿常数 $G$ 的现象依赖性，并给出在不同情形下预言不同有效引力常数 $G_e$ 的理论示例；作者尚不能给出符合宇宙学全部观测的自洽模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望考察变 $G$ 的 BIMOND 类理论能否解释暗物质在宇宙学中的某些作用，例如在不引入约 $2\pi$ 倍重子密度的物质密度时解释物质主导时期的膨胀历史。摘要指出，MOND 中由高加速度现象推得的 $G$ 非恒常性限制与宇宙学中的 $G$ 变化无关；作者力图给出一般框架，而非具体预言。

Method: 这是一项理论框架研究。作者以 BIMOND 为平台，其引力自由度为两个度规 $g_{\mu\nu}$ 与 $\hat{g}_{\mu\nu}$，给出度规对称子类的引力作用量 $I^B$，其中相互作用项 $\overset{\sim}{M}$ 为相对加速度张量 $C^{\alpha}_{\beta\gamma}$ 所构造无量纲标量的函数，$\ell_M=c^2/a_0$ 为 MOND 长度；并考虑标准表述与 Einstein-Palatini 表述，将拉格朗日密度乘以 $1+M_G$ 以得到 $G_e\equiv G/(1+M_G)$。摘要未说明数值计算、观测数据或统计分析。

Result: 摘要报告，在局部，当两个度规中随机涨落不同时，$\overset{\sim}{M}$ 封装星系系统中的 MOND 效应，而 $\overset{\sim}{M}$ 在宇宙学尺度上的平均充当（动力学）暗能量。在不添加自由度或有量纲常数的情况下，BIMOND 可扩展为体现 $G$ 现象依赖性的一类理论。作者描述了在不同情形下预言不同 $G_e$ 值的例子，包括一个对所有亚宇宙学系统（即使深处于 MOND 区域）$G$ 均取标准值的例子；还讨论了早期宇宙 $G_e\approx G$（如大爆炸核合成限制所要求）而在较晚时期 $G_e>G$ 并可影响物质主导时期膨胀历史的情形。摘要未给出具体数值预言或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为 BIMOND 可作为变 $G$ 理论的一般框架，其具体预言关键取决于理论结构细节（如变量选择、$\overset{\sim}{M}$ 与 $M_G$ 对这些变量的依赖）以及宇宙学未知输入（初始条件、孪生扇区物质内容等）。作者明确表示尚不能给出符合宇宙学全部观测（包括膨胀历史及其细节）的自洽模型，因此所讨论的 $G_e$ 取值情形属于该理论类中的示例而非已验证结果。摘要未提及脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、快速射电暴或射电观测，与这些主题的关系根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Bimetric MOND (BIMOND) is used as a platform for variable-<inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>G</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> theories that have MOND-specific idiosyncrasies. E.g., MOND premises dictate return to standard dynamics in the high-acceleration limit, predicting the standard value of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>G</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> for high-acceleration systems. This automatically ensures compliance of such theories with all the constraints on inconstancy of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>G</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> that emerge from the study of high-acceleration systems: geophysics, solar system, pulsars, supernovae, stellar evolution, emission of gravitational waves, etc. In MOND, constraints deduced from such phenomena have no bearing on possible <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>G</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> variability in cosmology. My guiding motivation is to see if such theories may account for some roles of dark matter in cosmology; e.g., in accounting for the expansion history of the Universe in the matter-dominated era, by having a <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>G</mml:mi><mml:mi>e</mml:mi></mml:msub><mml:mo>≈</mml:mo><mml:mn>2</mml:mn><mml:mi>π</mml:mi><mml:mi>G</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> govern the later stages of the expansion, instead of invoking matter density <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mo>≈</mml:mo><mml:mn>2</mml:mn><mml:mi>π</mml:mi><mml:mo>×</mml:mo></mml:math></inline-formula> baryon density. BIMOND is a relativistic MOND theory whose gravitational degrees of freedom are two metrics: <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>g</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mi>μ</mml:mi><mml:mi>ν</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula>, to which matter couples minimally, and <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mover><mml:mi>g</mml:mi><mml:mo>^</mml:mo></mml:mover><mml:mrow><mml:mi>μ</mml:mi><mml:mi>ν</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula>, defining the geometry of a twin sector, presumably with its own ``twin-matter.'' The BIMOND gravitational action for the metric-symmetric subclass is <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msup><mml:mi>I</mml:mi><mml:mi>B</mml:mi></mml:msup><mml:mo>∝</mml:mo><mml:msup><mml:mi>G</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:mn>1</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msup><mml:mo>∫</mml:mo><mml:msup><mml:mi>d</mml:mi><mml:mn>4</mml:mn></mml:msup><mml:mi>x</mml:mi><mml:mo>[</mml:mo><mml:mo>|</mml:mo><mml:mi>g</mml:mi><mml:msup><mml:mo>|</mml:mo><mml:mrow><mml:mn>1</mml:mn><mml:mo>/</mml:mo><mml:mn>2</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msup><mml:mi>R</mml:mi><mml:mo>+</mml:mo><mml:mo>|</mml:mo><mml:mover><mml:mi>g</mml:mi><mml:mo>^</mml:mo></mml:mover><mml:msup><mml:mo>|</mml:mo><mml:mrow><mml:mn>1</mml:mn><mml:mo>/</mml:mo><mml:mn>2</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msup><mml:mover><mml:mi>R</mml:mi><mml:mo>^</mml:mo></mml:mover><mml:mo>+</mml:mo><mml:mi>v</mml:mi><mml:mo>(</mml:mo><mml:mi>g</mml:mi><mml:mo>,</mml:mo><mml:mover><mml:mi>g</mml:mi><mml:mo>^</mml:mo></mml:mover><mml:mo>)</mml:mo><mml:msubsup><mml:mo>ℓ</mml:mo><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:mn>2</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msubsup><mml:mover><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mo>∼</mml:mo></mml:mover><mml:mo>]</mml:mo></mml:math></inline-formula>, where the metric-interaction term, <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mover><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mo>∼</mml:mo></mml:mover></mml:math></inline-formula>, is a function of dimensionless scalars constructed from <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mo>ℓ</mml:mo><mml:mi>M</mml:mi></mml:msub><mml:msubsup><mml:mi>C</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mi>β</mml:mi><mml:mi>γ</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mi>α</mml:mi></mml:msubsup></mml:math></inline-formula>, where the ``relative-acceleration'' tensor, <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msubsup><mml:mi>C</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mi>β</mml:mi><mml:mi>γ</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mi>α</mml:mi></mml:msubsup><mml:mo>≡</mml:mo><mml:msubsup><mml:mi>Γ</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mi>β</mml:mi><mml:mi>γ</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mi>α</mml:mi></mml:msubsup><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:msubsup><mml:mover><mml:mi>Γ</mml:mi><mml:mo>^</mml:mo></mml:mover><mml:mrow><mml:mi>β</mml:mi><mml:mi>γ</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mi>α</mml:mi></mml:msubsup></mml:math></inline-formula>, is the difference of the Levi-Civita connections, and <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mo>ℓ</mml:mo><mml:mi>M</mml:mi></mml:msub><mml:mo>=</mml:mo><mml:msup><mml:mi>c</mml:mi><mml:mn>2</mml:mn></mml:msup><mml:mo>/</mml:mo><mml:msub><mml:mi>a</mml:mi><mml:mn>0</mml:mn></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> is the MOND length. Locally, where the random fluctuations in the two metrics are different, <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mover><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mo>∼</mml:mo></mml:mover></mml:math></inline-formula> encapsulates MOND effects in galactic systems, and the average of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mover><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mo>∼</mml:mo></mml:mover></mml:math></inline-formula> on cosmological scales acts as a (dynamical) dark energy. Without adding degrees of freedom, or new dimensionful constants, BIMOND can be extended to a class of theories that entail what is best described as phenomenon-dependence of Newton's constant, <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>G</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula>: The Lagrangian density in <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msup><mml:mi>I</mml:mi><mml:mi>B</mml:mi></mml:msup></mml:math></inline-formula> is multiplied by <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mn>1</mml:mn><mml:mo>+</mml:mo><mml:msub><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mi>G</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula>, where <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mi>G</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> too is a function of the above scalars. <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>G</mml:mi><mml:mi>e</mml:mi></mml:msub><mml:mo>≡</mml:mo><mml:mi>G</mml:mi><mml:mo>/</mml:mo><mml:mo>(</mml:mo><mml:mn>1</mml:mn><mml:mo>+</mml:mo><mml:msub><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mi>G</mml:mi></mml:msub><mml:mo>)</mml:mo></mml:math></inline-formula> plays the role of the effective gravitational constant. I consider the standard and the Einstein-Palatini formulations for the above action. My aim here is to present the general framework, while specific predictions would depend crucially on details of the structure of the theory---e.g., on the choice of variables, and the dependence of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mover><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mo>∼</mml:mo></mml:mover></mml:math></inline-formula> and <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mi>G</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> on them---and, in cosmology, on unknown inputs: cosmological initial conditions, material content of the twin sector, etc. I cannot yet present a consistent model that complies with all the observations in cosmology, including the expansion history, with all its details. Instead, I describe some examples of theories in the class that predict different values of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>G</mml:mi><mml:mi>e</mml:mi></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> in different circumstances, including one where <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mi>G</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> takes its standard value for all subcosmological systems---even if they are deep in the MOND regime. I also discuss scenarios in which <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>G</mml:mi><mml:mi>e</mml:mi></mml:msub><mml:mo>≈</mml:mo><mml:mi>G</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> in the early Universe, as required by constraints from big bang nucleosynthesis, but with <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>G</mml:mi><mml:mi>e</mml:mi></mml:msub><mml:mo>&gt;</mml:mo><mml:mi>G</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> setting in at later times, where it can affect the expansion history during the matter-dominated era.

</details>


### [3011] [Measurement of angular cross-correlation between the cosmological dispersion measure and the thermal Sunyaev-Zeldovich effect](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.02155)
*Takahashi, Ryuichi,Ioka, Kunihito,Shirasaki, Masato,Osato, Ken*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该工作首次探测到FRB色散量与tSZ效应Compton y参数之间的角交叉相关，Planck y图给出 $4.0\sigma$ 的正相关信号（$\mathcal{A}=2.01\pm0.50$），ACT给出 $1.5\sigma$ 信号（$\mathcal{A}=1.23\pm0.82$），并据此在等温气体假设下推得平均电子温度约 $2\times10^7\,\mathrm{K}$。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB的DM与tSZ效应分别探测IGM及 intervening 星系和星系团中的自由电子密度与热压力，二者结合有望区分气体密度和温度；但此前缺乏对DM与tSZ角交叉相关的探测，本工作旨在测量这一相关并检验其对宇宙学与天体物理参数的敏感性。

Method: 摘要说明：使用晕模型 $\tt{HMx}$ 计算理论预期，并用水动力学模拟校准；在 $1^\prime$--$1000^\prime$ 角分离范围内测量观测交叉相关，所用的DM来自133个已定位FRB，y图来自Planck卫星和ACT。

Result: 摘要报告首次探测到DM与tSZ y参数之间的角交叉相关：Planck的振幅为 $\mathcal{A}=2.01\pm0.50$（$4.0\sigma$），ACT为 $\mathcal{A}=1.23\pm0.82$（$1.5\sigma$），其中 $\mathcal{A}=1$ 对应Planck 2018 $\Lambda$CDM宇宙学的理论预测。在等温气体假设下，所测振幅意味着平均电子温度约为 $2\times10^7\,\mathrm{K}$。该相关对物质成团参数 $\sigma_8$ 和重子反馈高度敏感，且对电离比例、Hubble常数等其他参数的依赖不同于单独的DM。

Conclusion: 作者认为，该角交叉相关的探测表明DM与tSZ效应的结合可以用于区分气体密度与温度；由于该相关对 $\sigma_8$ 和重子反馈高度敏感，且对其他参数的依赖不同于单独的DM，未来对DM和tSZ效应的联合分析可能有助于打破这些参数之间的简并。

Abstract: The dispersion measures (DMs) from fast radio bursts (FRBs) and the thermal Sunyaev--Zeldovich (tSZ) effect probe the free-electron density and thermal pressure, respectively, in the intergalactic medium (IGM) and the intervening galaxies and clusters. Their combination enables disentangling the gas density and temperature. In this work, we present the first detection of an angular cross-correlation between the DMs and the Compton y parameter of the tSZ effect. The theoretical expectation is calculated using the halo model <inline-formula><tex-math>$\tt {HMx}$</tex-math></inline-formula>, calibrated with hydrodynamic simulations. The observational cross-correlation is measured over angular separations of <inline-formula><tex-math>$1^\prime$</tex-math></inline-formula>--<inline-formula><tex-math>$1000^\prime$</tex-math></inline-formula> using the DMs from 133 localized FRBs and the y-maps from the Planck satellite and the Atacama Cosmology Telescope (ACT). We detect a positive correlation with amplitudes of <inline-formula><tex-math>$\mathcal {A}=2.01 \pm 0.50$</tex-math></inline-formula> (<inline-formula><tex-math>$4.0 \sigma$</tex-math></inline-formula>) for Planck and <inline-formula><tex-math>$\mathcal {A}=1.23 \pm 0.82$</tex-math></inline-formula> (<inline-formula><tex-math>$1.5 \sigma$</tex-math></inline-formula>) for ACT, where <inline-formula><tex-math>$\mathcal {A}=1$</tex-math></inline-formula> corresponds to the theoretical prediction of the Planck 2018 <inline-formula><tex-math>$\Lambda$</tex-math></inline-formula>CDM cosmology. Assuming an isothermal gas, the measured amplitude implies an average electron temperature of <inline-formula><tex-math>${\approx }2 \times 10^7 \, {\rm K}$</tex-math></inline-formula>. The correlation is highly sensitive to the matter clustering parameter <inline-formula><tex-math>$\sigma _8$</tex-math></inline-formula> and to baryon feedback, and its dependence on other cosmological and astrophysical parameters---such as the ionized fraction and the Hubble constant---differs from that of the DM alone. This suggests that future joint analyses of the DMs and the tSZ effect could help break degeneracies among these parameters.

</details>


### [3012] [Parkes observations for project P1183 semester 2023APRS_16]()
*Zhang, Songbo,Hobbs, George,Dai, Shi,Wu, Xuefeng,Li, Ye,Yang, Xuan,Tang, Zhenfan,Chang, Chenming*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 利用 Parkes UWL green time 观测重复快速射电暴 FRB 20220529，共探测到 21 个爆发，其中两个有对应的 FAST 同时观测，仅一个爆发具有足够亮的 4-pol 数据集可用于偏振分析；作者因此提议继续用 Parkes UWL 进行高时间分辨率和 4-pol 监测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 20220529 是一个新的高能量重复快速射电暴，可被 FAST 和 Parkes 望远镜观测，同时观测时间最长可达一小时。现有 Parkes UWL 观测虽探测到 21 个爆发，但仅两个有对应的 FAST 同时观测，且仅一个爆发具有足够亮的 4-pol 数据集以分析偏振性质，因此需要继续监测以获取更多完整偏振信息和同时观测数据。

Method: 利用 Parkes UWL green time 观测 FRB 20220529，共探测到 21 个爆发，其中两个爆发有对应的 FAST 同时观测，仅一个爆发具有 4-pol 数据集且亮度足以分析偏振性质。作者提议继续使用 Parkes UWL 进行高时间分辨率和 4-pol 观测。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度及分析方法的细节。

Result: 使用 Parkes UWL green time 观测 FRB 20220529，总共探测到 21 个爆发。其中两个爆发有对应的 FAST 同时观测。只有一个爆发具有 4-pol 数据集且亮度足以分析偏振性质。

Conclusion: 作者提议继续用 Parkes UWL 对该源进行高时间分辨率和 4-pol 监测，目标包括：探测更多具有完整偏振信息的爆发、探测更多具有对应 FAST 同时观测的爆发、利用 Parkes 和 FAST 同时观测的更多爆发研究辐射谱、利用高时间分辨率数据集研究爆发微结构，以及研究重复爆发频率范围的变化。根据摘要无法判断这些目标将得到何种具体物理结论。

Abstract: A new energetic repeating FRB 20220529 can be observed by both FAST and Parkes telescopes and the simultaneous observing time is up to one hour. We have observed this source using Parkes UWL green time and in total 21 bursts have been detected. Two bursts of them have the corresponding simultaneous FAST observations. Only one burst has 4-pol datasets and is bright enough to analyse the polarization properties. Therefore, we propose to continue the monitoring of the source of FRB 20220529 using the Parkes UWL with high-time resolution and 4-pol observation. The new proposed observation aims to: (1)detect more bursts by Parkes UWL with full polarization information; (2) detect more bursts by Parkes UWL with corresponding simultaneous FAST observations; (3) study the radiation spectrum by more bursts detected in simultaneous observations of Parkes and FAST; (4) study the burst microstructure using high time resolution datasets, and (5) study the frequency ranges changes of the repeating bursts.

</details>


### [3013] [Parkes observations for project P1183 semester 2023APRS_09]()
*Zhang, Songbo,Hobbs, George,Dai, Shi,Wu, Xuefeng,Li, Ye,Yang, Xuan,Tang, Zhenfan,Chang, Chenming*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提议拟继续用 Parkes UWL 以高时间分辨率和 4-pol 监测重复快速射电暴 FRB 20220529，此前的 Parkes UWL 观测共探测到 21 个暴，其中仅一个具有足够明亮且含 4-pol 的数据集可用于偏振分析，两个暴有对应的 FAST 同时观测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 20220529 是一个新的高能量重复快速射电暴，可被 FAST 与 Parkes 同时观测，同时观测时间最长可达一小时。此前 Parkes UWL 观测虽探测到 21 个暴，但只有两个暴有对应的 FAST 同时观测，且仅有一个暴的 4-pol 数据足够明亮可用于偏振分析，因此需要继续监测以积累更多数据。

Method: 使用 Parkes UWL 的 green time 对 FRB 20220529 进行观测，并提议继续以高时间分辨率和 4-pol 方式进行监测，同时利用与 FAST 的同时观测。摘要未说明具体观测频率范围、时间跨度、单次观测时长（除同时观测时间最长可达一小时外）、数据分析流程或统计方法。

Result: 利用 Parkes UWL 观测共探测到 21 个 FRB 20220529 的暴；其中两个暴具有对应的 FAST 同时观测；仅有一个暴具有 4-pol 数据集，且其亮度足以分析偏振性质。摘要未报告这些暴的流量、能量、偏振度、偏振位置角、谱指数或微结构等具体数值结果。

Conclusion: 作者据此提议继续用 Parkes UWL 高时间分辨率、4-pol 监测该源，目标包括：探测更多带完整偏振信息的暴；探测更多带 FAST 同时观测的暴；用同时观测的更多暴研究辐射谱；用高时间分辨率数据研究暴的微结构；以及研究重复暴的频率范围变化。摘要未给出已完成的物理解释。

Abstract: A new energetic repeating FRB 20220529 can be observed by both FAST and Parkes telescopes and the simultaneous observing time is up to one hour. We have observed this source using Parkes UWL green time and in total 21 bursts have been detected. Two bursts of them have the corresponding simultaneous FAST observations. Only one burst has 4-pol datasets and is bright enough to analyse the polarization properties. Therefore, we propose to continue the monitoring of the source of FRB 20220529 using the Parkes UWL with high-time resolution and 4-pol observation. The new proposed observation aims to: (1)detect more bursts by Parkes UWL with full polarization information; (2) detect more bursts by Parkes UWL with corresponding simultaneous FAST observations; (3) study the radiation spectrum by more bursts detected in simultaneous observations of Parkes and FAST; (4) study the burst microstructure using high time resolution datasets, and (5) study the frequency ranges changes of the repeating bursts.

</details>


### [3014] [Parkes observations for project P1183 semester 2023APRS_15]()
*Zhang, Songbo,Hobbs, George,Dai, Shi,Wu, Xuefeng,Li, Ye,Yang, Xuan,Tang, Zhenfan,Chang, Chenming*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 利用 Parkes UWL 的 green time 观测重复快速射电暴 FRB 20220529，共探测到 21 个爆发，其中 2 个有对应的 FAST 同时观测，且仅 1 个爆发具有足够明亮的 4-pol 数据集可用于偏振分析，因此提出继续以高时间分辨率和 4-pol 监测该源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 利用 Parkes UWL 的 green time 共探测到 21 个爆发；其中 2 个爆发具有相应的 FAST 同时观测；只有 1 个爆发具有 4-pol 数据集并且足够明亮，可用于分析偏振性质。摘要未说明这些爆发的能量、注量、等待时间、偏振参数、频谱指数或统计显著性等具体数值。

Conclusion: 作者据此提出继续使用 Parkes UWL 以高时间分辨率和 4-pol 观测监测 FRB 20220529，以探测更多带全偏振信息的爆发、探测更多具有 FAST 同时观测的爆发、研究辐射频谱与爆发微结构，并研究重复爆发的频率范围变化。摘要未给出尚未获得的观测结果或物理机制结论。根据摘要无法判断该源与脉冲星、磁星或 FRB 机制之间的具体物理联系。

We have observed this source using Parkes UWL green time and in total 21 bursts have been detected. Two bursts of them have the corresponding simultaneous FAST observations. Therefore, we propose to continue the monitoring of the source of FRB 20220529 using the Parkes UWL with high-time resolution and 4-pol observation. The new proposed observation aims to: (1)detect more bursts by Parkes UWL with full polarization information; (2) detect more bursts by Parkes UWL with corresponding simultaneous FAST observations; (3) study the radiation spectrum by more bursts detected in simultaneous observations of Parkes and FAST; (4) study the burst microstructure using high time resolution datasets, and (5) study the frequency ranges changes of the repeating bursts.

</details>


### [3015] [Parkes observations for project P1183 semester 2023APRS_10]()
*Zhang, Songbo,Hobbs, George,Dai, Shi,Wu, Xuefeng,Li, Ye,Yang, Xuan,Tang, Zhenfan,Chang, Chenming*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案建议继续用 Parkes UWL 以高时间分辨率和 4-pol 模式监测重复快速射电暴 FRB 20220529，此前已探测到 21 个暴，其中两个具有 FAST 同时观测，但仅一个暴的 4-pol 数据足以分析偏振性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FRB 20220529 是一个新的高能重复快速射电暴，可被 FAST 和 Parkes 两台望远镜同时观测，同时观测时间最长可达一小时。目前已探测到 21 个暴，但仅有一个暴的 4-pol 数据集足够明亮以分析偏振性质，且只有两个暴具备相应的 FAST 同时观测，因此需要继续监测以扩充偏振、同时观测与频谱等样本。

<details>

Abstract: We propose to observe the radio-loud magnetar 1E 1547.0-5408 to support an upcoming campaign with NASA's Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer (IXPE) to confirm the first ever direct detection of vacuum birefringence. This strong-field quantum effect was first predicted by Heisenberg back in the 1930s, but has eluded direct detection in Earth-based laboratories due to our inability to replicate the magnetic field strengths required to induce vacuum birefreingence. 1E 1547.0-5408 displays a high X-ray polarisation fraction with a strong energy and rotation-phase dependence, along with evidence of mode-locking in the polarisation position angle. Both effects are strong indicators that vacuum birefringence is occurring in the magnetised atmosphere of this extreme object. Our observations with Murriyang will not only provide a phase-coherent timing solution for folding the IXPE photons during the upcoming 2026 campaign, but provides a critical, independent measure of the magnetar viewing and magnetic geometry. Combined, these measurements will confirm this long sought direct of vacuum birefrinegnce, thereby opening a new window into studying quantum electrodynamics in one of the most extreme environments in the Universe.

</details>

### [3040] [Parkes observations for project P1129 semester 2022OCTS_04]()
*Pol, Nihan,Johnston, Simon,Deller, Adam,Burke-Spolaor, Sarah,Ho, Wynn*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: PSR J0837$-$2454 是一颗年轻（28kyr）、高银纬脉冲星，其 DM 推得距离对应银道面上方 $&gt;$1~kpc 的高度；该提案拟继续监测以维持计时相位连接，支持计划中的 VLBA 自行与视差观测，从而判断它是否是罕见的银河系晕 O/B 型星遗迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J0837$-$2454 的年轻年龄（28kyr）与其 DM 推得距离所对应的高银道 $z$ 高度（$&gt;$1~kpc）之间存在需要解释的情况：它可能诞生于高银道高度处的逃逸或走离 O/B 型星，或者其 DM 推得距离不正确而实际更靠近银道面。判断该脉冲星是否为罕见的银河系晕 O/B 型星遗迹，需要自行与视差测量，而持续计时监测是维持相位连接的必要条件。

Method: 摘要说明 PSR J0837$-$2454 的 DM 推得距离对应 $&gt;$1~kpc 的银道面上方高度。计划中的 VLBA 观测将估计该脉冲星的自行，并在脉冲星比 DM 所暗示更近时通过视差测量给出距离；本提案寻求继续监测该脉冲星，以在 VLBA 观测整个期间保持计时解的相位连接，这也是进行 VLBA 门控观测所必需的。摘要未说明观测频率或波段、时间跨度、采样、具体计时或统计分析方法。

Result: 摘要未报告已获得的观测结果。摘要指出的是拟开展的工作：VLBA 观测将提供自行的估计，并在脉冲星比 DM 所暗示更近时通过视差测量给出距离；继续监测将维持计时解的相位连接，并有助于研究该脉冲星的发射性质以及沿视线方向的 ISM。除年轻年龄 28kyr 和 DM 推得高度 $&gt;$1~kpc 外，摘要未给出其他数值、显著性或相关性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，自行和距离（若脉冲星比 DM 暗示更近则为视差距离）的测量对于确定 PSR J0837$-$2454 是否代表一颗罕见的银河系晕 O/B 型星遗迹至关重要。保持计时相位连接对计划中的 VLBA 门控观测至关重要，并且也将有助于研究该脉冲星的发射性质和沿视线的 ISM。该脉冲星是否与磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）存在联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: PSR J0837$-$2454 is a young, high-Galactic-latitude pulsar, whose distance derived from dispersion measure (DM) implies a height of $&gt;$1~kpc above the Galactic plane. The young age (28kyr) and position can be explained if (i) the pulsar was born at this high Galactic $z$-height from a runaway or walkaway O/B star; or (ii) the DM-derived distance to this pulsar is incorrect and the pulsar is closer to the plane of the Galaxy. VLBA observations will provide us with an estimate of the proper motion of the pulsar, along with the distance to the pulsar through a measurement of the parallax if the pulsar is closer than the DM implies. These measurements are crucial to determining whether or not this pulsar represents the remnants of a rare Milky Way halo O/B star. This proposal seeks to continue monitoring this pulsar in order to maintain phase connection of the timing solution throughout the duration of planned VLBA observations. This is crucial for conducting gated observations with the VLBA, but will also contribute to studies of the pulsar's emission properties and the ISM along the line-of-sight to the pulsar.

</details>

Conclusion: 摘要指出，这些测量对于确定 PSR J0837$-$2454 是否代表银河系晕中一颗罕见 O/B 型星的遗迹至关重要。根据摘要无法判断其 DM 导出距离是否正确、其是否确实诞生于高银道 $z$ 高度，或自行与视差测量的具体结果。

The young age (28kyr) and position can be explained if (i) the pulsar was born at this high Galactic $z$-height from a runaway or walkaway O/B star; or (ii) the DM-derived distance to this pulsar is incorrect and the pulsar is closer to the plane of the Galaxy. *Pol, Nihan,Johnston, Simon,Deller, Adam,Burke-Spolaor, Sarah,Ho, Wynn*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划继续对年轻、高银纬脉冲星 PSR J0837$-$2454 进行监测，以在计划的 VLBA 观测期间维持计时解的相位连接，从而支持通过自行与视差测量判定该脉冲星是否为罕见的银河系晕 O/B 型星遗迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J0837$-$2454 年轻（28kyr）且由 DM 导出的距离暗示其位于银道面上方 $&gt;$1~kpc，这一高银道 $z$ 高度有两种可能解释：诞生于该高度的逃逸或走离 O/B 型星，或 DM 导出距离不正确。摘要指出需要自行与视差测量来判定该脉冲星是否为罕见的银河系晕 O/B 型星遗迹。

Method: 摘要说明将用 VLBA 观测估计脉冲星自行，并在脉冲星比 DM 所暗示更近时通过视差测量给出距离；本提案寻求继续监测该脉冲星以在计划的 VLBA 观测期间维持计时解的相位连接，并指出这对用 VLBA 开展门控观测至关重要。观测频段、时间跨度、数据量与具体分析流程：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未报告已获得的观测结果；其陈述的是计划中的 VLBA 观测将提供自行估计，并可能通过视差给出距离，以及继续监测对维持相位连接的必要性。摘要未给出任何自行、视差、距离或计时精度的数值。摘要提到持续的监测还将有助于对该脉冲星发射性质以及沿视线方向 ISM 的研究。

Conclusion: 摘要指出，自行与距离（若脉冲星比 DM 暗示的更近则为视差距离）测量对于判定 PSR J0837$-$2454 是否代表一颗罕见的银河系晕 O/B 型星遗迹至关重要；继续计时监测是维持相位连接、支持 VLBA 门控观测所必需的。该脉冲星是否确为晕 O/B 型星遗迹，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: PSR J0837$-$2454 is a young, high-Galactic-latitude pulsar, whose distance derived from dispersion measure (DM) implies a height of $&gt;$1~kpc above the Galactic plane. The young age (28kyr) and position can be explained if (i) the pulsar was born at this high Galactic $z$-height from a runaway or walkaway O/B star; or (ii) the DM-derived distance to this pulsar is incorrect and the pulsar is closer to the plane of the Galaxy. VLBA observations will provide us with an estimate of the proper motion of the pulsar, along with the distance to the pulsar through a measurement of the parallax if the pulsar is closer than the DM implies. These measurements are crucial to determining whether or not this pulsar represents the remnants of a rare Milky Way halo O/B star. This proposal seeks to continue monitoring this pulsar in order to maintain phase connection of the timing solution throughout the duration of planned VLBA observations. This is crucial for conducting gated observations with the VLBA, but will also contribute to studies of the pulsar's emission properties and the ISM along the line-of-sight to the pulsar.

</details>

### [3046] [Parkes observations for project P895 semester 2018APRS_BPSR_01]()
*Hobbs, George,Manchester, Dick,Sarkissian, John,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,Keith, Michael,Coles, William,van Straten, Willem,Toomey, Lawrence,Russell, Chris,You, xiaopeng,Ravi, Vikram,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Dempsey, James,Shannon, Ryan,Wang, Jingbo,Wen, Linqing,Zhu, Xingjiang,Dai, Shi,Lasky, Paul,Burke, Sarah,Reardon, Daniel John,Zhang, Lei,Rosado, Pablo,Spiewak, Renee,Parthasarathy, Aditya*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 在对引力波背景振幅的限制中，PSR J1909-3744 单颗脉冲星的计时起主导作用，其上限已切入可行理论模型范围；但对这颗脉冲星单独观测无法实现无歧义探测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自 2005 年以来，Parkes 脉冲星计时阵列（PPTA）项目持续对引力波背景信号振幅给出越来越严格的限制，而这些上限目前主要由 PSR J1909-3744 单颗脉冲星主导。已有上限已切入可行理论模型范围，因此需要判断继续常规观测该脉冲星能否进一步收紧限制，并为引力波探测的观测策略提供依据。

Method: 摘要提到自 2005 年以来 Parkes 脉冲星计时阵列（PPTA）项目的计时观测，以及对该脉冲星进行持续常规观测；涉及的天体为 PSR J1909-3744。摘要未说明具体观测频段、时间跨度、数据量、样本、仪器配置或具体分析统计方法。

Result: 摘要指出，对引力波信号振幅的当前上限主要由单颗脉冲星 PSR J1909-3744 主导，仅凭这颗脉冲星的计时所得上限已经切入可行理论模型的范围；通过继续对该脉冲星进行常规观测来进一步降低振幅上限，将显著缩小该范围。摘要还指出，脉冲星数据中引力波的第一个证据很可能出现在 PSR J1909-3744 的计时中，但仅有单颗脉冲星无法作出无歧义探测。摘要未给出具体的振幅数值、置信度或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，继续对该脉冲星进行常规观测可显著缩小可行理论模型范围，并且由这颗脉冲星推得的可能信号强度有助于优化现有或未来脉冲星计时阵列探测引力波信号的观测策略；而单颗脉冲星不足以作出无歧义探测。根据摘要无法判断该工作与脉冲星单脉冲发射、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）之间的具体联系。

Abstract: Since the year 2005, the Parkes Pulsar Timing Array (PPTA) project has been placing ever more stringent constraints on the amplitude of a gravitational wave background signal. Such upper bounds on the amplitude of the gravitational wave signal are currently dominated by a single pulsar: PSR J1909-3744. The upper bound with this pulsar alone already cuts into the range of tenable theoretical models. Further reducing the amplitude bound (by continued regular observations of this pulsar) will significantly narrow that range. The first evidence of gravitational waves in the pulsar data are likely to be observed in the timing for PSR J1909-3744, but with only a single pulsar we will not be able to make an unambiguous detection. However, knowledge of the likely signal strength (derived from this pulsar) will help to optimise the observing strategy for the detection of the gravitational wave signals with existing or future pulsar timing arrays.

</details>

Abstract: Since the year 2005, the Parkes Pulsar Timing Array (PPTA) project has been placing ever more stringent constraints on the amplitude of a gravitational wave background signal. Such upper bounds on the amplitude of the gravitational wave signal are currently dominated by a single pulsar: PSR J1909-3744. The upper bound with this pulsar alone already cuts into the range of tenable theoretical models. Further reducing the amplitude bound (by continued regular observations of this pulsar) will significantly narrow that range. The first evidence of gravitational waves in the pulsar data are likely to be observed in the timing for PSR J1909-3744, but with only a single pulsar we will not be able to make an unambiguous detection. However, knowledge of the likely signal strength (derived from this pulsar) will help to optimise the observing strategy for the detection of the gravitational wave signals with existing or future pulsar timing arrays.

</details>

Motivation: 自2005年以来，PPTA项目持续对引力波背景信号振幅施加越来越严格的限制。当前振幅上限主要由单颗脉冲星PSR J1909-3744主导，且已切入可行理论模型范围；因此需要继续对该脉冲星进行常规观测以进一步压低上限。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测与分析方法，仅提及自2005年以来对PSR J1909-3744进行持续常规观测，并利用该脉冲星的计时来约束引力波背景振幅上限；未给出望远镜、频段、时间跨度、样本量或统计方法的细节。

Result: 对引力波背景信号振幅的当前上限由单颗脉冲星PSR J1909-3744主导；仅凭这颗脉冲星给出的上限已经切入可行理论模型的范围。进一步降低振幅上限将显著缩小该范围。摘要指出，脉冲星数据中引力波的首个证据很可能出现在PSR J1909-3744的计时中。

Conclusion: 作者认为，进一步降低振幅上限可显著缩小可行理论模型范围；虽然仅凭单颗脉冲星无法做出明确无误的引力波探测，但由该脉冲星导出的可能信号强度知识有助于优化现有或未来脉冲星计时阵列的探测观测策略。

Abstract: Since the year 2005, the Parkes Pulsar Timing Array (PPTA) project has been placing ever more stringent constraints on the amplitude of a gravitational wave background signal. Such upper bounds on the amplitude of the gravitational wave signal are currently dominated by a single pulsar: PSR J1909-3744. The upper bound with this pulsar alone already cuts into the range of tenable theoretical models. Further reducing the amplitude bound (by continued regular observations of this pulsar) will significantly narrow that range. The first evidence of gravitational waves in the pulsar data are likely to be observed in the timing for PSR J1909-3744, but with only a single pulsar we will not be able to make an unambiguous detection. However, knowledge of the likely signal strength (derived from this pulsar) will help to optimise the observing strategy for the detection of the gravitational wave signals with existing or future pulsar timing arrays.

</details>

### [3065] [Parkes observations for project P1129 semester 2021OCTS_07]()
*Pol, Nihan,Johnston, Simon,Burke-Spolaor, Sarah*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划对年轻的高银纬脉冲星 PSR J0837-2454 获得相干计时解，以支持门控 VLBA 观测，从而通过视差独立测定距离，并检验其 DM 导出距离是否被视线方向上的额外 DM 来源抬高。这些测量对于判断该脉冲星是否为罕见的银河系晕 O/B 型星遗迹至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J0837-2454 年轻（28kyr）且位于高银纬，其 DM 导出距离意味着它位于银道面上方 $&gt;$1~kpc。其年龄与位置有两种可能解释：它由高银道 $z$ 高度处的逃逸或“走离”O/B 型星诞生，或 DM 导出距离不正确、脉冲星其实更靠近银河系平面。摘要指出需要确定该脉冲星是否为罕见的银河系晕 O/B 型星遗迹。

Method: 摘要说明：在接下来一年内获得该脉冲星的相干计时解，以支持门控 VLBA 观测；结合对自行的独立估计，通过视差测量给出距离（若脉冲星比 DM 所暗示的更近）。摘要还提到研究散射和闪烁以检验视线上是否存在额外 DM 来源，并测量偏振性质以研究束几何以及该方向上的 ISM 和银河系磁场。具体观测频段、时间跨度、样本细节及分析流程摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未说明。摘要陈述的是拟开展的观测与测量计划，而非已完成的结果；它未报告任何计时、视差、自行、散射、闪烁、偏振、ISM 或磁场测量数值，也未给出显著性、相关性或已获得的脉冲轮廓信息。

Conclusion: 摘要提出的结论是：这些测量对于确定 PSR J0837-2454 是否代表一颗罕见的银河系晕 O/B 型星遗迹至关重要；散射和闪烁研究可检验视线上是否存在额外 DM 来源，从而可能抬高其 DM 导出距离及其在银道面上方的高度；偏振测量可用于研究其束几何并进一步研究该方向上的 ISM 和银河系磁场。根据摘要无法判断这些预期检验的最终物理结论。

Abstract: PSR J0837-2454 is a young, high-Galactic-latitude pulsar, whose distance derived from dispersion measure (DM) implies a height of $&gt;$1~kpc above the Galactic plane. The young age (28kyr) and position can be explained if (i) the pulsar was born at this high Galactic $z$-height from a runaway or walkaway O/B star; or (ii) the DM-derived distance to this pulsar is incorrect and the pulsar is closer to the plane of the Galaxy. Obtaining a coherent timing solution for the pulsar over the coming year will allow gated VLBA observations which, along with an independent estimate of the proper motion, will also provide us with a distance to the pulsar through a measurement of the parallax, if the pulsar is closer than the DM implies. These measurements are crucial to determining whether or not this pulsar represents the remnants of a rare Milky Way halo O/B star. In addition, studying the scattering and scintillation will allow us to test whether there is any additional source of DM along the line of sight to the pulsar that might inflate its DM-derived distance, and hence its height above the Galactic plane. Finally, measuring the polarisation properties of the pulsar will allow us to study its beam geometry, as well as further investigate the ISM and the Galactic magnetic field in this direction.

</details>

Result: 摘要未报告已完成观测的结果或具体数值测量。其陈述为计划性内容：未来一年获得相干计时解可使门控 VLBA 观测成为可能；视差测量在脉冲星比 DM 所暗示距离更近时可提供距离；散射与闪烁研究可检验视线方向是否存在可能夸大 DM 导出距离及银道面之上高度的额外 DM 源；偏振测量可研究波束几何并进一步研究该方向的 ISM 与银河系磁场。

Conclusion: 作者提出这些测量对于确定 PSR J0837-2454 是否代表一颗罕见的银河系晕 O/B 型星遗迹至关重要；若视差测量表明该脉冲星比 DM 所暗示的距离更近，或散射与闪烁研究显示视线方向存在额外 DM 源，则可检验 DM 导出距离及其高银纬高度是否被夸大。摘要还提出偏振测量可用于研究波束几何及该方向的 ISM 与银河系磁场。对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、FRB 或自转减速转矩变化等更广泛物理联系的解释：根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: PSR J0837-2454 is a young, high-Galactic-latitude pulsar, whose distance derived from dispersion measure (DM) implies a height of $&gt;$1~kpc above the Galactic plane. The young age (28kyr) and position can be explained if (i) the pulsar was born at this high Galactic $z$-height from a runaway or walkaway O/B star; or (ii) the DM-derived distance to this pulsar is incorrect and the pulsar is closer to the plane of the Galaxy. Obtaining a coherent timing solution for the pulsar over the coming year will allow gated VLBA observations which, along with an independent estimate of the proper motion, will also provide us with a distance to the pulsar through a measurement of the parallax, if the pulsar is closer than the DM implies. These measurements are crucial to determining whether or not this pulsar represents the remnants of a rare Milky Way halo O/B star. In addition, studying the scattering and scintillation will allow us to test whether there is any additional source of DM along the line of sight to the pulsar that might inflate its DM-derived distance, and hence its height above the Galactic plane. Finally, measuring the polarisation properties of the pulsar will allow us to study its beam geometry, as well as further investigate the ISM and the Galactic magnetic field in this direction.

</details>

TL;DR: PSR J0837-2454 是一颗年龄为 28kyr 的年轻高银纬脉冲星，其 DM 导出距离暗示它在银道面上方 $&gt;$1~kpc；摘要提出获取相干计时解、门控 VLBA 观测、自行与视差测量，以及散射、闪烁和偏振研究，以检验它是否是罕见的银河系晕 O/B 型星遗迹，或 DM 导出距离是否正确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J0837-2454 年轻（28kyr）且位于高银纬，其 DM 导出距离暗示它位于银道面上方 $&gt;$1~kpc。摘要提出的问题是：该脉冲星究竟是诞生于这一高银道 $z$-高度、来自逃逸或“走离”的 O/B 型星，还是其 DM 导出距离不正确、实际更靠近银河系平面。摘要指出这些测量对于确定它是否代表罕见的银河系晕 O/B 型星遗迹至关重要。

Method: 摘要说明：计划在未来一年内获得 PSR J0837-2454 的相干计时解；这将允许门控 VLBA 观测，并结合对自行运动的独立估计，在脉冲星比 DM 所暗示的更近时通过视差测量给出其距离。此外，将研究散射和闪烁，以检验视线方向上是否存在可能抬高 DM 导出距离的额外 DM 来源；还将测量偏振性质以研究波束几何以及该方向上的 ISM 和银河系磁场。具体观测频率、时间跨度、样本量和统计方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未报告已完成的观测结果。摘要陈述的既有信息为：PSR J0837-2454 是一颗年轻、高银纬脉冲星，年龄为 28kyr，其 DM 导出距离意味着它位于银道面上方 $&gt;$1~kpc。摘要中的其余内容为计划中的观测及其预期用途，包括相干计时解、门控 VLBA 观测、自行运动、视差距离、散射与闪烁检验，以及偏振测量。摘要未给出距离、视差、自行、DM、散射、闪烁或偏振的数值结果或显著性。

Conclusion: 摘要指出，年轻年龄（28kyr）和高银纬位置可以由两种情形之一解释：该脉冲星诞生于这一高银道 $z$-高度、来自逃逸或“走离”的 O/B 型星；或者其 DM 导出距离不正确、它更靠近银河系平面。摘要认为，相干计时、门控 VLBA 观测、自行与视差测量对于确定该脉冲星是否代表罕见的银河系晕 O/B 型星遗迹至关重要，散射与闪烁研究可用于检验视线方向上的额外 DM 来源，偏振测量可研究波束几何以及该方向上的 ISM 和银河系磁场。根据摘要无法判断这些解释中哪一种成立，也无法判断该脉冲星与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲发射之间是否存在关联。

Abstract: PSR J0837-2454 is a young, high-Galactic-latitude pulsar, whose distance derived from dispersion measure (DM) implies a height of $&gt;$1~kpc above the Galactic plane. The young age (28kyr) and position can be explained if (i) the pulsar was born at this high Galactic $z$-height from a runaway or walkaway O/B star; or (ii) the DM-derived distance to this pulsar is incorrect and the pulsar is closer to the plane of the Galaxy. Obtaining a coherent timing solution for the pulsar over the coming year will allow gated VLBA observations which, along with an independent estimate of the proper motion, will also provide us with a distance to the pulsar through a measurement of the parallax, if the pulsar is closer than the DM implies. These measurements are crucial to determining whether or not this pulsar represents the remnants of a rare Milky Way halo O/B star. In addition, studying the scattering and scintillation will allow us to test whether there is any additional source of DM along the line of sight to the pulsar that might inflate its DM-derived distance, and hence its height above the Galactic plane. Finally, measuring the polarisation properties of the pulsar will allow us to study its beam geometry, as well as further investigate the ISM and the Galactic magnetic field in this direction.

</details>

Obtaining a coherent timing solution for the pulsar over the coming year will allow gated VLBA observations which, along with an independent estimate of the proper motion, will also provide us with a distance to the pulsar through a measurement of the parallax, if the pulsar is closer than the DM implies. These measurements are crucial to determining whether or not this pulsar represents the remnants of a rare Milky Way halo O/B star. In addition, studying the scattering and scintillation will allow us to test whether there is any additional source of DM along the line of sight to the pulsar that might inflate its DM-derived distance, and hence its height above the Galactic plane. Finally, measuring the polarisation properties of the pulsar will allow us to study its beam geometry, as well as further investigate the ISM and the Galactic magnetic field in this direction.

### [3074] [Parkes observations for project P1162 semester 2023APRS_07]()
*Liu, Xiaojin,Hobbs, George,Cameron, Andrew,Zhu, Xingjiang,Wang, Pei,Hou, Xian,Parkinson, Pablo Saz,Wang, Ziyang,Ji, Long,Li, Jian*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划用 Parkes 继续计时观测新发现的毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1402+13，申请 14 小时以将计时基线延长至一年；其表观自转减慢率为已知毫秒脉冲星中最高，且初步分析显示它具有纳秒级计时精度、是脉冲星计时阵列的有希望候选体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脉冲星计时是研究脉冲星物理的有力工具，发现更奇异系统或以更高精度计时是脉冲星天文学的重要任务。PSR J1402+13 是近期发现的毫秒脉冲星，其表观自转减慢率若确认将对脉冲星再循环理论预言的加速过程构成严格限制，且初步分析显示它是有希望的脉冲星计时阵列候选体，因而值得后续计时观测。

Method: 使用 Parkes 对 PSR J1402+13 开展计时观测。摘要说明过去两个月已观测 8 次，并申请额外 14 小时以将计时基线延长至一年；提及 60 分钟观测可达到 6 纳秒量级的计时精度。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、数据采样与后端、计时分析流程或极化、单脉冲、RM 等分析方法。

Result: PSR J1402+13 的表观自转减慢率是已知毫秒脉冲星中最高的；该自转减慢率“如果得到确认”才会对再循环理论的加速过程施加严格限制。初步分析表明，它是脉冲星计时阵列非常有希望的候选体，使用 Parkes 进行 60 分钟观测可达到 6 纳秒量级的精度。过去两个月已观测 8 次。摘要未说明自转减慢率数值、显著性、计时精度已实测达到的严格程度或任何计时残差结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，继续观测并延长计时基线至一年将导出该系统的星历表，有助于理解其形成和演化历史，并可评估 PSR J1402+13 的计时性能及其纳入脉冲星计时阵列的适宜性。对于该源是否确为再循环理论限制案例，摘要使用“如果得到确认”的措辞，尚属待验证；其与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲/模式转换的物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Pulsar timing is a powerful tool in studying pulsar physics. Discovering more exotic pulsar systems or timing pulsars with higher precision is an essential part of pulsar astronomy. As a recently discovered millisecond pulsar, PSR J1402+13 is an interesting source for follow-up timing observations. First, its apparent spin-down rate is the highest among known millisecond pulsars. This spin-down rate, if confirmed, will place stringent constraints on the spin-up process predicted by pulsar recycling theories. Second, and more importantly, preliminary analysis shows that J1402+13 is a very promising candidate for pulsar timing arrays, with an achievable precision at the level of 6 nanoseconds for 60 minutes observation with Parkes. We have observed J1402+13 for 8 times in the past two months and propose to continue the observations in the coming semester. We apply for another 14 hours to observe the pulsar to extend the timing baseline to one year. This project will derive an ephemeris of the system, which is valuable to understand its formation and evolution history. Furthermore, the observations will allow us to evaluate the timing performance of J1402+13 and its suitability to be included in pulsar timing arrays.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者认为，通过继续观测将计时基线延长至一年，该项目可给出该系统的星历表，有助于理解其形成和演化历史，并可评估 PSR J1402+13 的计时表现及其纳入脉冲星计时阵的适用性。摘要未给出延长观测后的最终结果；其极高视自转减慢率的确认及其对再循环理论的约束仍属待验证的可能结果。

Abstract: Pulsar timing is a powerful tool in studying pulsar physics. Discovering more exotic pulsar systems or timing pulsars with higher precision is an essential part of pulsar astronomy. As a recently discovered millisecond pulsar, PSR J1402+13 is an interesting source for follow-up timing observations. First, its apparent spin-down rate is the highest among known millisecond pulsars. This spin-down rate, if confirmed, will place stringent constraints on the spin-up process predicted by pulsar recycling theories. Second, and more importantly, preliminary analysis shows that J1402+13 is a very promising candidate for pulsar timing arrays, with an achievable precision at the level of 6 nanoseconds for 60 minutes observation with Parkes. We have observed J1402+13 for 8 times in the past two months and propose to continue the observations in the coming semester. We apply for another 14 hours to observe the pulsar to extend the timing baseline to one year. This project will derive an ephemeris of the system, which is valuable to understand its formation and evolution history. Furthermore, the observations will allow us to evaluate the timing performance of J1402+13 and its suitability to be included in pulsar timing arrays.

</details>

Method: 申请使用 Parkes 继续对毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1402+13 进行计时观测。过去两个月已观测 8 次，本次申请再获 14 小时，以将计时基线延长至一年。摘要提到初步分析给出的 60 分钟观测精度估计，以及将得出该系统的星历表。除脉冲星计时外，具体的分析流程、频率或波段、偏振或单脉冲分析等摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：PSR J1402+13 的视自转减慢率在已知毫秒脉冲星中最高；初步分析表明该源是脉冲星计时阵列的很有前景的候选体，用 Parkes 进行 60 分钟观测可达到 6 纳秒量级的精度。过去两个月已观测该脉冲星 8 次。摘要未给出脉冲轮廓、偏振、色散量或射电频谱等具体测量结果，也未说明上述自转减慢率是否已被证实。

Conclusion: 作者认为，若该视自转减慢率得到证实，将对脉冲星再循环理论预言的加速过程施加严格限制；继续观测将得出该系统的星历表，有助于理解其形成与演化历史，并可评估 PSR J1402+13 的计时性能及其纳入脉冲星计时阵列的适宜性。摘要未提及磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射的关联；根据摘要无法判断其与这些主题的关系。

Abstract: Pulsar timing is a powerful tool in studying pulsar physics. Discovering more exotic pulsar systems or timing pulsars with higher precision is an essential part of pulsar astronomy. As a recently discovered millisecond pulsar, PSR J1402+13 is an interesting source for follow-up timing observations. First, its apparent spin-down rate is the highest among known millisecond pulsars. This spin-down rate, if confirmed, will place stringent constraints on the spin-up process predicted by pulsar recycling theories. Second, and more importantly, preliminary analysis shows that J1402+13 is a very promising candidate for pulsar timing arrays, with an achievable precision at the level of 6 nanoseconds for 60 minutes observation with Parkes. We have observed J1402+13 for 8 times in the past two months and propose to continue the observations in the coming semester. We apply for another 14 hours to observe the pulsar to extend the timing baseline to one year. This project will derive an ephemeris of the system, which is valuable to understand its formation and evolution history. Furthermore, the observations will allow us to evaluate the timing performance of J1402+13 and its suitability to be included in pulsar timing arrays.

</details>

### [3087] [Parkes observations for project P1186 semester 2023APRS_04]()
*Li, Qingying,Dang, Shijun,Xu, xin,Zhong, Wenqian,Tian, Jie*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用Parkes超宽带接收机对PSR J0934-5249开展长时间、宽带宽观测；此前GMRT在325 MHz单频观测显示该脉冲星具有清晰相干亚脉冲漂移和少量短时 null，但 null 数目太少，无法研究 null 引起的漂移率变化，且此前观测均为低宽带。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J0934-5249此前仅在325 MHz单频被GMRT观测，其亚脉冲漂移与nulling参数已由Arun Naidu et al. 2017首次估计，Basu et al. 2021的观测亦未给出进一步解释；已有的null数目太少，无法研究null是否引起漂移率变化，且两次观测均在低宽带进行。

Method: 摘要提到此前使用GMRT对PSR J0934-5249进行325 MHz单频观测，并利用单脉冲序列与2DFS图分析亚脉冲漂移和nulling；本次提出使用Parkes超宽带接收机对该脉冲星进行长时间观测，以获得宽带宽上的详细分析。观测时间跨度、样本量与具体分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告PSR J0934-5249的单脉冲序列显示出清晰的相干漂移并伴随一些短时null，2DFS图也显示出清晰特征，确认该脉冲星为相干漂移者。已观测到的null数目很少，不足以研究该脉冲星中任何由null引起的漂移率变化。Arun Naidu et al. 2017首次给出该脉冲星的漂移和nulling参数估计；Basu et al. 2021使用巨型米波射电望远镜观测了该脉冲星，但未作进一步解释。摘要未给出具体数值或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者提出使用Parkes超宽带接收机对这类脉冲星进行长时间观测，以便在宽带宽上给出详细分析；此前工作已在325 MHz单频确认了PSR J0934-5249的相干漂移特性，但由于null数目很少，无法研究null引起的漂移率变化。对该脉冲星物理机制及与磁星、快速射电暴等联系的进一步解释，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The multi-frequency observation of the subpulse drifting of PSR J0934-5249 with Parkers. the PSR J0934-5249 was observed at a single frequency (325 MHz) using the GMRT. Its single pulse sequence shows clear coherent drifting with some short nulls. 2DFS plot also shows a clear feature confirming that this pulsar is a coherent drifter. The number of nulls were small for us to study any null induced drift rate changes in this pulsar. Arun Naidu et al. 2017 Estimated the drifting and nulling parameters for the first time in this pulsar. The observations using the Giant Meterwave Radio Telescope for PSR J0934-5249, but there was no further explanation of the pulsar (Basu et al. 2021). Both observations were made at low broadband. We propose using the ultra wideband reciver of Parkes to observe these pulsars for a long time, so that to give a detailed analysis of these pulsar on the wide bandwidth.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者提出使用 Parkes 的超宽带接收机对这些脉冲星进行长时间观测，以便在宽带宽上给出详细分析；其动机在于此前观测均限于低频宽带、且已有工作未对该脉冲星作进一步解释。摘要未报告拟议观测的结果，因此对宽带宽分析能否改变对漂移、空脉冲或其物理机制的认识，根据摘要无法判断。与磁星、FRB、计时、自转减慢转矩变化或偏振的联系，摘要未说明。

Abstract: The multi-frequency observation of the subpulse drifting of PSR J0934-5249 with Parkers. the PSR J0934-5249 was observed at a single frequency (325 MHz) using the GMRT. Its single pulse sequence shows clear coherent drifting with some short nulls. 2DFS plot also shows a clear feature confirming that this pulsar is a coherent drifter. The number of nulls were small for us to study any null induced drift rate changes in this pulsar. Arun Naidu et al. 2017 Estimated the drifting and nulling parameters for the first time in this pulsar. The observations using the Giant Meterwave Radio Telescope for PSR J0934-5249, but there was no further explanation of the pulsar (Basu et al. 2021). Both observations were made at low broadband. We propose using the ultra wideband reciver of Parkes to observe these pulsars for a long time, so that to give a detailed analysis of these pulsar on the wide bandwidth.

### [3091] [Parkes observations for project P1162 semester 2023OCTS_01]()
*Liu, Xiaojin,Hobbs, George,Cameron, Andrew,Zhu, Xingjiang,Wang, Pei,Hou, Xian,Parkinson, Pablo Saz,Wang, Ziyang,Ji, Long,Li, Jian*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 对毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1402+13 进行 9 个月高节奏计时观测后，获得了相位相干解，测得 pdot 约为 10^{-20} s/s，远低于星表所报道的视自转减慢率，从而解决了其与自转加快理论之间表面上的矛盾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1402+13 是新发现的毫秒脉冲星，星表报道的视自转减慢率为已知毫秒脉冲星中最高，与自转加快理论存在表面矛盾；同时其视通量密度较高、距离较小，似乎具备较高计时精度，因此值得开展后续计时观测以检验这些问题。

Method: 过去 9 个月以高观测节奏对 PSR J1402+13 进行了计时观测，并获得相位相干解；申请再观测 15 小时以延长计时基线。摘要未说明所用望远镜或仪器、观测频段或频率、具体数据量与样本，以及除计时解之外的分析方法。

Result: 相位相干解给出的 pdot 约为 10^{-20} s/s，远低于星表报道的视自转减慢率，从而解决了与自转加快理论之间的表面矛盾。摘要还提及未来观测将用于改进计时解、评估计时精度及其用于脉冲星计时阵列的潜力，并研究闪烁效应、测量陡峭谱指数，以及促进光学和伽马射线波段观测；但除 pdot 量级外，摘要未给出具体数值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，这一显著更低的 pdot 解决了 PSR J1402+13 与自转加快理论之间的表面矛盾，并认为延长计时基线可改进计时解、评估其计时精度及用于脉冲星计时阵列的潜力，同时有助于研究闪烁效应、测量陡峭谱指数并促进光学与伽马射线观测。根据摘要无法判断该源与磁星、快速射电暴、单脉冲、模式转换或偏振等主题的具体物理联系。

Abstract: Pulsar timing is a powerful tool in studying pulsar physics. Discovering more exotic pulsar systems or timing pulsars with higher precision is an essential part of pulsar astronomy. As a recently discovered millisecond pulsar, PSR J1402+13 is an interesting source for follow-up timing observations. First, its apparent spin-down rate, as reported in the catalogue, was the highest among known millisecond pulsars, causing a seeming tension with the spin-up theory. Second, its apparent high flux density and small distance seemed to give a high timing precision. We have observed J1402+13 with high cadence in the past 9 months and obtained a phase-coherent solution, which gives a much lower pdot (~ 10^{-20} s/s) thus solves the tension with the spin-up theory. We apply for another 15 hours to observe the pulsar to further extend the timing baseline, which will refine our timing solution and help us clearly evaluate its timing precision and potential to be used for pulsar timing arrays. The observation will also help us study the scintillation effect of the pulsar and measure its steep spectral index. The more comprehensive measurements of the pulsar will also facilitate observations in optical and gamma-ray bands.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者认为已获得的相位相干解解决了与 spin-up 理论的张力；延长计时基线将改进计时解，并有助于评估其计时精度及用于脉冲星计时阵列的潜力，还可研究闪烁效应、测量陡峭谱指数，并促进光学和伽马射线波段观测。根据摘要无法判断更具体物理机制或向磁星、FRB 等方向的结论。

Abstract: Pulsar timing is a powerful tool in studying pulsar physics. Discovering more exotic pulsar systems or timing pulsars with higher precision is an essential part of pulsar astronomy. As a recently discovered millisecond pulsar, PSR J1402+13 is an interesting source for follow-up timing observations. First, its apparent spin-down rate, as reported in the catalogue, was the highest among known millisecond pulsars, causing a seeming tension with the spin-up theory. Second, its apparent high flux density and small distance seemed to give a high timing precision. We have observed J1402+13 with high cadence in the past 9 months and obtained a phase-coherent solution, which gives a much lower pdot (~ 10^{-20} s/s) thus solves the tension with the spin-up theory. We apply for another 15 hours to observe the pulsar to further extend the timing baseline, which will refine our timing solution and help us clearly evaluate its timing precision and potential to be used for pulsar timing arrays. The observation will also help us study the scintillation effect of the pulsar and measure its steep spectral index. The more comprehensive measurements of the pulsar will also facilitate observations in optical and gamma-ray bands.

</details>

### [3101] [Parkes observations for project P1052 semester 2020APRS_02]()
*van Straten, Willem,Green, James,Johnston, Simon,Hobbs, George,Karastergiou, Aris,Bhat, Ramesh,Keith, Michael,Weltevrede, Patrick,Toomey, Lawrence,Jameson, Andrew,Dempsey, James,Tiburzi, Caterina,Jankowski, Fabian,Venkatraman Krishnan, Vivek,McSweeney, Samuel James,Primak, Natalia,Parthasarathy, Aditya,Oswald, Lucy,Shaifullah, Golam,Griffin, Anthony,Hankin, Robin,Maan, Yogesh,Szary, Andrzej,Dyks, Jaroslaw,Vohl, Dany*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该研究提出开创性统计方法，并利用 Parkes 超宽带接收机开展大规模脉冲星射电发射统计调查，以研究短时间尺度的信号动力学，并探索 2 GHz 以上频谱和 recycled 脉冲星族群，从而对脉冲星磁层物理条件给出新约束。样本从毫秒脉冲星到磁星，覆盖磁层尺度四个数量级和磁场强度七个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经过五十年研究，脉冲星磁层中射电波发射与传播的物理机制仍未被很好地理解。原因包括：观测到的动态现象未被现有理论预测或解释、此前可同时研究的脉冲星频谱窗口有限，以及已研究的脉冲星样本存在偏差。该研究旨在突破这些限制。

Method: 摘要说明，作者发展了开创性统计方法，可在短时间尺度上研究射电脉冲星信号动力学（如漂移和准周期子脉冲结构、正交偏振发射模式转换、nulling 等），即便无法探测到单个脉冲。作者将使用这些新方法和 Parkes 的超宽带接收机开展大规模脉冲星射电发射统计调查，覆盖从毫秒脉冲星到磁星的样本，并探索 2 GHz 以上频谱及 recycled 脉冲星族群。摘要未说明具体观测时长、样本量和统计检验细节。

Result: 摘要未说明实际观测结果或已完成的数据分析结果。摘要仅说明将开展大规模统计调查，探索此前难以触及的 2 GHz 以上脉冲星频谱和 recycled 脉冲星族群，这些区域中脉冲星流量密度通常要低得多；并说明测量脉冲式发射事件的瞬时带宽将产生对磁层物理条件的新约束，例如磁层等离子体中强湍流的空间尺度。样本广度覆盖从毫秒脉冲星到磁星，跨越磁层尺度四个数量级和磁场强度七个数量级。

Conclusion: 作者明确的科学目标是利用新统计方法和 Parkes 超宽带接收机，研究此前难以触及的脉冲星频谱与族群，并通过脉冲式发射事件的瞬时带宽约束脉冲星磁层中的物理条件，如强湍流的空间尺度；同时利用从毫秒脉冲星到磁星的宽样本研究发射与传播物理在磁层尺度四个数量级和磁场强度七个数量级上的演化。根据摘要无法判断这些目标是否已实现或得到具体物理结论。

Abstract: After five decades of study, the physics of radio wave emission and propagation in the pulsar magnetosphere remains poorly understood. This is largely due to the wide variety of dynamic phenomena observed in pulsar signals that are neither predicted nor explained by current theory, the limited window of the pulsar spectrum that previously could be studied simultaneously, and the biased sample of the pulsar population that has been studied to date. To address these limitations, we have developed pioneering statistical methods that provide new interpretive insights and enable us to study the dynamics of the radio pulsar signal on short time scales (e.g. drifting and quasi-periodic sub-pulse structure, transitions between orthogonally polarized modes of emission, nulling, etc.) even when individual pulses cannot be detected. Using our novel methods and the ultra-wide bandwidth receiver at Parkes, we will undertake a large-scale survey of pulsar radio emission statistics and explore two previously inaccessible regions where pulsar flux densities are typically much lower: the pulsar spectrum above 2 GHz, and the recycled pulsar population. Measuring the instantaneous bandwidth of impulsive emission events will yield new constraints on the physical conditions in the pulsar magnetosphere, such as the spatial scale of strong turbulence in the magnetospheric plasma. The breadth of our sample, from millisecond pulsars to magnetars, will enable us to study the evolution of emission and propagation physics over four orders of magnitude in magnetospheric size and seven orders of magnitude in magnetic field strength.

</details>

### [3103] [Parkes observations for project P1162 semester 2022OCTS_03]()
*Liu, Xiaojin,Hobbs, George,Zhu, Xingjiang,Wang, Pei,Hou, Xian,Parkinson, Pablo Saz,Wang, Ziyang,Ji, Long,Li, Jian*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 申请用Parkes对毫秒脉冲星PSR J1402+13开展专门的计时观测，以导出其星历表并评估其计时性能；该源初步显示已知毫秒脉冲星中最高的自转减慢率，且有望以6纳秒量级精度（60分钟观测）成为脉冲星计时阵列候选源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脉冲星计时是研究脉冲星物理的有力工具，发现更多奇异脉冲星系统或更高精度计时是脉冲星天文学的重要部分。新发现的毫秒脉冲星PSR J1402+13值得后续计时：初步数据显示其自转减慢率在已知毫秒脉冲星中最高，若确认将约束脉冲星再循环理论预言的加速过程；同时它有潜力以高精度计时，成为脉冲星计时阵列候选源。

Method: 申请18.7小时的专门计时观测，使用Parkes在半年时间内观测PSR J1402+13，并计划在未来学期进行更多观测；摘要提到以60分钟观测可达到6纳秒量级的计时精度。项目将导出该系统的星历表，并评估其计时性能及纳入脉冲星计时阵列的适宜性。数据分析方法等细节摘要未说明。

Result: 根据初步数据，PSR J1402+13的自转减慢率在已知毫秒脉冲星中最高，但摘要表明该结果尚待确认。摘要还报告，用Parkes进行60分钟观测可达到6纳秒量级的计时精度。摘要未说明该精度是已验证结果还是预期可达精度。摘要未给出具体数值、误差或统计显著性。其余计时结果、脉冲轮廓、偏振或频谱等结果摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为，若PSR J1402+13的高自转减慢率得到确认，将对脉冲星再循环理论预言的加速过程施加严格约束。该项目将导出系统星历表，有助于理解其形成和演化历史；观测还将用于评估其计时性能以及被纳入脉冲星计时阵列的适宜性。摘要未报告实际观测结果，因此方法学可迁移性及与磁星、单脉冲、模式转换、FRB等的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Pulsar timing is a powerful tool in studying pulsar physics. Discovering more exotic pulsar systems or timing pulsars with higher precision is an essential part of pulsar astronomy. As a recently discovered millisecond pulsar, PSR J1402+13 is an interesting source for follow-up timing observations. First, its spin-down rate is the highest among known millisecond pulsars according to initial data. This spin-down rate, if confirmed, will place stringent constraints on the spin-up process predicted by pulsar recycling theories. Second, and more importantly, J1402+13 is a very promising candidate for pulsar timing arrays, with an achievable precision at the level of 6 nanoseconds for 60 minutes observation with Parkes. We thus apply for 18.7 hours to conduct dedicated timing observations of J1402+13 over the period of half a year (and more observations in the future semesters). This project will derive an ephemeris of the system, which is valuable to understand its formation and evolution history. Furthermore, the observations will allow us to evaluate the timing performance of J1402+13 and its suitability to be included in pulsar timing arrays.

</details>

First, its spin-down rate is the highest among known millisecond pulsars according to initial data. This spin-down rate, if confirmed, will place stringent constraints on the spin-up process predicted by pulsar recycling theories. Second, and more importantly, J1402+13 is a very promising candidate for pulsar timing arrays, with an achievable precision at the level of 6 nanoseconds for 60 minutes observation with Parkes. Conclusion: 作者认为，对 PSR J1402+13 的专门计时观测将导出该系统的星历表，有助于理解其形成和演化历史，并可评估其计时性能以及被纳入脉冲星计时阵列的适宜性；同时，若其较高的自转减慢率得到确认，将严格限制脉冲星再循环理论所预言的加速过程。除这些由摘要直接支持的论述外，关于其与磁星、单脉冲发射、模式转换或快速射电暴（FRB）的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Pulsar timing is a powerful tool in studying pulsar physics. Discovering more exotic pulsar systems or timing pulsars with higher precision is an essential part of pulsar astronomy. As a recently discovered millisecond pulsar, PSR J1402+13 is an interesting source for follow-up timing observations. First, its spin-down rate is the highest among known millisecond pulsars according to initial data. This spin-down rate, if confirmed, will place stringent constraints on the spin-up process predicted by pulsar recycling theories. Second, and more importantly, J1402+13 is a very promising candidate for pulsar timing arrays, with an achievable precision at the level of 6 nanoseconds for 60 minutes observation with Parkes. We thus apply for 18.7 hours to conduct dedicated timing observations of J1402+13 over the period of half a year (and more observations in the future semesters). This project will derive an ephemeris of the system, which is valuable to understand its formation and evolution history. Furthermore, the observations will allow us to evaluate the timing performance of J1402+13 and its suitability to be included in pulsar timing arrays.

</details>

Abstract: Pulsar timing is a powerful tool in studying pulsar physics. Discovering more exotic pulsar systems or timing pulsars with higher precision is an essential part of pulsar astronomy. As a recently discovered millisecond pulsar, PSR J1402+13 is an interesting source for follow-up timing observations. First, its spin-down rate is the highest among known millisecond pulsars according to initial data. This spin-down rate, if confirmed, will place stringent constraints on the spin-up process predicted by pulsar recycling theories. Second, and more importantly, J1402+13 is a very promising candidate for pulsar timing arrays, with an achievable precision at the level of 6 nanoseconds for 60 minutes observation with Parkes. We thus apply for 18.7 hours to conduct dedicated timing observations of J1402+13 over the period of half a year (and more observations in the future semesters). This project will derive an ephemeris of the system, which is valuable to understand its formation and evolution history. Furthermore, the observations will allow us to evaluate the timing performance of J1402+13 and its suitability to be included in pulsar timing arrays.

### [3114] [Parkes observations for project P985 semester 2018OCTS_01]()
*Zhang, Lei,Hobbs, George,Li, Di,Cameron, Andrew,Kaczmarek, Jane,Yuan, Jianping,Dai, Shi,Zhu, Weiwei*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请提出用Parkes望远镜的超宽带低频接收机观测新发现的脉冲星PSR J1926-06，以量化其宽频带间歇时间尺度、偏振、准周期性和模式转换；摘要指出该脉冲星具有随时间变化的多个脉冲成分、脉冲缺失、小时尺度间歇以及常常但并非总是出现的准周期流量变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一份提交给ATCA的类似申请题为“Unraveling the mysteries of the enigmatic pulsar PSR J1926-06”，本申请与其相关联。摘要称该新发现的脉冲星PSR J1926-06在辐射特性上独一无二，并“可能”是理解许多不同辐射现象的关键，因此需要对其及辐射特性进行详细刻画。

Method: 摘要说明拟使用安装在Parkes望远镜上的超宽带、低频接收机，以量化该脉冲星的宽频带间歇时间尺度、偏振、准周期性和模式转换；并申请Parkes、FAST和ATCA的观测时间以详细刻画该脉冲星及其辐射特性。具体观测频段、时间跨度、样本量与分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告，PSR J1926-06具有多个脉冲成分并随时间变化，模式转换和子脉冲漂移现象均很明显；表现出脉冲缺失，即少数单个脉冲似乎缺失；还表现出更长时间尺度（小时尺度）的间歇行为，辐射会长时间关闭；脉冲流量密度常常但并非总是似乎表现出准周期变化。摘要未给出定量数值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为该脉冲星独特的辐射特性“可能”是理解许多不同辐射现象的关键，因此提出在Parkes、FAST和ATCA上获取观测时间，以详细刻画该脉冲星及其辐射特性。摘要未给出已完成观测的结论性物理结果；其对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱、瞬变射电辐射或磁星—FRB联系的适用性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: This proposal is linked with a similar proposal submitted to ATCA entitled: "Unraveling the mysteries of the enigmatic pulsar PSR J1926-06". We propose to use the ultra-wide-bandwidth, low frequency receiver installed at the Parkes telescope in order to quantify the broad-band intermittency time scale, polarization, quasi-periodicities, and mode changing of a newly discovered pulsar, PSR J1926-06. The pulsar is unique in its emission properties. It has multiple pulse components, that change with time (both mode-changing and sub-pulse drifting phenomena are evident). The pulsar exhibits nulls in which a few individual pulses seem to be missing. It also exhibits longer-scale (hour-scale) intermittency behaviour in which the emission switches off for long periods of time. The pulse flux densities often, but not always, seem to exhibit quasi-periodic variations. Clearly this pulsar may hold the key to many different emission phenomena and we request time on Parkes, FAST and ATCA to parameterise the pulsar and its emission properties in detail.

</details>


### [3115] [Parkes observations for project P509 semester 2007APRS_01]()
*Camilo, Fernando,Gaensler, Bryan,Manchester, Dick,Ransom, Scott,Lorimer, Duncan Ross*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 利用 16 个月计时数据，作者确认年轻脉冲星 PSR J1833-1034 与 SNR G21.5-0.9 中心的中央峰化 X 射线源在亚角秒精度上重合，并测得制动指数 n = 2.18；作者希望继续计时以测量“第二制动指数”并维持其计时解，服务于 GLAST 伽马射线探测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1833-1034 是最近在 SNR G21.5-0.9 中心附近发现的非常年轻脉冲星；需要确认其与 SNR 的关联，并进一步约束其自转减慢律。“第二制动指数”迄今只对 2 颗脉冲星做过，同时该脉冲星是预计 2007 年发射的 GLAST 伽马射线探测的主要候选体之一，必须维持其计时解。

Method: 对该年轻脉冲星 PSR J1833-1034 进行计时，已获得 16 个月的计时数据；将计时位置与 Chandra 数据中 G21.5-0.9 中心附近的中央峰化 X 射线源进行位置比对；测量制动指数 n；并申请在本学期内用 24 hr 继续计时。摘要未说明具体观测频率、频段、仪器及分析细节。

Result: 以亚角秒精度确认 PSR J1833-1034 与 Chandra 数据中 G21.5-0.9 中心附近的中央峰化 X 射线源重合，从而确认脉冲星-SNR 关联；测得制动指数 n = 2.18，这是已知 1700 多颗脉冲星中第 6 次相位相干测量。作者正争取测量“第二制动指数”，此前仅对 2 颗脉冲星完成过。

Conclusion: 作者认为该脉冲星与 SNR G21.5-0.9 的关联已毫无疑问；测得的制动指数可用于约束该脉冲星的自转减慢律，并有望进一步测量“第二制动指数”。继续计时是为维持其计时解，以便其作为 GLAST 伽马射线探测候选体。根据摘要无法判断其与单脉冲、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱、磁星或 FRB 的联系。

Abstract: We have been timing the very young pulsar PSR J1833-1034, recently discovered near the center of the supernova remnant (SNR) G21.5-0.9 (Camilo et al. 2006). With 16 months of timing data in hand we have confirmed that the pulsar is coincident, to sub-arcsec precision, with the centrally-peaked X-ray source visible in Chandra data near the center of G21.5-0.9 and have therefore confirmed this pulsar-SNR association beyond any doubt. More unexpectedly, we have been able to measure this pulsar's braking index, n = 2.18, only the 6th such phase-coherent measurement done in over 1700 pulsars known. We now have a chance to measure the "second braking index" and place further constraints on the spin-down law obeyed by this pulsar. This has been done to date for only 2 pulsars. Finally, we wish to continue timing this pulsar because it will be one of the prime candidates for gamma-ray detection with the GLAST satellite to be launched in 2007, and in order to do so we must maintain its timing solution. For these reasons we request 24 hr for timing PSR J1833-1034 during the present semester.

</details>


### [3116] [Parkes observations for project P1411 semester 2026APRS_04]()
*Ahmad, Adeel,Filipovic, Miroslav,Dai, Shi,Bai, Juntao,Lazarevic, Sanja,Kaushik, Aditi S. S.*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 通过 ASKAP EMU 连续谱图像的图像域搜寻，采用三种针对性策略发现了七颗新脉冲星，包括三颗高散射脉冲星（DM &gt; 800 pc/cm^3）、两颗处于潜在宽双星系统的毫秒脉冲星和两颗正常脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统盲脉冲星巡天在高时间分辨率数据中搜寻周期信号，受到高 DM 下星际散射、致密双星轨道调制、闪烁效应和密集计算需求的限制；摘要指出 ASKAP EMU 超深射电连续谱图可提供绕过这些限制的互补性图像域脉冲星搜寻途径。

Method: 基于 ASKAP EMU 巡天的超深射电连续谱图进行图像域脉冲星搜寻，采用三种针对性策略：（1）识别嵌入 SNR 和 PWNe 的致密源，（2）通过方差成像探测高度变化的源，（3）选取高度圆偏振的致密源。摘要还提议用 Murriyang 的 UWL 接收机开展后续计时观测，以获得相位连接计时解。摘要未说明观测频率、时间跨度、样本规模及具体分析细节。

Result: 通过三种策略共发现七颗新脉冲星。样本包括三颗高散射脉冲星 PSR J1638-4713、PSR J1643-4511 和 PSR J1631-4722，DM &gt; 800 pc/cm^3，其中两颗与 PWNe 成协。两颗毫秒脉冲星 PSR J0927-7641 和 PSR J1838-5949 处于轨道周期为数十天的潜在宽双星系统中，另有两颗正常脉冲星 PSR J1153-7106 和 PSR 2223-0654。

Conclusion: 作者认为，所提议的 Murriyang UWL 后续计时观测可获得相位连接的计时解、精确位置和自旋参数，并确定双星系统的轨道特征，从而有助于研究脉冲星形成机制、双星演化路径以及 PWN-SNR 相互作用，并验证基于图像的发现技术是传统盲巡天探测难以发现脉冲星的有力补充。根据摘要无法判断这些目标与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射之间的具体物理联系。

Abstract: Conventional blind pulsar surveys that search for periodic signals in high-time-resolution data are increasingly limited by interstellar scattering at high dispersion measure (DM), orbital modulation in compact binaries, scintillation effects, and intensive computational demands. The Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) Evolutionary Map of the Universe (EMU) survey provides ultra-deep radio continuum maps enabling complementary image-domain pulsar searches that bypass these limitations. We have discovered seven new pulsars through three targeted strategies: (1) identifying compact sources embedded in supernova remnants (SNRs) and pulsar wind nebulae (PWNe), (2) detecting highly variable sources via variance imaging, and (3) selecting highly circularly polarised compact sources. Our sample includes three highly scattered pulsars (PSR J1638-4713 , PSR J1643-4511, and PSR J1631-4722 with DM &gt; 800 pc/cm^3) including two pulsars associated with PWNe. Two millisecond pulsars (PSR J0927-7641 and PSR J1838-5949) are in potential wide binary systems with orbital periods of several tens of days, and two additional normal pulsars (PSR J1153-7106 and PSR 2223-0654). We propose follow-up timing observations of these pulsars with Murriyang's Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver to obtain phase-connected timing solutions, measure precise positions and spin parameters, and determine orbital characteristics for the binary systems,. These observations will enable studies of pulsar formation mechanisms, binary evolution pathways, PWN-SNR interactions, and validate image-based discovery techniques as powerful complements to traditional blind surveys for detecting elusive pulsars.

</details>

Our sample includes three highly scattered pulsars (PSR J1638-4713 , PSR J1643-4511, and PSR J1631-4722 with DM &gt; 800 pc/cm^3) including two pulsars associated with PWNe. We propose follow-up timing observations of these pulsars with Murriyang's Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver to obtain phase-connected timing solutions, measure precise positions and spin parameters, and determine orbital characteristics for the binary systems,. These observations will enable studies of pulsar formation mechanisms, binary evolution pathways, PWN-SNR interactions, and validate image-based discovery techniques as powerful complements to traditional blind surveys for detecting elusive pulsars.

### [3118] [Parkes observations for project P1411 semester 2026APRS_26]()
*Ahmad, Adeel,Filipovic, Miroslav,Dai, Shi,Bai, Juntao,Lazarevic, Sanja,Kaushik, Aditi S. S.*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 利用 ASKAP EMU 巡天的超深射电连续谱图，通过三种图像域策略发现了七颗新脉冲星，包括三颗高 DM 高度散射脉冲星、两颗可能的宽双星毫秒脉冲星和两颗普通脉冲星，并提议用 Murriyang UWL 接收机开展后续计时观测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统盲脉冲星巡天在高时间分辨率数据中搜索周期信号，受高 DM 星际散射、致密双星轨道调制、闪烁效应和巨大计算量限制。ASKAP EMU 巡天的超深连续谱图为图像域脉冲星搜索提供互补途径，可绕开上述限制。

Method: 基于 ASKAP EMU 巡天的超深射电连续谱图开展图像域脉冲星搜索，采用三种针对性策略：（1）识别嵌入 SNR 和 PWNe 的致密源；（2）用方差成像探测高度变化源；（3）选择高度圆偏振致密源。并提议用 Murriyang 的 UWL 接收机对样本开展后续计时观测，以获得相位连接计时解、精确位置、自转参数及双星轨道特征。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度与样本量。

Result: 通过三种策略共发现七颗新脉冲星。样本含三颗高度散射脉冲星：PSR J1638-4713、PSR J1643-4511 和 PSR J1631-4722，DM &gt; 800 pc/cm^3，其中两颗与 PWNe 成协。两颗毫秒脉冲星 PSR J0927-7641 与 PSR J1838-5949 位于可能的宽双星系统，轨道周期为数十天。另有两颗普通脉冲星 PSR J1153-7106 和 PSR 2223-0654。摘要未给出显著性、测量不确定度或计时结果数值。

Conclusion: 作者认为，所提议的 Murriyang UWL 后续计时观测将有助于研究脉冲星形成机制、双星演化路径以及 PWN-SNR 相互作用，并验证基于图像的发现技术可作为传统盲巡天的有力补充，用于探测难以捉摸的脉冲星。摘要未讨论这些脉冲星与磁星、单脉冲发射、模式转换、偏振或 FRB 的具体联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Conventional blind pulsar surveys that search for periodic signals in high-time-resolution data are increasingly limited by interstellar scattering at high dispersion measure (DM), orbital modulation in compact binaries, scintillation effects, and intensive computational demands. The Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) Evolutionary Map of the Universe (EMU) survey provides ultra-deep radio continuum maps enabling complementary image-domain pulsar searches that bypass these limitations. We have discovered seven new pulsars through three targeted strategies: (1) identifying compact sources embedded in supernova remnants (SNRs) and pulsar wind nebulae (PWNe), (2) detecting highly variable sources via variance imaging, and (3) selecting highly circularly polarised compact sources. Our sample includes three highly scattered pulsars (PSR J1638-4713 , PSR J1643-4511, and PSR J1631-4722 with DM &gt; 800 pc/cm^3) including two pulsars associated with PWNe. Two millisecond pulsars (PSR J0927-7641 and PSR J1838-5949) are in potential wide binary systems with orbital periods of several tens of days, and two additional normal pulsars (PSR J1153-7106 and PSR 2223-0654). Conclusion: 作者提出用Murriyang UWL接收机对这些脉冲星进行后续计时观测，以获得相位连接的计时解、精确位置与自转参数，并确定双星系统轨道特征，从而支持脉冲星形成机制、双星演化路径、PWN-SNR相互作用研究，并验证基于图像的发现技术可作为传统盲巡天探测难以捉摸脉冲星的有力补充。该验证尚属提议观测的目标，根据摘要无法判断其实际效果。

The Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) Evolutionary Map of the Universe (EMU) survey provides ultra-deep radio continuum maps enabling complementary image-domain pulsar searches that bypass these limitations. We have discovered seven new pulsars through three targeted strategies: (1) identifying compact sources embedded in supernova remnants (SNRs) and pulsar wind nebulae (PWNe), (2) detecting highly variable sources via variance imaging, and (3) selecting highly circularly polarised compact sources. Our sample includes three highly scattered pulsars (PSR J1638-4713 , PSR J1643-4511, and PSR J1631-4722 with DM &gt; 800 pc/cm^3) including two pulsars associated with PWNe.
