Result: 通过三种针对性策略共发现七颗新脉冲星。样本包括三颗高度散射脉冲星（PSR J1638-4713、PSR J1643-4511和PSR J1631-4722，DM &gt; 800 pc/cm^3），其中两颗与PWNe相关。两颗毫秒脉冲星（PSR J0927-7641和PSR J1838-5949）位于潜在宽双星系统中，轨道周期为数十天。另有两颗普通脉冲星（PSR J1153-7106和PSR 2223-0654）。摘要未给出计时解、位置与自转参数的具体数值及显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，所提议的后续计时观测将有助于研究脉冲星形成机制、双星演化路径以及PWN-SNR相互作用，并验证基于图像的发现技术可作为传统盲巡天的有力补充，用于探测难以捉摸的脉冲星。摘要指出ASKAP EMU图像域搜寻可绕过传统盲巡天在高DM散射、致密双星轨道调制、闪烁效应和计算需求方面的限制。至于这些脉冲星与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射等的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Conventional blind pulsar surveys that search for periodic signals in high-time-resolution data are increasingly limited by interstellar scattering at high dispersion measure (DM), orbital modulation in compact binaries, scintillation effects, and intensive computational demands. The Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) Evolutionary Map of the Universe (EMU) survey provides ultra-deep radio continuum maps enabling complementary image-domain pulsar searches that bypass these limitations. We have discovered seven new pulsars through three targeted strategies: (1) identifying compact sources embedded in supernova remnants (SNRs) and pulsar wind nebulae (PWNe), (2) detecting highly variable sources via variance imaging, and (3) selecting highly circularly polarised compact sources. Our sample includes three highly scattered pulsars (PSR J1638-4713 , PSR J1643-4511, and PSR J1631-4722 with DM &gt; 800 pc/cm^3) including two pulsars associated with PWNe. Two millisecond pulsars (PSR J0927-7641 and PSR J1838-5949) are in potential wide binary systems with orbital periods of several tens of days, and two additional normal pulsars (PSR J1153-7106 and PSR 2223-0654). We propose follow-up timing observations of these pulsars with Murriyang's Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver to obtain phase-connected timing solutions, measure precise positions and spin parameters, and determine orbital characteristics for the binary systems,. These observations will enable studies of pulsar formation mechanisms, binary evolution pathways, PWN-SNR interactions, and validate image-based discovery techniques as powerful complements to traditional blind surveys for detecting elusive pulsars.

</details>

We have discovered seven new pulsars through three targeted strategies: (1) identifying compact sources embedded in supernova remnants (SNRs) and pulsar wind nebulae (PWNe), (2) detecting highly variable sources via variance imaging, and (3) selecting highly circularly polarised compact sources. Our sample includes three highly scattered pulsars (PSR J1638-4713 , PSR J1643-4511, and PSR J1631-4722 with DM &gt; 800 pc/cm^3) including two pulsars associated with PWNe. Two millisecond pulsars (PSR J0927-7641 and PSR J1838-5949) are in potential wide binary systems with orbital periods of several tens of days, and two additional normal pulsars (PSR J1153-7106 and PSR 2223-0654). We propose follow-up timing observations of these pulsars with Murriyang's Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver to obtain phase-connected timing solutions, measure precise positions and spin parameters, and determine orbital characteristics for the binary systems,. These observations will enable studies of pulsar formation mechanisms, binary evolution pathways, PWN-SNR interactions, and validate image-based discovery techniques as powerful complements to traditional blind surveys for detecting elusive pulsars.

</details>

We have discovered seven new pulsars through three targeted strategies: (1) identifying compact sources embedded in supernova remnants (SNRs) and pulsar wind nebulae (PWNe), (2) detecting highly variable sources via variance imaging, and (3) selecting highly circularly polarised compact sources. Method: 利用 ASKAP EMU 巡天的超深射电连续谱图开展图像域脉冲星搜索，采用三种针对性策略：识别嵌入 SNR 和 PWNe 的致密源、通过方差成像探测高度变化的源、选择高度圆偏振的致密源。作者提议用 Murriyang 的超宽带低频（UWL）接收机开展后续计时观测，以获得相位连接的计时解、测量精确位置和自旋参数，并确定双星系统的轨道特征。

Result: 通过三种策略共发现七颗新脉冲星。样本包括三颗高度散射脉冲星（PSR J1638-4713、PSR J1643-4511、PSR J1631-4722，DM &gt; 800 pc/cm^3），其中两颗与 PWNe 相关；两颗毫秒脉冲星（PSR J0927-7641、PSR J1838-5949）位于潜在宽双星系统中，轨道周期为数十天；另有两颗正常脉冲星（PSR J1153-7106、PSR 2223-0654）。

Conclusion: 作者认为，拟议的 Murriyang UWL 后续计时观测将有助于研究脉冲星形成机制、双星演化路径、PWN-SNR 相互作用，并验证基于图像的发现技术是传统盲巡天探测难以捉摸脉冲星的有力补充。根据摘要无法判断这些脉冲星与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射的具体物理联系。

Abstract: Conventional blind pulsar surveys that search for periodic signals in high-time-resolution data are increasingly limited by interstellar scattering at high dispersion measure (DM), orbital modulation in compact binaries, scintillation effects, and intensive computational demands. The Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) Evolutionary Map of the Universe (EMU) survey provides ultra-deep radio continuum maps enabling complementary image-domain pulsar searches that bypass these limitations. We have discovered seven new pulsars through three targeted strategies: (1) identifying compact sources embedded in supernova remnants (SNRs) and pulsar wind nebulae (PWNe), (2) detecting highly variable sources via variance imaging, and (3) selecting highly circularly polarised compact sources. Our sample includes three highly scattered pulsars (PSR J1638-4713 , PSR J1643-4511, and PSR J1631-4722 with DM &gt; 800 pc/cm^3) including two pulsars associated with PWNe. Two millisecond pulsars (PSR J0927-7641 and PSR J1838-5949) are in potential wide binary systems with orbital periods of several tens of days, and two additional normal pulsars (PSR J1153-7106 and PSR 2223-0654). We propose follow-up timing observations of these pulsars with Murriyang's Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver to obtain phase-connected timing solutions, measure precise positions and spin parameters, and determine orbital characteristics for the binary systems,. These observations will enable studies of pulsar formation mechanisms, binary evolution pathways, PWN-SNR interactions, and validate image-based discovery techniques as powerful complements to traditional blind surveys for detecting elusive pulsars.

</details>

### [3159] [Parkes observations for project P1149 semester 2022APRS_05]()
*Bhat, Ramesh,Dai, Shi,McSweeney, Samuel James,Swainston, Nicholas,Xue, Mengyao*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划用 Parkes 对 MWA SMART 巡天新发现的一颗脉冲星开展后续观测，以检验其是否属于罕见的低光度、陡谱脉冲星类别，并通过计时与偏振分析确定其自转、天体测量参数及可能的辐射几何结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MWA 正在进行的 SMART 脉冲星巡天新发现了一颗脉冲星，初步分析表明它可能属于罕见的低光度、陡谱脉冲星类别。这类脉冲星约占目前已知长周期脉冲星群体的 ~2%，理解其辐射与光谱性质对于全面认识银河系脉冲星群体及预测未来低频巡天可探测群体十分关键。

Method: 提议开展 Parkes 后续观测，对这颗脉冲星进行流量密度测量和光谱分析，并将 Parkes 数据与 MWA 数据以及计划中的 GMRT 观测相结合；同时开展定期计时观测以确定自转和天体测量参数，并可能进行高时间分辨率偏振分析以确定辐射几何结构。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度、样本量或统计分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告的是拟议观测，而非已完成的观测结果。初步分析表明，这颗新发现的脉冲星可能属于罕见的低光度、陡谱脉冲星类别；摘要指出该类脉冲星约占目前已知长周期脉冲星群体的 ~2%。所提议的观测旨在通过流量密度测量和光谱分析验证该推测，并确定其自转和天体测量参数，可能确定其辐射几何结构。摘要未给出具体流量密度、谱指数、计时精度或其他数值结果。

Conclusion: 作者明确提出，该类低光度、陡谱脉冲星的辐射与光谱性质研究有助于构建更全面的银河系脉冲星群体图景，并可为预测未来低频巡天（包括计划中的 SKA-Low）可探测的脉冲星群体提供依据。该脉冲星是否确属此类，仍需所提议的观测来验证；根据摘要无法判断其实际物理性质。与 FRB、磁星或单脉冲发射的直接联系摘要未说明。

Abstract: We propose Parkes follow-up observations of a new pulsar discovered from the ongoing SMART pulsar survey at the MWA. Initial analysis suggests that the pulsar likely belongs to the rare class of low-luminosity, steep-spectrum pulsars. The proposed observations will help verify this conjecture, through flux density measurements and spectral analysis of the pulsar, which will be possible by combining Parkes data along with those from MWA and the planned observations with the GMRT. This class of pulsars makes up ~2% of the currently-known population of long-period pulsars, and understanding their emission and spectral properties is vital to develop a more comprehensive picture of the Galactic population of pulsars, and to make meaningful forecast of the detectable population of pulsars in future low-frequency surveys, including those planned with SKA-Low. The proposed observations will also allow us to determine the pulsar's spin and astrometric parameters via regular timing observations, and possibly the pulsar's emission geometry via high-time resolution polarimetric analysis.

</details>

Abstract: We propose Parkes follow-up observations of a new pulsar discovered from the ongoing SMART pulsar survey at the MWA. Initial analysis suggests that the pulsar likely belongs to the rare class of low-luminosity, steep-spectrum pulsars. Conclusion: 作者提出，继续 Parkes 观测并借助希望从 GMRT 成像获得的干涉测量位置，可在更快的时间框架内获得计时解并确定脉冲星的自转和天体测量参数，同时给出更可靠的流量密度估计以确定其频谱和光度性质；理解这类低光度、陡谱脉冲星的辐射和频谱性质，有助于建立更全面的银河系脉冲星种群图景，并预测未来低频巡天（包括计划中的 SKA-Low）可探测的脉冲星种群。根据摘要无法判断该脉冲星与磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）之间存在何种物理联系。

Abstract: We propose continued Parkes follow-up observations of a new pulsar discovered from the ongoing SMART pulsar survey with the MWA. Initial analysis from Parkes and GMRT follow-ups suggests that the pulsar likely belongs to the rare class of low-luminosity, steep-spectrum pulsars. This class of pulsars make up ~2% of the currently-known population of long-period pulsars, and as such understanding their emission and spectral properties is vital for developing a more comprehensive picture of the Galactic population of pulsars, and also to make meaningful forecast for the detectable population of pulsars in future low-frequency surveys, including those planned with SKA-Low. The proposed observations, along with an interferometric position that we hope to obtain from GMRT imaging will allow us to obtain a timing solution on a faster time frame, thereby allowing us to determine the pulsar's spin and astrometric parameters. The observations will also yield more reliable estimates of pulsar flux density measurements, allowing us to determine the pulsar's spectral and luminosity properties.

*Bhat, Ramesh,Dai, Shi,McSweeney, Samuel James,Swainston, Nicholas,Xue, Mengyao*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟用 Parkes 对 MWA SMART 巡天新发现的一颗脉冲星开展后续观测，以验证其可能属于罕见的低光度、陡谱脉冲星类，并通过多台站数据测量流量密度与谱，同时通过计时确定自转与天体测量参数，可能通过高时间分辨率偏振分析确定辐射几何。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MWA 的 SMART 脉冲星巡天发现了一颗新脉冲星，初步分析提示其可能属于罕见的低光度、陡谱脉冲星类；这类脉冲星约占目前已知长周期脉冲星种群的 ~2%，理解其辐射和谱性质对构建银河系脉冲星种群的全面图景、并预测未来低频巡天（包括计划中的 SKA-Low）可探测的脉冲星种群十分重要。

Method: 提议开展 Parkes 后续观测，进行流量密度测量和谱分析，并结合 MWA 数据以及计划中的 GMRT 观测；还将进行定期计时观测以确定脉冲星的自转和天体测量参数，并可能开展高时间分辨率偏振分析。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、观测时间跨度、样本量和统计方法。

Result: 摘要报告的是拟议观测及其预期能力，而非已获得的观测结果：初步分析表明该脉冲星可能属于罕见的低光度、陡谱脉冲星类；所提议的观测将有助于通过流量密度测量和谱分析验证这一猜想，这类脉冲星约占已知长周期脉冲星种群的 ~2%。摘要未说明具体流量密度、谱指数、计时精度或偏振测量结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，结合 Parkes、MWA 和计划中的 GMRT 观测可检验该脉冲星属于低光度、陡谱类的猜想，并有助于更全面地认识银河系脉冲星种群以及预测未来低频巡天（包括 SKA-Low）的可探测种群；所提议观测还可确定其自转和天体测量参数，并可能确定其辐射几何。对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、模式转换、快速射电暴（FRB）或磁星—FRB 联系的直接适用性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose Parkes follow-up observations of a new pulsar discovered from the ongoing SMART pulsar survey at the MWA. Initial analysis suggests that the pulsar likely belongs to the rare class of low-luminosity, steep-spectrum pulsars. The proposed observations will help verify this conjecture, through flux density measurements and spectral analysis of the pulsar, which will be possible by combining Parkes data along with those from MWA and the planned observations with the GMRT. This class of pulsars makes up ~2% of the currently-known population of long-period pulsars, and understanding their emission and spectral properties is vital to develop a more comprehensive picture of the Galactic population of pulsars, and to make meaningful forecast of the detectable population of pulsars in future low-frequency surveys, including those planned with SKA-Low. The proposed observations will also allow us to determine the pulsar's spin and astrometric parameters via regular timing observations, and possibly the pulsar's emission geometry via high-time resolution polarimetric analysis.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: We propose continued Parkes follow-up observations of a new pulsar discovered from the ongoing SMART pulsar survey with the MWA. Initial analysis from Parkes and GMRT follow-ups suggests that the pulsar likely belongs to the rare class of low-luminosity, steep-spectrum pulsars. This class of pulsars make up ~2% of the currently-known population of long-period pulsars, and as such understanding their emission and spectral properties is vital for developing a more comprehensive picture of the Galactic population of pulsars, and also to make meaningful forecast for the detectable population of pulsars in future low-frequency surveys, including those planned with SKA-Low. The proposed observations, along with an interferometric position that we hope to obtain from GMRT imaging will allow us to obtain a timing solution on a faster time frame, thereby allowing us to determine the pulsar's spin and astrometric parameters. Motivation: 由 MWA 的 SMART 巡天新发现的脉冲星需要 Parkes 后随观测；初步分析提示它可能属于稀有的低光度、陡谱脉冲星类，该类约占已知长周期脉冲星的 ~2%。理解其辐射与谱性质，对构建更全面的银河系脉冲星族群图景、并为未来低频巡天（包括计划中的 SKA-Low）可探测脉冲星族群做出有意义预测十分关键。

Method: 摘要说明为继续开展 Parkes 后随观测的提案，目标是由正在进行的 SMART 脉冲星巡天与 MWA 新发现的一颗脉冲星；已有 Parkes 和 GMRT 后随观测的初步分析，并希望从 GMRT 成像获得干涉测量位置。拟通过观测获得计时解以确定自转与天体测量参数，并给出更可靠的通量密度测量以确定谱与光度性质。观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本规模及具体分析流程：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要指出，来自 Parkes 和 GMRT 后随观测的初步分析表明，该脉冲星可能属于稀有的低光度、陡谱脉冲星类；该类约占目前已知长周期脉冲星族群的 ~2%。摘要提出，所提议的观测连同希望从 GMRT 成像获得的干涉测量位置，将允许在更快的时间尺度上获得计时解，从而确定该脉冲星的自转与天体测量参数；观测还将给出更可靠的脉冲星通量密度测量估计，用以确定其谱与光度性质。具体数值、显著性及已测得参数：摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为，理解这类低光度、陡谱脉冲星的辐射与谱性质，对构建更全面的银河系脉冲星族群图景，以及对未来低频巡天（包括计划中的 SKA-Low）可探测脉冲星族群做出有意义预测至关重要；拟议观测与 GMRT 干涉测量位置将有助于更快获得计时解并确定自转与天体测量参数，同时改进通量密度、谱与光度性质估计。该脉冲星与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、单脉冲、模式转换或偏振的联系：根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose continued Parkes follow-up observations of a new pulsar discovered from the ongoing SMART pulsar survey with the MWA. Initial analysis from Parkes and GMRT follow-ups suggests that the pulsar likely belongs to the rare class of low-luminosity, steep-spectrum pulsars. This class of pulsars make up ~2% of the currently-known population of long-period pulsars, and as such understanding their emission and spectral properties is vital for developing a more comprehensive picture of the Galactic population of pulsars, and also to make meaningful forecast for the detectable population of pulsars in future low-frequency surveys, including those planned with SKA-Low. The proposed observations, along with an interferometric position that we hope to obtain from GMRT imaging will allow us to obtain a timing solution on a faster time frame, thereby allowing us to determine the pulsar's spin and astrometric parameters. The observations will also yield more reliable estimates of pulsar flux density measurements, allowing us to determine the pulsar's spectral and luminosity properties.

</details>

### [3171] [Parkes observations for project P1334 semester 2024OCTS_07]()
*Lower, Marcus,Johnston, Simon,Dai, Shi*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟利用 Murriyang 的 Ultra-Wideband Low 接收机对银河系中心首颗毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1744-2946（自旋周期 8.4 ms）进行每月常规观测，以测量其自转减慢率并评估其长期稳定性，从而回答该脉冲星向射电丝状结构注入能量的效率、能否纳入脉冲星计时阵列以及能否用于轴子暗物质搜寻等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 银河系中心射电图像显示出大量垂直于银道面的丝状结构，其射电辐射的驱动机制长期成谜；在一处丝状结构中偶然发现脉冲星后，这颗自旋周期 8.4 ms 的 PSR J1744-2946 成为银河系中心区域发现的第一颗毫秒脉冲星。但现有计时基线有限，其能量注入效率、能否纳入脉冲星计时阵列实验以及能否用于轴子暗物质搜寻均尚未解答。

Method: 摘要说明将使用 Murriyang 上的 Ultra-Wideband Low 接收机系统，对 PSR J1744-2946 开展规律的每月观测，以获得自转减慢率测量和长期稳定性信息。除脉冲星名称、自旋周期 8.4 ms 与该观测安排外，具体观测频段、时间跨度、数据量与分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告 PSR J1744-2946 的自旋周期为 8.4 ms，是银河系中心区域发现的第一颗毫秒脉冲星，且其位于一条射电丝状结构之中。摘要指出有限计时基线仍留下未解问题：脉冲星向射电丝状结构注入能量的效率、能否纳入脉冲星计时阵列实验、能否作为寻找轴子暗物质的关键组成部分。所提议的每月观测预计将提供自转减慢率测量和长期稳定性的认识。具体测量结果、数值与显著性摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者提出，通过 Murriyang 上 Ultra-Wideband Low 接收机系统对 PSR J1744-2946 进行每月常规观测，可获得自转减慢率测量并了解其长期稳定性，从而为上述关于能量注入效率、脉冲星计时阵列纳入可能性及轴子暗物质搜寻应用的问题提供答案。该脉冲星与射电丝状结构、计时阵列及轴子暗物质搜寻的具体物理关联与可转移性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The Galactic Centre is the most complex and dynamic region of our Galaxy. Radio images have revealed a plethora of filamentary structures that trace out magnetic fields running perpendicular to the Galactic plane. Exactly what powers the radio emission of these filaments had remained a mystery, until the serendipitous discovery of a pulsar embedded in one. With a spin-period of 8.4 ms, PSR J1744-2946 is the first ever millisecond pulsar to be discovered in the central region of our Galaxy. While an exciting discovery in its own right, the limited timing baseline leaves open several unanswered questions: How efficiently is the pulsar injecting energy into the radio filament? Could the pulsar be included in pulsar timing array experiments? And can it be used as a key component in the search for axion dark matter? In this proposal we will use the Ultra-Wideband Low receiver system on Murriyang to conduct regular, monthly observations of PSR J1744-2946. This will provide us with a measurement of the pulsar spin-down rate and a sense of its long-term stability, thereby providing answers to the questions posed above.

</details>

Motivation: 银河系中心射电图像显示出大量垂直于银道面的丝状结构，其射电辐射的能量来源长期不明；在一颗丝状结构中偶然发现的脉冲星提供了线索。PSR J1744-2946 是银河系中心区域发现的第一颗毫秒脉冲星，但其有限的计时基线使能量注入效率、能否纳入脉冲星计时阵列实验以及能否用于轴子暗物质搜寻等问题仍无答案。

Method: 摘要说明将使用 Murriyang 上的 Ultra-Wideband Low 接收机系统，对 PSR J1744-2946 开展定期、每月的观测。摘要未说明观测频段、时间跨度、具体分析流程或其他数据分析细节。

Result: 摘要报告称，PSR J1744-2946 的自转周期为 8.4 ms，是在银河系中心区域发现的第一颗毫秒脉冲星，且它嵌入在一条射电丝状结构中。摘要指出，拟议的每月观测将提供该脉冲星自转减慢率的测量，并给出对其长期稳定性的了解；但摘要未说明这些观测的结果或任何已测得数值。

Conclusion: 作者提出，对 PSR J1744-2946 开展定期每月观测以测量自转减慢率并了解其长期稳定性，将能回答该脉冲星向射电丝状结构注入能量的效率、它能否被纳入脉冲星计时阵列实验，以及它能否作为搜寻轴子暗物质的关键组成部分等问题。根据摘要无法判断这些问题的具体物理结论。

Abstract: The Galactic Centre is the most complex and dynamic region of our Galaxy. Radio images have revealed a plethora of filamentary structures that trace out magnetic fields running perpendicular to the Galactic plane. Exactly what powers the radio emission of these filaments had remained a mystery, until the serendipitous discovery of a pulsar embedded in one. With a spin-period of 8.4 ms, PSR J1744-2946 is the first ever millisecond pulsar to be discovered in the central region of our Galaxy. While an exciting discovery in its own right, the limited timing baseline leaves open several unanswered questions: How efficiently is the pulsar injecting energy into the radio filament? Could the pulsar be included in pulsar timing array experiments? And can it be used as a key component in the search for axion dark matter? In this proposal we will use the Ultra-Wideband Low receiver system on Murriyang to conduct regular, monthly observations of PSR J1744-2946. This will provide us with a measurement of the pulsar spin-down rate and a sense of its long-term stability, thereby providing answers to the questions posed above.

</details>

### [3178] [Parkes observations for project P860 semester 2019APRS_08]()
*Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, S.,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Wongphechauxsorn, Jompoj*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 在 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面部分的首次数据处理中发现了 106 颗此前未知的脉冲星；该申请请求对其进行首次后随计时观测，以刻画这些新脉冲星并开展银道面脉冲星族群研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HTRU 巡天低银纬银道面部分的处理已发现新脉冲星，但新脉冲星通常需要确认和计时观测才能产生科学成果，因此需要申请观测时间对其进行首次后随跟踪。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测仪器、频率或波段、时间跨度、样本筛选和数据分析方法；摘要仅说明已完成对整个巡天的第一遍处理，使用了周期性搜索算法以及部分相干的分段加速搜索流程。

Result: 摘要报告已发现 106 颗此前未知的脉冲星，并指出观测列表上的所有脉冲星均为首次后随跟踪，预计将产生全新的结果；此外，该计时项目将支持对银道面脉冲星族群的大规模考察，探索脉冲星参数空间的真实边界。

Conclusion: 摘要指出，对新脉冲星进行确认和一年初步计时是充分刻画它们的最低要求，可用于推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等参数，并探测可能由辐射不稳定性引起的意外行为；该后随计时项目对于跟进 HTRU 银道面巡天发现的有趣脉冲星系统是必要的。根据摘要无法判断这些结果与磁星、快速射电暴或其他具体物理联系的关联。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the initial follow-up of pulsar discoveries from the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed a first pass processing of the entire survey with our periodicity search algorithm as well as the partially-coherent segmented acceleration search pipeline, and have discovered 106 previously unknown pulsars. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic ?eld strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This follow-up timing project is necessary for following up on any interesting pulsar systems discovered from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. Since all of the pulsars on the observing list here are being followed-up for the first time, they will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will enable a large-scale examination of the Galactic plane pulsar population, exploring the true boundaries of pulsar parameter space.

</details>

Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic ?eld strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This follow-up timing project is necessary for following up on any interesting pulsar systems discovered from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. Since all of the pulsars on the observing list here are being followed-up for the first time, they will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will enable a large-scale examination of the Galactic plane pulsar population, exploring the true boundaries of pulsar parameter space.

Conclusion: 作者认为，该后续计时项目对于跟进 HTRU 银道面巡天中发现的任何有趣脉冲星系统是必要的，且由于观测列表上的脉冲星均为首次跟进观测，将产生全新的、令人兴奋的结果；该计时项目还将使得能够对银道面脉冲星种群进行大规模考察，探索脉冲星参数空间的真实边界。根据摘要无法判断其与单脉冲发射、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱、瞬变射电发射或磁星—快速射电暴（FRB）联系的具体关系。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the initial follow-up of pulsar discoveries from the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed a first pass processing of the entire survey with our periodicity search algorithm as well as the partially-coherent segmented acceleration search pipeline, and have discovered 106 previously unknown pulsars. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic ?eld strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This follow-up timing project is necessary for following up on any interesting pulsar systems discovered from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. Since all of the pulsars on the observing list here are being followed-up for the first time, they will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will enable a large-scale examination of the Galactic plane pulsar population, exploring the true boundaries of pulsar parameter space.

</details>

*Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, S.,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Wongphechauxsorn, Jompoj*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请请求对HTRU银道面巡天（P630）低银纬区域新发现的106颗脉冲星开展为期至少一年的后续计时观测，以获得新脉冲星的参数并开展银道面脉冲星种群的大规模考察。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需要对HTRU巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域发现的新脉冲星进行确认和后续计时。摘要指出，只有确认并开展后续计时观测后，通常才能从新脉冲星获得有意义的科学结果；新发现脉冲星需要初步计时才能被充分刻画。

Method: 摘要说明这是为P860项目申请观测时间，用于对HTRU巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域新发现脉冲星进行初步后续观测。已完成整个巡天的第一轮处理，使用周期性搜索算法以及部分相干分段加速度搜索流程。计划开展为期一年的初步计时。摘要未说明具体望远镜、观测频段、观测频次、数据量、统计方法或脉冲星样本细节。

Result: 摘要报告，利用周期性搜索算法及部分相干分段加速度搜索流程完成整个巡天第一轮处理后，发现了106颗此前未知的脉冲星。摘要称一年的初步计时是充分刻画新发现脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度，并可用于推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等参数，以及探测可能由发射不稳定性引起的异常行为。摘要称所有观测列表上的脉冲星均为首次跟进观测，预计将产生全新结果。未给出具体脉冲星参数、计时残差、偏振或单脉冲结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为该后续计时项目对于跟进HTRU银道面巡天发现的任何有趣脉冲星系统是必要的；一年的初步计时是充分刻画新发现脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度，并可推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率及探测可能的发射不稳定性。该计时项目还将支持对银道面脉冲星种群的大规模考察，探索脉冲星参数空间的真实边界。摘要未说明与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射的具体联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the initial follow-up of pulsar discoveries from the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed a first pass processing of the entire survey with our periodicity search algorithm as well as the partially-coherent segmented acceleration search pipeline, and have discovered 106 previously unknown pulsars. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic ?eld strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This follow-up timing project is necessary for following up on any interesting pulsar systems discovered from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. Since all of the pulsars on the observing list here are being followed-up for the first time, they will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will enable a large-scale examination of the Galactic plane pulsar population, exploring the true boundaries of pulsar parameter space.

</details>


### [3199] [Parkes observations for project P1050 semester 2020APRS_32]()
*Sengar, Rahul,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Wongphechauxsorn, Jompoj,Morello, Vincent*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请提出对 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域重新处理后发现的 54 颗潜在新脉冲星开展为期至少一年的初步跟踪计时，以刻画其参数并探测可能的发射不稳定性行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HTRU 巡天低银纬银道面部分经重新处理后产生了新脉冲星候选体，而只有经过确认和跟踪计时才能获得有意义的科学成果。摘要指出需要至少一年的初始计时来推导脉冲星参数并探测发射不稳定性，同时希望借此大规模考察银道面脉冲星种群与脉冲星参数空间边界。

Method: 这是为项目 P1050 提交的 2020APRS_32 学期 Parkes 观测时间申请。摘要说明对 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面部分 60 % 区域进行了首次重新处理，使用基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索和模板库搜索流程；提出对新发现脉冲星开展确认与跟踪计时观测，并指出一年的初始计时是最短所需时间跨度。摘要未说明具体观测频率、仪器配置、样本筛选判据或统计分析细节。

Result: 首次重新处理已覆盖该巡天 60 % 的区域，采用基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索和模板库搜索流程，发现了 54 颗潜在的此前未知脉冲星。摘要指出，这些脉冲星均为首次被跟踪观测，因此预期会产生全新的结果；一年的初始计时被认为是充分刻画新脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度。摘要未给出具体脉冲星参数、显著性数值或已完成的计时结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，对新发现脉冲星的确认与至少一年的跟踪计时是推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等参数并探测可能源于发射不稳定性的异常行为的必要条件，同时该计时项目有望支持对银道面脉冲星种群的大规模考察并探索脉冲星参数空间的真实边界。这些结论是在申请观测时间的语境下提出的；关于该样本与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或其他瞬变现象的具体联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the initial follow-up of pulsar discoveries from the re-processing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed a first pass re-processing of the 60 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search and template bank search pipelines, and have discovered potential 54 previously unknown pulsars. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This follow-up and timing project is necessary for following up on any interesting pulsar systems discovered from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. Since all of the pulsars on the observing list here are being followed-up for the first time, they will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will enable a large-scale examination of the Galactic plane pulsar population, exploring the true boundaries of pulsar parameter space.

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对 HTRU 巡天低银纬银道面区域 60 % 数据的重新处理已发现 54 颗潜在前所未知脉冲星，但新脉冲星通常只有在确认并开展后随计时之后才能得出有意义的科学结果，因此需要观测时间开展初步后随。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the initial follow-up of pulsar discoveries from the re-processing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed a first pass re-processing of the 60 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search and template bank search pipelines, and have discovered potential 54 previously unknown pulsars. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This follow-up and timing project is necessary for following up on any interesting pulsar systems discovered from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. Since all of the pulsars on the observing list here are being followed-up for the first time, they will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will enable a large-scale examination of the Galactic plane pulsar population, exploring the true boundaries of pulsar parameter space.

*Sengar, Rahul,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Bhandari, Shivani,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Wongphechauxsorn, Jompoj,Morello, Vincent*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HTRU巡天（P630）低银纬银河系盘区部分的第一次重处理已利用GPU相干加速度搜索和模板库搜索管线完成60 % 的数据，产生了潜在新脉冲星，但摘要指出有意义的科学结果通常只能在新脉冲星得到确认并开展后续计时观测活动之后获得，因此需要申请观测时间进行初步跟进。

Method: 摘要说明这是一份观测时间申请，针对HTRU巡天（P630）低银纬银河系盘区60 % 数据的第一次重处理，使用基于GPU的相干加速度搜索和模板库搜索管线，发现了54颗潜在新脉冲星；计划进行确认和后续计时观测活动，一年的初始计时被视为最短时间跨度。观测仪器、频率或频段、具体时间跨度以及样本细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告，对HTRU巡天（P630）低银纬银河系盘区部分的60 % 完成了第一次重处理，使用基于GPU的相干加速度搜索和模板库搜索管线，发现了54颗潜在的前所未知脉冲星。这些脉冲星均列于观测列表中并首次被后续跟进。摘要未给出关于这些脉冲星的性质、计时结果、偏振、频谱或爆发的具体测量结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，一年的初始计时是充分刻画任何新发现脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度，对于推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等脉冲星参数以及探测可能由发射不稳定性引起的意外行为是必需的；这一后续观测与计时项目对于跟进HTRU银河系盘巡天中发现的任何有趣脉冲星系统是必要的，并将使得能够对银河系盘脉冲星族群进行大规模考察，探索脉冲星参数空间的真实边界。该提案本身未报告已完成的物理结果，因此无法据此判断磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲发射等具体联系；根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the initial follow-up of pulsar discoveries from the re-processing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed a first pass re-processing of the 60 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search and template bank search pipelines, and have discovered potential 54 previously unknown pulsars. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This follow-up and timing project is necessary for following up on any interesting pulsar systems discovered from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. Since all of the pulsars on the observing list here are being followed-up for the first time, they will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will enable a large-scale examination of the Galactic plane pulsar population, exploring the true boundaries of pulsar parameter space.

</details>

Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This follow-up and timing project is necessary for following up on any interesting pulsar systems discovered from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. Since all of the pulsars on the observing list here are being followed-up for the first time, they will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will enable a large-scale examination of the Galactic plane pulsar population, exploring the true boundaries of pulsar parameter space.

Method: 摘要说明：对HTRU巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域进行重新处理，已用基于GPU的相干加速度搜索和模板库搜索pipeline完成该巡天62 %区域的第一遍重新处理；本申请为观测时间申请，用于对新发现脉冲星及预期的潜在脉冲星开展计时campaign与后继计时，观测列表上的脉冲星均已在当前2020APRS学期确认。具体观测仪器、频率或波段、时间跨度以外的数据细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：已完成对HTRU巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域62 %区域的第一遍重新处理，发现51颗此前未知的脉冲星；观测列表中所有脉冲星已在当前2020APRS学期得到确认；作者称后继计时将产生全新的结果，并指出一年的初始计时是充分刻画新脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度。具体脉冲星参数、观测数值或计时结果摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为，该计时项目是跟进HTRU银道面巡天中发现的任何有趣脉冲星系统所必需的；一年的初始计时对于推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等参数以及探测可能源于发射不稳定性的意外行为必不可少，并将支持对银道面脉冲星population的大规模考察，探索银道面中脉冲星参数空间的真实边界。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、单脉冲、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱、快速射电暴（FRB）或暂现射电发射之间的具体物理联系。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the timing campaign of new pulsar discoveries and follow-up of expected new potential pulsars from the re-processing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed the first pass re-processing of the 62 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search and template bank search pipelines, and have discovered 51 previously unknown pulsars. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This timing project is necessary for following up on any interesting pulsar systems discovered from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. Since all of the pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed in the current 2020APRS semester, the follow-up timing will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will enable a large-scale examination of the Galactic plane pulsar population, exploring the true boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

</details>


### [3234] [Parkes observations for project P1050 semester 2020OCTS_06]()

Since all of the pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed in the current 2020APRS semester, the follow-up timing will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will enable a large-scale examination of the Galactic plane pulsar population, exploring the true boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

We have now completed the first pass re-processing of the 62 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search and template bank search pipelines, and have discovered 51 previously unknown pulsars. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This timing project is necessary for following up on any interesting pulsar systems discovered from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. Since all of the pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed in the current 2020APRS semester, the follow-up timing will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will enable a large-scale examination of the Galactic plane pulsar population, exploring the true boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

</details>

### [3249] [Parkes observations for project P1173 semester 2022OCTS_01]()
*Mandow, Rami,Dawson, Joanne,Hobbs, George,Dai, Shi,Zic, Andrew,Marshman, Tommy*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请提出利用 Parkes UWL 对两颗已知蜘蛛脉冲星进行完整轨道观测，以分析其食效应，并借助伴星被烧蚀产生的碎片对脉冲星辐射的散射来研究该区域的湍流结构以及偏振、旋转测度和色散测度的变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蜘蛛脉冲星系统中，主脉冲星通过高能辐射和脉冲星风烧蚀低质量伴星。摘要指出，被烧蚀伴星周围的碎片会使脉冲星辐射沿视线传播时发生散射，从而有望揭示该区域复杂湍流结构的细节；近期研究还表明食区可导致散射以及偏振、旋转测度和色散测度的强烈变化。

Method: 摘要说明这是一项观测申请，拟利用 Parkes UWL 能力对两颗已知蜘蛛脉冲星的完整轨道进行观测，并据此分析这些系统的食效应。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本筛选、数据分析方法或统计方法。

Result: 这是一项观测申请，摘要未报告新的观测结果。摘要提及的既有研究结论是：食区可使脉冲星信号发生散射，揭示湍流场的小尺度结构，并导致脉冲星偏振、旋转测度和色散测度出现强烈变化。摘要未给出具体数值、显著性、时间跨度或相关程度。

Conclusion: 作者认为，利用 Parkes UWL 对两颗已知蜘蛛脉冲星进行完整轨道观测，将提供分析这些系统食效应的机会，并有助于在射电波段探测与低质量伴星被摧毁相关的机制。根据摘要无法判断这些观测对脉冲星计时、自转减速力矩变化或磁星—快速射电暴联系的适用性。

Abstract: Spider pulsar systems are compact binary pulsars with low-mass companions in tight orbits, where the primary pulsar is ablating the secondary through the output of high-energy radiation and pulsar wind due to proximity. These systems present an interesting opportunity to probe the mechanisms related to the destruction of these low-mass bodies in the radio regime, as debris surrounding the ablated secondary companion causes the pulsar emission to propagate and scatter as it moves through it, along our line of sight - revealing details of the complex, turbulent structure of this region. Recent studies have shown that the eclipsing region can cause pulsar signals to scatter, revealing small-scale structure of the turbulent field, as well as a strong variation in the pulsar's polarsiation, rotation measure and dispersion measure. Under this proposal, we wish to study two known spider pulsars for their full orbit with the Parkes UWL capability -- which has not been achieved by any other telescope. This will give us the opportunity to analyse he eclipsing effects of these systems.

</details>

Abstract: Spider pulsar systems are compact binary pulsars with low-mass companions in tight orbits, where the primary pulsar is ablating the secondary through the output of high-energy radiation and pulsar wind due to proximity. These systems present an interesting opportunity to probe the mechanisms related to the destruction of these low-mass bodies in the radio regime, as debris surrounding the ablated secondary companion causes the pulsar emission to propagate and scatter as it moves through it, along our line of sight - revealing details of the complex, turbulent structure of this region. Recent studies have shown that the eclipsing region can cause pulsar signals to scatter, revealing small-scale structure of the turbulent field, as well as a strong variation in the pulsar's polarsiation, rotation measure and dispersion measure. *Mandow, Rami,Dawson, Joanne,Hobbs, George,Dai, Shi,Zic, Andrew,Marshman, Tommy*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请拟利用 Parkes UWL 对两颗已知蜘蛛脉冲星进行完整轨道观测，以分析这些系统的食效应；摘要指出这是其他望远镜尚未实现的观测，并提到近期研究显示食区可引起脉冲星信号散射以及偏振、旋转测度和色散测度的强烈变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蜘蛛脉冲星系统中，主脉冲星通过高能辐射输出和脉冲星风剥离低质量伴星，被剥离伴星周围的碎片会沿视线方向使脉冲星辐射发生传播和散射，从而揭示该区域复杂的湍流结构。近期研究表明食区可引起散射、湍流场小尺度结构以及偏振、旋转测度和色散测度的强烈变化，因此有必要对已知蜘蛛脉冲星进行完整轨道观测以分析这些食效应。

Method: 摘要说明这是一份观测申请，拟利用 Parkes UWL 能力对两颗已知蜘蛛脉冲星在其完整轨道上进行研究，并称这是任何其他望远镜尚未实现的。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本量、数据分析方法或统计方法。

Result: 摘要未说明本申请已获得的观测结果。摘要提及的既有相关结果为：近期研究表明食区可导致脉冲星信号散射，揭示湍流场的小尺度结构，并伴随脉冲星偏振、旋转测度和色散测度的强烈变化。摘要未给出具体数值、显著性或其他定量结果。

Conclusion: 作者表示，希望利用 Parkes UWL 在完整轨道上研究两颗已知蜘蛛脉冲星，从而获得分析这些系统食效应的机会；其提出的科学背景是，被剥离伴星周围的碎片会使脉冲星辐射沿视线发生传播和散射，并可揭示该区域复杂湍流结构的细节。至于该观测能否直接推广到磁星、快速射电暴或其他瞬变射电现象，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Spider pulsar systems are compact binary pulsars with low-mass companions in tight orbits, where the primary pulsar is ablating the secondary through the output of high-energy radiation and pulsar wind due to proximity. These systems present an interesting opportunity to probe the mechanisms related to the destruction of these low-mass bodies in the radio regime, as debris surrounding the ablated secondary companion causes the pulsar emission to propagate and scatter as it moves through it, along our line of sight - revealing details of the complex, turbulent structure of this region. Recent studies have shown that the eclipsing region can cause pulsar signals to scatter, revealing small-scale structure of the turbulent field, as well as a strong variation in the pulsar's polarsiation, rotation measure and dispersion measure. Under this proposal, we wish to study two known spider pulsars for their full orbit with the Parkes UWL capability -- which has not been achieved by any other telescope. This will give us the opportunity to analyse he eclipsing effects of these systems.

</details>

These systems present an interesting opportunity to probe the mechanisms related to the destruction of these low-mass bodies in the radio regime, as debris surrounding the ablated secondary companion causes the pulsar emission to propagate and scatter as it moves through it, along our line of sight - revealing details of the complex, turbulent structure of this region. Recent studies have shown that the eclipsing region can cause pulsar signals to scatter, revealing small-scale structure of the turbulent field, as well as a strong variation in the pulsar's polarsiation, rotation measure and dispersion measure. Under this proposal, we wish to study two known spider pulsars for their full orbit with the Parkes UWL capability -- which has not been achieved by any other telescope. This will give us the opportunity to analyse he eclipsing effects of these systems.

</details>


### [3258] [Parkes observations for project P1173 semester 2022OCTS_02]()
*Mandow, Rami,Dawson, Joanne,Hobbs, George,Dai, Shi,Zic, Andrew,Marshman, Tommy*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用 Parkes UWL 对两颗已知蜘蛛脉冲星进行完整轨道观测，以分析其食效应；摘要指出食区可引起脉冲星信号散射，并伴随偏振、旋转测度和色散测度的强烈变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蜘蛛脉冲星系统中，主脉冲星通过高能辐射和脉冲星风剥蚀低质量伴星；伴星周围碎屑会散射沿视线传播的脉冲星辐射，从而可用于探测该区域复杂湍流结构。近期研究显示食区可引起散射并伴随偏振、旋转测度和色散测度的强烈变化，但利用 Parkes UWL 对已知蜘蛛脉冲星完整轨道的观测尚未实现。

Method: 摘要说明为提案性质，拟利用 Parkes UWL 能力对两颗已知蜘蛛脉冲星进行完整轨道研究，并分析这些系统的食效应。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、数据量、样本细节以及所使用的具体分析流程；仅提及与食区相关的散射、偏振、旋转测度和色散测度研究背景。

Result: 摘要未报告本提案所取得的新观测结果。其引述的近期研究结果表明，食区可导致脉冲星信号散射，揭示湍流场的小尺度结构，并出现脉冲星偏振、旋转测度和色散测度的强烈变化。摘要同时称，利用 Parkes UWL 对两颗已知蜘蛛脉冲星完整轨道进行观测是其他望远镜尚未实现的。

Conclusion: 作者拟通过 Parkes UWL 对两颗已知蜘蛛脉冲星的完整轨道观测，获得分析这些系统食效应的机会，并以此探测致密双星中低质量伴星剥蚀区域的相关机制。摘要未给出本提案的观测结论或物理推断；根据摘要无法判断其能否验证具体湍流结构或偏振、旋转测度、色散测度变化的物理机制。

Abstract: Spider pulsar systems are compact binary pulsars with low-mass companions in tight orbits, where the primary pulsar is ablating the secondary through the output of high-energy radiation and pulsar wind due to proximity. These systems present an interesting opportunity to probe the mechanisms related to the destruction of these low-mass bodies in the radio regime, as debris surrounding the ablated secondary companion causes the pulsar emission to propagate and scatter as it moves through it, along our line of sight - revealing details of the complex, turbulent structure of this region. Recent studies have shown that the eclipsing region can cause pulsar signals to scatter, revealing small-scale structure of the turbulent field, as well as a strong variation in the pulsar's polarsiation, rotation measure and dispersion measure. Under this proposal, we wish to study two known spider pulsars for their full orbit with the Parkes UWL capability -- which has not been achieved by any other telescope. This will give us the opportunity to analyse he eclipsing effects of these systems.

</details>


### [3259] [Parkes observations for project P985 semester 2019APRS_01]()
*Zhang, Lei,Hobbs, George,Li, Di,Cameron, Andrew,Kaczmarek, Jane,Dai, Shi*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划用 Parkes 超宽带低频接收机（并请求 Parkes、FAST、ATCA 时间）对新发现脉冲星 PSR J1926-0653 的宽频带间歇性、偏振、准周期性和模式转换进行详细刻画，因为该源表现出多脉冲成分随时间变化、单脉冲缺失、小时尺度发射关闭和可能的准周期流量变化等独特发射行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新发现的脉冲星 PSR J1926-0653 发射特性独特，具有多个随时间变化的脉冲成分、模式转换和子脉冲漂移、单脉冲缺失以及小时尺度发射关闭等现象，脉冲流量密度还常常表现出准周期变化。因此需要量化其宽频带间歇性时间尺度、偏振、准周期性和模式转换，以详细参数化该脉冲星及其发射特性。

Method: 摘要说明提议使用安装在 Parkes 望远镜上的超宽带、低频接收机进行观测，并请求 Parkes、FAST 和 ATCA 的时间；目标是对新发现的脉冲星 PSR J1926-0653 的宽频带间歇性时间尺度、偏振、准周期性、模式转换及其发射特性进行量化与详细参数化。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、时间跨度、样本量、灵敏度或具体分析方法。

Result: 根据摘要，PSR J1926-0653 具有多个脉冲成分且随时间变化，模式转换和子脉冲漂移现象均明显；它表现出 nulls，其中似乎缺失几个单脉冲，并表现出更长尺度（小时尺度）的间歇性行为，即发射长时间关闭；其脉冲流量密度常常（但并非总是）似乎表现出准周期变化。摘要未给出具体数值、不确定度或统计显著性；摘要未说明是否已获得观测或已有观测结果，因其为观测时间申请。

Conclusion: 作者明确认为该脉冲星可能在多种不同发射现象中具有关键意义，并请求在 Parkes、FAST 和 ATCA 上获得时间以详细参数化该脉冲星及其发射特性。这本质上是观测提案；对磁星、FRB、计时或自转减慢力矩变化的具体物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose to use the ultra-wide-bandwidth, low frequency receiver installed at the Parkes telescope in order to quantify the broad-band intermittency time scale, polarization, quasi-periodicities, and mode changing of a newly discovered pulsar, PSR J1926-0653. The pulsar is unique in its emission properties. It has multiple pulse components, that change with time (both mode- changing and sub-pulse drifting phenomena are evident). The pulsar exhibits nulls in which a few individual pulses seem to be missing. It also exhibits longer-scale (hour-scale) intermittency behaviour in which the emission switches off for long periods of time. The pulse flux densities often, but not always, seem to exhibit quasi-periodic variations. Clearly this pulsar may hold the key to many different emission phenomena and we request time on Parkes, FAST and ATCA to parameterise the pulsar and its emission properties in detail.

</details>

Abstract: We propose to use the ultra-wide-bandwidth, low frequency receiver installed at the Parkes telescope in order to quantify the broad-band intermittency time scale, polarization, quasi-periodicities, and mode changing of a newly discovered pulsar, PSR J1926-0653. The pulsar is unique in its emission properties. It has multiple pulse components, that change with time (both mode- changing and sub-pulse drifting phenomena are evident). The pulsar exhibits nulls in which a few individual pulses seem to be missing. It also exhibits longer-scale (hour-scale) intermittency behaviour in which the emission switches off for long periods of time. The pulse flux densities often, but not always, seem to exhibit quasi-periodic variations. Clearly this pulsar may hold the key to many different emission phenomena and we request time on Parkes, FAST and ATCA to parameterise the pulsar and its emission properties in detail.

### [3270] [Parkes observations for project P965 semester 2018APRS_02]()
*Oslowski, Stefan,Verbiest, Joris P. W.*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用新的超宽带接收机 UWL 观测强烈闪烁的毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1933-6211，以期获得更可靠的计时精度，从而通过 Shapiro-Delay 探测测量其质量。摘要中所述目标还包括测量其白矮星伴星类型、限制轨道倾角，并验证其能否用于高精度计时和脉冲星计时阵。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前对 PSR J1933-6211 的研究因该脉冲星的闪烁而未能测量其质量和轨道参数，只能给出限制；而可用射电频率带宽与 ISM 引起的去相关带宽之比，在 UWL 部署后显著增加，这为更可靠地探测明亮闪烁并改善计时精度提供了条件。该脉冲星的质量可能是已知最低的，其白矮星伴星类型也有待确定。

Method: 摘要仅说明将部署新的超宽带接收机 UWL 用于观测；预期在每次观测中更可靠地探测明亮闪烁，并利用宽带研究 PSR J1933-6211 的闪烁性质。摘要未说明具体望远镜、接收频段、观测时间跨度、样本量或数据分析方法细节。

Result: 摘要未报告已获得的观测结果。所述内容为预期：借助 UWL 预期更可靠地探测明亮闪烁，从而获得改进且可靠的计时精度，并有望通过 Shapiro-Delay 探测实现质量测量；宽带还可用于研究该脉冲星的闪烁性质并限制其轨道倾角。此前研究的结果是未能测量该系统的质量和轨道参数，只给出了限制。

Conclusion: 作者预期，若通过质量测量确定该脉冲星的质量，将同时确定其白矮星伴星的类型；该白矮星是已知最冷的此类天体之一（Antoniadis，私下交流）。作者还将验证增加的带宽所达到的精度是否足以进行高精度脉冲星计时，并将 PSR J1933-6211 纳入脉冲星计时阵实验。至于这些预期能否实现，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The deployment of the new ultra-wide-band receiver UWL enables a plethora of experiments which were previously not possible or very difficult. One immediate benefit for pulsar timing studies is the significantly increased ratio of available radio frequency bandwidth to the decorrelation bandwidth as induced by the ionised interstellar medium (ISM). PSR J1933-6211 is a strongly-scintillating millisecond pulsar. Due to its scintillation, previous studies failed to measure the mass and orbital parameters of this system and instead provided limits. With the UWL we expect more reliable detection of bright scintles during every observation; and hence improved and reliable timing precision that will allow a mass measurement through Shapiro-Delay detection. As an additional benefit, we can use the broad band to adequately study the scintillation properties of this pulsar and thereby constrain its orbital inclination. The mass of the pulsar is potentially the lowest known, depending on the type of its white dwarf companion. By measuring it we will also determine the type of the white dwarf which is interesting in its own right and is one of the coolest such objects known (Antoniadis, priv. comm.). Finally, we will verify if, as we expect, the precision attainable with the increased bandwidth is sufficient for high-precision pulsar timing and inclusion of PSR J1933-6211 in pulsar timing array experiments.

</details>

<details>

Motivation: PSR J1933-6211 是一颗强烈闪烁的毫秒脉冲星，其闪烁导致此前研究未能测量该系统质量与轨道参数，只给出限制。新型超宽带接收机 UWL 的部署为克服这一困难提供了契机，并可检验增加带宽后的精度是否足以支持高精度计时及纳入脉冲星计时阵。

Conclusion: 作者预期通过 UWL 的宽带观测实现质量测量并确定白矮星伴星类型；据摘要，该脉冲星质量可能是已知最低的，具体取决于白矮星伴星类型，而该白矮星是已知最冷此类天体之一（Antoniadis，私人交流）。作者还预期验证增加带宽后的精度是否足以支持高精度脉冲星计时并纳入脉冲星计时阵实验。根据摘要无法判断这些预期能否实现。

Abstract: The deployment of the new ultra-wide-band receiver UWL enables a plethora of experiments which were previously not possible or very difficult. One immediate benefit for pulsar timing studies is the significantly increased ratio of available radio frequency bandwidth to the decorrelation bandwidth as induced by the ionised interstellar medium (ISM). PSR J1933-6211 is a strongly-scintillating millisecond pulsar. Due to its scintillation, previous studies failed to measure the mass and orbital parameters of this system and instead provided limits. With the UWL we expect more reliable detection of bright scintles during every observation; and hence improved and reliable timing precision that will allow a mass measurement through Shapiro-Delay detection. As an additional benefit, we can use the broad band to adequately study the scintillation properties of this pulsar and thereby constrain its orbital inclination. The mass of the pulsar is potentially the lowest known, depending on the type of its white dwarf companion. By measuring it we will also determine the type of the white dwarf which is interesting in its own right and is one of the coolest such objects known (Antoniadis, priv. comm.). Finally, we will verify if, as we expect, the precision attainable with the increased bandwidth is sufficient for high-precision pulsar timing and inclusion of PSR J1933-6211 in pulsar timing array experiments.

</details>


### [3272] [Parkes observations for project P965 semester 2018APRS_01]()
*Oslowski, Stefan,Verbiest, Joris P. W.*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案预期利用 UWL 超宽带接收机对强烈闪烁的毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1933-6211 进行更可靠的闪烁体探测，以提高计时精度，从而实现通过 Shapiro-Delay 探测测量其质量，并验证其是否适合纳入脉冲星计时阵实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前对 PSR J1933-6211 的研究因其强烈闪烁而未能测量该系统的质量和轨道参数，只给出了限制；超宽带接收机 UWL 的部署使可用射电频率带宽与 ISM 引起的去相关带宽之比显著增大，从而有望克服这一困难，并进一步研究该脉冲星的闪烁性质与轨道倾角、可能的极低质量及其白矮星伴星类型。

Method: 摘要提及使用新部署的超宽带接收机 UWL 进行观测，预期在每次观测中更可靠地探测到明亮闪烁体，并利用宽带研究该脉冲星的闪烁性质；还提及通过 Shapiro-Delay 探测进行质量测量，以及验证所达到的精度是否足以进行高精度脉冲星计时并纳入脉冲星计时阵实验。具体观测频段、时间跨度、样本量和分析流程：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要为观测提案性质，主要给出预期而非已获得的测量结果：UWL 使可用射电频率带宽与 ISM 引起的去相关带宽之比显著增大；预期每次观测都能更可靠地探测到明亮闪烁体；预期获得改进且可靠的计时精度，从而可能通过 Shapiro-Delay 探测测量质量；并预期利用宽带限制轨道倾角。摘要还指出该脉冲星质量可能是已知最低的，取决于其白矮星伴星类型，而该白矮星是已知此类天体中最冷的之一（Antoniadis，私人通信）。摘要未给出具体数值结果、显著性或精度指标。

Conclusion: 作者认为，借助 UWL 增加带宽后可更可靠地探测闪烁体，从而获得足以支持 Shapiro-Delay 探测的计时精度，实现 PSR J1933-6211 的质量测量，并据此确定其白矮星伴星类型；他们还将验证该精度是否足以进行高精度脉冲星计时并将其纳入脉冲星计时阵实验。这些均为提案中的预期与目标，尚非已确立的结果；其物理可转移性根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The deployment of the new ultra-wide-band receiver UWL enables a plethora of experiments which were previously not possible or very difficult. One immediate benefit for pulsar timing studies is the significantly increased ratio of available radio frequency bandwidth to the decorrelation bandwidth as induced by the ionised interstellar medium (ISM). PSR J1933-6211 is a strongly-scintillating millisecond pulsar. Due to its scintillation, previous studies failed to measure the mass and orbital parameters of this system and instead provided limits. With the UWL we expect more reliable detection of bright scintles during every observation; and hence improved and reliable timing precision that will allow a mass measurement through Shapiro-Delay detection. As an additional benefit, we can use the broad band to adequately study the scintillation properties of this pulsar and thereby constrain its orbital inclination. The mass of the pulsar is potentially the lowest known, depending on the type of its white dwarf companion. By measuring it we will also determine the type of the white dwarf which is interesting in its own right and is one of the coolest such objects known (Antoniadis, priv. comm.). Finally, we will verify if, as we expect, the precision attainable with the increased bandwidth is sufficient for high-precision pulsar timing and inclusion of PSR J1933-6211 in pulsar timing array experiments.

</details>


### [3273] [Parkes observations for project P1330 semester 2024OCTS_05]()
*Bhakta, Deven,Ransom, Scott,DeCesar, Megan,Dai, Shi*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请计划用 Parkes（P1330）对新发现的 NGC6316 中高度加速双星毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1716-2808A（NGC6316A）开展为期一年的计时 campaña，以求解轨道、打破位置与自转减慢率之间的计时简并，并确认其是否为星团成员。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新发现的高度加速双星毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1716-2808A（NGC6316A）轨道尚未求解；只有先获得良好轨道解，才能开展后续观测，并通过一年期计时打破脉冲星位置与自转减慢率之间的计时简并，同时把该脉冲星与自 2022 年以来的先前观测联系并确认其是否为星团成员。

Method: 使用 Parkes（P1330）对 NGC6316 中的 PSR J1716-2808A 进行观测；2024 年 8 月有 6 次已排定观测，预期用于获得轨道解；本申请拟开展为期一年的计时 campaña；数据还可用于堆叠搜索（stack searching）以搜寻暗弱脉冲星，并对后续观测中发现的新脉冲星进行计时。观测频段、时间跨度细节、样本量及具体分析手段摘要未说明。

Result: 在 NGC6316 中发现 PSR J1716-2808A（NGC6316A），为高度加速的双星毫秒脉冲星（MSP）；提交申请时轨道尚未求解；2024 年 8 月有 6 次已排定观测，预期能提供良好的轨道解。摘要未报告已完成的计时、轨道参数、偏振、频谱、单脉冲或爆发等具体测量结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，为期一年的计时 campaña 对于打破脉冲星位置与自转减慢率之间的计时简并至关重要，并将据此把该脉冲星与可追溯至 2022 年的先前观测联系起来，还可确认该脉冲星是否属于该星团；此外，这些数据还可用于堆叠搜索暗弱脉冲星并为新发现脉冲星计时。脉冲星/磁星/快速射电暴（FRB）之间的物理联系：根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We discovered PSR J1716-2808A (NGC6316A), a highly accelerated binary millisecond pulsar (MSP), in NGC6316. We are currently observing it with Parkes (P1330) to solve for the orbit. At the time of this proposal submission, we have not yet solved the orbit. We have 6 scheduled observations in August 2024, which we expect to provide a good orbital solution to use in the proposed observations for this proposal. The goal of the proposed observations is to conduct a year long timing campaign. This is crucial to break the timing degeneracy that occurs between the pulsar's position and the pulsar's spindown rate. We will be able to use this to connect the pulsar to our previous observations spanning back to 2022. This will also confirm whether the pulsar is a part of the cluster. A secondary advantage of having these observations is that the data can also be used to search for faint pulsars via stack searching and time any new pulsars that are discovered in any subsequent observations.

</details>

Motivation: 摘要指出，PSR J1716-2808A 是一颗在 NGC6316 中发现的高度加速毫秒脉冲星双星，目前尚未求解其轨道。研究需求是求解轨道、打破脉冲星位置与自转减慢率之间的计时简并，并将该脉冲星与自 2022 年以来的先前观测联系起来，同时确认它是否属于该星团。

Result: 摘要报告：发现了 PSR J1716-2808A（NGC6316A），为 NGC6316 中一颗高度加速的毫秒脉冲星双星；截至提交本申请时轨道尚未求解；2024 年 8 月有 6 次已安排的观测，预期将提供良好轨道解。拟议的为期一年计时活动预计可打破位置与自转减慢率之间的计时简并，将该脉冲星与 2022 年以来的先前观测相连接，并确认其是否属于该星团。这些数据还可能有助于堆叠搜索暗弱脉冲星并为新发现脉冲星计时。摘要未给出具体数值、显著性或其他观测结果。

Conclusion: 作者明确给出的结论是：为期一年的计时活动对于打破脉冲星位置与自转减慢率之间的计时简并至关重要，可据此将该脉冲星与 2022 年以来的先前观测联系起来，并确认它是否属于该星团；这些数据还有次要优势，即可用于堆叠搜索暗弱脉冲星并为后续发现的新脉冲星计时。该脉冲星与磁星、快速射电暴或其他单脉冲/偏振/射电谱现象的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We discovered PSR J1716-2808A (NGC6316A), a highly accelerated binary millisecond pulsar (MSP), in NGC6316. We are currently observing it with Parkes (P1330) to solve for the orbit. At the time of this proposal submission, we have not yet solved the orbit. We have 6 scheduled observations in August 2024, which we expect to provide a good orbital solution to use in the proposed observations for this proposal. The goal of the proposed observations is to conduct a year long timing campaign. This is crucial to break the timing degeneracy that occurs between the pulsar's position and the pulsar's spindown rate. We will be able to use this to connect the pulsar to our previous observations spanning back to 2022. This will also confirm whether the pulsar is a part of the cluster. A secondary advantage of having these observations is that the data can also be used to search for faint pulsars via stack searching and time any new pulsars that are discovered in any subsequent observations.

</details>


### [3279] [Parkes observations for project P1172 semester 2022OCTS_08]()
*Mandow, Rami,Dawson, Joanne,Hobbs, George,Bhat, Ramesh,Shannon, Ryan,Zic, Andrew,Lower, Marcus,Gupta, Vivek,Kapur, Agastya,Marshman, Tommy*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: PSR J1713+0747 于 2021 年 4 月发生与磁层变化相关的显著事件，表现为脉冲轮廓变化，此后缓慢恢复；本提案拟用 Parkes UWL 以每日时间尺度高采样监测其轮廓、偏振等性质，以判断磁层是否恢复原状或进入新构型，并评估其作为引力波研究时钟的可用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1713+0747 因高 S/N、窄轮廓和长期观测历史，是全球脉冲星计时阵的高优先级毫秒脉冲星。2021 年 4 月它经历了与磁层变化相关的显著事件，此后缓慢恢复；需要理解这一恢复过程，以判断此类脉冲星是否仍可作为引力波研究的稳定时钟，并获取其通常稳定磁层如何响应脉冲式状态变化的新数据。

Method: 拟对 PSR J1713+0747 开展高采样率观测，以每日时间尺度探测脉冲轮廓恢复：每周 3 次、间隔 2 天，使用 Parkes UWL，构建时间分辨的脉冲轮廓、偏振及其他性质变化序列。摘要未说明具体观测频率、数据跨度、样本量或分析方法的更多细节。

Result: 2021 年 4 月，PSR J1713+0747 经历了一次与磁层变化相关的显著事件，表现为脉冲轮廓的可观测变化；此后该脉冲星一直缓慢恢复。拟开展的观测旨在揭示额外的短时间尺度行为；摘要未说明已获得的恢复测量、具体数值、变化幅度或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，理解该事件的恢复过程对于证明此类脉冲星仍是可用于引力波研究的可行时钟至关重要，并可提供关于这颗毫秒脉冲星通常稳定的磁层如何响应脉冲式状态变化的新数据。所提观测还将用于确定磁层是已回到原始构型，还是正在稳定到新构型；根据摘要无法判断该恢复是否已完成或最终构型为何。

Abstract: PSR J1713+0747 is an extremely stable millisecond pulsar used in global pulsar timing array campaigns as a high priority pulsar because of its strong S/N, narrow profile and long-term observation history. In April 2021, the pulsar experienced a significant event related to a change in its magnetosphere, presented as an observable change in the pulsar's profile. Since then, the pulsar has been slowly recovering and we wish to observe it with high cadence to allow us to create a detailed time-resolved series of variations in the MSPs profile, polarisation, and other properties. Under this proposal, we wish to probe the profile recovery on daily timescales (3 times per week with 2 day intervals in between), revealing additional short timescale behaviours, indicative of changes in the magnetosphere which are not available to other telescopes in the world, thanks to the Parkes UWL. This will also allow us to determine if the magnetosphere has returned to its original configuration or is settling into a new one. Understanding the recovery of this event is key for demonstrating that such pulsars are still viable clocks for use in gravitational wave studies, and in turn, provide us with new data on how the normally stable magnetosphere of this millisecond pulsar responds to an impulsive change in state.

</details>


### [3280] [Parkes observations for project P1050 semester 2021OCTS_25]()
*Sengar, Rahul,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Morello, Vincent,Bhandari, Shivani,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Wongphechauxsorn, Jompoj,Chen, Weiwei,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请报告在 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域重新处理中已发现 92 颗新脉冲星和 8 颗待确认的“class A”脉冲星，并申请对其中已确认脉冲星开展后续计时观测。作者指出一年的初始计时是充分刻画新脉冲星、推导特征年龄、磁场强度和自转减慢率所需的最短时间跨度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新发现的脉冲星通常只有在确认并开展后续计时后才能得到有意义的科学结果；要充分刻画新发现的脉冲星并推导其参数，至少需要一年的初始计时。该申请旨在为 HTRU 巡天低银纬银道面区域重新处理中发现的新脉冲星开展计时活动，并测量银道面脉冲星的真实种群及脉冲星参数空间的边界。

Method: 摘要说明这是为 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域重新处理中新发现脉冲星的计时活动提交的观测时间申请。数据处理使用了基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、模板库和快速折叠算法流水线，已覆盖该巡天的 90%。观测列表上的脉冲星已在先前和当前的 2021APRS 学期确认，本次申请为 2021 年 OCTS 的后续计时；具体观测仪器、频率或频段、时间跨度、样本量与统计分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 在已完成 90% 的巡天中，共发现 92 颗此前未知的脉冲星以及 8 颗等待确认的“class A”脉冲星。观测列表上的脉冲星已在先前和当前的 2021APRS 学期中得到确认。摘要未给出计时测量数值、自转减慢率、特征年龄、磁场强度、偏振、单脉冲或发射不稳定性等具体结果；脉冲星参数与异常行为被描述为计时活动预期可获得的内容。

Conclusion: 作者认为，一年的初始计时是充分刻画新发现脉冲星的最短时间跨度，对推导特征年龄、磁场强度和自转减慢率以及探测可能源于发射不稳定性的异常行为至关重要；2021 年 OCTS 的后续计时将产生全新结果。该计时项目还将使作者能够测量银道面脉冲星的真实种群以及银道面中脉冲星参数空间的边界。根据摘要无法判断与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射的直接联系。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the timing campaign of new pulsar discoveries from the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed 90 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search, template bank and fast folding algorithm pipelines, and now have discovered 92 previously unknown pulsars and 8 "class A" pulsars awaiting confirmation. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. Pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed in the previous and current 2021APRS semesters, the follow-up timing in OCTS2021 will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will allow us to measure the true Galactic plane pulsar population and the boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

</details>

Abstract: PSR J1713+0747 is an extremely stable millisecond pulsar used in global pulsar timing array campaigns as a high priority pulsar because of its strong S/N, narrow profile and long-term observation history. Under this proposal, we wish to probe the profile recovery on daily timescales (3 times per week with 2 day intervals in between), revealing additional short timescale behaviours, indicative of changes in the magnetosphere which are not available to other telescopes in the world, thanks to the Parkes UWL. This will also allow us to determine if the magnetosphere has returned to its original configuration or is settling into a new one. Understanding the recovery of this event is key for demonstrating that such pulsars are still viable clocks for use in gravitational wave studies, and in turn, provide us with new data on how the normally stable magnetosphere of this millisecond pulsar responds to an impulsive change in state.

### [3282] [Parkes observations for project P1050 semester 2021OCTS_21]()
*Sengar, Rahul,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Morello, Vincent,Bhandari, Shivani,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Wongphechauxsorn, Jompoj,Chen, Weiwei,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请请求为 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面重新处理中发现的 92 颗新脉冲星和 8 颗等待确认的 “class A” 脉冲星开展后续计时观测，并计划通过 OCTS2021 的计时测量真实的银道面脉冲星族群及脉冲星参数空间边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重新处理 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面部分后已发现新脉冲星，但摘要指出，有意思的科学成果通常只有在脉冲星得到确认并开展后续计时观测后才能获得，因此需要申请观测时间开展计时活动，以表征这些新发现的脉冲星。

Method: 摘要说明已完成该巡天的 90 %，使用基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、模板库（template bank）和快速折叠算法（fast folding algorithm）流程开展处理；申请开展新发现脉冲星的计时观测活动，观测列表上的脉冲星已在此前和当前 2021APRS 学期中得到确认，后续计时将在 OCTS2021 进行。具体望远镜、接收机、频率或频段、时间跨度、样本大小及统计分析细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告已完成巡天的 90 %，并发现 92 颗此前未知的脉冲星以及 8 颗等待确认的 “class A” 脉冲星；观测列表上的脉冲星已在此前和当前的 2021APRS 学期中得到确认。摘要指出，OCTS2021 中的后续计时将产生全新的结果，并称该计时项目将允许测量真实的银道面脉冲星族群和银道面中脉冲星参数空间的边界。摘要未说明具体脉冲星参数或计时结果。

Conclusion: 作者明确支持的含义是：对新发现脉冲星需要确认和后续计时，一年的初始计时是充分表征新发现脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度，对推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率以及探测可能由发射不稳定性导致的意外行为至关重要；该计时项目还将用于测量真实的银道面脉冲星族群及脉冲星参数空间边界。关于单脉冲发射、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱、自转减慢力矩变化或磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the timing campaign of new pulsar discoveries from the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed 90 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search, template bank and fast folding algorithm pipelines, and now have discovered 92 previously unknown pulsars and 8 "class A" pulsars awaiting confirmation. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. Pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed in the previous and current 2021APRS semesters, the follow-up timing in OCTS2021 will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will allow us to measure the true Galactic plane pulsar population and the boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

</details>

### [3284] [Parkes observations for project P1050 semester 2021OCTS_02]()
*Sengar, Rahul,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Morello, Vincent,Bhandari, Shivani,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Wongphechauxsorn, Jompoj,Chen, Weiwei,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请提出对 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域重新处理中发现的新脉冲星开展后续计时观测；该巡天已利用 GPU 相干加速度搜索、模板库和快速折叠算法流水线完成 90 %，并发现了 92 颗此前未知的脉冲星和 8 颗等待确认的“class A”脉冲星。文中指出至少一年的初始计时是充分刻画新脉冲星、推导其特征年龄、磁场强度和自转减慢率等参数并探测可能由发射不稳定性导致的异常行为所需的最短时间跨度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新发现的脉冲星通常只有在确认并开展后续计时之后才能得到有意义的科学结果；该申请希望为 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域重新处理中已确认的新脉冲星申请计时观测时间，并进一步测量真实的银道面脉冲星族群以及银道面中脉冲星参数空间的边界。

Method: 摘要说明该工作是对 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域重新处理所发现脉冲星的计时观测申请；已利用基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、模板库和快速折叠算法流水线完成巡天的 90 %；观测名单上的脉冲星已在此前和当前的 2021APRS 学期中得到确认；计划在 OCTS2021 开展后续计时，并指出一年的初始计时是所需的最短时间跨度。望远镜、具体观测频率或波段及分析细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告已利用基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、模板库和快速折叠算法流水线完成 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域的 90 %，并发现 92 颗此前未知的脉冲星以及 8 颗等待确认的“class A”脉冲星。摘要未说明这些脉冲星的具体计时、轮廓、偏振、频谱或单脉冲结果；OCTS2021 的后续计时被描述为将产生全新的结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，至少一年的初始计时是充分刻画任何新发现脉冲星所必需的最短时间跨度，对推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等脉冲星参数以及探测可能由发射不稳定性导致的异常行为至关重要；该计时项目还将使测量真实的银道面脉冲星族群以及银道面中脉冲星参数空间的边界成为可能。与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲发射的具体联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the timing campaign of new pulsar discoveries from the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed 90 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search, template bank and fast folding algorithm pipelines, and now have discovered 92 previously unknown pulsars and 8 "class A" pulsars awaiting confirmation. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. Pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed in the previous and current 2021APRS semesters, the follow-up timing in OCTS2021 will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will allow us to measure the true Galactic plane pulsar population and the boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

</details>


### [3285] [Parkes observations for project P1172 semester 2022OCTS_11]()
*Mandow, Rami,Dawson, Joanne,Hobbs, George,Bhat, Ramesh,Shannon, Ryan,Zic, Andrew,Lower, Marcus,Gupta, Vivek,Kapur, Agastya,Marshman, Tommy*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟利用 Parkes UWL 对 PSR J1713+0747 进行高节奏观测，以详细追踪其 2021 年 4 月磁层相关事件后脉冲轮廓的恢复过程，并判断磁层是恢复原状还是进入新构型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1713+0747 是用于全球脉冲星计时阵列的高优先级、极其稳定的毫秒脉冲星。2021 年 4 月它发生了一次与磁层变化相关的显著事件，表现为脉冲轮廓的可观测变化，此后一直缓慢恢复。需要高节奏观测来理解恢复过程，并检验此类脉冲星是否仍可作为引力波研究中的可行时钟。

Method: 观测对象为 PSR J1713+0747，使用 Parkes UWL；拟以每日时间尺度进行高节奏观测，具体为每周 3 次、间隔 2 天，以构建脉冲轮廓、偏振及其他性质变化的详细时间分辨序列，并探测其他短时间尺度行为。摘要未说明观测频率、偏振分析细节、总观测时长或统计分析方法。

Result: 摘要未说明。摘要仅指出 2021 年 4 月该脉冲星发生了一次与磁层变化相关的显著事件，表现为脉冲轮廓的可观测变化，此后缓慢恢复；摘要未给出恢复程度、时间尺度、数值、显著性或其他观测结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，理解这一事件的恢复过程对于证明此类脉冲星仍是可用于引力波研究的可行时钟至关重要，并可提供关于该毫秒脉冲星通常稳定的磁层如何响应脉冲式状态变化的新数据；高节奏观测还可揭示其他望远镜无法获得的短时间尺度磁层变化，并判断磁层是否恢复原状或稳定到新构型。根据摘要无法判断具体恢复机制或物理过程。

Abstract: PSR J1713+0747 is an extremely stable millisecond pulsar used in global pulsar timing array campaigns as a high priority pulsar because of its strong S/N, narrow profile and long-term observation history. In April 2021, the pulsar experienced a significant event related to a change in its magnetosphere, presented as an observable change in the pulsar's profile. Since then, the pulsar has been slowly recovering and we wish to observe it with high cadence to allow us to create a detailed time-resolved series of variations in the MSPs profile, polarisation, and other properties. Under this proposal, we wish to probe the profile recovery on daily timescales (3 times per week with 2 day intervals in between), revealing additional short timescale behaviours, indicative of changes in the magnetosphere which are not available to other telescopes in the world, thanks to the Parkes UWL. This will also allow us to determine if the magnetosphere has returned to its original configuration or is settling into a new one. Understanding the recovery of this event is key for demonstrating that such pulsars are still viable clocks for use in gravitational wave studies, and in turn, provide us with new data on how the normally stable magnetosphere of this millisecond pulsar responds to an impulsive change in state.

</details>

### [3287] [Parkes observations for project P1172 semester 2022OCTS_03]()
*Mandow, Rami,Dawson, Joanne,Hobbs, George,Bhat, Ramesh,Shannon, Ryan,Zic, Andrew,Lower, Marcus,Gupta, Vivek,Kapur, Agastya,Marshman, Tommy*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: PSR J1713+0747 在 2021 年 4 月经历了一次与磁层变化相关的显著事件，表现为脉冲轮廓变化，此后缓慢恢复；本提案拟用 Parkes UWL 以每周 3 次的高采样率追踪其轮廓、偏振等性质的恢复，以判断磁层是否恢复原状或进入新构型，并检验该毫秒脉冲星是否仍可作为引力波研究的计时时钟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1713+0747 因其高 S/N、窄轮廓和长期观测历史，是全球脉冲星计时阵列中的高优先级毫秒脉冲星。2021 年 4 月它经历了一次与磁层变化有关的显著事件，表现为脉冲轮廓的可观测变化，此后缓慢恢复。需要理解这一恢复过程，以判断该脉冲星是否仍可作为引力波研究中的可行时钟，并了解其通常稳定的磁层如何响应脉冲式状态变化。

Method: 拟对 PSR J1713+0747 进行高采样率观测，以构建其轮廓、偏振及其他性质变化的详细时间分辨序列，探测每日时间尺度上的轮廓恢复，具体为每周 3 次、间隔 2 天。观测使用 Parkes UWL，摘要称该仪器提供世界上其他望远镜无法获得的短时间尺度行为信息。摘要未说明观测波段、数据跨度、样本量或具体分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告：PSR J1713+0747 在 2021 年 4 月经历了一次与磁层变化相关的显著事件，表现为其脉冲轮廓的可观测变化；此后该脉冲星一直在缓慢恢复。摘要称，拟议的高采样率观测将揭示轮廓恢复过程中的额外短时间尺度行为，这些行为指示磁层变化。摘要未给出轮廓、偏振或其他性质的定量结果、数值、时间跨度或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者明确支持的结论是：理解该事件的恢复过程对于证明此类脉冲星仍是可用于引力波研究的可行时钟至关重要，并能提供关于该毫秒脉冲星通常稳定的磁层如何响应脉冲式状态变化的新数据。拟议观测还将用于确定磁层是已恢复到原始构型，还是正在稳定到一个新构型。根据摘要无法判断恢复过程的具体物理机制。

Abstract: PSR J1713+0747 is an extremely stable millisecond pulsar used in global pulsar timing array campaigns as a high priority pulsar because of its strong S/N, narrow profile and long-term observation history. In April 2021, the pulsar experienced a significant event related to a change in its magnetosphere, presented as an observable change in the pulsar's profile. Since then, the pulsar has been slowly recovering and we wish to observe it with high cadence to allow us to create a detailed time-resolved series of variations in the MSPs profile, polarisation, and other properties. Under this proposal, we wish to probe the profile recovery on daily timescales (3 times per week with 2 day intervals in between), revealing additional short timescale behaviours, indicative of changes in the magnetosphere which are not available to other telescopes in the world, thanks to the Parkes UWL. This will also allow us to determine if the magnetosphere has returned to its original configuration or is settling into a new one. Understanding the recovery of this event is key for demonstrating that such pulsars are still viable clocks for use in gravitational wave studies, and in turn, provide us with new data on how the normally stable magnetosphere of this millisecond pulsar responds to an impulsive change in state.

</details>
