In April 2021, the pulsar experienced a significant event related to a change in its magnetosphere, presented as an observable change in the pulsar's profile. Since then, the pulsar has been slowly recovering and we wish to observe it with high cadence to allow us to create a detailed time-resolved series of variations in the MSPs profile, polarisation, and other properties. Under this proposal, we wish to probe the profile recovery on daily timescales (3 times per week with 2 day intervals in between), revealing additional short timescale behaviours, indicative of changes in the magnetosphere which are not available to other telescopes in the world, thanks to the Parkes UWL. This will also allow us to determine if the magnetosphere has returned to its original configuration or is settling into a new one. Understanding the recovery of this event is key for demonstrating that such pulsars are still viable clocks for use in gravitational wave studies, and in turn, provide us with new data on how the normally stable magnetosphere of this millisecond pulsar responds to an impulsive change in state.

</details>


### [3290] [Parkes observations for project P1172 semester 2022OCTS_13]()
*Mandow, Rami,Dawson, Joanne,Hobbs, George,Bhat, Ramesh,Shannon, Ryan,Zic, Andrew,Lower, Marcus,Gupta, Vivek,Kapur, Agastya,Marshman, Tommy*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟利用 Parkes UWL 对毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1713+0747 进行高采样率观测，追踪 2021 年 4 月磁层相关事件后脉冲轮廓的恢复过程，并判断其磁层是回到原始构型还是稳定到新构型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1713+0747 因高信噪比、窄轮廓和长期观测历史而成为全球脉冲星计时阵列的高优先级毫秒脉冲星；2021 年 4 月它经历了一次与磁层变化相关的显著事件，此后缓慢恢复。需要理解该事件的恢复过程，以判断其是否仍可作为引力波研究的可行时钟，并了解通常稳定的磁层如何响应脉冲式状态变化。

Method: 拟使用 Parkes UWL 对该脉冲星进行高采样率观测，频率或波段、观测时间跨度与样本量摘要未说明；观测策略为每周 3 次、间隔 2 天，以每日时间尺度探测轮廓恢复，目标是构建脉冲轮廓、偏振及其他性质变化的详细时间分辨序列。具体计时、单脉冲、偏振、RM、DM 或统计分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：2021 年 4 月该脉冲星经历了一次与磁层变化相关的显著事件，表现为脉冲星轮廓的可观测变化；此后脉冲星一直在缓慢恢复。拟通过高采样率观测以每日时间尺度探测轮廓恢复，并揭示指示磁层变化的额外短时间尺度行为，这些行为借助 Parkes UWL 可获得而其他望远镜无法获得。具体的数值、显著性、偏振或频谱结果摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为，理解这一事件的恢复过程对于证明此类脉冲星仍是可用于引力波研究的可行时钟至关重要，并可提供关于这颗毫秒脉冲星通常稳定的磁层如何响应脉冲式状态变化的新数据；观测还将用于确定磁层是否已恢复到原始构型，还是正在稳定到新的构型。上述判断属于该提案的预期目标与推论；其物理机制及对快速射电暴或磁星的适用性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: PSR J1713+0747 is an extremely stable millisecond pulsar used in global pulsar timing array campaigns as a high priority pulsar because of its strong S/N, narrow profile and long-term observation history. In April 2021, the pulsar experienced a significant event related to a change in its magnetosphere, presented as an observable change in the pulsar's profile. Since then, the pulsar has been slowly recovering and we wish to observe it with high cadence to allow us to create a detailed time-resolved series of variations in the MSPs profile, polarisation, and other properties. Under this proposal, we wish to probe the profile recovery on daily timescales (3 times per week with 2 day intervals in between), revealing additional short timescale behaviours, indicative of changes in the magnetosphere which are not available to other telescopes in the world, thanks to the Parkes UWL. This will also allow us to determine if the magnetosphere has returned to its original configuration or is settling into a new one. Understanding the recovery of this event is key for demonstrating that such pulsars are still viable clocks for use in gravitational wave studies, and in turn, provide us with new data on how the normally stable magnetosphere of this millisecond pulsar responds to an impulsive change in state.

</details>


### [3291] [Parkes observations for project P1050 semester 2021OCTS_03]()
*Sengar, Rahul,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Morello, Vincent,Bhandari, Shivani,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Wongphechauxsorn, Jompoj,Chen, Weiwei,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请提出利用 Parkes 观测时间，对 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域重新处理中新发现的脉冲星开展后续计时；相关流程已借助基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、模板库与快速折叠算法完成巡天的 90 %，发现 92 颗此前未知脉冲星和 8 颗等待确认的“class A”脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新发现的脉冲星通常只有在确认并开展后续计时之后才能获得有意义的科学成果；一年的初始计时是充分刻画新脉冲星、推导其脉冲星参数并探测可能源自发射不稳定性的异常行为所需的最短时间跨度。该计时项目还旨在测量真实的银道面脉冲星population以及银道面中脉冲星参数空间的边界。

Method: 这是一份 Parkes 观测时间申请，针对 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域重新处理中新发现的脉冲星开展计时campaign，观测列表上的脉冲星已在先前和当前 2021APRS 学期得到确认，后续计时将在 OCTS2021 进行。巡天重新处理使用了基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、模板库以及快速折叠算法流程，现已完成巡天的 90 %。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、计时时间跨度细节以及数据分析方法。

Result: 巡天重新处理已完成 90 %，并已发现 92 颗此前未知的脉冲星以及 8 颗等待确认的“class A”脉冲星。摘要指出，一年的初始计时是充分刻画新发现脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度，可用于推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等脉冲星参数，并探测可能由发射不稳定性导致的异常行为；观测列表上的脉冲星已在先前和当前 2021APRS 学期得到确认，OCTS2021 的后续计时预计将产生全新的结果。摘要未给出具体的计时测量结果或数值。

Conclusion: 作者认为，对新发现脉冲星开展后续计时campaign将产生全新的、令人兴奋的结果，并使项目能够测量真实的银道面脉冲星population以及银道面中脉冲星参数空间的边界；一年的初始计时是充分刻画新脉冲星、推导其脉冲星参数并探测可能由发射不稳定性导致的异常行为的必要条件。根据摘要无法判断这些结果对脉冲星单脉冲、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）研究的适用性。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the timing campaign of new pulsar discoveries from the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed 90 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search, template bank and fast folding algorithm pipelines, and now have discovered 92 previously unknown pulsars and 8 "class A" pulsars awaiting confirmation. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. Pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed in the previous and current 2021APRS semesters, the follow-up timing in OCTS2021 will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will allow us to measure the true Galactic plane pulsar population and the boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

</details>


### [3292] [Parkes observations for project P1050 semester 2021OCTS_18]()
*Sengar, Rahul,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Morello, Vincent,Bhandari, Shivani,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Wongphechauxsorn, Jompoj,Chen, Weiwei,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对新发现脉冲星而言，通常只有在其得到确认并开展后续计时campaign之后才能获得有意义的科学结果；一年的初始计时是充分刻画新发现脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度，否则无法推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等参数，也难以探测可能由发射不稳定性导致的异常行为。

Result: 重新处理 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银河系盘区数据后，已发现 92 颗此前未知的脉冲星以及 8 颗“class A”脉冲星等待确认；该巡天已完成 90 %；观测列表中的脉冲星已在此前和当前 2021APRS 学期得到确认。摘要称 OCTS2021 的后续计时将产生全新的结果，但未给出具体计时结果或数值。

Conclusion: 作者认为一年的初始计时对于充分刻画新发现脉冲星、推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等参数以及探测可能由发射不稳定性导致的异常行为是必不可少的；该计时项目还将使其能够测量真实的银河系盘脉冲星population以及银河系盘中脉冲星参数空间的边界。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射的具体联系。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the timing campaign of new pulsar discoveries from the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed 90 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search, template bank and fast folding algorithm pipelines, and now have discovered 92 previously unknown pulsars and 8 "class A" pulsars awaiting confirmation. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. Pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed in the previous and current 2021APRS semesters, the follow-up timing in OCTS2021 will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will allow us to measure the true Galactic plane pulsar population and the boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

</details>

Result: 摘要未说明本次计时观测已获得的观测结果；仅报告在已完成 90 % 的巡天中，已发现 92 颗此前未知的脉冲星和 8 颗等待确认的 “class A” 脉冲星，并预期 OCTS2021 的后续计时将产生全新的结果。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the timing campaign of new pulsar discoveries from the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. Pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed in the previous and current 2021APRS semesters, the follow-up timing in OCTS2021 will produce completely new and exciting results. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. Pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed in the previous and current 2021APRS semesters, the follow-up timing in OCTS2021 will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will allow us to measure the true Galactic plane pulsar population and the boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

</details>


### [3301] [Parkes observations for project P1172 semester 2022OCTS_07]()
*Mandow, Rami,Dawson, Joanne,Hobbs, George,Bhat, Ramesh,Shannon, Ryan,Zic, Andrew,Lower, Marcus,Gupta, Vivek,Kapur, Agastya,Marshman, Tommy*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: PSR J1713+0747 在 2021 年 4 月经历了一次与磁层变化相关的显著事件，表现为脉冲轮廓可观测变化，此后缓慢恢复；本提案拟利用 Parkes UWL 以每周 3 次、间隔 2 天的每日时间尺度高频次观测，追踪其轮廓、极化等性质恢复过程，以判断磁层是否回到原位形或进入新位形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1713+0747 因高 S/N、窄脉冲轮廓和长期观测历史，被全球脉冲星计时阵计划列为高优先级脉冲星。2021 年 4 月它经历了一次与磁层变化有关的显著事件，表现为脉冲轮廓的可观测变化，此后缓慢恢复。需要了解该恢复过程，以判断这种通常稳定的毫秒脉冲星磁层如何响应脉冲式状态变化，并证明其是否仍可作为引力波研究的可用时钟。

Method: 摘要提及拟对该脉冲星进行高观测频次观测，以每日时间尺度探测脉冲轮廓恢复，具体为每周 3 次、间隔 2 天，使用 Parkes UWL，旨在建立脉冲轮廓、极化及其他性质变化的详细时间分辨序列，并揭示额外的短时间尺度行为。摘要未说明观测的起止时间、总时长、具体频段或数据处理与统计分析方法的细节。

Result: 摘要报告：2021 年 4 月 PSR J1713+0747 经历了一次与其磁层变化有关的显著事件，表现为脉冲轮廓的可观测变化；此后该脉冲星一直在缓慢恢复。摘要称 Parkes UWL 可提供世界上其他望远镜无法获得的、指示磁层变化的额外短时间尺度行为，但未给出具体数值结果、时间尺度数值、统计显著性、极化或频谱测量值，也未报告恢复是否已完成。

Conclusion: 作者认为，理解该事件的恢复过程对于证明此类脉冲星仍是可用于引力波研究的可行时钟至关重要，并可提供关于这颗毫秒脉冲星通常稳定的磁层如何响应脉冲式状态变化的新数据；拟通过观测确定磁层是已恢复到原始位形，还是正在稳定到一个新的位形。这些解释基于所提观测计划尚未获得的结果，具体物理机制与可迁移性根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: PSR J1713+0747 is an extremely stable millisecond pulsar used in global pulsar timing array campaigns as a high priority pulsar because of its strong S/N, narrow profile and long-term observation history. In April 2021, the pulsar experienced a significant event related to a change in its magnetosphere, presented as an observable change in the pulsar's profile. Since then, the pulsar has been slowly recovering and we wish to observe it with high cadence to allow us to create a detailed time-resolved series of variations in the MSPs profile, polarisation, and other properties. Under this proposal, we wish to probe the profile recovery on daily timescales (3 times per week with 2 day intervals in between), revealing additional short timescale behaviours, indicative of changes in the magnetosphere which are not available to other telescopes in the world, thanks to the Parkes UWL. This will also allow us to determine if the magnetosphere has returned to its original configuration or is settling into a new one. Understanding the recovery of this event is key for demonstrating that such pulsars are still viable clocks for use in gravitational wave studies, and in turn, provide us with new data on how the normally stable magnetosphere of this millisecond pulsar responds to an impulsive change in state.

</details>

### [3303] [Parkes observations for project P1050 semester 2021OCTS_34]()
*Sengar, Rahul,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Morello, Vincent,Bhandari, Shivani,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Wongphechauxsorn, Jompoj,Chen, Weiwei,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面部分经重新处理后产生了新脉冲星发现，但摘要指出有趣的科学通常只有在新脉冲星得到确认并完成后续计时 campaña 之后才能获得；同时需要测量真实的银道面脉冲星族群及银道面中脉冲星参数空间的边界。

Result: 已发现 92 颗此前未知的脉冲星和 8 颗等待确认的“class A”脉冲星；巡天 90 % 已完成；观测列表上的脉冲星已在此前和当前的 2021APRS 学期中得到确认。摘要预期 OCTS2021 的后续计时将产生全新的结果，但未给出计时结果、参数数值或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，一年的初始计时是充分刻画新发现脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度，对推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等脉冲星参数以及探测可能由发射不稳定性导致的异常行为必不可少；该计时项目还将使其能够测量真实的银道面脉冲星族群以及银道面中脉冲星参数空间的边界。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴、单脉冲、模式转换或偏振等的具体联系。

Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. Pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed in the previous and current 2021APRS semesters, the follow-up timing in OCTS2021 will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will allow us to measure the true Galactic plane pulsar population and the boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测仪器、频率或频段、时间跨度细节和数据量。摘要说明该项目基于 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域的重处理，使用基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、模板库以及快速折叠算法流水线；观测列表上的脉冲星已在此前及当前的 2021APRS 学期获得确认，OCTS2021 将开展后续计时，并指出一年的初始计时是充分刻画新发现脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度。

Result: 目前已利用基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、模板库和快速折叠算法流水线完成巡天的 90 %，发现 92 颗此前未知的脉冲星以及 8 颗等待确认的“class A”脉冲星。观测列表上的脉冲星已在此前及当前的 2021APRS 学期获得确认；摘要未说明 OCTS2021 后续计时的具体结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，一年的初始计时是充分刻画任何新发现脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度，这对于推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等脉冲星参数以及探测可能由发射不稳定性导致的意外行为至关重要；OCTS2021 的后续计时将产生全新的、令人激动的结果，并使作者能够测量真实的银道面脉冲星种群以及银道面中脉冲星参数空间的边界。根据摘要无法判断这些结果与单脉冲、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）之间的具体联系。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the timing campaign of new pulsar discoveries from the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed 90 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search, template bank and fast folding algorithm pipelines, and now have discovered 92 previously unknown pulsars and 8 "class A" pulsars awaiting confirmation. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. Pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed in the previous and current 2021APRS semesters, the follow-up timing in OCTS2021 will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will allow us to measure the true Galactic plane pulsar population and the boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

</details>

### [3310] [Parkes observations for project P1172 semester 2022OCTS_02]()
*Mandow, Rami,Dawson, Joanne,Hobbs, George,Bhat, Ramesh,Shannon, Ryan,Zic, Andrew,Lower, Marcus,Gupta, Vivek,Kapur, Agastya,Marshman, Tommy*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: PSR J1713+0747 在 2021 年 4 月经历了一次与磁层变化相关的轮廓变化事件，此后缓慢恢复；本提案拟用 Parkes UWL 以每日时间尺度高采样率监测其轮廓、偏振等性质，以刻画恢复过程并检验其是否仍是可用于引力波研究的可行时钟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1713+0747 是一颗极其稳定的毫秒脉冲星，因其高 S/N、窄轮廓和长期观测历史而成为全球脉冲星计时阵列的高优先级目标。2021 年 4 月它与磁层变化相关的显著事件及随后的缓慢恢复，带来了需要以高采样率刻画恢复细节、确认磁层是否回到原位形或进入新位形，并检验该类脉冲星能否继续作为引力波研究时钟的问题。

Method: 摘要说明拟利用 Parkes UWL 对该脉冲星开展高采样率观测，探测其轮廓恢复，观测节奏为每周 3 次、中间间隔 2 天，以构建轮廓、偏振及其他性质变化的详细时间分辨序列。提案强调，该采样率可揭示其他望远镜无法获得的短时间尺度行为。摘要未说明具体观测频率范围、时间跨度、样本量、数据分析方法或显著性检验方法。

Result: 摘要报告：2021 年 4 月，PSR J1713+0747 经历了一次与磁层变化相关的显著事件，表现为脉冲星轮廓的可观测变化；此后该脉冲星一直在缓慢恢复。提案预期通过高采样率观测揭示额外的短时间尺度行为，这些行为指示磁层变化。摘要未给出轮廓变化的具体数值、偏振或谱测量结果、显著性水平，也未给出恢复过程已完成或未完成的确定结论。

Conclusion: 作者明确指出，理解这一事件的恢复过程对于证明此类脉冲星仍是可用于引力波研究的可行时钟至关重要，并可提供关于这颗毫秒脉冲星通常稳定的磁层如何响应状态的脉冲式变化的新数据。作者还希望确定磁层是否已恢复到原始位形，还是正在稳定到新的位形。摘要未给出该问题已得出的最终判定；至于其与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲发射等主题的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: PSR J1713+0747 is an extremely stable millisecond pulsar used in global pulsar timing array campaigns as a high priority pulsar because of its strong S/N, narrow profile and long-term observation history. In April 2021, the pulsar experienced a significant event related to a change in its magnetosphere, presented as an observable change in the pulsar's profile. Since then, the pulsar has been slowly recovering and we wish to observe it with high cadence to allow us to create a detailed time-resolved series of variations in the MSPs profile, polarisation, and other properties. Under this proposal, we wish to probe the profile recovery on daily timescales (3 times per week with 2 day intervals in between), revealing additional short timescale behaviours, indicative of changes in the magnetosphere which are not available to other telescopes in the world, thanks to the Parkes UWL. This will also allow us to determine if the magnetosphere has returned to its original configuration or is settling into a new one. Understanding the recovery of this event is key for demonstrating that such pulsars are still viable clocks for use in gravitational wave studies, and in turn, provide us with new data on how the normally stable magnetosphere of this millisecond pulsar responds to an impulsive change in state.

</details>

In April 2021, the pulsar experienced a significant event related to a change in its magnetosphere, presented as an observable change in the pulsar's profile. Since then, the pulsar has been slowly recovering and we wish to observe it with high cadence to allow us to create a detailed time-resolved series of variations in the MSPs profile, polarisation, and other properties. Under this proposal, we wish to probe the profile recovery on daily timescales (3 times per week with 2 day intervals in between), revealing additional short timescale behaviours, indicative of changes in the magnetosphere which are not available to other telescopes in the world, thanks to the Parkes UWL. This will also allow us to determine if the magnetosphere has returned to its original configuration or is settling into a new one. Understanding the recovery of this event is key for demonstrating that such pulsars are still viable clocks for use in gravitational wave studies, and in turn, provide us with new data on how the normally stable magnetosphere of this millisecond pulsar responds to an impulsive change in state.

</details>


### [3312] [Parkes observations for project P1172 semester 2022OCTS_04]()
*Mandow, Rami,Dawson, Joanne,Hobbs, George,Bhat, Ramesh,Shannon, Ryan,Zic, Andrew,Lower, Marcus,Gupta, Vivek,Kapur, Agastya,Marshman, Tommy*

TL;DR: PSR J1713+0747 在 2021 年 4 月经历了一次磁层变化事件，表现为脉冲轮廓变化，此后缓慢恢复；该提案拟用 Parkes UWL 以每周 3 次的节奏观测，追踪其轮廓恢复与短时间尺度行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1713+0747 因高 S/N、窄轮廓和长期观测历史而成为全球脉冲星计时阵列中的高优先级毫秒脉冲星。2021 年 4 月它出现了一次与磁层变化相关的显著事件，并自那以后缓慢恢复；需要弄清其磁层是否回到原构型，以及此类脉冲星是否仍可作为引力波研究中的可行时钟。

Method: 摘要说明拟对 PSR J1713+0747 开展高采样率观测，以构建其轮廓、极化及其他性质变化的时间分辨序列；观测节奏为每日时间尺度，即每周 3 次、每次间隔 2 天。观测使用 Parkes UWL。摘要未说明具体频段、时间跨度、数据分析方法或样本量。

Result: 摘要未给出已完成的观测结果。摘要报告：2021 年 4 月该脉冲星经历了一次与磁层变化相关的显著事件，表现为脉冲轮廓的可观测变化；此后该脉冲星一直缓慢恢复。其余内容为拟进行的观测目标，即探测每日时间尺度上的轮廓恢复、揭示额外的短时间尺度行为，并确定磁层是否恢复到原始构型或稳定到新构型。摘要未说明具体数值、显著性或时间跨度。

Conclusion: 作者认为，理解这次事件的恢复过程，对于证明此类脉冲星仍是可用于引力波研究的可行时钟至关重要，并可提供关于这颗毫秒脉冲星通常稳定的磁层如何响应脉冲式状态变化的新数据。对磁层已恢复原构型还是稳定到新构型的问题，摘要表述为拟通过观测确定，尚未给出结论。

Since then, the pulsar has been slowly recovering and we wish to observe it with high cadence to allow us to create a detailed time-resolved series of variations in the MSPs profile, polarisation, and other properties. Under this proposal, we wish to probe the profile recovery on daily timescales (3 times per week with 2 day intervals in between), revealing additional short timescale behaviours, indicative of changes in the magnetosphere which are not available to other telescopes in the world, thanks to the Parkes UWL. This will also allow us to determine if the magnetosphere has returned to its original configuration or is settling into a new one. Understanding the recovery of this event is key for demonstrating that such pulsars are still viable clocks for use in gravitational wave studies, and in turn, provide us with new data on how the normally stable magnetosphere of this millisecond pulsar responds to an impulsive change in state.

</details>

### [3314] [Parkes observations for project P1050 semester 2021OCTS_09]()
*Sengar, Rahul,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Morello, Vincent,Bhandari, Shivani,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Wongphechauxsorn, Jompoj,Chen, Weiwei,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请报告对 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面部分再处理已发现 92 颗此前未知脉冲星和 8 颗等待确认的“class A”脉冲星，并申请在 OCTS2021 对这些已确认脉冲星开展后续计时，以刻画其参数并测量银道面脉冲星种群及参数空间边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 再处理 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域已发现新脉冲星，但摘要指出，通常只有在新脉冲星得到确认并开展后续计时观测活动之后，才能从中得到有意义的科学结果；因此需要初始计时来刻画这些新发现脉冲星，并测量真实的银道面脉冲星种群及脉冲星参数空间边界。

Method: 摘要说明对 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域进行再处理，使用基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、模板库和快速折叠算法流水线，现已完成该巡天的 90 %。观测列表上的脉冲星已在先前和当前的 2021APRS 学期中得到确认，本申请为 OCTS2021 的后续计时观测；摘要提到一年的初始计时是充分刻画新发现脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度。具体望远镜、观测频率或频段、样本量及统计分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告已发现 92 颗此前未知的脉冲星和 8 颗等待确认的“class A”脉冲星；使用基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、模板库和快速折叠算法流水线已完成该巡天的 90 %；观测列表上的脉冲星已在先前和当前的 2021APRS 学期中得到确认。摘要预期 OCTS2021 的后续计时将产生全新的、令人兴奋的结果，并允许测量真实的银道面脉冲星种群及银道面中脉冲星参数空间的边界。摘要未给出具体观测结果、数值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，一年的初始计时是充分刻画新发现脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度，对于推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等脉冲星参数以及探测可能由发射不稳定性导致的意外行为必不可少；该计时项目还将使作者能够测量真实的银道面脉冲星种群以及银道面中脉冲星参数空间的边界。根据摘要无法判断这些预期结果的具体物理含义或可迁移性。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the timing campaign of new pulsar discoveries from the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed 90 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search, template bank and fast folding algorithm pipelines, and now have discovered 92 previously unknown pulsars and 8 "class A" pulsars awaiting confirmation. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. Pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed in the previous and current 2021APRS semesters, the follow-up timing in OCTS2021 will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will allow us to measure the true Galactic plane pulsar population and the boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者认为，一年的初始计时足以刻画新发现脉冲星并推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等参数，且可能探测到由发射不稳定性导致的意外行为；OCTS2021 的后续计时将产生全新结果。该计时项目还将用于测量真实的银河系平面脉冲星族群以及银河系平面中脉冲星参数空间的边界。根据摘要无法判断这些计时结果对单脉冲发射、模式转换、偏振或磁星与 FRB 联系的具体意义。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the timing campaign of new pulsar discoveries from the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed 90 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search, template bank and fast folding algorithm pipelines, and now have discovered 92 previously unknown pulsars and 8 "class A" pulsars awaiting confirmation. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. Pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed in the previous and current 2021APRS semesters, the follow-up timing in OCTS2021 will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will allow us to measure the true Galactic plane pulsar population and the boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

</details>

### [3319] [Parkes observations for project P1172 semester 2022OCTS_10]()
*Mandow, Rami,Dawson, Joanne,Hobbs, George,Bhat, Ramesh,Shannon, Ryan,Zic, Andrew,Lower, Marcus,Gupta, Vivek,Kapur, Agastya,Marshman, Tommy*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用 Parkes UWL 对毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1713+0747 进行高节奏观测，追踪其 2021 年 4 月磁层相关事件后轮廓的缓慢恢复，以判断磁层是回到原始构型还是稳定到新构型，并检验其作为引力波研究中计时时钟的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1713+0747 因高 S/N、窄轮廓和长期观测历史，被全球脉冲星计时阵列列为高优先级脉冲星。2021 年 4 月它发生与磁层变化相关的显著事件，表现为轮廓变化，此后缓慢恢复；需要理解该恢复过程以评估此类脉冲星是否仍可作为引力波研究的可行时钟，并了解其通常稳定的磁层如何响应脉冲式状态变化。

Method: 拟使用 Parkes UWL 对该脉冲星进行高节奏观测，以日尺度探测轮廓恢复：每周 3 次，间隔 2 天。目标是构建该毫秒脉冲星轮廓、偏振及其他性质变化的详细时间分辨序列，并揭示额外的短时标行为。摘要未说明具体观测频段、时间跨度、样本量或统计分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告，2021 年 4 月该脉冲星经历了一次与磁层变化相关的显著事件，表现为脉冲星轮廓的可观测变化；自那时起该脉冲星一直在缓慢恢复。摘要指出，拟议的高节奏观测将揭示指示磁层变化的额外短时标行为，且这些观测得益于 Parkes UWL 而为世界上其他望远镜所无法获得；摘要未给出轮廓、偏振或计时量的具体数值或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，理解这一事件的恢复过程对于证明此类脉冲星仍是可用于引力波研究的可行时钟至关重要，并将提供关于该毫秒脉冲星通常稳定的磁层如何响应脉冲式状态变化的新数据；该观测还可判定磁层是恢复到原始构型还是稳定到新构型。所提出的高节奏观测能否实现上述目标，取决于实际观测结果，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: PSR J1713+0747 is an extremely stable millisecond pulsar used in global pulsar timing array campaigns as a high priority pulsar because of its strong S/N, narrow profile and long-term observation history. In April 2021, the pulsar experienced a significant event related to a change in its magnetosphere, presented as an observable change in the pulsar's profile. Since then, the pulsar has been slowly recovering and we wish to observe it with high cadence to allow us to create a detailed time-resolved series of variations in the MSPs profile, polarisation, and other properties. Under this proposal, we wish to probe the profile recovery on daily timescales (3 times per week with 2 day intervals in between), revealing additional short timescale behaviours, indicative of changes in the magnetosphere which are not available to other telescopes in the world, thanks to the Parkes UWL. This will also allow us to determine if the magnetosphere has returned to its original configuration or is settling into a new one. Understanding the recovery of this event is key for demonstrating that such pulsars are still viable clocks for use in gravitational wave studies, and in turn, provide us with new data on how the normally stable magnetosphere of this millisecond pulsar responds to an impulsive change in state.

</details>

Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. Pulsars on the observing list here have been confirmed in the previous and current 2021APRS semesters, the follow-up timing in OCTS2021 will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will allow us to measure the true Galactic plane pulsar population and the boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

</details>

### [3327] [Parkes observations for project P1172 semester 2022OCTS_06]()
*Mandow, Rami,Dawson, Joanne,Hobbs, George,Bhat, Ramesh,Shannon, Ryan,Zic, Andrew,Lower, Marcus,Gupta, Vivek,Kapur, Agastya,Marshman, Tommy*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: PSR J1713+0747 在 2021 年 4 月经历了一次与磁层变化相关的轮廓变化事件，此后缓慢恢复；本提案拟借助 Parkes UWL 以每周 3 次的高采样率观测，追踪其轮廓、偏振等性质的逐日恢复过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1713+0747 是用于全球脉冲星计时阵列的高优先级毫秒脉冲星，具有高 S/N、窄轮廓和长期观测历史。2021 年 4 月它发生了与磁层变化有关的显著事件，表现为轮廓变化，此后缓慢恢复；需要理解该恢复过程，以判断其是否仍可作为引力波研究中的可行时钟。

Method: 摘要说明拟对 PSR J1713+0747 以高采样率观测，探测每日时间尺度上的轮廓恢复，具体为每周 3 次、中间间隔 2 天，使用 Parkes UWL。目标包括建立该 MSP 轮廓、偏振及其他性质变化的详细时间分辨序列，并揭示指示磁层变化的额外短时间尺度行为。观测频段、时间跨度、样本与统计分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 该脉冲星于 2021 年 4 月经历了一次与磁层变化有关的显著事件，表现为其轮廓的可观测变化；此后脉冲星一直在缓慢恢复。摘要未报告该事件或恢复过程的具体数值、显著性、偏振或频谱结果；关于磁层是否已恢复原始构型还是稳定到新构型，摘要表述为有待通过拟议观测确定。

Conclusion: 作者认为，理解这一事件的恢复对于证明此类脉冲星仍是可用于引力波研究的可行时钟至关重要，并可提供关于这颗毫秒脉冲星通常稳定的磁层如何响应脉冲式状态变化的新数据；拟议的每日时间尺度观测有望揭示其他望远镜无法获得的、指示磁层变化的短时间尺度行为。根据摘要无法判断该事件的具体物理机制或与其他脉冲星、磁星及快速射电暴（FRB）的关联。

Abstract: PSR J1713+0747 is an extremely stable millisecond pulsar used in global pulsar timing array campaigns as a high priority pulsar because of its strong S/N, narrow profile and long-term observation history. In April 2021, the pulsar experienced a significant event related to a change in its magnetosphere, presented as an observable change in the pulsar's profile. Since then, the pulsar has been slowly recovering and we wish to observe it with high cadence to allow us to create a detailed time-resolved series of variations in the MSPs profile, polarisation, and other properties. Under this proposal, we wish to probe the profile recovery on daily timescales (3 times per week with 2 day intervals in between), revealing additional short timescale behaviours, indicative of changes in the magnetosphere which are not available to other telescopes in the world, thanks to the Parkes UWL. This will also allow us to determine if the magnetosphere has returned to its original configuration or is settling into a new one. Understanding the recovery of this event is key for demonstrating that such pulsars are still viable clocks for use in gravitational wave studies, and in turn, provide us with new data on how the normally stable magnetosphere of this millisecond pulsar responds to an impulsive change in state.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新发现的脉冲星通常只有在确认并开展后随计时观测后才能获得有意义的科学成果，而一年的初步计时是充分刻画新脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度，可用于推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率并探测可能的发射不稳定性。该后随计时项目是识别HTRU银河系盘巡天中任何有趣脉冲星系统的必要条件。

Motivation: PSR~J1759-2402 是少数围绕大质量恒星运行的脉冲星之一，轨道周期 8.2 年且高度偏心，预期 2021 年 1 月经过近星点。Lovell 望远镜虽长期监测，但其受限带宽和缺乏偏振能力，不适合跟踪该脉冲星进入和离开伴星掩食的过程，因此需要具备宽带和偏振能力的观测手段。

Method: 摘要说明将使用 Parkes 上的 UWL，利用其宽带和优异偏振特性；请求对该脉冲星进行每周观测，以追踪其沿轨道的进程。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本、数据分析方法或统计方法。摘要提及可确定散射、偏振、色散量（dispersion measure）和旋转量（rotation measure）的变化。

Result: 这是观测申请性质的摘要，未报告新的观测结果。摘要仅陈述 PSR~J1759-2402 的轨道周期为 8.2 年、轨道高度偏心、预期近星点在 2021 年 1 月，以及计划使用 Parkes UWL 进行每周观测以追踪其进入伴星星风时的散射、偏振、色散量和旋转量变化。摘要未给出任何已测得的散射、偏振、色散量、旋转量数值或显著性结果。

Conclusion: 作者明确主张，Parkes 上的 UWL 因具有宽带和优异偏振特性，能够确定该脉冲星进入伴星星风时散射、偏振、色散量（dispersion measure）和旋转量（rotation measure）的变化，因此请求每周观测以追踪其轨道进程。根据摘要无法判断这些测量将揭示的具体物理机制，也无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲发射等主题的联系。

Abstract: PSR~J1759-2402 is one of a small handful of pulsars which are in orbit about high mass stars. Its orbital period is 8.2 years and the orbit is highly eccentric with periastron expected in 2021 January. Although discovered at Parkes, the Lovell telescope has been monitoring the pulsar over many years. However, it's restricted bandwidth and lack of polarization capability make it unsuitable to follow the pulsar as it enters and leaves the eclipse by the companion. In contrast, the UWL on Parkes with its wide-band and excellent polarization characteristics means that we can determine scattering, polarization, dispersion measure and rotation measure changes as the pulsar enters its companion wind. We request weekly observations of the pulsar to track its progress around the orbit.

</details>

### [3340] [Parkes observations for project P1080 semester 2020OCTS_04]()
*Bhat, Ramesh,McSweeney, Samuel James,Swainston, Nicholas,Smith, Keegan,Sokolowski, Marcin*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟利用Parkes对MWA新发现的一颗脉冲星进行计时观测，以期加速确定其自转与天体测量参数，并通过低频超宽带流量密度、谱指数和偏振测量研究其低光度与发射特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MWA新发现了一颗脉冲星，其位置已以&lt;1角分精度确定，这为加速求得计时解并确定自转与天体测量参数提供了机会。该源估计光度约~0.1 mJy kpc^2（1.4 GHz），可能属于目前仅知少数几颗的低光度脉冲星，需要进一步观测加以研究。

Method: 摘要说明将开展计时观测，并使用超宽带低频接收机测量流量密度和谱指数，同时对新脉冲星进行偏振分析；观测依托Parkes，源由MWA发现，位置精度为&lt;1角分。样本仅为一颗新脉冲星。观测时长、具体频段、时间跨度及统计方法等：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未给出观测结果，仅报告该新脉冲星由MWA发现、位置已确定到&lt;1角分精度，1.4 GHz处估计光度约为~0.1 mJy kpc^2，并指出其可能是一颗低光度脉冲星。提议的计时、流量密度、谱指数和偏振观测旨在确定自转与天体测量参数并约束其几何结构和发射特性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，凭借已确定的位置可加速该脉冲星计时解的收敛并确定其自转与天体测量参数；若其确为低光度脉冲星，则属于目前已知仅有少数几颗的类别，低频超宽带流量密度与谱指数测量以及偏振分析将有助于进一步研究其低光度性质和发射特性。根据摘要无法判断该源与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲/模式转换等现象的联系。

Abstract: We propose timing observations of a new pulsar discovered with the MWA. Thanks to the interferometric advantages of the MWA and the unique design of our survey we were able to determine the pulsar's position to &lt;1 arcminute precision, thereby providing an opportunity for accelerated convergence of its timing solution and determine its spin and astrometric parameters. With an estimated luminosity ~0.1 mJy kpc^2 at 1.4 GHz, this may turn out to be a low-luminosity pulsar, of which only a handful are currently known. Observations with the ultra-wide band low-frequency receiver will help us further investigate this in detail through measurements flux densities and spectral index. We will also undertake polarimetric analysis of the new pulsar to better constrain the pulsar's geometry and emission properties.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MWA 新发现的这颗脉冲星已具备 &lt;1 角分的位置精度，但尚需计时观测以确定自旋与天体测量参数；其 1.4 GHz 估计光度约为 ~0.1 mJy kpc^2，可能属于目前已知仅少数几颗的低光度脉冲星，因此有必要进一步测量流量密度和谱指数并约束其几何与发射特性。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测时长与数据量。所述计划包括：对 MWA 新发现的脉冲星进行计时观测，以加速计时解收敛并确定自旋和天体测量参数；利用 MWA 的干涉测量优势及巡天独特设计将位置确定到 &lt;1 角分；使用超宽带低频接收机测量流量密度和谱指数；并开展偏振分析以约束脉冲星几何和发射特性。

Result: 摘要未报告已完成观测的结果，仅给出提案设想与已有基础：MWA 发现的这颗脉冲星位置已确定到 &lt;1 角分精度；其在 1.4 GHz 的估计光度约为 ~0.1 mJy kpc^2；因此该源可能是一颗低光度脉冲星，而目前已知的此类脉冲星仅有少数几颗。摘要未说明计时解、自旋参数、天体测量参数、流量密度、谱指数或偏振测量的具体数值。

Conclusion: 作者认为，借助 MWA 干涉测量和巡天设计带来的 &lt;1 角分定位，计时观测有望加速计时解收敛并确定自旋与天体测量参数；约 ~0.1 mJy kpc^2（1.4 GHz）的估计光度提示该源可能是一颗低光度脉冲星；超宽带低频接收机的流量密度与谱指数测量以及偏振分析将有助于进一步检验这一可能并约束其几何与发射特性。根据摘要无法判断该源与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲发射等具体现象的联系。

Abstract: We propose timing observations of a new pulsar discovered with the MWA. Thanks to the interferometric advantages of the MWA and the unique design of our survey we were able to determine the pulsar's position to &lt;1 arcminute precision, thereby providing an opportunity for accelerated convergence of its timing solution and determine its spin and astrometric parameters. With an estimated luminosity ~0.1 mJy kpc^2 at 1.4 GHz, this may turn out to be a low-luminosity pulsar, of which only a handful are currently known. Observations with the ultra-wide band low-frequency receiver will help us further investigate this in detail through measurements flux densities and spectral index. We will also undertake polarimetric analysis of the new pulsar to better constrain the pulsar's geometry and emission properties.

</details>


### [3342] [Parkes observations for project P1038 semester 2020APRS_09]()
*Stappers, Benjamin,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Lyne, Andrew,Bailes, Matthew,Keith, Michael,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案申请用 Parkes 的 UWL 对处于 8.2 年高偏心轨道、预计 2021 年 1 月过近星点的脉冲星 PSR~J1759-2402 进行每周观测，以在其进入伴星风期间确定散射、偏振、色散量和旋转量的变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR~J1759-2402 是少数围绕大质量恒星运行的脉冲星之一，轨道周期 8.2 年、高度偏心，预计 2021 年 1 月到达近星点。既有 Lovell 望远镜监测受限于带宽且缺乏偏振能力，不适合跟踪其进入和离开伴星遮挡的过程，因此需要具备宽带与偏振能力的观测来研究其进入伴星风的阶段。

Method: 摘要说明申请使用 Parkes 上的 UWL 对该脉冲星进行每周观测，以跟踪其绕轨运行进程；UWL 具有宽带和优异的偏振特性，可用于确定散射、偏振、色散量和旋转量的变化。摘要未说明具体观测频段、时间跨度、样本量或分析方法的进一步细节。

Result: 摘要为观测申请，未报告观测结果。摘要未说明散射、偏振、色散量或旋转量的任何实测变化或数值；也未说明该脉冲星进入或离开伴星遮挡的实际观测情况。摘要仅说明该脉冲星轨道周期为 8.2 年、轨道高度偏心、预计 2021 年 1 月到达近星点，以及其是在 Parkes 发现、Lovell 望远镜已监测多年。

Conclusion: 摘要提出的科学目的是借助 Parkes UWL 的宽带与偏振能力，在 PSR~J1759-2402 进入伴星风期间确定散射、偏振、色散量和旋转量的变化，并通过每周观测跟踪其绕轨运行进程。摘要未给出已完成的观测结论或物理机制解释；根据摘要无法判断其结果对脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴研究的可迁移性。

Abstract: PSR~J1759-2402 is one of a small handful of pulsars which are in orbit about high mass stars. Its orbital period is 8.2 years and the orbit is highly eccentric with periastron expected in 2021 January. Although discovered at Parkes, the Lovell telescope has been monitoring the pulsar over many years. However, it's restricted bandwidth and lack of polarization capability make it unsuitable to follow the pulsar as it enters and leaves the eclipse by the companion. In contrast, the UWL on Parkes with its wide-band and excellent polarization characteristics means that we can determine scattering, polarization, dispersion measure and rotation measure changes as the pulsar enters its companion wind. We request weekly observations of the pulsar to track its progress around the orbit.

</details>

Motivation: PSR~J1759-2402 是少数围绕大质量恒星运行的脉冲星之一，其 8.2 年高度偏心轨道预计于 2021 年 1 月过近星点。Lovell 望远镜虽长期监测该脉冲星，但带宽受限且缺乏偏振能力，不适合跟踪其进入和离开食（eclipse）的过程；因此需要具备宽带和优异偏振能力的观测手段来研究伴星风中的变化。

Method: 摘要说明拟使用 Parkes 上的 UWL，利用其宽带和优异偏振特性，确定该脉冲星进入伴星风时散射、偏振、色散量和旋转量的变化；并请求对该脉冲星进行每周观测，以追踪其沿轨道的进展。摘要未说明具体频段、观测时间跨度、样本量或分析统计方法。

Result: 摘要未说明。该摘要为观测申请性质，未报告已获得的观测结果、数值、趋势、相关性或统计显著性；仅说明 PSR~J1759-2402 的轨道周期为 8.2 年、轨道高度偏心、预计 2021 年 1 月过近星点，以及 Lovell 望远镜已多年监测该脉冲星。

Conclusion: 摘要提出可利用 Parkes 的 UWL 宽带和偏振能力，在该脉冲星进入伴星风时确定散射、偏振、DM 和 RM 的变化，并请求每周观测以追踪其轨道进展。摘要未给出已完成的物理结论；这些观测是否能够实现上述目标，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: PSR~J1759-2402 is one of a small handful of pulsars which are in orbit about high mass stars. Its orbital period is 8.2 years and the orbit is highly eccentric with periastron expected in 2021 January. Although discovered at Parkes, the Lovell telescope has been monitoring the pulsar over many years. However, it's restricted bandwidth and lack of polarization capability make it unsuitable to follow the pulsar as it enters and leaves the eclipse by the companion. In contrast, the UWL on Parkes with its wide-band and excellent polarization characteristics means that we can determine scattering, polarization, dispersion measure and rotation measure changes as the pulsar enters its companion wind. We request weekly observations of the pulsar to track its progress around the orbit.

</details>


### [3349] [Parkes observations for project P1080 semester 2020OCTS_07]()
*Bhat, Ramesh,McSweeney, Samuel James,Swainston, Nicholas,Smith, Keegan,Sokolowski, Marcin*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划用 Parkes 对一颗由 MWA 新发现的脉冲星开展计时观测，其位置已由 MWA 巡天确定到 &lt;1 角分精度，目标包括确定自旋与天体测量参数，并测量流量密度、谱指数和偏振性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MWA 巡天以干涉测量优势实现了 &lt;1 角分的位置精度，为新发现脉冲星的计时解加速收敛及自旋、天体测量参数测定提供了机会。该脉冲星在 1.4 GHz 处估计光度约为 ~0.1 mJy kpc^2，可能属于目前仅已知少数几颗的低光度脉冲星，因此有必要进一步观测其辐射与几何性质。

Method: 摘要说明将开展计时观测，并使用超宽带低频接收机观测以测量流量密度和谱指数，还将进行偏振分析以约束脉冲星几何结构与发射特性。摘要提及 MWA 巡天确定位置到 &lt;1 角分精度，1.4 GHz 处估计光度约为 ~0.1 mJy kpc^2。观测时间跨度、样本规模及具体分析流程等摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告该脉冲星由 MWA 巡天发现，并借助干涉测量优势与巡天设计将位置确定到 &lt;1 角分精度；在 1.4 GHz 处对其光度的估计约为 ~0.1 mJy kpc^2，因此该源可能是低光度脉冲星，而目前已知的此类脉冲星仅有少数几颗。摘要未说明计时、流量密度、谱指数或偏振分析的已获得结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为该源可能是一颗低光度脉冲星，需通过超宽带低频接收机测量流量密度与谱指数来进一步研究，并通过偏振分析更好地限制其几何结构与发射特性；加速收敛的计时解有望确定其自旋与天体测量参数。这些尚属拟议观测目标，而非已确立结果；与磁星、快速射电暴、单脉冲发射或模式转换的关系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose timing observations of a new pulsar discovered with the MWA. Thanks to the interferometric advantages of the MWA and the unique design of our survey we were able to determine the pulsar's position to &lt;1 arcminute precision, thereby providing an opportunity for accelerated convergence of its timing solution and determine its spin and astrometric parameters. With an estimated luminosity ~0.1 mJy kpc^2 at 1.4 GHz, this may turn out to be a low-luminosity pulsar, of which only a handful are currently known. Observations with the ultra-wide band low-frequency receiver will help us further investigate this in detail through measurements flux densities and spectral index. We will also undertake polarimetric analysis of the new pulsar to better constrain the pulsar's geometry and emission properties.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者提出，Parkes 的 UWL 因其宽带和优异偏振特性，可用于确定 PSR~J1759-2402 进入伴星风时散射、偏振、色散量和旋转量的变化，因此请求每周观测以跟踪其轨道进程。根据摘要无法判断这些观测是否实际执行、是否探测到变化，或该脉冲星与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）等现象之间是否存在联系。

Abstract: PSR~J1759-2402 is one of a small handful of pulsars which are in orbit about high mass stars. Its orbital period is 8.2 years and the orbit is highly eccentric with periastron expected in 2021 January. Although discovered at Parkes, the Lovell telescope has been monitoring the pulsar over many years. However, it's restricted bandwidth and lack of polarization capability make it unsuitable to follow the pulsar as it enters and leaves the eclipse by the companion. In contrast, the UWL on Parkes with its wide-band and excellent polarization characteristics means that we can determine scattering, polarization, dispersion measure and rotation measure changes as the pulsar enters its companion wind. We request weekly observations of the pulsar to track its progress around the orbit.

Result: 摘要为观测申请，未报告已获得的观测结果。摘要说明了该脉冲星的轨道周期为 8.2 年、轨道高度偏心、预计 2021 年 1 月到达近星点，以及 Lovell 望远镜已对其监测多年。所请求的观测旨在确定散射、偏振、色散量和旋转量在脉冲星进入伴星风时的变化，但尚未给出这些量的测量结果或显著性。摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为 Parkes 上的 UWL 具有宽带和优异的偏振特性，因而能够确定该脉冲星进入伴星风时散射、偏振、色散量和旋转量的变化，而 Lovell 望远镜因带宽受限且缺乏偏振能力而不适合跟踪食的进入和离开过程。因此请求每周观测以跟踪其沿轨道的运行。根据摘要无法判断该工作对脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）相关物理的可迁移性。

Abstract: PSR~J1759-2402 is one of a small handful of pulsars which are in orbit about high mass stars. Its orbital period is 8.2 years and the orbit is highly eccentric with periastron expected in 2021 January. Although discovered at Parkes, the Lovell telescope has been monitoring the pulsar over many years. However, it's restricted bandwidth and lack of polarization capability make it unsuitable to follow the pulsar as it enters and leaves the eclipse by the companion. In contrast, the UWL on Parkes with its wide-band and excellent polarization characteristics means that we can determine scattering, polarization, dispersion measure and rotation measure changes as the pulsar enters its companion wind. We request weekly observations of the pulsar to track its progress around the orbit.

</details>

### [3357] [Parkes observations for project P1080 semester 2020OCTS_03]()
*Bhat, Ramesh,McSweeney, Samuel James,Swainston, Nicholas,Smith, Keegan,Sokolowski, Marcin*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟用 Parkes 对一颗由 MWA 新发现、位置精度达 &lt;1 arcminute 的脉冲星开展计时观测，以确定其自转和天体测量参数；该脉冲星在 1.4 GHz 的估计光度约为 ~0.1 mJy kpc^2，可能属于目前已知仅少数几颗的低光度脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MWA 新发现的这颗脉冲星可能是一颗低光度脉冲星（1.4 GHz 估计光度约 ~0.1 mJy kpc^2），而目前已知的低光度脉冲星仅有少数几颗，因此值得进一步研究其自转、天体测量参数、流量密度、谱指数、几何结构与发射特性。摘要未说明更具体的知识空白。

Method: 拟开展计时观测；摘要提及 MWA 的干涉测量优势和巡天项目设计，使脉冲星位置被确定到 &lt;1 arcminute 精度，从而有望加速计时解收敛。观测将使用超宽带低频接收机测量流量密度和谱指数，并开展偏振分析。摘要未说明观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本量和具体分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告：MWA 新发现了一颗脉冲星；凭借 MWA 的干涉测量优势和巡天项目设计，其位置被确定到 &lt;1 arcminute 精度；该脉冲星在 1.4 GHz 的估计光度约为 ~0.1 mJy kpc^2，因此可能是一颗低光度脉冲星，而目前已知的此类脉冲星仅有少数几颗。摘要未说明时序、偏振、流量密度或谱指数的实测结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出，借助高精度位置可加速计时解收敛并确定该脉冲星的自转和天体测量参数；使用超宽带低频接收机测量流量密度和谱指数将有助于进一步研究其可能的低光度性质；偏振分析将更好地限制其几何结构和发射特性。该脉冲星是否确为低光度脉冲星，以及其对脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴研究的更广泛意义，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose timing observations of a new pulsar discovered with the MWA. Thanks to the interferometric advantages of the MWA and the unique design of our survey we were able to determine the pulsar's position to &lt;1 arcminute precision, thereby providing an opportunity for accelerated convergence of its timing solution and determine its spin and astrometric parameters. With an estimated luminosity ~0.1 mJy kpc^2 at 1.4 GHz, this may turn out to be a low-luminosity pulsar, of which only a handful are currently known. Observations with the ultra-wide band low-frequency receiver will help us further investigate this in detail through measurements flux densities and spectral index. We will also undertake polarimetric analysis of the new pulsar to better constrain the pulsar's geometry and emission properties.

</details>

*Bhat, Ramesh,McSweeney, Samuel James,Swainston, Nicholas,Smith, Keegan,Sokolowski, Marcin*

Motivation: PSR~J1759-2402 是少数围绕大质量恒星运行的脉冲星之一，其 8.2 年高度偏心轨道的近星点预计在 2021 年 1 月。Lovell 望远镜虽长期监测该脉冲星，但受限于带宽且缺乏偏振能力，不适合跟踪其进入和离开伴星掩食的过程，因此需要具备宽带和优异偏振能力的观测手段。

Method: 使用 Parkes 上的 UWL，利用其宽带和优异的偏振特性，并请求每周观测该脉冲星，以跟踪其沿轨道的进展；目标是确定脉冲星进入伴星风时的散射、偏振、色散量和旋转量变化。摘要未说明具体观测频段、时间跨度、样本量或统计分析方法。

Result: 摘要为观测申请性质，未报告观测结果或数据分析结果。摘要仅说明 PSR~J1759-2402 的轨道周期为 8.2 年、轨道高度偏心、近星点预计于 2021 年 1 月，并指出 Lovell 望远镜受限于带宽且缺乏偏振能力；未给出散射、偏振、色散量或旋转量的测量值或变化趋势。

Conclusion: 摘要未给出已由观测支持的科学结论，仅提出通过 Parkes UWL 的每周观测，能够在脉冲星进入伴星风时确定散射、偏振、色散量和旋转量的变化。是否可用于脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化或磁星—快速射电暴（FRB）联系等相关课题，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: PSR~J1759-2402 is one of a small handful of pulsars which are in orbit about high mass stars. Its orbital period is 8.2 years and the orbit is highly eccentric with periastron expected in 2021 January. Although discovered at Parkes, the Lovell telescope has been monitoring the pulsar over many years. However, it's restricted bandwidth and lack of polarization capability make it unsuitable to follow the pulsar as it enters and leaves the eclipse by the companion. In contrast, the UWL on Parkes with its wide-band and excellent polarization characteristics means that we can determine scattering, polarization, dispersion measure and rotation measure changes as the pulsar enters its companion wind. We request weekly observations of the pulsar to track its progress around the orbit.

</details>

### [3364] [Parkes observations for project P1229 semester 2023OCTS_09]()
*Kerr, Matthew,Camilo, Fernando,Ransom, Scott,Ray, Paul,Clark, Colin James,Nieder, Lars,Smith, David*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该观测计划拟通过密集初始观测结合间隔递增观测的自举式计时策略，为先前在 Fermi 伽马射线源搜索中发现的三颗毫秒脉冲星建立计时解，以探测预期中的伽马射线脉冲，并可能将它们纳入伽马射线脉冲星计时阵列以提高对低频引力波的灵敏度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前针对 Fermi 伽马射线源的脉冲星搜索发现了三颗毫秒脉冲星，但尽管有最初的后续跟踪努力，仍无法得到脉冲星计时解，因而无法探测预期中的伽马射线脉冲。作者希望解决这一知识缺口，从而检验射电与伽马射线发射机制、搜寻多波段对应体，并扩展伽马射线脉冲星计时阵列。

Method: 摘要说明拟议计划为针对三颗毫秒脉冲星开展的脉冲星计时（timing）观测活动。该计划将一组密集的初始观测与间隔逐渐增大的附加观测相结合，采用一种自举（bootstrap）方法，通常能够成功约束脉冲星计时解的所有基本参数。标题提及 Parkes 观测与项目 P1229 学期 2023OCTS_09。观测频段、时间跨度、具体仪器设置、数据分析细节及样本之外的信息：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告的是拟议的观测计划，而非已完成的科学结果。摘要指出，先前对 Fermi 伽马射线源搜索中发现的三颗毫秒脉冲星的后续跟踪努力未能产生可用于探测预期伽马射线脉冲的脉冲星计时解；拟议的密集初始观测加间隔递增观测相结合的自举方法，一般能够成功约束脉冲星计时解的所有基本参数。摘要未给出具体计时参数数值、探测显著性、脉冲轮廓、偏振或频谱结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，获得伽马射线脉冲将使得能够探究射电与伽马射线发射机制，并搜寻多波段对应体；更重要的是，它将使这些脉冲星能够被纳入伽马射线脉冲星计时阵列，提供额外基线，从而提高其对低频引力波的灵敏度。这些均属摘要明确表述的目标与预期意义；是否实际成功得到计时解及伽马射线脉冲，根据摘要无法判断。与脉冲星计时方法学相关，但摘要未涉及单脉冲、模式转换、自旋下降力矩变化、快速射电暴或磁星—FRB 联系。

Abstract: We propose a pulsar timing campaign of three millisecond pulsars discovered in previous pulsar searches of Fermi gamma-ray sources. Despite an original follow-up effort, it was not possible to produce a pulsar timing solution with which to detect the expected gamma-ray pulsations. The proposed campaign combines a set of dense, initial observations with additional observations at increasing separation, a bootstrap approach which is generally successful at constraining all the fundamental parameters of the pulsar timing solution. Securing the gamma-ray pulsations will enable probes of the radio and gamma-ray emission mechanisms and searches for multi-wavelength counterparts. And perhaps more importantly, it will allow these pulsars to be incorporated into the gamma-ray pulsar timing array, providing additional baselines which will increase its sensitivity to low-frequency gravitational waves.

</details>

Conclusion: 摘要提出的结论是：获得伽马射线脉冲将使得能够探测射电与伽马射线发射机制，并搜寻多波段对应体；更重要的是，它可使这些脉冲星被纳入伽马射线脉冲星计时阵列，提供额外基线以提高其对低频引力波的灵敏度。这些均为该计划预期可实现的目标，而非已确立的观测结果。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴、单脉冲发射、模式转换或偏振的具体联系。

Abstract: We propose a pulsar timing campaign of three millisecond pulsars discovered in previous pulsar searches of Fermi gamma-ray sources. Despite an original follow-up effort, it was not possible to produce a pulsar timing solution with which to detect the expected gamma-ray pulsations. The proposed campaign combines a set of dense, initial observations with additional observations at increasing separation, a bootstrap approach which is generally successful at constraining all the fundamental parameters of the pulsar timing solution. Securing the gamma-ray pulsations will enable probes of the radio and gamma-ray emission mechanisms and searches for multi-wavelength counterparts. And perhaps more importantly, it will allow these pulsars to be incorporated into the gamma-ray pulsar timing array, providing additional baselines which will increase its sensitivity to low-frequency gravitational waves.

</details>

Motivation: 此前对 Fermi 伽马射线源的脉冲星搜寻发现了三颗毫秒脉冲星，但尽管进行了最初的后续观测，仍未能得到脉冲星计时解，因此无法探测到预期的伽马射线脉冲。需要新的计时观测活动来约束计时解并实现伽马射线脉冲探测。

Method: 提出一项脉冲星计时观测活动，目标为三颗此前在 Fermi 伽马射线源脉冲星搜寻中发现的毫秒脉冲星。该活动将一组密集的初始观测与间隔逐渐增加的附加观测相结合，采用一种通常能够成功约束脉冲星计时解所有基本参数的自举方法。摘要未说明所用望远镜或仪器、观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本量以及具体分析细节。

Conclusion: 作者认为，获得伽马射线脉冲将使得能够探究射电与伽马射线发射机制，并搜寻多波段对应体；或许更重要的是，这将使这些脉冲星能够被纳入伽马射线脉冲星计时阵列，提供额外基线，从而提高其对低频引力波的灵敏度。根据摘要无法判断该计时活动对脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴相关物理的可迁移性。

Abstract: We propose a pulsar timing campaign of three millisecond pulsars discovered in previous pulsar searches of Fermi gamma-ray sources. Despite an original follow-up effort, it was not possible to produce a pulsar timing solution with which to detect the expected gamma-ray pulsations. The proposed campaign combines a set of dense, initial observations with additional observations at increasing separation, a bootstrap approach which is generally successful at constraining all the fundamental parameters of the pulsar timing solution. Securing the gamma-ray pulsations will enable probes of the radio and gamma-ray emission mechanisms and searches for multi-wavelength counterparts. And perhaps more importantly, it will allow these pulsars to be incorporated into the gamma-ray pulsar timing array, providing additional baselines which will increase its sensitivity to low-frequency gravitational waves.

</details>

Method: 摘要说明拟对三颗毫秒脉冲星开展脉冲星计时观测计划，将一组密集的初始观测与间隔逐渐增大的额外观测相结合，采用自举（bootstrap）方法。摘要未说明望远镜或仪器名称、观测频率或波段、观测时间跨度、具体数据量以及统计分析细节。

Result: 摘要报告称，尽管此前已进行后续观测努力，但仍未能产生可用于探测预期伽马射线脉冲的脉冲星计时解。摘要提出，所拟观测计划采用密集初始观测加间隔逐渐增大的观测方式，通常能够成功约束脉冲星计时解的所有基本参数。摘要未给出已获得的计时结果、脉冲轮廓、偏振、色散量或数值显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，所提出的脉冲星计时计划有望获得伽马射线脉冲，从而能够探究射电和伽马射线辐射机制并搜寻多波段对应体；作者还表示，或许更重要的是，这将使这些脉冲星被纳入伽马射线脉冲星计时阵，提供额外基线并提高其对低频引力波的灵敏度。根据摘要无法判断该计划对脉冲星单脉冲、模式转换、脉冲轮廓演化、偏振、自旋下降力矩变化或磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）联系的直接相关性。

Abstract: We propose a pulsar timing campaign of three millisecond pulsars discovered in previous pulsar searches of Fermi gamma-ray sources. Despite an original follow-up effort, it was not possible to produce a pulsar timing solution with which to detect the expected gamma-ray pulsations. The proposed campaign combines a set of dense, initial observations with additional observations at increasing separation, a bootstrap approach which is generally successful at constraining all the fundamental parameters of the pulsar timing solution. Securing the gamma-ray pulsations will enable probes of the radio and gamma-ray emission mechanisms and searches for multi-wavelength counterparts. And perhaps more importantly, it will allow these pulsars to be incorporated into the gamma-ray pulsar timing array, providing additional baselines which will increase its sensitivity to low-frequency gravitational waves.

</details>

TL;DR: 该计划拟通过密集初始观测结合间隔逐渐增大的后续观测，为先前在 Fermi 伽马射线源搜索中发现的三颗毫秒脉冲星建立计时解，以探测预期的伽马射线脉冲，并将其纳入伽马射线脉冲星计时阵列以提高对低频引力波的灵敏度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前在 Fermi 伽马射线源脉冲星搜索中发现的三颗毫秒脉冲星，虽经初步后续跟踪，仍无法获得足以探测预期伽马射线脉冲的计时解，因此需要新的计时观测计划以约束其计时解基本参数。

Method: 摘要未说明。摘要未给出具体望远镜或仪器、观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本量或数据分析方法；仅说明这是一项脉冲星计时观测计划，采用一组密集的初始观测与间隔逐渐增大的附加观测相结合的自举（bootstrap）式方法。

Result: 摘要未说明。摘要未报告任何已获得的计时解、脉冲轮廓、偏振、色散量（DM）、旋转量（RM）、通量或显著性结果；仅指出尽管此前已进行初步后续工作，仍无法得到脉冲星计时解，因而未能探测到预期的伽马射线脉冲。

Conclusion: 作者认为，通过该计时计划获得伽马射线脉冲，将可探究射电与伽马射线辐射机制并搜寻多波段对应体；更重要的是，可使这些脉冲星纳入伽马射线脉冲星计时阵列，提供额外基线以提高其对低频引力波的灵敏度。上述为拟议目标而非已实现结果。根据摘要无法判断该计划与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、单脉冲发射或模式转换之间的具体联系。

Abstract: We propose a pulsar timing campaign of three millisecond pulsars discovered in previous pulsar searches of Fermi gamma-ray sources. Despite an original follow-up effort, it was not possible to produce a pulsar timing solution with which to detect the expected gamma-ray pulsations. The proposed campaign combines a set of dense, initial observations with additional observations at increasing separation, a bootstrap approach which is generally successful at constraining all the fundamental parameters of the pulsar timing solution. Securing the gamma-ray pulsations will enable probes of the radio and gamma-ray emission mechanisms and searches for multi-wavelength counterparts. And perhaps more importantly, it will allow these pulsars to be incorporated into the gamma-ray pulsar timing array, providing additional baselines which will increase its sensitivity to low-frequency gravitational waves.

</details>

### [3386] [Parkes observations for project P1038 semester 2020OCTS_04]()
*Stappers, Benjamin,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Lyne, Andrew,Bailes, Matthew,Keith, Michael,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请请求继续对高度偏心轨道脉冲星 PSR~J1759-2402 进行每周 Parkes/UWL 观测，以跟踪其在 2021 年 3 月近星点前后进入伴星星风时的变化，并测量散射、偏振、DM 与 RM 的变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR~J1759-2402 是少数围绕大质量恒星运行的脉冲星之一，轨道周期 8.3 年、轨道高度偏心，预计 2021 年 3 月经过近星点。既有 Lovell 监测受限于带宽、维护安排与偏振能力，不适合跟踪其进入和离开食的过程，因此需要具备宽带与优异偏振能力的观测手段。

Method: 摘要说明请求继续对该脉冲星开展每周观测，以跟踪其沿轨道的进展；使用 Parkes 的 UWL，因其具有宽带和优异的偏振特性。摘要未说明具体观测频段、时间跨度、数据分析流程或统计方法。观测目标是在脉冲星进入伴星星风时确定散射、偏振、色散量（DM）和旋转测度（RM）的变化。

Result: 摘要未说明实际观测结果。文中仅陈述 PSR~J1759-2402 是少数围绕大质量恒星运行的脉冲星之一，轨道周期为 8.3 年，轨道高度偏心，预计 2021 年 3 月经过近星点；该脉冲星在 Parkes 被发现，Lovell 望远镜多年来一直在监测它，但其受限带宽、维护安排和较差偏振能力不适合跟踪进入和离开食的过程。

Conclusion: 作者主张，凭借 Parkes 上 UWL 的宽带和优异偏振特性，可确定该脉冲星进入伴星星风时散射、偏振、DM 和 RM 的变化，因此请求继续每周观测以跟踪其轨道进程。该结论属于观测申请的目标性陈述，尚无摘要给出的实际测量结果支持；与快速射电暴（FRB）、磁星或单脉冲发射的直接联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: PSR~J1759-2402 is one of a small handful of pulsars which are in orbit about high mass stars. Its orbital period is 8.3 years and the orbit is highly eccentric with periastron expected in 2021 March. Although discovered at Parkes, the Lovell telescope has been monitoring the pulsar over many years. However, it's restricted bandwidth, maintenance schedule and poorer polarization capability make it unsuitable to follow the pulsar as it enters and leaves the eclipse by the companion. In contrast, the UWL on Parkes with its wide- band and excellent polarization characteristics means that we can determine scattering, polarization, dispersion measure and rotation measure changes as the pulsar enters its companion wind. We request a continuation of our weekly observations of the pulsar to track its progress around the orbit.

</details>

TL;DR: 针对围绕大质量恒星运行、轨道周期 8.3 年且将于 2021 March 过近星点的脉冲星 PSR~J1759-2402，作者请求继续在 Parkes 使用 UWL 进行每周观测，以在脉冲星进入伴星风时确定散射、偏振、DM 和 RM 的变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR~J1759-2402 是少数围绕大质量恒星运行的脉冲星之一，轨道周期 8.3 年、轨道高度偏心，预计 2021 March 过近星点。Lovell 望远镜虽长期监测，但其受限带宽、维护安排和较差的偏振能力不适合跟踪该脉冲星进入和离开伴星遮掩的过程，因此需要更合适的观测手段。

Method: 摘要描述了使用 Parkes 上的 UWL 观测，强调其宽带和优异偏振特性；请求继续对该脉冲星进行每周观测，以跟踪其绕轨道的进展。摘要未说明观测频率或频段、时间跨度、具体数据分析方法或其他仪器细节。

Result: 摘要未说明。摘要主要陈述已知的轨道性质与观测请求，并未给出实际观测结果：未报告散射、偏振、色散量（DM）或旋转量（RM）的任何测量值或变化，也未给出伴有统计显著性、数值或不确定性结果的发现。

Conclusion: 作者的结论是，Parkes 上的 UWL 具有宽带和优异偏振特性，因此可用来确定该脉冲星进入伴星风时散射、偏振、DM 和 RM 的变化，故请求继续每周观测以跟踪其轨道进展。根据摘要无法判断与脉冲星单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、射电频谱、暂现射电辐射或磁星–FRB 联系的推断或可迁移性。

Abstract: PSR~J1759-2402 is one of a small handful of pulsars which are in orbit about high mass stars. Its orbital period is 8.3 years and the orbit is highly eccentric with periastron expected in 2021 March. Although discovered at Parkes, the Lovell telescope has been monitoring the pulsar over many years. However, it's restricted bandwidth, maintenance schedule and poorer polarization capability make it unsuitable to follow the pulsar as it enters and leaves the eclipse by the companion. In contrast, the UWL on Parkes with its wide- band and excellent polarization characteristics means that we can determine scattering, polarization, dispersion measure and rotation measure changes as the pulsar enters its companion wind. We request a continuation of our weekly observations of the pulsar to track its progress around the orbit.

</details>

However, it's restricted bandwidth, maintenance schedule and poorer polarization capability make it unsuitable to follow the pulsar as it enters and leaves the eclipse by the companion. In contrast, the UWL on Parkes with its wide- band and excellent polarization characteristics means that we can determine scattering, polarization, dispersion measure and rotation measure changes as the pulsar enters its companion wind. Method: 摘要说明该脉冲星由 Parkes 发现，Lovell 望远镜多年来对其进行监测；本申请请求继续每周观测，并使用 Parkes 上的 UWL，利用其宽带和优异的极化特性。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、时间跨度、样本量、数据分析方法或统计方法。

Result: 摘要未报告观测结果或新测量值。摘要给出的信息是：PSR~J1759-2402 的轨道周期为 8.3 年，轨道高度偏心，预计近星点为 2021 March；Lovell 望远镜多年来对其监测，但受限于带宽、维护安排和较差的极化能力；Parkes 的 UWL 则具备宽带和优异的极化特性，摘要指出可在脉冲星进入伴星风时确定散射、极化、色散量和旋转量的变化。摘要未给出这些量变化的具体数值或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者明确提出的结论是：由于 Lovell 望远镜在带宽、维护安排和极化能力方面的限制不适合跟踪该脉冲星进出伴星食的过程，而 Parkes 的 UWL 具备宽带和优异极化特性，因此请求继续每周观测，以追踪 PSR~J1759-2402 在轨道上的进展，并在其进入伴星风时测定散射、极化、色散量和旋转量的变化。根据摘要，无法判断这些观测结果对脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）相关物理过程的具体意义。

Abstract: PSR~J1759-2402 is one of a small handful of pulsars which are in orbit about high mass stars. Its orbital period is 8.3 years and the orbit is highly eccentric with periastron expected in 2021 March. Although discovered at Parkes, the Lovell telescope has been monitoring the pulsar over many years. However, it's restricted bandwidth, maintenance schedule and poorer polarization capability make it unsuitable to follow the pulsar as it enters and leaves the eclipse by the companion. In contrast, the UWL on Parkes with its wide- band and excellent polarization characteristics means that we can determine scattering, polarization, dispersion measure and rotation measure changes as the pulsar enters its companion wind. We request a continuation of our weekly observations of the pulsar to track its progress around the orbit.

</details>

### [3407] [Parkes observations for project P1007 semester 2019APRS_05]()
*Main, Robert,Wucknitz, Olaf,Antoniadis, John,Lin, Fang Xi,Mahajan, Nikhil*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用 Parkes 超宽带低频（UWL）接收机观测 5 颗最亮的食脉冲星（B1718-19、J1723-2837、B1744-24A、B1957+20、J2051-0827），以搜寻等离子体透镜效应，并在频率和时间上分辨透镜事件，从而限制双星内部物质的磁化、外流速度和质量损失率，并检验此类效应在食双星中的普遍性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期在 PSR B1957+20 和 PSR B1744-24A 两个食双星中观测到脉冲星辐射的极端等离子体透镜效应。该效应可在脉冲星处分辨约 ~10 km 的物理尺度，是探测脉冲星辐射的极灵敏手段，可用于测量双星内部物质的磁化并限制外流速度与质量损失率。尚不清楚等离子体透镜效应在食双星中有多普遍，因此需要对该类系统开展搜寻观测。

Method: 摘要说明拟观测 5 颗最亮的食脉冲星：B1718-19、J1723-2837、B1744-24A、B1957+20、J2051-0827，以搜寻等离子体透镜效应。观测使用 Parkes 超宽带低频（UWL）接收机，以便在频率和时间上分辨透镜事件，这被认为对限制物理参数至关重要。摘要未说明具体观测频率范围、观测时间跨度、数据量、分析流程或统计方法。

Result: 摘要主要陈述观测提议与预期，未报告新的观测结果或测量数值。摘要提到近期已在两个食双星 PSR B1957+20 和 PSR B1744-24A 中观测到极端等离子体透镜效应，并指出这类事件可在脉冲星处分辨约 ~10 km 的物理尺度；此外说明这些事件可用于测量双星内部物质的磁化程度，并限制外流速度和质量损失率。摘要未给出上述量的具体数值、误差或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者明确预期该研究将有助于确定等离子体透镜效应在食双星中有多普遍，为脉冲星辐射的位置给出改进的物理尺度，并有助于阐明这些系统食的本质及其演化路径。摘要未说明该提议观测是否已获得结果，也未给出对磁化、外流速度或质量损失率的具体限制；根据摘要无法判断其对脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）相关物理的直接推论。

Abstract: Recently, extreme plasma lensing of pulsar emission has been observed in two eclipsing binaries, PSR B1957+20 and PSR B1744-24A. These lensing events are an extremely sensitive probe of pulsar emission, resolving physical scales of ~10 km at the pulsar, and can be used to measure the magnetization of the intrabinary material, and constrain outflow velocities and mass-loss rates of the binaries. We propose to observe the 5 brightest eclipsing pulsars (B1718-19, J1723-2837, B1744-24A, B1957+20, J2051-0827), to search for the effects of plasma lensing, and to make use of the new Parkes Ultra Wide Band Low Frequency (UWL) receiver, which will allow us to resolve lensing events in frequency and time, which is crucial for constraining physical parameters. This study will help determine how ubiquitous the effects of plasma lensing are in eclipsing binaries, put improved physical scales on the locations of pulsar emission, and help shed light on the nature of eclipses and evolutionary pathways of these systems.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 摘要未说明观测频率范围、时间跨度、数据量与具体分析流程。摘要说明拟使用新的 Parkes 超宽带低频（UWL）接收机，观测 5 颗最亮的食脉冲星（B1718-19、J1723-2837、B1744-24A、B1957+20、J2051-0827），搜寻等离子体透镜效应，并在频率和时间上分辨透镜事件。

Result: 摘要未说明。摘要为观测提议，未报告已完成的观测结果；仅提及近期已在 PSR B1957+20 和 PSR B1744-24A 中观测到极端等离子体透镜效应，此类事件可在脉冲星处分辨约 ~10 km 的物理尺度，并可用于测量双星内部物质磁化、约束流出速度和质量损失率。

Conclusion: 作者认为，该研究将有助于确定等离子体透镜效应在食双星中有多普遍，为脉冲星辐射的位置给出改进的物理尺度，并有助于阐明这些系统的食的本质与演化路径。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、单脉冲发射或脉冲轮廓演化的直接联系。

Abstract: Recently, extreme plasma lensing of pulsar emission has been observed in two eclipsing binaries, PSR B1957+20 and PSR B1744-24A. These lensing events are an extremely sensitive probe of pulsar emission, resolving physical scales of ~10 km at the pulsar, and can be used to measure the magnetization of the intrabinary material, and constrain outflow velocities and mass-loss rates of the binaries. We propose to observe the 5 brightest eclipsing pulsars (B1718-19, J1723-2837, B1744-24A, B1957+20, J2051-0827), to search for the effects of plasma lensing, and to make use of the new Parkes Ultra Wide Band Low Frequency (UWL) receiver, which will allow us to resolve lensing events in frequency and time, which is crucial for constraining physical parameters. This study will help determine how ubiquitous the effects of plasma lensing are in eclipsing binaries, put improved physical scales on the locations of pulsar emission, and help shed light on the nature of eclipses and evolutionary pathways of these systems.

</details>

### [3415] [Parkes observations for project P1050 semester 2022APRS_16]()
*Sengar, Rahul,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Morello, Vincent,Bhandari, Shivani,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Wongphechauxsorn, Jompoj,Chen, Weiwei,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请基于 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域重新处理已发现 107 颗新脉冲星，并已完成巡天的 90 %；申请指出需要至少一年的初始计时才能充分刻画新脉冲星，推导特征年龄、磁场强度和自转减慢率等参数，并探测辐射不稳定性可能导致的异常行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对 HTRU 巡天低银纬银道面区域重新处理中新发现的脉冲星，通常只有在确认并开展后续计时之后才能获得科学结果；真正刻画新脉冲星需要至少一年的初始计时，这是推导脉冲星参数和探测异常行为的必要前提，同时也是测量真实银道面脉冲星族群与脉冲星参数空间边界的需要。

Method: 对 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域进行重新处理，采用 GPU 相干加速搜索、模板库和快速折叠算法三种流程；目前已通过该流程完成巡天的 90 %。申请开展后续计时观测活动，用于本学年及上一学年发现的毫秒脉冲星，以及对已确认脉冲星的跟踪。观测频率或波段、时间跨度具体设置、样本细节与统计方法摘要未说明。

Result: 在 GPU 相干加速搜索、模板库和快速折叠算法流程下已完成 HTRU 巡天低银纬银道面区域的 90 %，并发现 107 颗此前未知的脉冲星。摘要指出一年的初始计时是充分刻画新发现脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度，可用于推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等参数，并探测可能由辐射不稳定性引起的异常行为；但摘要未给出单颗脉冲星的计时、轮廓、偏振或频谱结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，APRS22 中的后续计时将产生全新的、令人兴奋的结果，并且该计时项目将使人们能够测量真实的银道面脉冲星族群以及银道面中脉冲星参数空间的边界。作者强调对新脉冲星而言，确认与后续计时是获得科学结果的必要条件，一年初始计时是充分刻画脉冲星及其可能由辐射不稳定性引起的异常行为的最短时间跨度。根据摘要无法判断这些结果对磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲模式转换的具体含义。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the timing campaign of new pulsar discoveries from the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed 90 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search, template bank and fast folding algorithm pipelines, and now have discovered 107 previously unknown pulsars. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This timing project is necessary for the timing of millisecond pulsars discovered in the current and last semester and for following up our confirmed pulsars from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. The follow-up timing in APRS22 will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will allow us to measure the true Galactic plane pulsar population and the boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

</details>

Result: 摘要报告：该巡天已完成 90 %，并发现 107 颗此前未知的脉冲星。摘要指出，一年初始计时是充分刻画新发现脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度，可用于导出特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等脉冲星参数，并可探测可能由发射不稳定性引起的异常行为。摘要中未给出具体脉冲星参数数值、显著性或计时结果。

Conclusion: 作者明确支持如下结论：该计时项目对于本学期和上一学期发现的毫秒脉冲星的计时，以及对 HTRU 银道面巡天中确认脉冲星的后续跟踪观测是必要的；APRS22 的后续计时将产生全新的、令人兴奋的结果；该计时项目还将使作者能够测量真实的银道面脉冲星种群以及银道面中脉冲星参数空间的边界。根据摘要无法判断该计时项目对磁星、快速射电暴或其他具体物理问题的可迁移性。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the timing campaign of new pulsar discoveries from the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed 90 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search, template bank and fast folding algorithm pipelines, and now have discovered 107 previously unknown pulsars. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This timing project is necessary for the timing of millisecond pulsars discovered in the current and last semester and for following up our confirmed pulsars from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. The follow-up timing in APRS22 will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will allow us to measure the true Galactic plane pulsar population and the boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

This timing project is necessary for the timing of millisecond pulsars discovered in the current and last semester and for following up our confirmed pulsars from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. Method: 申请观测时间以开展对 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域重新处理中新发现脉冲星的计时观测活动；巡天数据处理使用基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、模板库（template bank）和快速折叠算法（fast folding algorithm）流水线，摘要称已完成巡天的 90%。该项目对当前及上一学期发现的毫秒脉冲星以及已确认的 HTRU 银道面巡天脉冲星进行后续计时。摘要未说明望远镜名称、观测频率或波段、具体时间跨度、样本大小以及具体计时或分析技术细节（除一年初始计时这一体制性要求外）。

Motivation: 从 HTRU 巡天低银纬银道面区域重新处理中发现的新脉冲星需要确认和后续计时才能开展科学分析；描述新脉冲星通常至少需要一年初始计时，因此需要为当前及上一学期发现的毫秒脉冲星以及已确认的 HTRU 银道面脉冲星安排计时，并进而测量真实的银道面脉冲星 population 与参数空间边界。

Method: 摘要说明该工作利用基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、模板库以及 fast folding algorithm 流程重新处理 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域，已完成巡天的 90 %；并申请观测时间用于对已确认脉冲星及新发现的毫秒脉冲星开展后续计时 campaign，最短初始计时时间跨度为一年。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、仪器、样本总数之外的时间跨度、极化或单脉冲分析、统计方法或模拟细节。

Result: 摘要报告已完成 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面区域重新处理的 90 %，并通过基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、模板库和 fast folding algorithm 流程发现 107 颗此前未知的脉冲星。摘要指出，一年的初始计时是充分刻画新发现脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度，可用于推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等脉冲星参数，并探测可能由发射不稳定性导致的异常行为。摘要未说明具体的计时结果、极化、频谱或数值。

Conclusion: 作者认为，APRS22 的后续计时将产生全新的、令人振奋的结果，并可使人们测量真实的银道面脉冲星 population 以及银道面中脉冲星参数空间的边界。根据摘要无法判断这些计时结果是否与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或其他瞬变现象存在物理联系。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the timing campaign of new pulsar discoveries from the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have now completed 90 % of the survey with GPU based coherent acceleration search, template bank and fast folding algorithm pipelines, and now have discovered 107 previously unknown pulsars. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This timing project is necessary for the timing of millisecond pulsars discovered in the current and last semester and for following up our confirmed pulsars from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. The follow-up timing in APRS22 will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will allow us to measure the true Galactic plane pulsar population and the boundaries of pulsar parameter space in the galactic plane.

Result: 第一轮周期搜索处理已发现 106 颗此前未知脉冲星，处理预计在 2018OCTS 学期内完成；外推和族群合成表明该银河系盘巡天还应再产生 5 个发现。摘要指出一年的初步计时是充分刻画新发现脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度，可用于推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等参数并探测意外行为，但未给出具体数值结果或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为该后随计时项目对于识别 HTRU 银河系盘巡天中任何有趣的脉冲星系统是必要的，并可使所有首次后随观测的脉冲星产生全新结果，同时支持对银河系盘脉冲星族群的大规模考察、探索脉冲星参数空间的真实边界。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲发射等具体物理联系。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the initial follow-up of pulsar discoveries from the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We are in the final stages of our first pass processing with our periodicity search algorithm, and have already discovered 106 previously unknown pulsars. We expect that processing should be complete within the 2018OCTS semester. Extrapolation and population synthesis shows that the Galactic plane survey should result in a further 5 discoveries. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic ?eld strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This follow-up timing project is necessary for identifying any interesting pulsar systems discovered from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. Since all of the pulsars on the observing list here are being followed-up for the first time, they will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will enable a large-scale examination of the Galactic plane pulsar population, exploring the true boundaries of pulsar parameter space. Given the large number of discoveries expected and the long integration length required, this dedicated follow-up timing campaign is vital for achieving our science goals.

Given the large number of discoveries expected and the long integration length required, this dedicated follow-up timing campaign is vital for achieving our science goals.

</details>


### [3449] [Parkes observations for project P1004 semester 2019APRS_01]()
*Xie, Yanwei,Hobbs, George,Li, Di,Wang, Jingbo,Dai, Shi,Zhang, Lei*

TL;DR: 该申请计划利用新的 Parkes 超宽带接收机，测量星表中尚无流量密度记录的 Parkes 可观测脉冲星的流量密度，以便后续用于脉冲星族群、光度研究及巡天与调试规划。


<details>

Result: 摘要为观测申请，未报告已完成的测量结果或数值；仅说明已确定可由 Parkes 观测但在星表中没有流量密度测量的脉冲星，并计划测量其流量密度予以发表。具体脉冲星名称、流量密度数值及测量不确定度摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者表示，测量并发表这些脉冲星流量密度的目的，是后续利用这些测量结果研究脉冲星族群和光度，并协助规划新的脉冲星巡天和调试活动。至于该工作与单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）等的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: A fundamental property of any astronomical source is its flux density. The new Parkes ultra-widebandwidth receiver is ideal for studying pulsar profiles and measuring flux densities over wide bands. We have identified pulsars that can be observed by Parkes, but have no flux density measurements in the catalogue. Our proposal is simple - we wish to measure the pulsar flux densities, publish them and then later use those measurements to study pulsar populations, luminosities and to aid planning new pulsar surveys and commissioning activities.

</details>


### [3450] [Parkes observations for project P1416 semester 2026APRS_15]()
*Lower, Marcus,Johnston, Simon,Shannon, Ryan*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划用 Murriyang 的超宽带低和 MARS 接收机对双星脉冲星 PSR J1638-4725 开展监测，追踪其绕伴星运行时色散和散射的变化，以研究伴星星风在近星点前后的密度和温度分布，并配合即将到来的 2026 年近星点通过。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1638-4725 虽在 25 年前被发现，但与类似脉冲星双星系统相比仍是谜团：长期监测显示其在近星点前后数月于 GHz 频率上出现延长的“食”，且色散量、散射展宽和流量密度在整个轨道上强烈变化。伴星的初步光谱表征提示其可能为无星周盘的 O/B 型星，这为检验大质量恒星近星风区的结构和起源提供了机会。

Method: 摘要说明将使用 Murriyang 上的超宽带低接收机和 MARS 接收机，对 PSR J1638-4725 开展监测活动，追踪其绕伴星运行时的色散和散射变化；观测频率、时间跨度、样本量及具体分析方法摘要未说明。该监测还将配合一次更广泛的多波段活动，以捕捉即将到来的 2026 年近星点通过。

Result: 摘要报告，长期监测揭示 PSR J1638-4725 出现延长的“食”，即在近星点前后数月内于 GHz 频率上无法被探测到，并在整个轨道上存在强烈的观测色散量、散射展宽和流量密度变化。对伴星的初步光谱表征表明其可能是一颗 O/B 型星，但没有由抛射物质形成的星周盘。除此之外，摘要未说明本次拟议监测活动的具体结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，对 PSR J1638-4725 的监测可提供关于伴星星风在脉冲星扫过近星点前后密度和温度分布的独特见解，并有助于检验大质量恒星近星风区的结构和起源；这些观测还将在更广泛的多波段活动中发挥关键作用，以完整捕捉即将到来的 2026 年近星点通过。上述结论的具体物理推断根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Radio pulsars in orbit around high-mass stellar companions offer a rich source of extreme physics for both observational astronomers and theorists alike. Despite being discovered 25 years ago, PSR J1638-4725 remains a veritable mystery compared to similar pulsar binary systems. Long-term monitoring has revealed extended `eclipses' where the pulsar is undetectable for months around periastron at GHz frequencies, along with intense variations in the observed pulsar dispersion measure, scatter broadening and flux density throughout the entire orbit. Preliminary spectroscopic characterisation of the companion star suggests it may be an O/B star, albiet one without a circumstellar disc of ejected material. This raises the unique opportunity to answer test the structure and origin of the near-wind regime of high-mass stars. In this proposal we will conduct an ambitious monitoring campaign of PSR J1638-4725 with both the ultra-wideband low and MARS recievers on Murriyang. We will track changes in the pulsar dispersion and scattering as it swings around the companion star, providing unique insights into the density and temperature distribution of the stellar wind from the companion star before and after the pulsar swings through periastron. These observations will also play a pivotal role in a broader multi-wavelength campaign to fully capture the upcoming 2026 periastron passage.

</details>
