TL;DR: 该提案拟对极端相对论双脉冲星 PSR J1757-1854 进行覆盖连续 2 个轨道的观测，以确保 UWL 及其后端 Medusa 能正确处理极端相对论双星数据、帮助解决 ACOEs 问题，并首次在宽带宽下刻画该系统性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相对论双脉冲星的高精度计时可带来重要科学应用，包括对引力理论最具约束力的检验。但跨越较大观测带宽计时存在已知技术挑战，如视色散轨道效应（ACOEs）和近星点摆动，这些效应会干扰精确测量，且在宽带宽下更为显著；因此需要在新投入使用的 UWL 中予以校正。

Method: 摘要未说明观测频率或具体带宽设置；摘要说明拟对相对论双星 PSR J1757-1854 进行一小组观测，覆盖其连续 2 个轨道，并使用 UWL 及其后端 Medusa 处理数据，以检验对极端相对论双星系统数据的处理，并解决脉冲星数据处理软件包中的 ACOEs 问题。具体分析流程与统计方法摘要未说明。

Result: 论文为观测提案，摘要未报告实际观测结果或测量数值。摘要指出 PSR J1757-1854 展现出相对论脉冲星双星中所见过的一些最极端轨道特性，并预期这些覆盖连续 2 个轨道的观测将：确保 UWL（及其后端 Medusa）能正确处理极端相对论双星系统数据；帮助解决悬而未决的 ACOEs 问题；并作为次要目的，首次在宽带宽下刻画该双星系统的性质。

Conclusion: 作者认为，在宽带宽下校正 ACOEs 等效应，是确保新投入使用的 UWL 未来能够对相对论双脉冲星进行准确高精度计时的关键一步。所提议的 PSR J1757-1854 观测旨在检验并保障 UWL 及 Medusa 对极端相对论双星数据的处理能力、协助解决 ACOEs 问题，并首次在宽带宽下刻画该系统。根据摘要无法判断该工作与磁星、单脉冲发射、快速射电暴（FRB）的直接联系。

Abstract: Relativistic binary pulsars allow for a multitude of important scientific applications through the process of high-precision pulsar timing, including some of the most constraining tests of gravitational theories ever conducted. However, known technical challenges exist in the process of timing relativistic binary pulsars across large observing bandwidths, which can interfere with these precise measurements. These include apparent chromatic orbital effects (ACOEs), which cause an apparent change in the pulsar's dispersion measure as a function of orbital phase, and `periastron wobbles' caused by incorrect modeling of the pulsar's binary motion during phases of extreme acceleration and jerk. As these effects are more prominent across wide observing bandwidths, correcting them in the newly-commissioned UWL is a critical step in ensuring its ability to perform accurate high-precision timing of relativistic binary pulsars in the future. We propose a limited set of observations on the relativistic binary PSR J1757-1854, which displays some of the most extreme orbital properties ever seen in a relativistic pulsar binary. These observations, intended to span 2 consecutive orbits of the pulsar, will be used to ensure that the UWL (and its backend Medusa) are able to correctly process the data from extreme relativistic binary systems, will help to resolve the lingering problem of ACOEs in pulsar data-processing software packages, and will serve the secondary purpose of characterirsing the properties of this binary system over a wide bandwidth for the first time.

</details>


### [3468] [Parkes observations for project P1038 semester 2021APRS_06]()
*Stappers, Benjamin,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Lyne, Andrew,Bailes, Matthew,Keith, Michael,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: PSR~J1759-2402 是一颗轨道周期 8.3 年、高偏心率且预计 2021 年 3 月经过近星点的大质量伴星脉冲星；作者请求继续用 Parkes 的 UWL 进行每周观测，以跟踪其在近星点远侧的进展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR~J1759-2402 是少数围绕大质量恒星运行的脉冲星之一，轨道周期 8.3 年、高偏心率，预计 2021 年 3 月过近星点。Lovell 望远镜虽长期监测该脉冲星，但其受限带宽、维护计划和较差的偏振能力不适合跟踪脉冲星进入和离开伴星食的过程，因此需要更合适的观测手段。

Method: 摘要说明使用 Parkes 的 UWL 进行观测，其具有宽带和优异的偏振特性，并已用于测定该脉冲星进入伴星风时散射、偏振、色散量和旋转量的变化。作者请求继续每周观测该脉冲星，以跟踪其在近星点远侧的进展。具体观测频段、时间跨度、样本及分析方法的进一步细节，摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要称 PSR~J1759-2402 的轨道周期为 8.3 年，轨道高偏心率，预计 2021 年 3 月过近星点。作者表示已用 Parkes 的 UWL 确定该脉冲星进入伴星风时散射、偏振、色散量和旋转量的变化。摘要未给出这些变化的具体数值或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为 Parkes 的 UWL 的宽带和优异偏振特性使其适合跟踪该脉冲星进入和离开伴星食的过程，因此请求继续每周观测以跟踪其在近星点远侧的进展。该工作对脉冲星食、伴星风相互作用及偏振/散射/色散量/旋转量演化的具体物理含义，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: PSR~J1759-2402 is one of a small handful of pulsars which are in orbit about high mass stars. Its orbital period is 8.3 years and the orbit is highly eccentric with periastron expected in 2021 March. Although discovered at Parkes, the Lovell telescope has been monitoring the pulsar over many years. However, it's restricted bandwidth, maintenance schedule and poorer polarization capability make it unsuitable to follow the pulsar as it enters and leaves the eclipse by the companion. In contrast, the UWL on Parkes with its wide- band and excellent polarization characteristics means that we can, and already have determined scattering, polarization, dispersion measure and rotation measure changes as the pulsar enters its companion wind. We request a continuation of our weekly observations of the pulsar to track its progress on the far side of periastron.

</details>


### [3469] [Parkes observations for project P1080 semester 2021APRS_04]()
*Bhat, Ramesh,Dai, Shi,McSweeney, Samuel James,Swainston, Nicholas,Smith, Keegan,Sokolowski, Marcin*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟对一颗 MWA 新发现的脉冲星继续开展计时观测，利用约 5 角秒精度的位置信息和 Parkes、GMRT 数据，确定其自转与天体测量参数，并进一步检验其可能的陡谱、低光度性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该脉冲星为 MWA 新发现，需要持续计时以确定其自转和天体测量参数；同时，Parkes 与 GMRT 数据分析提示其可能为陡谱、低光度天体，需要在多个频段上进一步检验其谱性质、偏振频率依赖性和大幅变化，并保证在 MWA 下一学期难以常规观测期间仍能持续计时。

Method: 摘要说明拟开展 continued timing observations，并提及 MWA 的干涉测量优势、近期的 GMRT 后续观测、Parkes 和 GMRT 数据分析，以及将使用 ultra-wide band low-frequency receiver 观测多个频段。摘要未说明观测量、具体频段、时间跨度、样本量及统计或偏振分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告已将该脉冲星的位置确定到约 5 角秒精度，这可能有助于更快收敛到计时解，并有助于确定其自转和天体测量参数。对 Parkes 和 GMRT 数据的分析表明，该脉冲星很可能是一个陡谱、低光度天体；在多个频段上看到大幅变化。摘要未给出计时参数、偏振或谱指数的具体数值与显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，继续计时观测将有助于确定该新脉冲星的自转和天体测量参数；超宽带低频接收机观测可进一步强化其陡谱、低光度性质，并允许探索偏振的频率依赖性及多频段大幅变化；这些观测还能确保在 MWA 下一学期难以常规观测期间持续对该脉冲星计时。

Abstract: We propose continued timing observations of a new pulsar discovered with the MWA. Thanks to the interferometric advantages of the MWA and our recent GMRT follow-up, we have been able to determine the pulsar's position to ~5 arcseconds precision, which may help a faster convergence to its timing solution. This will help determine the pulsar's spin and astrometric parameters. The analysis of Parkes and GMRT data suggests that the pulsar is likely a steep-spectrum, low-luminosity object. Observations with the ultra-wide band low-frequency receiver will help further reinforce this, besides allowing us to explore the frequency dependence of its polarisation and a large variability that is seen at multiple frequency bands. Most importantly, these observations will ensure continued timing of the pulsar through the next semester when the MWA is unlikely to be available for regular observations.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR~J1759-2402 是少数围绕大质量恒星运行的脉冲星之一，轨道周期 8.3 年且高度偏心，预计 2021 年 3 月到达近星点。Lovell 望远镜虽长期监测，但受限于带宽、维护计划和较差的偏振能力，不适合跟踪该脉冲星进入和离开伴星遮挡食的过程；因此需要借助具有宽带和优异偏振特性的 Parkes UWL 继续观测。

Method: 摘要说明该脉冲星最初由 Parkes 发现，Lovell 望远镜多年来一直在监测，但因其受限带宽、维护计划和较差的偏振能力而不适合跟踪食过程。研究请求继续使用 Parkes 的 UWL 进行每周观测，以追踪脉冲星经过近星点远侧的进程。摘要提到已测定其进入伴星星风时的散射、偏振、色散量（DM）和旋转量（RM）变化，但未说明观测频率、时间跨度、样本量或具体分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告 PSR~J1759-2402 的轨道周期为 8.3 年，轨道高度偏心，近星点预计在 2021 年 3 月。该脉冲星是少数围绕大质量恒星运行的脉冲星之一。此前利用 Parkes UWL 的宽带和优异偏振特性，已确定该脉冲星进入伴星星风时散射、偏振、DM 和 RM 的变化。摘要未给出这些变化的具体数值、显著性或其他观测结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，Lovell 望远镜因带宽受限、维护计划和偏振能力较差，不适合跟踪该脉冲星进入和离开伴星遮挡食的过程，而 Parkes UWL 的宽带和优异偏振特性使其适合开展此类观测；据此请求继续每周观测，以追踪脉冲星在近星点远侧的进程。根据摘要无法判断更具体的物理机制或与磁星、快速射电暴等课题的联系。

Abstract: PSR~J1759-2402 is one of a small handful of pulsars which are in orbit about high mass stars. Its orbital period is 8.3 years and the orbit is highly eccentric with periastron expected in 2021 March. Although discovered at Parkes, the Lovell telescope has been monitoring the pulsar over many years. However, it's restricted bandwidth, maintenance schedule and poorer polarization capability make it unsuitable to follow the pulsar as it enters and leaves the eclipse by the companion. In contrast, the UWL on Parkes with its wide- band and excellent polarization characteristics means that we can, and already have determined scattering, polarization, dispersion measure and rotation measure changes as the pulsar enters its companion wind. We request a continuation of our weekly observations of the pulsar to track its progress on the far side of periastron.

</details>

Abstract: PSR~J1759-2402 is one of a small handful of pulsars which are in orbit about high mass stars. Its orbital period is 8.3 years and the orbit is highly eccentric with periastron expected in 2021 March. Although discovered at Parkes, the Lovell telescope has been monitoring the pulsar over many years. However, it's restricted bandwidth, maintenance schedule and poorer polarization capability make it unsuitable to follow the pulsar as it enters and leaves the eclipse by the companion. In contrast, the UWL on Parkes with its wide- band and excellent polarization characteristics means that we can, and already have determined scattering, polarization, dispersion measure and rotation measure changes as the pulsar enters its companion wind. ### [3478] [Parkes observations for project P1080 semester 2021APRS_03]()
*Bhat, Ramesh,Dai, Shi,McSweeney, Samuel James,Swainston, Nicholas,Smith, Keegan,Sokolowski, Marcin*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划继续对 MWA 新发现的一颗脉冲星开展计时观测；已有 MWA 与 GMRT 数据将该脉冲星位置定位于约 5 角秒精度，并表明它很可能是陡谱、低光度天体，后续观测旨在确定其自转与天体测量参数并保证继续计时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要指出，需要继续对 MWA 新发现的脉冲星进行计时观测，以确定其自转和天体测量参数；近期 GMRT 后续观测将位置精度提高到约 5 角秒，可能有助于更快收敛到计时解。此外，在 MWA 可能无法用于常规观测的下一学期，仍需保证对该脉冲星的持续计时。

Method: 摘要说明这是一项继续计时观测的提议，使用 Parkes 观测；提及 MWA 的干涉测量优势、近期的 GMRT 后续观测，以及将使用超宽带低频接收机。摘要还提到对 Parkes 和 GMRT 数据的分析，以及多个频段上看到的较大变化。具体观测频率或频段、时间跨度、样本量、统计或分析方法：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告，该脉冲星的位置已被确定到约 5 角秒精度，这可能有助于更快收敛到计时解。对 Parkes 和 GMRT 数据的分析表明，该脉冲星很可能是一个陡谱、低光度天体。摘要还提到在多个频段上看到较大变化，并计划探究其偏振的频率依赖性。摘要未给出确定的计时或自转参数数值、显著性水平或具体频段。

Conclusion: 作者提出，继续计时观测将有助于确定该脉冲星的自转和天体测量参数，并确保在下一个学期 MWA 不太可能用于常规观测期间持续对其进行计时。作者认为，使用超宽带低频接收机的观测将有助于进一步强化该脉冲星是陡谱、低光度天体的判断，并可探究其偏振的频率依赖性以及多个频段上的较大变化。根据摘要无法判断这些结果与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射的物理联系。

Abstract: We propose continued timing observations of a new pulsar discovered with the MWA. Thanks to the interferometric advantages of the MWA and our recent GMRT follow-up, we have been able to determine the pulsar's position to ~5 arcseconds precision, which may help a faster convergence to its timing solution. This will help determine the pulsar's spin and astrometric parameters. The analysis of Parkes and GMRT data suggests that the pulsar is likely a steep-spectrum, low-luminosity object. Observations with the ultra-wide band low-frequency receiver will help further reinforce this, besides allowing us to explore the frequency dependence of its polarisation and a large variability that is seen at multiple frequency bands. Most importantly, these observations will ensure continued timing of the pulsar through the next semester when the MWA is unlikely to be available for regular observations.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者认为，Parkes 上的 UWL 凭借宽带和优异的偏振特性，能够在该脉冲星进入伴星风时确定散射、偏振、色散量和旋转量的变化，并表示已经完成了这些确定工作；因此请求延续每周观测，以追踪该脉冲星在近星点远侧的过程。摘要未给出进一步物理机制解释或对更广泛脉冲星、磁星或 FRB 群体的推论，根据摘要无法判断其更广泛适用性。

Abstract: PSR~J1759-2402 is one of a small handful of pulsars which are in orbit about high mass stars. Its orbital period is 8.3 years and the orbit is highly eccentric with periastron expected in 2021 March. Although discovered at Parkes, the Lovell telescope has been monitoring the pulsar over many years. However, it's restricted bandwidth, maintenance schedule and poorer polarization capability make it unsuitable to follow the pulsar as it enters and leaves the eclipse by the companion. In contrast, the UWL on Parkes with its wide- band and excellent polarization characteristics means that we can, and already have determined scattering, polarization, dispersion measure and rotation measure changes as the pulsar enters its companion wind. We request a continuation of our weekly observations of the pulsar to track its progress on the far side of periastron.

</details>


### [3480] [Parkes observations for project P1080 semester 2021APRS_02]()
*Bhat, Ramesh,Dai, Shi,McSweeney, Samuel James,Swainston, Nicholas,Smith, Keegan,Sokolowski, Marcin*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟用 Parkes 继续对一颗 MWA 新发现的脉冲星开展计时观测，以确定其自转与天体测量参数；已有的 Parkes 和 GMRT 数据分析表明该脉冲星很可能是陡谱、低光度天体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MWA 新发现的这颗脉冲星需要持续计时观测以确定其自转和天体测量参数；同时，MWA 在下一学期不太可能用于常规观测，因此需要其他望远镜维持计时。摘要还提到该脉冲星在多个频段存在大幅变化，其偏振的频率依赖性和陡谱、低光度特征有待进一步检验。

Method: 摘要说明将对一颗 MWA 新发现的脉冲星继续开展计时观测，并使用 Parkes 和 GMRT 数据进行分析；借助 MWA 的干涉测量优势和近期 GMRT 后续观测，已将位置确定到约 5 角秒精度；拟使用超宽带低频接收机观测。摘要未说明具体观测频段、时间跨度、数据量和统计分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告该脉冲星位置已被确定到约 5 角秒精度，这可能有助于更快收敛到计时解；对 Parkes 和 GMRT 数据的分析表明该脉冲星很可能是陡谱、低光度天体；摘要还提到在多个频段看到大幅变化。摘要未给出具体的自转参数、天体测量数值、谱指数或偏振测量结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，继续计时观测将有助于确定该脉冲星的自转和天体测量参数；超宽带低频接收机观测可进一步强化其陡谱、低光度特征，并允许探究偏振的频率依赖性和多频段大幅变化；这些观测还能在下一学期 MWA 不太可能用于常规观测时确保对该脉冲星持续计时。根据摘要无法判断该脉冲星与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射研究的具体物理联系。

Abstract: We propose continued timing observations of a new pulsar discovered with the MWA. Thanks to the interferometric advantages of the MWA and our recent GMRT follow-up, we have been able to determine the pulsar's position to ~5 arcseconds precision, which may help a faster convergence to its timing solution. This will help determine the pulsar's spin and astrometric parameters. The analysis of Parkes and GMRT data suggests that the pulsar is likely a steep-spectrum, low-luminosity object. Observations with the ultra-wide band low-frequency receiver will help further reinforce this, besides allowing us to explore the frequency dependence of its polarisation and a large variability that is seen at multiple frequency bands. Most importantly, these observations will ensure continued timing of the pulsar through the next semester when the MWA is unlikely to be available for regular observations.

</details>


### [3481] [Parkes observations for project P1038 semester 2021APRS_02]()
*Stappers, Benjamin,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Lyne, Andrew,Bailes, Matthew,Keith, Michael,Levin, Lina,Champion, David,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR~J1759-2402 是少数围绕大质量恒星运行的脉冲星之一，其 8.3 年高偏心轨道预计 2021 March 过近星点。Lovell 望远镜虽长期监测该脉冲星，但受限于带宽、维护安排和较差的偏振能力，不适合跟踪其进入和离开伴星造成的食期间的行为，因此需要具备宽带与优良偏振性能的观测手段。

Method: 使用 Parkes 上的 UWL 进行观测，该仪器具有宽带和出色的偏振特性。拟继续每周观测该脉冲星，以跟踪其在近星点远侧的进展。摘要提到已用于测定脉冲星进入伴星风时的散射、偏振、色散量和旋转量变化；具体的观测频段、时间跨度、样本量与分析方法摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为，Parkes 上 UWL 的宽带与优良偏振特性使其适合在该脉冲星进入和离开伴星食期间进行跟踪，且已能测定其进入伴星风时散射、偏振、色散量和旋转量的变化；据此请求继续每周观测以跟踪近星点远侧的进展。该工作对脉冲星计时、偏振与伴星风相互作用研究的可迁移性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: PSR~J1759-2402 is one of a small handful of pulsars which are in orbit about high mass stars. Its orbital period is 8.3 years and the orbit is highly eccentric with periastron expected in 2021 March. Although discovered at Parkes, the Lovell telescope has been monitoring the pulsar over many years. However, it's restricted bandwidth, maintenance schedule and poorer polarization capability make it unsuitable to follow the pulsar as it enters and leaves the eclipse by the companion. In contrast, the UWL on Parkes with its wide- band and excellent polarization characteristics means that we can, and already have determined scattering, polarization, dispersion measure and rotation measure changes as the pulsar enters its companion wind. We request a continuation of our weekly observations of the pulsar to track its progress on the far side of periastron.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR~J1759-2402 是少数围绕大质量恒星运行的脉冲星之一，轨道周期 8.3 年、偏心率高，预计 2021 March 到达近星点。Lovell 望远镜虽长期监测，但其受限带宽、维护安排和较差偏振能力不适合跟踪脉冲星进入和离开伴星遮掩过程，因此需要具备宽带和优异偏振能力的 Parkes UWL 观测。

Method: 使用 Parkes 上的 UWL 进行观测，并请求继续每周观测该脉冲星，以追踪其在近星点远侧的进展。摘要提到已测定散射、偏振、色散量和旋转测度变化。具体带宽、频段、时间跨度、样本量和分析方法细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要指出，Lovell 望远镜多年来一直在监测该脉冲星，但其受限带宽、维护时间安排和较差偏振能力不适合跟踪脉冲星进入和离开伴星遮掩。相比之下，Parkes UWL 具有宽带和优异偏振特性，并且已经测定了该脉冲星进入伴星风时散射、偏振、色散量和旋转测度（rotation measure）的变化。摘要未给出这些变化的具体数值或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者基于 Parkes UWL 的能力和已获得的变化测量，认为应继续每周观测以跟踪脉冲星在近星点远侧的进展；摘要未将其直接解释为磁星、快速射电暴或自转减速力矩变化的证据，相关物理推断根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: PSR~J1759-2402 is one of a small handful of pulsars which are in orbit about high mass stars. Its orbital period is 8.3 years and the orbit is highly eccentric with periastron expected in 2021 March. Although discovered at Parkes, the Lovell telescope has been monitoring the pulsar over many years. However, it's restricted bandwidth, maintenance schedule and poorer polarization capability make it unsuitable to follow the pulsar as it enters and leaves the eclipse by the companion. In contrast, the UWL on Parkes with its wide- band and excellent polarization characteristics means that we can, and already have determined scattering, polarization, dispersion measure and rotation measure changes as the pulsar enters its companion wind. We request a continuation of our weekly observations of the pulsar to track its progress on the far side of periastron.

</details>

### [3488] [Parkes observations for project P1080 semester 2021APRS_05]()
*Bhat, Ramesh,Dai, Shi,McSweeney, Samuel James,Swainston, Nicholas,Smith, Keegan,Sokolowski, Marcin*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案申请继续用 Parkes 对一颗 MWA 新发现的脉冲星进行计时观测，以确定其自转与天体测量参数，并进一步检验其可能是陡谱、低光度脉冲星的特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MWA 新发现的脉冲星需要持续计时才能获得计时解；借助 MWA 的干涉测量优势和 GMRT 后续观测已将其位置定到约 5 角秒，这可能加快计时解收敛，而下一学期 MWA 不太可能用于常规观测，因此需要 Parkes 接手以保证计时的连续性。

Method: 摘要说明：利用 MWA 的干涉测量优势并用 GMRT 进行后续观测，将脉冲星位置确定到约 5 角秒；分析 Parkes 和 GMRT 数据；提议用超宽带低频接收机继续计时观测，以探究偏振的频率依赖性及多频段上的大幅变化。具体观测频段、时间跨度、样本量及分析细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：该脉冲星的位置已确定到约 5 角秒精度；Parkes 和 GMRT 数据分析表明该脉冲星可能是一个陡谱、低光度天体；在多个频段上看到大幅变化。摘要未说明自转与天体测量参数的具体数值、光谱指数、光度数值、变化幅度或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，持续计时观测有助于更快收敛到计时解并确定该脉冲星的自转与天体测量参数；超宽带低频接收机观测可进一步证实其陡谱、低光度性质，并允许探究偏振的频率依赖性和多频段大幅变化；这些观测还能确保在下一学期 MWA 不太可能常规观测时仍持续计时。该脉冲星与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲发射的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose continued timing observations of a new pulsar discovered with the MWA. Thanks to the interferometric advantages of the MWA and our recent GMRT follow-up, we have been able to determine the pulsar's position to ~5 arcseconds precision, which may help a faster convergence to its timing solution. This will help determine the pulsar's spin and astrometric parameters. The analysis of Parkes and GMRT data suggests that the pulsar is likely a steep-spectrum, low-luminosity object. Observations with the ultra-wide band low-frequency receiver will help further reinforce this, besides allowing us to explore the frequency dependence of its polarisation and a large variability that is seen at multiple frequency bands. Most importantly, these observations will ensure continued timing of the pulsar through the next semester when the MWA is unlikely to be available for regular observations.

</details>

*Ferdman, Robert,Kaspi, Victoria,Archibald, Robert*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用Parkes的Ultra Wideband Low-frequency（UWL）接收机系统观测Large Magellanic Cloud中射电宁静的年轻脉冲星PSR B0540--69，以期探测脉冲流量并研究其巨脉冲行为；其动机包括X射线观测到自转减慢率发生36%变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR B0540--69是传统上的射电宁静源，近期X射线观测显示其自转减慢率发生36%变化，被认为源于磁层过程的状态变化；类似间歇脉冲星行为提示这或伴随脉冲流量增加。该源也是少数已知发射巨脉冲的脉冲星之一，因此值得开展更高灵敏度射电观测。

Method: 摘要说明将使用Parkes的新的Ultra Wideband Low-frequency（UWL）接收机系统，对Large Magellanic Cloud中的PSR B0540--69开展观测；这将是迄今射电波段对该源最高灵敏度的观测。具体观测频率、时间跨度、样本、数据处理与统计分析方法，摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告称，近期X射线观测到PSR B0540--69的自转减慢率发生36%变化，被认为源于其磁层过程的状态变化。摘要还指出该源已知发射巨脉冲，是少数这样做的脉冲星之一；借助新的UWL接收机系统，将能开展迄今射电波段最高灵敏度的观测。摘要未报告新的射电探测结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，若成功探测到脉冲流量，将为该脉冲星磁层演化与行为提供重要见解，并有助于理解其glitch行为如何影响发射；即使没有探测到，也能以前所未有的灵敏度研究其巨脉冲行为。根据摘要无法判断磁层状态变化与射电脉冲流量之间的具体物理联系。

Abstract: We propose to perform observations of the very young pulsar PSR B0540--69 in the Large Magellanic Cloud to detect pulsed flux from this traditionally radio-quiet source. We are motivated to do so due to a relatively recent X-ray observation of a 36% change in its spin down rate, thought to be due to a state change in its magnetospheric processes. There is reason to believe this may be accompanied by an increase in pulsed flux, as has been seen in intermittent pulsar behaviour, for example. Additionally, PSR B0540--69 is known to emit giant pulses, one of only a small number of pulsars to do so. With the new Ultra Wideband Low-frequency (UWL) receiver system, we will be able to conduct the highest sensitivity observations of this source yet achieved at radio wavelengths. A successful detection of pulsed flux will provide important insight into the magnetospheric evolution and behaviour in this pulsar, and a better understanding of how its glitch behaviour may influence its emission. Even without such a detection, we will be able to study the giant pulse behaviour of PSR B0540--69 with unprecedented sensitivity.

</details>


### [3494] [Parkes observations for project P995 semester 2018OCTS_06]()
*Ferdman, Robert,Kaspi, Victoria,Archibald, Robert*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR B0540--69 传统上是射电宁静源，但近期 X 射线观测显示其自转减慢率变化了 36%，被认为源于磁层过程的状态改变；作者由此推测可能伴随脉冲流量增加，类似间歇脉冲星行为。此外该源是少数已知发出巨脉冲的脉冲星之一，因此有必要在射电波段开展更高灵敏度观测。

Method: 拟使用 Parkes 的超宽带低频（UWL）接收机系统对 PSR B0540--69 进行观测。摘要未说明具体观测频率、带宽、时间跨度、样本量、数据分析流程或统计与分析方法；仅说明将开展迄今在射电波段对该源灵敏度最高的观测，并据探测与否分别研究脉冲流量或巨脉冲行为。

Result: 这是观测提议，尚无论文观测结果。摘要仅报告了作为动机的已有信息：近期 X 射线观测显示 PSR B0540--69 的自转减慢率发生 36% 的变化，被认为源于其磁层过程的状态改变；该源已知发出巨脉冲，是少数此类脉冲星之一。作者表示新的 UWL 接收机将实现迄今该源在射电波段灵敏度最高的观测；成功探测脉冲流量可提供关于磁层演化与行为的见解，即使未探测到也可研究其巨脉冲行为。摘要未说明实际探测结果、统计显著性或数值测量。

Conclusion: 作者认为，若成功探测到脉冲流量，将为理解该脉冲星的磁层演化与行为提供重要见解，并有助于理解其 glitch 行为可能如何影响其辐射；若无探测，也可以前所未有的灵敏度研究其巨脉冲行为。这些是提议预期，尚未由观测结果确立。对于脉冲星射电辐射、单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、偏振、射电频谱以及磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）联系等方面的可迁移性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose to perform observations of the very young pulsar PSR B0540--69 in the Large Magellanic Cloud to detect pulsed flux from this traditionally radio-quiet source. We are motivated to do so due to a relatively recent X-ray observation of a 36% change in its spin down rate, thought to be due to a state change in its magnetospheric processes. There is reason to believe this may be accompanied by an increase in pulsed flux, as has been seen in intermittent pulsar behaviour, for example. Additionally, PSR B0540--69 is known to emit giant pulses, one of only a small number of pulsars to do so. With the new Ultra Wideband Low-frequency (UWL) receiver system, we will be able to conduct the highest sensitivity observations of this source yet achieved at radio wavelengths. A successful detection of pulsed flux will provide important insight into the magnetospheric evolution and behaviour in this pulsar, and a better understanding of how its glitch behaviour may influence its emission. Even without such a detection, we will be able to study the giant pulse behaviour of PSR B0540--69 with unprecedented sensitivity.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者认为，若成功探测到脉冲流量，将为了解 PSR B0540--69 的磁层演化与行为、以及更好地理解其 glitch 行为如何影响发射提供重要见解；即使未探测到，也可以前所未有的灵敏度研究其巨脉冲行为。该源自转减慢率变化与脉冲流量增加之间的关联属于基于间歇脉冲星行为的推测，根据摘要无法判断其是否成立。

Abstract: We propose to perform observations of the very young pulsar PSR B0540--69 in the Large Magellanic Cloud to detect pulsed flux from this traditionally radio-quiet source. We are motivated to do so due to a relatively recent X-ray observation of a 36% change in its spin down rate, thought to be due to a state change in its magnetospheric processes. There is reason to believe this may be accompanied by an increase in pulsed flux, as has been seen in intermittent pulsar behaviour, for example. Additionally, PSR B0540--69 is known to emit giant pulses, one of only a small number of pulsars to do so. With the new Ultra Wideband Low-frequency (UWL) receiver system, we will be able to conduct the highest sensitivity observations of this source yet achieved at radio wavelengths. A successful detection of pulsed flux will provide important insight into the magnetospheric evolution and behaviour in this pulsar, and a better understanding of how its glitch behaviour may influence its emission. Even without such a detection, we will be able to study the giant pulse behaviour of PSR B0540--69 with unprecedented sensitivity.

</details>


### [3507] [Parkes observations for project P995 semester 2018OCTS_02]()

Abstract: We propose to perform observations of the very young pulsar PSR B0540--69 in the Large Magellanic Cloud to detect pulsed flux from this traditionally radio-quiet source. We are motivated to do so due to a relatively recent X-ray observation of a 36% change in its spin down rate, thought to be due to a state change in its magnetospheric processes. There is reason to believe this may be accompanied by an increase in pulsed flux, as has been seen in intermittent pulsar behaviour, for example. Additionally, PSR B0540--69 is known to emit giant pulses, one of only a small number of pulsars to do so. With the new Ultra Wideband Low-frequency (UWL) receiver system, we will be able to conduct the highest sensitivity observations of this source yet achieved at radio wavelengths. A successful detection of pulsed flux will provide important insight into the magnetospheric evolution and behaviour in this pulsar, and a better understanding of how its glitch behaviour may influence its emission. A successful detection of pulsed flux will provide important insight into the magnetospheric evolution and behaviour in this pulsar, and a better understanding of how its glitch behaviour may influence its emission. Even without such a detection, we will be able to study the giant pulse behaviour of PSR B0540--69 with unprecedented sensitivity.

### [3513] [Parkes observations for project P995 semester 2018OCTS_16]()

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR B0540--69 传统上是射电安静源，近期 X 射线观测显示其自转减慢率变化 36%，被认为源于磁层过程的状态变化；类似间歇脉冲星行为提示这可能伴随脉冲流量增加。该源也是少数已知发射巨脉冲的脉冲星之一，因此值得在射电波段检验其脉冲流量与巨脉冲行为。

Method: 摘要未说明观测时间、时长与具体频率设置，仅说明拟使用 Parkes 的新超宽带低频（UWL）接收机系统对 PSR B0540--69 进行观测，并称这将是该源在射电波段迄今灵敏度最高的观测；未说明具体数据处理或分析方法。

Result: 摘要未报告实际观测结果，仅提出拟开展的观测。摘要指出，近期一次 X 射线观测显示该源自转减慢率发生 36% 的变化，并认为这可能由磁层过程的状态变化引起；摘要还指出 PSR B0540--69 已知会发射巨脉冲，是少数这样做的脉冲星之一。摘要未给出脉冲流量、巨脉冲或计时量的具体数值。

Conclusion: 作者认为，若成功探测到脉冲流量，将为该脉冲星的磁层演化与行为提供重要洞见，并有助于更好地理解其周期跃变行为可能如何影响其发射；即使未探测到，也能以前所未有的灵敏度研究其巨脉冲行为。这些均为拟议观测可能带来的结果，摘要未给出实际探测结论。

Abstract: We propose to perform observations of the very young pulsar PSR B0540--69 in the Large Magellanic Cloud to detect pulsed flux from this traditionally radio-quiet source. We are motivated to do so due to a relatively recent X-ray observation of a 36% change in its spin down rate, thought to be due to a state change in its magnetospheric processes. There is reason to believe this may be accompanied by an increase in pulsed flux, as has been seen in intermittent pulsar behaviour, for example. Additionally, PSR B0540--69 is known to emit giant pulses, one of only a small number of pulsars to do so. With the new Ultra Wideband Low-frequency (UWL) receiver system, we will be able to conduct the highest sensitivity observations of this source yet achieved at radio wavelengths. A successful detection of pulsed flux will provide important insight into the magnetospheric evolution and behaviour in this pulsar, and a better understanding of how its glitch behaviour may influence its emission. ### [3515] [Parkes observations for project P995 semester 2018OCTS_17]()
*Ferdman, Robert,Kaspi, Victoria,Archibald, Robert*

With the new Ultra Wideband Low-frequency (UWL) receiver system, we will be able to conduct the highest sensitivity observations of this source yet achieved at radio wavelengths. A successful detection of pulsed flux will provide important insight into the magnetospheric evolution and behaviour in this pulsar, and a better understanding of how its glitch behaviour may influence its emission. Even without such a detection, we will be able to study the giant pulse behaviour of PSR B0540--69 with unprecedented sensitivity.

A successful detection of pulsed flux will provide important insight into the magnetospheric evolution and behaviour in this pulsar, and a better understanding of how its glitch behaviour may influence its emission. ### [3518] [Parkes observations for project P1172 semester 2023APRS_10]()
*Mandow, Rami,Dawson, Joanne,Hobbs, George,Bhat, Ramesh,Russell, Chris,Shannon, Ryan,Reardon, Daniel John,Zic, Andrew,Lower, Marcus,Gupta, Vivek,Curylo, Malgorzata,Kapur, Agastya,Marshman, Tommy*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用 Parkes UWL 对毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1713+0747 在 2021 年 4 月一次磁层相关事件后的轮廓恢复进行高节奏观测，以追踪其轮廓、偏振等性质的时间分辨变化，并判断磁层是否回到原构型或稳定到新构型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1713+0747 因长期观测历史、非常稳定且狭窄的轮廓以及较高 S/N，对全球脉冲星计时阵列 campaign 很重要。2021 年 4 月它经历了一次与磁层变化相关的显著事件，表现为脉冲星轮廓变化，此后缓慢恢复。需要理解这一恢复过程，以证明此类脉冲星仍是可用于引力波研究的可行时钟，并获得其通常稳定磁层如何响应脉冲式状态变化的新数据。

Method: 拟对 PSR J1713+0747 开展高节奏观测，以每周时间尺度（每月每周一次）探测其轮廓恢复，并构建该毫秒脉冲星在轮廓、偏振及其他性质上变化的详细时间分辨序列。观测依赖 Parkes UWL，摘要称相关短时间尺度行为是其他望远镜无法获得的。摘要未说明具体频段、时间跨度、样本量或统计分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告：2021 年 4 月，PSR J1713+0747 经历了一次与其磁层变化有关的显著事件，表现为可观测到的脉冲星轮廓变化；自那以后该脉冲星一直在缓慢恢复。提案希望以每周时间尺度探测轮廓恢复，并揭示额外的短时间尺度行为，这些行为指示磁层变化；还希望确定磁层是已回到原始构型，还是正在稳定到新的构型。摘要未给出具体数值、显著性或其他观测结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，理解 PSR J1713+0747 此次事件的恢复过程，对于证明此类脉冲星仍是可用于引力波研究的可行时钟至关重要，并可提供关于这颗毫秒脉冲星通常稳定的磁层如何响应脉冲式状态变化的新数据；拟议观测将用于判断其磁层是回到原构型还是稳定到新构型。根据摘要无法判断更具体的物理机制或与快速射电暴（FRB）的联系。

Abstract: PSR J1713+0747 is a very important millisecond pulsar for global pulsar timing array campaigns, due to its long-term observation history, very stable and narrow profile and strong S/N. In April 2021, the pulsar experienced a significant event related to a change in its magnetosphere, presented as an observable change in the pulsar profile. Since then, the pulsar has been slowly recovering and we wish to observe this recovery with high-cadence observations to allow us to create a detailed time-resolved series of variations in the MSPs profile, polarisation, and other properties. Under this proposal, we wish to probe the profile recovery on weekly timescales (once per week per month), revealing additional short timescale behaviours, indicative of changes in the magnetosphere which are not available to other telescopes in the world, thanks to the Parkes UWL. This will also allow us to determine if the magnetosphere has returned to its original configuration or is settling into a new one. Understanding the recovery of this event is key for demonstrating that such pulsars are still viable clocks for use in gravitational wave studies, and in turn, provide us with new data on how the normally stable magnetosphere of this millisecond pulsar responds to an impulsive change in state.

</details>

The fundamental property of a pulsar is its pulse period and yet we have identified a large number of pulsars that do not having a measured spin-down rate and hence we do not know their evolutionary state, nor have good positions or knowledge of whether they are in a binary system. We have therefore selected 53 pulsars with the goal of measuring their spin-down rates. During this project we will also develop an automated pulsar-fold-mode online processing pipeline that includes online RFI mitigation. This pipeline will be made available as an ATNF service for other users.

</details>

Motivation: 新版 ATNF 脉冲星目录的论文希望公布迄今未发表的重要脉冲星参数。虽然脉冲周期是脉冲星的基本属性，但大量脉冲星尚未测得自转减慢率，因而其演化状态未知，也缺乏良好位置信息或双星系统信息。

Method: 作者选取了 53 颗脉冲星，目标是测量其自转减慢率；同时将开发一条自动化的脉冲星 fold-mode 在线处理流水线，其中包括在线 RFI 抑制，并将其作为 ATNF 服务提供。观测仪器、频率或频段、时间跨度、数据分析方法等细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告，作者已识别出大量尚未测得自转减慢率的脉冲星，并为此选取了 53 颗脉冲星作为测量目标；还计划开发包含在线 RFI 抑制的自动化脉冲星 fold-mode 在线处理流水线，并将其作为 ATNF 服务提供。截至摘要所述，尚无自转减慢率测量结果、任何数值或显著性结论。

Conclusion: 作者希望通过测量这 53 颗脉冲星的自转减慢率，为新版 ATNF 脉冲星目录补充此前未发表的重要脉冲星参数；并预期将所开发的自动化脉冲星 fold-mode 在线处理流水线（含在线 RFI 抑制）作为 ATNF 服务提供给其他用户。对所选取脉冲星的演化状态、位置或双星性质的具体物理结论，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We are actively developing a new version of the ATNF pulsar catalogue. In the paper describing the new catalogue we wish to take the opportunity to publish important pulsar parameters that have, to-date, not been published. The fundamental property of a pulsar is its pulse period and yet we have identified a large number of pulsars that do not having a measured spin-down rate and hence we do not know their evolutionary state, nor have good positions or knowledge of whether they are in a binary system. We have therefore selected 53 pulsars with the goal of measuring their spin-down rates. During this project we will also develop an automated pulsar-fold-mode online processing pipeline that includes online RFI mitigation. This pipeline will be made available as an ATNF service for other users.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者明确说明的目标是测量所选 53 颗脉冲星的自转减慢率，以便在新版 ATNF 脉冲星表相关论文中发表此前未发表的重要脉冲星参数，弥补这些脉冲星演化状态、位置和双星性质不清的空白；同时开发包含在线 RFI 抑制的自动化脉冲星折叠模式在线处理流水线，并将其作为 ATNF 服务提供给其他用户。根据摘要无法判断该工作与脉冲星单脉冲、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱、磁星或 FRB 之间的具体物理联系。

Abstract: We are actively developing a new version of the ATNF pulsar catalogue. In the paper describing the new catalogue we wish to take the opportunity to publish important pulsar parameters that have, to-date, not been published. ### [3560] [Parkes observations for project P1134 semester 2021OCTS_01]()
*Bhat, Ramesh,Dai, Shi,McSweeney, Samuel James,Swainston, Nicholas,Smith, Keegan,Agarwal, Nikita*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案针对 SMART 巡天数据处理中发现的一个间歇脉冲星候选体，提出计时与宽带后续观测，以判断其究竟是极端零脉冲脉冲星还是间歇（状态转换）脉冲星，并确定其自转、天体测量、偏振与辐射几何性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SMART 巡天数据处理中发现了一个间歇脉冲星候选体，初步分析尚不能区分它是极端零脉冲脉冲星还是间歇（状态转换）脉冲星；后者目前已知仅有少数几颗，其辐射机制仍未阐明，因此需要后续观测加以确认和深入研究。

Method: 摘要未说明具体望远镜、接收机、频率或波段、观测时长与采样细节；摘要明确提到将对候选体开展计时观测和宽带后续观测，通过定期计时观测测定自转与天体测量参数，并开展偏振分析以研究辐射性质与辐射几何结构。数据来源为正在进行的 SMART 巡天数据处理。

Result: 摘要未报告已完成的观测结果或具体数值。摘要指出，初步分析表明该候选体可能是极端零脉冲脉冲星，也可能是间歇（状态转换）脉冲星，这类脉冲星目前已知仅有少数几颗；所提议的观测有望阐明其间歇性质及其频率依赖关系，并用于确定自转参数、天体测量参数以及辐射几何结构。

Conclusion: 作者认为所提议的计时与宽带后续观测有助于进一步阐明该候选体的间歇性质及其频率依赖关系，并可通过定期计时确定其自转与天体测量参数，通过偏振分析探究其辐射性质并确定辐射几何结构。关于该候选体究竟属于极端零脉冲脉冲星还是间歇脉冲星，须由所提议观测判定；根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或其他脉冲星-磁星联系是否存在物理关联。

Abstract: We propose timing and broadband follow-up observations of an intermittent pulsar candidate that has emerged from our ongoing processing of the SMART survey data. Initial analysis suggests the possibility of it being either an extreme nuller, or possibly an intermittent (state-switching) pulsar, of which only a handful are currently known. These rare type of pulsars continue to pose challenges in our quest to uncover the elusive emission mechanism. The proposed observations will help further elucidate the intermittent nature and its frequency dependence, and will allow us to determine the pulsar's spin and astrometric parameters via regular timing observations. We will also undertake polarimetric analysis to further explore the emission properties, and to determine the pulsar's emission geometry.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者的结论是拟议观测将有助于阐明该候选体的间歇性质及其频率依赖，并可通过定期计时确定其自转与天体测量参数，通过偏振分析确定其辐射几何结构。摘要将寻找这类稀有脉冲星的辐射机制表述为持续存在的挑战；至于该候选体究竟属于极端消零还是间歇性脉冲星，以及其与磁星或 FRB 的物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose timing and broadband follow-up observations of an intermittent pulsar candidate that has emerged from our ongoing processing of the SMART survey data. Initial analysis suggests the possibility of it being either an extreme nuller, or possibly an intermittent (state-switching) pulsar, of which only a handful are currently known. These rare type of pulsars continue to pose challenges in our quest to uncover the elusive emission mechanism. The proposed observations will help further elucidate the intermittent nature and its frequency dependence, and will allow us to determine the pulsar's spin and astrometric parameters via regular timing observations. We will also undertake polarimetric analysis to further explore the emission properties, and to determine the pulsar's emission geometry.

TL;DR: 对一个来自 SMART 巡天数据处理的间歇脉冲星候选体开展计时与宽带后续观测，以判定其是极端零脉冲还是间歇（状态转换）脉冲星，并确定其自转与天体测量参数及辐射几何结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SMART 巡天数据处理中出现了间歇脉冲星候选体，初步分析显示它可能是极端零脉冲，也可能是目前已知仅少数几颗的间歇（状态转换）脉冲星。这类稀有脉冲星持续对揭示难以捉摸的辐射机制构成挑战，因此需要通过后续观测澄清其间歇性质。

Method: 对该候选体提出计时和宽带后续观测；具体望远镜、频段、观测时间跨度与样本量摘要未说明。将开展定期计时观测以确定自转和天体测量参数，并进行偏振分析以探究辐射性质与辐射几何结构。候选体来源于持续处理的 SMART 巡天数据，初步分析基于该数据。

Result: 摘要未报告观测结果。所报告的是候选体的发现情形：它出现在持续处理 SMART 巡天数据的过程中，初步分析表明其可能是极端零脉冲，也可能是间歇（状态转换）脉冲星；目前已知这类脉冲星仅有少数几颗。摘要未给出数值、显著性或其他定量结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出，这些观测将有助于进一步阐明该候选体的间歇性质及其频率依赖性，并确定其自转与天体测量参数；偏振分析将进一步探究辐射性质并确定辐射几何结构。摘要指出这类稀有脉冲星持续对揭示辐射机制构成挑战，但未给出最终的物理判定。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）的联系。

Abstract: We propose timing and broadband follow-up observations of an intermittent pulsar candidate that has emerged from our ongoing processing of the SMART survey data. Initial analysis suggests the possibility of it being either an extreme nuller, or possibly an intermittent (state-switching) pulsar, of which only a handful are currently known. These rare type of pulsars continue to pose challenges in our quest to uncover the elusive emission mechanism. The proposed observations will help further elucidate the intermittent nature and its frequency dependence, and will allow us to determine the pulsar's spin and astrometric parameters via regular timing observations. We will also undertake polarimetric analysis to further explore the emission properties, and to determine the pulsar's emission geometry.

</details>


### [3567] [Parkes observations for project P1134 semester 2021OCTS_03]()

<details>

Abstract: We propose timing and broadband follow-up observations of an intermittent pulsar candidate that has emerged from our ongoing processing of the SMART survey data. Initial analysis suggests the possibility of it being either an extreme nuller, or possibly an intermittent (state-switching) pulsar, of which only a handful are currently known. These rare type of pulsars continue to pose challenges in our quest to uncover the elusive emission mechanism. The proposed observations will help further elucidate the intermittent nature and its frequency dependence, and will allow us to determine the pulsar's spin and astrometric parameters via regular timing observations. We will also undertake polarimetric analysis to further explore the emission properties, and to determine the pulsar's emission geometry.

</details>


### [3568] [Parkes observations for project P1402 semester 2026APRS_07]()
*Vleeschower, Laila,Ransom, Scott,Van Leeuwen, Joeri,DeCesar, Megan,Cromartie, Thankful,Kaplan, David,Lynch, Ryan,Sengar, Rahul,Dolch, Timothy*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划用Murriyang（Parkes）的UWL接收机和APOLLO后端对新确认的窄占空比（约6%）毫秒脉冲星PSR J2147-3604开展35~hr计时观测，以获得相位相干计时解并刻画其自转、轨道与传播性质。摘要指出该源自转周期3.2 ms、DM为17 pc/cc，处于双星系统中，并已观测到强星际闪烁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J2147-3604是GBNCC巡天重新处理识别出的高置信度候选体，后经MeerKAT波束形成定位与Parkes后续观测确认，使用Parkes/UWL在700--1500~MHz探测到并确认其处于双星系统。摘要指出需要获得相位相干计时解以刻画其自转、轨道和传播性质，并因该脉冲星与一个FERMI源相关而需要精确射电星历。

Method: 摘要说明这是一项专门的Parkes/Murriyang计时观测提案，申请35~hr的Murriyang时间，使用UWL接收机和APOLLO后端，目标是获得相位相干的计时解。摘要提到此前使用green time分配的Parkes/UWL观测在700--1500~MHz探测到该脉冲星，并探测到强烈的星际闪烁；GBNCC巡天重新处理将其识别为候选体，MeerKAT波束形成定位与Parkes后续观测予以确认。具体分析流程摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告该脉冲星占空比窄（约6%），自转周期为3.2 ms，DM为17 pc/cc。它是在GBNCC巡天重新处理中被识别为高置信度候选体，随后经Fermi--TRAPUM合作组通过MeerKAT波束形成定位和Parkes后续观测确认。使用green time分配的Parkes/UWL观测在700--1500~MHz之间探测到它，并确认其处于双星系统中；由于其DM较低，还探测到强烈的星际闪烁。摘要未说明计时解、轨道参数或伽马射线脉冲搜索的结果。

Conclusion: 摘要陈述的目标是获得相位相干计时解并刻画该脉冲星的自转、轨道和传播性质，同时由于该脉冲星与一个FERMI源相关联，精确射电星历将能够支持在Fermi-LAT数据中开展敏感的伽马射线脉冲搜索，并评估PSR J2147-3604对脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）和未来伽马射线计时应用的适用性。摘要未给出这些应用的最终结果。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲发射等具体物理问题的联系。

Abstract: We propose a dedicated Parkes/Murriyang timing campaign of the newly confirmed narrow-duty cycle (~6 %) millisecond pulsar (MSP) PSR J2147-3604. This source was identified in a reprocessing of the Green Bank North Celestial Cap (GBNCC) survey as a high-confidence candidate with a spin period of 3.2 ms, and a dispersion measure, DM of 17 pc/cc. The pulsar was subsequently confirmed by the Fermi--TRAPUM collaboration via MeerKAT beamforming localisation and Parkes follow-up. Parkes/UWL observations allocated using green time detected this pulsar between 700--1500~MHz, and confirmed that it's in a binary system. Due to its low DM, we also detected strong interstellar scintillation. We request 35~hr of Murriyang time using the UWL receiver and APOLLO backend to obtain a phase-coherent timing solution and to characterise its spin, orbital, and propagation properties. Since the pulsar is also associated with a FERMI source, a precise radio ephemeris will also enable sensitive searches for gamma-ray pulsations in Fermi-LAT data and assess PSR J2147-3604's suitability for pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) and future gamma-ray timing applications.

</details>

### [3572] [Parkes observations for project P1402 semester 2026APRS_12]()
*Vleeschower, Laila,Ransom, Scott,Van Leeuwen, Joeri,DeCesar, Megan,Cromartie, Thankful,Kaplan, David,Lynch, Ryan,Sengar, Rahul,Dolch, Timothy*

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新确认的窄占空比（~6 %）毫秒脉冲星 PSR J2147-3604 需要专门的计时观测以获得相位相干计时解。摘要指出，该源与一个 FERMI 源相关联，精确的射电星历将有助于在 Fermi-LAT 数据中搜寻伽马射线脉冲，并评估其是否适合脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）及未来伽马射线计时应用。

Method: 摘要说明拟申请 35~hr 的 Murriyang 时间，使用 UWL 接收机和 APOLLO 后端开展专门的 Parkes/Murriyang 计时观测活动，以获得相位相干计时解并表征其自转、轨道和传播性质。该脉冲星此前在对 GBNCC 巡天的重新处理中被识别为候选体，后由 Fermi--TRAPUM 合作组通过 MeerKAT 波束形成定位和 Parkes 后续观测确认；使用 green time 分配的 Parkes/UWL 观测在 700--1500~MHz 探测到该脉冲星。摘要未说明其他分析方法的细节。

Result: 该源在对 GBNCC 巡天重新处理时被识别为高置信度候选体，自转周期为 3.2 ms，DM 为 17 pc/cc。该脉冲星随后由 Fermi--TRAPUM 合作组通过 MeerKAT 波束形成定位和 Parkes 后续观测确认。使用 green time 分配的 Parkes/UWL 观测在 700--1500~MHz 之间探测到该脉冲星，并确认其处于双星系统中。由于其低 DM，还探测到强烈的星际闪烁。摘要未报告相位相干计时解、轨道参数、偏振或频谱结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，用 UWL 接收机和 APOLLO 后端获得的相位相干计时解可用于表征 PSR J2147-3604 的自转、轨道和传播性质；由于该脉冲星与一个 FERMI 源相关联，精确的射电星历还将使得能够在 Fermi-LAT 数据中灵敏地搜寻伽马射线脉冲，并评估其对脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）和未来伽马射线计时应用的适用性。根据摘要无法判断与磁星、单脉冲发射、模式转换或快速射电暴（FRB）的具体物理联系。

Abstract: We propose a dedicated Parkes/Murriyang timing campaign of the newly confirmed narrow-duty cycle (~6 %) millisecond pulsar (MSP) PSR J2147-3604. Parkes/UWL observations allocated using green time detected this pulsar between 700--1500~MHz, and confirmed that it's in a binary system. Due to its low DM, we also detected strong interstellar scintillation. We request 35~hr of Murriyang time using the UWL receiver and APOLLO backend to obtain a phase-coherent timing solution and to characterise its spin, orbital, and propagation properties. Since the pulsar is also associated with a FERMI source, a precise radio ephemeris will also enable sensitive searches for gamma-ray pulsations in Fermi-LAT data and assess PSR J2147-3604's suitability for pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) and future gamma-ray timing applications.

Abstract: We propose a dedicated Parkes/Murriyang timing campaign of the newly confirmed narrow-duty cycle (~6 %) millisecond pulsar (MSP) PSR J2147-3604. *Vleeschower, Laila,Ransom, Scott,Van Leeuwen, Joeri,DeCesar, Megan,Cromartie, Thankful,Kaplan, David,Lynch, Ryan,Sengar, Rahul,Dolch, Timothy*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案申请 35 小时 Murriyang/UWL 与 APOLLO 后端观测，以对新确认的窄占空比（约6%）毫秒脉冲星 PSR J2147-3604 获得相位相干计时解并刻画其自转、轨道与传播性质；该星自转周期 3.2 ms、DM 为 17 pc/cc，已被确认处于双星系统中并表现出强烈星际闪烁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J2147-3604 是新近确认的窄占空比毫秒脉冲星，作为 GBNCC 巡天重新处理中的高置信度候选体被发现并随后被确认，其处于双星系统且低 DM 导致强烈星际闪烁；目前缺乏相位相干计时解，因而尚无精确射电星历用于刻画其性质并支持后续应用评估。

Method: 申请 35~hr 的 Murriyang 观测时间，使用 UWL 接收机和 APOLLO 后端，开展专门的 Parkes/Murriyang 计时观测活动，以获得相位相干计时解。摘要提及该源此前在 700--1500~MHz 的 Parkes/UWL 观测中被探测到；其最初由 GBNCC 巡天重新处理识别，随后经 MeerKAT 波束形成定位与 Parkes 后续观测确认。

Result: PSR J2147-3604 被识别为高置信度候选体，自转周期 3.2 ms，DM 为 17 pc/cc，占空比约 6%。它通过 MeerKAT 波束形成定位和 Parkes 后续观测被确认；Parkes/UWL 在 700--1500~MHz 的观测确认其处于双星系统中，并由于低 DM 而探测到强烈的星际闪烁。摘要未说明计时解、轨道参数、偏振或频谱等具体测量结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，获取精确射电星历后，可在 Fermi-LAT 数据中开展灵敏的伽马射线脉冲搜索，并评估 PSR J2147-3604 对脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）和未来伽马射线计时应用的适用性。该结论以拟议观测能够取得相位相干计时解为前提；其是否实际达到相应的计时精度与星历质量，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose a dedicated Parkes/Murriyang timing campaign of the newly confirmed narrow-duty cycle (~6 %) millisecond pulsar (MSP) PSR J2147-3604. This source was identified in a reprocessing of the Green Bank North Celestial Cap (GBNCC) survey as a high-confidence candidate with a spin period of 3.2 ms, and a dispersion measure, DM of 17 pc/cc. The pulsar was subsequently confirmed by the Fermi--TRAPUM collaboration via MeerKAT beamforming localisation and Parkes follow-up. Parkes/UWL observations allocated using green time detected this pulsar between 700--1500~MHz, and confirmed that it's in a binary system. Due to its low DM, we also detected strong interstellar scintillation. We request 35~hr of Murriyang time using the UWL receiver and APOLLO backend to obtain a phase-coherent timing solution and to characterise its spin, orbital, and propagation properties. Since the pulsar is also associated with a FERMI source, a precise radio ephemeris will also enable sensitive searches for gamma-ray pulsations in Fermi-LAT data and assess PSR J2147-3604's suitability for pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) and future gamma-ray timing applications.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者明确提出：拟通过35~hr的Murriyang UWL/APOLLO观测获得PSR J2147-3604的相位相干计时解，并刻画其自转、轨道和传播性质；精确射电星历将使在Fermi-LAT数据中开展灵敏的伽马射线脉冲搜索成为可能，并可用于评估该源对脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）及未来伽马射线计时应用的适用性。摘要未说明该源与快速射电暴（FRBs）或磁星（magnetars）的联系；其单脉冲、模式转换或偏振性质，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose a dedicated Parkes/Murriyang timing campaign of the newly confirmed narrow-duty cycle (~6 %) millisecond pulsar (MSP) PSR J2147-3604. This source was identified in a reprocessing of the Green Bank North Celestial Cap (GBNCC) survey as a high-confidence candidate with a spin period of 3.2 ms, and a dispersion measure, DM of 17 pc/cc. The pulsar was subsequently confirmed by the Fermi--TRAPUM collaboration via MeerKAT beamforming localisation and Parkes follow-up. Parkes/UWL observations allocated using green time detected this pulsar between 700--1500~MHz, and confirmed that it's in a binary system. Due to its low DM, we also detected strong interstellar scintillation. We request 35~hr of Murriyang time using the UWL receiver and APOLLO backend to obtain a phase-coherent timing solution and to characterise its spin, orbital, and propagation properties. Since the pulsar is also associated with a FERMI source, a precise radio ephemeris will also enable sensitive searches for gamma-ray pulsations in Fermi-LAT data and assess PSR J2147-3604's suitability for pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) and future gamma-ray timing applications.

Conclusion: 作者认为，借助所申请的 35~hr Murriyang UWL/APOLLO 观测可望获得相位相干计时解，从而表征该脉冲星的自转、轨道和传播性质；由于该脉冲星与一个 FERMI 源成协，精确的射电星历将使得能够在 Fermi-LAT 数据中开展灵敏的伽马射线脉冲搜索，并评估其对脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）及未来伽马射线计时应用的适用性。与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射的具体联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose a dedicated Parkes/Murriyang timing campaign of the newly confirmed narrow-duty cycle (~6 %) millisecond pulsar (MSP) PSR J2147-3604. This source was identified in a reprocessing of the Green Bank North Celestial Cap (GBNCC) survey as a high-confidence candidate with a spin period of 3.2 ms, and a dispersion measure, DM of 17 pc/cc. The pulsar was subsequently confirmed by the Fermi--TRAPUM collaboration via MeerKAT beamforming localisation and Parkes follow-up. Parkes/UWL observations allocated using green time detected this pulsar between 700--1500~MHz, and confirmed that it's in a binary system. Due to its low DM, we also detected strong interstellar scintillation. We request 35~hr of Murriyang time using the UWL receiver and APOLLO backend to obtain a phase-coherent timing solution and to characterise its spin, orbital, and propagation properties. Since the pulsar is also associated with a FERMI source, a precise radio ephemeris will also enable sensitive searches for gamma-ray pulsations in Fermi-LAT data and assess PSR J2147-3604's suitability for pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) and future gamma-ray timing applications.

</details>

### [3596] [Parkes observations for project P860 semester 2016OCTS]()
*Ng, Cherry,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Keane, Evan,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Cameron, Andrew,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Caleb, Manisha,Bhandari, Shivani,Burke, Sarah*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请请求观测时间，对 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面部分发现的脉冲星开展首次后随计时；此前已从 93% 的已处理数据中发现 88 颗脉冲星，外推与族群合成预期还将新增 15-20 项发现，而一年的初始计时是充分刻画这些新脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 发现脉冲星只是第一步，有趣科学通常需后随计时才能揭示；新发现脉冲星需要至少一年初始计时才能充分刻画并导出特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等参数，并探测可能由发射不稳定性引起的意外行为。该项目的动机是识别 HTRU 银道面巡天发现的任何有趣脉冲星系统，并对银道面脉冲星族群开展大规模考察。

Method: 摘要未说明。摘要仅说明这是为 HTRU 巡天（P630）低银纬银道面部分脉冲星发现申请观测时间，观测列表上的脉冲星均为首次后随；提到数据处理与数据审查仍在进行，预计在该学期末完成，并计划开展为期一年的初始后随计时。摘要未说明望远镜或仪器名称、观测频率或波段、样本量、时间跨度细节及具体分析手段。

Result: 已从 93% 的已处理数据中发现 88 颗脉冲星；外推和族群合成表明，银道面巡天还应导致进一步 15-20 项发现。摘要未报告任何计时结果、脉冲轮廓、偏振、频谱、爆发或自转减慢行为的具体数值；一年的初始计时被视为充分刻画新发现脉冲星、导出其特征年龄、磁场强度和自转减慢率所需的最短时间跨度，并可用于探测脉冲星可能由发射不稳定性导致的意外行为。

Conclusion: 作者认为，一年的初始后随计时是充分刻画新发现脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度，该后随计时项目对于识别 HTRU 银道面巡天中发现的任何有趣脉冲星系统是必要的；由于这些脉冲星均为首次后随，将产生全新结果，并使银道面脉冲星族群的大规模考察及脉冲星相空间真实边界的探索成为可能，因此这一专门的观测活动对实现科学目标至关重要。根据摘要无法判断其对磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲发射的具体物理联系。

Abstract: This is a request for observing time for the initial follow-up of pulsar discoveries from the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU survey (P630). We have already discovered 88 pulsars from 93% of processed data. With data processing on-going, we expect that processing and data review should be complete by the end of the upcoming semester. Extrapolation and population synthesis shows that the Galactic plane survey should result in a further 15-20 discoveries. The discovery of pulsars is just a first step and interesting science can usually only be revealed when a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. One year of initial timing is the minimal timespan required to fully-characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic ?eld strength, spin-down rate, as well as to detect any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This follow-up timing project is necessary for identifying any interesting pulsar systems discovered from the HTRU Galactic plane survey. Since all of the pulsars on the observing list here are followed-up for the first time, they will produce completely new and exciting results. In addition, this timing project will enable a large-scale examination of the Galactic plane pulsar population, exploring the true boundaries of pulsar phase space. Given the large number of discoveries expected and the long integration length required, this dedicated follow-up timing campaign is vital for achieving our science goals.

</details>

Abstract: Hot subdwarf (sdB) stars are core-helium burning stars with thin hydrogen envelopes and masses around 0.5 Msun. A large fraction of sdBs are members of short-period binaries with periods below a few days. Orbital shrinkage through a common envelope phase is the only likely formation channel for such short-period sdB binaries. Although most of the companions are low mass main sequence stars or white dwarfs, one proposed evolutionary channel produces an sdB with a recycled pulsar companion where the pulsar forms after two common envelope phases and a short X-ray binary phase. Theoretical models predict that about 1% of the compact sdB binaries should have pulsar companions. Method: 摘要未说明具体观测频段、仪器配置和数据分析方法；所述方案是申请 13.5 小时观测时间，利用 Parkes 对四个可观测的候选 sdB+脉冲星系统开展深度射电脉冲星搜寻。

Result: 摘要未报告实际观测结果。摘要指出，迄今为止尚未明确探测到 sdB 的脉冲星伴星，而已识别出六个候选体；理论模型预测约 1% 的致密 sdB 双星应具有脉冲星伴星。

Conclusion: 作者认为，一次探测将（a）成为首次探测到束缚于 sdB 星的脉冲星，证实所预测双星演化通道的有效性；（b）允许对 sdB 质量进行准确估计，从而检验关于这些神秘恒星的理论模型。根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星单脉冲、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）的具体物理联系。

Abstract: Hot subdwarf (sdB) stars are core-helium burning stars with thin hydrogen envelopes and masses around 0.5 Msun. A large fraction of sdBs are members of short-period binaries with periods below a few days. Orbital shrinkage through a common envelope phase is the only likely formation channel for such short-period sdB binaries. Although most of the companions are low mass main sequence stars or white dwarfs, one proposed evolutionary channel produces an sdB with a recycled pulsar companion where the pulsar forms after two common envelope phases and a short X-ray binary phase. Theoretical models predict that about 1% of the compact sdB binaries should have pulsar companions. So far no pulsar companion to an sdB has yet been detected unambiguously whereas six candidates have been identified. Here we propose 13.5 hrs of observing time to conduct a deep search for radio pulsars around four candidate sdB+pulsar systems which are accessible with Parkes. A detection would (a) be the first time a pulsar bound to an sdB star has been detected, confirming the efficacy of the predicted binary-evolution channel; and (b) allow for an accurate estimate of the sdB mass, testing models for these enigmatic stars.

</details>

### [3609] [Parkes observations for project P1211 semester 2024APRS_03]()
*Ahmad, Adeel,Filipovic, Miroslav,Dai, Shi,Barnes, Luke,Lazarevic, Sanja*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案利用新的 ASKAP EMU 图像在银河系平面中选出 16 个脉冲星候选体（含 7 个来自 2023APRS 学期的源），并提出使用 Parkes UWL 开展针对性脉冲星搜索，以在更高频率上搜索脉冲信号，避免强 DM 致散和散射效应，目标是发现此前 1.4 GHz 巡天因银河系平面密集电离介质而很可能遗漏的 MSPs 等极端脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统脉冲星搜索技术对紧凑双星系统中的毫秒脉冲星（MSPs）、极快自转的亚毫秒脉冲星以及高 DM 脉冲星等极端脉冲星不够灵敏；下一代射电望远镜阵列（如 ASKAP）的发展改变了这一状况，因为 ASKAP 能开展高灵敏度、宽天区覆盖的射电连续谱巡天，从而可在连续谱巡天中寻找候选体并开展针对性搜索，避免逐像素高时间分辨率搜索的高昂代价。此外，银河系平面中密集的电离介质使 MSPs 很可能被此前 1.4 GHz 的脉冲星巡天遗漏。

Method: 摘要未说明观测的频率范围、时间跨度、灵敏度或分析细节；提案描述的方法是：使用新的 ASKAP EMU 图像，通过选择谱指数陡于 -2.0 且致密度小于 1.2 的源，在银河系平面中识别脉冲星候选体，共找到 22 个候选体，其中 13 个为已知脉冲星、9 个可供后续跟踪；总计 16 个候选体，包括来自 2023APRS 学期的七个源。随后提出使用 Parkes UWL 对这些候选体开展针对性脉冲星搜索，以便在更高频率上搜索脉冲信号，避免强烈的 DM 致散和散射效应。

Result: 摘要报告：通过在 ASKAP EMU 图像中选择谱指数陡于 -2.0 且致密度小于 1.2 的源，共找到 22 个候选体；其中 13 个是已知脉冲星，另有 9 个源被认为数量合理、可供后续跟踪。合计候选体为 16 个，包含来自 2023APRS 学期的七个源。摘要还指出，由于银河系平面中密集的电离介质，MSPs 很可能被此前在 1.4 GHz 开展的脉冲星巡天遗漏。摘要未说明任何观测结果、探测数量、显著性、计时或偏振测量数值。

Conclusion: 作者提出使用 Parkes UWL 对 16 个候选体开展针对性脉冲星搜索，认为在更高频率上搜索脉冲信号可以避免强烈的 DM 致散和散射效应；其科学目标是在宽频带、全视场条件下搜索极端脉冲星，并弥补此前 1.4 GHz 巡天因银河系平面密集电离介质很可能遗漏 MSPs 的不足。摘要未说明是否已获得任何探测结果或对具体源物理性质的判断。根据摘要无法判断该提案与磁星、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱或 FRB 之间是否存在直接联系。

Abstract: Traditional pulsar searching techniques are not sensitive enough to extreme pulsars such as millisecond pulsars (MSPs) in compact binaries (e.g., Pulsar-Blackhole binary systems), extremely fast spinning pulsars (e.g., sub-MSPs), and high dispersion measure (DM) pulsars. Such a situation is now changed thanks to the development of next generation radio telescope arrays such as Australian Square Kilometer Array Pathfinder (ASKAP). ASKAP is capable of conducting highly sensitive radio continuum surveys with wide sky coverage (e.g, Evolutionary Map of The Universe survey). One of the solutions is to find pulsar candidates in radio continuum surveys such as ASKAP surveys and then carry out targeted searches. This technique allows us to search over the wide bandwidth with full field of view while avoiding the need for expensive pixel-by-pixel high time resolution searches. In this proposal, we propose to observe 16 pulsar candidates identified in the Galactic plane using new ASKAP EMU images. We found 22 candidates by selecting sources with spectral index steeper than -2.0 and compactness less than 1.2. Among them 13 are known pulsars and a reasonable number of candidates to follow up (9 sources). In total, we have 16 candidates including seven sources from 2023APRS semester. Because of the dense ionised medium in the Galactic Plane, MSPs are likely to be missed by previous pulsar surveys carried out at 1.4 GHz. Here, we propose a targeted pulsar search with the Parkes UWL which allow us to search pulsation at higher frequencies and therefore avoid strong DM smearing and scattering effects.

</details>


### [3610] [Parkes observations for project P1211 semester 2024APRS_23]()
*Ahmad, Adeel,Filipovic, Miroslav,Dai, Shi,Barnes, Luke,Lazarevic, Sanja*

TL;DR: 该提案利用新 ASKAP EMU 图像在银河系平面筛选出谱指数陡于 -2.0、致密度小于 1.2 的候选体，并提议用 Parkes UWL 对 16 个脉冲星候选体开展针对性搜索，以在更高频率上规避银河系平面强 DM 展宽与散射，从而探测可能被 1.4 GHz 巡天遗漏的 MSP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统脉冲星搜索技术对致密双星中的毫秒脉冲星、极快自转脉冲星和高 DM 脉冲星不够灵敏；下一代射电望远镜阵列（如 ASKAP）的发展改变了这一局面。摘要指出，银河系平面稠密的电离介质可能使 MSP 被此前 1.4 GHz 的脉冲星巡天遗漏，因此需要在射电连续谱巡天中先找候选体再做针对性搜索。

Method: 摘要说明：利用新的 ASKAP EMU 图像在银河系平面识别候选体，筛选条件为谱指数陡于 -2.0 且致密度小于 1.2；提议使用 Parkes UWL 对 16 个脉冲星候选体开展针对性搜索，以在更高频率搜索脉冲信号并避免强 DM 消色散展宽和散射效应。观测频率、时间跨度、灵敏度等细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：通过筛选谱指数陡于 -2.0 且致密度小于 1.2 的源，共找到 22 个候选体，其中 13 个是已知脉冲星，9 个源可供后续跟踪；总计 16 个候选体，包括来自 2023APRS 学期的七个源。摘要未说明实际观测结果、探测数量或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者提出，在 ASKAP 等射电连续谱巡天中寻找脉冲星候选体再开展针对性搜索，可在宽带宽、全视场条件下搜索，并避免逐像素高时间分辨率搜索的高昂代价；由于银河系平面稠密电离介质可能使 MSP 被此前 1.4 GHz 巡天遗漏，作者提议用 Parkes UWL 在更高频率搜索以规避强 DM 消色散展宽和散射效应。根据摘要无法判断该提案的实际探测效果或与其他脉冲星、磁星、FRB 研究的联系。

Abstract: Traditional pulsar searching techniques are not sensitive enough to extreme pulsars such as millisecond pulsars (MSPs) in compact binaries (e.g., Pulsar-Blackhole binary systems), extremely fast spinning pulsars (e.g., sub-MSPs), and high dispersion measure (DM) pulsars. Such a situation is now changed thanks to the development of next generation radio telescope arrays such as Australian Square Kilometer Array Pathfinder (ASKAP). ASKAP is capable of conducting highly sensitive radio continuum surveys with wide sky coverage (e.g, Evolutionary Map of The Universe survey). One of the solutions is to find pulsar candidates in radio continuum surveys such as ASKAP surveys and then carry out targeted searches. This technique allows us to search over the wide bandwidth with full field of view while avoiding the need for expensive pixel-by-pixel high time resolution searches. In this proposal, we propose to observe 16 pulsar candidates identified in the Galactic plane using new ASKAP EMU images. We found 22 candidates by selecting sources with spectral index steeper than -2.0 and compactness less than 1.2. Among them 13 are known pulsars and a reasonable number of candidates to follow up (9 sources). In total, we have 16 candidates including seven sources from 2023APRS semester. Because of the dense ionised medium in the Galactic Plane, MSPs are likely to be missed by previous pulsar surveys carried out at 1.4 GHz. Here, we propose a targeted pulsar search with the Parkes UWL which allow us to search pulsation at higher frequencies and therefore avoid strong DM smearing and scattering effects.

</details>

*Ahmad, Adeel,Filipovic, Miroslav,Dai, Shi,Barnes, Luke,Lazarevic, Sanja*

Conclusion: 作者提出，在 ASKAP 等射电连续谱巡天中先寻找脉冲星候选体再开展针对性搜索，可在宽带宽、全视场内搜索，同时避免昂贵的逐像素高时间分辨率搜索；并提议用 Parkes UWL 在更高频率搜索脉动，以规避银道面强 DM 模糊和散射效应，从而弥补以往 1.4 GHz 巡天对 MSPs 的可能遗漏。这些观测能否实际发现脉冲星，根据摘要无法判断。该工作在方法上或与脉冲星搜索、计时及 DM 相关研究有潜在联系，但这并非摘要所确立的结果。

Abstract: Traditional pulsar searching techniques are not sensitive enough to extreme pulsars such as millisecond pulsars (MSPs) in compact binaries (e.g., Pulsar-Blackhole binary systems), extremely fast spinning pulsars (e.g., sub-MSPs), and high dispersion measure (DM) pulsars. Conclusion: 作者认为，由于银道面中致密的电离介质，此前在 1.4 GHz 开展的脉冲星巡天很可能漏掉 MSP；因此在更高频率上用 Parkes UWL 进行定向搜索可避免强烈的 DM 模糊和散射效应。该结论基于摘要所述的电离介质与低频搜索限制。根据摘要无法判断是否有脉冲星或 MSP 被实际探测到，也无法判断其与磁星、FRB 等主题的物理联系。

Such a situation is now changed thanks to the development of next generation radio telescope arrays such as Australian Square Kilometer Array Pathfinder (ASKAP). ASKAP is capable of conducting highly sensitive radio continuum surveys with wide sky coverage (e.g, Evolutionary Map of The Universe survey). One of the solutions is to find pulsar candidates in radio continuum surveys such as ASKAP surveys and then carry out targeted searches. This technique allows us to search over the wide bandwidth with full field of view while avoiding the need for expensive pixel-by-pixel high time resolution searches. TL;DR: 该提案提出利用 Parkes UWL 对 16 个由 ASKAP EMU 图像在银道面识别出的脉冲星候选体开展定向搜寻，以在更高频率上搜寻脉冲信号，从而规避强 DM 消色散不足与散射效应；这些候选体来自按谱指数陡于 -2.0、致密度小于 1.2 筛选出的 22 个源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统脉冲星搜寻技术对极端脉冲星（致密双星中的 MSPs、sub-MSPs、高 DM 脉冲星）不够灵敏；ASKAP 等下一代射电望远镜阵列带来高灵敏度、宽天区覆盖的射电连续谱巡天，可在其中寻找候选体再定向搜寻；且由于银道面浓密电离介质，MSPs 很可能被此前 1.4 GHz 巡天遗漏。

Method: 使用新的 ASKAP EMU 图像在银道面识别候选体，筛选条件为谱指数陡于 -2.0 且致密度小于 1.2，得到 22 个候选体（13 个已知脉冲星、9 个待跟踪候选体；共 16 个候选体，含来自 2023APRS 学期的七个源）；提议用 Parkes UWL 开展定向脉冲星搜寻，在更高频率上搜寻脉冲信号。观测时长、数据跨度与具体分析流程摘要未说明。

Result: 通过选择谱指数陡于 -2.0 且致密度小于 1.2 的源，共找到 22 个候选体，其中 13 个为已知脉冲星，9 个源为数量合理的可跟踪候选体；总计有 16 个候选体，包括来自 2023APRS 学期的七个源。摘要未报告实际的脉冲星搜寻探测结果或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，通过对 ASKAP EMU 等射电连续谱巡天识别出的候选体进行定向搜寻，可在全视场、宽带宽下搜寻，同时避免逐像素高时间分辨率搜寻的高昂代价；并提议用 Parkes UWL 在更高频率搜寻脉冲信号，以避免强烈的 DM 消色散不足与散射效应，从而应对银道面浓密电离介质导致 MSPs 被此前 1.4 GHz 巡天遗漏的问题。所提观测尚未给出结果，实际探测能力根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Traditional pulsar searching techniques are not sensitive enough to extreme pulsars such as millisecond pulsars (MSPs) in compact binaries (e.g., Pulsar-Blackhole binary systems), extremely fast spinning pulsars (e.g., sub-MSPs), and high dispersion measure (DM) pulsars. Such a situation is now changed thanks to the development of next generation radio telescope arrays such as Australian Square Kilometer Array Pathfinder (ASKAP). ASKAP is capable of conducting highly sensitive radio continuum surveys with wide sky coverage (e.g, Evolutionary Map of The Universe survey). One of the solutions is to find pulsar candidates in radio continuum surveys such as ASKAP surveys and then carry out targeted searches. This technique allows us to search over the wide bandwidth with full field of view while avoiding the need for expensive pixel-by-pixel high time resolution searches. In this proposal, we propose to observe 16 pulsar candidates identified in the Galactic plane using new ASKAP EMU images. We found 22 candidates by selecting sources with spectral index steeper than -2.0 and compactness less than 1.2. Among them 13 are known pulsars and a reasonable number of candidates to follow up (9 sources). In total, we have 16 candidates including seven sources from 2023APRS semester. Because of the dense ionised medium in the Galactic Plane, MSPs are likely to be missed by previous pulsar surveys carried out at 1.4 GHz. Here, we propose a targeted pulsar search with the Parkes UWL which allow us to search pulsation at higher frequencies and therefore avoid strong DM smearing and scattering effects.

</details>

</details>

Conclusion: 作者提出，利用ASKAP等下一代射电望远镜阵列的宽天区高灵敏度射电连续谱巡天识别脉冲星候选体后再开展针对性搜寻，可避免昂贵的逐像素高时间分辨率搜寻；使用Parkes UWL在更高频率搜寻可避开银道面强DM致散和散射效应，从而有望发现此前1.4 GHz巡天可能遗漏的MSP。根据摘要无法判断该提案的实际观测结果及对磁星、FRB等主题的适用性。

Abstract: Traditional pulsar searching techniques are not sensitive enough to extreme pulsars such as millisecond pulsars (MSPs) in compact binaries (e.g., Pulsar-Blackhole binary systems), extremely fast spinning pulsars (e.g., sub-MSPs), and high dispersion measure (DM) pulsars. Such a situation is now changed thanks to the development of next generation radio telescope arrays such as Australian Square Kilometer Array Pathfinder (ASKAP). ASKAP is capable of conducting highly sensitive radio continuum surveys with wide sky coverage (e.g, Evolutionary Map of The Universe survey). One of the solutions is to find pulsar candidates in radio continuum surveys such as ASKAP surveys and then carry out targeted searches. This technique allows us to search over the wide bandwidth with full field of view while avoiding the need for expensive pixel-by-pixel high time resolution searches. In this proposal, we propose to observe 16 pulsar candidates identified in the Galactic plane using new ASKAP EMU images. We found 22 candidates by selecting sources with spectral index steeper than -2.0 and compactness less than 1.2. Among them 13 are known pulsars and a reasonable number of candidates to follow up (9 sources). In total, we have 16 candidates including seven sources from 2023APRS semester. Because of the dense ionised medium in the Galactic Plane, MSPs are likely to be missed by previous pulsar surveys carried out at 1.4 GHz. Here, we propose a targeted pulsar search with the Parkes UWL which allow us to search pulsation at higher frequencies and therefore avoid strong DM smearing and scattering effects.

TL;DR: 该提案计划使用 Parkes UWL 对由 ASKAP EMU 图像在银道面中筛选出的 16 个脉冲星候选体开展定向脉冲星搜索，以在更高频率上规避银道面电离介质造成的 DM 致散和散射影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统脉冲星搜索技术对致密双星中的 MSP、sub-MSPs 和高 DM 脉冲星等极端脉冲星不够灵敏。ASKAP 等下一代射电望远镜阵列可开展高灵敏度宽天区射电连续谱巡天，从而支持先在连续谱巡天中寻找候选体、再进行定向搜索的方案；银道面中致密的电离介质可能使此前 1.4 GHz 巡天漏掉 MSP。

Method: 利用新的 ASKAP EMU 图像在银道面中识别候选体，筛选条件为谱指数陡于 -2.0 且致密度小于 1.2，共发现 22 个候选体；其中 13 个为已知脉冲星，9 个可作后续跟踪，最终合计 16 个候选体（含 2023APRS 学期的七个源）。拟使用 Parkes UWL 在更高频率开展定向脉冲星搜索以搜索脉冲信号。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度或分析流程细节。

Result: 按谱指数陡于 -2.0 且致密度小于 1.2 的筛选标准，从 ASKAP EMU 图像中在银道面发现 22 个候选体：13 个为已知脉冲星，9 个为可供后续跟踪的候选体；加上 2023APRS 学期的七个源，总共形成 16 个候选体。摘要指出此前 1.4 GHz 的脉冲星巡天因银道面致密电离介质而很可能漏掉 MSP，但未报告新观测的探测结果。

Conclusion: 作者主张，利用 ASKAP EMU 等射电连续谱巡天先筛选候选体、再用 Parkes UWL 在更高频率进行定向搜索，可避免银道面致密电离介质造成的强 DM 致散和散射效应，从而有助于找回此前 1.4 GHz 巡天可能漏掉的 MSP 等极端脉冲星。根据摘要无法判断该方案能否实际探测到这些候选体的脉冲信号。

Abstract: Traditional pulsar searching techniques are not sensitive enough to extreme pulsars such as millisecond pulsars (MSPs) in compact binaries (e.g., Pulsar-Blackhole binary systems), extremely fast spinning pulsars (e.g., sub-MSPs), and high dispersion measure (DM) pulsars. Such a situation is now changed thanks to the development of next generation radio telescope arrays such as Australian Square Kilometer Array Pathfinder (ASKAP). ASKAP is capable of conducting highly sensitive radio continuum surveys with wide sky coverage (e.g, Evolutionary Map of The Universe survey). One of the solutions is to find pulsar candidates in radio continuum surveys such as ASKAP surveys and then carry out targeted searches. This technique allows us to search over the wide bandwidth with full field of view while avoiding the need for expensive pixel-by-pixel high time resolution searches. In this proposal, we propose to observe 16 pulsar candidates identified in the Galactic plane using new ASKAP EMU images. We found 22 candidates by selecting sources with spectral index steeper than -2.0 and compactness less than 1.2. Among them 13 are known pulsars and a reasonable number of candidates to follow up (9 sources). In total, we have 16 candidates including seven sources from 2023APRS semester. Because of the dense ionised medium in the Galactic Plane, MSPs are likely to be missed by previous pulsar surveys carried out at 1.4 GHz. Here, we propose a targeted pulsar search with the Parkes UWL which allow us to search pulsation at higher frequencies and therefore avoid strong DM smearing and scattering effects.

</details>

Abstract: Traditional pulsar searching techniques are not sensitive enough to extreme pulsars such as millisecond pulsars (MSPs) in compact binaries (e.g., Pulsar-Blackhole binary systems), extremely fast spinning pulsars (e.g., sub-MSPs), and high dispersion measure (DM) pulsars. Such a situation is now changed thanks to the development of next generation radio telescope arrays such as Australian Square Kilometer Array Pathfinder (ASKAP). This technique allows us to search over the wide bandwidth with full field of view while avoiding the need for expensive pixel-by-pixel high time resolution searches. In this proposal, we propose to observe 16 pulsar candidates identified in the Galactic plane using new ASKAP EMU images. We found 22 candidates by selecting sources with spectral index steeper than -2.0 and compactness less than 1.2. Among them 13 are known pulsars and a reasonable number of candidates to follow up (9 sources). In total, we have 16 candidates including seven sources from 2023APRS semester. Because of the dense ionised medium in the Galactic Plane, MSPs are likely to be missed by previous pulsar surveys carried out at 1.4 GHz. Here, we propose a targeted pulsar search with the Parkes UWL which allow us to search pulsation at higher frequencies and therefore avoid strong DM smearing and scattering effects.

</details>


### [3636] [Parkes observations for project P1330 semester 2025APRS_01]()
*Bhakta, Deven,Ransom, Scott,DeCesar, Megan,Dai, Shi*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案旨在继续用 Parkes 对球状星团 NGC6316 中高度加速的双星毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1716-2808A 进行计时，以建立一年半的计时 campaign，打破位置与自转减慢率之间的计时简并，并形成可追溯至 2022 年的三年计时基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者此前在球状星团 NGC6316 中发现了高度加速的双星毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1716-2808A，并用 Parkes 求解了其轨道，目前正在计时（P1330）。摘要指出，为打破脉冲星位置与自转减慢率之间的计时简并，需要建立足够长的计时基线。

Method: 摘要说明将继续使用 Parkes 对该 MSP 进行计时观测（项目 P1330），并指出在 OCT2024 学期还剩五次计划观测；目标是在至少一年按月节奏观测的基础上建立一年半的计时 campaign，并将其与可追溯至 2022 年的先前观测连接形成三年计时基线。摘要未说明具体的观测频率、时间跨度细节、采样或分析流程。

Result: 摘要报告发现了 PSR J1716-2808A（NGC6316A），即球状星团 NGC6316 中的一颗高度加速双星毫秒脉冲星；此前已用 Parkes 求解其轨道，目前正在计时。OCT2024 学期尚有五次计划观测。摘要未给出任何计时参数、轨道参数、位置、自转减慢率、显著性或其他数值结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，继续这些 Parkes 观测可建立一年半的计时 campaign，并有助于打破脉冲星位置与自转减慢率之间的计时简并，从而将观测连接为三年的计时基线；此外，这些数据还可用于对后续观测中新发现的脉冲星计时。根据摘要无法判断该 MSP 与其他脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）的物理联系或可迁移性。

Abstract: We discovered PSR J1716-2808A (NGC6316A), a highly accelerated binary millisecond pulsar (MSP), in the globular cluster NGC6316. We previously used Parkes to solve the orbit of this MSP and are currently timing it (P1330). We have five scheduled observations remaining in the OCT2024 semester. The goal of the proposed observations is to establish a year and a half long timing campaign with at least a year of monthly cadence observations. This is crucial to break the timing degeneracy that occurs between the pulsar's position and the pulsar's spindown rate. We will be able to use this to connect the pulsar to our previous observations spanning back to 2022, thereby creating a three year timing baseline. A secondary advantage of having these observations is that the data can also be used time any new pulsars that are discovered in any subsequent observations.

</details>

Conclusion: 摘要明确指出，拟议观测对于打破脉冲星位置与自转减慢率之间的计时简并至关重要，并可用于把该脉冲星与 2022 年以来的先前观测连接起来，从而形成三年的计时基线。摘要还指出，作为次要优势，这些数据也可用于对后续观测中新发现的脉冲星进行计时。摘要未报告已经完成的物理结论；根据摘要无法判断位置、自转减慢率或任何其他脉冲星参数的最终测定结果。

Abstract: We discovered PSR J1716-2808A (NGC6316A), a highly accelerated binary millisecond pulsar (MSP), in the globular cluster NGC6316. We previously used Parkes to solve the orbit of this MSP and are currently timing it (P1330). We have five scheduled observations remaining in the OCT2024 semester. The goal of the proposed observations is to establish a year and a half long timing campaign with at least a year of monthly cadence observations. This is crucial to break the timing degeneracy that occurs between the pulsar's position and the pulsar's spindown rate. We will be able to use this to connect the pulsar to our previous observations spanning back to 2022, thereby creating a three year timing baseline. A secondary advantage of having these observations is that the data can also be used time any new pulsars that are discovered in any subsequent observations.

</details>


### [3638] [Parkes observations for project P1207 semester 2023OCTS_02]()
*Xu, xin,Dai, Shi,Shang, Lunhua,Bai, Juntao,Zhi, QiJun*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划用Parkes确认九个Bulge方向脉冲星候选体，并对四个探测S/N&gt;20且距离大于3kpc的明亮候选体进行计时，以确定其自转和天体测量参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Bulge中是否存在大量脉冲星、尤其是毫秒脉冲星，是长期未决问题。此前用FAST对Bulge方向一小块区域的巡天发现了超过10个脉冲星候选体，其中四个估计距离大于3kpc、可能位于Bulge；而已知Bulge脉冲星数量很少，因此需要确定这些脉冲星的自转与天体测量参数。

Method: 摘要未说明观测时间跨度与具体接收机设置；提案为使用Parkes对九个脉冲星候选体开展确认观测，并对其中四个明亮候选体进行计时；这四个候选体的选取条件是探测S/N&gt;20且距离大于3kpc；候选体来自此前用FAST对Bulge方向一小块区域进行的巡天。

Result: 此前用FAST对Bulge方向一小块区域的巡天发现超过10个脉冲星候选体；其中四个明亮候选体估计距离大于3kpc，因此很可能位于Bulge区域。本次提案尚未给出Parkes观测结果，摘要未说明确认或计时结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，考虑到Bulge中已知脉冲星很少，确定这些脉冲星的自转和天体测量参数可能有助于理解Bulge的脉冲星族群，这些信息随后可用于研究该区域伽马射线辐射的起源和电子密度分布。根据摘要无法判断这些候选体与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射的联系。

Abstract: Whether there is a large population of pulsars in the Bulge, millisecond pulsars in particular, is a long-standing problem. We recently carried out a survey of a small region toward the Bulge with the Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Telescope (FAST) and discovered more than 10 pulsar candidates. Four bright pulsar candidates are estimated to have distances larger than 3kpc and are therefore likely located in the Bulge region. Considering the small number of pulsars we know in the Bulge, the determination of spin and astrometric parameters of these pulsars can be important for us to understand the pulsar population in the Bulge. These information can then be used to investigate the origin of Gamma-ray emission and the electron density distribution in the region. Here we propose to carry out confirmation observation of nine pulsar candidates and time those four bright ones (detected with S/N&gt;20, and with distance larger than 3kpc) with Parkes.

</details>

Motivation: 银河系核球中是否存在大量脉冲星、尤其是毫秒脉冲星，是长期未解决的问题。此前FAST对核球方向一小块区域的巡天发现了10个以上脉冲星候选体，其中四个明亮候选体估计距离大于3kpc、可能位于核球区域；而核球中已知脉冲星数量很少，因此确定这些脉冲星的自转与天体测量参数可能有助于理解核球脉冲星族群，并进一步研究该区域伽马射线辐射起源与电子密度分布。

Conclusion: 作者认为，考虑到核球中已知脉冲星数量很少，确定这些脉冲星的自转和天体测量参数可能对理解核球脉冲星族群很重要，这些信息随后可用于研究该区域伽马射线辐射的起源和电子密度分布。据此，作者提议用Parkes对九个候选体进行确认观测，并对四个明亮候选体进行计时。摘要尚未给出确认观测或计时的实际结果，因此对核球脉冲星族群、伽马射线起源与电子密度分布的具体物理结论根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Whether there is a large population of pulsars in the Bulge, millisecond pulsars in particular, is a long-standing problem. We recently carried out a survey of a small region toward the Bulge with the Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Telescope (FAST) and discovered more than 10 pulsar candidates. Four bright pulsar candidates are estimated to have distances larger than 3kpc and are therefore likely located in the Bulge region. Considering the small number of pulsars we know in the Bulge, the determination of spin and astrometric parameters of these pulsars can be important for us to understand the pulsar population in the Bulge. These information can then be used to investigate the origin of Gamma-ray emission and the electron density distribution in the region. Here we propose to carry out confirmation observation of nine pulsar candidates and time those four bright ones (detected with S/N&gt;20, and with distance larger than 3kpc) with Parkes.

</details>

*Xu, xin,Dai, Shi,Shang, Lunhua,Bai, Juntao,Zhi, QiJun*

  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 作者近期用FAST在朝向Bulge的一小块区域巡天，发现10个以上脉冲星候选体；其中四个明亮候选体估计距离大于3kpc，因此很可能位于Bulge区域。摘要提到将用Parkes对九个候选体做确认观测，并对四个明亮候选体计时，但未给出确认或计时结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，鉴于Bulge中已知脉冲星很少，确定这些脉冲星的自转与天体测量参数可能有助于理解Bulge的脉冲星population；这些信息随后可用于研究该区域伽马射线辐射的起源和电子密度分布。上述为提案所述的科学目标与潜在意义，摘要未给出已获得的确认或计时结论。

Abstract: Whether there is a large population of pulsars in the Bulge, millisecond pulsars in particular, is a long-standing problem. We recently carried out a survey of a small region toward the Bulge with the Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Telescope (FAST) and discovered more than 10 pulsar candidates. Four bright pulsar candidates are estimated to have distances larger than 3kpc and are therefore likely located in the Bulge region. Considering the small number of pulsars we know in the Bulge, the determination of spin and astrometric parameters of these pulsars can be important for us to understand the pulsar population in the Bulge. These information can then be used to investigate the origin of Gamma-ray emission and the electron density distribution in the region. ### [3645] [Parkes observations for project P1027 semester 2019OCTS_06]()
*Dai, Shi,Murphy, Tara,Lenc, Emil,Hobbs, George,Cameron, Andrew,Kaplan, David*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟用Parkes对ASKAP和Parkes UWL发现的新毫秒脉冲星J1431-6328（自转周期2.77 ms，可能位于双星系统）进行后续观测，以测量双星参数并获得计时解，为其作为脉冲星计时阵列候选体及未来计时观测奠定基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ASKAP与Parkes UWL发现的新毫秒脉冲星J1431-6328需要后续观测；摘要指出该发现展示了在射电连续谱图像中识别脉冲星候选体、再用高时间分辨率观测跟踪的能力，并指出该脉冲星可能处于双星系统，需要测得其双星参数以指导未来多波段观测，可能为双星演化提供新见解。

Method: 拟利用Parkes开展后续观测；摘要提到ASKAP与Parkes超宽带低频（UWL）接收机用于发现该脉冲星，并提到高时间分辨率观测；拟通过后续观测测量双星参数并获得该新脉冲星的计时解。观测频率或频段、时间跨度、样本量及具体分析流程摘要未说明。

Result: PSR J1431-6328是一颗新毫秒脉冲星，自转周期为2.77 ms，很可能处于双星系统中；该发现展示了在射电连续谱图像中识别脉冲星候选体、随后用高时间分辨率观测进行跟踪的能力；该脉冲星具有较短的自转周期、相对较大的通量密度及其天区位置，因此被视为脉冲星计时阵列的有前景候选体。后续观测的双星参数、计时解等具体结果摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为后续Parkes观测将测得双星参数并指导未来多波段观测，可能为双星演化提供新见解；所提议观测将获得该新脉冲星的计时解，对未来的计时观测至关重要，且其短周期、相对较大通量密度和天区位置使其成为脉冲星计时阵列的有前景候选体。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射的具体物理联系。

Abstract: We propose to carry out Parkes follow-up observations of the new millisecond pulsar, J1431-6328, discovered by the Australian SKA Pathfinder (ASKAP) and Parkes Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver. The discovery demonstrated the power of identifying pulsar candidates in radio continuum images and then following up with high time resolution observations. The discovery itself is also interesting. PSR J1431-6328 has a spin period of 2.77 ms, and is likely to be in a binary system. Follow-up observations will enable us to measure the binary parameters, which will guide future multi-wavelength observations and might shed new lights on the binary evolution. The short spin period, relatively large flux density and sky location of PSR J1431-6328 also make it a promising candidate for pulsar timing arrays. The proposed observations will allow us to obtain a timing solution of this new pulsar, and are therefore essential for future timing observations.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者认为，所提议的Parkes后续观测将能够测量该脉冲星的双星参数，从而指导未来多波段观测，并可能为双星演化提供新认识；这些观测还将获得该新脉冲星的计时解，因此对未来的计时观测至关重要。摘要未说明其与磁星、单脉冲发射、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱或快速射电暴（FRB）的直接联系；根据摘要无法判断这些方面的可迁移性。

Abstract: We propose to carry out Parkes follow-up observations of the new millisecond pulsar, J1431-6328, discovered by the Australian SKA Pathfinder (ASKAP) and Parkes Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver. The discovery demonstrated the power of identifying pulsar candidates in radio continuum images and then following up with high time resolution observations. The discovery itself is also interesting. PSR J1431-6328 has a spin period of 2.77 ms, and is likely to be in a binary system. Follow-up observations will enable us to measure the binary parameters, which will guide future multi-wavelength observations and might shed new lights on the binary evolution. The short spin period, relatively large flux density and sky location of PSR J1431-6328 also make it a promising candidate for pulsar timing arrays. The proposed observations will allow us to obtain a timing solution of this new pulsar, and are therefore essential for future timing observations.

### [3647] [Parkes observations for project P1027 semester 2019OCTS_12]()
*Dai, Shi,Murphy, Tara,Lenc, Emil,Hobbs, George,Cameron, Andrew,Kaplan, David*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟用 Parkes 对 ASKAP 与 Parkes UWL 发现的新毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1431-6328（自转周期 2.77 ms，可能处于双星系统）开展后续观测，以获得其计时解并测量双星参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1431-6328 是新发现的毫秒脉冲星，自转周期 2.77 ms，且很可能处于双星系统中；需要后续观测来测量双星参数，以指导未来多波段观测并可能为双星演化研究提供线索。其短自转周期、相对较大的流量密度和天空位置也使其成为脉冲星计时阵列的有前景候选体，因此需要获得计时解。

Method: 摘要指出将利用 Parkes 对 PSR J1431-6328 开展后续观测；该脉冲星由 ASKAP 和 Parkes UWL 接收机发现，发现方式是在射电连续谱图像中识别脉冲星候选体，随后用高时间分辨率观测进行跟踪。摘要说明拟议观测将用于获得这颗新脉冲星的计时解并测量双星参数。观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本量及具体分析细节摘要未说明。

Result: PSR J1431-6328 由 ASKAP 和 Parkes UWL 接收机发现；其自转周期为 2.77 ms，很可能处于双星系统中。摘要称该发现展示了在射电连续谱图像中识别脉冲星候选体并继以高时间分辨率观测进行跟踪的能力。该脉冲星具有较短的 自转周期、相对较大的 流量密度以及特定的天空位置。摘要未说明后续观测是否已获得双星参数或计时解。

Conclusion: 作者认为，后续观测将能够测量双星参数，从而指导未来的多波段观测，并可能为双星演化带来新的启示；所提议的观测将获得该脉冲星的计时解，因此对未来的计时观测至关重要。PSR J1431-6328 的短自转周期、相对较大的流量密度和天空位置使其成为脉冲星计时阵列的有前景候选体。根据摘要无法判断该脉冲星与磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）的联系。

Abstract: We propose to carry out Parkes follow-up observations of the new millisecond pulsar, J1431-6328, discovered by the Australian SKA Pathfinder (ASKAP) and Parkes Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver. The discovery demonstrated the power of identifying pulsar candidates in radio continuum images and then following up with high time resolution observations. The discovery itself is also interesting. PSR J1431-6328 has a spin period of 2.77 ms, and is likely to be in a binary system. Follow-up observations will enable us to measure the binary parameters, which will guide future multi-wavelength observations and might shed new lights on the binary evolution. The short spin period, relatively large flux density and sky location of PSR J1431-6328 also make it a promising candidate for pulsar timing arrays. The proposed observations will allow us to obtain a timing solution of this new pulsar, and are therefore essential for future timing observations.

</details>
