Result: 摘要主要说明提案目标而非已获得的结果：PSR J1431-6328 自转周期为 2.77 ms，处于轨道周期 88 天的极宽双星系统中，伴星质量极低；其脉冲轮廓稳定、轨道宽。计划通过结合一个月高节奏计时与先前常规监测获得相干计时解并高精度测量天体测量和轨道参数。计时解、宽带偏振性质及双星系统研究的结果计划在本学期末发表，摘要未给出具体数值结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为该极低质量伴星与长轨道周期的双星系统对理解双星演化具有独特价值，且 PSR J1431-6328 是脉冲星计时阵列和强等效原理检验的良好候选；预期获得相干计时解并高精度测量天体测量与轨道参数，相关计时解、宽带偏振性质和双星系统研究结果将在本学期末发表。根据摘要无法判断其对磁星、单脉冲发射、模式转换或 FRB 等的具体物理关联。

Abstract: We propose to continue the timing campaign of the new millisecond pulsar, J1431-6328, discovered by the Australian SKA Pathfinder (ASKAP). PSR J1431-6328 has a spin period of 2.77 ms and is in a very wide binary system with an orbital period of 88 days. The extremely low mass of the companion and the long orbital period make this binary system unique for the understanding of binary evolution. The stable profile and wide orbit of J1431-6328 also makes it a good candidate for pulsar timing arrays and tests of the strong equivalence principle. Combing one month of high cadence timing with previous regular monitoring, we aim to obtain a coherent timing solution of PSR J1431?6328 and measure its astrometric and orbital parameters with high precision. Results on the timing solution, wide band polarisation properties of this pulsar and studies of the binary system will be published at the end of this semester.

</details>


### [4160] [Parkes observations for project P1058 semester 2021OCTS_01]()
*Dai, Shi,Murphy, Tara,Lenc, Emil,Hobbs, George,Li, Di,Cameron, Andrew,Kaplan, David*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟继续对 ASKAP 新发现的毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1431-6328（自转周期 2.77 ms，位于轨道周期 88 天的宽双星系统）开展计时观测，目标是通过一个月的高节奏计时结合此前常规监测获得相干计时解，并高精度测量其天体测量与轨道参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1431-6328 是 ASKAP 新发现的毫秒脉冲星，其伴星质量极低且轨道周期长达 88 天，这一组合使其在理解双星演化方面具有独特性；其稳定脉冲轮廓与宽轨道也使其成为脉冲星计时阵列和强等效原理检验的良好候选者，因此需要持续的计时监测。

Method: 摘要说明将延续对 PSR J1431-6328 的计时活动，把一个月的高节奏计时与之前的常规监测相结合，以获得相干计时解并高精度测量天体测量与轨道参数；摘要还提及将研究该脉冲星的宽带偏振性质及双星系统。观测仪器、频段、具体时间跨度、样本量与统计分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要主要陈述提案目标而非已有结果：PSR J1431-6328 的自转周期为 2.77 ms，处于轨道周期 88 天的极宽双星系统，伴星质量极低；其脉冲轮廓稳定、轨道宽。摘要称计时解、宽带偏振性质与双星系统研究结果将在本学期末发表，因此尚未给出计时、偏振或轨道参数的测量数值与显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为该系统的极低伴星质量与长轨道周期使其对理解双星演化具有独特价值，其稳定轮廓与宽轨道使其适合用于脉冲星计时阵列和强等效原理检验；结合高节奏与常规监测有望获得相干计时解并高精度测定天体测量与轨道参数。与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射的直接联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose to continue the timing campaign of the new millisecond pulsar, J1431-6328, discovered by the Australian SKA Pathfinder (ASKAP). PSR J1431-6328 has a spin period of 2.77 ms and is in a very wide binary system with an orbital period of 88 days. The extremely low mass of the companion and the long orbital period make this binary system unique for the understanding of binary evolution. The stable profile and wide orbit of J1431-6328 also makes it a good candidate for pulsar timing arrays and tests of the strong equivalence principle. Combing one month of high cadence timing with previous regular monitoring, we aim to obtain a coherent timing solution of PSR J1431?6328 and measure its astrometric and orbital parameters with high precision. Results on the timing solution, wide band polarisation properties of this pulsar and studies of the binary system will be published at the end of this semester.

</details>


### [4161] [Parkes observations for project P941 semester 2018OCTS_01]()
*Papitto, Alessandro,Possenti, Andrea,Burgay, Marta,Corongiu, Alessandro,Stella, Luigi,Rea, Nanda,Bozzo, Enrico,Ferrigno, Carlo,Sanna, Andrea,Di Salvo, Tiziana,Burderi, Luciano,Iaria, Rosario*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划用 Parkes 64m 望远镜对处于紧密双星系统中的吸积毫秒脉冲星 MAXI J0911-655 开展 4 x 4 小时 NAPA 观测，在 X 射线爆发结束后数天内捕捉吸积停止后可能出现的射电脉冲星激活；这是未触发的提案 P941 的重新提交。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过渡型毫秒脉冲星在吸积供能（X射线）态与自转供能（射电）态之间快速切换，其发现为研究双星演化情景以及脉冲星磁层与吸积流的相互作用提供了新途径。MAXI J0911-655 是 NGC 2808 中首颗被发现的吸积毫秒脉冲星，处于 P_orb~40 min 的紧密双星系统并已 X 射线爆发超过两年，因此需要在其吸积停止后捕捉射电脉冲星的可能激活。

Method: 提议使用 Parkes 64m 望远镜对 MAXI J0911-655 进行 4 x 4 小时的 NAPA 观测，安排在 X 射线爆发结束后数天内执行，以捕捉一旦吸积停止后系统中可能出现的射电脉冲星激活。摘要未说明具体的分析流程、数据处理或统计方法。

Result: 该提案尚未触发执行：这是提案 P941 的重新提交，未触发是因为 {\src} 尚未衰减进入 X 射线宁静态。摘要报告 MAXI J0911-655 是 NGC 2808 中首颗被发现的吸积毫秒脉冲星，处于 P_orb~40 min 的紧密双星系统，且已处于 X 射线爆发状态超过两年。摘要未报告此次提议观测的探测结果。

Conclusion: 作者指出，若探测到射电脉冲星，所提议的观测将能够测量吸积事件后射电脉冲星开启所需时间，并研究一个拥有极轻伴星的双星系统中的状态转换。对于过渡型毫秒脉冲星磁层—吸积流相互作用的具体物理机制及其与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）等的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Transitional millisecond pulsars show rapid swings between accretion-powered (X-ray) and rotation-powered (radio) pulsar state. Their discovery opened a brand new window to study binary evolutionary scenarios and the interplay between the pulsar magnetosphere and accretion flows. MAXI J0911-655 is the first accreting millisecond pulsars discovered in the globular cluster NGC 2808. It is harboured in a close binary system (P_orb~40 min) and is in X-ray outburst for more than two years. We propose 4 x 4 hours NAPA observations of the source with the Parkes 64m telescope, to be performed within a few days from the end of the X-ray outburst, to catch the possible activation of a radio pulsar in the system expected as soon as accretion ceases. In case of a detection, the proposed observations will allow measuring the time needed for a radio pulsar to turn on after an accretion event, and to study state transitions in a binary system harbouring a very light donor star. This is the re-submission of prop. P941, not triggered as {\src} has not faded into X-ray quiescence yet.

</details>


### [4162] [Parkes observations for project P943 semester 2020APRS_01]()
*Bhattacharyya, Bhaswati,Johnston, Simon,Weltevrede, Patrick,Stappers, Benjamin,Roy, Jayanta,Agar, Crispin*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请请求在Parkes望远镜上使用UWL接收机对五颗由GMRT在Fermi未认证伽马射线源巡天中发现的毫秒脉冲星进行16小时观测，以研究其此前尚未探索的射电偏振性质、发射几何结构、射电与伽马射线发射起源，以及轮廓演化和频谱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 五颗毫秒脉冲星（PSR J1120-3618、PSR J1207-5050、PSR J1536-4948、PSR J1646-2142、PSR J1828+0625）是用GMRT在Fermi未认证伽马射线源巡天中发现的，其射电偏振性质迄今尚未被探索；摘要指出需要新的观测来研究其发射几何结构、射电与伽马射线发射起源以及宽频段的轮廓演化和频谱。

Method: 申请使用Parkes望远镜UWL接收机在0.7至4 GHz的大带宽进行射电偏振观测，并请求16小时观测时间；同时结合GMRT在700 MHz以下的观测。摘要称将利用相对相位对齐研究发射几何结构及射电与伽马射线发射起源，并研究这些MSP在150 MHz至4 GHz的轮廓演化和频谱。样本为五颗毫秒脉冲星。具体观测时间跨度、分析流程和统计方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未说明。该文为观测时间申请，未报告观测结果或分析结论；摘要仅说明这些MSP的射电偏振性质迄今尚未被探索，并指出Parkes UWL大带宽偏振观测将在这方面很有价值，且可补充GMRT在700 MHz以下关于频谱和轮廓演化的认识。摘要未给出任何测量数值、显著性、脉冲轮廓、偏振或频谱结果。

Conclusion: 摘要表述的是拟开展研究的预期价值：利用Parkes UWL在0.7至4 GHz的偏振观测有望有助于研究这些MSP的发射几何结构以及射电与伽马射线发射的起源，并与GMRT低于700 MHz的观测互补，用于研究其频谱和轮廓演化。由于摘要未报告实际观测结果，其物理结论尚无法评估；根据摘要无法判断这些预期能否实现，也无法判断与脉冲星计时、自转减慢力矩变化或磁星—快速射电暴（FRB）联系的相关性。

Abstract: We request observing time at the Parkes telescope for observing five millisecond pulsars - PSR J1120-3618, PSR J1207-5050, PSR J1536-4948, PSR J1646-2142 and PSR J1828+0625. These MSPs were discovered in a survey of Fermi unidentified gamma-ray sources with the GMRT. Radio polarisation properties of these MSPs are hitherto unexplored, and observations with the Parkes UWL receiver will be very valuable in that aspect. Main aims of this proposal are, (i) Investigation of emission geometry and probing the origin of radio and gamma-ray emission with relative phase alignment using polarisation observations with the Parkes telescope. (ii) Investigation of profile evolution and spectra for these MSPs from 150 MHz to 4 GHz with Parkes and GMRT observations. Proposed radio polarisation study with the Parkes telescope over the large bandwidth UWL receiver between 0.7 to 4 GHz, will complement our knowledge on spectra and profile evolution below 700 MHz with the GMRT observations. We request 16-hours of observing time at the Parkes to perform this study.

</details>


### [4163] [Parkes observations for project P1050 semester 2022OCTS_13]()
*Sengar, Rahul,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Morello, Vincent,Bhandari, Shivani,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Wongphechauxsorn, Jompoj,Chen, Weiwei,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请报告为 HTRU-S LowLat 和 PMPS 再处理中新发现的 115 颗脉冲星（其中 20 颗来自 PMPS）申请后续计时观测，指出至少一年的初始计时是充分刻画新脉冲星、推导其参数并探测异常行为的最低要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新发现的脉冲星通常只有在确认并开展后续计时之后才能获得有意义的科学结果；至少一年的初始计时是充分刻画新脉冲星、推导特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率并探测可能的发射不稳定性所需的最短时间跨度。摘要指出本项目对双星脉冲星、高 DM 脉冲星、散射轮廓脉冲星以及 UWL 波段宽带发射脉冲星的计时是必要的。

Method: 摘要说明该项目申请观测时间，用于 HTRU-S LowLat 与 PMPS 再处理中新发现脉冲星的计时 campaign；已完成 HTRU-S LowLat 巡天的 90%，并用基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、template bank 与 fast folding algorithm pipeline 完成零加速度 PMPS 搜索。摘要提及 OCTS22 的后续计时以及 UWL 波段，但未说明具体望远镜、接收机、观测频率、时间跨度、样本量或统计方法，摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告已完成 HTRU-S LowLat 巡天的 90%，并完成了零加速度 PMPS 搜索，共发现 115 颗此前未知的脉冲星，其中 20 颗发现于 PMPS。摘要指出新发现脉冲星包括双星脉冲星、高 DM 脉冲星、轮廓被散射的脉冲星以及在 UWL 波段较大带宽上显示发射的明亮脉冲星，并预期至少一年的初始计时可用于推导特征年龄、磁场强度和自转减慢率等参数以及探测意外行为。摘要未给出具体脉冲星参数数值、显著性或其他定量计时结果。

Conclusion: 摘要明确支持的结论是：至少一年的初始计时是充分刻画新发现脉冲星、推导特征年龄、磁场强度和自转减慢率等参数并探测可能由发射不稳定性导致的意外行为的最低要求；OCTS22 的后续计时将有助于完成许多长期科学目标，所获数据还将帮助理解星际介质性质、光谱性质以及脉冲星发射机制。根据摘要无法判断这些新脉冲星的具体物理性质或与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）的联系。

Abstract: This is a request for the observation time for the timing campaign of new pulsars discovered in the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU-S survey (HTRU-S LowLat) and the Parkes Multibeam Pulsar Survey (PMPS). We have completed 90 % of the HTRU-S LowLat survey and completed zero acceleration PMPS search with GPU-based coherent acceleration search, template bank, and fast folding algorithm pipelines and now have discovered 115 previously unknown pulsars among which 20 were found in the PMPS. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation, and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. At least one year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, and spin-down rate, as well as for detecting any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This project is necessary for the timing of several interesting pulsars, including binary pulsars, high DM pulsars, scattered profile pulsars, and bright ones that show emissions in larger bandwidths in the UWL band. The follow-up timing in OCTS22 will assist in completing many exciting large-term science goals. In addition, the data obtained from this timing project will allow us to obtain many auxiliary scientific results which would help us understand the nature of the interstellar medium, spectral properties as well as pulsar emission mechanism.

</details>


### [4164] [Parkes observations for project P1050 semester 2022OCTS_03]()
*Sengar, Rahul,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Morello, Vincent,Bhandari, Shivani,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Wongphechauxsorn, Jompoj,Chen, Weiwei,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel*

Method: 摘要是观测时间申请；已重新处理 HTRU-S 巡天低银道面区域（HTRU-S LowLat）与 Parkes 多波束脉冲星巡天（PMPS），完成 HTRU-S LowLat 的 90%，并使用基于 GPU 的相干加速度搜索、模板库和快速折叠算法流水线完成 PMPS 的零加速度搜索。摘要未说明具体望远镜、接收机、频率范围、观测时间跨度、样本数量及统计分析方法；OCTS22 后续计时拟在 UWL 波段开展。

Result: 已发现 115 颗此前未知脉冲星，其中 20 颗在 PMPS 中发现；HTRU-S LowLat 巡天已完成 90%，PMPS 的零加速度搜索已完成。所列计时对象类型包括双星脉冲星、高 DM 脉冲星、轮廓被散射的脉冲星，以及在 UWL 波段较大带宽内显示出辐射的明亮脉冲星。摘要未报告具体计时结果、脉冲轮廓、偏振、DM 或 RM 数值及统计显著性。

Abstract: This is a request for the observation time for the timing campaign of new pulsars discovered in the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU-S survey (HTRU-S LowLat) and the Parkes Multibeam Pulsar Survey (PMPS). We have completed 90 % of the HTRU-S LowLat survey and completed zero acceleration PMPS search with GPU-based coherent acceleration search, template bank, and fast folding algorithm pipelines and now have discovered 115 previously unknown pulsars among which 20 were found in the PMPS. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation, and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. At least one year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, and spin-down rate, as well as for detecting any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This project is necessary for the timing of several interesting pulsars, including binary pulsars, high DM pulsars, scattered profile pulsars, and bright ones that show emissions in larger bandwidths in the UWL band. The follow-up timing in OCTS22 will assist in completing many exciting large-term science goals. In addition, the data obtained from this timing project will allow us to obtain many auxiliary scientific results which would help us understand the nature of the interstellar medium, spectral properties as well as pulsar emission mechanism.

</details>

### [4166] [Parkes observations for project P1050 semester 2022OCTS_19]()
*Sengar, Rahul,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Champion, David,Jameson, Andrew,Cameron, Andrew,Ng, Cherry,Petroff, Emily,Barr, Ewan,Flynn, Chris,Morello, Vincent,Bhandari, Shivani,Balakrishnan, Vishnu,Wongphechauxsorn, Jompoj,Chen, Weiwei,Colom I Bernadich, Miquel*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新发现的脉冲星通常只有经过确认和后续计时才能产生有意义的科学成果，而充分刻画脉冲星所需的最短时间跨度为至少一年的初始计时，用以导出脉冲星参数并探测可能的发射不稳定性；该项目针对若干有趣脉冲星（双星、高DM、散射轮廓及UWL波段宽带辐射的亮脉冲星）的计时需求提出。

Result: 摘要报告已发现115颗此前未知的脉冲星，其中20颗是在PMPS中发现的；HTRU-S LowLat巡天已完成90 %，零加速度PMPS搜索已通过基于GPU的相干加速度搜索、模板库和快速折叠算法流水线完成。新发现的脉冲星群体中包含双星脉冲星、高DM脉冲星、具有散射轮廓的脉冲星，以及在UWL波段更大带宽上显示辐射的亮脉冲星。具体计时结果、数值和显著性，摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为，至少一年的初始计时是充分刻画新发现脉冲星并导出特征年龄、磁场强度、自转减慢率等参数以及探测发射不稳定性所致意外行为的必要条件；OCTS22的后续计时将有助于完成长期科学目标，其数据还可提供关于星际介质性质、光谱特性以及脉冲星发射机制的辅助科学成果。根据摘要无法判断与磁星—快速射电暴（FRB）联系或单脉冲、模式转换、偏振等具体物理问题的关系。

Abstract: This is a request for the observation time for the timing campaign of new pulsars discovered in the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU-S survey (HTRU-S LowLat) and the Parkes Multibeam Pulsar Survey (PMPS). We have completed 90 % of the HTRU-S LowLat survey and completed zero acceleration PMPS search with GPU-based coherent acceleration search, template bank, and fast folding algorithm pipelines and now have discovered 115 previously unknown pulsars among which 20 were found in the PMPS. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation, and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. At least one year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, and spin-down rate, as well as for detecting any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This project is necessary for the timing of several interesting pulsars, including binary pulsars, high DM pulsars, scattered profile pulsars, and bright ones that show emissions in larger bandwidths in the UWL band. The follow-up timing in OCTS22 will assist in completing many exciting large-term science goals. In addition, the data obtained from this timing project will allow us to obtain many auxiliary scientific results which would help us understand the nature of the interstellar medium, spectral properties as well as pulsar emission mechanism.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者认为后续计时对完整刻画新发现脉冲星是必要的，可导出特征年龄、磁场强度和自旋减慢率等参数，并探测可能源于发射不稳定性的异常行为；OCTS22的后续计时将有助于完成多项长期科学目标。所获数据还可用于理解星际介质性质、光谱性质以及脉冲星发射机制。摘要未说明对磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射的具体结论，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: This is a request for the observation time for the timing campaign of new pulsars discovered in the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU-S survey (HTRU-S LowLat) and the Parkes Multibeam Pulsar Survey (PMPS). We have completed 90 % of the HTRU-S LowLat survey and completed zero acceleration PMPS search with GPU-based coherent acceleration search, template bank, and fast folding algorithm pipelines and now have discovered 115 previously unknown pulsars among which 20 were found in the PMPS. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation, and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. At least one year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, and spin-down rate, as well as for detecting any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This project is necessary for the timing of several interesting pulsars, including binary pulsars, high DM pulsars, scattered profile pulsars, and bright ones that show emissions in larger bandwidths in the UWL band. The follow-up timing in OCTS22 will assist in completing many exciting large-term science goals. In addition, the data obtained from this timing project will allow us to obtain many auxiliary scientific results which would help us understand the nature of the interstellar medium, spectral properties as well as pulsar emission mechanism.

Conclusion: 作者认为，至少一年的初始计时是充分表征新发现脉冲星、推导特征年龄、磁场强度和自转减慢率等参数并探测可能由发射不稳定性导致的意外行为的必要条件，OCTS22 中的后续计时将有助于完成许多长期科学目标；该项目的数据还可用于获得辅助科学结果，以帮助理解星际介质的性质、频谱特性以及脉冲星发射机制。摘要未说明这些解释所依据的具体观测证据。

Abstract: This is a request for the observation time for the timing campaign of new pulsars discovered in the reprocessing of the low-latitude Galactic plane section of the HTRU-S survey (HTRU-S LowLat) and the Parkes Multibeam Pulsar Survey (PMPS). We have completed 90 % of the HTRU-S LowLat survey and completed zero acceleration PMPS search with GPU-based coherent acceleration search, template bank, and fast folding algorithm pipelines and now have discovered 115 previously unknown pulsars among which 20 were found in the PMPS. Interesting science can usually only be derived from a new pulsar after confirmation, and a follow-up timing campaign is carried out. At least one year of initial timing is the minimum timespan required to fully characterise any newly-discovered pulsars, essential for deriving pulsar parameters such as the characteristic age, magnetic field strength, and spin-down rate, as well as for detecting any unexpected behaviour of the pulsar which might result from emission instabilities. This project is necessary for the timing of several interesting pulsars, including binary pulsars, high DM pulsars, scattered profile pulsars, and bright ones that show emissions in larger bandwidths in the UWL band. The follow-up timing in OCTS22 will assist in completing many exciting large-term science goals. In addition, the data obtained from this timing project will allow us to obtain many auxiliary scientific results which would help us understand the nature of the interstellar medium, spectral properties as well as pulsar emission mechanism.

</details>

Motivation: 脉冲星闪烁包含散射光之间光程差的信息；对许多明亮脉冲星的观测提示散射并非随机，而是来自视线方向上一个或多个薄透镜的强各向异性散射。透镜与地球的距离可多年不变，有时还会产生持续一个月的分立像，其简单性与长寿命提示可能用有限参数建模并做预测。摘要未说明更具体的知识空白。

Method: 摘要说明拟用 Parkes Ultra Wideband Receiver 和 H-OH receiver 观测最亮脉冲星 B0833-45 的闪烁，该源显示出分立透镜像和强各向异性散射的证据；将检验对闪烁图样频率演化给出具体预言的闪烁模型，并利用偏振数据搜寻跨越透镜的磁性空间结构。观测时间跨度、数据量、样本大小及具体分析流程摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要为观测提案，未报告观测结果。摘要仅陈述既有认识：许多明亮脉冲星的闪烁观测表明散射并非随机，而是一个或多个薄透镜处的强各向异性散射所致；透镜到地球的距离可多年保持不变，某些情况下透镜产生持续一个月的源的分立像；B0833-45 显示出分立透镜像和强各向异性散射的证据。数值结果与统计显著性摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者提出通过观测检验对闪烁图样频率演化有具体预言的闪烁模型，并用偏振数据搜寻被理论认为可产生各向异性散射透镜的磁性空间结构；同时利用该巨型星际透镜的高灵敏度和分辨率限制 Vela 脉冲星的发射区尺寸。作者未给出实际结论，因为这是观测提案。与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、单脉冲、模式转换、计时或自转减慢转矩变化的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Pulsar scintillation, variation of the observed pulsar flux against time and frequency, contains the information of light path difference between scattered light. Observations of scintillation from many bright pulsars suggest that the scattering is not random, but instead due to highly anisotropic scattering at one more thin lenses along the line of sight. The distance from the lens to the Earth can remain the same for years, and in some cases, the lens produces discrete images of the source that last for a month. The simplicity of the scattered images, and the longevity of the lenses suggest that it may be possible to model the lens with a finite number of parameters, and make a predictive model for pulsar scintillation. We propose to observe the scintillation of the brightest pulsar, B0833-45, which shows evidence of discrete lensed images and highly anisotropic scattering, with the Parkes Ultra Wideband Receiver and the H-OH receiver. With these observations, we will test scintillation models, which make concrete predictions for the frequency evolution of the scintillation pattern. We will also use the polarization data to search for magnetic spatial structures across the lens, which have been theorized as a mechanism to create the lenses responsible for anisotropic scattering. Meanwhile, we will use the great sensitivity and resolution of this giant interstellar lens to constrain the emission region size of the Vela pulsar.

</details>

### [4184] [Parkes observations for project P737 semester 2016OCTS]()
*Hobbs, George,Manchester, Dick,Johnston, Simon,Sarkissian, John,Reynolds, John,Bailes, Matthew,Keith, Michael,van Straten, Willem,Kerr, Matthew,Jameson, Andrew,Shannon, Ryan*

TL;DR: 这是一份 Parkes 望远镜项目 P737 的观测申请，旨在通过对 PSR J0437-4715 从升起到落下的观测，测量馈源中的交叉耦合，以测试无法在标准维护期内完成的新后端仪器，并将结果提供给望远镜使用者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高层次脉冲星观测已带来重要天文成果，而新后端仪器的某些测试无法在标准维护期内完成；高精度脉冲星计时实验需要测量馈源中的交叉耦合，而该测量只能借助特定观测方式实现，因此需要专门申请观测时间。

Method: 使用 Parkes 射电望远镜开展脉冲星观测；申请对 PSR J0437-4715 进行从升起到落下的观测，以测量馈源中的交叉耦合；目标是测试新的后端仪器。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度、采样规模及数据处理方法。

Conclusion: 作者申请开展对 PSR J0437-4715 从升起到落下的观测，以测量馈源交叉耦合并测试新的后端仪器，且拟将结果公开供望远镜用户使用。摘要未给出这些测试所得出的物理结论。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、单脉冲发射、模式转换、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱或 FRB 的联系。

Abstract: Pulsar observations using the Parkes radio telescope have led to some of the most exciting astronomical results in the last few years. The aim of this proposal is to carry out tests of the new backend instruments which cannot be carried out during standard maintenance periods. High precision pulsar timing experiments require cross-coupling in the feed to be measured. This can only be done using observations of PSR J0437-4715 from rise-to-set. We propose to undertake such observations and make the results available for any users of the telescope.

</details>

### [4186] [Parkes observations for project P1168 semester 2022OCTS_03]()
*DeCesar, Megan,Ransom, Scott,Kerr, Matthew,Dai, Shi*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 利用 Green Bank Telescope 在球状星团 Terzan 1 中首次发现了七颗脉冲星，包括五颗自转周期为 3 到 6 ms 的完全再循环毫秒脉冲星、一颗 11 ms 毫秒脉冲星和一颗自转周期为 134 ms 的脉冲星；初步计时表明七颗很可能都是孤立脉冲星，并申请用 Parkes 的 UWL 接收机开展三次观测以检验其计时可行性并搜寻新脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 Terzan 1 中首次发现脉冲星，为研究该核心坍缩球状星团中的脉冲星族群提供了新样本；其中 134 ms 长周期脉冲星在电子俘获形成脉冲星而非核心坍缩超新星形成的背景下特别值得关注，而其在 Parkes 是否可被有效计时尚待检验。

Method: 使用 Green Bank Telescope 发现并初步计时 Terzan 1 中的七颗脉冲星；申请三次 Parkes 观测，使用 UWL 接收机，利用宽带宽在低频灵敏度与高频散射减弱之间取得平衡，以检验这些脉冲星在 Parkes 的计时效果；除计时外，还在拟议观测中搜寻新脉冲星。

Result: 在球状星团 Terzan 1 中发现七颗脉冲星，为该星团首次发现：五颗完全再循环毫秒脉冲星自转周期在 3 到 6 ms 之间，一颗 11 ms 毫秒脉冲星，以及一颗自转周期异常长的 134 ms 脉冲星。初步计时表明七颗很可能都是孤立脉冲星，与 Terzan 1 是核心坍缩球状星团相一致。

Conclusion: 作者认为，七颗脉冲星很可能都是孤立脉冲星这一初步计时结果与 Terzan 1 作为核心坍缩球状星团的性质一致；134 ms 长周期脉冲星在通过电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成脉冲星的背景下是特别有趣的发现。Parkes 观测能否成功计时取决于这些脉冲星是否足够明亮；若可计时，将继续一整年的观测或于下一学期继续计时。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射的具体联系。

Abstract: We have discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope, the first pulsars to be found in this cluster. The discoveries include five fully-recycled millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with spin periods between 3 and 6 ms, an 11-ms MSP, and a pulsar with an unusually long spin period of 134 ms. Preliminary timing suggests that all seven are likely isolated pulsars, consistent with Terzan 1 being a core-collapsed globular cluster. The 134-ms pulsar is an especially interesting discovery in the context of pulsar formation via electron-capture rather than core-collapse supernovae. We propose three Parkes observations with the UWL receiver to test how well these pulsars can be timed at Parkes; the wide bandwidth will provide a balance of sensitivity at low frequencies and reduced scattering at high frequencies. If the pulsars are sufficiently bright to be timed, we will either request completing a full year of observations under continuing status or propose to continue the timing campaign in the next semester. In addition to timing, the proposed observations will also be searched for new pulsars.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者认为这七颗很可能均为孤立脉冲星，这与 Terzan 1 作为核心坍缩球状星团的图像一致；134 ms 脉冲星在脉冲星通过电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成的背景下是尤其令人感兴趣的发现。若脉冲星足够明亮可被计时，将申请在 continuing status 下完成一整年观测或在下一学期继续计时。至于其与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射等的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We have discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope, the first pulsars to be found in this cluster. The discoveries include five fully-recycled millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with spin periods between 3 and 6 ms, an 11-ms MSP, and a pulsar with an unusually long spin period of 134 ms. We propose three Parkes observations with the UWL receiver to test how well these pulsars can be timed at Parkes; the wide bandwidth will provide a balance of sensitivity at low frequencies and reduced scattering at high frequencies. If the pulsars are sufficiently bright to be timed, we will either request completing a full year of observations under continuing status or propose to continue the timing campaign in the next semester. In addition to timing, the proposed observations will also be searched for new pulsars.

</details>

*DeCesar, Megan,Ransom, Scott,Kerr, Matthew,Dai, Shi*

Method: 摘要未说明。

Result: 在球状星团 Terzan 1 中首次发现七颗脉冲星：五颗完全再循环毫秒脉冲星，自转周期在 3 至 6 ms 之间；一颗 11 ms 的毫秒脉冲星；以及一颗自转周期异常长的 134 ms 脉冲星。初步计时表明这七颗很可能都是孤立脉冲星，与 Terzan 1 是核心坍缩球状星团相一致。134 ms 脉冲星在通过电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成脉冲星的背景下特别有趣。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现与 Terzan 1 作为核心坍缩球状星团的图像相一致，并特别指出 134 ms 脉冲星在电子俘获形成脉冲星的背景下值得关注。所申请的 Parkes UWL 观测将检验这些脉冲星能否被有效计时；若足够亮可计时，则计划在 continuing status 下完成一年观测或在下一学期继续计时 campaña，同时搜寻新脉冲星。

Abstract: We have discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope, the first pulsars to be found in this cluster. The discoveries include five fully-recycled millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with spin periods between 3 and 6 ms, an 11-ms MSP, and a pulsar with an unusually long spin period of 134 ms. Preliminary timing suggests that all seven are likely isolated pulsars, consistent with Terzan 1 being a core-collapsed globular cluster. The 134-ms pulsar is an especially interesting discovery in the context of pulsar formation via electron-capture rather than core-collapse supernovae. We propose three Parkes observations with the UWL receiver to test how well these pulsars can be timed at Parkes; the wide bandwidth will provide a balance of sensitivity at low frequencies and reduced scattering at high frequencies. If the pulsars are sufficiently bright to be timed, we will either request completing a full year of observations under continuing status or propose to continue the timing campaign in the next semester. In addition to timing, the proposed observations will also be searched for new pulsars.

</details>


### [4189] [Parkes observations for project P1180 semester 2023APRS_01]()
*Bhat, Ramesh,Dai, Shi,McSweeney, Samuel James,Meyers, Bradley,Kudale, Sanjay,Xue, Mengyao,Sett, Susmita,Grover, Garvit*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划用 Parkes（Murriyang）对 SMART 巡天中的两颗脉冲星 PSR J1357-2530 和 PSR J0452-3418 进行 GHz 频段宽带后续观测，以扩展频率覆盖并详细研究其脉冲轮廓结构和单脉冲现象学及其频率依赖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1357-2530 此前以错误名称和存在差异的色散量被报道，缺乏精确位置与计时解；PSR J0452-3418 是 SMART 巡天新发现。PSR J1357-2530 可能属于罕见的低光度、陡谱脉冲星类别，理解其发射与谱性质有助于描绘银河系脉冲星群体并预测未来低频巡天（包括 SKA-Low）的可探测群体。

Method: 摘要说明拟利用 Parkes（Murriyang）观测，将两颗脉冲星的频率覆盖扩展至 GHz 频率，以研究脉冲轮廓结构和单脉冲现象学及其频率依赖性。后续观测已在利用 MWA 档案数据和 uGMRT 定向观测（300-750 MHz）进行。具体观测时长、频段细节、计时与偏振分析流程、样本统计方法等，摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：PSR J0452-3418 为 SMART 巡天新发现，自转周期 1.665 s，色散量 $19.6\,pc\,cm^{-3}$。PSR J1357-2530 实为重新发现，先前文献报道名称有误、色散量存在差异，且无可用的精确位置或计时解。PSR J1357-2530 可能属于罕见的低光度、陡谱脉冲星类别，这类脉冲星约占当前已知长周期脉冲星群体的 ~2%。摘要未给出 Parkes 观测的实际结果。

Conclusion: 作者主张，对这两颗脉冲星开展 GHz 频率的宽带后续观测可扩展频率覆盖，从而详细刻画其脉冲轮廓结构与单脉冲现象学及其频率依赖性；理解低光度、陡谱脉冲星的发射与谱性质，对于构建更全面的银河系脉冲星群体图景，以及为未来低频巡天（包括计划中的 SKA-Low）可探测脉冲星群体作出有意义的预测，具有重要价值。根据摘要无法判断该低频巡天可探测群体预测在具体数值或模型层面的可迁移性。

Abstract: We propose to carry out broadband follow-up observations of two new pulsars discovered in the ongoing SMART pulsar survey. PSR J1357-2530 is actually a re-discovery, but was originally reported in the literature with an incorrect name and discrepant dispersion measure, and no accurate position or timing solution available. PSR J0452-3418 is a new discovery from the SMART survey, with a spin period of 1.665 s and dispersion measure of $19.6\,pc\,cm^{-3}$. PSR J1357-2530 likely belongs to the rare class of low-luminosity, steep-spectrum pulsars; a class of pulsars that make up ~2% of the currently-known population of long-period pulsars. As such, understanding their emission and spectral properties is vital for developing a more comprehensive picture of the Galactic population of pulsars, and to make meaningful forecasts for the detectable population of pulsars in future low-frequency surveys, including those planned with SKA-Low. Follow-up of both pulsars is under way, using MWA archival data and targeted observations with the uGMRT (300-750 MHz). Parkes (Murriyang) observations will enable us to extend the frequency coverage to GHz frequencies, allowing us to investigate their pulse profile structure and single-pulse phenomenology in detail, including their frequency dependence.

</details>

As such, understanding their emission and spectral properties is vital for developing a more comprehensive picture of the Galactic population of pulsars, and to make meaningful forecasts for the detectable population of pulsars in future low-frequency surveys, including those planned with SKA-Low. Follow-up of both pulsars is under way, using MWA archival data and targeted observations with the uGMRT (300-750 MHz). Parkes (Murriyang) observations will enable us to extend the frequency coverage to GHz frequencies, allowing us to investigate their pulse profile structure and single-pulse phenomenology in detail, including their frequency dependence.

### [4191] [Parkes observations for project P1168 semester 2024APRS_02]()
*DeCesar, Megan,Ransom, Scott,Kerr, Matthew,Dai, Shi,Bhakta, Deven,Singleton, Justine*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 在球状星团 Terzan 1 中发现七颗脉冲星，包括五颗 3–6 ms 的完全再循环毫秒脉冲星、一颗 11 ms 的部分再循环 MSP 和一颗 134 ms 长周期脉冲星；Parkes 计时确认它们均为孤立系统，与 Terzan 1 的核心坍缩性质相符。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 球状星团 Terzan 1 中脉冲星的发现与计时可为理解星团动力学和脉冲星形成途径提供样本。摘要指出的关键问题是：这颗 134 ms 脉冲星特征年龄仅 23 Myr，其形成可能涉及电子俘获过程而非核心坍缩超新星；同时需要长基线计时来确认其年轻或年老性质并约束内禀自旋性质。摘要未说明。

Method: 利用绿岸望远镜（GBT）发现七颗脉冲星，并在过去一年中用 Parkes 望远镜开展计时观测；提议继续 Parkes 计时至 2024OCT，以获得长基线计时解，用于测量自行和可能额外的自旋导数；此外将探测脉冲星偏振性质和 Terzan 1 方向的银河系磁场，并在所提议观测中搜寻先前可能遗漏的新脉冲星。摘要未说明具体观测频率、频段、时间跨度细节或样本量。

Result: 在 Terzan 1 中发现七颗脉冲星：五颗自旋周期 3–6 ms 的完全再循环毫秒脉冲星、一颗 11 ms 的部分再循环 MSP、一颗自旋周期异常长的 134 ms 脉冲星。Parkes 计时确认七颗脉冲星均为孤立，与 Terzan 1 是核心坍缩球状星团相符。134 ms 脉冲星特征年龄为 23 Myr。相关论文正在准备，计划于 2024 年 1 月或 2 月提交。摘要未说明显著性数值或不确定度。

Conclusion: 作者认为，134 ms 脉冲星 23 Myr 的特征年龄使其在电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成脉冲星的背景下特别有趣；孤立脉冲星与核心坍缩球状星团的相符性得到计时确认。作者提议通过继续计时获得长基线解，以测量自行和可能额外自旋导数，从而探测星团动力学、约束脉冲星内禀自旋性质并确认该 134 ms 脉冲星的年轻或年老性质。根据摘要无法判断该方法对磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲研究的直接适用性。

Abstract: We discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope (GBT) and have been timing them over the last year with the Parkes Telescope. The discoveries include five fully-recycled millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with spin periods between 3 and 6 ms, a partially-recycled 11-ms MSP, and a pulsar with an unusually long spin period of 134 ms. With our Parkes timing campaign, we have confirmed that all seven pulsars are isolated, consistent with Terzan 1 being a core-collapsed globular cluster. The 134-ms pulsar has a characteristic age of 23 Myr and is thus an especially interesting discovery in the context of pulsar formation via electron-capture rather than core-collapse supernovae. (We are preparing a paper detailing these results and will submit it in January or February 2024.) We propose to continue timing Terzan 1 at Parkes in order to obtain long-baseline timing solutions, which will yield measurements of proper motion and potentially additional spin derivatives that together can be used to probe the cluster dynamics, constrain intrinsic spin properties of the pulsars, and confirm the young vs. old nature of the 134 ms pulsar. In addition to timing, we will probe the pulsars' polarization properties and the Galactic magnetic field in the direction of Terzan 1; and the proposed observations will also be searched for new pulsars that may have been missed in previous observations. We request continuing status to continue these timing observations through 2024OCT.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 摘要报告在 Terzan 1 中发现七颗脉冲星：五颗完全再循环毫秒脉冲星（MSP），自转周期在 3 到 6 ms 之间；一颗部分再循环的 11-ms MSP；一颗自转周期异常长为 134 ms 的脉冲星。Parkes 计时活动确认七颗脉冲星均为孤立，与 Terzan 1 是核心坍缩球状星团相一致。134-ms 脉冲星的特征年龄为 23 Myr。摘要还提到作者正在准备一篇详述这些结果的论文，并计划于 2024 年 1 月或 2 月提交。

Conclusion: 作者认为，七颗脉冲星均为孤立这一结果与 Terzan 1 是核心坍缩球状星团相一致；134-ms 脉冲星特征年龄为 23 Myr，使其在通过电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成脉冲星的背景下成为尤其令人感兴趣的发现，但摘要称该脉冲星的年轻与年老性质仍待继续计时确认。作者计划通过长基线计时解探测星团动力学并约束脉冲星内禀自转性质，并探测脉冲星偏振性质与 Terzan 1 方向上的银河系磁场。该工作与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、单脉冲发射或模式转换的直接联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope (GBT) and have been timing them over the last year with the Parkes Telescope. The discoveries include five fully-recycled millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with spin periods between 3 and 6 ms, a partially-recycled 11-ms MSP, and a pulsar with an unusually long spin period of 134 ms. With our Parkes timing campaign, we have confirmed that all seven pulsars are isolated, consistent with Terzan 1 being a core-collapsed globular cluster. The 134-ms pulsar has a characteristic age of 23 Myr and is thus an especially interesting discovery in the context of pulsar formation via electron-capture rather than core-collapse supernovae. (We are preparing a paper detailing these results and will submit it in January or February 2024.) We propose to continue timing Terzan 1 at Parkes in order to obtain long-baseline timing solutions, which will yield measurements of proper motion and potentially additional spin derivatives that together can be used to probe the cluster dynamics, constrain intrinsic spin properties of the pulsars, and confirm the young vs. old nature of the 134 ms pulsar. In addition to timing, we will probe the pulsars' polarization properties and the Galactic magnetic field in the direction of Terzan 1; and the proposed observations will also be searched for new pulsars that may have been missed in previous observations. We request continuing status to continue these timing observations through 2024OCT.

*Hobbs, George,Manchester, Dick,Green, James,Johnston, Simon,Sarkissian, John,Reynolds, John,Bailes, Matthew,van Straten, Willem,Jameson, Andrew,Shannon, Ryan,Kaczmarek, Jane,Dai, Shi*

Method: 摘要说明使用 Parkes 射电望远镜开展脉冲星观测，对 PSR J0437-4715 进行从升起到落下的观测，以测量馈源交叉耦合，并利用 P737 测试无法在标准维护期内完成的新后端仪器测试，以及调试 UWB 等新接收机。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、时间跨度、数据量、数据处理与统计分析方法。

Abstract: Pulsar observations using the Parkes radio telescope have led to some of the most exciting astronomical results in the last few years. The aim of this proposal is to carry out tests of the new backend instruments which cannot be carried out during standard maintenance periods. High precision pulsar timing experiments require cross-coupling in the feed to be measured. This can only be done using observations of PSR J0437-4715 from rise-to-set. We propose to undertake such observations and make the results available for any users of the telescope. We will also use P737 to commission new receivers such as the UWB.

</details>

*Hobbs, George,Manchester, Dick,Green, James,Johnston, Simon,Sarkissian, John,Reynolds, John,Bailes, Matthew,van Straten, Willem,Jameson, Andrew,Shannon, Ryan,Kaczmarek, Jane,Dai, Shi*

### [4245] [Parkes observations for project P1323 semester 2024APRS_01]()
*Bennett, Alex,Bhat, Ramesh,Driver, Simon,Meyers, Bradley*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案发展了一种利用 Gaia DR3 和 RACS-low 图像筛选大质量非退化伴星脉冲星候选体的新技术，从约 100 个候选体中选出五个最佳候选体，拟用 Parkes 射电望远镜 Murriyang 进行脉冲星搜寻后续观测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 寻找具有大质量非退化伴星的脉冲星双星系统；这类系统被认为伴星光谱型为 O 或 B 型、约 10 太阳质量，且脉冲星不从伴星吸积物质。摘要说明的新技术以 Gaia DR3 和已知七个非退化伴星系统确定的选择参数来缩小候选体名单。摘要未说明。

Method: 发展了一种利用 Gaia 第三次数据发布（DR3）筛选候选体的技术，选择参数基于已知的七个非退化伴星系统；从筛选后约 100 个候选体中，检查 Rapid ASKAP Continuum Survey（RACS-low）公开图像，判断伴星位置处或附近是否存在射电源；RACS-low 空间分辨率为 15 角秒，据此选出最佳五个候选体，拟用 Parkes 射电望远镜 Murriyang 进行后续脉冲星搜寻观测。摘要未说明观测频率、时间跨度及分析细节。

Result: 摘要报告：所发展的技术利用 Gaia DR3 依据伴星缩小候选体名单；选择参数取自已知的七个具有非退化伴星的系统；从经筛选的约 100 个可能候选体中，通过检查 RACS-low 公开图像寻找伴星位置处或附近的射电源，选出最佳的五个候选体进行后续观测；拟使用 Parkes 射电望远镜 Murriyang 搜寻射电脉冲星。摘要未说明具体巡天结果、探测数量或显著性。

Conclusion: 这些候选体被怀疑是脉冲星双星系统，伴星为 O 或 B 型、约 10 太阳质量，脉冲星不从伴星吸积物质；该后续观测数据将作为一篇预计 2024 年底完成的硕士研究论文的主要组成部分。关于该方法能否推广至单脉冲、模式转换、偏振、脉冲轮廓演化或磁星与 FRB 关联等问题，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We have developed a novel technique to search for potential pulsars with massive, non-degenerate companions and are proposing to follow up on the first set of promising candidates. These candidates are suspected to be pulsar binary systems, with a companion star having spectral class O or B (roughly 10 solar masses), in which the pulsar is not accreting matter from this companion. The technique we have developed uses Gaia's third data release (DR3) to narrow down a list of candidates based on the companion star of these systems. The selection parameters are determined from the known systems with non-degenerate companions, of which there are seven. From a pruned list ~100 possible candidates, we inspected the publicly available images from the Rapid ASKAP Continuum Survey (RACS-low) to determine the presence of any radio sources at or near the location of the companion star, which could indicate a radio pulsar signal. RACS-low has a high spatial resolution (15 arcsec) allowing us to select the best five candidates to follow-up using the Parkes radio telescope, Murriyang, to search for a radio pulsar. This data will be used as a major component of a Masters research student thesis, due to complete at the end of 2024.

</details>


### [4246] [Parkes observations for project P1323 semester 2024APRS_02]()
*Bennett, Alex,Bhat, Ramesh,Driver, Simon,Meyers, Bradley*

Conclusion: 摘要的核心工作是提出并推进对五个候选脉冲星双星系统的Parkes/Murriyang后续射电搜寻，相关数据将构成一项预计2024年底完成的硕士论文的主要组成部分。对于这些候选体是否确为脉冲星双星、是否探测到射电脉冲，或与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）等是否存在联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We have developed a novel technique to search for potential pulsars with massive, non-degenerate companions and are proposing to follow up on the first set of promising candidates. These candidates are suspected to be pulsar binary systems, with a companion star having spectral class O or B (roughly 10 solar masses), in which the pulsar is not accreting matter from this companion. The technique we have developed uses Gaia's third data release (DR3) to narrow down a list of candidates based on the companion star of these systems. The selection parameters are determined from the known systems with non-degenerate companions, of which there are seven. From a pruned list ~100 possible candidates, we inspected the publicly available images from the Rapid ASKAP Continuum Survey (RACS-low) to determine the presence of any radio sources at or near the location of the companion star, which could indicate a radio pulsar signal. RACS-low has a high spatial resolution (15 arcsec) allowing us to select the best five candidates to follow-up using the Parkes radio telescope, Murriyang, to search for a radio pulsar. This data will be used as a major component of a Masters research student thesis, due to complete at the end of 2024.

</details>


### [4247] [Parkes observations for project P1365 semester 2026APRS_07]()
*Xue, Mengyao,Bhat, Ramesh,Zhu, Weiwei,Meyers, Bradley,Zhou, Yukai,Fu, Qiuyang,Tan, Chia Min,Lee, Christopher*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: SMART巡项目第二遍深度搜寻在过去一年中新发现16颗脉冲星（含两颗毫秒脉冲星），使SMART发现总数达到20颗；本项目申请用Parkes Murriyang望远镜对11颗新脉冲星开展计时跟踪观测，以确定其自转与天体测量参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SMART是首个在SKA-Low频段开展的南天脉冲星巡项目，其第二遍深度搜寻已发现新脉冲星，但这些新脉冲星的自转和天体测量参数尚需计时观测确定；同时，由于MWA自2025年起不再支持常规脉冲星观测，计时跟踪观测必须依赖其他望远镜。此外还需识别适合进一步详细跟踪观测的专门目标。

Method: 对80分钟观测开展SMART第二遍深度搜寻处理；使用Parkes Murriyang望远镜对11颗新脉冲星（包括上一学期的六颗）进行计时跟踪观测，该望远镜具备相同的天空覆盖、灵敏度和宽频率覆盖；数据将用于研究~100 MHz到4 GHz的脉冲轮廓、偏振和流量密度。摘要未说明具体观测频率设置、时间跨度与分析方法细节。

Result: 过去一年的第二遍处理发现了16颗新脉冲星，其中包括两颗毫秒脉冲星；结合第一遍结果，SMART发现总数达到20颗。此前学期的工作已证明Murriyang适用于对SMART发现进行计时。摘要未给出这11颗脉冲星的计时参数、脉冲轮廓、偏振或流量密度的具体测量结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些成果暗示了在SKA-Low频段开展的首个南天脉冲星巡项目的令人振奋的前景，并认为Parkes Murriyang望远镜因具备相同的天空覆盖、灵敏度和宽频率覆盖而是对SMART发现进行计时的最佳选择；相关分析与结果将纳入一篇在准备中的论文。根据摘要无法判断对磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射等主题的具体物理联系。

Abstract: Following the successful demonstration of a pilot first-pass (shallow) search of a small fraction of the sky, the second-pass processing has commenced for the SMART pulsar survey, which involves deep searches of 80-minute observations. Over the past year, this second-pass processing has led to the discovery of 16 new pulsars (including two millisecond pulsars), bringing the total number of SMART discoveries to 20 when combined with the first-pass results. These outcomes hint at the exciting promise of this first southern-sky pulsar survey in the frequency band of SKA-Low. All new pulsars require timing observations to determine their spin and astrometric parameters. Another important aspect of timing newly discovered pulsars is to identify specialised targets for further detailed follow-ups. Since the MWA no longer supports routine pulsar observations from 2025, timing follow-ups rely on other telescopes. The Parkes Murriyang telescope, with an identical sky coverage, sensitivity and the wide frequency coverage, offers the best option to time SMART discoveries. We have demonstrated Murriyang's suitability for this through previous semesters and are now extending the project to a sample of 11 pulsars, including six from the last semester. The data will also allow us to study pulse profiles, polarisation, and flux densities from ~100 MHz to 4 GHz. The analysis/results will be included in a publication in preparation that will detail the deep-search pipeline and report on initial pulsar discoveries.

</details>

Abstract: Following the successful demonstration of a pilot first-pass (shallow) search of a small fraction of the sky, the second-pass processing has commenced for the SMART pulsar survey, which involves deep searches of 80-minute observations. Over the past year, this second-pass processing has led to the discovery of 16 new pulsars (including two millisecond pulsars), bringing the total number of SMART discoveries to 20 when combined with the first-pass results. Since the MWA no longer supports routine pulsar observations from 2025, timing follow-ups rely on other telescopes. We have demonstrated Murriyang's suitability for this through previous semesters and are now extending the project to a sample of 11 pulsars, including six from the last semester. ### [4249] [Parkes observations for project P1365 semester 2026APRS_16]()

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 对80分钟观测开展第二轮深度搜寻处理；使用Parkes Murriyang望远镜进行计时后续观测，样本为11颗脉冲星，其中包括来自上一学期的六颗；数据将用于研究约100 MHz至4 GHz范围内的脉冲轮廓、极化和通量密度。分析/结果将纳入一篇正在准备中的出版物，详述深度搜寻流程并报告初步脉冲星发现。具体观测频率设置、时间跨度、分析流程细节摘要未说明。

Result: 第二遍深度处理在过去一年中新发现16颗脉冲星，其中包括两颗毫秒脉冲星；结合第一遍结果，SMART发现总数达到20颗。摘要指出这些结果暗示该巡天具有令人振奋的前景，并称此前学期的工作已演示Murriyang适用于对SMART发现目标进行计时。摘要提到数据将允许研究从约100 MHz到4 GHz的脉冲轮廓、偏振和通量密度，但未给出具体测量数值或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现暗示了首个在SKA-Low频段开展的南天脉冲星巡天的前景；所有新脉冲星都需计时观测来确定自转和天体测量参数，并识别适合进一步详细跟踪观测的专门目标；由于MWA自2025年起不再支持常规脉冲星观测，Parkes Murriyang望远镜因具有相同天空覆盖、灵敏度和宽频率覆盖而是计时SMART发现目标的最佳选择；相关分析/结果将纳入一篇正在准备中的出版物，详述深度搜寻流程并报告初步脉冲星发现。根据摘要无法判断与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射之间的物理联系。

Abstract: Following the successful demonstration of a pilot first-pass (shallow) search of a small fraction of the sky, the second-pass processing has commenced for the SMART pulsar survey, which involves deep searches of 80-minute observations. Over the past year, this second-pass processing has led to the discovery of 16 new pulsars (including two millisecond pulsars), bringing the total number of SMART discoveries to 20 when combined with the first-pass results. These outcomes hint at the exciting promise of this first southern-sky pulsar survey in the frequency band of SKA-Low. All new pulsars require timing observations to determine their spin and astrometric parameters. Another important aspect of timing newly discovered pulsars is to identify specialised targets for further detailed follow-ups. Since the MWA no longer supports routine pulsar observations from 2025, timing follow-ups rely on other telescopes. The Parkes Murriyang telescope, with an identical sky coverage, sensitivity and the wide frequency coverage, offers the best option to time SMART discoveries. We have demonstrated Murriyang's suitability for this through previous semesters and are now extending the project to a sample of 11 pulsars, including six from the last semester. The data will also allow us to study pulse profiles, polarisation, and flux densities from ~100 MHz to 4 GHz. The analysis/results will be included in a publication in preparation that will detail the deep-search pipeline and report on initial pulsar discoveries.

</details>

<details>

Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果暗示了SKA-Low频段首次南天脉冲星巡天具有令人振奋的前景；所有新脉冲星需要计时观测以确定自转和天体测量参数，并识别适合进一步详细跟踪观测的专门目标。Murriyang因具有相同天空覆盖、灵敏度和宽频率覆盖而被视为对SMART发现进行计时的最佳选择。与脉冲星计时、脉冲轮廓、极化和流量密度相关的研究将由正在准备中的出版物给出。关于磁星、单脉冲发射、模式转换、自转减速力矩变化或磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）联系的物理含义，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Following the successful demonstration of a pilot first-pass (shallow) search of a small fraction of the sky, the second-pass processing has commenced for the SMART pulsar survey, which involves deep searches of 80-minute observations. Over the past year, this second-pass processing has led to the discovery of 16 new pulsars (including two millisecond pulsars), bringing the total number of SMART discoveries to 20 when combined with the first-pass results. These outcomes hint at the exciting promise of this first southern-sky pulsar survey in the frequency band of SKA-Low. All new pulsars require timing observations to determine their spin and astrometric parameters. Another important aspect of timing newly discovered pulsars is to identify specialised targets for further detailed follow-ups. Since the MWA no longer supports routine pulsar observations from 2025, timing follow-ups rely on other telescopes. The Parkes Murriyang telescope, with an identical sky coverage, sensitivity and the wide frequency coverage, offers the best option to time SMART discoveries. We have demonstrated Murriyang's suitability for this through previous semesters and are now extending the project to a sample of 11 pulsars, including six from the last semester. The data will also allow us to study pulse profiles, polarisation, and flux densities from ~100 MHz to 4 GHz. The analysis/results will be included in a publication in preparation that will detail the deep-search pipeline and report on initial pulsar discoveries.

</details>

Abstract: Following the successful demonstration of a pilot first-pass (shallow) search of a small fraction of the sky, the second-pass processing has commenced for the SMART pulsar survey, which involves deep searches of 80-minute observations. Over the past year, this second-pass processing has led to the discovery of 16 new pulsars (including two millisecond pulsars), bringing the total number of SMART discoveries to 20 when combined with the first-pass results. These outcomes hint at the exciting promise of this first southern-sky pulsar survey in the frequency band of SKA-Low. All new pulsars require timing observations to determine their spin and astrometric parameters. Another important aspect of timing newly discovered pulsars is to identify specialised targets for further detailed follow-ups. Since the MWA no longer supports routine pulsar observations from 2025, timing follow-ups rely on other telescopes. The Parkes Murriyang telescope, with an identical sky coverage, sensitivity and the wide frequency coverage, offers the best option to time SMART discoveries. We have demonstrated Murriyang's suitability for this through previous semesters and are now extending the project to a sample of 11 pulsars, including six from the last semester. The data will also allow us to study pulse profiles, polarisation, and flux densities from ~100 MHz to 4 GHz. The analysis/results will be included in a publication in preparation that will detail the deep-search pipeline and report on initial pulsar discoveries.

### [4267] [Parkes observations for project P1365 semester 2026OCTS_01]()
*Xue, Mengyao,Bhat, Ramesh,Zhu, Weiwei,Meyers, Bradley,Sokolowski, Marcin,Di Pietrantonio, Cristian,Zhou, Yukai,Fu, Qiuyang,Tan, Chia Min,Lee, Christopher*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: SMART巡测第二遍处理新发现21颗脉冲星（含两颗毫秒脉冲星），使SMART发现总数达25颗；该提案申请Parkes Murriyang望远镜对一个由11颗脉冲星组成的样本进行计时观测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 所有SMART新发现脉冲星都需要计时观测以确定自转和天体测量参数，并识别可供进一步详细跟踪观测的专门目标。由于MWA目前无法用于常规脉冲星观测，计时跟踪必须依赖其他望远镜。

Method: SMART巡测的第二遍处理对80分钟观测进行深度搜索；计时跟踪使用Parkes Murriyang望远镜。目标样本经调整后保持为11颗脉冲星，移除了六颗、新增了六个新发现源（五个来自典型脉冲星搜索方法，一个来自基于图像的瞬变搜索技术）。数据频率覆盖~100 MHz到4 GHz，用于研究脉冲轮廓、极化和通量密度。摘要未说明具体观测时长、时间跨度与统计分析方法。

Result: 在过去一年中，第二遍处理已发现21颗新脉冲星，包括两颗毫秒脉冲星；与第一遍结果结合后，SMART发现总数达到25颗。这些结果表明，这项在SKA-Low频段进行的首个南天脉冲星巡测具有令人期待的前景。目标样本调整为11颗脉冲星，其中六颗因到本学期末将积累满一年Parkes计时数据而被移除。分析/结果将包含在即将发表的出版物中。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现暗示了在SKA-Low频段开展首个南天脉冲星巡测的令人期待的前景，并指出Parkes Murriyang望远镜因具有相同的天空覆盖、高灵敏度和宽频率覆盖，是对SMART发现进行计时的最佳选择。根据摘要无法判断这些目标的自转、天体测量、极化或谱性质的具体物理结论。

Abstract: Following the successful demonstration of a pilot first-pass (shallow) search of a small fraction of the sky, the second-pass processing has commenced for the SMART pulsar survey, which involves deep searches of 80-minute observations. Over the past year, this second-pass processing has led to the discovery of 21 new pulsars (including two millisecond pulsars), bringing the total number of SMART discoveries to 25 when combined with the first-pass results. These outcomes hint at the exciting promise of this first southern-sky pulsar survey in the frequency band of SKA-Low. All new pulsars require timing observations to determine their spin and astrometric parameters. Another important aspect of timing newly discovered pulsars is to identify specialised targets for further detailed follow-ups. Since the MWA is currently not available for routine pulsar observations, timing follow-ups rely on other telescopes. The Parkes Murriyang telescope, with identical sky coverage, high sensitivity, and wide frequency coverage, offers the best option for timing SMART discoveries. We have refined the proposed targets from our previous proposal by removing six pulsars that will have accumulated a full year of Parkes timing data by the end of the current semester, and by adding six newly discovered sources, five from typical pulsar searching methods, and one from image-based transient searching techniques, thereby maintaining a total sample of 11 pulsars. The data will also allow us to study pulse profiles, polarisation, and flux densities from ~100 MHz to 4 GHz. The analysis/results will be included in a forthcoming publication.

</details>


### [4268] [Parkes observations for project P1168 semester 2024OCTS_01]()
*DeCesar, Megan,Ransom, Scott,Kerr, Matthew,Dai, Shi,Bhakta, Deven,Singleton, Justine*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 在球状星团 Terzan 1 中发现七颗脉冲星，并用 Parkes 计时确认它们均为孤立脉冲星，其中包括五颗 3–6 ms 的完全再循环 MSP、一颗 11 ms 的部分再循环 MSP 和一颗 134 ms 的长周期脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Terzan 1 中脉冲星的发现与计时可用于检验该星团是否为核心坍缩星团，并特别关注 134 ms 脉冲星在电子俘获形成脉冲星背景下的意义；长期计时可用于探测星团动力学、约束脉冲星固有自转性质并确认该脉冲星的年轻与年老性质。

Method: 用 Green Bank Telescope（GBT）在球状星团 Terzan 1 中发现七颗脉冲星，随后用 Parkes Telescope 进行了 1.5 年计时；学生合作者将用 P1168 数据集对第八颗 MSP 计时。已获持续至 2024OCT 的延续状态，将继续在 Parkes 计时以获得长基线计时解，并探测偏振性质、Terzan 1 方向的银河系磁场以及搜索新脉冲星。

Result: 发现的七颗脉冲星包括五颗自转周期在 3 到 6 ms 之间的完全再循环 MSP、一颗 11 ms 的部分再循环 MSP，以及一颗自转周期为 134 ms 的脉冲星。Parkes 计时确认全部七颗均为孤立脉冲星，与 Terzan 1 为核心坍缩星团一致；134 ms 脉冲星的特征年龄为 23 Myr。另在 Ter 1 中发现第八颗 MSP。

Conclusion: 这七颗孤立脉冲星与 Terzan 1 为核心坍缩星团一致；134 ms 脉冲星特征年龄为 23 Myr，是电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成脉冲星背景下尤其有趣的发现。长期计时将测量自行并可能给出额外自转导数，用于探测星团动力学、约束固有自转性质并确认该 134 ms 脉冲星的年轻与年老性质；还将探测偏振性质和该方向的银河系磁场，并搜索可能被漏掉的新脉冲星。

Abstract: We discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope (GBT) and have been timing them over the last 1.5 year with the Parkes Telescope. The discoveries include five fully-recycled millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with spin periods between 3 and 6 ms, a partially-recycled 11-ms MSP, and a pulsar with an unusually long spin period of 134 ms. With our Parkes timing campaign, we have confirmed that all seven pulsars are isolated, consistent with Terzan 1 being a core-collapsed cluster. The 134-ms pulsar has a characteristic age of 23 Myr and is thus an especially interesting discovery in the context of pulsar formation via electron-capture rather than core-collapse supernovae. (We will submit our paper detailing these results by autumn 2024.) Student collaborator Bhakta discovered an eighth MSP in Ter 1 and will use the P1168 dataset to time it. We have been granted continuing status through 2024OCT, with which we will continue timing Terzan 1 at Parkes in order to obtain long-baseline timing solutions. This long-term timing will yield measurements of proper motion and potentially additional spin derivatives that together can be used to probe the cluster dynamics, constrain intrinsic spin properties of the pulsars, and confirm the young vs. old nature of the 134 ms pulsar. In addition to timing, we will probe the pulsars' polarization properties and the Galactic magnetic field in the direction of Terzan 1. We will also search these observations for new pulsars that may have been missed in previous observations.

</details>


### [4269] [Parkes observations for project P1365 semester 2026OCTS_02]()
*Xue, Mengyao,Bhat, Ramesh,Zhu, Weiwei,Meyers, Bradley,Sokolowski, Marcin,Di Pietrantonio, Cristian,Zhou, Yukai,Fu, Qiuyang,Tan, Chia Min,Lee, Christopher*

<details>

Result: 过去一年中，SMART巡天第二遍处理发现了21颗新脉冲星，包括两颗毫秒脉冲星；与第一遍结果合并后，SMART发现总数达到25颗。改进后的提案保持11颗脉冲星的总样本。摘要指出这些结果暗示了这一SKA-Low频段内首个南天脉冲星巡天的令人振奋的前景。计时观测的具体结果、脉冲轮廓、偏振与通量密度测量摘要未说明，分析/结果将包含在即将发表的出版物中。

Conclusion: 作者认为第二遍处理的发现显示SMART作为SKA-Low频段首个南天脉冲星巡天具有令人振奋的前景，并认为Parkes Murriyang望远镜因具相同天空覆盖、高灵敏度和宽频率覆盖而可提供对SMART发现源进行计时的最佳选择，该计时还可识别适合进一步详细后续观测的专门目标。至于这些源与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲发射等的物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Following the successful demonstration of a pilot first-pass (shallow) search of a small fraction of the sky, the second-pass processing has commenced for the SMART pulsar survey, which involves deep searches of 80-minute observations. Over the past year, this second-pass processing has led to the discovery of 21 new pulsars (including two millisecond pulsars), bringing the total number of SMART discoveries to 25 when combined with the first-pass results. These outcomes hint at the exciting promise of this first southern-sky pulsar survey in the frequency band of SKA-Low. All new pulsars require timing observations to determine their spin and astrometric parameters. Another important aspect of timing newly discovered pulsars is to identify specialised targets for further detailed follow-ups. Since the MWA is currently not available for routine pulsar observations, timing follow-ups rely on other telescopes. The Parkes Murriyang telescope, with identical sky coverage, high sensitivity, and wide frequency coverage, offers the best option for timing SMART discoveries. We have refined the proposed targets from our previous proposal by removing six pulsars that will have accumulated a full year of Parkes timing data by the end of the current semester, and by adding six newly discovered sources, five from typical pulsar searching methods, and one from image-based transient searching techniques, thereby maintaining a total sample of 11 pulsars. The data will also allow us to study pulse profiles, polarisation, and flux densities from ~100 MHz to 4 GHz. The analysis/results will be included in a forthcoming publication.

</details>


### [4270] [Parkes observations for project P971 semester 2024APRS_05]()
*Venkatraman Krishnan, Vivek,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Flynn, Chris,Reardon, Daniel John,Batrakov, Alexander*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案要求对相对论性脉冲星—白矮星双星 PSR J1141$-$6545 继续进行计时观测，以在更高精度上研究已有数据中已揭示的 Lense-Thirring 进动以及测地进动所暗示的复杂辐射束结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1141$-$6545 是独特的相对论性脉冲星—白矮星双星系统，可涉及从相对论现象到脉冲星辐射锥以及视线方向星际等离子体结构与分布的广泛物理问题；已有数据分析已揭示双星系统中 Lense-Thirring 进动的首次探测，并暗示了通过测地进动探测到的复杂辐射束结构，因此需要在未来数年继续计时以在更高精度上研究这些效应。

Method: 摘要说明将开展进一步的计时观测；所涉系统为相对论性脉冲星—白矮星双星 PSR J1141$-$6545，并提及对已有数据的分析。摘要未说明具体望远镜、观测频段、时间跨度、数据量或计时分析细节。标题提及 Parkes 观测与项目 P971 semester 2024APRS_05。

Result: 对已有数据的分析已经揭示了双星系统中 Lense-Thirring 进动的首次探测，并暗示了通过测地进动探测到的复杂辐射束结构。摘要未给出相关数值、精度或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为该独特系统可提供从相对论现象、脉冲星辐射锥研究到沿视线方向星际等离子体结构与分布的广泛物理研究途径，并指出未来数年对该系统进一步计时是在更高精度上研究 Lense-Thirring 进动与测地进动相关效应的必要条件。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射等课题的直接联系。

Abstract: We propose further timing observations of the relativistic pulsar - white-dwarf binary, PSR J1141$-$6545. This unique system offers access to a wide range of physics, from relativistic phenomena through pulsar emission cone studies, to the structure and distribution of interstellar plasma along our line-of-sight. The analysis of existing data has already revealed the first detection of Lense-Thirring precession in a binary star system, and hinted at complex emission beam structure probed via geodetic precession. Further timing of this system for the next few years is needed for studies of these effects at higher precision.

</details>


### [4271] [Parkes observations for project P971 semester 2024APRS_03]()

The analysis of existing data has already revealed the first detection of Lense-Thirring precession in a binary star system, and hinted at complex emission beam structure probed via geodetic precession. Further timing of this system for the next few years is needed for studies of these effects at higher precision.

</details>

### [4291] [Parkes observations for project P1019 semester 2019APRS_03]()
*van Jaarsveld, Naomi,Camilo, Fernando,Stappers, Benjamin,McBride, Vanessa*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: MeerKAT 在银河系盘面发现了一个与“Mouse”星云高度相似的弓形激波星云，其尖端很可能有一颗超声速运动的年轻脉冲星；作者提议用 UWL 接收机进行极深全轨道搜索，以发现该暗弱脉冲星或对其朝向地球的束流流量密度给出强限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MeerKAT 在银河系盘面巡天中发现了一个与“Mouse”星云显著相似的弓形激波星云，与 Mouse 一样，其尖端极可能存在一颗超声速运动的年轻脉冲星。但该区域已被 High Time Resolution Universe 低纬度巡天搜索过，说明这颗脉冲星必定很暗弱，因而需要更深的搜索。

Method: 摘要说明将使用新近可用的 UWL 接收机进行一次全轨道观测，对该星云所在区域开展极深搜索，灵敏度比此前对该区域的搜索暗约一个数量级。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、观测时间跨度、样本量以及数据处理或统计分析方法。

Result: 摘要说明 MeerKAT 作为银河系盘面巡天的一部分发现了该弓形激波星云，并指出其与“Mouse”星云有显著相似性；摘要还说明该区域已被 High Time Resolution Universe 低纬度巡天搜索过，因此该脉冲星必定很暗弱。摘要未报告新的脉冲星探测、流量密度数值或限制结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出，这次极深搜索要么将揭示位于该星云中的暗弱年轻脉冲星，要么将对其朝向地球的束流流量密度给出极具约束力的限制。该星云尖端存在超声速运动年轻脉冲星被表述为极可能而非已确认。根据摘要无法判断该星云与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲、偏振、模式转换等具体脉冲星观测现象的关系。

Abstract: As part of a survey of the Galactic plane MeerKAT has identified a spectacular new bow-shock nebula that shows marked similarities to the nebula known as the ``Mouse''. Like the Mouse it is very likely that at the tip of this nebula there is a young pulsar moving supersonically. As this region of the plane has been searched as part of the High Time Resolution Universe low-latitude survey we know that the pulsar must be faint. We propose here to undertake a very deep search, about an order of magnitude fainter than previous searches of this region, using a full-track observation with the newly available UWL receiver. This search will either reveal the faint young pulsar that resides in this nebula or place extremely constraining limits on its flux density beamed towards the Earth.

</details>


### [4292] [Parkes observations for project P1122 semester 2026APRS_03]()
*Mandow, Rami,Reardon, Daniel John,Zic, Andrew*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该 NAPA 提案旨在针对毫秒脉冲星脉冲轮廓突变（如 PSR J1713+0747 近期发生的剧烈形状变化）获取尽可能接近事件时刻的足量观测，以刻画事件及其恢复过程，从而避免未建模噪声显著降低脉冲星计时阵列对引力波信号的灵敏度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要指出，用于引力波实验的毫秒脉冲星并非完全稳定，例如 PSR J1713+0747 的脉冲轮廓最近剧烈变化，目前尚不确定其是否会恢复到原始状态。监测此类事件及其恢复对建模脉冲星数据集中的噪声过程至关重要，而未建模噪声过程会显著降低脉冲星计时阵列对引力波信号的灵敏度。

Method: 摘要说明这是一份 NAPA 提案，目标是获取足够数量的、尽可能接近此类脉冲轮廓变化事件的观测，以监测事件及其恢复过程。摘要未说明具体望远镜或仪器、观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本量及具体分析流程。

Result: 摘要提及越来越多的证据表明用于引力波实验的毫秒脉冲星并非完全稳定，并具体指出 PSR J1713+0747 的脉冲轮廓最近发生剧烈形状变化，且目前尚不确定其是否会恢复原始状态。除此之外，摘要未说明具体观测结果、数值、时间尺度或统计显著性。摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 摘要支持的解释是：监测脉冲轮廓变化事件及其恢复过程对建模脉冲星数据集中的噪声过程至关重要；若事件未被完全刻画，未建模噪声过程将显著降低脉冲星计时阵列数据集对引力波信号的灵敏度，而若事件被完全刻画则不受影响。据此，作者提出通过 NAPA 提案获取足够数量的、尽可能接近此类事件的观测。关于该事件的具体物理机制、恢复行为的可预测性，以及与其他脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴现象的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: There is growing evidence that the millisecond pulsars used for gravitational wave experiments are not perfectly stable. For instance, the pulse profile of PSR J1713+0747 recently dramatically changed shape, and we are currently unsure whether or not the pulse profile will recover back to its original state. Monitoring such events and their recovery is crucial for modelling the noise processes in pulsar data sets. The sensitivity of the pulsar timing array data sets to gravitational wave signals will be significantly reduced in the presence of unmodelled noise processes, but will not be affected if the event is fully characterised. This is a NAPA proposal to obtain a sufficient number of observations as close to such events as possible.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者认为，监测此类脉冲轮廓变化事件及其恢复过程，对于建模脉冲星数据集中的噪声过程至关重要，也是维持脉冲星计时阵列对引力波信号灵敏度的关键。根据摘要无法判断该事件的具体物理机制，也无法判断其与其他脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴现象的联系。

Abstract: There is growing evidence that the millisecond pulsars used for gravitational wave experiments are not perfectly stable. For instance, the pulse profile of PSR J1713+0747 recently dramatically changed shape, and we are currently unsure whether or not the pulse profile will recover back to its original state. Monitoring such events and their recovery is crucial for modelling the noise processes in pulsar data sets. The sensitivity of the pulsar timing array data sets to gravitational wave signals will be significantly reduced in the presence of unmodelled noise processes, but will not be affected if the event is fully characterised. Motivation: 摘要指出，用于引力波实验的毫秒脉冲星并非完全稳定，例如PSR J1713+0747的脉冲轮廓最近剧烈改变形状，且目前尚不确定其是否会恢复原状。监测此类事件及其恢复对建模脉冲星数据集中的噪声过程至关重要；未建模噪声会显著降低脉冲星计时阵列数据对引力波信号的灵敏度，而事件被完全表征则不受影响。

Method: 这是一份NAPA提案，目的是尽可能靠近此类事件获取足够数量的观测。摘要未说明具体的观测仪器、频段、时间跨度、样本、数据处理或分析统计方法。

Result: 摘要报告，越来越多的证据表明用于引力波实验的毫秒脉冲星并非完全稳定；作为例子，PSR J1713+0747的脉冲轮廓最近发生了剧烈的形状变化，目前尚不确定该脉冲轮廓是否会恢复至原始状态。摘要未给出该变化的具体数值、发生时间、观测频段或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者明确支持的结论是：监测此类事件及其恢复对建模脉冲星数据集中的噪声过程至关重要；存在未建模噪声过程时，脉冲星计时阵列数据对引力波信号的灵敏度会显著降低，而若事件被完全表征则不受影响。为此提出NAPA提案，以尽可能靠近此类事件获取足够数量的观测。根据摘要无法判断该事件与磁星、快速射电暴、单脉冲发射或自转减慢力矩变化之间的具体物理联系。

Abstract: There is growing evidence that the millisecond pulsars used for gravitational wave experiments are not perfectly stable. For instance, the pulse profile of PSR J1713+0747 recently dramatically changed shape, and we are currently unsure whether or not the pulse profile will recover back to its original state. Monitoring such events and their recovery is crucial for modelling the noise processes in pulsar data sets. The sensitivity of the pulsar timing array data sets to gravitational wave signals will be significantly reduced in the presence of unmodelled noise processes, but will not be affected if the event is fully characterised. This is a NAPA proposal to obtain a sufficient number of observations as close to such events as possible.

</details>


### [4296] [Parkes observations for project P1019 semester 2019APRS_02]()
*van Jaarsveld, Naomi,Camilo, Fernando,Stappers, Benjamin,McBride, Vanessa*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: MeerKAT 在银道面巡天中发现了一个与“Mouse”星云高度相似的弓激波星云，其顶端极可能有一颗暗弱的年轻脉冲星；作者提议用 UWL 接收机进行全轨道深度搜索，以发现该脉冲星或给出严格流量密度上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MeerKAT 巡天发现的弓激波星云与“Mouse”星云相似，暗示其顶端可能有超音速运动的年轻脉冲星；但该区域此前已被 High Time Resolution Universe 低纬度巡天搜索过，说明该脉冲星必定暗弱，需要更深的搜索来检验这一可能并约束其流量密度。

Method: 摘要说明将使用新可用的 UWL 接收机进行全轨道观测，开展极深搜索，灵敏度比此前对该区域的搜索暗约一个数量级；该区域此前已由 High Time Resolution Universe 低纬度巡天搜索。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度、数据处理或搜索算法等其他细节。

Result: 摘要报告 MeerKAT 在银道面巡天中发现了一个与“Mouse”星云显著相似的弓激波星云，并指出该星云顶端极可能存在一颗超音速运动的年轻脉冲星。由于该区域已被 High Time Resolution Universe 低纬度巡天搜索，作者推断该脉冲星必定很暗弱。摘要未说明实际观测结果、探测或未探测情况、流量密度数值及显著性。

Conclusion: 作者提出的搜索要么揭示该星云中暗弱的年轻脉冲星，要么对其朝向地球方向束射的流量密度给出极具约束力的限制。该脉冲星的存在、其与磁星或快速射电暴的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: As part of a survey of the Galactic plane MeerKAT has identified a spectacular new bow-shock nebula that shows marked similarities to the nebula known as the ``Mouse''. Like the Mouse it is very likely that at the tip of this nebula there is a young pulsar moving supersonically. As this region of the plane has been searched as part of the High Time Resolution Universe low-latitude survey we know that the pulsar must be faint. We propose here to undertake a very deep search, about an order of magnitude fainter than previous searches of this region, using a full-track observation with the newly available UWL receiver. This search will either reveal the faint young pulsar that resides in this nebula or place extremely constraining limits on its flux density beamed towards the Earth.

</details>


### [4297] [Parkes observations for project P1058 semester 2020OCTS_01]()
*Dai, Shi,Murphy, Tara,Lenc, Emil,Hobbs, George,Cameron, Andrew,Kaplan, David,Freeburn, James*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟继续对 ASKAP 新发现的毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1431-6328（自转周期 2.77 ms，处于轨道周期 88 天的宽双星系统）开展计时观测，并计划在本学期末发表计时解、宽带偏振性质与双星系统研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1431-6328 是 ASKAP 新发现的毫秒脉冲星，伴星质量相对较低、轨道周期长达 88 天，这一双星构型对理解双星演化具有重要意义；同时其稳定脉冲轮廓和宽轨道使其成为脉冲星计时阵列与强等效原理检验的候选目标，因此需要持续的计时观测。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测设备、接收机、观测频段、观测时间跨度、数据量或分析流程；仅说明提议继续对 PSR J1431-6328 开展计时观测活动（timing campaign），并计划总结该计时活动、给出计时解、宽带偏振性质以及对双星系统的研究。

Result: 摘要仅给出 PSR J1431-6328 的基本性质：自转周期为 2.77 ms，处于轨道周期为 88 天的极宽双星系统中，伴星质量相对较低；该脉冲星具有稳定的脉冲轮廓和宽轨道。所提议的计时观测结果、计时解、宽带偏振性质及双星系统研究结果均为计划在学期末发表的内容，摘要未给出具体测量值、显著性或其他结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为该双星系统对理解双星演化极为有趣，且该脉冲星因稳定轮廓与宽轨道而适合用于脉冲星计时阵列和强等效原理检验；计划以论文形式发表计时解、宽带偏振性质及双星系统研究。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射等具体物理问题的联系。

Abstract: We propose to continue the timing campaign of the new millisecond pulsar, J1431-6328, discovered by the Australian SKA Pathfinder (ASKAP). PSR J1431-6328 has a spin period of 2.77 ms and is in a very wide binary system with an orbital period of 88 days. The relatively low mass of the companion and the long orbital period make this binary system extremely interesting for the understanding of binary evolution. The stable profile and wide orbit of J1431-6328 also makes it a good candidate for pulsar timing arrays and tests of the strong equivalence principle. By the end of this semester, we plan to summarise the timing campaign with a paper and publish the timing solution, wide band polarisation properties of this pulsar and studies of the binary system.

</details>

Abstract: We propose to continue the timing campaign of the new millisecond pulsar, J1431-6328, discovered by the Australian SKA Pathfinder (ASKAP). Method: 摘要说明这是一项对 PSR J1431-6328 的计时观测活动（继续申请），该脉冲星由 ASKAP 发现；摘要未说明具体观测仪器、频段、观测时间跨度、数据量、样本规模，也未说明所用的计时、单脉冲、偏振或统计分析方法细节。摘要提到计划在本学期末发表计时解、宽带偏振性质以及对双星系统的研究。

Result: 摘要未说明已获得的观测结果。摘要仅给出 PSR J1431-6328 的自转周期为 2.77 ms，处于轨道周期为 88 天的极宽双星系统中，伴星质量相对较低；并指出其脉冲轮廓稳定、轨道宽阔。摘要未报告计时精度、偏振测量、色散量或任何数值结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，伴星质量相对较低且轨道周期较长使该双星系统对理解双星演化极为有趣；J1431-6328 的稳定轮廓与宽轨道也使其成为脉冲星计时阵列和强等效原理检验的良好候选者，并计划以论文形式给出计时解、宽带偏振性质与双星系统研究。根据摘要，该工作与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射的物理联系无法判断。根据摘要无法判断其具体物理机制。

Abstract: We propose to continue the timing campaign of the new millisecond pulsar, J1431-6328, discovered by the Australian SKA Pathfinder (ASKAP). PSR J1431-6328 has a spin period of 2.77 ms and is in a very wide binary system with an orbital period of 88 days. The relatively low mass of the companion and the long orbital period make this binary system extremely interesting for the understanding of binary evolution. The stable profile and wide orbit of J1431-6328 also makes it a good candidate for pulsar timing arrays and tests of the strong equivalence principle. By the end of this semester, we plan to summarise the timing campaign with a paper and publish the timing solution, wide band polarisation properties of this pulsar and studies of the binary system.

</details>

### [4307] [Parkes observations for project P875 semester 2014OCTS]()
*Jankowski, Fabian,Bailes, Matthew,van Straten, Willem,Keane, Evan,Barr, Ewan*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划系统测量约500颗脉冲星的流量密度，在732和3100 MHz提供约1000个新测量，以改进脉冲星族群频谱知识，并为Molonglo（843 MHz）和SKA等未来观测做准备。研究还包括更新所选脉冲星星历表，并考察平均脉冲轮廓随频率的变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有脉冲星族群的频谱知识有限，需要系统测量流量密度以确定射电辐射谱指数、研究脉冲星辐射机制，并为下一代望远镜（如SKA）优化观测策略。同时，该工作为正在翻新的Molonglo Observatory Synthesis Telescope做前期准备。

Method: 摘要未说明观测时间跨度、样本选取细节及具体分析方法，仅说明拟系统测量约500颗脉冲星的流量密度，在732和3100 MHz获得约1000个新测量，并利用Parkes新数据检查更新所选脉冲星的星历表，同时研究平均脉冲轮廓及其随频率的变化。

Result: 摘要未说明已完成的具体观测结果，仅提出预期目标：为约500颗脉冲星系统测量流量密度，在732和3100 MHz提供约1000个新测量，覆盖目前已知脉冲星中约四分之一，从而大幅改进脉冲星族群频谱知识，并约束Molonglo中心频率843 MHz处预期的流量密度。

Conclusion: 论文将改进脉冲星族群频谱知识、确定射电辐射谱指数、研究脉冲星辐射机制，并帮助为SKA等下一代望远镜优化观测策略；同时为Molonglo的观测做准备，约束843 MHz处预期流量密度。这些工作是否与磁星、FRB或单脉冲等主题相关，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: In this proposal we aim to measure the flux densities of about 500 pulsars in a systematic way. Doing this we will vastly improve upon the current spectral knowledge of the pulsar population and provide around 1000 new measurements at 732 and 3100 MHz for about a quarter of the currently known pulsars. This is extremely important both for pulsar population studies, in particular for determining the spectral index of the radio emission, investigations of the pulsar emission mechanism and for optimizing observing strategies for next generation telescopes, such as the SKA. This proposal also acts as preparatory work for the Molonglo Observatory Synthesis Telescope, which we are refurbishing at the moment. This work will help us constrain the flux density expected at the centre frequency of Molonglo, at 843 MHz. We will also use the new data from Parkes to check and update the ephemerides of all the selected pulsars in order to have a database that is as up to date as possible before observations with Molonglo commence. We will also investigate the averaged pulse profiles and how they change with frequency.

</details>


### [4308] [Parkes observations for project P1365 semester 2025OCTS_12]()
*Xue, Mengyao,Bhat, Ramesh,Zhu, Weiwei,Meyers, Bradley,Zhou, Yukai,Fu, Qiuyang,Tan, Chia Min,Lee, Christopher*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: SMART脉冲星巡天第二遍深度搜寻在过去一年新发现11颗脉冲星（含两颗毫秒脉冲星），使第一遍的计数增至三倍；后续将用Parkes Murriyang望远镜对包括10颗脉冲星在内的样本开展计时与轮廓、极化、流量密度研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第一遍浅层搜寻仅覆盖小部分天区；SMART巡天第二遍需要对80分钟观测进行深度搜寻。新发现的脉冲星需要计时以确定自转和天体测量参数并选取详细后续观测目标，而MWA在接下来一年不再支持常规脉冲星观测，因此需要其他望远镜承接计时后续观测。

Method: 对80分钟观测进行第二遍深度搜寻处理，属该巡天过去一年的处理工作；计时后续观测使用Parkes \emph{Murriyang}望远镜，扩展至10颗脉冲星样本（含来自试点项目的两颗）；数据可覆盖$\sim$100 MHz至4 GHz，用于研究脉冲轮廓、极化和流量密度。更具体的搜寻管线与本项目观测参数摘要未说明。

Result: 第二遍处理在过去一年发现了11颗新脉冲星，其中包括两颗毫秒脉冲星，使第一遍的初始计数增至三倍。上学期的试点项目已证明\emph{Murriyang}适合用于对SMART发现进行计时。相关分析/结果将纳入一篇在准备的出版物，该出版物将详述深度搜寻管线并报告初步脉冲星发现。详见摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为第二遍深度搜寻的发现暗示了这项在SKA-Low频段进行的首个南天脉冲星巡天的前景；Parkes \emph{Murriyang}因具有相同天区覆盖、灵敏度和宽频率覆盖，是对SMART发现进行计时的最佳选择，并可支持脉冲轮廓、极化和流量密度研究。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、单脉冲发射、模式转换、自旋下降力矩变化或快速射电暴之间的物理联系。

Abstract: Following the successful demonstration of a pilot first-pass (shallow) search of a small fraction of the sky, the second-pass processing has commenced for the SMART pulsar survey, which involves deep searches of 80-minute observations. The processing over the past year has led to the discovery of 11 new pulsars (including two millisecond ones), thus tripling the initial count from the first pass, and hinting at the exciting promise of this first southern-sky pulsar survey in the frequency band of SKA-Low. All new pulsars need to be timed in order to determine their spin and astrometric parameters and to select specialised targets for detailed follow-ups. With the MWA no longer supporting routine pulsar observations for the coming year, timing follow-ups rely on other telescopes. The Parkes \emph{Murriyang} telescope, with an identical sky coverage, sensitivity and the wide frequency coverage, offers the best option to time SMART discoveries. We have demonstrated \emph{Murriyang's} suitability for this through a pilot project last semester and are now extending the project to a larger sample of 10 pulsars including two from the pilot project. The data will also allow us to study pulse profiles, polarisation, and flux densities from $\sim$100 MHz to 4 GHz. The analysis/results will be included in a publication in preparation that will detail the deep-search pipeline and report on initial pulsar discoveries.

</details>

*Xue, Mengyao,Bhat, Ramesh,Zhu, Weiwei,Meyers, Bradley,Zhou, Yukai,Fu, Qiuyang,Tan, Chia Min,Lee, Christopher*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SMART巡天第一遍仅对天空一小部分做了浅层搜索，其后续深度搜索已发现新的脉冲星，而所有新脉冲星都需计时以确定自转和天体测量参数并挑选详细后续观测目标；同时MWA未来一年不再支持常规脉冲星观测，因此需要其他望远镜承担计时后续观测。

Method: SMART巡天第二遍处理对80分钟观测进行深度搜索；计时后续观测使用Parkes \emph{Murriyang}望远镜，其天空覆盖、灵敏度和宽频率覆盖与MWA相同。项目由上学期试点项目扩展为包含10颗脉冲星的更大样本，其中两颗来自试点项目。数据将用于研究脉冲轮廓、极化和通量密度，频率范围约100 MHz至4 GHz。更详细的分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 过去一年的处理发现11颗新脉冲星，其中包括两颗毫秒脉冲星，使第一遍的初始数目增至三倍，并暗示这项在SKA-Low频段开展的首个南天脉冲星巡天具有前景。上学期试点项目已证明\emph{Murriyang}适合用于对SMART发现进行计时。摘要未说明计时、脉冲轮廓、极化或通量密度的具体测量结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，Parkes \emph{Murriyang}望远镜凭借与MWA相同的天空覆盖、灵敏度和宽频率覆盖，是在MWA不再支持常规脉冲星观测时为SMART发现提供计时的最佳选择；他们已将试点项目扩展至10颗脉冲星的样本，并预期相关分析/结果将纳入一篇详述深度搜索流程并报告初步脉冲星发现的论文。

Abstract: Following the successful demonstration of a pilot first-pass (shallow) search of a small fraction of the sky, the second-pass processing has commenced for the SMART pulsar survey, which involves deep searches of 80-minute observations. The processing over the past year has led to the discovery of 11 new pulsars (including two millisecond ones), thus tripling the initial count from the first pass, and hinting at the exciting promise of this first southern-sky pulsar survey in the frequency band of SKA-Low. All new pulsars need to be timed in order to determine their spin and astrometric parameters and to select specialised targets for detailed follow-ups. With the MWA no longer supporting routine pulsar observations for the coming year, timing follow-ups rely on other telescopes. The Parkes \emph{Murriyang} telescope, with an identical sky coverage, sensitivity and the wide frequency coverage, offers the best option to time SMART discoveries. We have demonstrated \emph{Murriyang's} suitability for this through a pilot project last semester and are now extending the project to a larger sample of 10 pulsars including two from the pilot project. The data will also allow us to study pulse profiles, polarisation, and flux densities from $\sim$100 MHz to 4 GHz. The analysis/results will be included in a publication in preparation that will detail the deep-search pipeline and report on initial pulsar discoveries.

</details>


### [4310] [Parkes observations for project P1168 semester 2023OCTS_06]()
*DeCesar, Megan,Ransom, Scott,Kerr, Matthew,Dai, Shi*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 用 GBT 在球状星团 Terzan 1 中首次发现七颗脉冲星，包括五颗自转周期 3–6 ms 的完全再循环毫秒脉冲星、一颗 11 ms 脉冲星和一颗异常长的 134 ms 脉冲星；初步计时表明它们很可能都是孤立脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该工作旨在报告在球状星团 Terzan 1 中首次发现的脉冲星，并利用后续 Parkes 计时观测改进计时参数、探测脉冲星在星团势场中的加速度、研究其偏振性质与 Terzan 1 方向的银河系磁场，同时搜寻此前观测可能遗漏的新脉冲星。摘要未说明更具体的知识空白。

Method: 使用 Green Bank Telescope（GBT）发现脉冲星；2022OCT 用 Parkes 对 Terzan 1 观测三次并确认所有脉冲星可被探测；自 2023APR 起开展为期一年的计时 campaign，并申请延续至 2023OCT。计划利用 2022OCT 观测将相位连接扩展到一年以上，并尝试相位连接回溯至最初的 GBT 发现指向；还将探测偏振性质与银河系磁场并搜寻新脉冲星。观测频率、具体分析方法与样本细节摘要未说明。

Result: 在 Terzan 1 中发现七颗脉冲星，为该星团首批脉冲星；其中包括五颗自转周期介于 3 到 6 ms 的完全再循环 MSP、一颗 11-ms MSP，以及一颗自转周期异常长为 134 ms 的脉冲星。初步计时表明七颗很可能都是孤立脉冲星，与 Terzan 1 是核心坍缩球状星团相符。2022OCT 的三次 Parkes 观测确认所有脉冲星均可被探测到。摘要未给出更具体的计时、偏振或显著性数值。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些初步计时结果与 Terzan 1 作为核心坍缩球状星团相符，并指出 134-ms 脉冲星在经由电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成脉冲星的背景下尤其有趣。计划通过延长相位连接改进计时参数并探测星团势场中的加速度，同时研究偏振与银河系磁场并搜寻新脉冲星。根据摘要无法判断其对磁星、FRB 或单脉冲发射的具体物理联系。

Abstract: We discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope (GBT), the first pulsars to be found in this cluster. The discoveries include five fully-recycled millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with spin periods between 3 and 6 ms, an 11-ms MSP, and a pulsar with an unusually long spin period of 134 ms. Our preliminary timing suggested that all seven are likely isolated pulsars, consistent with Terzan 1 being a core-collapsed globular cluster. The 134-ms pulsar is an especially interesting discovery in the context of pulsar formation via electron-capture rather than core-collapse supernovae. In 2022OCT we observed Terzan 1 with Parkes three times and confirmed that all pulsars could be detected. We began a year-long timing campaign in the present semester, 2023APR, and were granted continuing status for that campaign. We request to continue timing these pulsars through 2023OCT. To refine the timing parameters and probe the pulsars' acceleration in the cluster potential, we will extend phase connection beyond one year using the 2022OCT observations, and we will attempt to phase connect back to the original GBT discovery pointings. In addition to timing, we will probe the pulsars' polarization properties and the Galactic magnetic field in the direction of Terzan 1; and the proposed observations will also be searched for new pulsars that may have been missed in previous observations.

</details>

Abstract: Following the successful demonstration of a pilot first-pass (shallow) search of a small fraction of the sky, the second-pass processing has commenced for the SMART pulsar survey, which involves deep searches of 80-minute observations.
