Method: 基于 80 分钟观测对 SMART 巡天开展第二遍深度搜寻处理；利用 Parkes \emph{Murriyang} 望远镜对包含 10 颗脉冲星的样本（其中两颗来自上学期试点项目）进行计时后续观测，并研究 $\sim$100 MHz 至 4 GHz 的脉冲轮廓、偏振和流量密度。摘要未说明具体观测频段设置、时间跨度、统计或搜寻算法细节。

Result: 过去一年的第二遍处理发现 11 颗新脉冲星，其中包括两颗毫秒脉冲星，使首次遍历的初始计数增至三倍；作者称这暗示了这项在 SKA-Low 频段开展的首个南天脉冲星巡天令人振奋的前景。上学期试点项目已证明 \emph{Murriyang} 适用于对 SMART 发现的计时。摘要未给出显著性、不确定度或具体参数数值。

Conclusion: 作者认为 SMART 第二遍处理的新发现显示了该巡天的前景，并计划通过 \emph{Murriyang} 计时确定新脉冲星的自转与天体测量参数、挑选专门后续目标，同时研究其脉冲轮廓、偏振与宽频流量密度，相关分析与结果将纳入一篇正在准备的出版物，用以详述深度搜寻流程并报告初步发现。根据摘要无法判断与磁星、FRB、单脉冲发射或自转减速力矩变化等的具体物理联系。

Abstract: Following the successful demonstration of a pilot first-pass (shallow) search of a small fraction of the sky, the second-pass processing has commenced for the SMART pulsar survey, which involves deep searches of 80-minute observations. The processing over the past year has led to the discovery of 11 new pulsars (including two millisecond ones), thus tripling the initial count from the first pass, and hinting at the exciting promise of this first southern-sky pulsar survey in the frequency band of SKA-Low. All new pulsars need to be timed in order to determine their spin and astrometric parameters and to select specialised targets for detailed follow-ups. With the MWA no longer supporting routine pulsar observations for the coming year, timing follow-ups rely on other telescopes. The Parkes \emph{Murriyang} telescope, with an identical sky coverage, sensitivity and the wide frequency coverage, offers the best option to time SMART discoveries. We have demonstrated \emph{Murriyang's} suitability for this through a pilot project last semester and are now extending the project to a larger sample of 10 pulsars including two from the pilot project. The data will also allow us to study pulse profiles, polarisation, and flux densities from $\sim$100 MHz to 4 GHz. The analysis/results will be included in a publication in preparation that will detail the deep-search pipeline and report on initial pulsar discoveries.

### [4319] [Parkes observations for project P1168 semester 2023OCTS_01]()
*DeCesar, Megan,Ransom, Scott,Kerr, Matthew,Dai, Shi*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 利用 GBT 在球状星团 Terzan 1 中首次发现七颗脉冲星，其中五颗为自转周期 3–6 ms 的完全再循环毫秒脉冲星，另有一颗 11 ms 脉冲星和一颗周期异常长的 134 ms 脉冲星；初步计时表明七颗很可能均为孤立脉冲星。后续 Parkes 观测确认所有脉冲星均可探测，并已启动并延续为期一年的计时计划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Terzan 1 此前未被发现过脉冲星。该提案旨在对 GBT 新发现的七颗脉冲星开展长期计时，以改进计时参数、探测脉冲星在星团势中的加速度，并检验其是否为孤立脉冲星；其中 134 ms 长周期脉冲星对通过电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成脉冲星的图景具有特殊意义。此外还希望探测脉冲星偏振性质与 Terzan 1 方向的银河系磁场，并搜寻此前可能遗漏的新脉冲星。

Method: 使用 GBT 在球状星团 Terzan 1 中发现七颗脉冲星。2022OCT 用 Parkes 对该星团观测三次，确认所有脉冲星均可被探测。自 2023APR 起开展为期一年的计时计划并获得延续，申请继续计时至 2023OCT。计划利用 2022OCT 观测将相位连接延长至一年以上，并尝试相位连接回溯到最初的 GBT 发现指向；此外将探测脉冲星偏振性质及 Terzan 1 方向的银河系磁场，并在所提议观测中搜寻新脉冲星。观测频率、带宽、具体时间跨度等摘要未说明。

Result: 在 Terzan 1 中首次发现七颗脉冲星，包括五颗自转周期介于 3 和 6 ms 的完全再循环毫秒脉冲星、一颗 11 ms 的毫秒脉冲星，以及一颗自转周期异常长为 134 ms 的脉冲星。初步计时表明七颗很可能均为孤立脉冲星，与 Terzan 1 是核心坍缩球状星团相符。2022OCT 的 Parkes 三次观测确认所有脉冲星都能被探测到。计时参数改进、星团势中加速度探测、偏振与银河系磁场结果以及新脉冲星搜寻结果摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为七颗脉冲星很可能均为孤立脉冲星，这与 Terzan 1 作为核心坍缩球状星团的性质相符；并指出 134 ms 脉冲星在通过电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成脉冲星的背景下尤其值得关注。所提议的长期计时、相位连接、偏振与银河系磁场探测以及新脉冲星搜寻有望改进计时参数并探测脉冲星在星团势中的加速度，但相关物理结论尚待观测确定，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope (GBT), the first pulsars to be found in this cluster. The discoveries include five fully-recycled millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with spin periods between 3 and 6 ms, an 11-ms MSP, and a pulsar with an unusually long spin period of 134 ms. Our preliminary timing suggested that all seven are likely isolated pulsars, consistent with Terzan 1 being a core-collapsed globular cluster. The 134-ms pulsar is an especially interesting discovery in the context of pulsar formation via electron-capture rather than core-collapse supernovae. In 2022OCT we observed Terzan 1 with Parkes three times and confirmed that all pulsars could be detected. We began a year-long timing campaign in the present semester, 2023APR, and were granted continuing status for that campaign. We request to continue timing these pulsars through 2023OCT. To refine the timing parameters and probe the pulsars' acceleration in the cluster potential, we will extend phase connection beyond one year using the 2022OCT observations, and we will attempt to phase connect back to the original GBT discovery pointings. In addition to timing, we will probe the pulsars' polarization properties and the Galactic magnetic field in the direction of Terzan 1; and the proposed observations will also be searched for new pulsars that may have been missed in previous observations.

</details>

The processing over the past year has led to the discovery of 11 new pulsars (including two millisecond ones), thus tripling the initial count from the first pass, and hinting at the exciting promise of this first southern-sky pulsar survey in the frequency band of SKA-Low. All new pulsars need to be timed in order to determine their spin and astrometric parameters and to select specialised targets for detailed follow-ups. With the MWA no longer supporting routine pulsar observations for the coming year, timing follow-ups rely on other telescopes. The Parkes \emph{Murriyang} telescope, with an identical sky coverage, sensitivity and the wide frequency coverage, offers the best option to time SMART discoveries. We have demonstrated \emph{Murriyang's} suitability for this through a pilot project last semester and are now extending the project to a larger sample of 10 pulsars including two from the pilot project. The data will also allow us to study pulse profiles, polarisation, and flux densities from $\sim$100 MHz to 4 GHz. The processing over the past year has led to the discovery of 11 new pulsars (including two millisecond ones), thus tripling the initial count from the first pass, and hinting at the exciting promise of this first southern-sky pulsar survey in the frequency band of SKA-Low. All new pulsars need to be timed in order to determine their spin and astrometric parameters and to select specialised targets for detailed follow-ups. With the MWA no longer supporting routine pulsar observations for the coming year, timing follow-ups rely on other telescopes. The Parkes \emph{Murriyang} telescope, with an identical sky coverage, sensitivity and the wide frequency coverage, offers the best option to time SMART discoveries. We have demonstrated \emph{Murriyang's} suitability for this through a pilot project last semester and are now extending the project to a larger sample of 10 pulsars including two from the pilot project. The data will also allow us to study pulse profiles, polarisation, and flux densities from $\sim$100 MHz to 4 GHz. ### [4329] [Parkes observations for project P1168 semester 2023OCTS_03]()
*DeCesar, Megan,Ransom, Scott,Kerr, Matthew,Dai, Shi*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 利用 GBT 在球状星团 Terzan 1 中首次发现七颗脉冲星，其中包括五颗自转周期 3–6 ms 的完全再循环毫秒脉冲星、一颗 11 ms 毫秒脉冲星和一颗 134 ms 长周期脉冲星；初步计时表明它们很可能都是孤立脉冲星。Parkes 的 2022OCT 三次观测确认全部可被探测到，并申请延续为期一年的计时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前 Terzan 1 中未被发现脉冲星；该星团是核心坍缩球状星团，其中 134 ms 长周期脉冲星对通过电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成脉冲星的情形尤其有意义。作者希望继续对这些脉冲星计时以改进计时参数、探测其在星团势场中的加速度，并探测偏振性质与方向上的银河系磁场。

Method: 使用 Green Bank Telescope（GBT）发现脉冲星，并在 2022OCT 用 Parkes 对 Terzan 1 观测三次；自 2023APR 起开展为期一年的计时 campaña，申请延续至 2023OCT。计时方面将用 2022OCT 观测把相位连接扩展到超过一年，并尝试回溯相位连接到最初的 GBT 发现指向；此外将探测脉冲星偏振性质与 Terzan 1 方向的银河系磁场，并搜寻此前观测可能遗漏的新脉冲星。摘要未说明具体观测频率、频段与数据量。

Result: 在 Terzan 1 中发现七颗脉冲星，为该星团首批脉冲星：五颗完全再循环毫秒脉冲星（MSP），自转周期介于 3 和 6 ms 之间；一颗 11 ms 的 MSP；一颗自转周期异常长的 134 ms 脉冲星。初步计时表明七颗很可能都是孤立脉冲星，与 Terzan 1 是核心坍缩球状星团相符。2022OCT 用 Parkes 三次观测确认所有脉冲星都能被探测到，并为本学期的计时 campaña 获得延续状态。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些脉冲星很可能都是孤立脉冲星，与 Terzan 1 作为核心坍缩球状星团相符；134 ms 脉冲星在通过电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成脉冲星的背景下特别有趣。计划通过延续计时改进计时参数、探测脉冲星在星团势场中的加速度，并探测偏振性质与 Terzan 1 方向的银河系磁场，同时搜寻可能遗漏的新脉冲星。根据摘要无法判断其对磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲辐射的具体联系。

Abstract: We discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope (GBT), the first pulsars to be found in this cluster. The discoveries include five fully-recycled millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with spin periods between 3 and 6 ms, an 11-ms MSP, and a pulsar with an unusually long spin period of 134 ms. Our preliminary timing suggested that all seven are likely isolated pulsars, consistent with Terzan 1 being a core-collapsed globular cluster. The 134-ms pulsar is an especially interesting discovery in the context of pulsar formation via electron-capture rather than core-collapse supernovae. In 2022OCT we observed Terzan 1 with Parkes three times and confirmed that all pulsars could be detected. We began a year-long timing campaign in the present semester, 2023APR, and were granted continuing status for that campaign. We request to continue timing these pulsars through 2023OCT. To refine the timing parameters and probe the pulsars' acceleration in the cluster potential, we will extend phase connection beyond one year using the 2022OCT observations, and we will attempt to phase connect back to the original GBT discovery pointings. In addition to timing, we will probe the pulsars' polarization properties and the Galactic magnetic field in the direction of Terzan 1; and the proposed observations will also be searched for new pulsars that may have been missed in previous observations.

</details>

With the MWA no longer supporting routine pulsar observations for the coming year, timing follow-ups rely on other telescopes. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Terzan 1 此前未被发现脉冲星，该工作在 GBT 观测中首次发现七颗脉冲星，其中包括一颗自转周期异常长（134 ms）的脉冲星，其在通过电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成脉冲星的背景下尤其值得关注；后续需要在 2022OCT 三次 Parkes 观测确认全部可探测的基础上继续计时、改进计时参数并探测星团势中的加速度。

Method: 用绿岸望远镜（GBT）在球状星团 Terzan 1 中发现七颗脉冲星；“初步计时”用于判断它们是否为孤立脉冲星。2022OCT 用 Parkes 观测 Terzan 1 三次，确认所有脉冲星均可探测；2023APR 起开展为期一年的计时观测计划并获延续资格，拟继续计时至 2023OCT。此外将利用 2022OCT 观测把相位连接延长至一年以上，并尝试相位连接到最初的 GBT 发现指向，同时探测偏振性质与 Terzan 1 方向的银河系磁场，并搜寻可能遗漏的新脉冲星。观测频段、积分时间、样本规模等细节摘要未说明。

Result: 在球状星团 Terzan 1 中发现七颗脉冲星，为该星团首批脉冲星：五颗完全再循环的毫秒脉冲星（MSP），自转周期在 3 至 6 ms 之间；一颗 11 ms 的 MSP；以及一颗自转周期异常长的 134 ms 脉冲星。初步计时表明，这七颗很可能都是孤立脉冲星，与 Terzan 1 是核心坍缩球状星团相符。2022OCT 用 Parkes 对 Terzan 1 的三次观测确认所有脉冲星都能被探测到。

Conclusion: 作者认为，七颗脉冲星很可能都是孤立脉冲星，这与 Terzan 1 是一个核心坍缩球状星团相符；134 ms 脉冲星在通过电子俘获（而非核心坍缩超新星）形成脉冲星的背景下是一个尤其有趣的发现。作者计划通过延长相位连接、并尝试连接回最初的 GBT 发现指向来改进计时参数、探测脉冲星在星团势中的加速度，同时探测偏振性质与 Terzan 1 方向的银河系磁场，并搜寻此前可能遗漏的新脉冲星。这些拟开展的偏振、磁场与搜寻工作属于计划内容；根据摘要无法判断其最终结果。

Abstract: We discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope (GBT), the first pulsars to be found in this cluster. The discoveries include five fully-recycled millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with spin periods between 3 and 6 ms, an 11-ms MSP, and a pulsar with an unusually long spin period of 134 ms. Our preliminary timing suggested that all seven are likely isolated pulsars, consistent with Terzan 1 being a core-collapsed globular cluster. The 134-ms pulsar is an especially interesting discovery in the context of pulsar formation via electron-capture rather than core-collapse supernovae. In 2022OCT we observed Terzan 1 with Parkes three times and confirmed that all pulsars could be detected. We began a year-long timing campaign in the present semester, 2023APR, and were granted continuing status for that campaign. We request to continue timing these pulsars through 2023OCT. To refine the timing parameters and probe the pulsars' acceleration in the cluster potential, we will extend phase connection beyond one year using the 2022OCT observations, and we will attempt to phase connect back to the original GBT discovery pointings. In addition to timing, we will probe the pulsars' polarization properties and the Galactic magnetic field in the direction of Terzan 1; and the proposed observations will also be searched for new pulsars that may have been missed in previous observations.

</details>

Abstract: We discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope (GBT), the first pulsars to be found in this cluster. ### [4334] [Parkes observations for project P1365 semester 2025OCTS_18]()
*Xue, Mengyao,Bhat, Ramesh,Zhu, Weiwei,Meyers, Bradley,Zhou, Yukai,Fu, Qiuyang,Tan, Chia Min,Lee, Christopher*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: SMART脉冲星巡天的第二轮深度搜索处理已启动，过去一年发现11颗新脉冲星（含两颗毫秒脉冲星），使首轮数目增至三倍；Parkes Murriyang望远镜被用于对10颗脉冲星开展计时后续观测，并将研究其脉冲轮廓、偏振与流量密度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SMART巡天在首轮浅层搜索试点成功后进入第二轮深度搜索，过去一年新增11颗脉冲星，显示这一首个在SKA-Low频段开展的南天脉冲星巡天的前景。所有新脉冲星都需计时以确定自转与天体测量参数并挑选后续详细观测目标；而MWA在接下来一年不再支持常规脉冲星观测，因此需要其他望远镜承担计时后续观测。

Method: 对80分钟观测进行深度搜索的第二轮处理；已通过上一学期的试点项目证明Parkes \emph{Murriyang}望远镜适合计时，现扩展到10颗脉冲星样本（含两颗来自试点项目）。将获取的数据用于脉冲轮廓、偏振和流量密度研究，频率范围$\sim$100 MHz到4 GHz。计时分析、搜索流程与统计方法的具体细节摘要未说明。

Result: 第二轮处理在过去一年发现11颗新脉冲星，其中包括两颗毫秒脉冲星，使首轮得到的数目增至三倍。上一学期的试点项目已证明\emph{Murriyang}适合对SMART发现的脉冲星进行计时；项目现扩展至更大的10颗脉冲星样本，其中包括两颗来自试点项目的脉冲星。摘要未给出脉冲轮廓、偏振或流量密度的具体测量结果或数值。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现暗示了这一首个在SKA-Low频段进行的南天脉冲星巡天令人振奋的前景，并认定Parkes \emph{Murriyang}因具有相同的天空覆盖、灵敏度和宽频率覆盖，是计时SMART发现脉冲星的最佳选择。相关分析/结果将纳入一篇正在准备的出版物，详述深度搜索流程并报告初步脉冲星发现。根据摘要无法判断该巡天或计时样本对磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射等具体物理问题的意义。

Abstract: Following the successful demonstration of a pilot first-pass (shallow) search of a small fraction of the sky, the second-pass processing has commenced for the SMART pulsar survey, which involves deep searches of 80-minute observations. The processing over the past year has led to the discovery of 11 new pulsars (including two millisecond ones), thus tripling the initial count from the first pass, and hinting at the exciting promise of this first southern-sky pulsar survey in the frequency band of SKA-Low. All new pulsars need to be timed in order to determine their spin and astrometric parameters and to select specialised targets for detailed follow-ups. With the MWA no longer supporting routine pulsar observations for the coming year, timing follow-ups rely on other telescopes. The Parkes \emph{Murriyang} telescope, with an identical sky coverage, sensitivity and the wide frequency coverage, offers the best option to time SMART discoveries. We have demonstrated \emph{Murriyang's} suitability for this through a pilot project last semester and are now extending the project to a larger sample of 10 pulsars including two from the pilot project. The data will also allow us to study pulse profiles, polarisation, and flux densities from $\sim$100 MHz to 4 GHz. The analysis/results will be included in a publication in preparation that will detail the deep-search pipeline and report on initial pulsar discoveries.

</details>

*DeCesar, Megan,Ransom, Scott,Kerr, Matthew,Dai, Shi*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 七颗脉冲星可能均为孤立脉冲星，这与 Terzan 1 是核心坍缩球状星团相符；134 ms 脉冲星在通过电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成脉冲星的背景下特别有趣。作者提议通过一年计时campaign获得相位连接计时解、扩展相位连接、探测星团势中的加速度、研究偏振性质与银河系磁场并搜索新脉冲星。根据摘要无法判断这些目标的最终实现情况。

Abstract: We discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope (GBT), the first pulsars to be found in this cluster. The discoveries include five fully-recycled millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with spin periods between 3 and 6 ms, an 11-ms MSP, and a pulsar with an unusually long spin period of 134 ms. Our preliminary timing suggested that all seven are likely isolated pulsars, consistent with Terzan 1 being a core-collapsed globular cluster. The 134-ms pulsar is an especially interesting discovery in the context of pulsar formation via electron-capture rather than core-collapse supernovae. We observed Terzan 1 at Parkes with the UWL receiver in 2022OCT to test whether the pulsars could be detected and thus timed at Parkes. All seven pulsars are significantly detected in both observations. We propose a year-long timing campaign with Parkes/UWL to obtain phase-connected timing solutions for these pulsars; we request continuing status to continue these timing observations through 2023OCT. To refine the timing parameters and probe the pulsars' acceleration in the cluster potential, we will extend phase connection beyond one year using the 2022OCT observations, and we will attempt to phase connect back to the original GBT discovery pointings. In addition to timing, we will probe the pulsars' polarization properties and the Galactic magnetic field in the direction of Terzan 1; and the proposed observations will also be searched for new pulsars that may have been missed in previous observations.

</details>

Abstract: We discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope (GBT), the first pulsars to be found in this cluster. The discoveries include five fully-recycled millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with spin periods between 3 and 6 ms, an 11-ms MSP, and a pulsar with an unusually long spin period of 134 ms. ### [4337] [Parkes observations for project P1238 semester 2025OCTS_02]()
*Lazarevic, Sanja,Filipovic, Miroslav,Edwards, Philip,Rowell, Gavin,Dai, Shi,Brose, Robert,Velovic, Velibor,Ahmad, Adeel,Burger-Scheidlin, Christopher*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟利用 Parkes UWL 接收机对嵌于超新星遗迹和/或脉冲星风星云中的三个脉冲星候选体开展定向搜寻，并预期利用 UWL 的高频频段（3-4 GHz）减轻高 DM 造成的散射与脉冲展宽，从而提升对遥远、高色散脉冲星的可探测性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 年轻高能脉冲星可驱动脉冲星风星云（PWNe），其起源有时与母体超新星遗迹（SNR）相关。ASKAP 和 MeerKAT 的下一代射电巡天灵敏度和分辨率高，适合发现银河系中弥散、低表面亮度的 PWNe 和 SNR，并可利用 PWN 与 SNR 的关联指导射电脉冲星的定向搜寻。作者此前已借此发现两颗驱动弓形激波 PWNe 的高 DM 脉冲星，现希望继续搜寻最有希望的科学候选体。

Method: 基于 ASKAP 和 MeerKAT 巡天的 PWN 与 SNR 关联，选出三个最有希望且科学上引人注目的脉冲星候选体，提议使用 Parkes Ultra-Wideband Low（UWL）接收机开展定向搜寻，并特别利用其高频频段（3-4 GHz）以减轻高 DM 引起的散射和脉冲展宽。摘要未说明观测时间跨度、具体天区、灵敏度或分析流程细节。

Result: 摘要报告作者此前已成功发现两颗驱动弓形激波 PWNe 的高 DM 脉冲星，并据此继续提出搜寻。此次共选出三个脉冲星候选体，这些候选体位于 SNR 和/或 PWNe 中、靠近银道面，并可能处于很远的距离，因此预期具有高 DM。摘要指出高 DM 会导致散射和脉冲展宽，使这类脉冲星难以在常规低频脉冲星巡天中被探测到；并预期 UWL 的宽频率覆盖，特别是 3-4 GHz 高频频段，可减轻这些效应并显著增强对遥远、高色散脉冲星的可探测性。摘要未给出观测结果或探测统计。

Conclusion: 作者认为，利用 ASKAP 和 MeerKAT 巡天发现的 PWN 与 SNR 关联来指导脉冲星定向搜寻是成功策略，并预期 Parkes UWL 的宽频率覆盖、特别是 3-4 GHz 高频频段，能够减轻高 DM 造成的散射与脉冲展宽，从而提升对遥远、高色散脉冲星的可探测性。根据摘要无法判断该提案是否已获得观测结果或探测到脉冲星，也无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射等的具体联系。

Abstract: Young and energetic pulsars can power pulsar wind nebulae (PWNe), which are observable across the electromagnetic spectrum from radio to X-rays. Occasionally, the origin of a PWNe is connected to the parent supernova remnants (SNR). The exceptional sensitivity and high resolution of next-generation radio surveys conducted with ASKAP and MeerKAT make them particularly effective in discovering diffuse and low surface brightness objects in our Galaxy, such as PWNe and SNRs. We can then use these PWN and SNR associations to guide our targeted search for radio pulsars. This strategy has proven successful with our recent discoveries of two high-dispersion measure (DM) pulsars powering a bow-shocked PWNe. Building on this success, we continue our search and have selected the most promising and scientifically compelling candidates for detailed follow-up investigation. We propose to use the Parkes Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver to conduct a targeted search for three pulsar candidates. Given that the pulsar candidates are embedded in SNRs and/or PWNe, located near the Galactic Plane, and may be at large distances, we expect them to have high DMs. High DMs result in scattering and pulse broadening, making them difficult to detect in conventional low-frequency pulsar surveys. The wide frequency coverage of UWL, particularly its high-frequency band (3-4 GHz), presents a unique opportunity to mitigate these effects and significantly enhance the detectability of distant, highly dispersed pulsars.

</details>


### [4338] [Parkes observations for project P1168 semester 2023APRS_07]()
*DeCesar, Megan,Ransom, Scott,Kerr, Matthew,Dai, Shi*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 用 GBT 在球状星团 Terzan 1 中首次发现七颗脉冲星，包括五颗自转周期 3–6 ms 的完全再循环 MSP、一颗 11 ms MSP 和一颗 134 ms 长周期脉冲星；初步计时表明七颗可能均为孤立脉冲星，且七颗在 Parkes/UWL 的 2022OCT 观测中均被显著探测到。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Terzan 1 此前未被发现脉冲星，摘要指出这是在该星团中首次发现脉冲星。作者希望对这些脉冲星开展长期计时以获得相位连接解、改进计时参数并探测其在星团势中的加速度；同时，134 ms 脉冲星在通过电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成脉冲星的背景下特别有趣，且作者希望探测其偏振性质及 Terzan 1 方向的银河系磁场，并搜寻此前可能被遗漏的新脉冲星。

Method: 用绿岸望远镜（GBT）在球状星团 Terzan 1 中发现七颗脉冲星并进行初步计时。2022OCT 用 Parkes 的 UWL 接收机观测 Terzan 1，以检验这些脉冲星能否在 Parkes 被探测并被计时。提议用 Parkes/UWL 开展为期一年的计时 campaña，请求继续保持状态至 2023OCT；将利用 2022OCT 观测把相位连接延长至一年以上，并尝试相位连接到最初的 GBT 发现指向。此外将探测脉冲星偏振性质和 Terzan 1 方向的银河系磁场，并搜寻新脉冲星。具体观测频率、时间跨度细节和数据分析流程摘要未说明。

Result: 在 Terzan 1 中发现七颗脉冲星，为首次在该星团发现脉冲星：五颗完全再循环 MSP 自转周期为 3 至 6 ms，一颗 11 ms MSP，以及一颗自转周期异常长达 134 ms 的脉冲星。初步计时表明七颗很可能均为孤立脉冲星，与 Terzan 1 是核心坍缩球状星团相符。全部七颗脉冲星在 2022OCT 与（继续）Parkes/UWL 观测中均被显著探测到。摘要未给出显著性数值、计时参数或偏振与磁场探测结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现表明 Terzan 1 中存在脉冲星，且七颗很可能均为孤立脉冲星，与核心坍缩球状星团的预期相符；134 ms 脉冲星在电子俘获形成脉冲星的背景下特别有趣。作者计划通过长期相位连接计时改进参数并探测星团势中的加速度，同时探测偏振性质和银河系磁场并搜寻新脉冲星。对于该 134 ms 脉冲星是否确由电子俘获形成，以及偏振与磁场探测能否实现，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope (GBT), the first pulsars to be found in this cluster. The discoveries include five fully-recycled millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with spin periods between 3 and 6 ms, an 11-ms MSP, and a pulsar with an unusually long spin period of 134 ms. Our preliminary timing suggested that all seven are likely isolated pulsars, consistent with Terzan 1 being a core-collapsed globular cluster. The 134-ms pulsar is an especially interesting discovery in the context of pulsar formation via electron-capture rather than core-collapse supernovae. We observed Terzan 1 at Parkes with the UWL receiver in 2022OCT to test whether the pulsars could be detected and thus timed at Parkes. All seven pulsars are significantly detected in both observations. We propose a year-long timing campaign with Parkes/UWL to obtain phase-connected timing solutions for these pulsars; we request continuing status to continue these timing observations through 2023OCT. To refine the timing parameters and probe the pulsars' acceleration in the cluster potential, we will extend phase connection beyond one year using the 2022OCT observations, and we will attempt to phase connect back to the original GBT discovery pointings. In addition to timing, we will probe the pulsars' polarization properties and the Galactic magnetic field in the direction of Terzan 1; and the proposed observations will also be searched for new pulsars that may have been missed in previous observations.

</details>


### [4339] [Parkes observations for project P1168 semester 2023APRS_06]()
*DeCesar, Megan,Ransom, Scott,Kerr, Matthew,Dai, Shi*

Conclusion: 作者认为，七颗可能均为孤立脉冲星，与 Terzan 1 是核心坍缩球状星团相符；134 ms 脉冲星在通过电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成脉冲星的背景下特别有趣。作者提议通过一年期 Parkes/UWL 计时 campaign 获得相位连接计时解，改进计时参数并探测脉冲星在星团势中的加速度，同时探测偏振性质、Terzan 1 方向的银河系磁场并搜寻新脉冲星。根据摘要无法判断这些脉冲星与磁星或 FRB 的联系。

Abstract: We discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope (GBT), the first pulsars to be found in this cluster. The discoveries include five fully-recycled millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with spin periods between 3 and 6 ms, an 11-ms MSP, and a pulsar with an unusually long spin period of 134 ms. Our preliminary timing suggested that all seven are likely isolated pulsars, consistent with Terzan 1 being a core-collapsed globular cluster. The 134-ms pulsar is an especially interesting discovery in the context of pulsar formation via electron-capture rather than core-collapse supernovae. We observed Terzan 1 at Parkes with the UWL receiver in 2022OCT to test whether the pulsars could be detected and thus timed at Parkes. All seven pulsars are significantly detected in both observations. We propose a year-long timing campaign with Parkes/UWL to obtain phase-connected timing solutions for these pulsars; we request continuing status to continue these timing observations through 2023OCT. To refine the timing parameters and probe the pulsars' acceleration in the cluster potential, we will extend phase connection beyond one year using the 2022OCT observations, and we will attempt to phase connect back to the original GBT discovery pointings. In addition to timing, we will probe the pulsars' polarization properties and the Galactic magnetic field in the direction of Terzan 1; and the proposed observations will also be searched for new pulsars that may have been missed in previous observations.

</details>

*DeCesar, Megan,Ransom, Scott,Kerr, Matthew,Dai, Shi*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 利用 GBT 在球状星团 Terzan 1 中首次发现七颗脉冲星，包括五颗周期 3–6 ms 的完全再循环毫秒脉冲星、一颗 11 ms 毫秒脉冲星和一颗周期 134 ms 的异常长周期脉冲星，且七颗均在 Parkes/UWL 的 2022OCT 观测中被显著探测到。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Terzan 1 此前未被发现脉冲星，因此需要在该球状星团中搜寻脉冲星并对其计时，以研究其脉冲星族群、验证其核坍缩星团的性质，并检验 134 ms 长周期脉冲星与通过电子俘获形成脉冲星这一图像的关系。

Method: 用 GBT 在球状星团 Terzan 1 中发现七颗脉冲星并作初步计时；2022OCT 用 Parkes 的 UWL 接收机观测以检验探测；提议以 Parkes/UWL 开展为期一年的计时 campaña，申请延续至 2023OCT，并利用 2022OCT 观测及尝试连接回最初 GBT 发现指向来扩展相位连接。摘要未说明具体频率或波段、样本量之外的观测时长细节与统计方法。

Result: 发现七颗脉冲星，其中五颗为自转周期 3–6 ms 的完全再循环毫秒脉冲星，一颗为 11 ms 毫秒脉冲星，一颗自转周期异常长为 134 ms；初步计时表明七颗很可能均为孤立脉冲星，与 Terzan 1 为核坍缩球状星团相符；七颗脉冲星在两次观测（包括 Parkes/UWL 2022OCT 观测）中均被显著探测到。

Conclusion: 作者认为七颗脉冲星很可能均为孤立脉冲星，这与 Terzan 1 是核坍缩球状星团相符；134 ms 脉冲星在通过电子俘获而非核坍缩超新星形成脉冲星的背景下尤为有趣。后续拟通过扩展相位连接改进计时参数并探测脉冲星在星团势中的加速度，同时探测脉冲星偏振性质与 Terzan 1 方向上的银河系磁场，并搜寻可能被遗漏的新脉冲星。根据摘要无法判断这些目标能否实现及其物理含义。

Abstract: We discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope (GBT), the first pulsars to be found in this cluster. The discoveries include five fully-recycled millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with spin periods between 3 and 6 ms, an 11-ms MSP, and a pulsar with an unusually long spin period of 134 ms. Our preliminary timing suggested that all seven are likely isolated pulsars, consistent with Terzan 1 being a core-collapsed globular cluster. The 134-ms pulsar is an especially interesting discovery in the context of pulsar formation via electron-capture rather than core-collapse supernovae. We observed Terzan 1 at Parkes with the UWL receiver in 2022OCT to test whether the pulsars could be detected and thus timed at Parkes. All seven pulsars are significantly detected in both observations. We propose a year-long timing campaign with Parkes/UWL to obtain phase-connected timing solutions for these pulsars; we request continuing status to continue these timing observations through 2023OCT. To refine the timing parameters and probe the pulsars' acceleration in the cluster potential, we will extend phase connection beyond one year using the 2022OCT observations, and we will attempt to phase connect back to the original GBT discovery pointings. In addition to timing, we will probe the pulsars' polarization properties and the Galactic magnetic field in the direction of Terzan 1; and the proposed observations will also be searched for new pulsars that may have been missed in previous observations.

</details>


### [4344] [Parkes observations for project P1238 semester 2025OCTS_04]()
*Lazarevic, Sanja,Filipovic, Miroslav,Edwards, Philip,Rowell, Gavin,Dai, Shi,Brose, Robert,Velovic, Velibor,Ahmad, Adeel,Burger-Scheidlin, Christopher*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请提出用Parkes UWL接收机对三个嵌于SNRs和/或PWNe中的脉冲星候选体开展定向搜寻，预期它们具有高DM，并借助UWL的高频波段（3-4 GHz）缓解散射与脉冲展宽、提高可探测性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 年轻高能脉冲星可驱动PWNe，其起源有时与母体SNR相关。ASKAP和MeerKAT等下一代射电巡天能发现弥散、低表面亮度的PWNe和SNR，并可通过PWN与SNR成协来指导射电脉冲星的定向搜寻；作者此前已借此发现两颗驱动弓形激波PWNe的高DM脉冲星，现继续筛选最具吸引力的候选体进行后续研究。

Method: 摘要说明将使用Parkes超宽带低频（UWL）接收机对三个脉冲星候选体开展定向搜寻；这些候选体嵌于SNRs和/或PWNe中、位于银道面附近且可能距离很远，因此预期具有高DM。摘要提到UWL的宽频率覆盖，特别是高频波段（3-4 GHz）。观测时间跨度、具体处理流程与统计方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告，作者此前的策略已成功发现两颗驱动弓形激波PWNe的高DM脉冲星。基于这一成功，作者继续搜寻并选出了最有希望且最具科学吸引力的候选体，拟对三个脉冲星候选体进行详细后续观测。摘要预期这些脉冲星候选体具有高DM；高DM会导致散射和脉冲展宽，使其难以在常规低频脉冲星巡天中被探测到。摘要未给出这三个候选体的探测结果或具体数值。

Conclusion: 作者认为，UWL的宽频率覆盖，尤其是其高频波段（3-4 GHz），为缓解高DM引起的散射与脉冲展宽、显著提高对遥远且高色散脉冲星的可探测性提供了独特机会。这些候选体是否最终被确认为脉冲星、其物理性质如何，根据摘要无法判断。对磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲发射等主题的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Young and energetic pulsars can power pulsar wind nebulae (PWNe), which are observable across the electromagnetic spectrum from radio to X-rays. Occasionally, the origin of a PWNe is connected to the parent supernova remnants (SNR). The exceptional sensitivity and high resolution of next-generation radio surveys conducted with ASKAP and MeerKAT make them particularly effective in discovering diffuse and low surface brightness objects in our Galaxy, such as PWNe and SNRs. We can then use these PWN and SNR associations to guide our targeted search for radio pulsars. This strategy has proven successful with our recent discoveries of two high-dispersion measure (DM) pulsars powering a bow-shocked PWNe. Building on this success, we continue our search and have selected the most promising and scientifically compelling candidates for detailed follow-up investigation. We propose to use the Parkes Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver to conduct a targeted search for three pulsar candidates. Given that the pulsar candidates are embedded in SNRs and/or PWNe, located near the Galactic Plane, and may be at large distances, we expect them to have high DMs. High DMs result in scattering and pulse broadening, making them difficult to detect in conventional low-frequency pulsar surveys. The wide frequency coverage of UWL, particularly its high-frequency band (3-4 GHz), presents a unique opportunity to mitigate these effects and significantly enhance the detectability of distant, highly dispersed pulsars.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者认为，由于候选脉冲星嵌入SNR和/或PWNe中、位于银道面附近且可能距离很远，预期具有高DM；高DM引起的散射和脉冲展宽使其难以在传统低频脉冲星巡天中被探测。作者据此提出，UWL的宽频率覆盖、特别是3-4 GHz高频波段，提供了减轻这些效应并显著增强对遥远、高色散脉冲星可探测性的独特机会。对与磁星、单脉冲发射、模式转换或FRB等更具体物理联系的判断，根据摘要无法判断。

Building on this success, we continue our search and have selected the most promising and scientifically compelling candidates for detailed follow-up investigation. We propose to use the Parkes Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver to conduct a targeted search for three pulsar candidates. Given that the pulsar candidates are embedded in SNRs and/or PWNe, located near the Galactic Plane, and may be at large distances, we expect them to have high DMs. High DMs result in scattering and pulse broadening, making them difficult to detect in conventional low-frequency pulsar surveys. The wide frequency coverage of UWL, particularly its high-frequency band (3-4 GHz), presents a unique opportunity to mitigate these effects and significantly enhance the detectability of distant, highly dispersed pulsars.

</details>


### [4349] [Parkes observations for project P1238 semester 2025OCTS_03]()
*Lazarevic, Sanja,Filipovic, Miroslav,Edwards, Philip,Rowell, Gavin,Dai, Shi,Brose, Robert,Velovic, Velibor,Ahmad, Adeel,Burger-Scheidlin, Christopher*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划使用 Parkes UWL 接收机对嵌于超新星遗迹和/或脉冲星风星云中的三个脉冲星候选体开展定向搜寻，利用其高频波段（3-4 GHz）缓解高色散量导致的散射与脉冲展宽，从而提升对遥远、高色散脉冲星的可探测性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 年轻高能脉冲星可驱动从射电到X射线可观测的脉冲星风星云（PWNe），其起源有时与母体超新星遗迹（SNR）相关。ASKAP 和 MeerKAT 的下一代射电巡天能发现银河系中弥散的、低表面亮度的 PWNe 和 SNR，并可用 PWN-SNR 关联指导对射电脉冲星的定向搜寻。作者此前据此发现两颗驱动弓形激波 PWNe 的高色散量（DM）脉冲星，现继续搜寻并选出最有希望的候选体。

Method: 摘要说明将使用 Parkes Ultra-Wideband Low（UWL）接收机对三个脉冲星候选体开展定向搜寻；这些候选体嵌于 SNR 和/或 PWNe 中，位于银河系平面附近，并可能距离较远。作者预计其具有高 DM，而高 DM 会导致散射和脉冲展宽，使其难以在常规低频脉冲星巡天中被探测到；UWL 的宽频率覆盖，尤其是 3-4 GHz 高频波段，可用于缓解这些效应。其他观测参数与数据分析细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要说明作者此前已发现两颗驱动弓形激波 PWNe 的高 DM 脉冲星，并据此继续搜寻、选出最有希望且科学上最具吸引力的候选体用于后续研究；本次提出对三个脉冲星候选体开展定向搜寻。由于候选体嵌于 SNR 和/或 PWNe 中、靠近银河系平面且可能距离较远，预计具有高 DM；高 DM 会造成散射和脉冲展宽，使其难以被常规低频巡天探测，而 UWL 的宽频覆盖尤其 3-4 GHz 高频波段可缓解这些效应。摘要未说明具体探测结果、信噪比或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，鉴于候选体嵌于 SNR 和/或 PWNe、靠近银河系平面且可能距离很远，预期具有高 DM；高 DM 引起的散射和脉冲展宽使其难以在常规低频脉冲星巡天中被探测。UWL 的宽频率覆盖，特别是 3-4 GHz 高频波段，为缓解这些效应并显著提升对遥远、高色散脉冲星的可探测性提供了独特机会。摘要仅陈述该预期与观测策略，未给出实际探测效果或物理结论，因此根据摘要无法判断该策略能否成功。就与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、单脉冲、模式转换、偏振或自转减慢力矩变化等的联系而言，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Young and energetic pulsars can power pulsar wind nebulae (PWNe), which are observable across the electromagnetic spectrum from radio to X-rays. Occasionally, the origin of a PWNe is connected to the parent supernova remnants (SNR). The exceptional sensitivity and high resolution of next-generation radio surveys conducted with ASKAP and MeerKAT make them particularly effective in discovering diffuse and low surface brightness objects in our Galaxy, such as PWNe and SNRs. We can then use these PWN and SNR associations to guide our targeted search for radio pulsars. This strategy has proven successful with our recent discoveries of two high-dispersion measure (DM) pulsars powering a bow-shocked PWNe. Building on this success, we continue our search and have selected the most promising and scientifically compelling candidates for detailed follow-up investigation. We propose to use the Parkes Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver to conduct a targeted search for three pulsar candidates. Given that the pulsar candidates are embedded in SNRs and/or PWNe, located near the Galactic Plane, and may be at large distances, we expect them to have high DMs. High DMs result in scattering and pulse broadening, making them difficult to detect in conventional low-frequency pulsar surveys. The wide frequency coverage of UWL, particularly its high-frequency band (3-4 GHz), presents a unique opportunity to mitigate these effects and significantly enhance the detectability of distant, highly dispersed pulsars.

</details>

The wide frequency coverage of UWL, particularly its high-frequency band (3-4 GHz), presents a unique opportunity to mitigate these effects and significantly enhance the detectability of distant, highly dispersed pulsars.

### [4351] [Parkes observations for project P1168 semester 2023APRS_08]()
*DeCesar, Megan,Ransom, Scott,Kerr, Matthew,Dai, Shi*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 利用 GBT 在球状星团 Terzan 1 中首次发现七颗脉冲星，包括五颗自转周期为 3–6 ms 的完全再循环 MSP、一颗 11 ms MSP 和一颗周期异常长的 134 ms 脉冲星；初步计时表明七颗很可能均为孤立脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Terzan 1 此前未被发现脉冲星，而在该星团中搜寻脉冲星并研究其性质，有助于检验其核心坍缩球状星团的性质；其中 134 ms 脉冲星在脉冲星经由电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成的背景下尤具意义。

Method: 用 GBT 在球状星团 Terzan 1 中开展搜寻，发现七颗脉冲星并进行了初步计时；2022OCT 用 Parkes 的 UWL 接收机对 Terzan 1 进行观测，以检验这些脉冲星能否在 Parkes 被探测和计时。提议开展为期一年的 Parkes/UWL 计时 campaign，并请求将观测延续至 2023OCT；还计划用 2022OCT 观测将相位连接扩展至一年以上并尝试连回最初 GBT 发现指向，同时探测偏振性质和 Terzan 1 方向的银河系磁场，并搜寻可能遗漏的新脉冲星。频率、带宽等具体观测配置摘要未说明。

Result: 共发现七颗脉冲星，为首批在 Terzan 1 中发现的脉冲星：五颗为自转周期 3–6 ms 的完全再循环毫秒脉冲星（MSP），一颗为 11 ms 的 MSP，另一颗自转周期异常长为 134 ms。初步计时表明七颗很可能均为孤立脉冲星，与 Terzan 1 是核心坍缩球状星团相符。七颗脉冲星在 GBT 与 2022OCT Parkes/UWL 两次观测中均被显著探测到。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现，尤其是 134 ms 脉冲星，在脉冲星经由电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成的背景下特别有趣；七颗脉冲星很可能均为孤立脉冲星，与 Terzan 1 为核心坍缩球状星团相符。作者提出通过一年期 Parkes/UWL 计时 campaign 获得相位连接计时解，并扩展相位连接以改进计时参数、探测脉冲星在星团势中的加速度，同时研究偏振性质、Terzan 1 方向的银河系磁场并搜寻新脉冲星。根据摘要无法判断该工作与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲发射的具体联系。

Abstract: We discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope (GBT), the first pulsars to be found in this cluster. The discoveries include five fully-recycled millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with spin periods between 3 and 6 ms, an 11-ms MSP, and a pulsar with an unusually long spin period of 134 ms. Our preliminary timing suggested that all seven are likely isolated pulsars, consistent with Terzan 1 being a core-collapsed globular cluster. The 134-ms pulsar is an especially interesting discovery in the context of pulsar formation via electron-capture rather than core-collapse supernovae. We observed Terzan 1 at Parkes with the UWL receiver in 2022OCT to test whether the pulsars could be detected and thus timed at Parkes. All seven pulsars are significantly detected in both observations. We propose a year-long timing campaign with Parkes/UWL to obtain phase-connected timing solutions for these pulsars; we request continuing status to continue these timing observations through 2023OCT. To refine the timing parameters and probe the pulsars' acceleration in the cluster potential, we will extend phase connection beyond one year using the 2022OCT observations, and we will attempt to phase connect back to the original GBT discovery pointings. In addition to timing, we will probe the pulsars' polarization properties and the Galactic magnetic field in the direction of Terzan 1; and the proposed observations will also be searched for new pulsars that may have been missed in previous observations.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Terzan 1 此前没有已知脉冲星，该提案旨在报告并确认其中的新脉冲星发现，并检验其能否在 Parkes 被探测和计时。七颗脉冲星初步看来可能均为孤立脉冲星，这与 Terzan 1 是核心塌缩球状星团相符；其中 134-ms 脉冲星在电子俘获形成脉冲星的背景下特别值得关注。提案还需要更长基线的计时来改进参数并探测脉冲星在星团势中的加速度。

Method: 用 Green Bank Telescope（GBT）在 Terzan 1 中搜索并发现了七颗脉冲星，并开展初步计时。2022OCT 使用 Parkes 的 UWL 接收机观测 Terzan 1，以检验这些脉冲星能否在 Parkes 被探测到。提案请求开展为期一年的 Parkes/UWL 计时观测活动以获得相位连接计时解，并把相位连接延长至一年以上，同时尝试相位连接到最初的 GBT 发现指向。除计时外还将探测脉冲星偏振性质和 Terzan 1 方向上的银河系磁场，并搜寻此前观测可能遗漏的新脉冲星。频率或波段、单次观测时长、样本大小与时间跨度细节摘要未说明。

Result: 在 Terzan 1 中发现七颗脉冲星，为该星团首批脉冲星：五颗自转周期在 3 至 6 ms 之间的完全再循环毫秒脉冲星（MSP）、一颗 11-ms MSP，以及一颗自转周期异常长的 134 ms 脉冲星。初步计时表明七颗很可能都是孤立脉冲星，与 Terzan 1 为核心塌缩球状星团相一致。2022OCT 的 Parkes/UWL 观测中，全部七颗脉冲星均被显著探测到。

Conclusion: 作者认为七颗脉冲星很可能均为孤立脉冲星，这与 Terzan 1 是核心塌缩球状星团相符；134-ms 脉冲星在脉冲星通过电子俘获而非核心塌缩超新星形成的背景下是特别有趣的发现。作者提议以 Parkes/UWL 开展为期一年的计时观测以获得相位连接计时解，并延长相位连接以改进计时参数和探测脉冲星在星团势中的加速度，同时探测偏振性质与 Terzan 1 方向的银河系磁场并搜寻新脉冲星。该提案的最终计时、偏振与磁场结果摘要未说明；其对磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、单脉冲发射或脉冲轮廓演化的直接关联，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope (GBT), the first pulsars to be found in this cluster. The discoveries include five fully-recycled millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with spin periods between 3 and 6 ms, an 11-ms MSP, and a pulsar with an unusually long spin period of 134 ms. Our preliminary timing suggested that all seven are likely isolated pulsars, consistent with Terzan 1 being a core-collapsed globular cluster. The 134-ms pulsar is an especially interesting discovery in the context of pulsar formation via electron-capture rather than core-collapse supernovae. We observed Terzan 1 at Parkes with the UWL receiver in 2022OCT to test whether the pulsars could be detected and thus timed at Parkes. All seven pulsars are significantly detected in both observations. We propose a year-long timing campaign with Parkes/UWL to obtain phase-connected timing solutions for these pulsars; we request continuing status to continue these timing observations through 2023OCT. To refine the timing parameters and probe the pulsars' acceleration in the cluster potential, we will extend phase connection beyond one year using the 2022OCT observations, and we will attempt to phase connect back to the original GBT discovery pointings. In addition to timing, we will probe the pulsars' polarization properties and the Galactic magnetic field in the direction of Terzan 1; and the proposed observations will also be searched for new pulsars that may have been missed in previous observations.

</details>

### [4354] [Parkes observations for project P1168 semester 2023APRS_11]()
*DeCesar, Megan,Ransom, Scott,Kerr, Matthew,Dai, Shi*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 用 GBT 在球状星团 Terzan 1 中首次发现七颗脉冲星，包括五颗 3–6 ms 的完全再循环 MSP、一颗 11 ms MSP 和一颗 134 ms 脉冲星；2022OCT 用 Parkes/UWL 观测时七颗均被显著探测到。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前 Terzan 1 中尚未发现脉冲星，该星团被认为可能是核塌缩球状星团；初步计时提示七颗脉冲星很可能均为孤立脉冲星；其中 134 ms 脉冲星在通过电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成脉冲星的背景下特别值得关注。

Method: 用 GBT 在球状星团 Terzan 1 中开展脉冲星搜寻与初步计时；于 2022OCT 用 Parkes 的 UWL 接收机观测 Terzan 1，以检验这些脉冲星能否在 Parkes 被探测并计时。提议用 Parkes/UWL 进行为期一年的计时 campaña，并请求继续状态将计时观测延续至 2023OCT；计划利用 2022OCT 观测将相位连接延长至一年以上，并尝试相位连接回最初的 GBT 发现指向。摘要未说明观测频率、具体时间跨度、样本量或数据分析细节。

Result: 在 Terzan 1 中发现七颗脉冲星：五颗自转周期为 3 至 6 ms 的完全再循环 MSP、一颗 11 ms MSP，以及一颗自转周期为 134 ms 的异常长周期脉冲星。初步计时表明七颗很可能均为孤立脉冲星，与 Terzan 1 是核塌缩球状星团相符。所有七颗脉冲星在 2022OCT 的 Parkes/UWL 观测和另一组观测中均被显著探测到。摘要未给出显著性数值或计时参数。

Conclusion: 作者提出用 Parkes/UWL 开展一年计时 campaña 以获得相位连接的计时解，并延长相位连接、回连到 GBT 发现指向，以改进计时参数并探测脉冲星在星团势中的加速度；此外还将探测脉冲星偏振性质与 Terzan 1 方向的银河系磁场，并搜寻此前可能遗漏的新脉冲星。134 ms 脉冲星被认为在电子俘获形成脉冲星的背景下特别有趣。根据摘要无法判断这些脉冲星与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射的具体联系。

Abstract: We discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope (GBT), the first pulsars to be found in this cluster. The discoveries include five fully-recycled millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with spin periods between 3 and 6 ms, an 11-ms MSP, and a pulsar with an unusually long spin period of 134 ms. Our preliminary timing suggested that all seven are likely isolated pulsars, consistent with Terzan 1 being a core-collapsed globular cluster. The 134-ms pulsar is an especially interesting discovery in the context of pulsar formation via electron-capture rather than core-collapse supernovae. We observed Terzan 1 at Parkes with the UWL receiver in 2022OCT to test whether the pulsars could be detected and thus timed at Parkes. All seven pulsars are significantly detected in both observations. We propose a year-long timing campaign with Parkes/UWL to obtain phase-connected timing solutions for these pulsars; we request continuing status to continue these timing observations through 2023OCT. To refine the timing parameters and probe the pulsars' acceleration in the cluster potential, we will extend phase connection beyond one year using the 2022OCT observations, and we will attempt to phase connect back to the original GBT discovery pointings. In addition to timing, we will probe the pulsars' polarization properties and the Galactic magnetic field in the direction of Terzan 1; and the proposed observations will also be searched for new pulsars that may have been missed in previous observations.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者认为这七颗可能均为孤立脉冲星，这与 Terzan 1 是核心坍缩球状星团相符；134 ms 脉冲星在通过电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成脉冲星的背景下特别有趣。作者提出通过一年及更长的 Parkes/UWL 计时获取相位连接解、改进计时参数并探测脉冲星在星团势中的加速度，同时探测偏振性质与 Terzan 1 方向的银河系磁场并搜寻可能遗漏的新脉冲星。至于这些目标能否全部实现及其物理推论，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope (GBT), the first pulsars to be found in this cluster. Our preliminary timing suggested that all seven are likely isolated pulsars, consistent with Terzan 1 being a core-collapsed globular cluster. We observed Terzan 1 at Parkes with the UWL receiver in 2022OCT to test whether the pulsars could be detected and thus timed at Parkes. All seven pulsars are significantly detected in both observations. To refine the timing parameters and probe the pulsars' acceleration in the cluster potential, we will extend phase connection beyond one year using the 2022OCT observations, and we will attempt to phase connect back to the original GBT discovery pointings. In addition to timing, we will probe the pulsars' polarization properties and the Galactic magnetic field in the direction of Terzan 1; and the proposed observations will also be searched for new pulsars that may have been missed in previous observations.

### [4356] [Parkes observations for project P1238 semester 2025OCTS_07]()
*Lazarevic, Sanja,Filipovic, Miroslav,Edwards, Philip,Rowell, Gavin,Dai, Shi,Brose, Robert,Velovic, Velibor,Ahmad, Adeel,Burger-Scheidlin, Christopher*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案提出使用Parkes UWL接收机对三个嵌于超新星遗迹和/或脉冲星风星云中的脉冲星候选体开展定向搜寻；预期这些候选体具有高DM，而UWL的高频频段（3-4 GHz）有助于缓解散射和脉冲展宽，从而提高其可探测性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 年轻高能脉冲星可驱动脉冲星风星云（PWN），其起源有时与超新星遗迹（SNR）相关。ASKAP和MeerKAT等下一代射电巡天灵敏度高、分辨率高，适合发现弥散、低表面亮度的PWN和SNR，并可利用PWN/SNR关联指导脉冲星定向搜寻。作者此前已通过该策略发现两颗驱动弓形激波PWN的高DM脉冲星，现继续搜寻并选出最有希望的候选体。摘要未说明具体的知识空白。

Method: 拟使用Parkes超宽带低频（UWL）接收机开展定向搜寻，目标为三个脉冲星候选体。候选体嵌于超新星遗迹和/或脉冲星风星云中，位于银河系平面附近，且可能距离较远，预期具有高DM。UWL具有宽频率覆盖，特别是3-4 GHz高频频段，可用于缓解散射和脉冲展宽。除上述内容外，观测时间跨度、数据量、分析流程（如计时、单脉冲、偏振、频谱或统计方法）摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告此前的搜寻策略已取得成功，即最近发现了两颗高色散量（DM）脉冲星，它们为弓形激波脉冲星风星云提供能量。基于此项成功，作者继续搜寻并已为详细后续研究选出最有希望且在科学上最具吸引力的候选体，本次拟观测其中三个脉冲星候选体。摘要未说明实际的观测结果、探测数量、显著性、DM数值、脉冲轮廓、偏振或频谱测量。

Conclusion: 作者认为，由于候选体嵌于SNR和/或PWN中、位于银河系平面附近且可能距离较远，预期具有高DM；高DM导致的散射和脉冲展宽使其难以在传统低频脉冲星巡天中被探测。UWL的宽频率覆盖，尤其是3-4 GHz高频频段，为缓解这些效应并显著提高遥远、高色散脉冲星的可探测性提供了独特机会。这一方法学上的相关性属于作者的预期，尚待观测检验；对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲、模式转换或FRB等具体物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Young and energetic pulsars can power pulsar wind nebulae (PWNe), which are observable across the electromagnetic spectrum from radio to X-rays. Occasionally, the origin of a PWNe is connected to the parent supernova remnants (SNR). The exceptional sensitivity and high resolution of next-generation radio surveys conducted with ASKAP and MeerKAT make them particularly effective in discovering diffuse and low surface brightness objects in our Galaxy, such as PWNe and SNRs. We can then use these PWN and SNR associations to guide our targeted search for radio pulsars. This strategy has proven successful with our recent discoveries of two high-dispersion measure (DM) pulsars powering a bow-shocked PWNe. Building on this success, we continue our search and have selected the most promising and scientifically compelling candidates for detailed follow-up investigation. We propose to use the Parkes Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver to conduct a targeted search for three pulsar candidates. Given that the pulsar candidates are embedded in SNRs and/or PWNe, located near the Galactic Plane, and may be at large distances, we expect them to have high DMs. High DMs result in scattering and pulse broadening, making them difficult to detect in conventional low-frequency pulsar surveys. The wide frequency coverage of UWL, particularly its high-frequency band (3-4 GHz), presents a unique opportunity to mitigate these effects and significantly enhance the detectability of distant, highly dispersed pulsars.

</details>

Motivation: Terzan 1 此前未发现脉冲星；作者需要检验新发现的七颗脉冲星能否在 Parkes 被探测并计时，从而获得相位连接计时解，并进一步改进计时参数、探测脉冲星在星团势中的加速度。摘要还指出 134-ms 脉冲星对通过电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成脉冲星的情形特别有意义。

Method: 用 Green Bank Telescope（GBT）在球状星团 Terzan 1 中开展发现观测；在 Parkes 用 UWL 接收机于 2022OCT 观测 Terzan 1，以检验七颗脉冲星能否被探测并计时；提出为期一年的 Parkes/UWL 计时观测活动以获得相位连接计时解，并请求 continuing status 将计时观测延续到 2023OCT；计划用 2022OCT 观测将相位连接扩展到一年以上，并尝试相位连接回最初的 GBT 发现指向观测。摘要未说明具体频率、带宽、时间采样或分析软件。

Result: 在 Terzan 1 中发现七颗脉冲星，为该星团首批脉冲星；包括五颗自转周期 3–6 ms 的完全再循环毫秒脉冲星、一颗 11-ms 的 MSP，以及一颗自转周期异常长、为 134 ms 的脉冲星。初步计时表明七颗很可能均为孤立脉冲星，与 Terzan 1 是核心坍缩球状星团相符。全部七颗脉冲星在两次观测（含 2022OCT 的 Parkes/UWL 观测）中均被显著探测到。摘要未给出具体显著性数值或计时参数。

Conclusion: 作者认为七颗脉冲星很可能均为孤立脉冲星，这与 Terzan 1 作为核心坍缩球状星团的性质一致；134-ms 脉冲星在通过电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成脉冲星的背景下是特别有趣的发现。拟议的 Parkes/UWL 计时活动旨在获得相位连接计时解、改进计时参数、探测脉冲星在星团势中的加速度，并进一步研究脉冲星偏振性质及 Terzan 1 方向的银河系磁场，同时搜索此前可能遗漏的新脉冲星。上述偏振、磁场与加速度结果尚未由摘要给出，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope (GBT), the first pulsars to be found in this cluster. The discoveries include five fully-recycled millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with spin periods between 3 and 6 ms, an 11-ms MSP, and a pulsar with an unusually long spin period of 134 ms. Our preliminary timing suggested that all seven are likely isolated pulsars, consistent with Terzan 1 being a core-collapsed globular cluster. The 134-ms pulsar is an especially interesting discovery in the context of pulsar formation via electron-capture rather than core-collapse supernovae. We observed Terzan 1 at Parkes with the UWL receiver in 2022OCT to test whether the pulsars could be detected and thus timed at Parkes. All seven pulsars are significantly detected in both observations. We propose a year-long timing campaign with Parkes/UWL to obtain phase-connected timing solutions for these pulsars; we request continuing status to continue these timing observations through 2023OCT. To refine the timing parameters and probe the pulsars' acceleration in the cluster potential, we will extend phase connection beyond one year using the 2022OCT observations, and we will attempt to phase connect back to the original GBT discovery pointings. In addition to timing, we will probe the pulsars' polarization properties and the Galactic magnetic field in the direction of Terzan 1; and the proposed observations will also be searched for new pulsars that may have been missed in previous observations.

</details>


### [4360] [Parkes observations for project P1238 semester 2025OCTS_12]()
*Lazarevic, Sanja,Filipovic, Miroslav,Edwards, Philip,Rowell, Gavin,Dai, Shi,Brose, Robert,Velovic, Velibor,Ahmad, Adeel,Burger-Scheidlin, Christopher*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划使用 Parkes UWL 接收机对嵌于超新星遗迹和/或脉冲星风星云中的三个脉冲星候选体开展有针对性的搜寻，重点利用其 3-4 GHz 高频波段来缓解高色散量导致的散射与脉冲展宽，从而提高探测遥远高 DM 脉冲星的可能性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 年轻高能脉冲星可驱动脉冲星风星云（PWNe），其起源有时与超新星遗迹（SNR）相关。ASKAP 和 MeerKAT 等下一代射电巡天能发现弥散、低表面亮度的 PWNe 和 SNRs，从而用 PWN/SNR 关联指导射电脉冲星的有针对性搜寻；此前已据此成功发现两颗驱动弓激波 PWNe 的高 DM 脉冲星，本文拟继续沿此路径跟进最有前景的候选体。

Method: 摘要为观测提案：拟使用 Parkes Ultra-Wideband Low（UWL）接收机对三个脉冲星候选体开展有针对性的搜寻。候选体选自 ASKAP 和 MeerKAT 下一代射电巡天中发现的 PWN/SNR 关联，它们嵌于 SNRs 和/或 PWNe 中、位于银河系平面附近且可能距离很远。利用 UWL 的宽频率覆盖，特别是 3-4 GHz 高频波段来缓解高 DM 引起的散射与脉冲展宽。观测时长、具体数据处理与计时或单脉冲分析流程：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要所述为提案而非已完成观测的结果。已报告的相关成功是：此前通过利用 PWN 和 SNR 关联进行有针对性搜寻，发现了两颗高色散量（DM）脉冲星，且它们驱动弓激波 PWNe。基于此，作者遴选出三个最具前景的脉冲星候选体，预期它们因嵌于 SNRs 和/或 PWNe、靠近银河系平面且可能距离遥远而具有高 DM，并因此受到散射和脉冲展宽影响，在传统低频脉冲星巡天中难以探测。本次拟议搜寻的探测结果、具体 DM 数值或其他观测量：摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者明确提出，UWL 的宽频率覆盖，尤其是 3-4 GHz 高频波段，可缓解高 DM 导致的散射与脉冲展宽，从而为显著提高遥远、高色散脉冲星的可探测性提供独特机会；这也是其选择该接收机对三个候选体开展目标搜寻的理由。摘要未给出已完成的探测结论或对候选体性质的物理判定；这些候选体与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或脉冲星计时、自转减慢、偏振、射电谱等具体物理过程的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Young and energetic pulsars can power pulsar wind nebulae (PWNe), which are observable across the electromagnetic spectrum from radio to X-rays. Occasionally, the origin of a PWNe is connected to the parent supernova remnants (SNR). The exceptional sensitivity and high resolution of next-generation radio surveys conducted with ASKAP and MeerKAT make them particularly effective in discovering diffuse and low surface brightness objects in our Galaxy, such as PWNe and SNRs. We can then use these PWN and SNR associations to guide our targeted search for radio pulsars. This strategy has proven successful with our recent discoveries of two high-dispersion measure (DM) pulsars powering a bow-shocked PWNe. Building on this success, we continue our search and have selected the most promising and scientifically compelling candidates for detailed follow-up investigation. We propose to use the Parkes Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver to conduct a targeted search for three pulsar candidates. Given that the pulsar candidates are embedded in SNRs and/or PWNe, located near the Galactic Plane, and may be at large distances, we expect them to have high DMs. High DMs result in scattering and pulse broadening, making them difficult to detect in conventional low-frequency pulsar surveys. The wide frequency coverage of UWL, particularly its high-frequency band (3-4 GHz), presents a unique opportunity to mitigate these effects and significantly enhance the detectability of distant, highly dispersed pulsars.

</details>


### [4361] [Parkes observations for project P1168 semester 2023APRS_05]()
*DeCesar, Megan,Ransom, Scott,Kerr, Matthew,Dai, Shi*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 用 GBT 在球状星团 Terzan 1 中首次发现七颗脉冲星，包括五颗周期 3–6 ms 的完全再循环 MSP、一颗 11 ms MSP 和一颗 134 ms 长周期脉冲星；初步计时表明七颗可能均为孤立脉冲星，且全部在 Parkes/UWL 的 2022OCT 观测中被显著探测到。


<details>

Motivation: Terzan 1 此前从未被发现脉冲星，因此需要在该星团中搜寻并建立计时解；同时，在该星团中检验脉冲星发现与计时可行性，并借此研究脉冲星形成机制（尤其是电子俘获形成路径）、脉冲星在星团势中的加速度、偏振性质与银河系磁场。

Method: 用 Green Bank Telescope（GBT）发现七颗脉冲星并进行初步计时；2022OCT 用 Parkes 的 UWL 接收机观测 Terzan 1，检验是否可探测并计时；提议 Parkes/UWL 为期一年的计时campaign以获得相位连接计时解，并将相位连接扩展至一年以上，尝试连接回 GBT 发现指向；同时探测偏振性质与银河系磁场，并搜寻新脉冲星。摘要未说明观测频率或频段、总观测时长与具体分析方法。

Result: 在 Terzan 1 中发现七颗脉冲星：五颗自转周期 3–6 ms 的完全再循环 MSP、一颗 11 ms MSP、一颗自转周期 134 ms 的脉冲星。初步计时表明七颗很可能均为孤立脉冲星，与 Terzan 1 是核心坍缩球状星团相符。2022OCT 的 Parkes/UWL 观测中，七颗脉冲星均被显著探测到。

Conclusion: 作者认为七颗脉冲星可能均为孤立脉冲星，这与 Terzan 1 作为核心坍缩球状星团相符；134 ms 脉冲星在通过电子俘获而非核心坍缩超新星形成脉冲星的背景下特别有趣。提议的 Parkes/UWL 一年计时campaign旨在获得相位连接计时解、改进计时参数、探测脉冲星在星团势中的加速度，并进一步研究偏振性质、Terzan 1 方向的银河系磁场以及搜寻可能被遗漏的新脉冲星。根据摘要无法判断七颗脉冲星与磁星、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、自转减慢力矩变化或 FRB 之间是否存在直接联系。

Abstract: We discovered seven pulsars in the globular cluster Terzan 1 with the Green Bank Telescope (GBT), the first pulsars to be found in this cluster. The discoveries include five fully-recycled millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with spin periods between 3 and 6 ms, an 11-ms MSP, and a pulsar with an unusually long spin period of 134 ms. Our preliminary timing suggested that all seven are likely isolated pulsars, consistent with Terzan 1 being a core-collapsed globular cluster. The 134-ms pulsar is an especially interesting discovery in the context of pulsar formation via electron-capture rather than core-collapse supernovae. We observed Terzan 1 at Parkes with the UWL receiver in 2022OCT to test whether the pulsars could be detected and thus timed at Parkes. All seven pulsars are significantly detected in both observations. We propose a year-long timing campaign with Parkes/UWL to obtain phase-connected timing solutions for these pulsars; we request continuing status to continue these timing observations through 2023OCT. To refine the timing parameters and probe the pulsars' acceleration in the cluster potential, we will extend phase connection beyond one year using the 2022OCT observations, and we will attempt to phase connect back to the original GBT discovery pointings. In addition to timing, we will probe the pulsars' polarization properties and the Galactic magnetic field in the direction of Terzan 1; and the proposed observations will also be searched for new pulsars that may have been missed in previous observations.

</details>

### [4364] [Parkes observations for project P1372 semester 2025OCTS_03]()
*Wang, Ziteng,Zic, Andrew,McSweeney, Samuel James,Hurley-Walker, Natasha,Petrou, Flora,Tan, Chia Min*

TL;DR: 该申请针对新确认的蜘蛛脉冲星双星 PSR J1646-4406（其伽马射线源为 4GFL J1646.5-4406，可能为红背系统）提出同时的 Murriyang UWL 与 ATCA L 波段观测，以期进一步限制轨道参数、研究食机制与双星内激波并理解其演化路径。摘要尚未报告观测结果。

### [4368] [Parkes observations for project P1069 semester 2020APRS_10]()
*Dai, Shi,Murphy, Tara,Hobbs, George,Zic, Andrew,Kaplan, David,Qiu, Hao,Stewart, Adam,Pritchard, Joshua,Jones, Megan*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RACS提供了南半球首次在成像领域开展的全天脉冲星巡天，并识别出八个异常脉冲星候选体；它们具有高圆偏振比例、缺乏光学对应体、强变化性，且此前脉冲星巡天未探测到这些相对明亮的源，这可能指示其具有极端性质，因此需要Parkes后续观测加以确认和深入研究。

Method: 摘要说明拟利用Parkes对RACS选出的八个脉冲星候选体开展后续观测，并使用UWL进行高时间分辨率和频率分辨率的定向搜索。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、时间跨度、分析流程以及统计或偏振分析方法。

Conclusion: 作者提出，所拟议的Parkes高时间分辨率和频率分辨率定向搜索将能够对具有极短自转周期或处于致密双星中的脉冲星开展深度搜索。根据摘要无法判断这些候选体是否确为脉冲星，也无法判断其变化性的具体物理成因。

Abstract: We propose to carry out Parkes follow-up observations of pulsar candidates identified in the Rapid ASKAP Continuum Survey (RACS). This is the first all-sky pulsar survey in the imaging domain in the southern hemisphere thanks to ASKAP. Eight sources have been selected because of (1) their very high fraction of circular polarisation; (2) their lack of optical counterparts; (3) strong variability, which might indicate either strong interstellar scintillation or eclipsing by companion stars if in binaries; (4) the non-detection of these relatively bright sources in previous pulsar surveys, which might indicate extreme nature of these candidates. High time and frequency resolution targeted search with UWL are proposed. Such observations will enable us to carry out deep searches of pulsars with very short spin periods or in compact binaries.

</details>

Method: 摘要说明拟开展Parkes后续观测，从RACS中选取八个脉冲星候选体，并使用UWL进行高时间与频率分辨率的目标搜寻观测；摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度、灵敏度或分析流程。

Result: 摘要报告已从RACS中选出八个源，其入选依据为：极高比例的圆偏振；缺乏光学对应体；强变异性，可能源于强星际闪烁，或若处于双星中则可能源于伴星掩食；以及这些相对明亮的源在此前脉冲星巡天中未被探测到，这可能表明其具有极端性质。摘要未给出观测结果或数值。

Conclusion: 作者提出，所拟议的Parkes高时间与频率分辨率观测将能够对极短自转周期脉冲星或处于致密双星中的脉冲星开展深度搜寻；对候选体极端性质的判断属于其入选理由中提出的可能解释，尚待观测检验。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、单脉冲发射或FRB的具体物理联系。

Abstract: We propose to carry out Parkes follow-up observations of pulsar candidates identified in the Rapid ASKAP Continuum Survey (RACS). This is the first all-sky pulsar survey in the imaging domain in the southern hemisphere thanks to ASKAP. Eight sources have been selected because of (1) their very high fraction of circular polarisation; (2) their lack of optical counterparts; (3) strong variability, which might indicate either strong interstellar scintillation or eclipsing by companion stars if in binaries; (4) the non-detection of these relatively bright sources in previous pulsar surveys, which might indicate extreme nature of these candidates. ### [4385] [Parkes observations for project P1011 semester 2019APRS_12]()
*Jankowski, Fabian,Stappers, Benjamin,Keane, Evan*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟利用Parkes望远镜UWL接收机在约700–4000 MHz的宽频覆盖，测定26颗此前已显示射电频谱特征或迹象的脉冲星的频谱，以刻画并在所记录带宽内分辨其频谱特征，进而探讨这些特征的物理起源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 射电频谱中呈现曲率或拐折等特征的脉冲星在已知脉冲星族群中似属特殊，仅约20%表现出这类特征；但除1.4 GHz外，可靠流量密度测量往往缺失，导致其频谱形态和特征无法被准确确定。

Method: 摘要说明，拟利用Parkes望远镜新近投入使用的UWL接收机，其瞬时频率覆盖约为700至4000 MHz且灵敏度高，用于测定26颗此前已被认定表现出频谱特征或迹象的射电脉冲星的频谱；摘要未说明观测时间跨度、具体分析流程或统计方法。

Result: 摘要未报告观测结果或数据分析结果，仅提出计划：利用新的Parkes数据确定这26颗脉冲星在上述频率范围内的频谱形态、表征其频谱特征，并在所记录的带宽内分辨这些特征。摘要未给出具体流量密度、谱指数、特征频率或显著性数值。

Conclusion: 作者的目标是理解所观测频谱特征的物理起源，即判断这些特征是否可能为这些源中脉冲星发射所固有，还是由脉冲星磁层内部的吸收过程造成，抑或来自沿视线方向的作用。摘要未给出已确立的结论；根据摘要无法判断哪一机制成立。

Abstract: Pulsars with features in their radio spectra, such as curvature or breaks seem to be special cases among the known pulsar population, with only about 20 per cent exhibiting them. Unfortunately, reliable flux density measurements besides at 1.4 GHz are often unavailable, so that their spectral morphologies and features cannot be determined accurately. We propose to utilize the unique capabilities of the newly commissioned UWL receiver at the Parkes telescope, its extremely wide instantaneous frequency coverage from about 700 to 4000 MHz together with its high sensitivity, to determine the spectra of 26 radio pulsars. These have previously been identified to exhibit spectral features or show hints thereof. The new Parkes data are crucial to determine their spectral morphologies in that frequency range, to characterize their spectral features and to resolve these within the recorded bandwidth. Our aim is to understand the physical origin of the features, namely, whether these are perhaps intrinsic to the pulsar emission in these sources, are caused by absorption processes inside the pulsar's magnetosphere, or along the line of sight.

</details>

TL;DR: 该提案拟利用Parkes望远镜新投入使用的UWL接收机在约700至4000 MHz的宽频覆盖，测定26颗此前已显示频谱特征或迹象的射电脉冲星的频谱，以确定其频谱形态并分辨这些特征，进而理解其物理起源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅有约20%的已知脉冲星在射电频谱中表现出曲率或折断等特征，似乎属于特殊情况；而除1.4 GHz外，可靠的流量密度测量往往缺失，导致其频谱形态与特征无法准确确定。因此需要新的宽带、高灵敏度观测来刻画这些频谱特征并探讨其物理起源。

Method: 摘要说明这是一个观测提案：利用Parkes望远镜新投入使用的UWL接收机，其瞬时频率覆盖约700至4000 MHz，并具有高灵敏度，用于测定26颗此前已被识别为表现出频谱特征或迹象的射电脉冲星的频谱。目标是确定该频率范围内的频谱形态、表征并在记录带宽内分辨其频谱特征。具体观测时长、数据处理与统计方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未报告观测结果。摘要指出，已知脉冲星中仅约20%表现出曲率或折断等射电频谱特征；除1.4 GHz外，可靠的流量密度测量往往无法获得，因此难以准确确定其频谱形态与特征；并指出26颗脉冲星此前已被识别为表现出频谱特征或显示出其迹象。

Conclusion: 作者提出，新的Parkes UWL数据对于确定这些脉冲星在所覆盖频率范围内的频谱形态、表征其频谱特征并在记录带宽内分辨这些特征至关重要；其目标是理解这些频谱特征的物理起源，即这些特征或许内禀于这些源的脉冲星发射，或由脉冲星磁层内部的吸收过程导致，或沿视线方向所致。摘要未给出对这些可能性的判断。

Abstract: Pulsars with features in their radio spectra, such as curvature or breaks seem to be special cases among the known pulsar population, with only about 20 per cent exhibiting them. Unfortunately, reliable flux density measurements besides at 1.4 GHz are often unavailable, so that their spectral morphologies and features cannot be determined accurately. We propose to utilize the unique capabilities of the newly commissioned UWL receiver at the Parkes telescope, its extremely wide instantaneous frequency coverage from about 700 to 4000 MHz together with its high sensitivity, to determine the spectra of 26 radio pulsars. These have previously been identified to exhibit spectral features or show hints thereof. The new Parkes data are crucial to determine their spectral morphologies in that frequency range, to characterize their spectral features and to resolve these within the recorded bandwidth. Our aim is to understand the physical origin of the features, namely, whether these are perhaps intrinsic to the pulsar emission in these sources, are caused by absorption processes inside the pulsar's magnetosphere, or along the line of sight.

</details>

TL;DR: 该提案拟利用Parkes望远镜新投入使用的UWL接收机（约700至4000 MHz）测量26颗此前被识别为具有光谱特征或迹象的射电脉冲星的流量密度，以确定其光谱形态并表征光谱特征。其目标是弄清这些特征的物理起源，即它们是否内禀于这些源的脉冲星发射、由脉冲星磁层内吸收过程引起，还是沿视线方向造成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具有射电光谱特征（如曲率或折断）的脉冲星在已知脉冲星族群中似属特殊情况，仅约20%表现出这类特征；而除1.4 GHz外，可靠的流量密度测量往往无法获得，导致其光谱形态和特征无法被准确确定。该提案因此希望填补这一测量与表征缺口，并进一步探究这些特征的物理起源。

Method: 摘要未说明观测时间跨度或数据分析方法。摘要说明：提议利用Parkes望远镜新近投入使用的UWL接收机的独特能力，其瞬时频率覆盖约700至4000 MHz且灵敏度高，用以确定26颗射电脉冲星的光谱；这些脉冲星此前已被识别为表现出光谱特征或显示出其迹象。目标是确定其在上述频率范围内的光谱形态、表征光谱特征，并在所记录的带宽内分辨这些特征。

Result: 摘要未说明。摘要仅报告背景性陈述：具有曲率或折断等射电光谱特征的脉冲星在已知脉冲星族群中似属特殊情况，仅约20%表现出这类特征；除1.4 GHz外，可靠的流量密度测量往往无法获得。摘要未给出新的观测结果、流量密度数值、光谱形态测定结果、显著性或统计量。

Conclusion: 作者的明确目标是理解这些光谱特征的物理起源，即判断这些特征是否或许内禀于这些源中的脉冲星发射，是由脉冲星磁层内部的吸收过程引起，还是沿视线方向引起。摘要将这些可能性表述为有待检验的选项，未给出确定性结论。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、单脉冲发射、模式转换、偏振或计时等主题的关联。

Abstract: Pulsars with features in their radio spectra, such as curvature or breaks seem to be special cases among the known pulsar population, with only about 20 per cent exhibiting them. Unfortunately, reliable flux density measurements besides at 1.4 GHz are often unavailable, so that their spectral morphologies and features cannot be determined accurately. We propose to utilize the unique capabilities of the newly commissioned UWL receiver at the Parkes telescope, its extremely wide instantaneous frequency coverage from about 700 to 4000 MHz together with its high sensitivity, to determine the spectra of 26 radio pulsars. These have previously been identified to exhibit spectral features or show hints thereof. The new Parkes data are crucial to determine their spectral morphologies in that frequency range, to characterize their spectral features and to resolve these within the recorded bandwidth. Our aim is to understand the physical origin of the features, namely, whether these are perhaps intrinsic to the pulsar emission in these sources, are caused by absorption processes inside the pulsar's magnetosphere, or along the line of sight.

</details>

### [4401] [Parkes observations for project P1200 semester 2026APRS_01]()

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需要确定诸如 P456 的脉冲星计时项目应继续使用 UWL，还是转向 CryoPAF；摘要指出 CryoPAF 在重叠频段系统温度更低，且不需要额外校准观测，但这一潜在优势是否适用于高精度计时尚需观测验证。

Method: 使用单个 CryoPAF 波束进行高精度脉冲星计时实验，观测 J1909-3744、J1744-1134、J1713+0747 三颗计时精度最佳的脉冲星，并观测 J0613-0200、J1017-7156、J1902-5105、J2129-5721；将所得结果与 P456 的观测结果比较。具体时间跨度、观测频段设置与统计方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要为提案，尚未报告已获得的观测结果。摘要给出的预期用途包括：演示使用 CryoPAF 的脉冲星计时技术；证明 CryoPAF 可被偏振和流量校准到高精度计时所需水平；提供 CryoPAF 高精度计时数据集以确保系统内无计时偏移；比较 UWL 与 CryoPAF 结果，确定哪类脉冲星最适合用 CryoPAF、哪类最适合用 UWL。所涉及脉冲星中 J0613-0200、J1017-7156、J1902-5105、J2129-5721 在 2 GHz 以上信噪比降低。

Conclusion: 作者提出通过对比 CryoPAF 与 UWL 的高精度计时结果，判断 P456 等计时项目是否应转向 CryoPAF，并据此确定不同脉冲星更适合的接收系统；这些判断取决于拟议观测的结果，摘要未给出已完成的物理结论。该方法与高精度脉冲星计时技术相关，但摘要未提及磁星、单脉冲发射、模式转换、自转减慢力矩变化或快速射电暴。

Abstract: We propose to use a single CryoPAF beam for high precision pulsar timing experiments to determine whether pulsar timing projects, such as P456, should continue with the UWL or transition to the CryoPAF, which has a lower system temperature in the overlapping bands and no requirement for extra calibration observations. We will observe three of the best timed pulsars and compare the resulting observations with those from P456. These pulsars are J1909-3744, J1744-1134, and J1713+0747. In addition, we will also observe J0613-0200, J1017-7156, J1902-5105, J2129-5721, which show diminished signal-to-noise above 2 GHz, but are still important to the P456 observing programme. The results will be used to demonstrate pulsar timing techniques using the CryoPAF; demonstrate that the CryoPAF can be polarization and flux calibrated to a level required for high precision timing; provide high-precision timing data sets with the CryoPAF in order to ensure there are no timing offsets within the system; compare the UWL and CryoPAF results to determine which type of pulsars are best observed with the CryoPAF and which with the UWL.

</details>

### [4406] [Parkes observations for project P1330 semester 2024APRS_03]()
*Bhakta, Deven,Ransom, Scott,DeCesar, Megan,Dai, Shi*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请报告在NGC6316中发现了一颗高度加速的双星毫秒脉冲星NGC6316A，这是该星团中首颗被探测到的脉冲星；申请17次3小时指向观测以求解其轨道并开展一年计时，同时搜索更多脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 球状星团因恒星密度高、相互作用频繁而优先产生毫秒脉冲星（MSP），估计其中含有数十到数百颗MSP；Fermi探测到的球状星团伽马射线辐射的主要假说也归因于星团MSP。但部分被预测有数十颗MSP的星团此前并无探测，需要寻找以检验这些预期。

Method: 观测了三个被预测拥有数十颗MSP但此前未探测到脉冲星的星团，搜索需在色散量（DM）、周期和加速度上进行；已获得该双星轨道周期的较好限制，并申请17次3小时指向观测以求解轨道、开展为期一年的计时campaign并搜索更多脉冲星。摘要未说明望远镜、接收机、观测频段、具体时间跨度及数据分析细节。

Result: 在NGC6316中发现了高度加速的双星毫秒脉冲星NGC6316A，这是该星团中第一颗被发现的脉冲星。已知该星团的DM后，在该星团内找到更多脉冲星的机会增加；目前已对双星轨道周期有较好的限制，但尚未完全限制轨道参数，也未确定伴星类型。摘要未给出具体数值。

Conclusion: 在特定球状星团中发现第一颗脉冲星是最具挑战性的步骤；一旦确定星团DM，后续搜索更多脉冲星的可行性提高，而后续观测对完全限制该双星轨道参数、确定伴星类型以及搜索更多脉冲星是必要的。根据摘要无法判断该发现对磁星—快速射电暴（FRB）联系等问题的意义。

Abstract: Millisecond pulsars (MSPs) are created preferentially in globular clusters (GCs), compared to the Galactic disk, due to the large stellar density and the resulting interactions that occur within the clusters. Estimates have tens to hundreds of MSPs within these clusters. Furthermore, the leading hypothesis behind the gamma-ray emission from the GCs, detected by Fermi, is due to cluster MSPs. Thus, we observed three clusters, that were predicted to have tens of MSPs but did not have any detected, and found a highly accelerated binary MSP (NGC6316A) in NGC6316. Finding the first pulsar in a particular globular cluster is always the most challenging part as we have to search over the dispersion measure (DM) as well as period and acceleration. Our chances of finding more pulsars within the cluster have increased now that we know the DM of the cluster. We have a decent constraint on the orbital period of the binary but in order to fully constrain the orbital parameters and determine the type of companion star, we need subsequent observations. These subsequent observations will also be useful to search for more pulsars within the cluster. We are requesting 17 3 hour pointings to solve for the orbit of the binary pulsar and conduct a year-long timing campaign on the pulsar while searching for more pulsars.

</details>


### [4407] [Parkes observations for project P1330 semester 2024APRS_04]()
*Bhakta, Deven,Ransom, Scott,DeCesar, Megan,Dai, Shi*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 在被预测拥有数十颗毫秒脉冲星但此前未探测到脉冲星的三个球状星团中，作者在NGC6316中发现了一颗高度加速的毫秒脉冲星双星NGC6316A（该星团的首颗脉冲星），并申请17次3小时指向观测以求解其轨道、开展为期一年的计时campaign并搜寻更多脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 毫秒脉冲星（MSP）因球状星团（GC）内恒星密度高及由此产生的相互作用，相比银盘更易在球状星团中形成；估计这些星团内有数十至数百颗MSP。此外，Fermi探测到的球状星团伽马射线辐射的主流假说认为源自星团MSP。然而部分被预测拥有数十颗MSP的星团此前未探测到任何脉冲星，需要观测检验并填补这一空白。

Method: 观测了三个被预测拥有数十颗MSP但此前未探测到脉冲星的星团；在DM以及周期和加速度上进行搜索；已在NGC6316中发现一颗高度加速的毫秒脉冲星双星NGC6316A。摘要未说明所用望远镜或仪器、观测频段、观测时间跨度与具体分析流程。作者申请17次3小时的指向观测，用于求解该双星轨道、对脉冲星开展为期一年的计时campaign，并同时搜寻该星团内的更多脉冲星。

Result: 在被预测拥有数十颗MSP但此前无脉冲星探测的三个星团中，于NGC6316发现了一颗高度加速的毫秒脉冲星双星（NGC6316A），这是该星团的首颗脉冲星。由于必须同时在DM以及周期和加速度上搜索，第一颗脉冲星的发现最为困难；已知该星团的DM后，在星团内找到更多脉冲星的机会增加。对双星轨道周期已有一定限制。摘要未给出DM数值、轨道周期数值、加速度数值或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，已知该星团的DM提高了在该星团内发现更多脉冲星的可能性；为完全限制NGC6316A的轨道参数并确定伴星类型，需要后续观测，这些观测也有助于搜寻更多脉冲星。根据摘要无法判断该发现与磁星、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱、自转减慢力矩变化或快速射电暴（FRB）之间是否存在联系；摘要中出现的DM搜索属于该发现本身的搜索参数，并非DM相关科学结论。

Abstract: Millisecond pulsars (MSPs) are created preferentially in globular clusters (GCs), compared to the Galactic disk, due to the large stellar density and the resulting interactions that occur within the clusters. Estimates have tens to hundreds of MSPs within these clusters. Furthermore, the leading hypothesis behind the gamma-ray emission from the GCs, detected by Fermi, is due to cluster MSPs. Thus, we observed three clusters, that were predicted to have tens of MSPs but did not have any detected, and found a highly accelerated binary MSP (NGC6316A) in NGC6316. Finding the first pulsar in a particular globular cluster is always the most challenging part as we have to search over the dispersion measure (DM) as well as period and acceleration. Our chances of finding more pulsars within the cluster have increased now that we know the DM of the cluster. We have a decent constraint on the orbital period of the binary but in order to fully constrain the orbital parameters and determine the type of companion star, we need subsequent observations. These subsequent observations will also be useful to search for more pulsars within the cluster. We are requesting 17 3 hour pointings to solve for the orbit of the binary pulsar and conduct a year-long timing campaign on the pulsar while searching for more pulsars.

</details>

### [4411] [Parkes observations for project P1413 semester 2026APRS_09]()
*Sengar, Rahul,Bailes, Matthew,Tauris, Thomas,Kaplan, David,Clark, Colin James*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请拟用 75 小时 Parkes 观测时间对非再循环 340 ms 脉冲星 PSR J1635-5134（18 小时近圆形轨道、伴星最小质量 0.26 太阳质量）开展后随观测，其 DM 变化超过 30 pc/cc 且随轨道相位变化，并已从以中等幅度为主转为持续较大。目标是通过延长计时基线和相位定向观测，将天体测量精度提升至亚角秒并刻画多余 DM 的时间行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1635-5134 位于双星脉冲星参数空间中稀疏占据的区域，可能代表低效自旋加速之后一个短命的演化阶段，因而可能是典型双星与毫秒脉冲星-WD 族群之间的缺失一环。该系统表现出依赖轨道相位的 DM 变化，且此前 Parkes 监测显示 DM 变化从以中等幅度为主转为持续较大，稀疏或不规则的观测无法表征这一演化中的等离子体环境；其高 DM 变化是间歇还是长期存在、多余物质如何随轨道相位和历元变化，以及 sdB 星风是否为所需电子柱供能，均有待确定。

Method: 申请 75 小时 Parkes 观测时间，对 PSR J1635-5134 进行专门的射电后随观测；通过延长计时基线以提升天体测量精度至亚角秒，并在食/DM 变化相位期间进行相位定向观测。摘要提及此前用 Parkes 进行的监测，但未说明具体接收机、观测频段、总时间跨度及数据分析方法。脉冲星周期为 340 ms，轨道周期为 18 小时，伴星最小质量为 0.26 太阳质量，DM 变化超过 30 pc/cc。

Result: PSR J1635-5134 是一颗非再循环的 340 ms 脉冲星，处于近圆形 18 小时轨道中，伴星最小质量为 0.26 太阳质量。该系统表现出依赖轨道相位的 DM 变化，DM 变化超过 30 pc/cc，表明存在大量电离物质，可能与伴星流出物有关；在此前 Parkes 监测中，DM 变化从以中等幅度为主转变为持续较大。摘要未说明这些变化的统计显著性、具体历元或观测频段。

Conclusion: 作者依据摘要提出，PSR J1635-5134 可能代表低效自旋加速之后一个短命演化阶段，从而提供典型双星与毫秒脉冲星-WD 族群之间的缺失一环；依赖轨道相位的 DM 变化指示大量电离物质，可能与伴星流出物有关，并可能由 sdB 星风提供所需电子柱。延长计时基线与相位定向观测被认为对限制等离子体起源和几何结构、检验上述假说至关重要。根据摘要无法判断这些解释的最终确证程度。

Abstract: We request 75 hours of Parkes observing time for dedicated radio follow-up observations of PSR J1635-5134, a promising candidate pulsar-subdwarf B (sdB) star binary system. PSR J1635-5134 is a non-recycled 340 ms pulsar in a nearly circular 18-hour orbit with a minimum companion mass of 0.26 solar mass. It lies in a sparsely populated region of binary-pulsars parameter space and may represent a short-lived evolutionary stage immediately following inefficient spin-up, thereby providing a missing link between canonical binaries and the millisecond pulsar-WD population. The system exhibits peculiar, orbital-phase-dependent dispersion-measure (DM) variability, with DM variations exceeding 30 pc/cc, indicating substantial ionised material plausibly associated with an outflow from the companion. Moreover, during prior monitoring with Parkes, the DM variations shifted from being predominantly modest to being persistently large, implying an evolving plasma environment that cannot be characterised with sparse or irregular observations. Determining whether these high-DM variations are intermittent or long-lived, and mapping how the excess material varies with orbital phase and epoch, are essential for constraining the origin and geometry of the plasma and for testing the hypothesis that an sdB wind supplies the required electron column. Through this proposal, we aim to (i) extend the timing baseline to improve astrometric precision to sub-arcsecond accuracy, enabling secure identification of the optical counterpart in a crowded field, and (ii) perform phase-targeted observations during eclipse/DM variation phases to understand the temporal behavior of excess DM.

</details>

Through this proposal, we aim to (i) extend the timing baseline to improve astrometric precision to sub-arcsecond accuracy, enabling secure identification of the optical counterpart in a crowded field, and (ii) perform phase-targeted observations during eclipse/DM variation phases to understand the temporal behavior of excess DM.

Abstract: We request 75 hours of Parkes observing time for dedicated radio follow-up observations of PSR J1635-5134, a promising candidate pulsar-subdwarf B (sdB) star binary system. PSR J1635-5134 is a non-recycled 340 ms pulsar in a nearly circular 18-hour orbit with a minimum companion mass of 0.26 solar mass. It lies in a sparsely populated region of binary-pulsars parameter space and may represent a short-lived evolutionary stage immediately following inefficient spin-up, thereby providing a missing link between canonical binaries and the millisecond pulsar-WD population. The system exhibits peculiar, orbital-phase-dependent dispersion-measure (DM) variability, with DM variations exceeding 30 pc/cc, indicating substantial ionised material plausibly associated with an outflow from the companion. Moreover, during prior monitoring with Parkes, the DM variations shifted from being predominantly modest to being persistently large, implying an evolving plasma environment that cannot be characterised with sparse or irregular observations. Determining whether these high-DM variations are intermittent or long-lived, and mapping how the excess material varies with orbital phase and epoch, are essential for constraining the origin and geometry of the plasma and for testing the hypothesis that an sdB wind supplies the required electron column. Through this proposal, we aim to (i) extend the timing baseline to improve astrometric precision to sub-arcsecond accuracy, enabling secure identification of the optical counterpart in a crowded field, and (ii) perform phase-targeted observations during eclipse/DM variation phases to understand the temporal behavior of excess DM.

TL;DR: 申请 75 小时 Parkes 观测时间对非再循环 340 ms 脉冲星 PSR J1635-5134（18 小时近圆轨道、伴星最小质量 0.26 太阳质量的脉冲星—sdB 双星候选体）进行后续观测，以研究其超过 30 pc/cc 的轨道相位相关 DM 变化并延长计时基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1635-5134 位于双脉冲星参数空间中稀疏占据的区域，可能代表低效自旋加速后一个短寿命演化阶段，并可能是典型双星与毫秒脉冲星—WD 族群之间缺失的一环；该系统还表现出无法用稀疏或不规则观测表征的、不断演化的等离子体环境，因此需要专门的后续观测。

Abstract: We request 75 hours of Parkes observing time for dedicated radio follow-up observations of PSR J1635-5134, a promising candidate pulsar-subdwarf B (sdB) star binary system. PSR J1635-5134 is a non-recycled 340 ms pulsar in a nearly circular 18-hour orbit with a minimum companion mass of 0.26 solar mass. It lies in a sparsely populated region of binary-pulsars parameter space and may represent a short-lived evolutionary stage immediately following inefficient spin-up, thereby providing a missing link between canonical binaries and the millisecond pulsar-WD population. The system exhibits peculiar, orbital-phase-dependent dispersion-measure (DM) variability, with DM variations exceeding 30 pc/cc, indicating substantial ionised material plausibly associated with an outflow from the companion. Moreover, during prior monitoring with Parkes, the DM variations shifted from being predominantly modest to being persistently large, implying an evolving plasma environment that cannot be characterised with sparse or irregular observations. Determining whether these high-DM variations are intermittent or long-lived, and mapping how the excess material varies with orbital phase and epoch, are essential for constraining the origin and geometry of the plasma and for testing the hypothesis that an sdB wind supplies the required electron column. Through this proposal, we aim to (i) extend the timing baseline to improve astrometric precision to sub-arcsecond accuracy, enabling secure identification of the optical counterpart in a crowded field, and (ii) perform phase-targeted observations during eclipse/DM variation phases to understand the temporal behavior of excess DM.

</details>

Abstract: We request 75 hours of Parkes observing time for dedicated radio follow-up observations of PSR J1635-5134, a promising candidate pulsar-subdwarf B (sdB) star binary system. PSR J1635-5134 is a non-recycled 340 ms pulsar in a nearly circular 18-hour orbit with a minimum companion mass of 0.26 solar mass. It lies in a sparsely populated region of binary-pulsars parameter space and may represent a short-lived evolutionary stage immediately following inefficient spin-up, thereby providing a missing link between canonical binaries and the millisecond pulsar-WD population. The system exhibits peculiar, orbital-phase-dependent dispersion-measure (DM) variability, with DM variations exceeding 30 pc/cc, indicating substantial ionised material plausibly associated with an outflow from the companion. Moreover, during prior monitoring with Parkes, the DM variations shifted from being predominantly modest to being persistently large, implying an evolving plasma environment that cannot be characterised with sparse or irregular observations. Determining whether these high-DM variations are intermittent or long-lived, and mapping how the excess material varies with orbital phase and epoch, are essential for constraining the origin and geometry of the plasma and for testing the hypothesis that an sdB wind supplies the required electron column. PSR J1635-5134 is a non-recycled 340 ms pulsar in a nearly circular 18-hour orbit with a minimum companion mass of 0.26 solar mass. It lies in a sparsely populated region of binary-pulsars parameter space and may represent a short-lived evolutionary stage immediately following inefficient spin-up, thereby providing a missing link between canonical binaries and the millisecond pulsar-WD population. The system exhibits peculiar, orbital-phase-dependent dispersion-measure (DM) variability, with DM variations exceeding 30 pc/cc, indicating substantial ionised material plausibly associated with an outflow from the companion. Moreover, during prior monitoring with Parkes, the DM variations shifted from being predominantly modest to being persistently large, implying an evolving plasma environment that cannot be characterised with sparse or irregular observations. Determining whether these high-DM variations are intermittent or long-lived, and mapping how the excess material varies with orbital phase and epoch, are essential for constraining the origin and geometry of the plasma and for testing the hypothesis that an sdB wind supplies the required electron column. Through this proposal, we aim to (i) extend the timing baseline to improve astrometric precision to sub-arcsecond accuracy, enabling secure identification of the optical counterpart in a crowded field, and (ii) perform phase-targeted observations during eclipse/DM variation phases to understand the temporal behavior of excess DM.
