TL;DR: 该申请请求 75 小时 Parkes 观测时间，对非再循环 340 ms 脉冲星 PSR J1635-5134——一个近圆形 18 小时轨道、最小伴星质量 0.26 太阳质量的脉冲星-sdB 双星候选体——进行后续观测，以延长计时基线并理解其超过 30 pc/cc 的轨道相位依赖 DM 变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1635-5134 位于双星脉冲星参数空间的稀疏区域，可能代表紧随低效自旋加速之后的短寿演化阶段，为典型双星与毫秒脉冲星-WD 族群之间提供缺失的一环；该系统表现出奇特的轨道相位依赖 DM 变化，且先前监测显示 DM 变化由以适度为主转为持续很大，因而需要专门观测来加以表征。

Method: 申请 75 小时 Parkes 观测时间，对 PSR J1635-5134 进行专门的射电后续观测；计划延长计时基线以提高天体测量精度，并在食/DM 变化相位期间进行相位指向观测。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、观测时间跨度以及数据分析方法细节。

Result: PSR J1635-5134 是一颗非再循环的 340 ms 脉冲星，处于近圆形 18 小时轨道上，最小伴星质量为 0.26 太阳质量。该系统表现出依赖轨道相位的 DM 变化，DM 变化超过 30 pc/cc；在先前 Parkes 监测期间，DM 变化从以适度为主转变为持续很大。摘要未说明这些结果的统计显著性或其他定量指标。

Conclusion: 作者认为，超过 30 pc/cc 的 DM 变化表明存在大量电离物质，可能与该伴星的流出物有关；DM 变化的转变意味着一个演化的等离子体环境，无法通过稀疏或不规则观测来表征。确定高 DM 变化是间歇性还是长期存在、并描绘过量物质随轨道相位和历元的变化，对于约束等离子体起源与几何结构以及检验 sdB 星风提供所需电子柱的假说至关重要。根据摘要无法判断该系统的物理机制与其他脉冲星、磁星或 FRB 族群的直接联系。

Abstract: We request 75 hours of Parkes observing time for dedicated radio follow-up observations of PSR J1635-5134, a promising candidate pulsar-subdwarf B (sdB) star binary system. PSR J1635-5134 is a non-recycled 340 ms pulsar in a nearly circular 18-hour orbit with a minimum companion mass of 0.26 solar mass. It lies in a sparsely populated region of binary-pulsars parameter space and may represent a short-lived evolutionary stage immediately following inefficient spin-up, thereby providing a missing link between canonical binaries and the millisecond pulsar-WD population. The system exhibits peculiar, orbital-phase-dependent dispersion-measure (DM) variability, with DM variations exceeding 30 pc/cc, indicating substantial ionised material plausibly associated with an outflow from the companion. Moreover, during prior monitoring with Parkes, the DM variations shifted from being predominantly modest to being persistently large, implying an evolving plasma environment that cannot be characterised with sparse or irregular observations. Determining whether these high-DM variations are intermittent or long-lived, and mapping how the excess material varies with orbital phase and epoch, are essential for constraining the origin and geometry of the plasma and for testing the hypothesis that an sdB wind supplies the required electron column. Through this proposal, we aim to (i) extend the timing baseline to improve astrometric precision to sub-arcsecond accuracy, enabling secure identification of the optical counterpart in a crowded field, and (ii) perform phase-targeted observations during eclipse/DM variation phases to understand the temporal behavior of excess DM.

</details>

### [4439] [Parkes observations for project P1078 semester 2020OCTS_01]()
*Kansabanik, Devojyoti,Johnston, Simon,Weltevrede, Patrick,Stappers, Benjamin,Bhattacharyya, Bhaswati,Roy, Jayanta*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请提出用Parkes UWL接收机在700-4032 MHz对三个在较高射电频率出现食的较亮黑寡妇毫秒脉冲星进行30小时观测，通过食相位谱建模与偏振/旋转测度测量，直接探测食物质并检验食边界磁场强度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黑寡妇毫秒脉冲星是带有低质量伴星、轨道周期小于10小时的特殊MSP子类，伴星物质被相对论性脉冲星风吹出，造成频率相关的射电食。摘要指出，现有谜题在于食边界处导出磁场强度比承受脉冲星风冲压所需低几个数量级；同时，在光学厚到薄转变态直接探测食物质及在不同轨道相位研究食机制仍有待开展。

Method: 摘要未说明。申请30小时观测时间，使用Parkes UWL接收机，频率范围700-4032 MHz，观测三个相对明亮、在相对较高射电频率显示食的已知食黑寡妇毫秒脉冲星。分析包括：对食相位谱在光学厚到薄转变态（光学深度约1）建模；同时进行偏振观测并测量旋转测度（rotation measure）；对食期间不同轨道相位的谱进行建模。

Result: 摘要未说明。摘要为观测时间申请，未报告已完成观测的结果。摘要陈述的预期产出包括：应用已在前期演示过的食相位谱建模技术，可直接探测食物质；由同时偏振观测的旋转测度测量预测食边界磁场强度；将食边界导出的磁场强度与食相位谱建模值比较；对不同轨道相位的谱建模以探测食物质性质和食机制。

Conclusion: 作者预期这些观测可用于直接探测食物质，并通过比较旋转测度导出的食边界磁场强度与食相位谱建模值，解决食边界磁场强度比承受脉冲星风冲压所需低几个数量级的现有谜题；同时还预期通过建模食期间不同轨道相位的谱，探测不同轨道相位的食物质性质和食机制，作为研究脉冲星与恒星风相互作用的新方式。根据摘要无法判断这些预期是否已得到证实，也无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲现象的联系。

Abstract: Black-Widow (BW) millisecond pulsars (MSPs) form a special subclass of MSPs having a low mass companion (~0.01-0.05 solar mass) in compact binary orbit with orbital period &lt; 10 hours. Material blown from the companion by relativistic pulsar wind causes frequency dependent eclipses of the pulsar radio emission. Among these known eclipsing BW MSPs we have chosen three relatively bright objects which show eclipses at relatively higher radio frequencies. We request 30 hours observing time to observe these pulsars with Parkes UWL receiver in 700-4032 MHz to achieve the following science goals, i) With wideband observations of these pulsars we will apply a technique of modelling the eclipse phase spectra (already demonstrated by us) in optically thick to thin transition state (optical depth ~1), which will in turn allow to directly probe to the eclipse material. ii) Simultaneous polarisation observations will allow us to predict the magnetic field strength in the eclipse boundaries through measurements of the rotation measure . Derived magnetic field strengths at the eclipse boundaries will be compared with the values from modelling the eclipse phase spectra. This will allow us to solve the existing puzzle of few orders of magnitude lower magnetic field strength at eclipse boundaries to withstand the pulsar wind ram pressure. iii) Modelling the spectra at different orbital phases over the eclipse will allow us to probe the eclipse material properties and eclipse mechanism at different orbital phases, which is a new way to probe the pulsar and stellar wind interaction.

</details>

Material blown from the companion by relativistic pulsar wind causes frequency dependent eclipses of the pulsar radio emission. Among these known eclipsing BW MSPs we have chosen three relatively bright objects which show eclipses at relatively higher radio frequencies. We request 30 hours observing time to observe these pulsars with Parkes UWL receiver in 700-4032 MHz to achieve the following science goals, i) With wideband observations of these pulsars we will apply a technique of modelling the eclipse phase spectra (already demonstrated by us) in optically thick to thin transition state (optical depth ~1), which will in turn allow to directly probe to the eclipse material. ii) Simultaneous polarisation observations will allow us to predict the magnetic field strength in the eclipse boundaries through measurements of the rotation measure . Derived magnetic field strengths at the eclipse boundaries will be compared with the values from modelling the eclipse phase spectra. This will allow us to solve the existing puzzle of few orders of magnitude lower magnetic field strength at eclipse boundaries to withstand the pulsar wind ram pressure. iii) Modelling the spectra at different orbital phases over the eclipse will allow us to probe the eclipse material properties and eclipse mechanism at different orbital phases, which is a new way to probe the pulsar and stellar wind interaction.

</details>


### [4442] [Parkes observations for project P1078 semester 2020OCTS_04]()
*Kansabanik, Devojyoti,Johnston, Simon,Weltevrede, Patrick,Stappers, Benjamin,Bhattacharyya, Bhaswati,Roy, Jayanta*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请拟用Parkes UWL接收机在700–4032 MHz对三个在相对较高射电频率上显示食的黑寡妇毫秒脉冲星观测30小时，通过食相谱建模与偏振测量旋转测度来探测食物质并比较食边界磁场强度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黑寡妇毫秒脉冲星具有低质量伴星和短轨道周期，其伴星物质被相对论性脉冲星风吹出，造成频率依赖的射电食。已有谜题是食边界处由现有途径得到的磁场强度比承受脉冲星风冲压所需低几个数量级，而食边界磁场、食物质性质及食机制仍需直接探测与建模。

Method: 摘要说明申请30小时观测时间，使用Parkes UWL接收机在700–4032 MHz观测三个相对明亮、在相对较高射电频率显示食的已知食黑寡妇毫秒脉冲星；计划进行宽带观测以对食相谱建模（光学厚到光学薄过渡态，光学深度约1），并进行同时偏振观测以测量旋转测度。摘要未说明具体统计或采样方法。

Result: 摘要未说明实际观测结果；该文为观测时间申请，未报告已获得的测量值、趋势或显著性。摘要提出将比较由旋转测度预测的食边界磁场强度与由食相谱建模得到的数值，并拟对不同轨道相位处的谱建模以探测食物质性质和食机制，但未给出任何具体数值或结论。

Conclusion: 作者提出，宽带食相谱建模可直接探测食物质，同时偏振观测可通过旋转测度预测食边界磁场强度，并与谱建模结果比较，以期解决食边界磁场强度低几个数量级却仍能承受脉冲星风冲压的谜题；对不同轨道相位的谱建模有望探测食物质性质和食机制，并提供探测脉冲星与星风相互作用的新方式。这些为拟议目标，尚非已确立结果。

Abstract: Black-Widow (BW) millisecond pulsars (MSPs) form a special subclass of MSPs having a low mass companion (~0.01-0.05 solar mass) in compact binary orbit with orbital period &lt; 10 hours. Material blown from the companion by relativistic pulsar wind causes frequency dependent eclipses of the pulsar radio emission. Among these known eclipsing BW MSPs we have chosen three relatively bright objects which show eclipses at relatively higher radio frequencies. We request 30 hours observing time to observe these pulsars with Parkes UWL receiver in 700-4032 MHz to achieve the following science goals, i) With wideband observations of these pulsars we will apply a technique of modelling the eclipse phase spectra (already demonstrated by us) in optically thick to thin transition state (optical depth ~1), which will in turn allow to directly probe to the eclipse material. ii) Simultaneous polarisation observations will allow us to predict the magnetic field strength in the eclipse boundaries through measurements of the rotation measure . Derived magnetic field strengths at the eclipse boundaries will be compared with the values from modelling the eclipse phase spectra. This will allow us to solve the existing puzzle of few orders of magnitude lower magnetic field strength at eclipse boundaries to withstand the pulsar wind ram pressure. iii) Modelling the spectra at different orbital phases over the eclipse will allow us to probe the eclipse material properties and eclipse mechanism at different orbital phases, which is a new way to probe the pulsar and stellar wind interaction.

</details>

### [4444] [Parkes observations for project P971 semester 2021APRS_05]()
*Venkatraman Krishnan, Vivek,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Flynn, Chris,Reardon, Daniel John,Batrakov, Alexander*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案请求继续对相对论性脉冲星—白矮星双星 PSR J1141$-$6545 进行计时观测，以更高精度研究此前在现有数据中已首次探测到的 Lense-Thirring 进动，以及由测地进动暗示的复杂辐射束结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1141$-$6545 这一相对论性脉冲星—白矮星双星系统可提供从相对论现象、脉冲星辐射锥研究到视线方向星际等离子体结构与分布等多方面物理研究途径；现有数据分析已取得结果，但仍需未来数年的进一步计时观测以更高精度研究这些效应。

Method: 对相对论性脉冲星—白矮星双星 PSR J1141$-$6545 继续进行计时观测；摘要提及对现有数据的分析，但未说明所用望远镜、频段、时间跨度、样本量或具体分析方法。摘要未说明具体观测频率、观测时长与统计方法。

Result: 对现有数据的分析已首次在双星系统中探测到 Lense-Thirring 进动，并暗示存在通过测地进动探测的复杂辐射束结构。摘要未给出具体数值、精度或显著性。摘要还说明自本学期起将该观测项目转换为一个大项目提案，并请求 TAC 在下学期授予预分级状态。

Conclusion: 作者认为，未来几年对 PSR J1141$-$6545 的进一步计时观测对于以更高精度研究 Lense-Thirring 进动和复杂辐射束结构等效应是必要的，并据此请求将该项目转为大项目并获得预分级状态。关于该系统的结果对脉冲星、磁星、单脉冲辐射或快速射电暴（FRB）研究的可迁移性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose further timing observations of the relativistic pulsar - white-dwarf binary, PSR J1141$-$6545. This unique system offers access to a wide range of physics, from relativistic phenomena through pulsar emission cone studies, to the structure and distribution of interstellar plasma along our line-of-sight. The analysis of existing data has already revealed the first detection of Lense-Thirring precession in a binary star system, and hinted at complex emission beam structure probed via geodetic precession. Further timing of this system for the next few years is needed for studies of these effects at higher precision. From this semester, we are converting this project into a large project proposal. We request the TAC to award us pre-graded status for the next semester.

</details>

<details>

We request the TAC to award us pre-graded status for the next semester.

</details>


### [4457] [Parkes observations for project P971 semester 2021OCTS_07]()
*Venkatraman Krishnan, Vivek,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,van Straten, Willem,Flynn, Chris,Reardon, Daniel John,Batrakov, Alexander*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 对相对论性脉冲星-白矮星双星 PSR J1141$-$6545 的进一步计时观测被提议，以更高精度研究此前已首次探测到的 Lense-Thirring 进动以及由测地进动暗示的复杂辐射束结构；该项目将从本学期起转为大项目提案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSR J1141$-$6545 是相对论性脉冲星-白矮星双星，可提供从相对论现象、脉冲星辐射锥研究到视线方向星际等离子体结构与分布等多方面物理研究途径。已有数据分析已首次在双星系统中探测到 Lense-Thirring 进动，并暗示存在由测地进动探测的复杂辐射束结构，但需要更高精度的研究。

Method: 摘要说明将开展进一步的计时观测，并提到对已有数据的分析；未给出具体望远镜、观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本量或统计分析方法。摘要未说明。

Result: 对已有数据的分析已经首次在双星系统中探测到 Lense-Thirring 进动，并暗示了通过测地进动探测到的复杂辐射束结构。摘要未给出具体数值、精度或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，未来几年对该系统进行进一步计时观测，是在更高精度上研究上述效应的必要条件；从本学期起，该项目将转为大项目提案，并请求 TAC 在下个学期授予预评级（pre-graded）状态。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲发射的直接联系。

Abstract: We propose further timing observations of the relativistic pulsar - white-dwarf binary, PSR J1141$-$6545. This unique system offers access to a wide range of physics, from relativistic phenomena through pulsar emission cone studies, to the structure and distribution of interstellar plasma along our line-of-sight. The analysis of existing data has already revealed the first detection of Lense-Thirring precession in a binary star system, and hinted at complex emission beam structure probed via geodetic precession. Further timing of this system for the next few years is needed for studies of these effects at higher precision. From this semester, we are converting this project into a large project proposal. We request the TAC to award us pre-graded status for the next semester.

</details>

Abstract: We propose further timing observations of the relativistic pulsar - white-dwarf binary, PSR J1141$-$6545. The analysis of existing data has already revealed the first detection of Lense-Thirring precession in a binary star system, and hinted at complex emission beam structure probed via geodetic precession. Further timing of this system for the next few years is needed for studies of these effects at higher precision. From this semester, we are converting this project into a large project proposal. ### [4459] [Parkes observations for project P630 semester 2009OCTS_16]()
*Bailes, Matthew,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Keith, Michael,Burke-Spolaor, Sarah,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Bates, Samuel,Milia, Sabrina*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用20cm多波束与新数字滤波器组阵列开展迄今最宏大、最全面的全天脉冲星与暂现源巡天，预期发现数百颗毫秒脉冲星和正常脉冲星，并已在迄今发现中确认了磁场最强的脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要指出该巡天旨在超越以往，成为迄今最宏大和全面的全天脉冲星与暂现源巡天；其科学背景涉及搜寻相对论性双星和毫秒脉冲星、RRATs与河外射电暴，并希望帮助界定脉冲星周期下限、检验相对论引力理论、发现暂现源以及为引力波探测提供脉冲星。摘要未明确说明具体的知识空白。

Method: 摘要说明拟利用20cm多波束和一个新的数字滤波器组阵列开展全天巡天，创建可未来数据挖掘的拍字节数字记录，用于搜寻相对论性双星和毫秒脉冲星、RRATs及河外射电暴。具体观测时间跨度、样本量和数据分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告该巡天已经发现了迄今发现磁场最强的脉冲星。摘要还预期该巡天应能发现数百颗新的毫秒脉冲星和正常脉冲星，并有助于界定脉冲星周期下限、检验相对论引力理论、发现暂现源以及为引力波探测提供脉冲星。具体数值、显著性、计时或偏振等观测结果摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 摘要明确表述该巡天应能发现数百颗新的毫秒脉冲星和正常脉冲星，帮助界定脉冲星周期下限、检验相对论引力理论、发现暂现源，并为引力波探测提供脉冲星；并说明该巡天已经发现了迄今发现磁场最强的脉冲星。至于这些预期发现与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲发射之间的具体物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose to carry out the most ambitious and comprehensive all-sky survey for pulsars and transient sources to date. Using the 20cm multibeam and a new digital filterbank array this survey will create a petabyte digital record of the sky that can be data mined in the future and used to search for relativistic binary and millisecond pulsars, RRATs, and extragalactic radio bursts. The survey should discover 100s of new millisecond and normal pulsars and help define the lower limit to pulsar periods, test theories of relativistic gravity, find transients and provide pulsars for gravitational wave detection. The survey has already discovered the most magnetic pulsar ever found.

</details>


### [4460] [Parkes observations for project P630 semester 2009OCTS_07]()
*Bailes, Matthew,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Keith, Michael,Burke-Spolaor, Sarah,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Bates, Samuel,Milia, Sabrina*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要提出要开展迄今最宏大、最全面的全天脉冲星与暂现源巡天，目标是搜寻相对论性双星、毫秒脉冲星、RRATs和河外射电暴，并用于界定脉冲星周期下限、检验相对论引力理论、寻找暂现源以及为引力波探测提供脉冲星。

Method: 摘要说明将使用20cm多波束以及一个新的数字滤波库阵列开展全天巡天，并创建一份拍字节量级的天空数字记录，供未来数据挖掘和搜寻脉冲星与暂现源之用。摘要未说明具体观测时间跨度、样本规模、灵敏度指标或数据分析流程。

Result: 摘要称该巡天已发现迄今磁场最强的脉冲星；并预计应能发现数百颗新的毫秒脉冲星和正常脉冲星，有助于界定脉冲星自转周期下限、检验相对论引力理论、发现暂现源并为引力波探测提供脉冲星。摘要未给出具体发现数目、显著性或其他定量结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，这一使用20cm多波束和数字滤波库阵列的全天巡天将产生可供未来挖掘的拍字节量级数字记录，并预期在脉冲星与暂现源搜寻、相对论引力检验和引力波探测等方面发挥作用；摘要还明确称该巡天已发现迄今磁场最强的脉冲星。除上述内容外，根据摘要无法判断更具体的物理诠释或对脉冲星、磁星与FRB关联的可迁移性。

Abstract: We propose to carry out the most ambitious and comprehensive all-sky survey for pulsars and transient sources to date. Using the 20cm multibeam and a new digital filterbank array this survey will create a petabyte digital record of the sky that can be data mined in the future and used to search for relativistic binary and millisecond pulsars, RRATs, and extragalactic radio bursts. The survey should discover 100s of new millisecond and normal pulsars and help define the lower limit to pulsar periods, test theories of relativistic gravity, find transients and provide pulsars for gravitational wave detection. The survey has already discovered the most magnetic pulsar ever found.

</details>

Abstract: We propose to carry out the most ambitious and comprehensive all-sky survey for pulsars and transient sources to date. Using the 20cm multibeam and a new digital filterbank array this survey will create a petabyte digital record of the sky that can be data mined in the future and used to search for relativistic binary and millisecond pulsars, RRATs, and extragalactic radio bursts. The survey should discover 100s of new millisecond and normal pulsars and help define the lower limit to pulsar periods, test theories of relativistic gravity, find transients and provide pulsars for gravitational wave detection. Motivation: 摘要提出要开展迄今最宏大、最全面的全天脉冲星和暂现源巡天，目标是搜寻相对论性双星、毫秒脉冲星、RRATs和河外射电暴，并检验相对论引力理论、确定脉冲星周期下限以及为引力波探测提供脉冲星。

Method: 利用20cm多波束以及一台新的数字滤波器组阵列开展全天巡天，创建拍字节量级的天空数字记录，供未来数据挖掘，并用于搜寻相对论性双星和毫秒脉冲星、RRATs以及河外射电暴。其余观测细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要预期该巡天应能发现数百颗新的毫秒脉冲星和正常脉冲星，并有助于确定脉冲星周期的下限、检验相对论引力理论、发现暂现源以及为引力波探测提供脉冲星。摘要还指出，该巡天已经发现了迄今发现的磁场最强的脉冲星。摘要未给出具体数值、显著性或其他定量结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出的结论是：这项利用20cm多波束和新数字滤波器组阵列开展的全天巡天，预期能发现数百颗新的毫秒脉冲星和正常脉冲星，并可用于确定脉冲星周期下限、检验相对论引力理论、发现暂现源和为引力波探测提供脉冲星；摘要还称该巡天已发现迄今磁场最强的脉冲星。根据摘要无法判断其对磁星与快速射电暴（FRB）关联的具体物理解释。

Abstract: We propose to carry out the most ambitious and comprehensive all-sky survey for pulsars and transient sources to date. Using the 20cm multibeam and a new digital filterbank array this survey will create a petabyte digital record of the sky that can be data mined in the future and used to search for relativistic binary and millisecond pulsars, RRATs, and extragalactic radio bursts. The survey should discover 100s of new millisecond and normal pulsars and help define the lower limit to pulsar periods, test theories of relativistic gravity, find transients and provide pulsars for gravitational wave detection. The survey has already discovered the most magnetic pulsar ever found.

</details>

Result: 摘要称该巡天应能发现数百颗新的毫秒脉冲星和正常脉冲星，并帮助界定脉冲星周期下限、检验相对论性引力理论、发现暂现源以及为引力波探测提供脉冲星；摘要还称该巡天已经发现了迄今磁场最强的脉冲星。摘要未给出具体数值、显著性或其他定量结果。

Conclusion: 摘要明确给出的结论是：该巡天应能发现数百颗新的毫秒脉冲星和正常脉冲星，并帮助界定脉冲星周期下限、检验相对论性引力理论、发现暂现源以及为引力波探测提供脉冲星；摘要并称该巡天已经发现了迄今磁场最强的脉冲星。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星—快速射电暴（FRB）联系、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振或射电频谱等方面的具体联系。

Abstract: We propose to carry out the most ambitious and comprehensive all-sky survey for pulsars and transient sources to date. Using the 20cm multibeam and a new digital filterbank array this survey will create a petabyte digital record of the sky that can be data mined in the future and used to search for relativistic binary and millisecond pulsars, RRATs, and extragalactic radio bursts. The survey should discover 100s of new millisecond and normal pulsars and help define the lower limit to pulsar periods, test theories of relativistic gravity, find transients and provide pulsars for gravitational wave detection. The survey has already discovered the most magnetic pulsar ever found.

### [4476] [Parkes observations for project P1059 semester 2020APRS_15]()
*Dai, Shi,Lenc, Emil,Hobbs, George,Zhang, Lei,Joshi, Bhal Chandra,Achamveedu, Gopakumar,Thyagarajan, Nithyanandan*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划用 Parkes UWL 接收机观测 22 颗高银纬脉冲星，首次表征其偏振、频谱和星际闪烁的宽带特性，以协助发展面向未来射电连续谱巡天的成像脉冲星搜寻技术。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高银纬脉冲星样本此前缺乏流量密度与偏振测量，其宽带偏振、频谱和闪烁特性尚未被表征；这些信息可为未来射电连续谱巡天中的成像脉冲星搜寻技术提供依据，并用于脉冲星辐射机制与高银纬星际介质研究。

Method: 摘要未说明实际的观测执行细节。提案拟使用 Parkes Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) 接收机，观测由 22 颗高银纬脉冲星组成的样本，目标是测量其流量密度、偏振、宽带频谱和星际闪烁特性；摘要未说明具体频率范围、时间跨度或分析流程。

Result: 摘要未说明。摘要为观测提案，未报告已获得的观测结果、测量数值或统计显著性；仅说明该 22 颗脉冲星样本此前未测量过流量密度和偏振。

Conclusion: 作者提出，表征这些脉冲星的宽带频谱、偏振和闪烁特性将有助于发展面向未来射电连续谱巡天（例如使用 Australian SKA Pathfinder (ASKAP)）的成像脉冲星搜寻技术，并可用于脉冲星辐射机制和高银纬星际介质研究。根据摘要无法判断具体物理结论。

Abstract: We propose to observe a sample of 22 pulsars at high Galactic latitudes with the Parkes Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver. This sample of pulsars does not have flux densities nor polarisation measured before. The goal is to characterise their wideband properties in polarisation, spectrum and interstellar scintillation. Such properties will help us develop imaging pulsar search techniques for future radio continuum surveys, such as with the Australian SKA Pathfinder (ASKAP). Wideband spectrum, polarisation and scintillation of pulsars will also be useful for studies of pulsar radiation mechanism and interstellar medium at high Galactic latitudes.

</details>

TL;DR: 该提案计划使用 Parkes 超宽带低频（UWL）接收机观测高银纬处 22 颗此前未测量流量密度和偏振的脉冲星，以刻画其在偏振、频谱和星际闪烁方面的宽带性质。作者认为这些性质有助于为未来射电连续谱巡天（如 ASKAP）开发成像脉冲星搜索技术，并有助于研究脉冲星辐射机制和高银纬星际介质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 所提议观测的 22 颗高银纬脉冲星此前没有流量密度或偏振测量，因此需要刻画其宽带性质。摘要指出，这些性质有助于为未来射电连续谱巡天（例如使用 ASKAP 的巡天）开发成像脉冲星搜索技术，并可服务于脉冲星辐射机制以及高银纬处星际介质的研究。

Method: 摘要说明，拟使用 Parkes 超宽带低频（UWL）接收机观测高银纬处的一个由 22 颗脉冲星组成的样本。目标是刻画这些脉冲星的宽带性质，涉及偏振、频谱和星际闪烁。摘要未说明具体观测频段、时间跨度、数据分析方法或统计方法。

Result: 摘要未说明。摘要介绍的是一项拟议观测，并指出该样本中的脉冲星此前尚未测量过流量密度或偏振；摘要没有报告观测结果、测量值、趋势、相关性或显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，刻画这些脉冲星的宽带频谱、偏振和星际闪烁将有助于为未来射电连续谱巡天（例如使用 ASKAP 的巡天）开发成像脉冲星搜索技术，并将有助于研究脉冲星辐射机制和高银纬处的星际介质。摘要未报告任何观测结果，因此对这些预期用途是否能够实现，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose to observe a sample of 22 pulsars at high Galactic latitudes with the Parkes Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver. This sample of pulsars does not have flux densities nor polarisation measured before. The goal is to characterise their wideband properties in polarisation, spectrum and interstellar scintillation. Such properties will help us develop imaging pulsar search techniques for future radio continuum surveys, such as with the Australian SKA Pathfinder (ASKAP). Wideband spectrum, polarisation and scintillation of pulsars will also be useful for studies of pulsar radiation mechanism and interstellar medium at high Galactic latitudes.

</details>

### [4497] [Parkes observations for project P630 semester 2009APRS_15]()
*Bailes, Matthew,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bhat, Ramesh,Keith, Michael,Burke-Spolaor, Sarah,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Bates, Samuel,Levin, Lina*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划利用20cm多波束和新数字滤波器组阵列开展迄今最全面的全天脉冲星与瞬变源巡天，预期发现数百颗新的毫秒和正常脉冲星、RRATs及河外射电暴，并已作出首个新脉冲星发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该提案旨在开展迄今最宏大、最全面的全天脉冲星与瞬变源巡天，以搜寻相对论性双星和毫秒脉冲星、RRATs以及河外射电暴，并界定脉冲星周期下限、检验相对论引力理论、发现瞬变源以及为引力波探测提供脉冲星。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测细节；提案称使用20cm多波束和一个新的数字滤波器组阵列开展全天巡天，创建可未来数据挖掘的拍字节量级天空数字记录；未说明时间跨度、样本或统计分析方法。

Result: 该巡天预期发现数百颗新的毫秒脉冲星和正常脉冲星，并指出硬件已全部到位且已作出首个新脉冲星发现；摘要未给出具体数值、显著性或其他观测结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为该巡天将有助于界定脉冲星周期下限、检验相对论引力理论、发现瞬变源并为引力波探测提供脉冲星。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、单脉冲发射、模式转换、自转减慢转矩变化或FRB的具体物理联系。

Abstract: We propose to carry out the most ambitious and comprehensive all-sky survey for pulsars and transient sources to date. Using the 20cm multibeam and a new digital filterbank array this survey will create a petabyte digital record of the sky that can be data mined in the future and used to search for relativistic binary and millisecond pulsars, RRATs, and extragalactic radio bursts. The survey should discover 100s of new millisecond and normal pulsars and help define the lower limit to pulsar periods, test theories of relativistic gravity, find transients and provide pulsars for gravitational wave detection. With all the hardware in place, and our first new pulsar discovery made, we request a substantial time allocation this semester.

</details>

Result: 摘要称硬件已全部到位，并已作出首个新脉冲星发现；预期该巡天将发现数百颗新的毫秒脉冲星和正常脉冲星，有助于确定脉冲星周期的下限、检验相对论引力理论、发现暂现源，并为引力波探测提供脉冲星。摘要未说明具体的观测数值、显著性或已发现脉冲星的参数。

Conclusion: 作者认为该巡天应能发现数百颗新的毫秒脉冲星和正常脉冲星，帮助确定脉冲星周期的下限，检验相对论引力理论，发现暂现源，并为引力波探测提供脉冲星；摘要同时以已作出的首个新脉冲星发现和硬件到位为由申请本学期实质性时间分配。所述对相对论性双星、毫秒脉冲星、RRATs和河外射电暴的搜寻与未来数据挖掘，属于提案所陈述的目标与预期，而非已建立的观测结果；其对读者所关注的单脉冲、模式转换、偏振、计时、自转减慢力矩变化或磁星—FRB联系的具体适用性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose to carry out the most ambitious and comprehensive all-sky survey for pulsars and transient sources to date. Using the 20cm multibeam and a new digital filterbank array this survey will create a petabyte digital record of the sky that can be data mined in the future and used to search for relativistic binary and millisecond pulsars, RRATs, and extragalactic radio bursts. The survey should discover 100s of new millisecond and normal pulsars and help define the lower limit to pulsar periods, test theories of relativistic gravity, find transients and provide pulsars for gravitational wave detection. With all the hardware in place, and our first new pulsar discovery made, we request a substantial time allocation this semester.

The survey should discover 100s of new millisecond and normal pulsars and help define the lower limit to pulsar periods, test theories of relativistic gravity, find transients and provide pulsars for gravitational wave detection. ### [4519] [Parkes observations for project P512 semester 2006APRS_02]()
*Johnston, Simon,Possenti, Andrea,Manchester, Dick,Kramer, Michael,Lyne, Andrew,O'Brien, J.,Hobbs, George,Edwards, Russell,McLaughlin, Maura,Burgay, Marta,D'Amico, N.,Lorimer, Duncan Ross*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 较低频率巡天可能因选择效应而漏掉部分脉冲星，尤其是位于旋臂中、在较低频率下被隐藏的年轻脉冲星；同时，内银河系中色散和散射物质的分布仍有待改进认识，高频瞬变射电天空也需巡测。该提案据此提出沿银河系平面开展新的脉冲星巡天。

Method: 使用新的甲醇多波束（Methanol Multibeam）接收机沿银河系平面开展脉冲星巡天；摘要提及这是高频率巡天，并给出通过模拟预期发现脉冲星总数。观测时间跨度、具体观测频段、样本量以及数据分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 模拟表明，预期总共会发现 200 颗脉冲星，其中约一半将是新发现。摘要未说明实际观测结果，也未报告具体发现的脉冲星、计时、偏振、频谱或爆发事件。

Conclusion: 作者提出该巡天有望发现先前在较低频率巡天中被选择排除的脉冲星，包括隐藏在旋臂中的年轻脉冲星，改进对色散和散射物质分布的认识，还可能发现伴星为黑洞的脉冲星及短周期双星脉冲星，并巡测高频瞬变射电天空；预期发现 200 颗脉冲星，其中约一半为新发现。根据摘要无法判断该巡天与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲发射的具体联系。

Abstract: We propose to undertake a pulsar survey along the Galactic Plane using the new Methanol Multibeam receiver in order to uncover pulsars previously selected against in lower frequency surveys. The scientific aims of this survey are (a) to discover young pulsars in the spiral arms, hidden at lower frequencies, (b) to improve our knowledge of the distribution of dispersing and scattering material, particularly in the inner Galaxy, (c) strike it lucky and discover unique objects (e.g. a pulsar with a black hole companion and short period binary pulsars) and (d) to survey the transient radio sky at high frequencies. Simulations have shown that we expect to find a total of 200 pulsars of which about one half will be new detections.

</details>

Using the 20cm multibeam and a new digital filterbank array this survey will create a petabyte digital record of the sky that can be data mined in the future and used to search for relativistic binary and millisecond pulsars, RRATs, and extragalactic radio bursts. The survey should discover 100s of new millisecond and normal pulsars and help define the lower limit to pulsar periods, test theories of relativistic gravity, find transients and provide pulsars for gravitational wave detection. With all the hardware in place, and our first new pulsar discovery made, we request a substantial time allocation this semester.

</details>


### [4529] [Parkes observations for project P630 semester 2009APRS_17]()
*Bailes, Matthew,Possenti, Andrea,Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael,Burgay, Marta,Bhat, Ramesh,Keith, Michael,Burke-Spolaor, Sarah,van Straten, Willem,Stappers, Benjamin,Bates, Samuel,Levin, Lina*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 摘要未说明巡天已完成的具体发现数量或统计结果。摘要提出该巡天应能发现数百颗新的毫秒脉冲星和正常脉冲星，并有助于确定脉冲星周期的下限、检验相对论引力理论、发现暂现源以及为引力波探测提供脉冲星；摘要还说明所有硬件已到位，并且已完成首颗新脉冲星的发现。

Conclusion: 作者认为，在所有硬件到位且已实现首颗新脉冲星发现的基础上，该巡天有望发现数百颗新的毫秒脉冲星和正常脉冲星，并有助于确定脉冲星周期下限、检验相对论引力理论、发现暂现源以及为引力波探测提供脉冲星，因此请求在本学期获得大量时间分配。根据摘要无法判断其对磁星、快速射电暴、单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱或脉冲星计时与自转减慢力矩变化等具体方向的可迁移性。

Abstract: We propose to carry out the most ambitious and comprehensive all-sky survey for pulsars and transient sources to date. Using the 20cm multibeam and a new digital filterbank array this survey will create a petabyte digital record of the sky that can be data mined in the future and used to search for relativistic binary and millisecond pulsars, RRATs, and extragalactic radio bursts. The survey should discover 100s of new millisecond and normal pulsars and help define the lower limit to pulsar periods, test theories of relativistic gravity, find transients and provide pulsars for gravitational wave detection. With all the hardware in place, and our first new pulsar discovery made, we request a substantial time allocation this semester.

</details>


### [4530] [Parkes observations for project P1398 semester 2026APRS_14]()
*Gao, Shi-Jie,Zhang, Songbo,Wang, Ziteng,Li, Xiangdong*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 重新处理 2008 年 Parkes 6.5-GHz 脉冲星巡天档案数据后，发现了四颗此前未知的毫秒脉冲星候选体（自转周期 3-11 ms，色散量 20-170 pc/cc），其中两颗候选体显示出显著视线加速度，可能位于致密双星系统中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低频（&lt; ~1 GHz）银道面脉冲星巡天受到天空背景噪声、星际散射和色散致展宽的限制，导致脉冲星群体普查不完整；高频（&gt; 2 GHz）观测可减轻这些效应，并近来促成了在低频无法探测到的脉冲星的发现。

Method: 使用现代搜索技术重新分析 2008 年 Parkes 6.5-GHz 脉冲星巡天的档案数据。摘要还提出申请使用 Parkes（Murriyang）UWL 接收机进行共计 8.4 小时的后续观测以确认候选体，并刻画其在 704-4032 MHz 范围内的辐射。

Result: 重新处理揭示了四颗此前未知的毫秒脉冲星候选体，自转周期为 3-11 ms，色散量为 20-170 pc/cc；两颗候选体表现出显著的视线方向加速度，表明其可能属于致密双星系统。

Conclusion: 作者认为，确认这些源将扩大高频选择的脉冲星群体，并证明高频搜索对于揭示在常规低频巡天中被遮蔽的奇异系统仍具有持续的重要性。根据摘要无法判断这些候选体与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲/模式转换等现象的具体联系。

Abstract: Low-frequency (&lt; ~1 GHz) Galactic-plane pulsar surveys are strongly limited by sky background noise, interstellar scattering, and dispersion smearing, leading to an incomplete census of the pulsar population. High-frequency (&gt; 2 GHz) observations mitigate these effects and have recently enabled the discovery of pulsars that remain undetectable at low-frequency. We analyzed archival data from the 2008 Parkes 6.5-GHz pulsar survey using modern search techniques. This reprocessing has revealed four previously unknown millisecond pulsar candidates with spin periods of 3-11 ms and dispersion measures of 20-170 pc/cc. Two candidates exhibit significant line-of-sight acceleration, indicating likely membership in compact binary systems. We request a total of 8.4 hours of follow-up observations with the Parkes (Murriyang) Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver to confirm these candidates and characterize their emission across 704-4032 MHz. Confirming these sources would expand the population of high-frequency selected pulsars and demonstrate the continued importance of high-frequency searches for uncovering exotic systems obscured in conventional low-frequency surveys.

</details>

### [4534] [Parkes observations for project P1317 semester 2024OCTS_07]()
*Berteaud, Joanna,Dai, Shi,Clavel, Maïca,Calore, Francesca*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 在6个未识别X射线源候选体中的射电对应体方向上，发现了两颗新毫秒脉冲星PSR J1740-2807和PSR J1740-2805，使银河系中心方向高色散MSP达到4颗，可能首次直接揭示核球MSP族群，并提出用Parkes定期计时以揭示其性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 银河系核球是否存在毫秒脉冲星族群，关系到对费米GeV过量的理解；此前研究提示过去X射线观测可能探测到其中一些MSP，并在未识别X射线源中识别出大量MSP候选体，但需射电观测判定其性质。

Method: 分析未发表的射电图像以寻找候选体的射电对应体，并获得20小时Green Bank Telescope观测时间。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度、样本选择细节及计时、单脉冲、极化、RM、DM或频谱等分析方法。

Result: 在其中一个射电/X射线目标方向上发现两颗新毫秒脉冲星PSR J1740-2807和PSR J1740-2805，使银河系中心方向高色散MSP数量达到4颗；发现6个候选体有有趣的射电对应体。摘要未说明具体色散值、显著性、计时参数或辐射性质。

Conclusion: 作者认为这可能是核球MSP族群的首次直接证据，并提议用Parkes定期计时以揭示其性质，还可能宣称PSR J1740-2807与原X射线源关联；此类后续研究将对理解费米GeV过量产生重大影响。根据摘要无法判断与磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射等主题的具体联系。

Abstract: The existence of a population of millisecond pulsars (MSPs) in the Galactic bulge is supported, among others, by the Fermi GeV excess, a signal of gamma rays coming from the Galactic center (GC) direction and resembling the cumulative emission of known MSPs. A previous study showed that, while these MSPs are unresolved in gamma rays, some of them could have been detected in past X-ray observations. The authors also identified a large number of MSP candidates among unidentified X-ray sources. By analyzing unpublished radio images, we found interesting radio counterparts to 6 of those candidates, and were granted 20h of observations with the Green Bank Telescope to settle on their nature. We discovered two new MSPs, PSR J1740-2807 and PSR J1740-2805, towards one of our radio/X-ray targets, bringing to 4 the number of highly-dispersed MSPs in the GC direction and probably unveiling the first direct evidence of a bulge MSP population. We propose to carry out regular timing of these pulsar with Parkes, in order to reveal their properties and potentially claim association of PSR J1740-2807 with the original X-ray source. The follow up of these sources will have a major impact on our understanding of the Fermi GeV excess.

</details>


### [4535] [Parkes observations for project P1317 semester 2024OCTS_03]()
*Berteaud, Joanna,Dai, Shi,Clavel, Maïca,Calore, Francesca*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 在银心方向的一个射电/X射线目标中发现了PSR J1740-2807和PSR J1740-2805两颗新毫秒脉冲星，使该方向高色散MSP数量达到4颗，可能首次直接揭示银核球MSP群体证据；作者提议用Parkes对其定期计时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 银心方向的Fermi GeV过量类似于已知MSP的累积伽马射线发射，支持银河系核球中存在MSP群体，但该群体的直接证据仍然缺乏。此前研究指出部分核球MSP可能在以往X射线观测中被探测到，并在未识别X射线源中给出大量MSP候选体，需要射电、X射线与计时观测加以确认。

Method: 摘要所述的已有工作为：分析未发表的射电图像，在6个X射线MSP候选体中寻找射电对应体；申请并实施了20h的绿岸望远镜观测以判定其性质。本申请拟利用Parkes对这些脉冲星进行定期计时，以揭示其性质并检验PSR J1740-2807与原始X射线源的成协。摘要未说明观测频率或波段、时间跨度与具体的计时或分析细节。

Result: 摘要报告已在其中一个射电/X射线目标方向发现两颗新毫秒脉冲星，PSR J1740-2807和PSR J1740-2805，使银心方向高色散MSP的数量达到4颗；并指出这可能首次直接揭示核球MSP群体的证据。摘要未说明这两颗脉冲星的周期、色散量、通量、偏振或计时参数等具体测量结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现有可能首次直接提供银河系核球MSP群体的证据，并且对这些源的后续跟踪（包括以Parkes进行的定期计时，以及PSR J1740-2807可能与原X射线源成协）将对理解Fermi GeV过量产生重大影响。上述群体归属与成协仍以“可能”表述；根据摘要无法判断具体的物理机制。

Abstract: The existence of a population of millisecond pulsars (MSPs) in the Galactic bulge is supported, among others, by the Fermi GeV excess, a signal of gamma rays coming from the Galactic center (GC) direction and resembling the cumulative emission of known MSPs. A previous study showed that, while these MSPs are unresolved in gamma rays, some of them could have been detected in past X-ray observations. The authors also identified a large number of MSP candidates among unidentified X-ray sources. By analyzing unpublished radio images, we found interesting radio counterparts to 6 of those candidates, and were granted 20h of observations with the Green Bank Telescope to settle on their nature. We discovered two new MSPs, PSR J1740-2807 and PSR J1740-2805, towards one of our radio/X-ray targets, bringing to 4 the number of highly-dispersed MSPs in the GC direction and probably unveiling the first direct evidence of a bulge MSP population. We propose to carry out regular timing of these pulsar with Parkes, in order to reveal their properties and potentially claim association of PSR J1740-2807 with the original X-ray source. The follow up of these sources will have a major impact on our understanding of the Fermi GeV excess.

</details>


### [4536] [Parkes observations for project P1317 semester 2024OCTS_05]()
*Berteaud, Joanna,Dai, Shi,Clavel, Maïca,Calore, Francesca*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 通过在射电/X射线候选体方向上的射电观测，发现了两颗新的毫秒脉冲星PSR J1740-2807和PSR J1740-2805，使银心方向上高色散MSP的数量达到4颗，并可能首次揭示银河系核球MSP群体的直接证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 银河系核球中是否存在毫秒脉冲星群体，可由Fermi GeV过量这一来自银心方向、类似已知MSP累积发射的伽马射线信号提供支持。已有研究显示这些MSP虽在伽马射线波段未被分辨，但部分可能在过去的X射线观测中被探测到，且从未证认X射线源中识别出大量MSP候选体，因此需要射电观测判定其性质。

Method: 分析未发表的射电图像，在6个MSP候选体中寻找射电对应体；获得20h的绿湾望远镜观测时间以判定其性质。摘要还提出用Parkes对这些脉冲星进行定期计时。观测频段、时间跨度及具体分析细节摘要未说明。

Result: 在其中一个射电/X射线目标方向上发现了两颗新的MSP：PSR J1740-2807和PSR J1740-2805，使GC方向上高色散MSP的数量达到4颗。此前已在6个MSP候选体中发现了射电对应体。摘要未给出这两颗脉冲星的周期、色散量或其他参数。

Conclusion: 作者认为这一发现可能首次揭示银河系核球MSP群体的直接证据，并提议通过Parkes定期计时揭示其性质、有可能宣称PSR J1740-2807与原始X射线源的关联，且这些源的后续研究将对理解Fermi GeV过量产生重大影响。当前摘要所述仍为提议性后续观测，其具体物理结论根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The existence of a population of millisecond pulsars (MSPs) in the Galactic bulge is supported, among others, by the Fermi GeV excess, a signal of gamma rays coming from the Galactic center (GC) direction and resembling the cumulative emission of known MSPs. A previous study showed that, while these MSPs are unresolved in gamma rays, some of them could have been detected in past X-ray observations. The authors also identified a large number of MSP candidates among unidentified X-ray sources. By analyzing unpublished radio images, we found interesting radio counterparts to 6 of those candidates, and were granted 20h of observations with the Green Bank Telescope to settle on their nature. We discovered two new MSPs, PSR J1740-2807 and PSR J1740-2805, towards one of our radio/X-ray targets, bringing to 4 the number of highly-dispersed MSPs in the GC direction and probably unveiling the first direct evidence of a bulge MSP population. We propose to carry out regular timing of these pulsar with Parkes, in order to reveal their properties and potentially claim association of PSR J1740-2807 with the original X-ray source. The follow up of these sources will have a major impact on our understanding of the Fermi GeV excess.

</details>


### [4537] [Parkes observations for project P1398 semester 2026APRS_01]()
*Gao, Shi-Jie,Zhang, Songbo,Wang, Ziteng,Li, Xiangdong*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 对2008年Parkes 6.5-GHz脉冲星巡天档案数据的重新处理发现了四颗此前未知的毫秒脉冲星候选体（自转周期3-11 ms，DM 20-170 pc/cc），其中两颗表现出显著的视线方向加速度，可能位于致密双星系统中；作者申请8.4小时Parkes UWL后续观测（704-4032 MHz）以确认并刻画它们。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低频（&lt; ~1 GHz）银道面脉冲星巡天受天空背景噪声、星际散射和色散致展宽强烈限制，导致脉冲星族群普查不完整。高频（&gt; 2 GHz）观测可减轻这些效应，并已使发现低频无法探测的脉冲星成为可能。作者希望确认在高频档案数据中发现的候选体，以扩大高频选出的脉冲星族群并检验高频搜索对揭示低频巡天中被遮蔽系统的价值。

Method: 使用现代搜索技术分析2008年Parkes 6.5-GHz脉冲星巡天的档案数据；识别出毫秒脉冲星候选体并给出其自转周期与DM。作者申请总计8.4小时Parkes（Murriyang）Ultra-Wideband Low（UWL）接收机后续观测，以确认候选体并刻画其在704-4032 MHz范围内的辐射。摘要未说明具体的搜索算法、显著性判据、样本筛选标准或数据时间跨度细节。

Result: 重新处理2008年Parkes 6.5-GHz脉冲星巡天档案数据后，发现了四颗此前未知的毫秒脉冲星候选体，自转周期为3-11 ms，DM为20-170 pc/cc。其中两颗候选体表现出显著的视线方向加速度，表明它们很可能位于致密双星系统中。摘要给出的对象仅为候选体，尚未由后续观测确认。

Conclusion: 作者指出，确认这些源将扩大高频选出的脉冲星族群，并表明高频搜索对于揭示在常规低频巡天中被遮蔽的奇异系统仍具有持续的重要性。这一结论以候选体得到确认为前提；关于这些候选体的物理性质、双星参数或与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、单脉冲辐射、偏振或射电谱特征的关联，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Low-frequency (&lt; ~1 GHz) Galactic-plane pulsar surveys are strongly limited by sky background noise, interstellar scattering, and dispersion smearing, leading to an incomplete census of the pulsar population. High-frequency (&gt; 2 GHz) observations mitigate these effects and have recently enabled the discovery of pulsars that remain undetectable at low-frequency. We analyzed archival data from the 2008 Parkes 6.5-GHz pulsar survey using modern search techniques. This reprocessing has revealed four previously unknown millisecond pulsar candidates with spin periods of 3-11 ms and dispersion measures of 20-170 pc/cc. Two candidates exhibit significant line-of-sight acceleration, indicating likely membership in compact binary systems. We request a total of 8.4 hours of follow-up observations with the Parkes (Murriyang) Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver to confirm these candidates and characterize their emission across 704-4032 MHz. Confirming these sources would expand the population of high-frequency selected pulsars and demonstrate the continued importance of high-frequency searches for uncovering exotic systems obscured in conventional low-frequency surveys.

</details>

Motivation: 银河系核球中是否存在毫秒脉冲星种群，是理解Fermi GeV过量的关键问题之一：该伽马射线信号来自银河系中心方向，且类似于已知MSP的累积发射。此前研究表明这些MSP在伽马射线中未被分辨，但其中一些可能已在过去X射线观测中被探测到，且作者已在未证认X射线源中识别出大量MSP候选体，因此需要通过射电观测判定这些候选体的真实性质。

Method: 通过分析未发表的射电图像，在6个X射线MSP候选体上发现射电对应体，并获得20小时的Green Bank Telescope观测时间来判定其性质。在此基础上，作者提议用Parkes对这些脉冲星进行定期计时（timing）。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、观测时间跨度、样本大小以及所采用的计时、偏振或谱分析等方法细节。

Result: 在其中一个射电/X射线目标方向上发现了两颗新的毫秒脉冲星，PSR J1740-2807和PSR J1740-2805，使银河系中心方向上高色散MSP的数量达到4颗。此外，在未证认X射线源的MSP候选体中，有6个被找到有趣的射电对应体。摘要未给出这些脉冲星的周期、色散量、通量等具体数值，也未给出统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，这两颗新MSP的发现可能首次直接揭示核球MSP种群的证据，并提议通过Parkes定期计时揭示其性质，且有可能宣称PSR J1740-2807与原始X射线源存在关联；对这些源的后续跟踪将对理解Fermi GeV过量产生重大影响。上述关联与种群解释在摘要中以“可能”表述，尚未成为既定结果；其具体物理含义根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The existence of a population of millisecond pulsars (MSPs) in the Galactic bulge is supported, among others, by the Fermi GeV excess, a signal of gamma rays coming from the Galactic center (GC) direction and resembling the cumulative emission of known MSPs. A previous study showed that, while these MSPs are unresolved in gamma rays, some of them could have been detected in past X-ray observations. The authors also identified a large number of MSP candidates among unidentified X-ray sources. By analyzing unpublished radio images, we found interesting radio counterparts to 6 of those candidates, and were granted 20h of observations with the Green Bank Telescope to settle on their nature. We discovered two new MSPs, PSR J1740-2807 and PSR J1740-2805, towards one of our radio/X-ray targets, bringing to 4 the number of highly-dispersed MSPs in the GC direction and probably unveiling the first direct evidence of a bulge MSP population. We propose to carry out regular timing of these pulsar with Parkes, in order to reveal their properties and potentially claim association of PSR J1740-2807 with the original X-ray source. The follow up of these sources will have a major impact on our understanding of the Fermi GeV excess.

</details>

### [4545] [Parkes observations for project P1398 semester 2026APRS_15]()
*Gao, Shi-Jie,Zhang, Songbo,Wang, Ziteng,Li, Xiangdong*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 通过用现代搜索技术重新处理2008年Parkes 6.5-GHz脉冲星巡天存档数据，发现了四颗此前未知的毫秒脉冲星候选体（自转周期3-11 ms，色散量20-170 pc/cc），其中两颗可能位于致密双星系统；作者申请8.4小时Parkes（Murriyang）UWL后续观测，在704-4032 MHz确认并刻画这些候选体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低频（&lt; ~1 GHz）银道面脉冲星巡天受天空背景噪声、星际散射和色散致展宽强烈限制，导致脉冲星群体普查不完整；高频（&gt; 2 GHz）观测可减轻这些效应，并近来使人们发现了低频无法探测的脉冲星，因此有必要重新挖掘高频巡天存档数据。

Method: 使用现代搜索技术重新分析2008年Parkes 6.5-GHz脉冲星巡天的存档数据；并申请总共8.4小时Parkes（Murriyang）Ultra-Wideband Low（UWL）接收机后续观测，以确认候选体并刻画其在704-4032 MHz的辐射。摘要未说明其他观测频率、时间跨度、样本细节或具体分析流程。

Result: 该重新处理揭示了四颗此前未知的毫秒脉冲星候选体，自转周期为3-11 ms，色散量为20-170 pc/cc；其中两个候选体表现出显著的视线方向加速度，表明它们可能属于致密双星系统。摘要将此列为候选体，尚待后续观测确认；摘要未说明统计显著性、置信度或其他辐射特征。

Conclusion: 作者认为，确认这些源将扩展高频选出的脉冲星群体，并表明高频搜索对于揭示在常规低频巡天中被遮蔽的奇特系统仍具有持续的重要性。由于候选体尚未确认，这些关于群体扩展与高频巡天价值的判断仍属有待观测支持的前景性结论。

Abstract: Low-frequency (&lt; ~1 GHz) Galactic-plane pulsar surveys are strongly limited by sky background noise, interstellar scattering, and dispersion smearing, leading to an incomplete census of the pulsar population. High-frequency (&gt; 2 GHz) observations mitigate these effects and have recently enabled the discovery of pulsars that remain undetectable at low-frequency. We analyzed archival data from the 2008 Parkes 6.5-GHz pulsar survey using modern search techniques. This reprocessing has revealed four previously unknown millisecond pulsar candidates with spin periods of 3-11 ms and dispersion measures of 20-170 pc/cc. Two candidates exhibit significant line-of-sight acceleration, indicating likely membership in compact binary systems. We request a total of 8.4 hours of follow-up observations with the Parkes (Murriyang) Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver to confirm these candidates and characterize their emission across 704-4032 MHz. Confirming these sources would expand the population of high-frequency selected pulsars and demonstrate the continued importance of high-frequency searches for uncovering exotic systems obscured in conventional low-frequency surveys.

</details>

Motivation: 低频（&lt; ~1 GHz）银道面脉冲星巡天受天空背景噪声、星际散射和色散致展宽强烈限制，造成脉冲星族群普查不完整；高频（&gt; 2 GHz）观测可减轻这些效应，并近来使得发现低频无法探测的脉冲星成为可能。该工作据此重新挖掘历史高频巡天档案，以补充高频所选脉冲星样本。

Method: 使用现代搜寻技术分析2008年Parkes 6.5-GHz脉冲星巡天的档案数据；申请总计8.4小时Parkes（Murriyang）Ultra-Wideband Low（UWL）接收机后续观测，以确认候选体并刻画其在704-4032 MHz范围内的辐射。摘要未说明此次档案再处理所用的具体搜寻流程、单脉冲、偏振、计时或统计分析方法细节。

Result: 该重新处理揭示了四颗此前未知的毫秒脉冲星候选体，自转周期为3-11 ms，色散量为20-170 pc/cc。其中两颗候选体表现出显著的视线方向加速度，表明它们很可能属于致密双星系统。摘要未说明候选体的探测显著性、通量、谱指数或偏振结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，确认这些候选体将扩充高频所选脉冲星的族群，并表明高频搜寻对于揭示在常规低频巡天中被遮蔽的奇特系统仍具有持续的重要性。关于这些候选体与磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、单脉冲辐射、模式转换或自转减慢力矩变化之间的物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Low-frequency (&lt; ~1 GHz) Galactic-plane pulsar surveys are strongly limited by sky background noise, interstellar scattering, and dispersion smearing, leading to an incomplete census of the pulsar population. High-frequency (&gt; 2 GHz) observations mitigate these effects and have recently enabled the discovery of pulsars that remain undetectable at low-frequency. We analyzed archival data from the 2008 Parkes 6.5-GHz pulsar survey using modern search techniques. This reprocessing has revealed four previously unknown millisecond pulsar candidates with spin periods of 3-11 ms and dispersion measures of 20-170 pc/cc. Two candidates exhibit significant line-of-sight acceleration, indicating likely membership in compact binary systems. We request a total of 8.4 hours of follow-up observations with the Parkes (Murriyang) Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver to confirm these candidates and characterize their emission across 704-4032 MHz. Confirming these sources would expand the population of high-frequency selected pulsars and demonstrate the continued importance of high-frequency searches for uncovering exotic systems obscured in conventional low-frequency surveys.

</details>

### [4553] [Parkes observations for project P512 semester 2008APRS_01]()
*Johnston, Simon,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Lyne, Andrew,O'Brien, J.,Hobbs, George,McLaughlin, Maura,Burgay, Marta,D'Amico, Nichi,Bailes, Matthew,Lorimer, Duncan Ross*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划使用新的甲醇多波束接收机沿银道面完成一项脉冲星巡天，旨在发现较低频率巡天所选择排除的脉冲星，包括隐藏在旋臂中的年轻脉冲星，并巡测高频瞬变射电天空。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前较低频率的巡天可能因选择效应而漏掉部分脉冲星，尤其是隐藏在旋臂中的年轻脉冲星；同时，内银河的弥散与散射物质分布尚需改进认识，高频瞬变射电天空也有待巡测。因此需要开展沿银道面的高频脉冲星巡天，并期待发现带有黑洞伴星的脉冲星、短周期双星脉冲星等独特天体。

Method: 摘要说明拟使用新的甲醇多波束（Methanol Multibeam）接收机，沿银道面完成一项脉冲星巡天；巡天目标是发现较低频率巡天所选择排除的脉冲星，并在高频率下巡测瞬变射电天空。具体的观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本规模、灵敏度以及计时、单脉冲、偏振、RM、DM 或统计分析方法，摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未说明。该摘要为一项巡天提议，未给出已完成观测、已发现脉冲星、已测量参数或统计分析结果；未报告任何脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）的探测，也未给出周期、DM、RM、偏振、流量或显著性等数值。

Conclusion: 作者提出的科学目标包括：发现较低频率下被遮蔽、位于旋臂中的年轻脉冲星，改进对内银河弥散和散射物质分布的认识，发现带有黑洞伴星的脉冲星与短周期双星脉冲星等独特天体，并巡测高频瞬变射电天空。摘要未给出已完成结果，因此这些目标是否实现无法判断；至于与单脉冲发射、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱或磁星—FRB 联系的直接关联，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose to complete a pulsar survey along the Galactic Plane using the new Methanol Multibeam receiver in order to uncover pulsars previously selected against in lower frequency surveys. The scientific aims of this survey are (a) to discover young pulsars in the spiral arms, hidden at lower frequencies, (b) to improve our knowledge of the distribution of dispersing and scattering material, particularly in the inner Galaxy, (c) strike it lucky and discover unique objects (e.g. a pulsar with a black hole companion and short period binary pulsars) and (d) to survey the transient radio sky at high frequencies.

</details>

*Johnston, Simon,Possenti, Andrea,Kramer, Michael,Lyne, Andrew,O'Brien, J.,Hobbs, George,McLaughlin, Maura,Burgay, Marta,D'Amico, Nichi,Bailes, Matthew,Lorimer, Duncan Ross*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟继续使用甲醇多波束接收机沿银道面开展脉冲星巡天，以发现此前被较低频率巡天排除的脉冲星，并推进年轻脉冲星、内银河色散与散射物质分布、独特天体及高频瞬变射电天空等目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前较低频率巡天可能选择性地排除了部分脉冲星，因此需要沿银道面开展巡天；同时，内银河中色散和散射物质的分布尚需改进认识，并有必要巡测高频瞬变射电天空。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测、数据、时间跨度、样本或分析方法；仅说明提议继续使用新的甲醇多波束接收机，沿银道面开展脉冲星巡天，并涉及高频率巡测瞬变射电天空。

Result: 摘要未说明已获得的观测结果；仅提出拟通过该巡天发现旋臂中隐藏在较低频率下的年轻脉冲星、改进对内银河色散和散射物质分布的认识、发现独特天体，以及在高频率下巡测瞬变射电天空。

Conclusion: 作者提出的科学目标包括：发现旋臂中较低频率下隐藏的年轻脉冲星，改进对色散和散射物质分布的认识（尤其在内银河），并期望发现独特天体及巡测高频瞬变射电天空。根据摘要无法判断该巡天与脉冲星单脉冲、脉冲轮廓演化、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、偏振、射电频谱、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）之间的具体联系。

Abstract: We propose to continue undertake a pulsar survey along the Galactic Plane using the new Methanol Multibeam receiver in order to uncover pulsars previously selected against in lower frequency surveys. The scientific aims of this survey are (a) to discover young pulsars in the spiral arms, hidden at lower frequencies, (b) to improve our knowledge of the distribution of dispersing and scattering material, particularly in the inner Galaxy, (c) strike it lucky and discover unique objects (e.g. a pulsar with a black hole companion and short period binary pulsars) and (d) to survey the transient radio sky at high frequencies.

</details>


### [4558] [Parkes observations for project P972 semester 2018OCTS_05]()
*Oswald, Lucy,Johnston, Simon,Karastergiou, Aris*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟利用Parkes Ultra-Wideband接收机对一小组明亮脉冲星在可用的最宽频率范围内观测单个脉冲与平均脉冲轮廓中的总功率、线偏振和圆偏振以及偏振位置角轮廓，以区分本征发射性质与脉冲星磁层和星际介质中的传播效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脉冲星发现50年后仍在推动广义相对论检验和冷致密核物质状态方程研究，但仍存在理解脉冲星取向与射电束几何、以及决定其频谱和偏振度的等离子体条件等紧迫未决问题；进展主要受限于望远镜灵敏度和同时频率覆盖。

Method: 摘要未说明具体观测时间、时长和样本数量。摘要指出，提议使用Parkes Ultra-Wideband接收机，对一小组明亮脉冲星进行观测；在可用的最宽频率范围内，从单个脉冲和平均脉冲轮廓中测量总功率、线偏振和圆偏振以及偏振位置角轮廓。摘要未说明具体的分析或统计方法。

Result: 摘要未说明已获得的观测结果。摘要仅提出：Parkes Ultra-Wideband接收机将改变这一局面，拟议观测聚焦于一小群明亮脉冲星，并将在单个脉冲和平均脉冲轮廓中、在可用的最宽频率范围内测量总功率、线偏振和圆偏振以及偏振位置角轮廓。摘要未给出数值、趋势、相关性或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者明确支持的科学含义是，这些数据将使他们能够以前所未有的方式，将脉冲星磁层和星际介质中的传播效应与本征发射性质分离开来。关于该提案对脉冲星计时、自转减慢力矩变化、模式转换、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）的相关性，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: 50 years after the discovery of pulsars, these objects continue to push the boundaries in the testing of fundamental physics, most notably in General Relativity and in understanding the equation of state of cold, dense, nuclear matter. A number of pressing open questions remain, as basic as understanding pulsar orientation and radio beam geometry, and as complicated as understanding the plasma conditions that set their spectrum and degree of polarisation. Progress has mainly been limited by telescope sensitivity and simultaneous frequency coverage. The Parkes Ultra-Wideband receiver will change the game. We propose observations focused on a small group of bright pulsars to answer key questions on the pulsar emission process. We focus on three key observables, measured in individual pulses and average pulse profiles, across the widest available frequency range: the total power, the linear and circular polarisation, and the polarisation position angle profile across the pulse. The data will allow us to separate intrinsic emission properties from propagation effects in the pulsar magnetosphere and the interstellar medium, in a way that has never before been possible.

</details>

### [4564] [Parkes observations for project P1071 semester 2020OCTS_01]()

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 间歇脉冲星是当前脉冲星研究的主要课题，因为它们把脉冲星发射研究与自转不规则性直接联系起来。新的超宽带低频（UWL）接收机提供前所未有的频率覆盖，使更详细研究间歇脉冲星发射特性成为可能。摘要指出这类脉冲星的发射以从数天到数年的长间隔开启和关闭，但对其时间尺度、关闭态发射和频率依赖等仍需观测研究。

Method: 摘要说明申请使用超宽带低频（UWL）接收机对间歇脉冲星进行观测，利用其前所未有的频率覆盖研究发射特性。拟确定时间尺度的分布和频率依赖，寻找关闭态中的弱发射或爆发式发射，并确定开启/关闭发射过程的带宽、频谱特征、宽带脉冲能量分布演化及长期与短期发射变化的可能联系。具体望远镜名称、观测频率、时间跨度、样本量和统计方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未报告已获得的观测结果或定量发现。它仅说明间歇脉冲星发射以从数天到数年的长间隔开启和关闭，并提出将确定时间尺度的分布和频率依赖，寻找关闭态中的弱或爆发式发射，确定开启/关闭发射过程的带宽、发射的频谱特征，研究脉冲能量分布在宽带上的演化，并寻找长期与短期发射变化之间可能的联系。未给出具体数值、显著性、事件或相关性结果。

Conclusion: 摘要称这些观测将为理解这些脉冲星如何发射，以及该发射如何随时间并作为频率的函数变化提供认识。作者未在摘要中给出具体的物理机制解释、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）联系，也未报告自转不规则性的具体结论；根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Intermittent pulsars are a major topic of current pulsar research as they provide a direct link between studies of pulsar emission and irregularities in the rotation of the pulsars. The new Ultra-Wide-Low(UWL) receiver provides unprecedented frequency coverage and will allow us to study the emission properties of the intermittent pulsars in great detail. We request observations with the UWL receiver to intermittent pulsars. These are pulsars whose emission switches on and off at long intervals from days to years. We will determine the distribution and frequency dependence of the time scales, look for weak or bursty emission in the off states and determine the bandwidth of the on/off emission process, the spectral characteristics of the emission, the evolution of pulse energy distribution over wide-band and search for possible link between long- and short-term emission variability. These observations will provide insights into how these pulsars emit and how that emission is changing in time and as a function of frequency.

</details>

### [4570] [Parkes observations for project P512 semester 2006OCTS_02]()
*Johnston, Simon,Possenti, Andrea,Manchester, Dick,Kramer, Michael,Lyne, Andrew,O'Brien, J.,Hobbs, George,Edwards, Russell,McLaughlin, Maura,Burgay, Marta,D'Amico, N.,Bailes, Matthew,Lorimer, Duncan Ross*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟继续使用甲醇多波束接收机沿银道面开展脉冲星巡天，模拟预期共发现 200 颗脉冲星，其中约一半为新发现，并同时巡测高频瞬变射电天空。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 较低频率巡天会对部分脉冲星产生选择效应，使其被遗漏；研究希望在旋臂中发现这些被隐藏的年轻脉冲星，并改进对内银河中色散与散射物质分布的认识，同时在高频段巡测瞬变射电天空。

Method: 摘要说明拟沿银道面使用新的甲醇多波束（Methanol Multibeam）接收机继续开展脉冲星巡天，并开展高频瞬变射电天空巡测；此外进行了模拟以预期探测数量。观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本量、数据处理与统计分析方法等具体细节，摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未报告实际观测结果；仅说明模拟表明预期共发现 200 颗脉冲星，其中约一半将是新发现。摘要未说明具体探测、计时、偏振、光谱或瞬变事件结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出该巡天可发现旋臂中在较低频率下被隐藏的年轻脉冲星，增进对内银河色散和散射物质分布的认识，并有可能发现独特天体（如带黑洞伴星的脉冲星和短周期双星脉冲星）以及在高频段巡测瞬变射电天空。与脉冲星单脉冲、模式转换、计时、自转减慢力矩变化、磁星及快速射电暴（FRB）的直接联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose to continue undertake a pulsar survey along the Galactic Plane using the new Methanol Multibeam receiver in order to uncover pulsars previously selected against in lower frequency surveys. The scientific aims of this survey are (a) to discover young pulsars in the spiral arms, hidden at lower frequencies, (b) to improve our knowledge of the distribution of dispersing and scattering material, particularly in the inner Galaxy, (c) strike it lucky and discover unique objects (e.g. a pulsar with a black hole companion and short period binary pulsars) and (d) to survey the transient radio sky at high frequencies. Simulations have shown that we expect to find a total of 200 pulsars of which about one half will be new detections.

</details>


### [4571] [Parkes observations for project P512 semester 2006OCTS_01]()
*Johnston, Simon,Possenti, Andrea,Manchester, Dick,Kramer, Michael,Lyne, Andrew,O'Brien, J.,Hobbs, George,Edwards, Russell,McLaughlin, Maura,Burgay, Marta,D'Amico, N.,Bailes, Matthew,Lorimer, Duncan Ross*

TL;DR: 该提案计划继续使用甲醇多波束接收机沿银道面开展脉冲星巡天，以发现较低频率巡天所遗漏的脉冲星；模拟预期共发现 200 颗脉冲星，其中约一半为新发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前较低频率巡天可能对某些脉冲星存在选择偏差，使其难以被探测；该巡天旨在沿银道面发现这类被遗漏的脉冲星，并研究内银河色散与散射物质的分布，同时寻找独特天体并巡测高频暂现射电天空。

Method: 摘要说明拟继续使用新的甲醇多波束接收机沿银道面开展脉冲星巡天，并在高频段巡测射电暂现天空；此外提及模拟给出预期发现数。具体观测频率或波段、时间跨度、样本、数据处理与统计分析方法：摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未报告已获得的观测结果。其报告的是提案的科学目标与预期：模拟表明预期总共发现 200 颗脉冲星，其中约一半将是新发现；目标包括发现旋臂中在较低频率被隐藏的年轻脉冲星、增进对内银河色散和散射物质分布的了解，以及发现独特天体（如伴星为黑洞的脉冲星和短周期双星脉冲星）。

Conclusion: 作者认为，使用甲醇多波束接收机继续沿银道面巡天有望发现较低频率巡天所遗漏的脉冲星，从而推进对脉冲星分布与星际色散、散射物质的认识，并可能发现独特天体、巡测高频暂现射电天空。该工作是观测提案而非已完成结果，对脉冲星、磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、单脉冲、模式转换、计时或偏振等具体课题的适用性：根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose to continue undertake a pulsar survey along the Galactic Plane using the new Methanol Multibeam receiver in order to uncover pulsars previously selected against in lower frequency surveys. The scientific aims of this survey are (a) to discover young pulsars in the spiral arms, hidden at lower frequencies, (b) to improve our knowledge of the distribution of dispersing and scattering material, particularly in the inner Galaxy, (c) strike it lucky and discover unique objects (e.g. a pulsar with a black hole companion and short period binary pulsars) and (d) to survey the transient radio sky at high frequencies. Simulations have shown that we expect to find a total of 200 pulsars of which about one half will be new detections.

</details>


### [4572] [Parkes observations for project P1238 semester 2023OCTS_04]()
*Ahmad, Adeel,Filipovic, Miroslav,Johnston, Simon,Dai, Shi,Barnes, Luke,Lazarevic, Sanja*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请提出利用Parkes UWL接收机，对由ASKAP EMU巡天在银道面识别出的四个新脉冲星风云候选体所驱动的射电脉冲星开展定向搜寻；高DM导致的散射与展宽可能使此类脉冲星在此前巡天中难以探测，而UWL的宽频率覆盖尤其是高频有望规避这些效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 年轻高能脉冲星可驱动强脉冲星风云（PWN），从射电到X射线乃至更高频段均可观测。ASKAP EMU巡天的优越灵敏度使在银道面识别新PWN成为可能，并可用其指导射电脉冲星搜寻；此前已由此发现一颗高DM脉冲星驱动具有最长尾之一的弓形激波PWN。摘要支持的空白是：银道面中可能存在的、距离较远且DM较高的这类脉冲星，会因强散射和展宽在此前脉冲星巡天中无法被探测。

Method: 基于ASKAP EMU巡天数据，分析覆盖银道面的若干EMU视场并识别出四个新的PWN候选体；随后申请使用Parkes UWL接收机对这些PWN所驱动的射电脉冲星进行定向搜寻，利用UWL的宽频率覆盖（尤其高频）来规避高DM带来的散射与展宽效应。观测时长、具体频段、灵敏度、样本统计与分析流程细节摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：此前利用ASKAP EMU巡天识别PWN并指导搜寻的策略已被证明成功，表现为发现一颗高DM脉冲星，它驱动着一个具有最长尾之一的弓形激波PWN。最近分析覆盖银道面的若干EMU视场后，识别出另外四个新的PWN候选体。摘要未说明这些候选体的具体名称、位置、DM、流量或其他测量值，也未说明本次拟议搜寻是否已有探测结果。

Conclusion: 作者认为，这些位于银道面且可能距离较远的PWN–脉冲星系统预期具有较大DM；高DM导致的强散射和展宽会使脉冲星在此前巡天中无法被探测，而Parkes UWL的宽频率覆盖，尤其是高频，可避免这些效应，从而提高发现这些脉冲星的机会。摘要所述结论限于该观测策略的可行性与预期收益；根据摘要无法判断其对脉冲星计时、自转减慢转矩变化、偏振、射电频谱、单脉冲或磁星–快速射电暴（FRB）联系的具体意义。

Abstract: Young and energetic pulsars can power strong pulsar wind nebula (PWN), which can be observed from radio to X-ray and beyond. Thanks to the superior sensitivity of the ASKAP EMU survey, we are able to identify new PWNe in the Galactic plane, and use them to guide our search of radio pulsars. This strategy was demonstrated successful by the recent discovery of a high dispersion measure (DM) pulsar powering a bow-shocked PWN with one of the longest tail. Recently, we analysed several EMU fields covering the Galactic plane and identified another four new PWNe candidates. Here we propose to use the Parkes UWL receiver to carry out targeted search of radio pulsars powering these PWNe. Since these system are located in the Galactic plane and can be distant, we expect them to have large DMs. Such high DMs will lead to strong scattering and smearing and make pulsars undetectable in previous pulsar surveys. The wide frequency coverage of UWL, especially the high frequencies, will allow us to avoid these effects and therefore offer us a better chance to find these pulsars.

</details>

### [4576] [Parkes observations for project P1010 semester 2019APRS_07]()
*Posselt, Bettina,Manchester, Dick,Weltevrede, Patrick,Pavlov, George,Dai, Shi*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟用 Parkes NAPA 对 PSR B1055-52 开展与 XMM-Newton 同步的射电观测，以寻找射电脉冲强度的准周期开/关变化与 X 射线脉冲强度之间的相关性，并研究其长期流量变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已探测到的射电—X 射线脉冲相关性发生在长得多的时标上，而 PSR B1055-52 射电脉冲强度表现出约 20 个周期的准周期开/关变化，且在 interpulse 与主脉冲之间相位锁定，据摘要提示全球性磁层重排；同时该脉冲星还显示有趣的长期流量变化。摘要因此提出利用这一罕见机会检验类似全球过程在短时标上是否也表现为射电—X 射线相关。

Method: 摘要未说明。据摘要，将开展 Parkes NAPA 射电观测，并与已获批准的 XMM-Newton X 射线观测同时进行；将寻找脉冲行为中的射电—X 射线相关性，重点检验 X 射线脉冲强度与射电脉冲强度准周期开/关变化的相关性，并研究该脉冲星的长期流量变化。具体频段、时标、样本量、数据分析方法及统计检验均未说明。

Result: 摘要未说明，因为该文为观测提议，尚未报告实际观测结果。摘要仅陈述拟开展的工作与已知背景：PSR B1055-52 的射电脉冲强度存在非常特殊的准周期开/关变化，时标短（约 20 个周期），且在 interpulse 与主脉冲之间相位锁定；在两颗较老的脉冲星中已探测到射电—X 射线相关性，但发生在长得多的时标上；该脉冲星还显示一些有趣的长期流量变化。

Conclusion: 据摘要，这些短时标、相位锁定的准周期射电变化指示全球性磁层重排；PSR B1055-52 为在射电与 X 射线光变曲线中寻找类似全球过程的短期表现提供了罕见机会。作者拟通过同步观测检验短时标射电—X 射线相关性并研究长期流量变化。根据摘要无法判断该提议观测最终能否证实这一解释，也无法判断其与磁星及快速射电暴（FRB）的关联。

Abstract: We propose Parkes NAPA radio observations of PSR B1055-52 to be carried out simultaneously with approved X-ray observations by XMM-Newton. We will look for radio-X-ray correlations in the pulse behavior. In particular, we will search for a correlation of the X-ray pulse intensity with the very unusual quasi-periodic on/off change in the radio pulse intensity. These quasi-periodic changes on short timescale (about 20 periods) are also phase-locked between interpulse and main pulse, indicating global magnetospheric rearrangements. While radio-X-ray correlations have been detected in two older pulsars, they occur on much longer timescales. PSR B1055-52 provides a rare opportunity to search for the short-term manifestations of similar global processes in the radio and X-ray light curves. This radio- and X-ray- bright pulsar also shows some interesting long-term flux variability which we will investigate.

</details>

Result: 摘要为观测提案，未报告观测结果。摘要指出，射电脉冲强度存在非常不寻常的准周期 on/off 变化，短时标约为 20 个周期，且在 interpulse 与主脉冲之间相位锁定，表明全球性磁层重排；此前已在两颗较老脉冲星中探测到射电–X 射线相关性，但发生在长得多的时标上；PSR B1055-52 射电和 X 射线均明亮，并表现出一些有趣的长时标流量变化。相关性的数值与显著性摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 摘要提出的科学目标是检验 PSR B1055-52 中 X 射线脉冲强度是否与射电脉冲强度的准周期 on/off 变化相关，以寻找射电与 X 射线光变曲线中类似全球性过程的短期表现，并研究其长时标流量变化。该脉冲星被视为搜寻此类短期表现的一个罕见机会。根据摘要无法判断该相关性是否存在及其物理机制。

Abstract: We propose Parkes NAPA radio observations of PSR B1055-52 to be carried out simultaneously with approved X-ray observations by XMM-Newton. We will look for radio-X-ray correlations in the pulse behavior. In particular, we will search for a correlation of the X-ray pulse intensity with the very unusual quasi-periodic on/off change in the radio pulse intensity. These quasi-periodic changes on short timescale (about 20 periods) are also phase-locked between interpulse and main pulse, indicating global magnetospheric rearrangements. While radio-X-ray correlations have been detected in two older pulsars, they occur on much longer timescales. PSR B1055-52 provides a rare opportunity to search for the short-term manifestations of similar global processes in the radio and X-ray light curves. This radio- and X-ray- bright pulsar also shows some interesting long-term flux variability which we will investigate.

</details>

### [4583] [Parkes observations for project P1322 semester 2024APRS_01]()
*Sengar, Rahul,Dobie, Dougal,Kaplan, David,Anumarlapudi, Akash*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案旨在使用Parkes射电望远镜的超宽带低（UWL）接收机，确认快速ASKAP连续谱巡天（RACS）识别出的25个陡谱源是否具有脉冲星性质。摘要指出，大带宽覆盖使该接收机成为实现这一目标的理想仪器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于时间序列周期性分析的脉冲星搜索已编目超过3,400颗脉冲星，但由于色散量导致的展宽以及多普勒展宽效应引起的自转周期调制，在探测毫秒脉冲星和双星脉冲星方面存在困难。射电波段全天成像巡天可通过成像发现脉冲星，无需事先知道脉冲宽度、色散量或双星性质。摘要以RACS识别出的25个陡谱源为待确认目标。

Method: 摘要说明将使用Parkes射电望远镜的超宽带低（UWL）接收机开展观测，以确认快速ASKAP连续谱巡天（RACS）识别出的25个陡谱源是否具有脉冲星性质；摘要强调UWL接收机具有大带宽覆盖。关于具体观测频率、时间跨度、灵敏度、数据分析流程以及是否进行计时、单脉冲、偏振、色散量或射电频谱拟合，摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要指出传统周期性搜索方法已编目超过3,400颗脉冲星；快速ASKAP连续谱巡天（RACS）识别出25个具有与脉冲星一致的光谱指数的陡谱源。该提案提出使用Parkes UWL接收机确认这些源的脉冲星性质，但摘要未报告实际观测结果、确认数量、脉冲轮廓、偏振、计时或光谱测量结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出，由于UWL接收机具有大带宽覆盖，使用Parkes UWL接收机是确认RACS所识别25个陡谱源脉冲星性质的理想途径。摘要未说明实际观测是否已完成或这些源是否已被确认为脉冲星；关于其对磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或其他暂现射电源的解释，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Pulsars are critical for probing fundamental questions in various domains of physics and astrophysics. Traditional pulsar search methods, focusing on periodicity analysis of time series data, have cataloged over 3,400 pulsars. However, these methods face challenges in detecting millisecond pulsars (MSPs) and binary pulsars due to dispersion measure smearing and the modulation in spin period due to Doppler smearing effect. An alternative way to overcome these challenges has been the use of all-sky imaging surveys at radio wavelengths, enabling the discovery of pulsars through imaging rather than traditional searches. This approach, which detects phase-averaged emission from pulsars, overcomes the limitations of traditional methods. Imaging surveys, such as those conducted by the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP), are particularly effective in identifying pulsars without prior knowledge of their pulse width, dispersion measure, or binarity. The Rapid ASKAP Continuum Survey (RACS) has identified 25 steep spectrum sources with a spectral index consistent with pulsars. To confirm the pulsar nature of these sources, in this proposal, we will use the Ultra-Wide-low (UWL) receiver of the Parkes radio telescope. Due to a large bandwidth coverage, the UWL receiver of Parkes is an ideal instrument to achieve this goal.

</details>

### [4590] [Parkes observations for project P1322 semester 2024APRS_08]()
*Sengar, Rahul,Dobie, Dougal,Kaplan, David,Anumarlapudi, Akash*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案计划使用Parkes射电望远镜的Ultra-Wide-low（UWL）接收机，对快速ASKAP连续谱巡天（RACS）识别出的25个频谱指数与脉冲星一致的陡谱源进行观测，以确认其脉冲星性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于时间序列周期性分析的脉冲星搜索已编目超过3，400颗脉冲星，但由于色散量涂抹和多普勒涂抹效应导致的自转周期调制，在探测毫秒脉冲星和双星脉冲星时面临挑战；射电波段全天成像巡天可通过探测相位平均发射来克服这些局限。

Method: 摘要提到快速ASKAP连续谱巡天（RACS）已识别出25个频谱指数与脉冲星一致的陡谱源；本提案将使用Parkes射电望远镜的Ultra-Wide-low（UWL）接收机对这些源进行观测，并指出UWL接收机因具有大带宽覆盖而是实现该目标的理想仪器。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、时间跨度以及分析方法的细节。

Result: 摘要报告，传统周期性搜索已编目超过3，400颗脉冲星；成像巡天特别适合在无需事先知道脉冲宽度、色散量或双星性质的情况下识别脉冲星；RACS已识别出25个频谱指数与脉冲星一致的陡谱源。摘要未说明对这批源进行观测后的结果，因为这些观测属于提案内容。

Conclusion: 作者认为，射电波段全天成像巡天通过探测相位平均发射，可克服传统周期性搜索在毫秒脉冲星和双星脉冲星探测中因色散量涂抹和多普勒涂抹而面临的局限；并计划利用Parkes UWL接收机的大带宽覆盖来确认RACS所识别25个陡谱源的脉冲星性质。根据摘要无法判断这些源是否最终被确认为脉冲星。

Abstract: Pulsars are critical for probing fundamental questions in various domains of physics and astrophysics. Traditional pulsar search methods, focusing on periodicity analysis of time series data, have cataloged over 3,400 pulsars. However, these methods face challenges in detecting millisecond pulsars (MSPs) and binary pulsars due to dispersion measure smearing and the modulation in spin period due to Doppler smearing effect. An alternative way to overcome these challenges has been the use of all-sky imaging surveys at radio wavelengths, enabling the discovery of pulsars through imaging rather than traditional searches. This approach, which detects phase-averaged emission from pulsars, overcomes the limitations of traditional methods. Imaging surveys, such as those conducted by the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP), are particularly effective in identifying pulsars without prior knowledge of their pulse width, dispersion measure, or binarity. The Rapid ASKAP Continuum Survey (RACS) has identified 25 steep spectrum sources with a spectral index consistent with pulsars. To confirm the pulsar nature of these sources, in this proposal, we will use the Ultra-Wide-low (UWL) receiver of the Parkes radio telescope. Due to a large bandwidth coverage, the UWL receiver of Parkes is an ideal instrument to achieve this goal.

</details>


### [4591] [Parkes observations for project P1452 semester 2026OCTS_01]()
*DeCesar, Megan,Ransom, Scott,Maccarone, Tom,Frail, Dale,Polisensky, Emil,Pattie, Eliot*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟在 MeerKAT 和甚大阵列成像巡天发现的 20 个脉冲星候选体中搜寻脉冲星，预期主要发现毫秒脉冲星；候选体主要依据陡谱、圆偏振和/或线偏振，以及较小程度上依据射电变化程度选出，共申请 22.5 小时观测时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 MeerKAT 和甚大阵列对银河系核球和银盘的成像巡天中已发现脉冲星候选体，这些候选体主要被识别为陡谱、圆偏振和/或线偏振源，并在较小程度上依据射电变化程度被识别。本提案旨在对这些候选体开展脉冲星搜寻，并预期主要发现毫秒脉冲星；摘要未说明更具体的科学背景或知识空白。

Method: 使用 MeerKAT 和甚大阵列成像巡天对银河系核球和银盘的观测结果中选出的脉冲星候选体；共选定 20 个目标，其中 11 个可能是核球成员，9 个位于银盘。计划使用 UWL 接收机对每个源进行两次半小时指向观测，外加每两个源 15 分钟的 overhead（设置和转向），共请求 22.5 小时观测时间。摘要未说明具体的搜寻或分析方法。

Result: 摘要报告的是观测提案，而非已完成的观测结果：从 MeerKAT 和甚大阵列对银河系核球和银盘的成像巡天中选取了 20 个脉冲星候选体，其中 11 个可能是核球成员，9 个位于银盘；候选体主要被识别为陡谱、圆偏振和/或线偏振源，并在较小程度上依据射电变化程度被识别；计划用 UWL 接收机对每个源进行两次半小时指向观测，外加每两个源 15 分钟 overhead，共请求 22.5 小时观测时间。摘要未说明任何已获得的脉冲星、毫秒脉冲星、脉冲轮廓、偏振、计时或脉冲结果。

Conclusion: 作者明确提出对这些候选体开展脉冲星搜寻，并预期主要发现毫秒脉冲星，目标来源为银河系核球和银盘中的候选体。该提案尚处于申请观测阶段，因此无法据摘要判断搜索是否成功或任何源的真实性质；与脉冲星、磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲发射的具体物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: We propose a search for pulsars, with the expectation of finding primarily millisecond pulsars, in pulsar candidates found in MeerKAT and Very Large Array imaging surveys of the Galactic Bulge and Plane. The candidates were identified primarily as steep-spectrum, circularly- and/or linearly-polarized sources, and to a lesser degree by the level of radio variability observed. We have chosen 20 pulsar candidates to target in this proposal, eleven that may be Bulge members and nine others in the Plane. We request two half-hour pointings per source with the UWL receiver, plus 15 minutes of overhead (setup and slewing) per two sources, for a total of 22.5 hours of observing time.

</details>

Abstract: We propose a search for pulsars, with the expectation of finding primarily millisecond pulsars, in pulsar candidates found in MeerKAT and Very Large Array imaging surveys of the Galactic Bulge and Plane. We request two half-hour pointings per source with the UWL receiver, plus 15 minutes of overhead (setup and slewing) per two sources, for a total of 22.5 hours of observing time.

### [4593] [Parkes observations for project P1317 semester 2026APRS_03]()
*Berteaud, Joanna,Dai, Shi,Clark, Colin James,Clavel, Maïca,Calore, Francesca*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 在6个毫秒脉冲星候选体中，作者发现两颗新毫秒脉冲星PSR J1740-28和PSR J1740-2805，显著增加了银河系中心方向上高度色散毫秒脉冲星的数量；后续Murriyang数据给出二者双星参数，并表明其中一颗是黑寡妇候选体，与MeerKAT探测到的圆偏振源相关联。作者提议继续定期计时观测以约束参数、研究长期演化并排除它们属于一个新球状星团。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 银河系核球中是否存在毫秒脉冲星种群，是理解Fermi GeV过量（来自银河系中心方向、类似已知MSP累积发射的伽马射线信号）性质的关键问题。作者此前获得20小时绿岸望远镜观测时间，以研究6个MSP候选体的性质，从而检验核球MSP种群这一设想。

Method: 摘要说明：2022年使用绿岸望远镜进行了20小时观测，目标为6个MSP候选体；2023年至2025年间使用Murriyang望远镜收集数据，用于获取双星参数并开展计时分析，并提及MeerKAT数据中的圆偏振源。具体观测频率或波段、时间分辨率、样本筛选与统计方法等，摘要未说明。

Result: 在一个目标源方向上发现两颗新毫秒脉冲星PSR J1740-28和PSR J1740-2805，显著增加了银河系中心方向上高度色散MSP的数量。2023年至2025年的Murriyang数据给出了两颗脉冲星的双星参数，并揭示其中一颗为黑寡妇候选体，与MeerKAT数据中探测到的圆偏振源相关联；另一颗脉冲星因十分暗弱，其位置仍受到较宽松的限制。摘要未给出脉冲周期、色散量、轨道参数或显著性等具体数值。

Conclusion: 作者认为，这两颗新发现的高度色散毫秒脉冲星可能首次提供了银河系核球MSP种群的直接证据；其中一颗黑寡妇候选体与MeerKAT圆偏振源相关联。作者提议继续用Murriyang定期计时观测，以约束脉冲星参数、研究其长期演化，并排除它们属于一个新球状星团的可能性。该结果对脉冲星计时、双星演化和核球MSP种群研究的适用性，摘要已给出相应表述；对磁星、单脉冲发射、模式转换、自转减慢力矩变化或FRB联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The existence of a population of millisecond pulsars (MSPs) in the Galactic bulge is supported, among others, by the Fermi GeV excess, a signal of gamma rays coming from the Galactic center (GC) direction and resembling the cumulative emission of known MSPs. In 2022, we were granted 20h of observations with the Green Bank Telescope to shed light onto the nature of 6 MSP candidates. We discovered two new MSPs, PSR J1740-28 and PSR J1740-2805, towards one of our targets, significantly increasing the number of highly-dispersed MSPs in the GC direction and probably unveiling the first direct evidence of a bulge MSP population. Data collected with the Murriyang telescope between 2023 and 2025 enabled us to obtain binary parameters for both pulsars and revealed that one of them is a black-widow candidate, associated with a circularly polarized source detected in MeerKAT data. Due to the faintness of the other pulsar, its position remains loosely constrained. We propose to continue regular timing observations of these pulsars with Murriyang, in order to constrain their parameter, study their long-term evolution, and rule out that they belong to a new globular cluster.

</details>


### [4594] [Parkes observations for project P1317 semester 2026APRS_04]()
*Berteaud, Joanna,Dai, Shi,Clark, Colin James,Clavel, Maïca,Calore, Francesca*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 在Green Bank Telescope的20小时观测中，于一个目标方向发现了两颗新的毫秒脉冲星PSR J1740-28和PSR J1740-2805；后续Murriyang观测给出了两者的双星参数，并显示其中一颗是黑寡妇候选体，与MeerKAT数据中的圆偏振源相关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 银河系核球中是否存在毫秒脉冲星（MSP）群体是一个重要问题，Fermi GeV过量（来自银河系中心方向的伽马射线信号，类似于已知MSP的累积发射）为该群体的存在提供了支持。作者希望揭示6个MSP候选体的性质，以进一步检验核球MSP群体这一图像。

Method: 摘要说明：2022年获得Green Bank Telescope 20小时观测，用于研究6个MSP候选体；2023年至2025年间使用Murriyang望远镜收集数据，用于获取两颗脉冲星的双星参数并开展位置与关联分析；MeerKAT数据用于关联圆偏振源。摘要未说明具体观测频率或波段、数据量、分析流程细节。作者提议继续用Murriyang进行定期计时观测。摘要未说明拟议观测的时长与频段。

Result: 在一个目标方向上发现了两颗新MSP：PSR J1740-28和PSR J1740-2805，显著增加了银河系中心方向上高色散MSP的数量。2023年至2025年的Murriyang数据给出了这两颗脉冲星的双星参数，并揭示其中一颗是黑寡妇候选体，且与MeerKAT数据中探测到的圆偏振源相关联。另一颗脉冲星因十分暗弱，其位置仍受到较宽松的限制。摘要未给出具体色散量、周期、轨道参数或显著性数值。

Conclusion: 作者认为这两个发现显著增加了银河系中心方向上高色散MSP的数量，并可能是核球MSP群体的首个直接证据；其中一颗脉冲星被列为黑寡妇候选体，并与MeerKAT圆偏振源相关联。作者提议继续以Murriyang定期计时，以限制其参数、研究长期演化，并排除它们属于一个新球状星团的可能性。上述关于核球MSP群体与FRB等更广泛联系的解释，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The existence of a population of millisecond pulsars (MSPs) in the Galactic bulge is supported, among others, by the Fermi GeV excess, a signal of gamma rays coming from the Galactic center (GC) direction and resembling the cumulative emission of known MSPs. In 2022, we were granted 20h of observations with the Green Bank Telescope to shed light onto the nature of 6 MSP candidates. We discovered two new MSPs, PSR J1740-28 and PSR J1740-2805, towards one of our targets, significantly increasing the number of highly-dispersed MSPs in the GC direction and probably unveiling the first direct evidence of a bulge MSP population. Data collected with the Murriyang telescope between 2023 and 2025 enabled us to obtain binary parameters for both pulsars and revealed that one of them is a black-widow candidate, associated with a circularly polarized source detected in MeerKAT data. Due to the faintness of the other pulsar, its position remains loosely constrained. We propose to continue regular timing observations of these pulsars with Murriyang, in order to constrain their parameter, study their long-term evolution, and rule out that they belong to a new globular cluster.

</details>

Data collected with the Murriyang telescope between 2023 and 2025 enabled us to obtain binary parameters for both pulsars and revealed that one of them is a black-widow candidate, associated with a circularly polarized source detected in MeerKAT data. Due to the faintness of the other pulsar, its position remains loosely constrained. We propose to continue regular timing observations of these pulsars with Murriyang, in order to constrain their parameter, study their long-term evolution, and rule out that they belong to a new globular cluster.

Motivation: Fermi GeV过量等证据支持银河系核球中存在毫秒脉冲星族群，但该族群的直接证据仍有待确认。作者此前获得绿岸望远镜20小时观测时间，用于探究6个MSP候选体的性质，并希望通过后续观测进一步确认新发现脉冲星的性质与归属。

Method: 摘要说明的观测包括：2022年使用绿岸望远镜对6个MSP候选体进行20小时观测；2023年至2025年使用Murriyang望远镜收集数据。分析内容为获取两颗脉冲星的双星参数、约束位置，并提议继续用Murriyang进行定期计时观测。具体频率或波段、分析流程与统计方法摘要未说明。

Result: 在一个目标方向发现两颗新MSP，PSR J1740-28和PSR J1740-2805，显著增加了GC方向上高色散MSP的数量。Murriyang 2023–2025年数据给出了两颗脉冲星的双星参数，并揭示其中一颗为黑寡妇候选体，与MeerKAT数据中探测到的圆偏振源相关联；另一颗脉冲星因暗弱，位置仍受较宽松限制。

Conclusion: 作者认为这一发现可能首次提供了核球MSP族群的直接证据，并提议继续用Murriyang定期计时观测，以约束参数、研究长期演化，并排除这两颗脉冲星属于一个新球状星团的可能性。这些解释仍为作者基于摘要所述发现的表述，其物理细节根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The existence of a population of millisecond pulsars (MSPs) in the Galactic bulge is supported, among others, by the Fermi GeV excess, a signal of gamma rays coming from the Galactic center (GC) direction and resembling the cumulative emission of known MSPs. In 2022, we were granted 20h of observations with the Green Bank Telescope to shed light onto the nature of 6 MSP candidates. We discovered two new MSPs, PSR J1740-28 and PSR J1740-2805, towards one of our targets, significantly increasing the number of highly-dispersed MSPs in the GC direction and probably unveiling the first direct evidence of a bulge MSP population. Data collected with the Murriyang telescope between 2023 and 2025 enabled us to obtain binary parameters for both pulsars and revealed that one of them is a black-widow candidate, associated with a circularly polarized source detected in MeerKAT data. Due to the faintness of the other pulsar, its position remains loosely constrained. We propose to continue regular timing observations of these pulsars with Murriyang, in order to constrain their parameter, study their long-term evolution, and rule out that they belong to a new globular cluster.

</details>


### [4597] [Parkes observations for project P1339 semester 2024OCTS_02]()
*Yang, Xuan,Hobbs, George,Toomey, Lawrence,Dai, Shi,Zic, Andrew,Zhang, Songbo,Wu, Xuefeng,Li, Ye,Wang, Jieshuang*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 作者报告在一个数据集的无监督机器学习流程中发现一个位于赤经 20:47:34.4、赤纬 -16:42:03 的重复宽带信号，持续数秒、在 60 秒观测内重复，并在八个不同波束中依次被探测到；该异常事件可能与区域内一颗恒星（白矮星候选体 Gaia DR3 6886074198993703168）的恒星耀发有关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望从观测数据中寻找此前未知的源，为此采用无监督机器学习流程处理数据集，并由此发现一系列“unknown-unknown”源，其中包含本文讨论的异常事件。摘要未说明该数据集的具体科学目标或已知的知识空白。

Method: 摘要未说明数据集、望远镜或仪器名称、频段、时间跨度与样本大小。摘要称将无监督机器学习流程应用于数据集，并称观测对应于通过依次将每个波束指向一颗脉冲星来测试多波束系统；异常信号在八个不同波束中被依次探测到。摘要未说明具体的统计、计时或谱分析流程。信号在 60 秒观测内重复出现，持续数秒；利用 GAIA 在异常事件 0.23 deg 半径、100 pc 以内识别出四个源。

Result: 在赤经 20:47:34.4、赤纬 -16:42:03 发现一个持续数秒的宽带信号，在 60 秒观测过程中重复出现；该信号在八个不同波束中被依次探测到，且并非脉冲星波束。该异常事件 0.23 deg 半径内，GAIA 识别出共四个位于 100 pc 以内的源，其中一个是白矮星候选体 Gaia DR3 6886074198993703168。摘要未给出通量、偏振、频谱指数、显著性或重复周期等数值。

Conclusion: 作者推测，观测到的异常事件可能是一颗来自所覆盖区域内某颗恒星的恒星耀发；如果该异常事件来自一颗白矮星，那么它可能是继 AR Sco 之后第二个已确认的射电活动脉冲星发射白矮星。这一物理归属与脉冲星、磁星、快速射电暴等具体联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: After applying an unsupervised machine learning pipeline to dataset, we found a series of "unknown-unknown" source in the sky. In the position right ascension 20:47:34.4 and declination -16:42:03, we found a broadband signal that last a few seconds. However, through the 60 second observation it repeats. The observations corresponded to testing the multibeam system by pointing each of the beams in turn at a pulsar. Our signal was detected in eight different beams in sequence (not the pulsar beam), with the same position at right ascension 20:47:34.4 and declination -16:42:03. Within a 0.23 deg radius to the anomalous event, GAIA has identified a total of four sources located within 100 pc. One of them is Gaia DR3 6886074198993703168, a white dwarf candidate. We speculate that the observed anomalous event could potentially be a stellar flare originating from one of the stars within the covered region. If this anomalous event comes from a white dwarf, then it could be the second confirmed radio active pulsar emitting white dwarf after AR Sco.

</details>

Method: 申请使用 Parkes 望远镜的 UWL 接收机（700-4000 MHz）以全极化模式观测四颗蜘蛛 MSP：PSR J1048+2339、PSR J1908+2105、PSR J2052+1219 和 PSR J2256-1024；为每颗脉冲星覆盖近一个完整轨道，共申请 23 小时观测时间，包括每个历元中用于设置和校准的时间。计划对光学厚到光学薄过渡区间（光学深度接近 1）的食相谱进行建模，并观测食进入和食离开时可能的 RM 变化。

Abstract: We propose observing time with the Parkes telescope to investigate four ``spider" millisecond pulsars (MSPs), PSR J1048+2339 (a redback spider), PSR J1908+2105 (an MSP that occupies a region of parameter space between black widows and redbacks), PSR J2052+1219 and PSR J2256-1024 (black widow spiders). Spider MSPs are commonly seen to exhibit frequency-dependent eclipsing. Observations with wide bandwidth telescopes like Parkes UWL (700-4000 MHz) will be extremely useful to study the eclipse mechanisms in these systems. Eclipse properties of spider MSPs are hitherto unexplored at the frequency regime available with the Parkes UWL receiver. We propose to investigate a sample of 4 MSPs mentioned above (for which polarization has not been studied) with the Parkes telescope using the UWL receiver in full polar mode, which will be addressed with this proposal. One of the aims is to model the eclipse phase spectra using wideband observations of these pulsars in an optically thick-to-thin transitioning regime (optical depth nearly 1), to explore the eclipse mechanism. Observing the possible changes in rotation measure (RM) at eclipse ingress and egress will allow us to probe the magnetic field in the eclipse boundaries. We request to cover nearly one full orbit for each of these MSPs. Thus we propose 23 hours of observing time including time for setup and calibration in each epoch with the Parkes UWL receiver for the investigation of the eclipse mechanism as well as the polarization, profile evolution, and spectra of four spider MSPs.

</details>
