### [4605] [Parkes observations for project P990 semester 2018OCTS_01]()
*Li, Di,Mcclure-Griffiths, Naomi,Green, James,Hobbs, George,Stanimirovic, Snezana,Cameron, Andrew,Kaczmarek, Jane,Dai, Shi,Krco, Marko,Zhang, Lei,Weisberg, Joel*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案提出利用 Parkes 对 PSR B1641-45 和 G339 区域同时观测 HI、OH 和 CH 的发射、吸收与受激发射，目标是在 CH 中探测受激发射（若成功将成为第 2 例且是 OH 以外物种中的首例），并结合多种成分改进对 ISM 的理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前唯一已发表的天然、快速切换受激 OH 发射事例来自 PSR B1641-45 方向；OH 与 CH ?-双重跃迁在暗分子气体示踪上相似，且二者天体化学条件、分布和能级结构相似，促使作者尝试在 CH 中探测受激发射。

Method: 摘要说明拟利用 Parkes 观测，在无需移动波束的情况下使用时域中的自然 ON 与 OFF 信号；提议同时获取 HI、OH 和 CH 的发射、吸收和受激发射（高节奏谱，采用“门控”模式或基带记录），并绘制 L 波段波束中的 OH/CH 发射成分。摘要提到 Parkes 正在调试的新 UWL。具体观测时长、样本量、统计与分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要未报告新的观测结果。文中提到目前唯一已发表的天然、快速切换受激 OH 发射事例是在 PSR B1641-45 方向观测到的；来自脉冲星的自然 ON 与 OFF 时域信号被成功用作探测微观物理与 ISM 结构的工具；OH 和 CH ?-双重跃迁都能很好地示踪所谓的“暗分子气体”。CH 受激发射探测尚未给出结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出，若在 CH 中探测到受激发射，将是此类探测的第 2 例，也是 OH 以外物种中的首例；将受激发射（或未探测到）与 Parkes 波束内多个其他发射/吸收成分联合分析，将显著提升对朝向 PSR B1641-45 和 G339 区域 ISM 的理解；脉冲星光子被其间气体放大也展示了地外智慧进行星际通信的一种可行原理。对脉冲星、磁星、快速射电暴或单脉冲等主题的直接联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: The only published instance of natural, fast-switching, stimulated OH emission was observed toward PSR B1641-45. Without having to move the beam, the natural ON and OFF signals in the time-domain from a pulsar were successfully utilized as a unique tool for probing microphysics as well as ISM structures. The amplification of pulsar photons by intervening gas, presumably with non-LTE excitation, also demonstrate a feasible principle for interstellar communication by extraterrestrial intelligence. Recently, we have carried out systematic studies of OH and CH ?-doubling transitions, showing that they both well trace the so-called ``dark-molecular-gas''. The similarity in their astrochemical conditions, distribution, and energy level structures, motivate us to try to detect stimulated emission in CH. If successful, this will be the 2nd such detection as well as the first in a species other than OH. A combined analysis of stimulated emission (or non-detection) with multiple other emission/absorption components in the Parkes beam, will significant improve our understanding of ISM toward PSR B1641-45 and G339 regions. The new UWL currently under commission at Parkes promises critical new capability of carrying out the proposed observations much more efficiently than before. We thus propose to obtain emission, absorption, and stimulated emission (high-cadence spectra in `gated' mode or baseband recording) of HI, OH, and CH, simultaneously. We also propose to map out the OH/CH emission components in the L-band beam to further resolve the origin of those ISM structures.

</details>

Method: 申请使用 Parkes 望远镜 UWL 接收机（700-4000 MHz）以全偏振模式观测四颗 spider MSP——PSR J1048+2339、PSR J1908+2105、PSR J2052+1219、PSR J2256-1024；申请覆盖各自近一个完整轨道，共 23 小时观测时间，包含各 epoch 的设置与校准时间。拟用宽带观测建模光学厚到光学薄过渡区域（光学深度接近 1）的食相谱，并观测食 ingress 与 egress 处 RM 的可能变化。摘要未说明具体的分析流程与统计方法。

Result: 摘要为观测申请，未报告观测结果。摘要仅说明 spider MSP 通常表现出频率依赖的食，且这些系统的食性质迄今尚未在 Parkes UWL 可用频率范围内被探索，所提四颗 MSP 的偏振尚未被研究。根据摘要无法判断实际测量到的食、RM、偏振、轮廓或频谱结果。

Conclusion: 作者提出，宽带宽观测可用于研究这些系统中的食机制，覆盖近一个完整轨道的全偏振观测可支持食相谱建模、RM 变化探测以及偏振、轮廓演化和频谱研究。上述均为拟开展研究的预期目标与科学理由，而非已确立的结论；根据摘要无法判断相关物理机制是否成立及其对磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）或单脉冲研究的可迁移性。

Abstract: We propose observing time with the Parkes telescope to investigate four ``spider" millisecond pulsars (MSPs), PSR J1048+2339 (a redback spider), PSR J1908+2105 (an MSP that occupies a region of parameter space between black widows and redbacks), PSR J2052+1219 and PSR J2256-1024 (black widow spiders). Spider MSPs are commonly seen to exhibit frequency-dependent eclipsing. Observations with wide bandwidth telescopes like Parkes UWL (700-4000 MHz) will be extremely useful to study the eclipse mechanisms in these systems. Eclipse properties of spider MSPs are hitherto unexplored at the frequency regime available with the Parkes UWL receiver. We propose to investigate a sample of 4 MSPs mentioned above (for which polarization has not been studied) with the Parkes telescope using the UWL receiver in full polar mode, which will be addressed with this proposal. One of the aims is to model the eclipse phase spectra using wideband observations of these pulsars in an optically thick-to-thin transitioning regime (optical depth nearly 1), to explore the eclipse mechanism. Observing the possible changes in rotation measure (RM) at eclipse ingress and egress will allow us to probe the magnetic field in the eclipse boundaries. We request to cover nearly one full orbit for each of these MSPs. Thus we propose 23 hours of observing time including time for setup and calibration in each epoch with the Parkes UWL receiver for the investigation of the eclipse mechanism as well as the polarization, profile evolution, and spectra of four spider MSPs.

</details>


### [4609] [Parkes observations for project P1121 semester 2021APRS_03]()
*Chanapote, Thanapol,Jaroenjittichai, Phrudth,Kramer, Michael,Halson, Marcus,Namkham, Nakornping,Sugiyama, Koichiro*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该项目拟利用 Parkes 和 UWL 对模式转换脉冲星开展同时多频全极化观测，以探索基于 Hibschman &amp; Arons（2001）估计带电电流密度的新方法，并研究 PSR B1822-09 模式分离轮廓形状的频率依赖行为，进而扩展到其他模式转换脉冲星。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要指出，本项目希望探索一种基于 Hibschman &amp; Arons（2001）工作估计带电电流密度的新方法，并研究 PSR B1822-09 模式分离轮廓形状显著的频率依赖行为，将其扩展到其他模式转换脉冲星，从而增进对模式转换脉冲星及脉冲星磁层的理解。

Method: 摘要说明将使用 Parkes 和 UWL 获取同时多频全极化观测；计划研究并比较模式间的子脉冲调制、轮廓形状与强度以及极化位置角在时间和频率演化两方面的情况。摘要未说明具体观测频率或频段、时间跨度、样本大小及统计分析方法。

Result: 摘要主要描述项目目标，未报告已获得的具体观测结果。摘要提到的研究内容包括：探索估计带电电流密度的新方法、研究 PSR B1822-09 模式分离轮廓形状显著的频率依赖行为，以及比较两种模式的子脉冲调制、轮廓形状与强度、极化位置角在时间和频率演化方面的情况。摘要未说明数值结果、显著性或其他定量发现。

Conclusion: 作者期望该数据集能为理解模式转换脉冲星以及一般而言的脉冲星磁层提供更多见解；并期望所探索的方法可用于估计带电电流密度，以及将 PSR B1822-09 的研究扩展至其他模式转换脉冲星。这些属于项目目标与预期，而非摘要中已报告的结果。根据摘要无法判断其与快速射电暴（FRB）或磁星的具体联系。

Abstract: This project aims to obtain simultaneous multi-frequency full-polarisation observations of mode-switching pulsars to explore a novel method to estimate the charged current density based on the work by Hibschman &amp; Arons (2001) and to investigate the remarkable frequency-dependent behaviour of the mode-separated profile shape of PSR B1822-09 and expand to the other moding pulsars. This dataset will allow us to investigate and compare between the modes subpulse modulation, profile's shape and intensity, and polarisation position angle in both aspects of time and frequency evolution. Using Parkes and UWL, this dataset will provide more insights in understanding mode-switching pulsars and the pulsar's magnetosphere in general.

</details>

### [4612] [Parkes observations for project P963 semester 2018APRS_01]()
*Johnston, Simon,Kramer, Michael*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案拟利用超宽带接收机，在0.7至4.0 GHz的连续频率范围内对alpha接近90度的interpulse脉冲星进行灵敏观测，以首次回答脉冲星磁层射电辐射高度、其随频率与场线的变化以及波束填充因子等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脉冲星磁层射电辐射仍有关键问题未解：辐射高度、高度在辐射场线之间及随频率的变化、脉冲星波束的整体填充因子。这些问题受未知观测几何影响而复杂化，而对大多数脉冲星，观测几何主要由转动轴与磁轴倾角alpha决定。

Method: 摘要未说明。摘要仅说明拟研究alpha接近90度的interpulse脉冲星，并使用超宽带接收机在0.7至4.0~GHz连续频率范围内进行灵敏观测；未给出望远镜、时间跨度、样本量或具体分析方法等信息。

Result: 摘要未说明。该文为观测提案，摘要说明上述观测将使其首次能够回答辐射高度、高度在辐射场线之间及随频率的变化以及波束填充因子等问题，但未报告任何观测结果、数值或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者提出，通过研究已知alpha接近90度的interpulse脉冲星，并利用超宽带接收机在0.7至4.0~GHz连续频率范围内进行灵敏观测，将首次能够回答关于射电辐射高度、其随频率与场线的变化以及脉冲星波束整体填充因子的问题。根据摘要无法判断进一步的物理诠释及其与磁星或FRB的联系。

Abstract: Key questions about the radio emission from pulsar magnetospheres remain unanswered. These include the height of the radio emission above the surface, and the variations of height across the emitting field lines and as a function of frequency, and the overall filling factor of the pulsar beam. These questions are complicated by the unknown viewing geometry, which is mostly determined by the inclination angle between the rotation and magnetic axes (alpha) for the majority of pulsars. Here, we propose to investigate interpulse pulsars where we know that alpha is close to 90 degrees. We will use the ultra-wide band receiver to make sensitive observations across a continuous frequency range from 0.7 to 4.0~GHz. This will allow us, for the first time, to answer the questions posed above.

</details>

Conclusion: 作者提出，对已知 alpha 接近 90 度的行星际脉冲脉冲星，利用超宽带接收机在 0.7 至 4.0~GHz 连续频率范围内的灵敏观测，将首次使其能够回答上述关于射电辐射高度、其随辐射场线和频率的变化以及波束填充因子的关键问题。根据摘要无法判断具体的物理机制或这些方法是否可迁移至单脉冲、模式转换、脉冲星计时、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）等问题。

Abstract: Key questions about the radio emission from pulsar magnetospheres remain unanswered. These include the height of the radio emission above the surface, and the variations of height across the emitting field lines and as a function of frequency, and the overall filling factor of the pulsar beam. These questions are complicated by the unknown viewing geometry, which is mostly determined by the inclination angle between the rotation and magnetic axes (alpha) for the majority of pulsars. Here, we propose to investigate interpulse pulsars where we know that alpha is close to 90 degrees. We will use the ultra-wide band receiver to make sensitive observations across a continuous frequency range from 0.7 to 4.0~GHz. This will allow us, for the first time, to answer the questions posed above.

</details>


### [4616] [Parkes observations for project P1238 semester 2024OCTS_09]()
*Ahmad, Adeel,Filipovic, Miroslav,Johnston, Simon,Kothes, Roland,Dai, Shi,Barnes, Luke,Lazarevic, Sanja,Smeaton, Zachary*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该提案申请使用Parkes UWL接收机，对与七个PWN候选体成协的SNR方向开展定向射电脉冲星搜寻；这些候选体由SMGPS天区分析识别，而预期的高DM会导致强散射与展宽，UWL的宽频率覆盖（尤其高频）被寄望于规避这些效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 年轻高能脉冲星可驱动从射电到X射线及更高频段的脉冲星风云（PWN）。下一代射电巡天（ASKAP EMU、SMGPS）的灵敏度与高分辨率使识别与PWN和SNR成协的脉冲星候选体成为可能，并可据此指导射电脉冲星搜寻；近期已由此发现两颗驱动弓激波PWN的高DM脉冲星。摘要指出，银道面且可能遥远的SNR预期具有大DM，由此导致的强散射和展宽使这类脉冲星在此前巡天中无法被探测到。

Method: 摘要说明：分析了几片SMGPS天区，识别出七个可能与三个新发现和四个已知银河系SNR成协的PWN候选体；申请使用Parkes UWL接收机对这些PWN所驱动的射电脉冲星开展定向搜寻，并利用UWL的宽频率覆盖、尤其是高频部分来规避高DM带来的散射与展宽。此前策略已通过使用ASKAP EMU射电连续谱图像发现两颗驱动弓激波PWN的高DM脉冲星得到验证。观测时长、灵敏度与具体搜寻/分析方法摘要未说明。

Result: 摘要报告：近期使用ASKAP EMU射电连续谱图像发现了两颗驱动弓激波PWN的高DM脉冲星，证明了以PWN和SNR成协关系指导射电脉冲星搜寻这一策略是成功的；最近分析几片SMGPS天区，识别出七个PWN候选体，它们可能与三个新发现的和四个已知的银河系SNR成协。摘要未给出这些脉冲星或候选体的具体DM数值、显著性、通量或其他测量量。

Conclusion: 作者认为，利用PWN与SNR成协关系指导定向搜寻是有效的，并预期所针对的SNR因位于银道面且可能遥远而具有大DM，因而此前的脉冲星巡天会因强散射和展宽而无法探测到这些脉冲星；Parkes UWL的宽频率覆盖（尤其高频）可规避这些效应，从而提供更好的发现机会。该判断基于摘要中的预期，尚待所提议观测验证；与其他脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）现象的物理联系，根据摘要无法判断。

Abstract: Young and energetic pulsars can power strong pulsar wind nebula (PWN), which can be observed from radio to X-ray and beyond. Leveraging the sensitivity and high-resolution of next-generation radio surveys like ASKAP EMU and SARAO MeerKAT 1.3 GHz Galactic Plane Survey (SMGPS), we are now able to identify pulsar candidates associated with PWNe and SNRs. We can then use these PWN and SNR associations to guide our search of radio pulsars. This strategy was demonstrated successful by our recent discoveries of two high dispersion measure (DM) pulsars powering a bow-shocked PWNe using ASKAP EMU radio continuum images. Recently, we analysed several SMGPS fields and identified seven PWNe candidates potentially associated to three new and four known Galactic SNRs. Here we propose to use the Parkes UWL receiver to carry out the targeted search of radio pulsars powering these PWNe. Since these SNRs are located in Galactic plane and can be distant, we expect them to have large DMs. Such high DMs will lead to strong scattering and smearing and make pulsars undetectable in previous pulsar surveys. The wide frequency coverage of UWL, especially the high frequencies, will allow us to avoid these effects and therefore offer us a better chance to find these pulsars.

</details>

Here we propose to use the Parkes UWL receiver to carry out the targeted search of radio pulsars powering these PWNe. Since these SNRs are located in Galactic plane and can be distant, we expect them to have large DMs. Such high DMs will lead to strong scattering and smearing and make pulsars undetectable in previous pulsar surveys. The wide frequency coverage of UWL, especially the high frequencies, will allow us to avoid these effects and therefore offer us a better chance to find these pulsars.

</details>

### [4625] [Parkes observations for project P1325 semester 2024APRS_04]()
*Ghosh, Ankita,Johnston, Simon,Weltevrede, Patrick,Bhattacharyya, Bhaswati,Roy, Jayanta*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该申请提出利用 Parkes UWL（700-4000 MHz）对三颗 spider 毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1242-4712、PSR J2101-4802 和 PSR J2129-0429 进行观测，以研究其频率依赖的食机制、偏振、轮廓演化和频谱，申请总观测时间为 40 小时。摘要仅陈述申请目标，未给出实际观测结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: spider 毫秒脉冲星轨道紧凑（周期小于一天），伴星质量低（低于 0.9 太阳质量），多数表现出频率依赖的食与食边界附近的线性退偏振；而 Parkes UWL 接收机可及频率范围内这类系统的食特性尚属未知，需要宽频带观测填补这一空白。

Method: 申请使用 Parkes 望远镜及 Parkes UWL 接收机（700-4000 MHz），在 full polar 模式下对 PSR J1242-4712、PSR J2101-4802 和 PSR J2129-0429 三颗 spider MSP 进行观测，通过建模光学厚到光学薄过渡区（光学深度接近 1）的食相位谱，并探测轨道过程中 DM 与 RM 的变化。申请总时间为 40 小时，含设置与校准。摘要未说明具体观测日期与时间跨度。

Result: 摘要为观测时间申请，未报告实际观测结果。摘要陈述的目标为：研究三颗 spider MSP 在不同频率下食持续时间的变化与基本食机制，建模过渡区食相位谱，通过 full polar 偏振约束食区内磁场强度变化，并探测轨道过程中 DM 和 RM 的变化，同时研究偏振、轮廓演化和频谱。

Conclusion: 摘要提出的预期意义是：Parkes UWL 宽频带观测与食相位谱建模、full polar 偏振、DM/RM 轨道变化探测相结合，可为这些 spider MSP 系统特定的食机制提供关键见解。由于仅为观测申请，未给出物理结论。根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、FRB 或单脉冲发射研究的具体联系。

Abstract: We request observation time with the Parkes telescope to investigate the characteristics of three "spider" millisecond pulsars (MSPs): PSR J1242-4712, PSR J2101-4802, and PSR J2129-0429. Distinguished by their remarkably compact binary orbits, these spider MSPs have an orbital period of less than a day and harbor low-mass companions (below 0.9 solar mass), all belonging to the redback spider systems. The majority of spider MSPs exhibit frequency-dependent eclipses with linear depolarization observed near their eclipse boundaries. Using the wide bandwidth of the Parkes UWL telescope (700-4000 MHz), we aim to investigate variations in the duration of eclipses within these systems across different frequencies, while also examining the fundamental eclipse mechanism. Notably, the eclipse properties of spider MSPs remain uncharted within the frequency range accessible by the Parkes UWL receiver. Our proposal aims to investigate three spider MSPs, using the wide bandwidth of Parkes UWL, specifically by modeling eclipse phase spectra in the optically thick-to-thin transitioning regime (optical depth nearly 1). Additionally, a polarization study using the UWL receiver in full polar mode will help constrain magnetic field strength variation within the eclipse region. This includes probing changes in Dispersion Measure (DM) and Rotation Measure (RM) across the pulsar's orbit, offering crucial insights into the system's specific eclipse mechanism. Therefore, we request a total of 40 hours of observing time including setup, and calibration for the investigation of the eclipse mechanisms, polarization, profile evolution, and spectra in these spider MSPs.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 作者提出，通过宽带宽食相位谱建模以及在full polar模式下测量轨道上的DM和RM变化，可约束食区域内的磁场强度变化，并为这些系统的特定食机制提供关键见解。根据摘要无法判断其与FRB或磁星的具体联系。

Abstract: We request observation time with the Parkes telescope to investigate the characteristics of three "spider" millisecond pulsars (MSPs): PSR J1242-4712, PSR J2101-4802, and PSR J2129-0429. Distinguished by their remarkably compact binary orbits, these spider MSPs have an orbital period of less than a day and harbor low-mass companions (below 0.9 solar mass), all belonging to the redback spider systems. The majority of spider MSPs exhibit frequency-dependent eclipses with linear depolarization observed near their eclipse boundaries. Using the wide bandwidth of the Parkes UWL telescope (700-4000 MHz), we aim to investigate variations in the duration of eclipses within these systems across different frequencies, while also examining the fundamental eclipse mechanism. Notably, the eclipse properties of spider MSPs remain uncharted within the frequency range accessible by the Parkes UWL receiver. Our proposal aims to investigate three spider MSPs, using the wide bandwidth of Parkes UWL, specifically by modeling eclipse phase spectra in the optically thick-to-thin transitioning regime (optical depth nearly 1). Additionally, a polarization study using the UWL receiver in full polar mode will help constrain magnetic field strength variation within the eclipse region. This includes probing changes in Dispersion Measure (DM) and Rotation Measure (RM) across the pulsar's orbit, offering crucial insights into the system's specific eclipse mechanism. Therefore, we request a total of 40 hours of observing time including setup, and calibration for the investigation of the eclipse mechanisms, polarization, profile evolution, and spectra in these spider MSPs.

</details>

### [4630] [Parkes observations for project P456 semester 2018OCTS_38]()
*Hobbs, George,Manchester, Dick,Sarkissian, John,Bailes, Matthew,Bhat, Ramesh,Keith, Michael,Coles, William,van Straten, Willem,Toomey, Lawrence,Russell, Chris,Oslowski, Stefan,Kerr, Matthew,Dempsey, James,Shannon, Ryan,Wang, Jingbo,Levin, Yuri,Wen, Linqing,Zhu, Xingjiang,Dai, Shi,Reardon, Daniel John,Spiewak, Renee,Zhang, Lei,Parthasarathy, Aditya*

Main category: scix

TL;DR: 该持续性 Parkes 观测申请旨在维持 PPTA 在脉冲星计时阵列领域的领先地位，继续以 15 至 20 天的节奏在三个不同波长上观测，以改进对超低频引力波背景的限制，直至其最终被探测到，并在探测后继续支持引力波天文学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PPTA 是三个国际脉冲星计时小组中历史最悠久、望远镜和小组规模最小者，但其对非相干引力波背景强度的限制是唯一显著约束理论模型的限制。作者希望借助南天优势、目标专注的小组、校准最好的接收机以及约 15 至 20 天三个不同波长的观测节奏，保持在该领域的领先地位。

Method: 摘要未说明具体数据、分析方法或统计流程。摘要仅说明为持续性 Parkes 观测申请，观测以 15 至 20 天的几乎规则节奏在三个不同波长上进行，用于持续改进对超低频引力波的限制。

Result: 摘要未报告新的观测数值结果。摘要称 PPTA 拥有最好的测量和最好的成果，其对非相干引力波背景强度的限制是唯一能显著约束理论模型的限制，并称已保持领先地位，原因为南天覆盖、规模小但专注的小组、校准最好的接收机以及 15 至 20 天三个不同波长的近乎规则观测节奏。

Conclusion: 作者认为持续 Parkes 观测将持续改进对超低频引力波的限制直至其被探测到，并至少在第一阶段 SKA 能改进灵敏度和观测节奏之前仍有价值；即使引力波背景被探测到，仍需继续观测以支持新兴的引力波天文学领域。根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星单脉冲、磁星、快速射电暴（FRB）、偏振或射电频谱等主题的具体联系。

Abstract: The Parkes Pulsar Timing Array (PPTA) project has three primary goals: (a) detection of gravitational waves from astronomical sources, (b) establishment of a pulsar timescale, and (c) improvement of our understanding of Solar-system dynamics. The PPTA is the oldest of three international pulsar timing groups. We have the smallest telescope and the smallest group, but the best measurements and the best results. Our bound on the strength of the incoherent gravitational wave background is the only bound which significantly constrains theoretical models. We have maintained our leading position because: we have the southern sky; we have a small but well-focussed group; we have the best-calibrated receivers; and we have been able to observe with an almost regular cadence of 15 to 20 days at three different wavelengths. With this proposal we aim to maintain our pre-eminent position in the field. Unlike most observing proposals, this is a continuing proposal for which the observations will continue to improve bounds on ultra-low-frequency gravitational waves until they are finally detected. Continued Parkes observations will remain valuable at least until the first stage of the SKA is able to improve on our sensitivity and observing cadence. Even after the gravitational wave background is detected we will want to continue observations in support of the nascent field of gravitational wave astronomy!

</details>

The PPTA is the oldest of three international pulsar timing groups. We have the smallest telescope and the smallest group, but the best measurements and the best results. Our bound on the strength of the incoherent gravitational wave background is the only bound which significantly constrains theoretical models. We have maintained our leading position because: we have the southern sky; we have a small but well-focussed group; we have the best-calibrated receivers; and we have been able to observe with an almost regular cadence of 15 to 20 days at three different wavelengths. With this proposal we aim to maintain our pre-eminent position in the field. Unlike most observing proposals, this is a continuing proposal for which the observations will continue to improve bounds on ultra-low-frequency gravitational waves until they are finally detected. Continued Parkes observations will remain valuable at least until the first stage of the SKA is able to improve on our sensitivity and observing cadence. Result: 摘要称 PPTA 是三个国际脉冲星计时组中历史最悠久的，拥有最小的望远镜和最小的团队，但拥有最好的测量和最好的结果；其对非相干引力波背景强度的限制是唯一能显著约束理论模型的限制。摘要将领先地位归因于拥有南天、规模小但目标集中的团队、校准最好的接收机，以及以15至20天节奏在三个不同波长上的近乎规则观测。

Abstract: The Parkes Pulsar Timing Array (PPTA) project has three primary goals: (a) detection of gravitational waves from astronomical sources, (b) establishment of a pulsar timescale, and (c) improvement of our understanding of Solar-system dynamics. The PPTA is the oldest of three international pulsar timing groups. We have the smallest telescope and the smallest group, but the best measurements and the best results. Our bound on the strength of the incoherent gravitational wave background is the only bound which significantly constrains theoretical models. We have maintained our leading position because: we have the southern sky; we have a small but well-focussed group; we have the best-calibrated receivers; and we have been able to observe with an almost regular cadence of 15 to 20 days at three different wavelengths. With this proposal we aim to maintain our pre-eminent position in the field. Unlike most observing proposals, this is a continuing proposal for which the observations will continue to improve bounds on ultra-low-frequency gravitational waves until they are finally detected. Continued Parkes observations will remain valuable at least until the first stage of the SKA is able to improve on our sensitivity and observing cadence. Even after the gravitational wave background is detected we will want to continue observations in support of the nascent field of gravitational wave astronomy!

</details>

Result: 摘要报告PPTA是三个国际脉冲星计时组中最早的一个，拥有最小的望远镜和最小的团队，但拥有最好的测量和最好的结果；其对非相干引力波背景强度的限制是唯一能显著约束理论模型的限制。摘要称已保持领先地位，原因包括拥有南天、规模小但重点突出的团队、校准最好的接收机，以及以15至20天几乎规则的节奏在宽带宽上观测。摘要未给出具体数值限制或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为，持续的Parkes观测将持续改进对超低频引力波的限制，直到它们最终被探测到；在SKA第一阶段能够改进灵敏度和观测节奏之前，这些观测至少仍具有价值；即使在引力波背景被探测到之后，仍希望继续观测以支持新兴的引力波天文学领域。根据摘要无法判断该工作与脉冲星单脉冲、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）的具体物理关联。

Abstract: The Parkes Pulsar Timing Array (PPTA) project has three primary goals: (a) detection of gravitational waves from astronomical sources, (b) establishment of a pulsar timescale, and (c) improvement of our understanding of Solar-system dynamics. The PPTA is the oldest of three international pulsar timing groups. We have the smallest telescope and the smallest group, but the best measurements and the best results. Our bound on the strength of the incoherent gravitational wave background is the only bound which significantly constrains theoretical models. We have maintained our leading position because: we have the southern sky; we have a small but well-focussed group; we have the best-calibrated receivers; and we have been able to observe with an almost regular cadence of 15 to 20 days over a wide bandwidth. With this proposal we aim to maintain our pre-eminent position in the field. Unlike most observing proposals, this is a continuing proposal for which the observations will continue to improve bounds on ultra-low-frequency gravitational waves until they are finally detected. Continued Parkes observations will remain valuable at least until the first stage of the SKA is able to improve on our sensitivity and observing cadence. Even after the gravitational wave background is detected we will want to continue observations in support of the nascent field of gravitational wave astronomy!

</details>

Result: 摘要报告：PPTA是三个国际脉冲星计时组中最古老的一个；该组拥有最小的望远镜和最小的团队，但自称拥有最好的测量和最好的结果；其对非相干引力波背景强度的限制是唯一能显著约束理论模型的限制；并称长期以15至20天的几乎规则节奏在宽带宽上观测。摘要未给出具体数值、显著性水平或统计量。

Conclusion: 作者认为，凭借南天覆盖、小而聚焦的团队、校准最好的接收机以及15至20天的几乎规则宽带宽观测节奏，PPTA得以保持领先地位；继续Parkes观测将不断改进对超低频引力波的限制直至其被探测，并在SKA第一阶段改进灵敏度与观测节奏之前保持价值，且在引力波背景被探测后仍应支持新兴的引力波天文学。该工作为计时阵列观测申请，与脉冲星计时直接相关；根据摘要无法判断其与磁星、单脉冲发射、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱或FRB的具体联系。

Abstract: The Parkes Pulsar Timing Array (PPTA) project has three primary goals: (a) detection of gravitational waves from astronomical sources, (b) establishment of a pulsar timescale, and (c) improvement of our understanding of Solar-system dynamics. The PPTA is the oldest of three international pulsar timing groups. We have the smallest telescope and the smallest group, but the best measurements and the best results. Our bound on the strength of the incoherent gravitational wave background is the only bound which significantly constrains theoretical models. We have maintained our leading position because: we have the southern sky; we have a small but well-focussed group; we have the best-calibrated receivers; and we have been able to observe with an almost regular cadence of 15 to 20 days over a wide bandwidth. With this proposal we aim to maintain our pre-eminent position in the field. Unlike most observing proposals, this is a continuing proposal for which the observations will continue to improve bounds on ultra-low-frequency gravitational waves until they are finally detected. Continued Parkes observations will remain valuable at least until the first stage of the SKA is able to improve on our sensitivity and observing cadence. Even after the gravitational wave background is detected we will want to continue observations in support of the nascent field of gravitational wave astronomy!

</details>

Result: 摘要未给出具体观测数值结果，仅称PPTA拥有最好的测量结果和最好的成果，其对非相干引力波背景强度的限制是唯一显著约束理论模型的限制，并称持续的Parkes观测将不断改进对超低频引力波的限制，直到其最终被探测到；具体限制数值、显著性及时间尺度摘要未说明。

Conclusion: 作者认为，继续Parkes观测可保持PPTA在该领域的领先地位，并持续改进对超低频引力波背景的限制；在SKA第一阶段能够改进灵敏度和观测节奏之前，这些观测仍具有价值；即使在引力波背景被探测到后，仍应继续观测以支持新兴的引力波天文学领域。根据摘要无法判断其与脉冲星单脉冲、磁星、快速射电暴或自转减慢力矩变化的具体联系。

Abstract: The Parkes Pulsar Timing Array (PPTA) project has three primary goals: (a) detection of gravitational waves from astronomical sources, (b) establishment of a pulsar timescale, and (c) improvement of our understanding of Solar-system dynamics. The PPTA is the oldest of three international pulsar timing groups. We have the smallest telescope and the smallest group, but the best measurements and the best results. Our bound on the strength of the incoherent gravitational wave background is the only bound which significantly constrains theoretical models. We have maintained our leading position because: we have the southern sky; we have a small but well-focussed group; we have the best-calibrated receivers; and we have been able to observe with an almost regular cadence of 15 to 20 days over a wide bandwidth. With this proposal we aim to maintain our pre-eminent position in the field. Unlike most observing proposals, this is a continuing proposal for which the observations will continue to improve bounds on ultra-low-frequency gravitational waves until they are finally detected. Continued Parkes observations will remain valuable at least until the first stage of the SKA is able to improve on our sensitivity and observing cadence. Even after the gravitational wave background is detected we will want to continue observations in support of the nascent field of gravitational wave astronomy!

Method: 摘要未说明具体的观测、数据处理或分析方法。摘要仅说明作者能够以 15 到 20 天的几乎规律节奏在三个不同波长上观测，并称 Parkes 观测将持续进行，直到 SKA 第一阶段能够改进灵敏度和观测节奏。

Result: 摘要称作者拥有最好的测量结果和最好的成果，其校准最好的接收机、南天覆盖、小而专注的团队以及 15 到 20 天节奏的三个不同波长观测使其保持领先地位。摘要称其对非相干引力波背景强度的限制是唯一能显著约束理论模型的限制。摘要未给出具体数值、显著性、源名称或观测时段。

Our bound on the strength of the incoherent gravitational wave background is the only bound which significantly constrains theoretical models. We have maintained our leading position because: we have the southern sky; we have a small but well-focussed group; we have the best-calibrated receivers; and we have been able to observe with an almost regular cadence of 15 to 20 days at three different wavelengths. Method: 摘要说明PPTA使用Parkes望远镜进行观测，拥有南天、校准最好的接收机，并以15至20天的几乎规则节奏在宽带宽上观测。摘要未说明具体观测频段、数据量、时间跨度、样本数目或分析方法的细节。

Result: 摘要报告PPTA是三个国际脉冲星计时团体中历史最悠久的，拥有最小的望远镜和最小的团队，但具有最好的测量结果和最好成果。其对非相干引力波背景强度的限制是唯一显著约束理论模型的限制。摘要未给出具体数值、不确定性或统计显著性。

Conclusion: 作者认为持续Parkes观测将不断改进对超低频引力波的限制，至少到SKA第一阶段能够改进灵敏度和观测节奏之前仍有价值；即使引力波背景被探测到后，仍需继续观测以支持新兴的引力波天文学。根据摘要无法判断该工作与脉冲星单脉冲、模式转换、偏振、射电频谱或磁星—FRB联系的直接关系。

Abstract: The Parkes Pulsar Timing Array (PPTA) project has three primary goals: (a) detection of gravitational waves from astronomical sources, (b) establishment of a pulsar timescale, and (c) improvement of our understanding of Solar-system dynamics. The PPTA is the oldest of three international pulsar timing groups. We have the smallest telescope and the smallest group, but the best measurements and the best results. Our bound on the strength of the incoherent gravitational wave background is the only bound which significantly constrains theoretical models. We have maintained our leading position because: we have the southern sky; we have a small but well-focussed group; we have the best-calibrated receivers; and we have been able to observe with an almost regular cadence of 15 to 20 days over a wide bandwidth. With this proposal we aim to maintain our pre-eminent position in the field. Unlike most observing proposals, this is a continuing proposal for which the observations will continue to improve bounds on ultra-low-frequency gravitational waves until they are finally detected. Continued Parkes observations will remain valuable at least until the first stage of the SKA is able to improve on our sensitivity and observing cadence. Even after the gravitational wave background is detected we will want to continue observations in support of the nascent field of gravitational wave astronomy!

</details>

The PPTA is the oldest of three international pulsar timing groups. We have the smallest telescope and the smallest group, but the best measurements and the best results. Our bound on the strength of the incoherent gravitational wave background is the only bound which significantly constrains theoretical models. We have maintained our leading position because: we have the southern sky; we have a small but well-focussed group; we have the best-calibrated receivers; and we have been able to observe with an almost regular cadence of 15 to 20 days at three different wavelengths. With this proposal we aim to maintain our pre-eminent position in the field. Unlike most observing proposals, this is a continuing proposal for which the observations will continue to improve bounds on ultra-low-frequency gravitational waves until they are finally detected. Continued Parkes observations will remain valuable at least until the first stage of the SKA is able to improve on our sensitivity and observing cadence. Even after the gravitational wave background is detected we will want to continue observations in support of the nascent field of gravitational wave astronomy!
